74.words: bat (noun): a small flying animal that hangs upside down
74.asset_description: A fruit bat hangs upside down from a cave ceiling at dusk, opens its big eyes and stretches its wings, then drops off and flies out over a still lake under a pink sunset sky, its reflection skimming the water.

79.words: bear (noun): a large heavy wild animal with thick fur
79.asset_description: A huge brown bear charges through a misty river, splashing after a fish, then rears up on its hind legs dripping water, shakes its fur in a spray and stares straight at the camera.

82.words: bee (noun): a flying insect that makes honey and can sting
82.asset_description: A fuzzy bumblebee lands on a purple clover flower in a meadow, crawls over the bloom collecting nectar, then flies across the field to a wooden hive box and squeezes in through the entrance hole.

87.words: bird (noun): an animal with feathers and wings
87.asset_description: A round orange-breasted robin perches on a blossoming branch in a garden, sings with its beak wide open, flutters its wings and tail, then flies off across the lawn and lands on another flowering branch to keep singing.

88.words: dog (noun): an animal kept as a pet that barks
88.asset_description: A person holds a black-and-tan dachshund up to the camera against a blue sky in a garden; the long-eared dog looks around calmly, then leans its nose right into the lens for a close-up sniff.

89.words: cat (noun): a small furry pet that says meow
89.asset_description: A black cat sits on the top platform of a tall cat tower in a bedroom while a tabby cat sits in the level below; the black cat peers over the edge and finally leaps off the tower with its front legs spread wide.

90.asset_description: A happy black pug puppy stands upright on its back legs in a bathtub of shallow water, tongue out, bouncing and paddling its front paws like a little dance in front of shampoo bottles.

133.words: camel (noun): a desert animal with one or two humps
133.asset_description: A camel strides across rippled sand dunes at sunset, then folds its legs, settles down on the sand and chews while looking straight into the camera.

146.words: caterpillar (noun): the young worm-like form of a butterfly
146.asset_description: A close-up of a plump green-and-yellow striped caterpillar crawling along a wet leaf in a misty forest; a green chrysalis hangs from the branch above and a blue butterfly flutters past.

159.words: chicken (noun): a farm bird kept for its eggs and meat
159.asset_description: A brown hen pecks around a whitewashed Greek courtyard with pink flowers, walks into a small wooden coop, settles on the straw and lays an egg, which a woman in a blue dress collects into her basket.

197.words: cow (noun): a large farm animal that gives milk
197.asset_description: On an alpine meadow, a brown-and-white cow with a bell around its neck chews grass while a woman in a traditional dress milks it on a wooden stool; she pours the fresh milk from the pail into a jug, a calf comes to drink, and the cow nuzzles her cheek. Music only, no speech.

201.words: crocodile (noun): a big reptile with a long body and sharp teeth
201.asset_description: A crocodile swims across a muddy river toward the bank, crawls out onto the wet mud and opens its huge jaws wide before settling by the water.

209.words: curious (adjective): wanting to know what is going on
209.asset_description: Filmed from inside a cardboard box, a ginger cat peers down through a round hole, stares at the camera, reaches its paw inside and finally pushes its nose and tongue right up to the lens to investigate.

219.words: deer (noun): a wild forest animal, the males have antlers
219.asset_description: A large red deer stag with tall branching antlers walks through ferns in a misty forest, stops to stare straight at the camera, lets out a bellow, then turns and bounds away into the fog.

236.words: dolphin (noun): a smart sea animal that jumps and plays
236.asset_description: Filmed from a boat, a sleek grey dolphin swims fast alongside the railing just under the surface of the deep blue sea. It then races ahead and leaps high out of the water several times, splashing back down tail-first.

237.words: donkey (noun): a small grey animal with long ears
237.asset_description: A grey donkey with long ears stands on a cobbled village street under an orange tree, staring at the camera and braying loudly with its mouth wide open. It then flops down, rolls happily on its back in the dust, gets up and trots toward the camera.

250.words: duck (noun): a water bird with a flat beak
250.asset_description: A male mallard duck swims on a calm pond under willow trees, tips tail-up to feed underwater with its orange feet in the air, then pops back up. It rears out of the water flapping its wings, settles, and quacks at the camera.

262.words: elephant (noun): a huge grey animal with a long trunk
262.asset_description: A large African elephant stands at a waterhole among white egrets, drinking with its trunk, splashing mud and spraying water over itself. It finishes facing the camera with ears spread wide and trunk raised.

280.asset_description: A tiny orange tabby kitten with huge round eyes sits on a bed and stares straight into the camera. It tilts its head, then reaches out a paw and bats at the lens until its face fills the whole frame in a blurry extreme close-up.

305.words: fly (noun): a small insect with two wings
305.asset_description: At a sunny breakfast table, a black fly buzzes around a glass of tea and lands on a slice of toast spread with red jam. A hand waves a napkin to chase it away, and the fly circles back to perch on the jam jar and the tea glass.

314.words: fox (noun): a wild animal with red fur and a bushy tail
314.asset_description: A red fox with a white chest and bushy tail trots through a frosty autumn meadow between birch trees at sunrise. It walks toward the camera, then does its signature high pounce, diving head-first into the frosty grass to catch something, and shakes itself off.

319.words: frog (noun): a small green animal that jumps and croaks
319.asset_description: A green frog sits on a mossy stone in a koi pond covered with lily pads under red maple leaves. It puffs out its white throat as it croaks, then leaps through the air and lands on a floating lily pad while orange koi fish swim below.

332.words: giraffe (noun): a very tall animal with a long neck
332.asset_description: On a sunny savanna with zebras in the background, a giraffe stretches its long neck to eat leaves from the top of an acacia tree, then splays its front legs wide to drink from a small waterhole.

341.words: goat (noun): a farm animal with horns that climbs well
341.asset_description: A brown-and-white goat with long horns climbs onto a stone wall in a village yard, chews laundry hanging from a clothesline, then walks up onto a rooftop and bleats loudly at the sky.

359.words: hamster (noun): a small furry pet that runs in a wheel
359.asset_description: An orange hamster runs in a wooden wheel in its cage at night, then climbs to a bowl of seeds and stuffs its cheeks until they bulge, burrows through the wood shavings and pops its head out with cheeks still full.

392.words: horse (noun): a large animal people ride
392.asset_description: On a wide green steppe a woman in a traditional brown coat adjusts the bridle of a bay horse that playfully sticks out its tongue, climbs into the saddle and rides off across the grassland toward distant yurts.

415.words: kangaroo (noun): an Australian animal that hops on big back legs
415.asset_description: A red kangaroo bounds across the outback at sunset, stops and stands upright close to the camera, revealing a joey peeking out of its pouch before hopping away into the dusk.

427.words: ladybug (noun): a small red beetle with black spots
427.asset_description: In extreme close-up, a red ladybug with black spots climbs a dewy blade of grass in a sunny flower meadow, then opens its wing covers and flies off into the blue sky.

446.words: lion (noun): a big wild cat with a mane that roars
446.asset_description: A big male lion with a dark mane walks through golden savanna grass at sunset, an acacia tree behind him. He opens his huge mouth and roars straight at the camera, then lies down in the grass.

450.words: lizard (noun): a small reptile with four legs and a long tail
450.asset_description: A small green lizard suns itself on a stone wall in a hot courtyard, lifting its head at the camera. It darts past a cactus and clings to the vertical wall, its long tail hanging down the stone.

483.words: monkey (noun): a clever animal with a long tail that climbs trees
483.asset_description: A macaque monkey climbs a huge banyan tree by a mossy temple, swings along a branch and hangs upside down by its tail. It drops onto a fruit seller's table, grabs a banana while the man waves his hat at it, then sits on a branch peeling and eating the banana.

487.words: mouse (noun): a small furry animal with a long tail
487.asset_description: In a warm-lit wooden barn at night, a little grey mouse peeks out of a hole in the wall and creeps toward a piece of cheese on the floorboards. It sits up, nibbles the cheese held in its tiny pink paws, then scurries back into the hole with its tail sliding in last.

518.words: owl (noun): a round-faced bird that hunts at night
518.asset_description: An extreme close-up of a huge orange eye pulls back to reveal a grey owl staring into the camera. It perches on a branch at dusk, swiveling its head, then spreads its wings and flies off toward the sunset over the forest.

530.words: parrot (noun): a bright tropical bird with a curved beak
530.asset_description: A bright red scarlet macaw perches on a wooden porch railing in front of tropical flowers and banana leaves, flaps a wing, preens its yellow-and-blue feathers, tilts its head and squawks Hello at the camera.

542.words: penguin (noun): a black and white bird that swims but cannot fly
542.asset_description: A gentoo penguin waddles across Antarctic snow toward the camera, flops onto its belly to slide down the ice, then dives into the sea and swims underwater past the ice edge.

550.words: pig (noun): a pink farm animal with a flat nose and short legs
550.asset_description: A big pink pig rolls happily in a muddy patch on a sunny farmyard, gets up, roots in the dirt with its snout, trots across the yard and drinks from a metal bucket while a farmer watches by the fence.

551.words: pigeon (noun): a grey city bird that walks and pecks at crumbs
551.asset_description: A grey pigeon struts between cafe chairs on a cobblestone city square, pecks around with other pigeons near a fountain, then flies up and lands on a terracotta rooftop.

595.words: rabbit (noun): a small animal with long ears and a fluffy tail
595.asset_description: A wild brown rabbit moves through grassy dunes at sunset. It hops between tufts, sits upright on its hind legs with ears tall, nibbles clover, washes its face with its paws and bounds away.

600.words: rat (noun): an animal like a big mouse with a long tail
600.asset_description: At night on a city sidewalk a rat scurries past a parked bike to a pizza box lying on a manhole cover. It stands up on its hind legs, sniffs the steam, grabs a slice and drags it across the pavement down into the open drain, cheese stretching behind.

661.words: shark (noun): a big ocean fish with rows of pointed teeth
661.asset_description: A shark swims through a swirling ring of small silver fish above a coral reef, then glides right up to the camera and opens its tooth-filled mouth in extreme close-up.

665.words: sheep (noun): a farm animal with thick wool that says baa
665.asset_description: A very woolly black-faced sheep grazes on a misty green hillside, lifts its head, bleats loudly with its mouth wide open right into the camera, then turns and trots off toward the flock in the distance.

700.words: snail (noun): a slow small animal that carries its shell
700.asset_description: A close-up of a brown-shelled snail gliding slowly across a wet stone path in the rain, leaving a silvery trail, stretching its antennae and climbing onto an orange autumn leaf.

701.words: snake (noun): a long animal with no legs that slides along
701.asset_description: A pale sand-colored snake slithers down a desert dune, leaving a winding track in the rippled sand, then coils up on a flat black rock and flicks its tongue at the camera.

729.words: squirrel (noun): a small tree animal with a big bushy tail
729.asset_description: In a park full of red autumn maples, a grey squirrel climbs a tree trunk, sits on a branch nibbling a nut by a tree hole, then dashes along a thin branch with an acorn in its mouth and leaps away.

758.words: swan (noun): a large white water bird with a long neck
758.asset_description: A white swan glides on a calm lake, curls its long neck to preen its feathers, dips its orange beak, then rears up flapping its huge wings and splashes across the water past small dark ducks.

780.words: stand (verb): to be upright on your feet
780.asset_description: Three house cats stand fully upright on their hind legs in a row on a plaid bed, holding the pose like little soldiers. One by one they wobble, bat a paw at the camera and drop down, then rise to stand again.

783.words: tiger (noun): a big wild cat with orange fur and black stripes
783.asset_description: A wild tiger pushes through tall dry grass in a jungle, wades chest-deep into a forest river, splashes and snarls toward the camera, then climbs out on the muddy bank.

813.words: turkey (noun): a big farm bird with a red neck and fan tail
813.asset_description: A large male turkey struts around a farmyard in autumn, fanning out its huge brown tail feathers and gobbling, with other turkeys in the background. It hops up onto a hay bale and poses with its tail spread wide.

815.words: turtle (noun): a sea animal with a hard shell on its back
815.asset_description: A sea turtle crawls across white sand between big rocks on a tropical beach, reaches the water and slides in. It then glides underwater over a coral reef and swims up toward the sparkling surface.

827.words: animal (noun): a living thing that moves, like a dog or a bird
827.asset_description: A storybook watercolor scene full of animals - an owl, giraffe, cow, zebra, hippo, dog, pig, goat, hen, lion cub and elephant - slowly turns from black-and-white to full color while printed labels fade away.

879.words: wolf (noun): a wild animal like a big dog that hunts in packs
879.asset_description: A grey wolf walks toward the camera across deep snow on a mountain ridge at dusk, pine forest behind it. It stops, lifts its head and howls, breath steaming in the cold, then turns and trots away.

880.words: wool (noun): the soft hair of sheep used to make clothes
880.asset_description: A cartoon farm girl shears a fluffy sheep, hugs the huge pile of soft wool, spins it on a spinning wheel into a ball of yarn and knits a cream sweater. She then dresses the now-bald lamb in the sweater and it runs off happily across the field.

1344.words: spider (noun): a small creature with eight legs that makes webs
1344.asset_description: A striped garden spider sits in the middle of its dew-covered web, every thread strung with glowing water drops in golden morning light.

1479.words: zoo (noun): a place where wild animals are kept to see
1479.asset_description: Visitors stand on a wooden platform at a zoo while a smiling young woman reaches out to feed a giraffe that stretches its head over the fence, trees and sunlight in the background.

1491.words: butterfly (noun): an insect with large colorful wings
1491.asset_description: Watercolor painting of many butterflies in different colors flying above flowers and trees.

1534.words: horn (noun): a hard pointed growth on an animal's head
1534.asset_description: Two white unicorns in a misty mountain forest, one rearing on its hind legs and a giant one looking down from the clouds, each with a long spiral horn on its forehead.

1653.words: goldfish (noun): a small orange fish people keep as a pet
1653.asset_description: A grey cat seen from behind sits on the floor and stares up at a yellow goldfish swimming in a round glass bowl on a yellow stand.

1729.words: pet (noun): an animal kept at home for company
1729.asset_description: A vintage illustration of a laughing girl in a yellow dress holding a grey cat while a dalmatian dog sits beside her looking up; behind them stands a painter's easel and a vase of brushes.

1762.words: whale (noun): a huge sea animal that breathes air
1762.asset_description: A black-and-white engraving of a man falling into the open mouth of a huge whale-like sea creature with a great curved tail, waves crashing around them.

1855.words: tail (noun): the part at the back end of an animal's body
1855.asset_description: A glowing watercolor peacock on black spreads its huge tail of blue, purple and green feathers with golden eye spots, gold paint splattered below.

1872.words: black (adjective): having the darkest color, like night
1872.asset_description: A vintage engraving of a completely black cat standing on a pile of three old books and bending down to sniff their edge.

1883.asset_description: An old black-and-white engraving of a farmyard: hens, chicks and a rooster peck the ground between wooden fences and low thatched cottages.

1894.words: hedgehog (noun): a small animal covered in sharp spines
1894.asset_description: A cute children's illustration of a hedgehog family tucked into a cozy burrow under a big tree, resting under orange and purple blankets beside a glowing flower lamp.

1941.words: pirate (noun): a sea robber who attacks ships
1941.asset_description: A detailed render of a mouse dressed as a pirate: skull-emblem tricorn hat, brass goggles, red scarf and leather jacket, posing like a little adventurer against a blurred harbor at night.

1967.words: cute (adjective): small and sweet in a way that makes you smile
1967.asset_description: A fluffy white baby fox with huge purple eyes smiles and hugs a branch of pink blossoms while soft pink flower balls float all around it.

1994.words: on top of (preposition): resting on the highest part of something
1994.asset_description: A black cat with yellow eyes sits proudly on top of a tall pile of stacked books, its tail curling down the side, against a pastel sunset sky between green hedges.

2001.words: beak (noun): the hard pointed mouth part of a bird
2001.asset_description: A watercolor portrait of an owl facing the viewer, with huge ringed orange-and-blue eyes and a sharp golden beak at the center of its face.

2002.words: whiskers (noun): the long stiff hairs on a cat's face
2002.asset_description: A vivid painted profile of a cat's head with green eyes; very long white whiskers fan out from its muzzle across the whole picture.

2005.words: crow (noun): a big all-black bird with a harsh call
2005.asset_description: A dark painting of a black crow perched on a bare branch, looking up against a foggy grey forest and cloudy sky.

2048.words: wild (adjective): living in nature, not kept by people
2048.asset_description: A wolf stares straight ahead with piercing yellow eyes while its grey-green body dissolves into swirling leaves and feathers on a white background.

2058.words: reach (verb): to move your arm forward to touch something
2058.asset_description: A brown bear stands high on a wooden ladder leaning against a snowy white fir tree and stretches its paw up to grab a yellow star from the night sky.

2069.words: reindeer (noun): a large deer with antlers from the cold north
2069.asset_description: Santa Claus and his six reindeer hang upside down, tangled in ropes from the blades of a wind turbine; the red sleigh dangles among them and a gift bag lies on the snow below.

2092.words: fluffy (adjective): soft and light, like fur or feathers
2092.asset_description: A very fluffy round blue owl with big dark eyes sits in the snow in a glowing night forest full of blue sparkling lights.

2204.asset_description: A painted Jesus in a white robe gently cradles a woolly white lamb against his chest, eyes lowered, under a soft golden sky.

2212.words: stripes (noun): long thin lines of a different color
2212.asset_description: A white tiger with bold black stripes and pale blue eyes walks straight toward the viewer through snowy mist.

2364.words: bull (noun): a large male animal of the cow family
2364.asset_description: A blue-skinned Hindu god sits cross-legged in falling snow wearing gold necklaces, while a white bull with curved horns stands behind him among snowy trees.

2381.words: claws (noun): the sharp curved nails on an animal's feet
2381.asset_description: A vividly colored owl with big yellow eyes sits on a twisted branch in front of a huge glowing full moon, its sharp claws gripping the wood, in a psychedelic starry night scene.

2499.words: teddy bear (noun): a soft cuddly toy animal for children
2499.asset_description: Two soft teddy-bear-like bears, a big one and a small one, sit cuddling together on a path in a green fir forest dotted with falling snow.

2525.words: lift (verb): to take hold of something and move it
2525.asset_description: A flat cartoon mother bear stands in dark hills at night and lifts her small baby bear up high, so the cub can reach for the yellow stars next to a crescent moon.

2648.words: ant (noun): a tiny insect that lives in large groups
2648.asset_description: A glossy black ant with yellow-striped legs and antennae is shown huge in a neon pink and purple 3D scene, standing beside a giant letter A on a fuzzy pink floor.

2682.words: attack (verb): to suddenly try to hurt someone with force
2682.asset_description: A tiger leaps straight at the viewer off a grey boulder, mouth wide open showing its fangs and front claws stretched out, with a misty green jungle valley behind it.

3191.words: to hug (verb): to put your arms around someone tightly
3191.asset_description: Children's-book illustration of a long-haired girl in a blue dress holding a big black-and-white cat tightly against her chest with both arms and grinning; yellow stars and paw prints fill the purple background.

3283.words: seagull (noun): a big white and grey bird that lives by the sea
3283.asset_description: Flat vector illustration of a black-and-white seagull standing on top of a red coin-operated tower viewer on a wooden pier, with the blue sea and sky behind it.

3323.words: hippo (noun): a very big grey animal that lives in rivers
3323.asset_description: Soft watercolour drawing of a baby hippo lying on the grass with its chin resting on one front foot, big brown eyes looking up, with white daisies growing around it.

3369.words: to smell (verb): to inhale the odor of something
3369.asset_description: Soft blue-grey watercolour of a fluffy baby rabbit standing up and holding the stem of a large blue flower in its paws, eyes closed and nose pressed into the petals as it sniffs it.

3485.words: to touch (verb): to put your hand or finger on something
3485.asset_description: A woman in a long orange dress reaches up and lays her open hand on the trunk of a huge elephant standing in front of her in a warm, dusty jungle clearing.

3585.words: zebra (noun): a wild horse with black and white stripes
3585.asset_description: Muted painting of misty green hills: three striped zebras stand on the grass, the nearest one with its head down eating, with small trees and fog in the valleys behind.

3619.words: eagle (noun): a large strong bird that hunts
3619.asset_description: Soft painted scene of a misty river at dawn. A large eagle with a white head and wide spread wings glides high over the pale water, with flat marshy banks, reeds and distant palm trees below.

3663.words: llama (noun): a tall woolly Andean animal that carries loads
3663.asset_description: Poster illustration of Patagonia: a brown and white llama-like animal stands on a grassy ridge and looks back over its shoulder, with a blue lake, green hills and sharp snowy peaks behind it in the evening light.

3777.words: wings (noun): the parts a bird or plane uses to fly
3777.asset_description: A glowing golden firebird hovers above still water at sunset with both wings spread wide, sparks scattering around it and rocky cliffs on either side.

4009.words: line (noun): people or things standing one beside another
4009.asset_description: A cartoon flock of white ducks waddles down a winding gravel path through a bright green alpine valley. They walk one behind another in a long unbroken row, orange feet slapping the gravel, with dandelions, a wooden fence and a farmhouse on the hillside behind them.

4020.words: watch (verb): to look at something carefully
4020.asset_description: A black labrador stands in a shallow forest creek with the water around its legs, head lowered towards the surface. A small brown frog swims slowly across the water just in front of its nose. The dog holds completely still and keeps its eyes fixed on the frog as it paddles away between the reflections of the ferns and trees.

4024.words: follow (verb): to go or travel behind someone
4024.asset_description: A man in a white shirt and yellow rubber boots stands at the open door of a red barn on a muddy farmyard. Brown hens stream out of the doorway past him. A goat, a large black and pink pig and a goose come out next and walk after him, and the camera backs away as they come. Finally three white alpacas walk out of the barn and follow the camera closely, the leading one filling the frame with its face.
4024.transcript: Guys, it's not all sunshine and rainbows. Oh, wait. Hang on. It might actually be.

4055.words: dinosaur (noun): a huge extinct reptile from long ago
4055.asset_description: A husky with blue eyes sits on a teal leaf-patterned bed in front of a brown buttoned headboard. Two large plastic toy dinosaurs, a red-brown one and a dark grey one, are held up in front of it by hands out of shot, their jaws open and teeth bared, and they snap towards the dog from both sides. The husky opens its mouth, tips its head back and howls at them, then paws at the grey one. At the end the dinosaurs are set down on the bed and the husky sits between them panting with its tongue out.

4065.words: driver (noun): the person who drives a motor vehicle
4065.asset_description: A shot from the back of an open-topped sports car parked on a forest road. A big white Samoyed dog in a turquoise harness sits upright in the driver's seat with its front paws resting by the steering wheel, staring straight ahead through the windscreen. A beagle sits in the passenger seat with its tongue out, a grey cat perches on the centre console between them, and a raccoon looks over from the narrow rear seat. Tall pine trees and mist fill the view ahead; nobody moves and the car does not start.

4077.words: asleep (adjective): in a state of sleep
4077.asset_description: An animated night scene on a rooftop ledge, with a full moon and the blurred lights of a city behind. Two plump pigeons are asleep side by side in a big twig nest, a teal one and a white and pink one, both with their eyes closed and their heads tipped together. The teal pigeon suddenly jerks awake, beats its wings and lifts out of the nest, hovering for a moment while the other stays fast asleep with its eyes still shut. He drops back down beside her and settles, but stays sitting bolt upright with his eyes wide open, staring into the dark while she sleeps on.
4077.transcript: It's here. Probably just a mosquito. Go back to sleep.

4089.words: dance (verb): to move your body to music
4089.asset_description: A night dive on white sand: two black-gloved hands hold out a small action camera and an octopus reaches out and takes it. The picture then becomes the octopus's own point of view — its head and arms in the foreground as it crawls low over the sand, past dark rocks, and down a narrow gully. It arrives in what looks like an underwater nightclub: glowing red jellyfish hang overhead like lamps, blue laser beams sweep the water, and a crowd of octopuses, one wearing white sunglasses, waves its arms and dances under the lights.

4094.asset_description: A camera mounted on a horse follows its day on a desert ranch. First a close-up of the horse's muzzle dripping water as it drinks from a concrete trough, red rock cliffs behind it. Then a barn corner where a trolley is stacked high with brightly coloured sacks of animal feed in red, blue, green, yellow and pink, with a green shovel leaning beside it. Then a black horse and a chestnut horse stand nose to nose eating pale green hay from a big round metal feeder at sunrise. Finally the horse walks down a dirt road lined with tall golden poplars.

4096.words: free (adjective): able to do what you want, not held back
4096.asset_description: Underwater on bright white sand in clear turquoise water. A green sea turtle is tangled in a heavy brown rope net, unable to move. Two snorkellers in fins hold the turtle steady and work at the ropes with their hands, then one cuts the strands away with a black-handled knife. They peel the net back off the shell and flippers. Freed, the turtle glides away over the pale sand, its shadow following beneath it.

4107.words: cover (verb): to provide something with a covering
4107.asset_description: Filmed from the audience of a circus. An elephant stands alone in the sawdust ring under a spotlight. A huge grey sheet is dropped from above and floats down over the elephant until the whole animal is hidden under the cloth, which spreads out across the ring floor. A performer in a dark red suit stands beside the covered shape with his arm out. The sheet is then pulled away and a white tiger with black stripes walks out where the elephant had been, padding across the ring towards the audience and snarling at the camera.

4111.asset_description: A man in a black T-shirt, jeans and mirrored sunglasses kneels in the dirt beside a weathered wooden barn, holding a hammer and laying out fresh pale timber boards. A big woolly ram with curled horns walks straight up behind him and shoves its head into his side, pushing him against the barn wall. He shouts, braces one hand on the wall and tries to keep working, but the ram butts him again and again. In the last shot he is sitting slumped on the ground with the hammer still in his hand, head back, while the ram stands over him.
4111.transcript: with spring right around the corner. Ow! Oh my God! I'm sick of these goats. We're definitely having lamb chops tonight. Oh my God.

4127.asset_description: A red dirt track through a dry pine forest. A white and chestnut sifaka lemur comes bounding down the track towards the camera, hopping upright on its back legs with its arms held out. It stops right in front of the camera, sitting up on its hind legs, and a woman's hand offers it a small piece of orange carrot, which it takes in both black hands and nibbles. While it eats, the hand reaches out and strokes the thick white fur of its chest and belly, running over it slowly again and again while the lemur sits still and lets her, staring straight into the camera with big orange eyes.
4127.transcript: Here, have some carrot. It's so silky, so soft.

4138.asset_description: A man in a white cap kneels on the tarmac drive outside a house and holds out both hands as an old golden retriever steps out of the open door towards him. He takes its head in both hands, rubs its ears and cheeks and kisses the top of its nose. The next shot is inside the open boot of a car, where the dog sits on a blanket beside him with a pink lead and licks at a small tub of vanilla ice cream he holds out. Then in the fenced back garden the dog runs to him across the grass and he crouches down, laughing, and rubs both hands through the fur of its back and sides.

4144.words: tube (noun): a long hollow pipe for liquids or gases
4144.asset_description: A plastic storage box on a wooden floor is filled to the top with pink packing peanuts, and a ferret is digging in the middle of it with only its head showing. Pink peanuts lie scattered all over the floor. A long grey ribbed tube lies bent in a loop on the floor next to the box. Ferrets jump out of the box, run across the wooden floor, dive into one end of the tube and pop out of the other, while another ferret keeps swimming through the peanuts in the box.

4168.asset_description: A split-screen cartoon of the old fable. In the top half a brown hare bounds over a grassy hill, then sits down, then lies flat on its back asleep. In the bottom half a tortoise plods forward step by step with a purple butterfly beside it and never stops. Behind them the sky turns from green daylight to an orange sunset and then to a starry night with a crescent moon, and the tortoise is still walking.

4169.words: look (noun): the act of turning your eyes toward something
4169.asset_description: A man in an Alaska cap and a black hood films himself from a canoe on a wide green river with bushes along the bank. Two brown bears are swimming in the water behind him and one of them comes right up alongside the boat. He keeps his face to the camera and turns only his eyes for a long sideways look at the bear beside him, then relaxes into a grin as it swims past.

4170.words: save (verb): to keep someone safe from harm
4170.asset_description: An animated hen leads four yellow chicks across a frozen lake, one chick carrying a white daisy. The ice splits into sharp plates and gives way; the hen and a chick drop into the blue water below and sink among the bubbles. The hen swims up and breaks the surface holding the soaked chick against her chest, lifts it out onto solid ice, and stands over all the chicks huddled together again.

4172.words: escape (noun): the act of getting away from a place
4172.asset_description: A grass field burns at dusk in an animated film. A hen snatches up her nest of chicks and flies low over the fire, then lands in a river and pushes through the current with the nest held above the water. She wades out on the far bank, sets the chicks down and drops onto the stones, worn out, while the wildfire still glows on the hillside behind her.

4177.words: mouth (noun): the opening you eat and speak through
4177.asset_description: A hen runs over a grassy hilltop at sunset carrying a small cloth sack, then climbs a sheer grey rock face with the sack in her beak. At a ledge she tips grain out of the sack into a nest where three grey hawk chicks stretch up with their mouths open wide to be fed. At night the adult hawk lands in front of her beside the sack, wings spread and eyes hard on her.

4184.words: bring (verb): to take something with you somewhere
4184.asset_description: A small curly apricot-coloured poodle puppy stands on a living-room carpet over a white dome-shaped ball machine with a yellow tennis ball sitting in its opening. The puppy takes the ball, the machine shoots it away down the room, and the puppy runs off after it. It comes back down the carpet with the ball in its mouth and drops it into the hole in the top of the machine, then waits for the next shot. The same round repeats.

4186.words: return (verb): to go or come back to a place
4186.asset_description: On a blue tennis court in bright sun, an apricot goldendoodle stands next to an orange and white egg-shaped ball machine placed on the service line. A tennis ball is hit over the net towards the dog. The dog runs off across the court after it while a person stands waiting at the far baseline. The dog comes back to the machine with the yellow ball in its mouth, drops it into the opening on top and stands beside the machine waiting for the next ball.

4187.asset_description: Four parrots sit in a row on the back of a beige sofa in front of white curtains: a grey African grey, a white cockatoo with a yellow crest, a blue and gold macaw and a small green parrot. A hand holds a blue and white toy pistol up at them from below and 'shoots' one bird after another. Each parrot in turn flops sideways onto the sofa and lies there motionless with its feet in the air, playing dead, until the whole row has fallen over.

4189.asset_description: In a wooden-floored hallway a hand holds a black dog bowl full of brown dry food and pushes a small white pill down into the middle of it, then covers the spot with a dollop of white yoghurt. A black and white husky comes to the bowl and eats. When it lifts its head the bowl is put down on the floor: all the food and the yoghurt are gone and only the single white pill is left lying on the bare bottom of the bowl. The husky sits in the doorway and stares into the camera.

4190.asset_description: A ginger and white cat sits on a low stone ledge outside a zoo enclosure, at the black iron bars. On the other side a huge male lion with a dark mane walks straight up to the bars and lowers its head until its face is right in front of the cat, the two noses almost touching through the bars. A lioness comes up behind and bares her teeth. The cat stays sitting where it is; the lions turn and walk away across the muddy enclosure, and the cat sits calmly at the bars with visitors watching in the distance.

4205.words: carry (verb): to move while holding something in your hands
4205.asset_description: A golden hamster comes along a sunlit garden path with a white daisy held in its mouth. It stumbles and goes flat on its face on the paving, the daisy still with it, lies there a moment with its eyes shut, then pushes itself up, sits back on its haunches and holds the daisy against its chest, facing the camera in the low evening light.

4225.words: dish (noun): a plate or bowl for holding or serving food
4225.asset_description: A golden hamster sits on a white kitchen counter beside the sink, eating a green scouring pad out of a small round white dish. A white box like a phone box is set down next to the dish and a second hamster peeks in from the right. The hamster leaves the dish, sniffs along the edge of the box and nibbles at its lid until the box opens to show a yellow and green sponge inside, then rears up on its back legs.

4230.words: seat (noun): a space reserved for sitting
4230.asset_description: At night, a torch shines into the open window of a dark red pickup truck. A golden retriever in a camouflage jacket and cap sits upright in the driver's seat with a paw on the steering wheel, staring back at the camera. In the seat beside it a dachshund in an orange hat sits stiffly. Nobody moves for a long moment. Then the shot cuts to the truck's red tail lights speeding away down an unlit country road.
4230.transcript: Evening. Where y'all coming from? Oh, you know, we were just out there hunting squirrels. Why does your friend look like that? Dispatch, I got a vehicle fleeing. Code 3.

4232.words: show (noun): the act of entertaining people in public
4232.asset_description: At a marine park with palm trees and empty rows of stadium seating, a shirtless man crouches at the edge of a big turquoise pool holding a large silver ball and talks to a bottlenose dolphin resting at the wall. The dolphin lifts its head and listens, then backs off into open water, launches itself high into the air upside down and strikes the ball away with its tail. The man leaps up with both hands on his head, mouth wide open, watching the ball fly off into the blue sky.
4232.transcript: Hey buddy, do you like Messi? Do you like Ronaldo? Can you show us Ronaldo's overhead kick?

4246.words: blue (noun): the blue color, like a clear sky
4246.asset_description: Inside a wooden aviary with wire mesh walls in a green wood, a young woman in a green T-shirt and a baseball cap holds a large peacock in her arms and laughs. The bird's deep blue neck and chest fill most of the frame, its crest standing up on its head and its scaly clawed feet dangling against her arm. It leans its head in towards her face, and at the end stretches its long blue neck straight towards the camera until the shining blue feathers fill the shot.
4246.transcript: Sometimes you just gotta add them to your video. Ready? See? They just, you know.

4249.words: back (noun): the rear part of the body from neck to bottom
4249.asset_description: A first-person view from the back of a flying red dragon. Two hands grip a saddle horn in the bottom of the frame and the dragon's broad red back, covered in rows of dark spikes running down the spine, stretches away in front. The dragon glides over green valleys, blue lakes and waterfalls, then tips forward and dives towards a canyon where two waterfalls fall into a river. It raises its head and blows a burst of fire up into the sky with its wings spread wide, and finally levels off and glides towards a golden sunset over a wide lake.

4257.asset_description: An animated pond scene. A baby panda and a small green turtle swim underwater below a big lily pad, blowing streams of bubbles, while a grumpy fish watches from behind. They shoot up out of the water and fly through the air above a sunlit bamboo forest with their arms and legs flung out and shocked faces. Then the panda sits on a huge floating lily pad with the turtle clamped in a tight hug against its chest, arms wrapped right around the shell; the grumpy fish pokes its head out of the water below. The last shot shows the panda squeezing the turtle close among pink water lilies.

4261.words: sunny (adjective): bright and pleasant, full of sun
4261.asset_description: A rectangular garden pool with a blue rim and clear turquoise water stands on a lawn in bright sunshine, with a row of small conifers and a dark fence behind it. Two Jack Russell terriers swim in the pool pushing a big red ball with their noses. One paddles across the pool nudging the ball ahead of it towards the camera, water sparkling in the sun, while the second dog swims behind. At the end the red ball rests against the sunlit edge of the pool in close-up with the second terrier still paddling towards it.

4266.asset_description: A shaggy grey dog tears across a wide, wet dark-sand beach below green cliffs on an overcast day. It wheels round, sprints up the grassy dune straight at the camera until its fur fills the screen, then throws itself down in the long grass and rolls on its back with all four legs in the air, a collar round its neck.

4281.words: change (noun): when something passes from one state to another
4281.asset_description: A guide in a khaki shirt stands in dense green rainforest holding a leafy twig with a bright green chameleon on it, grinning into the camera. He slides a piece of rough brown bark under the animal; it steps across onto the wood and its skin turns from green to a striped orange-brown that matches the bark exactly. He stares at it wide-eyed and delighted.

4350.words: bell (noun): a hollow metal device that rings when struck
4350.asset_description: An illustrated alpine scene. A boy in a flat cap, white shirt and red waistcoat runs down a dirt track waving a thin stick above his head, driving a small herd of brown-and-white cows ahead of him. Each cow has a big brass bell hanging from a wide collar under its neck, drawn large and golden in the foreground. A wooden chalet with a stone base and a shingled roof stands on the slope behind them. The meadow is full of small white, yellow and blue wildflowers; further down the valley there are haystacks, barns, a blue lake and snow-capped peaks under heavy purple clouds.

4376.words: noise (noun): sound of any kind, often unpleasant
4376.asset_description: A woman lies on the grass in a dog park filming herself. A small fluffy white dog plants itself right in front of the camera, opens its mouth wide and starts barking at it. A big spotted dog and a large black-and-white dog behind join in with their heads up and mouths open, and the two women sitting behind pull shocked faces and clap their hands over their ears while the little dog keeps going.

4501.words: insect (noun): a small air-breathing creature with six legs
4501.asset_description: A soft cartoon illustration of a plump green caterpillar with yellow stripes resting along a big green leaf in a sunny garden. It has a small smiling face with pink cheeks and a row of little round legs gripping the leaf. A bite-shaped piece is missing from the edge of the leaf just in front of it, with one crumb of leaf floating away. Behind it are rounded bushes, pink, blue and yellow flowers and sparkles of light.

4747.words: seagull (noun): a big white and grey bird that lives by the sea
4747.asset_description: An older man in a flat cap and a dark knitted cardigan stands at the stern rail of a ferry crossing the Bosphorus at dusk, with the wake churning white behind him and a domed mosque and the city skyline on the shore. He holds a torn piece of bread in one hand and holds crumbs out in the other. One big white and grey sea bird glides in from the left at head height with its wings fully spread; then a second and a third arrive, and by the end of the clip a dozen of them are hanging in the air all around him, wings out and red beaks open, some almost within touching distance while he laughs.

4961.words: pet (noun): an animal kept at home for company
4961.asset_description: A living room with a balcony full of houseplants. A grey tabby house cat lies flat on a rug with its belly to the floor, eyes locked on a small grey toy mouse on the wooden floor in front of it. Its owner sits at a low table behind, watching open-mouthed and covering his mouth with excitement. The cat wiggles, springs forward at the toy, then settles on the floor with its paws crossed, looking straight at the camera while the man throws up his hands.

5319.words: web (noun): a network formed by weaving threads
5319.asset_description: A blue ballpoint-pen drawing: a wide spider web is strung between bare tree branches, and a large spider hangs on a thread just below it. Drops hang along the web threads, a single leaf drifts down, and patterned flowers fill the bottom of the page.

5359.words: hippo (noun): a very big grey animal that lives in rivers
5359.asset_description: A ranger in a khaki uniform and cap stands on a wooden jetty over green river water and points behind her, eyes wide and mouth open in surprise. A large grey hippo floats just off the deck with its head and back above the water, then sinks lower and lower until only its nostrils and finally just ripples are left on the surface, while she keeps staring at the camera.

5507.words: zoo (noun): a place where wild animals are kept to see
5507.asset_description: A young man in a bright palm-print shirt tours a zoo holding a spotting sheet of animal pictures. He crouches on the grass and lets a goat eat a handful of hay out of his hands, then stands at a glass pool where penguins stand on the rocks and swim past him, and finally holds a leafy branch up to a giraffe that leans over the wooden fence and takes the leaves with its tongue.

318.words: friendship (noun): the bond between friends who care for each other
318.asset_description: A cartoon girl sits sadly on a boardwalk next to her dropped ice cream cone. Her friend arrives with a fresh ice cream, sits beside her, asks 'Bad day?' and gives her half. They share the ice cream, high-five, cheer up and walk off into the sunset with an arm around each other.
318.transcript: Hey! Bad day? The worst. Here. Half for you. You're the best!

654.words: secret (noun): something you know but must not tell others
654.asset_description: On a lantern-lit rooftop at dusk, an animated young woman pulls her friend close and whispers a secret into her ear; the friend gasps, they both press fingers to their lips going shh, then sit side by side acting innocent when a man peeks over and asks what they are doing.
654.transcript: Come here. Closer. Really? Shh! What are you two doing?

872.words: whistling (noun): making a high sound by blowing through your lips
872.asset_description: At a garden table under a lemon tree, a young man whistles and coaches his friend to do it too. Her first tries produce only air, but she keeps puckering her lips and finally gets a real whistle out, and they both cheer.
872.transcript: *whistling* Nothing, just air! *whistling* *whistling* That's it, you did it! *whistling*

2820.words: share (verb): to use one thing together with someone
2820.asset_description: Two smiling 3D-cartoon girls, one dark-haired in a white top and one blonde in a pink dress, stand side by side at a table and hold the same open white book between them, both looking down at its pages.

3019.words: to smile (verb): to make a happy face by turning your mouth up
3019.asset_description: A bright anime illustration of a long-haired girl in a white top smiling straight at the viewer and holding up two fingers, with a second grinning girl walking behind her across a sunny green meadow.

4023.asset_description: Seen from above, a young man in swim shorts jumps off a bridge into a green river and drops towards a blue inflatable dinghy where two friends are lying. He hits the water beside them with a big splash and disappears under the surface. He comes up, grabs the side of the dinghy and hauls himself on board. All three end up standing and grappling on the wobbling dinghy, laughing and shoving each other while small motorboats sit moored along the wooded bank.

4050.words: friend (noun): a person you know well and like a lot
4050.asset_description: Two young men stand barefoot on the open tailgate of a van in the desert at sunrise with their fists raised, cheering. The white van drives along a coast road above the ocean. Inside, the van is lined with pale wood and fairy lights, and a black dog in a red bandana lies on a wooden bunk while a hand reaches in to stroke it. At night four friends and the dog sit in camping chairs in a circle around a small fire pit in the sand beside the lit van. Finally the four of them and the dog sit in a row on the tailgate, backs to the camera, watching an orange sunset over the sea.
4050.transcript: Hey kids, it's your dad here. Been on the road for four years now, living out my childhood dreams. Home isn't a place, it's the people you're with.

4057.words: cola (noun): a fizzy drink flavored with kola nuts
4057.asset_description: In a white kitchen a man in a blue zip sweater and sunglasses holds a large bottle of cola in both hands and shakes it hard, looking at the camera. Filmed from inside the house through a patio door, he goes out into the garden, sets the bottle down carefully on a low brick wall beside a garden shed and walks away. A woman in a turquoise sweatshirt and lilac leggings comes and sits on the wall next to the bottle, picks it up and twists the cap. The cola erupts in a tall brown jet straight up into her face and over her clothes; she jumps up, soaked, and throws her hands in the air.

4594.words: together (adverb): with each other, close or touching
4594.asset_description: A young woman in a party dress cries hard, tears running down her cheeks as she presses a tissue to her face. The camera pulls back to show she is in the middle of a group of friends in evening clothes, all of them crying and laughing at the same time. They press in on each other, arms round shoulders and backs, until the whole group ends up in one tight knot of people hugging.

4760.words: share (verb): to use one thing together with someone
4760.asset_description: On a sunlit cobbled street in Lisbon two teenagers stand face to face with a single ice cream cone between them; he hands it across to her and they slap hands. They then run together along the rails after a yellow tram. The scene cuts to a wooden jetty at sunset where a group of friends dance, then pull into one tight huddle with their arms around each other, silhouetted against the low sun.

156.words: chest (noun): the front upper part of the body
156.asset_description: A young runner in a blue race shirt pants at the finish line, gets a gold medal hung around his neck, and proudly presses both hands to his chest where the medal rests.

437.words: leg (noun): one of the long body parts you walk on
437.asset_description: A runner on the Great Wall of China stretches one leg high up on the stone parapet, then sprints up the steep stairs with close-ups of her legs and feet, finishing with her hands on her knees, breathing hard and smiling.

913.words: arm (noun): the human limb between the shoulder and the hand
913.asset_description: A low-angle close-up of a woman in a climbing gym, her chalk-dusted arm stretched fully overhead as her hand grips a big blue hold on the colorful bouldering wall.

956.words: brain (noun): the organ in the head we think with
956.asset_description: A woman in a white lab coat, pen between her teeth, holds an anatomical brain model up with both hands and studies it; a model skull sits on the desk in front of her.

1069.asset_description: An extreme close-up of a person's open green-brown eye with long lashes and the eyebrow above it, filling the whole frame.

1070.words: face (noun): the front of the head, from forehead to chin
1070.asset_description: Close-up of a young woman's freckled face as she laughs, lit by warm golden-hour light with a blurred street behind her.

1076.words: finger (noun): any of the long parts on your hand, not the thumb
1076.asset_description: Macro shot of an index finger reaching out to touch a clear water drop hanging from the tip of a green leaf.

1088.words: foot (noun): the part of the leg below the ankle
1088.asset_description: Close-up of a bare foot rising onto its toes mid-step in dewy green grass, with rolled-up trousers above the ankle.

1129.words: heart (noun): the muscular organ in your chest
1129.asset_description: A doctor with a stethoscope around his neck sits at a desk and points at a large anatomical model of a human heart he holds in his other hand.

1161.words: knee (noun): the joint in the middle of your leg
1161.asset_description: A man sits on a locker-room bench grimacing in pain as he presses a dripping ice pack against his bent knee with both hands.

1214.words: neck (noun): the part that connects the head to the body
1214.asset_description: A close-up on black background of a woman tilting her head far to the side, her hand behind her ear, so the long stretched line of her neck with its tendons fills the frame.

1314.words: shoulder (noun): the body part between the neck and the arm
1314.asset_description: In a clinic, a physiotherapist examines a woman's shoulder as she raises her arm behind her head, pressing carefully on the joint, an anatomy poster on the wall.

1400.words: throat (noun): the passage to your stomach and lungs
1400.asset_description: In a doctor's office, a woman opens her mouth wide and holds her neck while a doctor shines a small penlight into her mouth to examine her throat.

1403.words: toe (noun): one of the five small end parts of the foot
1403.asset_description: A close-up of bare feet on a sunny beach: the toes curl and dig into the wet sand, flicking it up, as sea foam washes in beside them.

1404.words: tongue (noun): the soft muscular part inside your mouth
1404.asset_description: On a snowy winter street, a young woman in a beanie, scarf and mittens sticks out her tongue to catch a single snowflake resting on its tip.

1454.words: waist (noun): the narrow middle of the body above the hips
1454.asset_description: A woman in dark sports clothes stands among houseplants and wraps a yellow measuring tape around her bare waist, looking down to read the number.

1656.words: lips (noun): the two soft edges of your mouth
1656.asset_description: A watercolor of a woman's face with closed eyes: shiny red lips, purple-pink eye shadow and dark lashes floating on white paper.

1926.words: teeth (noun): the hard white things in your mouth for biting
1926.asset_description: A psychedelic painting of a human skull covered in swirling rainbow patterns with a feather-like crest; its full row of grinning teeth is the brightest, most detailed part of the image.

1961.words: bone (noun): the rigid tissue that makes up the skeleton
1961.asset_description: A grinning human skeleton leans over a large open book while small red hearts and pale smoke swirl around its skull and ribcage.

2097.words: ear (noun): the part of your head you hear with
2097.asset_description: A watercolor painting of a cute furry brown creature with enormous round ears bigger than its head, wearing a red sweater and green shorts, standing next to a yellow orange fruit.

2257.words: eyebrows (noun): the lines of hair above your eyes
2257.asset_description: A soft colored-pencil portrait of a woman with thick dark eyebrows that join in the middle, her hair braided up with flowers, wearing long earrings and a high-collared cream blouse.

2734.words: nose (noun): the organ of smell in the middle of the face
2734.asset_description: A painted white-and-ginger cat with huge pink ears, big green eyes and a small pink nose sits on green moss on a white background, wearing a thick crown of leaves and bright flowers.

2951.words: hand (noun): the end of the limb you grab things with
2951.asset_description: Digital artwork of two blue painted hands reaching toward each other from above and below, fingertips almost touching around a jagged red shard, against glowing pink and blue storm clouds.

3070.words: hands (noun): the parts at the ends of your arms
3070.asset_description: Pencil drawing on aged paper: two open cupped hands rise from the bottom of the page, and above them a bare tree made of sketched branches and geometric shapes seems to grow out of nothing.

3192.words: eyes (noun): the two body parts you see with
3192.asset_description: Bold vector portrait, close up, of a woman wrapped in a deep blue headscarf that covers her hair, nose and mouth so that only her brown eyes, eyebrows and lashes are visible.

3671.words: to spread your arms (phrase): to open your body wide, hands out to each side
3671.asset_description: Swirling painted illustration of the Christ statue seen from the front: the tall robed figure stands with both arms stretched straight out to the sides, high above a green hill, with curling blue and yellow clouds all around.

4202.words: belly (noun): the front of the body between chest and hips
4202.asset_description: Two dachshunds lie flat on their backs on a sunny concrete patio with their bellies turned up to the sun and their legs flopped out. A hand comes into the shot holding a white kitchen turner and hovers it over the nearest dog's belly, as if about to flip it like something cooking. The dogs do not move; a third dachshund in a green collar walks up to the spatula at the end.

4596.words: nose (noun): the organ of smell in the middle of the face
4596.asset_description: A young woman with her hair in a messy bun sits curled on a sofa under a checked blanket, crying. Her eyes and the skin around her nose are red and swollen. She lifts a white tissue to her face, covers her nose with both hands and blows it, then lowers the tissue and goes on crying with the blanket clutched to her chest.

4710.words: arm (noun): the human limb between the shoulder and the hand
4710.asset_description: Three people work out together on a path in a green park. An older woman in a bright red tracksuit stands in the middle between a young woman in a mint jacket and a young man in a grey hoodie. All three stretch both arms straight up over their heads with their palms open, then jog on the spot swinging their arms bent at the elbow, then swing both arms wide out to the sides at shoulder height. They keep smiling at the camera while other walkers and a dog pass under the fresh green trees behind them.

4718.asset_description: An extreme close up fills the screen with one brown eye: the white, the ring of brown around the black centre, the reflections of the ceiling lights and the long lashes above and below. A thumb comes in and gently pulls the upper lid open wider. An optician holds a small black torch beside the eye and shines it in, and the brown ring lights up amber while the black centre shrinks. The shot pulls back to show a young woman smiling in an optician's shop with walls of spectacle frames behind her, and finally the optician holds up a big cut through model of an eyeball beside her while she points at it and talks.

4719.words: chin (noun): the part of the lower jaw that sticks out
4719.asset_description: A soft painted portrait of a young person filling the whole frame from the top of the head to the base of the neck. They have tousled mid brown hair, thick dark eyebrows, large brown eyes with small white highlights, pink cheeks and a small closed lipped smile. Below the mouth the rounded chin and the line of the jaw stand out clearly against the pale neck, and behind them is a blurred wash of green meadow and blue sky.

4816.words: heart (noun): the muscular organ in your chest
4816.asset_description: A young woman in a neon yellow vest stands on an outdoor basketball court breathing hard with her mouth open after playing. She presses her flat hand onto her chest over her heart and looks down, still panting. A man in a green shirt comes up beside her, puts his hand on her shoulder and stares wide-eyed at the camera; the two of them then lean over the smartwatch on her wrist and both react in shock at the number on it while other players carry on with the ball behind them.

4915.words: shoulder (noun): the body part between the neck and the arm
4915.asset_description: Five friends are on a sunny rooftop terrace with a city skyline behind them. Two of them laugh with an arm laid across the other's back, hand resting where the neck meets the arm. The group lines up side by side, each one's arm hooked over the next one's upper body, and walks forward together; a low shot catches their trainers on the tiles. They pull into a tight circle with hands on each other's backs, then line up again and jump into the air with their arms flung up.

4977.words: hand (noun): the end of the limb you grab things with
4977.asset_description: A first-person clip in the tropics: an outstretched arm and open hand with beaded bracelets fills the foreground, leading the camera along a path through misty green rice terraces while a smiling long-haired man holds on at the other end. He then sits on the steps of a carved stone temple beside a monkey, and finally rides a big rope swing out over a jungle valley of palms and terraces, feet bare against the sky.

4982.words: ankle (noun): the joint between your leg and your foot
4982.asset_description: On a green football pitch a player in a white kit dribbles the ball, then suddenly pulls up, grimaces and doubles over. He drops onto the grass and grips his leg just above the boot, his face twisted in pain. Two opponents in blue crouch down, take him under the arms and lift him back onto his feet, and he ends up sitting on a wooden bench at the side of the pitch, still holding the same spot above his foot.

5016.words: knee (noun): the joint in the middle of your leg
5016.asset_description: A young man in a white T-shirt and denim shorts sits barefoot on a clinic examination couch while a doctor in a white coat stands beside him holding a reflex hammer. He stands up, bends his legs and drops into a deep squat facing the camera so his bare knees are in the middle of the frame, then sits back on the couch, puts a hand on his knee and laughs with the doctor.

5103.words: neck (noun): the part that connects the head to the body
5103.asset_description: A woman in a lilac blouse sits at an office desk in front of a computer monitor, tips her head to one side and rubs the back of her neck with her hand, wincing. She rolls her head and talks to the camera. The shot cuts to a close-up of her chest and shoulders as she loops a thick mustard scarf around her neck and knots it. Then the scene cuts outdoors: she stands at a green fence at a wildlife park in the same blouse and scarf, and a giraffe lowers its very long neck down over her head from above. She turns to the camera with her mouth wide open in astonishment, hand at her chin.

5346.words: stomach (noun): the muscular organ that holds the food you eat
5346.asset_description: A curly-haired young man stands in a school canteen queue with both hands flat on his middle, wincing and talking as the line shuffles past trays of food. He then sits at a table and forks up a huge mouthful of spaghetti in tomato sauce, chews with his eyes shut, and finally leans back and pats his middle with both hands, satisfied.

5406.words: toe (noun): one of the five small end parts of the foot
5406.asset_description: A close shot of hot beach sand shows a pair of bare feet with the toes spread wide, and a white shell lying in the sand right in front of them. A young woman in a tie-dye T-shirt, denim shorts and a visor steps forward, treads straight onto the shell and jerks her foot up with a pained laugh. She hops on one leg, grabs the sore foot and shakes it out, then bounds away across the sand and jumps onto a striped beach towel.

5409.words: tooth (noun): one of the hard white parts in your jaws
5409.asset_description: A young woman with freckles smiles into the camera and pulls her lower lip down with one finger to show her front teeth close up. The film cuts to a dental surgery where she sits in the chair in a mint jumper while a dentist holds a small round mirror up to her open mouth. Then she is outside under a tree, biting into a big red apple, and finally she holds up the bitten apple and grins straight at the camera.

110.words: box (noun): a container with flat sides, often of cardboard
110.asset_description: In an empty flat, a young woman folds a flat sheet of cardboard into a big box, packs a rolled blanket, mugs and a plant into it with her partner, closes the lid, carries it and stacks three boxes; her cat jumps on top of the pile.

252.words: dust (noun): tiny dry bits of dirt that cover surfaces
252.asset_description: In an old attic full of jars, a finger drags a clean stripe through the thick grey dust on a shelf and the hand comes up coated. A young man lifts an old suitcase and blows a huge cloud of dust off it into the sunbeams while his friend laughs and coughs.

253.words: dusting (noun): wiping fine dirt off shelves and furniture
253.asset_description: A couple gasps in mock horror at a finger swiped through the dust on their shelf. They dust the whole flat with cloth and duster - picture frame, lampshade, door frame - get a dust cloud in the face, and finish with exaggerated thumbs up over the spotless shelves while the cat climbs in.

484.words: mop (noun): a stick with soft strings to wash floors
484.asset_description: In an animated late-night diner, a waitress dunks a mop into a red bucket, wrings it out dripping, and mops the checkered floor between stacked chairs. She nearly slips on the wet tiles, catches herself, and finally leans on the mop admiring the shiny clean floor.

683.words: sink (noun): a basin with a tap for washing things
683.asset_description: A man fills a white kitchen sink with water and dish soap until a huge foam mountain rises, then he and a woman wash dirty plates in it and finally the water drains away.

802.words: trash can (noun): a container you put rubbish in
802.asset_description: A woman with a microphone commentates like a sports announcer while a man shoots crumpled paper balls at a mini basketball hoop mounted above a teal trash can. He celebrates a made shot, then picks up the missed paper balls off the floor and drops them into the open can.
802.transcript: (upbeat music) - For the win. - Switch! (upbeat music)

860.words: washing (noun): cleaning something with water and soap
860.asset_description: A couple washes a car caked in orange mud on their driveway: they hose it down, scrub the hood with foamy sponges while their dog trots around, then rinse off the suds. The car ends up shiny silver and they pose proudly beside it.
860.transcript: Soak it all! Brand new car!

960.words: broom (noun): a brush with a long handle for sweeping floors
960.asset_description: A woman in denim overalls sweeps a dusty wooden hallway floor with a straw broom, dust flying up and a dustpan waiting by a chair behind her.

1085.words: floor (noun): the flat inside surface of a room you walk on
1085.asset_description: A barefoot woman mops a wide wooden floor in a bright, nearly empty room, a bucket tipped over beside her and a rolled carpet against the wall.

1151.words: iron (noun): the hot tool for pressing clothes smooth
1151.asset_description: A man in a denim shirt presses a white shirt on an ironing board with a steaming iron, in a bedroom with shirts hanging in an open wardrobe.

1152.words: ironing board (noun): a tall folding table for smoothing clothes flat
1152.asset_description: A barefoot woman unfolds and sets up an ironing board in a bright room, with an iron waiting on the windowsill and a basket of laundry beside her.

1347.words: sponge (noun): a soft object with holes used for washing
1347.asset_description: A hand squeezes a yellow soapy sponge over a kitchen sink so water streams out, with dirty plates and washing-up liquid in the background.

1544.words: laundry (noun): garments that can be cleaned by washing
1544.asset_description: A painting of a woman in an apron hanging white laundry on clotheslines in a garden, carrying a wicker basket of washed linen on her hip.

3087.words: to pour (verb): to make something flow out of a container
3087.asset_description: Cartoon of a smiling woman in a kitchen tipping a green bag so brown pet-food pellets pour out into a bowl she steadies on the counter.

3767.words: clean up (verb): to make a place tidy by removing rubbish
3767.asset_description: A flat vector illustration shows about eight football fans in blue shirts and blue-and-white scarves bending between the grey seats of a stadium, picking up bits of litter and dropping them into big blue rubbish bags.

4155.asset_description: In a tiled bathroom, a cartoon-like ginger kitten in a pink t-shirt stands at a toilet holding a white plate smeared with red sauce. It dips the dirty plate into the toilet bowl, then reaches up with one paw and presses the flush button. Blue water swirls round the bowl and the kitten swishes the plate through it. At the end the kitten proudly puts a shining white plate on top of a tall stack of clean plates, with the dirty sauce-covered ones beside it.

4196.words: bucket (noun): a round open container with a handle
4196.asset_description: A cartoon: a round white character leans over a lit candle that stands in a small grey metal bucket on a bed of straw in a stone cellar. It blows the candle out and the room goes dark, leaving only the bucket and the smoking candle in the gloom. The scene cuts to a bedroom where the same character lies asleep in bed under a blue duvet with a red cap on. A digital clock shows 6:10, four phones lie on the duvet and light up with alarms, and a framed poster on the wall reads WAKE UP. CHASE GOALS. REPEAT. The character sleeps on with its mouth open, drooling.

4220.words: clean (verb): to make clean by removing dirt
4220.asset_description: A man in a black t-shirt stands beside a white sports car parked on a road through dry golden hills at sunset. He lifts the front lid and leans in, then works over the bodywork with a grey microfibre cloth, wiping the paint in long strokes in close-up until it is spotless. Close shots follow of the wing mirror and of the rear spoiler rising, and then the car pulls away and drives off down the empty road into the low sun.

4253.words: to wash (verb): to clean your body with soap and water
4253.asset_description: A motocross rider sits on a green dirt bike in a wet paddock, caked from helmet to boots in thick brown mud, so that the goggles and the whole suit are one solid brown crust. Two mechanics in team shirts and caps work on him with a pressure hose: one wipes the mud off the helmet with a cloth while the other kneels and blasts water over the rider's legs and the bike. Brown water runs off in sheets and the green bodywork of the bike appears clean again under the mud.

4367.words: dry (verb): to remove the moisture and make dry
4367.asset_description: An ink-style drawing of the side of a wooden apartment building. Big white sheets and shirts are pegged out on lines strung between the balconies, billowing in the wind. A person in a grey robe leans on the iron balcony railing looking down at the street, with potted plants beside them, telephone poles and swirling clouds behind.

4448.words: handle (noun): the part of an object you hold to use or move it
4448.asset_description: A woman stands in a wooden-floored living room covered in a thick carpet of coloured paper confetti, holding a broom by its long blue handle with both hands. She pushes the brush head across the boards, gripping the handle high up with one hand and low down with the other, and gathers the confetti into a heap. She then holds the broom in one hand and a dustpan by its own upright blue handle in the other, sweeps the heap into the pan, and finally leans on the top of the broom handle and grins at the camera.

4539.words: cartoon (noun): a humorous drawing in a newspaper
4539.asset_description: A hand-drawn comic-style picture with thick black outlines, flat colours and motion lines. A grinning man with round white eyes, a patched apron, big yellow rubber gloves and brown shoes swings a mop across a blue-and-cream chequered floor. Sparkle stars and soap bubbles pop off the wet tiles. A grey mop bucket on castors, full of suds and fitted with a wringer, stands to the right. Behind him are office windows with a drawn city skyline, a potted fern and a radiator.

4990.words: iron (noun): the hot tool for pressing clothes smooth
4990.asset_description: A young man in a grey sleeveless top works alone in a launderette in front of a row of big industrial washing machines. He shakes out a striped shirt, lays it flat on an ironing board and presses it with a heavy steam iron, then reaches for the next item beside a tall stack of folded, freshly washed clothes.

5087.words: dirty (adjective): covered with dirt or grime
5087.asset_description: A white tiled kitchen floor is covered with a long line of muddy brown animal paw prints leading from the door across the room. An older man in a flat cap and braces dips a string mop into a grey bucket of water, wrings it out, and then pushes a flat mop over the prints. The tiles he has passed over come up white and clean again, until he stands at the far end of a spotless floor that reflects the window.

5249.words: to wash (verb): to clean your body with soap and water
5249.asset_description: A young man in a grey sweatshirt and mint-green rubber gloves stands at a kitchen sink and works on a blackened cast-iron frying pan, rubbing it hard with a soapy steel-wool pad until foam covers it. He lifts a heavy sooty pot out of the sink and scours its round underside, grimacing with the effort. He then hauls a cast-iron grill pan with a ridged rack out of the water, sets it over the sink and scours the black bars of the rack with both hands, foam and grime running off into the basin.

5324.words: sponge (noun): a soft object with holes used for washing
5324.asset_description: A young woman stands at a kitchen sink and squeezes a white drop of dish soap from a blue-capped bottle onto a yellow-and-green sponge she holds over a large steel pan crusted with red tomato sauce. She scrubs the inside of the pan with the sponge under the running tap until foam covers the surface and the sauce washes away. She rinses the pan, then turns to the camera holding the clean, shining pan in one hand and the sponge in the other.

5372.words: broom (noun): a brush with a long handle for sweeping floors
5372.asset_description: A young man in a grey vest and shorts works his way across a white-tiled outdoor terrace, pulling a brush on a long wooden handle over the tiles and pushing scattered dry leaves into a growing heap. Palm trees, a parked car and a street are visible behind him; he works in flip-flops and the wet tiles reflect his shadow.

5377.words: collect (verb): to gather things together into one place
5377.asset_description: A hand-drawn kitchen scene: a dark-haired girl in a flowered apron leans right across a long wooden farmhouse table and stretches her arm out over the boards. In front of her the dirty plates from the meal have been gathered into one leaning stack with forks and knives laid on top; a linen cloth is still in the air above the pile and dust puffs off the wood. Behind her are painted wooden chairs, a dresser full of crockery, a jug and a bowl of apples on a sunlit windowsill.

5378.words: set (verb): to put something down in a certain place
5378.asset_description: Three short scenes around tables. A young man in a grey T-shirt puts a mug down on a small folding table in a hallway, then rocks the table to show how it wobbles. In a bright kitchen a woman puts glasses and colourful plates down one by one around a wooden table, laying a place in front of every chair. Finally a man in a blue suit stands at the head of an enormous banquet table in a marble hall and opens his arms over it, where candles, flowers, glasses and plates have all been put in their places down its whole length.

5421.words: garbage (noun): food and waste thrown out of a kitchen
5421.asset_description: A drawn grey-green kitchen scene. A metal bin stands in the middle of the floor, so full that its lid has been pushed off and hangs to one side; empty milk and juice cartons, a tin and crumpled paper stick out of the bag inside it. More screwed-up paper and food packaging lies scattered across the tiled floor. On the right a young man in a jacket and boots pulls back with both hands raised as a crumpled paper ball flies past him towards the viewer.

5480.words: task (noun): a piece of work you take on
5480.asset_description: A young man in a backwards cap stands at a kitchen sink washing a soapy plate by hand. The camera pulls back to show towers of dirty plates stacked far above his head on both sides of the sink, plus dirty cups and glasses on the counter. He keeps scrubbing plate after plate, then looks at the remaining towers, opens his mouth and groans, and the stacks are still just as high at the end.

382.asset_description: Two window cleaners in helmets and harnesses stand on a suspended platform near the top of a skyscraper, squeegeeing the glass while the camera looks down at the tiny city streets far below.

465.words: market (noun): a place where people buy and sell food and goods
465.asset_description: In an animated old-town street market, a young woman with a basket walks between stalls under striped awnings. She picks ripe tomatoes from a friendly farmer, smells a peach, tastes cheese a vendor cuts for her, and strolls on through the busy stalls.
465.transcript: Fresh today! Very fresh! Mmm, two, please. Thank you, my dear.

585.words: public (adjective): open to everyone, not private
585.asset_description: In a hand-painted animated city square a young woman sits on a case and plays a red accordion beside a fountain. Workers, elderly people and families stop one by one until a large crowd rings the square to listen.

669.words: shop (noun): a building or room where you buy things
669.asset_description: In a retro cartoon, a woman in a red coat enters a little grocery shop, fills her basket with jars and a loaf of bread, pays the friendly bald shopkeeper three coins at an old cash register, and leaves through the door under the striped awning.
