669.transcript: How much please three coins my friend, thank you come again

739.words: stop (verb): to end moving and stay still
739.asset_description: A man in a red hoodie walks down a city street and halts at a red octagonal sign that reads STOP FOR PIZZA; he shrugs, obeys the sign, walks to a sidewalk pizza cart and happily takes a bite of a slice.
739.transcript: What is on the sign? Stop for pizza, okay?

941.words: bench (noun): a long seat for more than one person
941.asset_description: A woman sits on a wooden park bench in autumn as startled pigeons burst up around her and coffee spills from her cup, leaves swirling in the sunlight.

959.words: bridge (noun): a structure that lets people cross a river or road
959.asset_description: A woman in a dark coat and scarf walks along a riverside boardwalk beneath a huge steel suspension bridge at sunset while seagulls fly past.

1218.words: no one (phrase): not a single person
1218.asset_description: A playground at dusk with absolutely no one there: an empty spinning merry-go-round, a still tire swing, a forgotten scarf on the railing and leaves blowing across the ground.

1317.words: sidewalk (noun): the paved path beside a road where people walk
1317.asset_description: A businessman with a leather briefcase strides along a wide stone sidewalk beside a city street at sunrise, a pigeon fluttering up in front of him and parked cars along the kerb.

1323.words: skyscraper (noun): a very tall building with many floors
1323.asset_description: A low-angle shot of a woman in a black coat and scarf gazing straight up at a huge glass skyscraper that towers into a blue sky over a city plaza.

1350.words: square (noun): an open space in a town with buildings around it
1350.asset_description: A woman in a summer dress runs across a sunlit Italian town square with an obelisk and fountain, scattering a big flock of pigeons; people sit at cafe tables under umbrellas.

1367.words: street (noun): a road in a town lined with buildings
1367.asset_description: A woman in a beige trench coat strides across a busy big-city street between yellow taxis and a bus, with skyscrapers on both sides and steam rising from a manhole.

1369.words: streetlight (noun): a tall lamp that lights a street at night
1369.asset_description: On a rainy evening promenade, a grinning man swings around an ornate glowing lamppost and kicks up water from a puddle, with a whole row of lit streetlights receding behind him.

1410.words: traffic light (noun): the lights that tell cars to stop and go
1410.asset_description: On a rainy evening street, a woman on a bicycle waits under a large traffic light glowing red, yellow and green, with cars passing behind her.

1508.words: church (noun): a place where Christians go to worship
1508.asset_description: Detailed ink drawing of an old stone church with arched windows and a tall pointed tower.

1548.words: window (noun): the glass opening in the side of a vehicle
1548.asset_description: A flat vector brick apartment building where every window shows different residents: a large family at the top, parents with a baby, a cook with a child, and a mother and son among flower boxes.

1642.words: village (noun): a place where people live, smaller than a town
1642.asset_description: A flat cartoon skyline of little crooked houses, a tower and power lines standing on green grass under a huge red evening sky.

1652.words: touch (verb): to put your fingers on something gently
1652.asset_description: On a neon city street at night, a girl in a denim jacket stretches out her arm to touch a huge glowing blue butterfly surrounded by sparks.

1677.words: city (noun): a large crowded area of streets and buildings
1677.asset_description: A vector city at dusk with tall lit buildings; on a bridge in the foreground, a row of silhouetted people walk while staring down at their glowing phones.

1919.words: narrow (adjective): not wide, small from side to side
1919.asset_description: A vividly colored painting of a narrow cobblestone lane between old stone houses at night, lit by warm lanterns under a huge full moon.

1987.words: future (phrase): the time that will come after now
1987.asset_description: An aerial view of a glowing futuristic city of neon towers split by a winding bright river, with saucer-shaped craft and a huge luminous ring hovering in the sky.

2023.words: gift (noun): something you are given for free
2023.asset_description: A warm painting of a snowy city street at night with two big glowing Christmas trees; brightly wrapped gift boxes in pink and yellow sit in the snow beside the small tree while a person walks past lit shop windows.

2040.words: decoration (noun): a pretty thing that makes a place look festive
2040.asset_description: A snowy street of old timber houses covered in Christmas decorations - green garlands with red bows along the roofs - with a glowing lantern hanging in the foreground and people walking through the snow.

2093.words: green (adjective): the color between blue and yellow
2093.asset_description: A futuristic city street where every skyscraper and rooftop is covered in green trees and plants, sunlight falling on a curving road between the leafy buildings.

2201.words: orange (adjective): having the color between red and yellow
2201.asset_description: A young woman with long bright orange hair wears matching orange sci-fi armor while standing on a city street between tall gray buildings.

2208.words: pink (adjective): a light shade of red
2208.asset_description: A young woman with bright pink hair stands in white-and-copper robotic armor on a blurred city street with a pedestrian behind her.

2228.words: above (preposition): higher than something, over it
2228.asset_description: A woman with robotic metal arms and legs sits relaxed on a ledge of a tall structure, the whole city stretching far below her under a cloudy sky.

2379.words: fall (verb): to descend freely under gravity
2379.asset_description: A watercolor city street on a wet grey day: orange and red leaves fall and swirl from a big tree over the rain-soaked pavement, past black lampposts, small pedestrians and parked cars.

2439.words: wet (adjective): covered or soaked with water
2439.asset_description: A dark blue classic car drives down a wet night street that mirrors the glowing windows, streetlights and moon of the old brick buildings around it.

2449.words: shop window (noun): a big glass front where a store shows its goods
2449.asset_description: A couple walks arm in arm through a snowy pink-lit town street at dusk; both sides of the street are lined with glowing shop windows full of displays, under garlands and lanterns.

2652.words: grey (adjective): a color between white and black
2652.asset_description: Five people in long coats walk toward the viewer under umbrellas on a wet street; everything is grey and black except one woman in a bright red coat with a red umbrella, and a big suspension bridge stands in the mist behind them.

3482.words: steps (noun): a flight of stairs you walk up or down
3482.asset_description: A woman in a red dress and sunglasses sits on wide pale stone steps in the sun, a straw tote beside her and red bougainvillea hanging over the wall.

3842.words: throw away (verb): to get rid of something you no longer want
3842.asset_description: A flat illustration shows a young man in a grey tracksuit with a sports bag walking along a park path at sunset and dropping a paper coffee cup into a wooden bin, with palm trees, a bridge and a city skyline behind him.

4030.words: park (noun): a large public area of land with grass and trees
4030.asset_description: In a large public park with mown lawns, bare trees, benches and a gravel path, a man in a dark jacket walks along the narrow stone rim of a round ornamental pond. Orange and white koi swim just under the surface below him. He wobbles, throws one arm up to keep his balance and topples in with a huge splash. He sits up soaked in the waist-deep water while people walk past on the path behind, then hauls himself back over the stone rim.

4042.words: store (noun): a shop where goods are sold
4042.asset_description: At dusk a young couple stands on the pavement outside a brightly lit convenience store, its glass front and stocked shelves glowing behind them. The woman, in a pale yellow wrap dress with a white frangipani in her hair, sips from a whole green coconut through a red-and-white striped straw; a close-up shows her drinking with the store's shelves of packets and bottles filling the background. She looks up at the tall man in a white t-shirt beside her; he looks down at her and says no. She keeps holding the coconut between them and smiles up at him as scooters and other shoppers pass behind.

4126.words: building (noun): a structure with a roof and walls
4126.asset_description: Shot at night on a phone. Two young men climb over a tall black iron fence with spear-shaped tips, next to a red warning sign, and drop down into dark bushes and tree roots on the other side. They walk up through the dark, and then the camera lifts to show where they have come out: a vast city spread below them, thousands of lit windows in tall towers packed along both sides of a dark harbour, with more towers climbing the hillsides and low cloud glowing above them. The two sit down side by side on the concrete edge and look out over the lit-up city.

4323.words: lane (noun): a narrow way or road
4323.asset_description: A photograph of a narrow cobbled lane running between rows of brightly painted corrugated-iron houses — red, blue, yellow — with a yellow iron balcony above on the left. The lane narrows away towards a low sun at the far end. In the middle of it a couple dance: a man in a brown waistcoat holds a woman in a long grey skirt in a dance hold, both leaning into a long step.

4398.words: advertisement (noun): a public promotion of a product or service
4398.asset_description: A woman in cat-eye glasses stands at a bus shelter looking up with her mouth open in amazement. From a moving train window a large roadside billboard advertising a house slides past above the motorway. Then she is standing in Times Square at dusk, turning on the spot under towers of huge lit advertising screens and grinning up at them.

4456.words: modern (adjective): belonging to the present, modern era
4456.asset_description: A man in a green bomber jacket walks along a street past an old red-brick block with washing hung out over its small balconies, and puts his hand on the worn brickwork. He steps back and looks up, and right beside the old block stands a tall new tower of blue-green glass and steel that runs up out of the frame. He walks round to its front, where a smooth curved glass revolving door turns in a flat stone facade, and stares up at the rows of glass panels. The clip ends with him at the foot of an old stone building with tall columns and a heavy wooden door.

4465.asset_description: A man in a cap with a shoulder bag travels through a city by bus. He waits by the roadside as a small van passes, then steps up into a white city bus through the front door. A red double-decker bus drives past tall glass office towers. He climbs the narrow staircase inside the double-decker up to the open top deck, and at the top he throws both arms wide and shouts with delight as the bus drives on between the skyscrapers.

4588.words: traffic (noun): the vehicles and people moving along a place
4588.asset_description: A drawing of a city street at night in heavy rain, lit pink and blue by neon buildings and glowing signs. A young man in a long black hooded coat and white trainers strides across the striped crossing in the middle of the road. Cars are stopped on both sides of him with their headlights on, and other people in raincoats walk across in front of and behind him. The wet road throws back the coloured light in long reflections and rain streaks the air.

4670.words: roof (noun): the protective covering on top of a building
4670.asset_description: Evening light over an Italian city. A young woman in a white dress stands on the flat roof terrace of an apartment block and hangs washing on lines strung across it. The camera shows the view around her: rows of tiled and flat rooftops with aerials and chimneys stretching to the horizon, with washing lines hanging between the buildings below.

4676.words: tradition (noun): a pattern of action passed down over time
4676.asset_description: A traditional Dutch cheese market on a cobbled town square. Two carriers in white uniforms and orange sashes trot past with a wooden barrow stacked high with yellow cheese wheels on their shoulders, watched by a crowd of onlookers. A young carrier picks a heavy wheel off a pile, lifts it up to the camera and grins, then stacks more wheels into tall towers before clapping his hands over the finished piles.

4692.asset_description: In a supermarket a worker in a green polo shirt and apron reaches into a cardboard box full of drink cans standing on the floor by a cold room door. He carries the cans to the aisle and lines them up on a shelf already packed with rows of colourful tins and cans. He straightens the front row so all the labels face out, then picks up the empty flattened box and walks off down the aisle between the full shelves.

4798.words: temple (noun): a building where people pray
4798.asset_description: A woman in a white sundress and a straw hat walks up a stone path towards an ancient hilltop temple with tall columns in golden evening light, then runs down a narrow whitewashed alley under bright pink bougainvillea, then joins friends dancing arm in arm at a seaside table above a blue bay.

4802.words: museum (noun): a building for displaying valuable old objects
4802.asset_description: A uniformed guard walks through a marble museum hall past bronze statues in glass cases and framed paintings, raises a hand to hold someone back, opens a tall wooden door, points out the way for a family holding a map, then stands in the middle of the skylit hall with his arms folded while visitors walk past.

4805.words: church (noun): a place where Christians go to worship
4805.asset_description: A young man in glasses stands by a large stone fountain in a Roman square staring open-mouthed at an open guidebook, with a domed church and an obelisk behind him; he holds the book up beside the fountain, sits on the wide steps of a columned church and points up at it, then looks out from a stone balustrade over the rooftops of the city and holds the open book up against the view.

4835.words: city (noun): a large crowded area of streets and buildings
4835.asset_description: A shaky running camera chases a figure along a city pavement at night. Lit shop windows and neon signs run down one side, parked cars and traffic lights line the road on the other, and tall apartment blocks with lit windows stand at the end of the street under a deep blue sky.

4874.words: traffic light (noun): the lights that tell cars to stop and go
4874.asset_description: A cyclist in a yellow jersey and a white-and-yellow helmet is stopped at a big city junction, mouth open in shock; above and beside her a traffic light shows green and amber. The camera pulls back and pedestrians, runners and a dog stream across the striped crossing in front of her while tall buildings rise on both sides.

4885.words: street (noun): a road in a town lined with buildings
4885.asset_description: A woman in a beige utility vest holds a small rainbow flag up high and walks up a sunny cobbled street in an old Italian hill town; stone houses with shutters and balconies line both sides, and a long line of people follows her up the street.

5037.words: sidewalk (noun): the paved path beside a road where people walk
5037.asset_description: A woman in a camel trench coat wheels a grey suitcase across a marble hotel lobby and out through a revolving glass door. She steps onto the wide paved sidewalk of a Paris street, cars passing on the road right beside her, and looks around while other people walk past her on the same pavement. She then comes back in and stops at the reception counter with a document in her hand.

5045.words: sound (noun): the effect you hear from something
5045.asset_description: At night on a neon-lit Korean shopping street, a young man with bleached hair and headphones around his neck cups a hand behind his ear towards the camera, then pulls the headphones up over his ears. The camera swings down to the pavement, where a big silver boombox with two round speakers stands next to a lamppost, playing while shoppers pass behind it. The clip ends at a concert in front of a towering wall of stacked loudspeakers, with a performer on stage and the crowd's hands in the air.

5085.words: statue (noun): a figure of a person or creature made of stone
5085.asset_description: A young woman in an embroidered white blouse and jeans tours several public memorials. She crouches beside a seated bronze figure of a bearded man on a stone plinth and points at the inscribed plaque, then stands up and takes a selfie with it while a pigeon flies past. She then stands in front of a tall stone column topped by a winged bronze figure, filming it with her phone, and finally walks across a wide plaza below a huge metal figure with outstretched arms, throwing her own arms up in the same pose.

5108.words: village (noun): a place where people live, smaller than a town
5108.asset_description: A young woman with long beaded braids in a yellow sunflower dress laughs in a covered fabric market, holding up a green and gold wax-print cloth between stacks of folded fabric, then wrapping it around herself. Next she sits in a narrow painted canoe that glides past a village of wooden houses built on stilts over the water, waving up at children sitting in a doorway above her. At the end she stands in the middle of a ring of men playing hand drums on a sandy village street at sunset, dancing as they drum.

5195.words: bench (noun): a long seat for more than one person
5195.asset_description: A young man in a yellow beanie and denim jacket sits on a long wooden slatted seat in a green park, trees and paths behind him. Several books are spread out along the seat next to him and a huge open volume lies across his knees. He picks up a small dark red book, then bends over the big open one, flipping through its pages faster and faster with his mouth open. At the end he lifts the enormous brown book right up over his head with both hands and stares up at it.

5340.words: garage (noun): a building where a car is kept
5340.asset_description: Two boys carry a big cardboard box together into an open garage, the up-and-over door raised and the lawn and fence bright outside. They set it down among other flat-pack boxes, open one and find a football, which the smaller boy lifts out and throws. A close shot shows one boy tightening the bolts of a pale wooden bunk-bed frame. Indoors the finished bunk bed stands made up; the two boys bump fists and then sit side by side on the bottom bunk, laughing at the camera.

5468.words: sign (noun): a big board that shows advertisements
5468.asset_description: A selfie-stick shot of a young woman with pink-tipped hair and a bearded man crossing a wide Japanese city intersection at dusk. Filling the buildings behind and above them are huge illuminated advertising boards - stacked panels of neon lettering, brand logos and lit-up product pictures running up the facades on every side. The two walk towards the camera across the striped crossing with a dense crowd of people behind them; she pulls a wide-eyed, delighted face at the lens.

24.words: spoon (noun): a tool with a small bowl for eating liquid food
24.asset_description: In an anime-style seaside kitchen a girl takes a spoon from a cutlery drawer, admires it in the window light, scoops steaming soup from a pot to taste, then happily eats a whole bowl of soup with the spoon until it is empty.

66.words: baking (noun): cooking bread or cake in an oven
66.asset_description: A woman in an apron kneads and shapes bread dough, scores it and puts it in the oven; she and her partner watch the loaf rise through the glass, then pull out the golden bread, set it on a rack and smell it happily.
66.transcript: Not near! Let it rise! Listen, perfect!

97.words: boil (verb): to heat a liquid until it bubbles
97.asset_description: In a hand-painted mountain hut a girl in a red shawl tends a copper pot over an open fire; the water goes from still to small bubbles to a rolling boil with steam, and she lifts the pot with a cloth and pours the boiling water into a clay teapot.

121.words: burn (verb): to damage food or skin with too much heat
121.asset_description: A 3D-animated man cooks a pancake in a smoking frying pan in his kitchen; when he tips the pan onto the plate the pancake is completely black and charred, and he stares at it in shock saying 'Oops'.

200.words: cream (noun): the thick fatty part of milk
200.asset_description: In a home kitchen a woman pours liquid cream into a metal bowl and a man whisks it until stiff peaks form, shows the peaks on the whisk saying "solid", even holds the bowl upside down over his head, then they spoon the whipped cream onto waffles with berries and taste it.
200.transcript: Peaks! Look at that! See? Solid!

260.words: egg (noun): an oval thing laid by a hen, used as food
260.asset_description: A young man's first egg crumbles and he grumbles while picking shell bits out of the bowl, his cat watching from the window. He cracks a fresh egg into a buttered pan, fries it sunny-side up, slides it onto toast and dips the bread into the runny golden yolk, eating with yolk on his chin.
260.transcript: Shell not again The deep gold

302.words: flour (noun): a white powder made from grain for baking
302.asset_description: In a rustic kitchen a man scoops white flour, sifts it over a wooden table like snow, presses handprints into it, then kneads it with water into dough. He ends up with flour on his nose and face and jokes about it with a woman while a dog watches.
302.transcript: Let it snow! Got you! Classic!

328.words: garlic (noun): a small white bulb with a strong taste
328.asset_description: A woman in a kitchen smashes a garlic bulb with her palm, breaks it into cloves and peels one; she sniffs it, winces at the strong smell, then drops it into a pan of hot oil and she and her partner sniff the delicious steam.
328.transcript: Smash skins off. That smell incredible.

329.words: gas (noun): a fuel that burns with a blue flame
329.asset_description: A couple at an old white stove turns the knob and the gas burner lights with a blue flame; they watch it burn, set a kettle on it, then start frying red onions in an oiled pan over the flame.

352.words: grill (noun): a metal frame for cooking food over heat
352.asset_description: On an evening patio a man wipes the hot bars of a charcoal grill, lays out peppers, tomatoes and a slab of white cheese, flips the cheese to show dark criss-cross grill stripes and serves everything on a plate.
352.transcript: Two seconds, ready? The stripes, look!

424.words: knife (noun): a tool with a sharp blade for cutting
424.asset_description: In a bright kitchen, a man uses a large knife to slice a loaf of bread and then a tomato, builds an open sandwich with the slices, and a couple gives a thumbs up while tasting it.

491.words: mustard (noun): a yellow spicy sauce you put on hot dogs
491.asset_description: In a rustic kitchen, a man tastes a spoonful of bright yellow mustard from a stone bowl and winces at its sharp taste. He whisks the mustard with honey into a glaze, brushes it over a tray of carrots, and a woman tastes the result and reacts with delighted surprise.
491.transcript: Ooh, sharp! Sweet and sharp, wow!

511.words: onion (noun): a round vegetable that makes your eyes water
511.asset_description: A man peels a white onion, halves it on a cutting board and starts slicing, but his eyes water and he wipes tears while a woman behind him cries too. He then puts on blue swim goggles, gives a thumbs up, and happily finishes chopping the onion.

514.words: oven (noun): a hot box in a kitchen for baking and roasting
514.asset_description: A young couple slides a tray of raw bread dough into a kitchen oven and crouches at the glass door, watching the light inside as the loaf rises and turns golden. Wearing oven mitts, they pull out the finished brown loaf, thrilled.

523.words: pan (noun): a flat metal pot with a handle for frying
523.asset_description: In a rustic kitchen a man in an apron oils a steel frying pan, adds sliced peppers and onion, tosses the vegetables high in the pan while a woman watches amazed, then slides them onto a plate.
523.transcript: Little one first! The big door!

537.words: peel (verb): to take the skin off fruit or vegetables
537.asset_description: In a hand-painted anime scene a girl with a braid sits on a porch above green fields and peels a red apple with a small knife in one long unbroken spiral that drops into a basket, then holds up the fully peeled pale apple.

543.words: pepper (noun): a hot-tasting powder from ground black seeds
543.asset_description: A man in a bright kitchen grinds black pepper from a tall wooden pepper mill over a bowl of creamy pasta, then the pepper tickles his nose and he sneezes into his elbow before laughing and presenting the dish.
543.transcript: (upbeat music) Grind, grind, grind. Ah, ah. (laughs)

557.words: plate (noun): a flat round dish you eat food from
557.asset_description: A chef polishes a large white plate with a cloth, twirls spaghetti in tomato sauce onto its center with tongs, adds basil and a ring of olive oil, wipes the rim clean and proudly serves the plate to a delighted woman at a candlelit table.

571.words: pot (noun): a deep round container for cooking
571.asset_description: In a rustic kitchen, a young couple fills a big metal pot with water, sets it over an open fire and tips small potatoes into it. They cover it with a lid, peek inside as it boils and joke that the water is "dancing", then lift a cooked potato out on a fork through the steam.
571.transcript: Watching won't help. Look, it's dancing!

606.words: recipe (noun): a set of steps that tells you how to cook a dish
606.asset_description: A couple in a kitchen follows a hand-drawn recipe card with icons for eggs, milk and a pan: they crack eggs, whisk batter, fry pancakes and finish a tall honey-topped stack, checking the card at each step.
606.transcript: Step one, eggs. Just like the card.

632.words: salt (noun): white crystals you add to food for flavour
632.asset_description: In a stone kitchen by the sea, a hand pinches coarse white salt from a small wooden pot and sprinkles it over a board of ripe tomato slices while a seagull watches through the open window; a couple licks salt from their fingers and bites into the salted tomatoes with bread, delighted at the taste.

694.words: slice (verb): to cut something into thin flat pieces
694.asset_description: A 3D-animated young chef slices a tomato into a neat fan of thin rounds on a wooden board, then proudly holds one translucent slice up to the light with a big grin.

734.words: steak (noun): a thick slice of beef that you fry or grill
734.asset_description: A man lays a thick raw ribeye into a cast-iron pan over a gas flame, sears it, bastes it with butter and thyme, rests it under foil, then slices it open to show a pink center and tastes a piece while his beagle watches over the counter.
734.transcript: That crust, listen. Rested, now perfect.

735.words: steam (noun): the hot white cloud boiling water turns into
735.asset_description: In a cozy winter cabin kitchen, a man lifts the lid off a big pot and an enormous cloud of steam billows up, completely fogging his glasses so he cannot see; his friends laugh and wave the white cloud away while holding mugs.
735.transcript: Whoa, the cloud! I see nothing!

742.words: stove (noun): a kitchen machine with burners for cooking
742.asset_description: In a spice-filled kitchen a man clicks the gas stove burners alight one by one, blue flames appear, and a couple sets pots, a pan and a kettle on all four burners to cook together.
742.transcript: Click, click, hoo. Click, click, click, hoo. All four going.

769.words: teaspoon (noun): a small spoon for stirring drinks
769.asset_description: Close-up of small silver teaspoons dipped into Turkish tea glasses on saucers; a couple stirs their tea with the tiny spoons, lifts them out and tastes a spoonful each while a cat naps on the windowsill.
769.transcript: Plop and stir. Tiny but mighty.

948.words: blender (noun): the machine whose blades mix food into a drink
948.asset_description: In a bright kitchen a woman tosses raspberries and blueberries into a glass blender jug already half full of pink smoothie, the berries frozen mid-air.

1011.asset_description: A smiling middle-aged person in a blue shirt and apron stirs a steaming pot on a gas stove with one wooden spoon and lifts another to taste the food.

1160.words: kitchen (noun): a room equipped for preparing meals
1160.asset_description: A man tosses colourful vegetables in a wok over a gas hob in a bright kitchen, with wooden counters, plates on shelves, herbs and a chopping board around him.

3078.words: to fry (verb): to cook food in hot oil in a pan
3078.asset_description: Cartoon of a woman in a blue apron standing at the cooker in a wooden kitchen, turning three fried eggs in a frying pan with a spatula; bowls, an oil bottle and an eggshell sit beside her.

3089.words: to bake (verb): to cook food by putting it in a hot oven
3089.asset_description: A cartoon woman in an apron and blue oven mitts stands in a wooden kitchen holding out a black baking tray with nine round chocolate-chip cookies on it, smiling.

3709.words: to taste (verb): to taste a little of something
3709.asset_description: Illustration of a chef in a white jacket and checked apron standing at a steaming stove in a professional kitchen, eyes closed, lifting a spoonful of orange soup from the pot to her lips.

4021.words: cut (verb): to separate something with a knife or blade
4021.asset_description: Two hands press peeled bananas into a bed of grated carrot in a lined glass baking dish, then tip in flour and sugar. The baked sponge comes out deep orange and a spoon spreads thick cream cheese frosting over the top. Chopped pistachios are scattered on and a long knife slices the cake down and across into even squares.

4037.words: cook (verb): to prepare a hot meal
4037.asset_description: A sausage that has been cut into strips at one end so that it splays out like an octopus stands in the oil of a hot black frying pan. Beaten egg is poured from a white bowl all around it and spreads across the pan, and a thin stream of oil is drizzled over the top. The egg sets into a round yellow omelette with the sausage in the middle. The finished omelette is slid out of the pan onto a white plate and chopped green spring onion is sprinkled over it.

4228.words: shore (noun): the land along the edge of the sea or a lake
4228.asset_description: A man in a khaki shirt climbs into a dark blue helicopter on a sunny airfield. The camera flies low over pine forest and steep green mountains towards a bright turquoise lake. He stands on the grassy shore with his arms spread wide facing the water and the grey rock walls behind it. He then cracks two eggs onto a flat black pan on a small camping stove set on the rocks by the lake, and finally sits at a low wooden table eating the cooked eggs with sliced bread and tomatoes.

4238.words: roast (verb): to cook with dry heat in an oven
4238.asset_description: Two hands rinse a raw rack of lamb ribs in a fast mountain stream, with green hills and grazing horses behind. The rack is then laid on a flat stone slab set over glowing red coals and slowly browns, steaming, with the sun low over the hills. A man inflates a big white tent on the grass with an orange pump. Inside the tent, on a patterned carpet, two men sit at a low wooden table and eat the roasted ribs, which are served on a bed of lettuce with cherry tomatoes.

4283.asset_description: An outdoor evening cooking class under strings of fairy lights: a chef in whites tosses food in a wok over a tall gas flame while the class, all in aprons, lean over the counter watching with their hands under their chins; she sets a finished plate of stir-fry down in front of them and the whole class claps and cheers.

4326.words: wood (noun): the hard substance under the bark of trees
4326.asset_description: A photograph taken at sunset on a flat grassy plain with a low white farmhouse in the distance. A man in a black beret and a work shirt lifts a heavy iron grill rack loaded with racks of ribs off a long open fire pit, sending a shower of orange sparks up. The pit below is full of burning logs and a thick bed of pale ash. A rough wooden table on the left holds a mate gourd with a metal straw, and the pit itself is framed with thick wooden beams.

4365.words: fresh (adjective): recently made, produced or picked
4365.asset_description: An older woman pulls a tray of just-baked golden rolls out of the oven in a country kitchen. A younger woman in a red apron turns to the camera holding a warm loaf of bread in one hand and a berry tart in the other, mouth open in delight. The table fills with steaming rolls, croissants, loaves and pies straight from the oven, and both women throw their arms up beside it.

4514.words: skill (noun): an ability you gain by training
4514.asset_description: A cartoon restaurant kitchen. A grinning chef in a tall white hat and white jacket stands in the middle: one hand tosses a copper frying pan whose contents (a lobster, prawns, bell peppers, onion rings and mushrooms) fly up in a huge sheet of orange flame, while the other hand holds out a steaming wooden spoon. Behind him three other cooks in white hats watch him and cheer, one with a pot lid, one with a whisk, one with a knife. Copper pans hang on the wall and plated dishes with silver cloches wait on the pass under warming lamps.

4527.words: vegetable (noun): a plant part you eat, like roots, leaves or stems
4527.asset_description: A street cook in a white cap works at a huge round wooden block in front of a crowd of onlookers. With a broad steel cleaver he chops a bunch of spring onions into rings, then sweeps together the red and green chillies and carrot sticks he has just cut into a pile, then sets a whole white cabbage on the block, halves it and shreds it with fast strokes until a mountain of fine white and green shreds covers the block. Trays of prepared food and a flaming wok stand behind him.

4569.words: to fry (verb): to cook food in hot oil in a pan
4569.asset_description: A man with long hair tied back cooks in the open side doorway of a camper van parked above a surf beach, the turquoise sea and breaking waves filling the background. Strips of red and yellow pepper sizzle in a frying pan on the gas hob; he stirs them with a spatula, then lays two pink fish fillets into the pan beside them and presses them down. He lifts a small saucepan and pours sauce over the fish, and finally sets the finished plate of fish and peppers down on the counter.

4570.asset_description: Three kitchens in a row. A bearded man in a vest tosses sliced peppers and carrots out of a wok over a roaring blue flame in a food truck above a turquoise sea. Then a woman in an apron stir-fries at a street stall in a crowded market street, ladling in stock until a wall of orange flame leaps out of the wok and she laughs behind it. Finally a man in a white double-breasted chef's jacket with his name stitched on the chest sets a sprig of microgreens on a plated dish of pork, carrots and purée in a stainless steel restaurant kitchen, then steps back and looks at it.

4619.words: raw (adjective): not processed or cooked, in a simple natural state
4619.asset_description: A wooden cabin kitchen with a fjord and snowy mountains through the window. A young man in a thick Nordic wool jumper holds a handful of frozen dark berries under the running tap, then picks up a whole raw chicken, pale and frozen, and turns it over under the water so it runs off the skin into the steel sink. Finally he heaves a huge whole salmon up out of the sink and holds it across both hands, mouth wide open in amazement. Jars of preserves and two kettles stand on the counter behind him.

4795.words: to bake (verb): to cook food by putting it in a hot oven
4795.asset_description: In a pine kitchen an elderly woman in a floral apron pulls an open oven door down and slides out a tray of chocolate-chip cookies while two small girls bounce beside her with clenched fists and open mouths. In close-up her hands hold out two of the warm cookies and each girl bites into one. She then sits in an armchair knitting a blue square on needles with a wool ball in her lap and a girl dozing against her arm, and reads aloud from a picture book with her glasses on. The last shot is a garden table under fruit trees where she and the children sit around a cake stand and teapot.

4936.words: kitchen (noun): a room equipped for preparing meals
4936.asset_description: A cook in a white jacket and tall white hat works in a professional restaurant kitchen: steel counters, a row of gas burners, shelves of pots, a knife rack and bottles of oil on the wall behind her. She tosses a pan over a burner and a tall flame rises; she drops green herbs into peppers and prawns frying in the pan; at the pass she arranges the food on a white plate with tweezers, tastes the sauce from a spoon, then looks up and speaks to the camera.

4994.asset_description: An elderly woman in a flowery apron winds a sheet of pasta dough through a hand-cranked pasta machine in a rustic kitchen, with cut strips drying on a rack below. She then stirs a big red pot of meat and tomato sauce with a long wooden spoon, blows on it and tastes it, drops in a basil leaf, and finally carries the finished dish out to a long wooden table where a whole family claps and cheers.

5017.words: cut (adjective): separated into pieces with a sharp knife
5017.asset_description: Close up, a man's hands slice a tomato into thin rounds with a large kitchen knife on a wooden board. He works along the board slicing cucumber, then yellow pepper, then a red onion, until the board is covered with neat rows of pieces. He straightens up behind the board, which now shows the vegetables laid out in a rainbow-coloured row, and speaks to the camera.

5168.words: batch (noun): all the cakes baked at the same time
5168.asset_description: In a small tiled bakery a woman in a white shirt, apron and headscarf slides a tray of custard tarts out of a wood-fired oven whose flames are still burning. She sets the tray on the marble counter, straightens the tarts in their tins and sprinkles powder over them. She then carries the tray to the shop front and holds it out to a small girl, who takes a tart and bites into it, while a crowd of people behind the girl claps and shouts its approval.

5171.words: add (verb): to join one thing to a group of others
5171.asset_description: A grey-haired man in a striped shirt and apron stands at a hob in a small kitchen with a tall stainless steel stockpot in front of him. He tips a board of chopped carrots, potatoes and red peppers into the empty pot, then pours a jug of golden stock in on top of them. Wearing a padded oven glove he lowers the lid onto the pot; steam rises when he takes it off again, and he stirs the finished vegetable stew with a wooden spoon, smiling at the camera.

139.words: capital (noun): the city where a country's government is
139.asset_description: An anime boy in a green hood climbs a grassy hill holding a map marked with a glowing star; from the top he sees the country's capital spread out below, a vast city crowned by a golden dome, and throws his arm up cheering.

300.words: flag (noun): a coloured cloth that stands for a country
300.asset_description: In a Pixar-style 3D animation, a girl in a red parka stands by a stone hut on a snowy mountain and pulls the rope of a flagpole with her mittens. A folded teal flag rises up the pole, unfurls with a white stripe and golden sun, and she salutes it proudly as it waves against the peaks.

920.words: austria (noun): a small country in central Europe with the Alps
920.asset_description: A young woman in a traditional dirndl dress swings on a rope swing above a lake, with the village of Hallstatt, a church spire and steep green Alps behind her.

921.words: austrian (adjective): from the country with Vienna as its capital
921.asset_description: A waiter in a vest and bow tie serves a slice of Sachertorte and a cup of coffee in a grand old Viennese coffee house with mirrors, marble columns and chandeliers.

1026.words: czech (adjective): from the country with Prague as its capital
1026.asset_description: A bartender in a brick-vaulted Czech beer hall pulls the tap and fills a dimpled glass mug with foamy lager, copper brewing kettles in the background.

1028.words: czech republic (noun): a small country in central Europe, capital Prague
1028.asset_description: A woman in a long dark coat turns toward the camera on Charles Bridge in Prague, with pigeons flying past and Prague Castle glowing in the sunset behind her.

1050.words: dutch (adjective): from or connected with the Netherlands
1050.asset_description: A smiling man rides a city bicycle with a crate of tulips over a canal bridge in Amsterdam, tall gabled Dutch houses and pigeons behind him.

1115.words: greece (noun): a sunny country in the south of Europe
1115.asset_description: A woman in a flowing blue-and-white dress twirls on a terrace above the sea in Santorini, with whitewashed houses, blue-domed churches and pink petals in the air around her.

1195.words: mexican (adjective): from the country south of the United States
1195.asset_description: A smiling young woman in an embroidered blouse flips a tortilla in the air over a big griddle at a street food stall. Colorful papel picado paper banners hang over the sunny Mexican street, with bowls of limes, radishes and salsa in front.

1216.words: netherlands (noun): a flat country in Europe with tulips and windmills
1216.asset_description: A woman cycles along a brick path between bright red and yellow tulip fields, a basket of tulips on her handlebars, with several traditional Dutch windmills standing along a canal behind her.

1255.words: poland (noun): a country in central Europe, east of Germany
1255.asset_description: A woman in a long black coat stands among flocking pigeons on the snowy main square of Krakow, with St. Mary's Basilica, the Cloth Hall and horse carriages behind her.

1258.words: polish (adjective): from Poland or connected to its people
1258.asset_description: A smiling woman in an apron claps flour from her hands in a rustic old kitchen while making pierogi, the traditional Polish dumplings laid out in rows on a floured wooden board.

1260.words: portugal (noun): a country in the far west of Europe, next to Spain
1260.asset_description: A woman in a flowery dress runs barefoot down a steep cobbled Lisbon street beside a classic yellow tram, with tiled house fronts, hanging laundry and the sea glowing at the bottom of the hill.

1262.words: portuguese (adjective): from Portugal or connected to its people
1262.asset_description: A baker in an apron dusts cinnamon over trays of pasteis de nata, the famous Portuguese custard tarts, in a sunlit bakery decorated with blue-and-white azulejo tiles.

1327.words: slovak (adjective): from or belonging to the country east of Czechia
1327.asset_description: A shepherd in traditional Slovak folk dress - sheepskin vest, black hat and wooden crook - walks among his sheep before a log hut and the Tatra mountains at sunset.

1328.words: slovakia (noun): a small central European country next to Austria
1328.asset_description: A young woman in embroidered Slovak folk costume twirls her dark skirt in a flowering meadow below a ruined hilltop castle and jagged mountains.

1380.words: switzerland (noun): a small country in Europe known for the Alps
1380.asset_description: A man in a red plaid shirt leans back playing a long wooden alphorn in a flowery alpine meadow. Brown-and-white cows with bells graze by a still lake, and the Matterhorn peak rises against the sky behind them.

1528.words: japan (noun): the East Asian country of Mount Fuji
1528.asset_description: A flat vector scene with the classic symbols of Japan: snowy Mount Fuji, a red torii gate, a pagoda tower, a big red sun and hot-air balloons in a circle frame.

1537.words: egypt (noun): the country of the pyramids and the Nile
1537.asset_description: A collage-style illustration of an ancient Egyptian pharaoh in a crown and kilt holding a bow, standing before tall columns covered in hieroglyphs printed over an old book page.

1596.words: russia (noun): the largest country in the world, east of Europe
1596.asset_description: A painterly picture of Saint Basil's Cathedral in Moscow with its colorful striped onion domes, lit by a full moon breaking through dark blue clouds, with a statue in front.

1612.words: korea (noun): a country in East Asia, next to China and Japan
1612.asset_description: A cartoon girl and boy in colorful traditional Korean hanbok clothes wave happily in front of a giant red lucky bag ringed by stylized clouds and a rainbow circle.

1614.words: spain (noun): a country in south-west Europe next to Portugal
1614.asset_description: A retro travel poster of a Spanish town: bulls run through a street between red, white and yellow houses while fireworks burst over a white tower; the word SPAIN is printed at the bottom.

1743.words: italy (noun): a country in southern Europe, home of pizza
1743.asset_description: A watercolor of the Piazza dei Miracoli in Pisa with the cathedral and the Leaning Tower; in the foreground two men stand at an ice-cream cart under a large umbrella.

1935.words: new york (noun): the biggest city in the United States
1935.asset_description: A flat vector skyline of New York at sunset: the Statue of Liberty stands in the harbor in front of the Empire State Building and rows of hazy skyscrapers under a peach-colored sky.

2146.words: france (noun): the European country whose capital is Paris
2146.asset_description: A stylized pop-art Eiffel Tower in black, orange and purple lines rising against pastel blue and cream shapes with paint-splash accents.

2153.words: china (noun): a very big country in East Asia
2153.asset_description: Watercolor painting of a Chinese dragon coiling through orange clouds and teal ocean waves above small mountains, with a red artist's seal in the corner.

2157.words: india (noun): a large country in South Asia
2157.asset_description: Ornate painting of a blue-skinned baby Krishna from India wearing a golden headdress and heavy gold necklaces, surrounded by roses, hydrangeas and pink lilies.

2247.words: scotland (noun): a country in the north of Great Britain
2247.asset_description: A flat travel-poster scene of an old stone church with a square tower standing alone on a grassy hillside in the countryside. Orange autumn bushes line a still river that reflects the tower, with mountains behind.

2752.words: germany (noun): the country in central Europe, capital Berlin
2752.asset_description: A painted grey mouse stands upright wearing a black, red and gold football shirt, with one paw beside a black-and-white football and a big German flag hanging behind it.

4568.words: continent (noun): one of the large landmasses of the earth
4568.asset_description: A school yard with a giant world map painted across the tarmac in bright colours, each land mass a different colour. A girl in an orange hoodie and rainbow trainers jumps from land mass to land mass, landing squarely on the yellow one, then hopping on across the map. Her classmates in tracksuits stand in a wide ring around the edge of the map watching her. She finishes by landing with both feet on the white land mass at the bottom right and throwing her arms out wide, laughing at the camera.

4579.words: abroad (adverb): to or in a foreign country
4579.asset_description: A woman in a denim jacket sewn all over with national flag patches grins into the camera from behind a spinning school globe. The shot cuts to her in front of the Eiffel Tower in Paris with both arms thrown up, then to a selfie on the back of a scooter riding past green rice terraces in Bali, then to her standing on the crest of a desert dune at sunset with her arms spread wide, and finally jumping on the dune towards the camera.

4731.words: nation (noun): a large group who share a country and an identity
4731.asset_description: A flag-raising ceremony outside a large curved glass building. A woman in a grey uniform suit hauls on a rope and a flag climbs its pole above her. The shot widens to a long line of women in the same grey suits, each raising a different national flag on a white pole, so that the flags of many countries rise together in a row. Rows of officials in dark suits stand watching in silence, and the final shots show the whole semicircle of flagpoles in front of the glass facade with a large flag flying at the centre.

4756.words: france (noun): the European country whose capital is Paris
4756.asset_description: A woman with a red scarf rides a bicycle along a paved riverside path with a long baguette sticking out of the front wicker basket; the Eiffel Tower and a stone bridge over the river fill the background. She then walks between rows of a purple lavender field at dusk with her arms out, turning to laugh at the sky. Finally she sits under the red awning of a pavement cafe at sunset, biting into a croissant with crumbs on the paper in front of her.

4779.words: germany (noun): the country in central Europe, capital Berlin
4779.asset_description: A travel selfie video. A man with a backpack films himself grinning in front of the Brandenburg Gate in Berlin, its columns and bronze horse statue above him and cyclists crossing the square behind. The scene cuts to him leaning on a stone parapet in the mountains, looking across a pine forest at a white fairy-tale castle half hidden in mist. Finally he is inside a festival beer tent strung with lights, where men in traditional jackets and hats hold up stone beer mugs and a giant pretzel while he raises a mug of his own to the camera.

4970.words: independence (noun): freedom from the control of others
4970.asset_description: A night photo of a packed old-town street: a huge crowd fills the square in front of a stone clock tower, fireworks burst in the dark blue sky and confetti falls over the people. Several people sit on friends' shoulders waving large plain flags in red, blue, green and yellow, and everyone below is cheering with raised fists and open mouths.

5098.words: national (adjective): belonging to one nation or country
5098.asset_description: A packed floodlit football stadium at night. A young man in the foreground has his face painted half light blue and half white, the colours of his country, and wears the same light-blue-and-white striped shirt and a matching scarf. He hammers a big drum strapped to his chest while the whole stand around him sings and jumps in the same colours. Scarves are held up overhead, and then a huge light-blue-and-white flag is passed over the crowd until it covers the whole frame; he looks up at it, still shouting.

5296.words: traditional (adjective): done or worn as it was long ago
5296.asset_description: Outside a wooden mountain hut, a young man in an embroidered folk shirt, leather belt and a black felt hat with a feather cooks an old country dish over a fire. He scrapes small dumplings off a wooden board into a big black cauldron of boiling water, holds up a white lump of sheep cheese, sprinkles fried bacon over the pot and stirs it with a wooden spoon. He then serves the finished dish in a carved wooden bowl on a rough wooden table and grins at the camera while hikers watch from the hut behind him.

130.words: calendar (noun): a chart showing the days, weeks and months
130.asset_description: An anime woman crosses off the day on a big wall calendar with a red crayon, then flips through the pages and points excitedly at a date circled with a little heart, hugging her hands to her chest.

243.asset_description: After a timer beep, a woman frantically pulls a sweater over her head, hair standing up with static, while her partner helps her into a scarf, jacket and beanie. She laces boots, checks the full winter outfit in the mirror and gets a thumbs up before hurrying out the door with her bag.

273.words: evening (noun): the part of the day before night
273.asset_description: A couple stands at a wall above a small town clinking mugs as the sun sinks behind the hills. The sky slowly darkens from orange sunset to deep blue dusk, the town lights come on and the moon brightens above them.

299.words: wake up (verb): to make someone stop sleeping
299.asset_description: A fixed night camera shows a woman fast asleep in bed when her dog jumps up, paces over the blanket and nudges and licks her face. She stirs, sits up rubbing her eyes and hides her face laughing while the excited dog stands over her wanting to play.

499.words: newspaper (noun): printed pages of news that come out daily
499.asset_description: At an outdoor cafe table with coffee and a croissant, a woman opens a huge broadsheet newspaper that completely hides her face. Her boyfriend leans over as she plays peek-a-boo from behind the pages, then she folds the newspaper up neatly and they leave together laughing.
499.transcript: The whole world's in here! Peek-a-boo!

501.words: night (noun): the dark time between evening and morning
501.asset_description: A young couple walks home through a quiet whitewashed village street at night under the moon and street lamps, a black cat trailing them. They say good night at a blue door and the man walks off alone down the dark lane.

519.words: pack (verb): to put things into a bag or box to take along
519.asset_description: Hands fill an empty beige tote bag laid on a bed: a pink water bottle goes into a side pocket, then notebooks and books, a pencil pouch and earphones each find their place. The full bag is zipped up and lifted by its straps, ready to go.
519.transcript: I pack my bag for school. I put my books, my bottle, and my pens inside.

593.words: pyjamas (noun): loose soft clothes you wear in bed
593.asset_description: On a snowy winter evening a young man and woman in matching checked pyjamas warm them on a radiator, put them on and shuffle around the attic bedroom with hot drinks. They fall backwards onto the bed while their dog naps on the rug.

645.words: schedule (noun): a plan of the things you must do and when
645.asset_description: An animated man in a teal shirt stands at a big wall planner calendar in an office, pinning colored magnets on different days, circling one date with a marker and ticking it, then steps back satisfied saying it is sorted.

653.words: searching (noun): the act of looking carefully for something
653.asset_description: A frantic couple turns their apartment upside down searching for lost keys: she digs under couch cushions and through drawers, he crawls under the sofa and shakes out a backpack, they argue by the front door - where the keys turn out to be hanging in the lock the whole time.
653.transcript: They were right here! Oh, you're kidding!

672.words: showering (noun): washing your body under falling water
672.asset_description: At an outdoor beach shower, a young woman in a wetsuit rinses off under the cold water, shrieking and hugging herself, then pulls her laughing friend under the spray; they both rinse the sand off and dry themselves with towels.

692.words: sleeping (noun): the state of resting with your eyes closed
692.asset_description: In a cozy log cabin a man yawns and stretches, flops onto the bed, pulls the knitted blanket over himself and falls asleep with his eyes closed while a woman reads and a cat watches in the background.
692.transcript: Mmmmm. Best spot ever. Half open.

708.words: soap (noun): a bar or liquid you use with water to wash
708.asset_description: In a hand-painted anime garden, a young man picks up a pale bar of soap at a stone outdoor sink, lathers his muddy hands into thick white foam, rinses them under the tap, and admires his clean hands as a bubble floats by.

792.words: toothpaste (noun): a cream you put on a brush to clean teeth
792.asset_description: In a Pixar-style bathroom, a woman in a lilac bathrobe squeezes toothpaste onto her toothbrush, but the paste keeps flowing out into a huge wobbling spiral tower; she stares at it wide-eyed, scrapes a normal blob back onto the brush and happily brushes her teeth.

795.words: towel (noun): a soft cloth for drying yourself
795.asset_description: A Pixar-style muscular man climbs dripping out of a pool, grabs a striped towel from a lounger and rubs his face and hair dry until it stands up in wild spikes; his wet dog shakes water over him, so he laughs and wraps the dog in the towel too.

855.words: walking (noun): going somewhere on foot for fun or exercise
855.asset_description: A cartoon couple in retro 80s tracksuits and headbands strolls along a palm-lined beach boardwalk, the man carrying a grocery bag of vegetables. They walk past beach huts and lampposts, then lean on the railing to look at the sea.

861.words: watch (noun): a small clock you wear on your wrist
861.asset_description: A close-up shows a wristwatch on a young man's arm; he taps its face, reads the time and panics. He and his roommate scramble for their coats and rush out of the apartment, leaving the kitchen empty.

933.words: bathroom (noun): a room with a bath or shower and a washbasin
933.asset_description: In a white-tiled bathroom with a shower head, towels and a toothbrush cup, a woman bends over the sink and splashes water onto her face.

1200.words: morning (noun): the time between dawn and noon
1200.asset_description: A woman in a bathrobe stretches her arms up on an old-town balcony as the low sun rises over the street. A steaming cup of coffee sits on the railing in the golden early light.

1315.words: shower (noun): a fixture that sprays water over you
1315.asset_description: A man in swim shorts stands under a large rain shower head in a white-tiled bathroom, head tilted back and wet hair flying as water streams down.

1325.asset_description: A woman in grey pyjamas lies curled on a bed with her eyes closed, hugging the pillow, in a calm sunlit bedroom.

1385.words: tap (noun): a thing you turn to let water run out
1385.asset_description: A close-up of a chrome bathroom tap with water streaming out while a young woman reaches to turn the handle, splashing droplets over her hand. A bar of soap rests on the white sink edge.

1406.words: toothbrush (noun): a small brush used for cleaning the teeth
1406.asset_description: A smiling woman in a sunny bathroom holds up her toothbrush with foam on the bristles, toothpaste foam on her teeth, with the sink and a cup of bamboo toothbrushes behind her.

1676.asset_description: A flat illustration of a red-haired girl sitting sideways in a red armchair, holding a steaming paper cup, against a blue starry background.

2510.words: bedtime (noun): the time when you go to sleep
2510.asset_description: A red-haired boy and a fluffy grey cat lie side by side under a big white blanket at bedtime, both peeking out with sleepy, content faces.

3163.words: to wash (verb): to clean your body with soap and water
3163.asset_description: Cartoon of a dark-haired girl in a red T-shirt leaning over a bathroom sink, rubbing her soapy hands together under running water from the tap; a soap dispenser and a mirror hang on the blue tiled wall.

3164.words: to brush your teeth (phrase): to clean your mouth with toothpaste
3164.asset_description: Cartoon of a girl in a purple T-shirt standing at a bathroom sink with the tap running, holding a yellow toothbrush in her mouth with white foam around her lips; a tube of toothpaste stands on the counter and a mirror hangs behind her.

3176.words: to sit (verb): to rest your weight on your bottom
3176.asset_description: Simple line-and-colour drawing of a girl in a green jacket sitting on the grass with her back against a big tree trunk and her knees pulled up, smiling as she watches a small green butterfly fly past in the blue sky.

3222.words: to sleep (verb): to rest with your eyes closed, not awake
3222.asset_description: Oil painting of a white and ginger cat curled up asleep with its eyes shut on the seat of a green and cream striped armchair, one paw hanging over the edge, against a bright green wall.

4016.words: bath (noun): a tub of liquid that something is put into
4016.asset_description: A grey British Shorthair cat crouches on the rim of a white bath filled with pale green water, staring down at two small dark toys floating on the surface. It reaches a front paw down and taps at the water, sending rings spreading out across it. After a few tries it pulls the wet paw back, shakes it and walks off along the rim.

4045.words: find (verb): to discover something or where it is
4045.asset_description: In the living room of a stone-and-wood villa a man in a dark blue shirt and white shorts is looking for something: he turns on the spot, pats himself down, leans over the sofa and checks around the cushions while a woman in a cream robe sits on the sofa watching him. The camera cuts to a sunlit stone ledge by the window where two magazines, a bunch of car keys and a black phone are lying. Back inside, the man walks past the sofa holding the phone up, smiling, and the woman looks up at him.

4117.words: search (noun): looking carefully in order to find something
4117.asset_description: An animated living room with a low round wooden table, a pale sofa and big windows onto a green garden. A man in a dark blue shirt stands looking worried, then starts hunting through the room: he throws the sofa cushions into the air, crouches down to look under the furniture and turns around again and again. A woman in a cream top sits calmly on the sofa watching him with a small knowing smile. The camera drops to the coffee table, where his phone and a bunch of car keys are lying in plain sight; a hand reaches in and points at them. He looks up, sheepish, picks up the phone, and she stands behind the sofa with her arms folded, pointing at the table.

4197.words: late (adjective): after the usual or expected time
4197.asset_description: A cartoon: a round white character with a red cap lies in bed under a blue duvet in a sunlit bedroom, an alarm clock on the bedside table. It picks up its phone, sees 7:01 on the red screen, frowns, puts the phone down and goes back to sleep with a happy smile. Time passes, the light in the room turns brighter. It picks the phone up again and the screen now reads 10:50. Its eyes go wide, it throws the blue duvet up into the air and shoots out of the room, leaving the bare mattress, the flying blanket and a puff of dust behind.

4224.words: toilet (noun): a room with a toilet in it
4224.asset_description: In a warm, softly lit hallway with a rug and a potted plant, an enormously fat green cartoon lizard waddles up to a doorway and has to squeeze its round belly through the frame. The door swings shut, and a small dark sign on it reads WC. The hallway sits quiet for a few seconds. Then the door opens again and the same lizard comes out completely slim, throwing both arms in the air with a delighted open-mouthed grin.

4284.words: rush (noun): the act of moving hurriedly and carelessly
4284.asset_description: A pencil sketch of a man dashing out of the front door of a flat: a slice of toast clamped in his teeth, a travel coffee cup and a briefcase in one hand, his jacket half pulled on over an untied tie, his free arm thrown out after a set of keys flying through the air, both shoelaces trailing loose behind him, with coats on hooks and shoes scattered by the door.

4285.asset_description: A grown man knots his tie in front of a mirror in a flat, drinks coffee standing up, sits at the kitchen table signing his way through a thick stack of bills and documents, shoulders a work bag and leaves through the front door, then walks to work in a stream of office commuters crossing a city street.

4378.words: shower (noun): a fixture that sprays water over you
4378.asset_description: A teenage boy squeezes into a tiny bathroom to brush his teeth, standing over the toilet with a chrome shower head and hose on the tiled wall right behind him. Cut to a door opening on a family bathroom where a woman lines coloured rubber ducks along the edge of the bath. Cut again to an older man in a bathrobe pushing open tall double doors onto an enormous marble bathroom with a skylight, a freestanding tub and two shower heads on the glass-walled wall behind him.

4380.asset_description: A woman in a colourful head wrap and a pastel robe leans over the edge of an empty white bathtub and turns on the tap. Water pours from the tap into the tub. Bottles of shampoo and bath products stand on the ledge behind her. The camera drops down inside the tub and watches from the water line as the running water and bath foam build up, more and more white bubbles spreading across the surface until the whole tub is full of thick foam. In the last shot she is lying back in the full tub with foam up to her chin, eyes closed, smiling, a small blob of foam on her nose.

4391.words: alone (adverb): without any others with you
4391.asset_description: A woman on her own at home. She sings into a hairbrush and dances around her empty living room in a big jumper. Then she sits at a table with a whole pepperoni pizza in front of her and one lit candle, and takes a bite straight from the slice. Finally she carries the pizza box through to her bedroom and lies back across the bed by herself, smiling.

4477.words: month (noun): one of the twelve parts of the year
4477.asset_description: An illustration of a man in a colour-blocked polo shirt standing at a wall, lifting the top sheet of a pinned-up calendar with one hand and turning the page over with the other. The sheet underneath shows a grid of squares with one square ringed in red. A red marker hangs from a string beside the calendar and three blank notes are pinned to the wall below it.

4478.words: date (noun): the specified day of the month
4478.asset_description: A woman in a mustard jumper stands at a white wall next to a window with a big photo calendar hanging on it. She uncaps a red marker, leans in and draws a red ring around one number in the grid, grinning at it. She then scribbles a large cross over the ringed number, and finally turns to the camera beaming and points at the marked day with her finger.

4548.words: late (adverb): later than usual or expected
4548.asset_description: A rainbow-coloured twin-bell alarm clock stands on a bedside table showing almost ten o'clock, with someone asleep in the bed behind it. The man screws up his face against the pillow. Next he stands in his kitchen holding a striped mug, hair everywhere, staring straight ahead in horror under a big round wall clock. Then a woman in a navy suit and heels stops in the middle of a grand glass-roofed shopping arcade, checks her wristwatch under the huge station clock on the end wall, and runs off through the crowd.

4550.words: finally (adverb): after a long delay, at last
4550.asset_description: Early morning in a kitchen with low sun through the window. A woman in a cream dressing gown yawns behind her hand and reaches up into the cupboard above the coffee machine, then leans in over the paper filter. She then props her chin on both hands right beside the machine and watches the glass jug, waiting, while the coffee drips in slowly. When the jug is full she lifts it and pours a long stream of dark coffee into a big painted mug, then holds the mug in both hands, closes her eyes and drinks.

4728.asset_description: A woman in blue medical scrubs comes home through her front door at the end of a shift, hanging her keys in a bowl. She yawns hugely with her eyes screwed shut, peels off her grey jacket and drops her bag, yawning again and rubbing her face with her hand. She staggers to the sofa and drops onto it sideways, and the clip ends with her lying asleep on the cushions with her eyes closed and her phone beside her.

4877.asset_description: A woman in a cream jumper and jeans is seated alone in a padded seat in an empty auditorium, blowing out a breath. As the camera pulls back, more and more people are seated in the rows around and behind her, until the whole vast hall is full of people sitting quietly in their seats, all facing the same way.

4937.words: ring (verb): to sound loudly, like a bell
4937.asset_description: A young man in a denim apron works the griddle of an American diner with red booths behind him. He cracks an egg onto the hot plate beside frying eggs and pancakes, flips the pancakes with a spatula, and stacks them on a green-rimmed plate. Syrup is poured over a pat of butter on top of the stack. He then leans over the counter, eyes wide, and strikes the metal service bell with his palm to call the order away.

4992.words: busy (adjective): fully occupied with what you are doing
4992.asset_description: An older woman in a yellow cardigan carries a big armful of clean laundry across a bright room, opens a tall white cupboard and pulls out a folding ironing board. She sets it up on the wooden floor, spreads its patchwork cover flat, then works through the pile with a steam iron and holds up a finished pale blue shirt.

5088.words: awake (adjective): not in a state of sleep
5088.asset_description: A soft watercolour of a wooden farmhouse at sunrise. A boy in a long pale nightshirt leans out of an open window with both arms stretched high above his head, mouth open in a yawn, just out of bed. Outside, the sun is coming up over misty hills and sends long rays across a meadow full of grass and small flowers. A cockerel stands on a fence post with its beak open and a few birds fly in the distance.

5148.words: morning (noun): the time between dawn and noon
5148.asset_description: Early light over an empty paved plaza: a person in a mustard coat stands at the edge with a flock of grey birds pecking in front of them, then the birds lift off low across the stones. Inside a deserted station hall the same person stands alone at the foot of a bank of escalators under the bright ceiling lights. They sit by themselves on a long empty row of seats with a canvas bag beside them, sipping from a can. In the last shot they stand in the middle of a wide boulevard, alone on the white stripes of the crossing with no traffic at all, while the sun comes up between the buildings and the trees behind them.

5202.words: put (verb): to set something down in a certain place
5202.asset_description: A woman opens a big double-door fridge and finds it almost bare, with only one jar of pickles on a shelf. Then hands start placing food inside: an apple onto a glass shelf, a bag of lettuce and cucumbers onto the shelf below, jars and a juice carton into the door racks. At the end she steps back in front of a fridge packed with fruit, vegetables, milk and juice and her mouth falls open.

5410.words: toothbrush (noun): a small brush used for cleaning the teeth
5410.asset_description: A close shot shows a blue-and-white tube squeezing a stripe of pale blue paste onto the bristles of a small green-and-white brush. A young man in blue pyjamas then stands at the bathroom mirror scrubbing his front teeth with it and working it around his mouth. He bends over the basin, rinses with water from his cupped hand and spits, then straightens up, smiles at his reflection and stands the brush in a white cup beside the tap.

5467.words: awake (verb): to stop sleeping and open your eyes
5467.asset_description: A brightly painted bunk room at a summer camp with open windows onto trees. A teenage boy on a top bunk jolts out of sleep with his eyes wide and his mouth open, then sits up and rubs his face with both hands while another child still lies asleep on the bunk below. The camera moves across the room and the whole dormitory comes out of sleep: children push back their duvets, sit up on the edges of their bunks and rub their eyes, with sandals and flip-flops on the floor beside the beds.

5482.words: bath (noun): when you soak and wash your body in a tub
5482.asset_description: A short montage of things being washed. First two hands scrub a white plate with a sponge under a running kitchen tap. Then a jet of water sprays the front of a dark car on a driveway. Then a hand lifts a pale shirt out of a big metal tub filled with white suds. Then a woman kneels on a lawn laughing while she washes a golden retriever sitting in a large grey plastic tub of water. Finally a group of people soap up cars at a car wash in a car park.

5496.words: adjust (verb): to alter something so that it is just right
5496.asset_description: A young couple's morning at home. She stands at the stove in his oversized blue shirt, flipping a pancake in a frying pan while he dances up behind her in a white shirt and tie. She then turns to him, holding a big mug of coffee, and carefully straightens the knot of his tie against his collar until it sits right. Later they kneel at a low table in the living room holding hands over two slices of cake, and finally they flop onto the sofa laughing, she raising the TV remote in the air.

151.words: chain (noun): a row of metal rings joined together
151.asset_description: Two men close a tall iron gate and wrap a heavy metal chain around its bars several times, pulling it tight to lock the gate shut, then smile and shake hands.

451.words: lock (verb): to close something with a key
451.asset_description: In a cartoon canal scene at night, a hand pushes a brass key into the keyhole of a wooden houseboat door and turns it. The woman in a red coat tests the handle, says all is safe, and walks away along the dock.

909.words: anyone (noun): a person, no matter which one
909.asset_description: In a night snowstorm, a hooded man stands at the wooden door of a log cabin under a lit lantern, arm raised with a small hammer as he knocks, looking up to see whether anyone is home.

1097.words: garage (noun): a building where a car is kept
1097.asset_description: A woman in dark overalls reaches up to pull down the metal door of a home garage at sunset; inside are a parked car, bicycles hung on the wall and shelves of boxes.

1159.words: key (noun): a small metal device that turns in a lock
1159.asset_description: A hand holds up a brass key on a leather fob in a warmly lit hotel corridor lined with doors.

1988.words: fence (noun): a barrier that goes around an area
1988.asset_description: Tall spiked wrought-iron fences and an open gate flank a stone staircase that climbs between lanterns to the glowing door of a gothic mansion wrapped in fog.

2011.words: open (adjective): not closed, so you can go or see through
2011.asset_description: A warm painting of a library room: a glass-paneled door stands wide open onto sunlit steps and a big window with a hanging green plant, and an open book lies on the desk in front.

2068.words: door (noun): the opening in a wall you enter or leave through
2068.asset_description: A snowy stone cottage with a glowing open red door framed by wreaths and lights; a decorated Christmas tree with a yellow star stands in the snowy yard beside it.

4076.words: door (noun): the opening in a wall you enter or leave through
4076.asset_description: A camera fixed under a helicopter looks back at its wide open side door. Three skydivers sit inside the cabin with their backs to the camera, framed by the doorway, with blue sky and a coastline visible through the opening. One by one they swing out through the open door onto the landing skid, stand on it barefoot holding the frame, and then push off. They drop away in a spread position over a coastal town with a winding river and a long white beach. The helicopter climbs and shrinks to a small shape in the empty blue sky.

4242.words: pass (verb): to go across or through
4242.asset_description: A ginger-and-white cat and a tabby cat sit side by side on a dark polished tiled hallway floor, looking up at the camera. A tall white metal safety gate blocks the doorway behind them. The ginger cat walks up to the gate and slips between its bars into the dark room beyond. The tabby then crosses to a small square cat flap set low in the white wall next to the gate, pushes its head through and squeezes its whole body out, until only its striped tail is left in the hallway.

4769.words: fence (noun): a barrier that goes around an area
4769.asset_description: A woman in a denim cap with a plait, an orange fleece and a backpack holds the camera at arm's length on a canyon viewpoint at sunrise. Behind her a wooden post-and-rail fence runs along the rim, closing off the drop. She turns from the camera to the canyon, her mouth open, and swings her free arm out towards the orange-lit rock walls; then she claps her hand over her mouth and keeps staring out over the fence at the canyon.

4841.words: key (noun): a small metal device that turns in a lock
4841.asset_description: A woman in a denim jacket stands in a hallway looking around with a frustrated frown. She crouches at an open kitchen drawer and rakes through hair ties, tape rolls, markers and packets. She moves into a walk-in wardrobe and pushes along the rail of hanging clothes, then tips a wicker laundry basket full of clothes upside down onto a chest of drawers. Finally she sits on the floor by a pile of clothes and holds a small metal key up to the camera with her mouth open in triumph.

4883.words: reveal (verb): to make something visible for everyone to see
4883.asset_description: A woman in a bright floral sundress walks smiling down a pale hallway; tall carved wooden double doors appear; she strides through the vaulted hall of an Italian villa with her arms flung wide; she pushes two huge studded wooden doors apart, steps outside, and the open doors show a sunlit valley of green hills behind her.

5007.words: lock (noun): a fastener on a door that keeps it closed
5007.asset_description: A woman in a bright yellow raincoat stands on the step of a blue front door with a brass knocker, digging anxiously through her beige tote bag. She finds a bunch of keys and holds them up in front of her face, grinning with relief. A close shot shows her sliding one key into the round metal lock set in the blue door and turning it. She pushes the door open and steps into the hallway.

5049.words: close (verb): to move something so an opening is blocked
5049.asset_description: A montage of things being shut and locked up. Hands hook a brass padlock through the metal hasp of a wooden garden gate and snap it closed. A man in a cream jacket crouches by a bike rack in a town square and threads a lock through his bicycle frame, then spins the dial of a combination padlock on a rainbow cable wrapped around the rack. In the last shots he turns a key in the lock of a wooden front door under a porch light at dusk, pulls the door closed behind him and walks away.

5116.words: to open (verb): to make something become open
