5116.asset_description: A hand pushes a small frosted kitchen window outwards above a steel sink, letting daylight and a potted plant on the outside sill into the dim room. Cut to a young man in a pale linen shirt striding through a bright Paris apartment towards the windows. He grabs the long white curtains and throws them apart, then swings the tall casement windows open over the rooftops. Finally he pushes both leaves of the balcony doors wide open with his arms spread and walks out onto the wrought-iron balcony into full sun.

5119.words: entrance (noun): something that gives you a way to get in
5119.asset_description: A large crowd in summer clothes is packed in front of two huge studded wooden gates set in a grey stone archway, with pink and white bunting strung above them. Two members of staff push the gates apart from the inside and a bright strip of the park appears between them. As the gates swing fully open a painted carousel comes into view beyond the archway. The crowd streams forward through the entrance and out into the fairground, a young woman in a red dress laughing and running ahead of them towards the carousel.

5127.words: shut (verb): to move a lid so an opening is closed
5127.asset_description: In a bedroom papered with travel posters, a young woman kneels over a hard-shell suitcase lying open on the bed. She folds T-shirts and stacks them in until the case is heaped over the rim, then grabs the lid and swings it down. It will not close, so she climbs on top, sits on the lid with her whole weight and presses it down with both hands, pulling faces the whole time.

5498.words: window (noun): the glass opening in the side of a vehicle
5498.asset_description: A young woman with a blonde plait pushes open a different window in every shot and leans out into the view behind it. First a white casement window over an old-town courtyard of pastel houses with shutters and potted plants; then a wooden chalet window opening onto a green alpine meadow under a blue sky; then a window straight onto a sandy beach and turquoise sea; then a big wooden chalet window framing a snowy mountain peak, which she pushes wide open and leans through, smiling.

147.words: cave (noun): a large hole in rock you can go into
147.asset_description: Two hikers with helmets and headlamps squeeze through a rocky entrance overgrown with ivy and walk into a dark cave, their lights revealing an underground lake and huge stalactites; one calls 'Hello?' into the echo.

173.words: cliff (noun): a high steep wall of rock
173.asset_description: A couple in rain jackets walks up to the grassy edge of a massive dark sea cliff. They carefully lie down on their stomachs and peek over the edge at the waves crashing far below, laughing in amazement.

254.words: earth (noun): the planet we live on
254.asset_description: By an open window above a coastal village, a young couple lean over a desk globe, spin it and stop it with a hand. They point at a spot on the little blue planet and grin at each other saying this is where they are, while a cat sleeps on the windowsill.

291.words: field (noun): an open area of land for crops or grass
291.asset_description: A golden wheat field stretches to the horizon at sunset as a couple walks down a narrow path through it. They brush their hands over the ripe wheat, hold up a single stalk against the sun, and the woman runs laughing along the path between the tall rows.

310.words: forest (noun): a large area covered with trees
310.asset_description: A red-haired woman and a young man walk from a green meadow in among huge tall trees. Deep inside the woods they tilt their heads back to stare up at the towering trunks as sunbeams cut through the mist, spread their arms wide and say 'Oh wow, so nice.'

495.words: nature (noun): the world of plants, water and mountains
495.asset_description: A couple climbs over a wooden fence and walks through a green alpine meadow toward a clear stony stream. They quietly watch two deer grazing on the far bank, then lie down side by side in the wildflower grass gazing up at the sky.

508.words: ocean (noun): the huge salt water that covers most of the earth
508.asset_description: From the deck of a sailboat, endless deep-blue water stretches to the horizon under a clear sky. Dolphins leap out of the waves beside the boat while the crew in sailing jackets points and cheers.

615.words: river (noun): a long stream of water flowing to the sea
615.asset_description: Two people race autumn leaves on a crystal-clear turquoise river running over pebbles between forested banks; the leaves drift with the current past a grey heron that finally flies off low over the water.

616.words: rock (noun): a very big hard piece of stone
616.asset_description: A couple in a misty green valley push with all their strength against a giant round rock that will not move, slide off it into the grass, then climb up the boulder instead and stand on top cheering with raised arms.

634.words: sand (noun): tiny grains of rock that cover beaches and deserts
634.asset_description: On a beach at sunset a young man lets dry sand pour from his fist into his other palm and shows a handful mixed with tiny pebbles; bare feet press footprints into the wet sand, a woman draws a big spiral in it with a stick, and a wave washes over the drawing.

718.words: south (noun): the direction toward the bottom of a map
718.asset_description: On a frosty field at low sun, a woman points up at a long V of geese migrating across the sky; a group of villagers climbs over a stone wall, plants a wooden direction post, and walks off across the stubble field following the birds toward the horizon.

746.words: stream (noun): a small narrow river running through land
746.asset_description: A couple kneels beside a clear, narrow stream winding through a green sheep pasture, dips their hands in the cold flowing water, floats a small leaf boat on it, and finally jumps across it laughing.

793.words: top (noun): the highest part or point of something
793.asset_description: On a windy hill summit, a woman in a purple jacket stacks flat stones onto a tall rock cairn, reaching higher and higher until she balances the last stone on the very top, then steps back and spreads her arms in triumph.

808.words: tree (noun): a tall plant with a wooden trunk and branches
808.asset_description: Two friends walk across a golden meadow at sunset toward a huge old oak tree. They press their hands against its rough bark, say how big it is, and crane their necks up at the massive trunk and spreading branches above them.

844.words: valley (noun): the low land between mountains
844.asset_description: A hiking couple reaches a grassy ridge and stops in awe above a huge green valley where a silver river winds between steep cliffs. They spread their arms, point at the view and dance around happily.

850.words: volcano (noun): a mountain that erupts fire and melted rock
850.asset_description: A couple stands in silhouette on a grassy ridge above a sea of clouds at dawn, watching a huge cone-shaped volcano. A thick column of smoke rises from its crater, and as night falls the top glows orange with lava; music only.

864.words: water (noun): the clear liquid in rivers, rain and seas
864.asset_description: A hiker crouches at a rocky forest stream and fills a glass bottle straight from the current. She holds the bottle up against the sun to show how clear it is, drinks deeply and smiles at her hiking partner before they walk on.

868.words: wave (noun): a wall of water moving across the sea
868.asset_description: Two swimmers turn to see a huge green wave rising behind them at the beach. It curls and crashes right over their heads, and they come up in the foam and sprint out of the surf onto the sand.

901.words: air (noun): the gas around us that we breathe
901.asset_description: A man with a backpack stands on a rocky mountain summit with his arms spread wide, facing endless blue ridges under a clear sky, breathing in the fresh air; a tiny paraglider floats in the distance.

1033.words: desert (noun): a huge dry area of sand where little grows
1033.asset_description: Endless golden sand dunes ripple under a clear blue sky, with a tiny camel caravan crossing a distant ridge.

1134.words: hill (noun): a raised piece of land, smaller than a mountain
1134.asset_description: A round green hill with a single large tree on top, a winding path leading up the slope, sheep grazing and a small figure flying a colorful kite partway up.

1156.words: jungle (noun): a thick tropical forest full of vines
1156.asset_description: A red parrot flies through dense tropical forest full of huge leaves, vines and moss-covered trees, with mist and a waterfall in the background.

1206.words: mud (noun): soft wet earth, soil soaked with water
1206.asset_description: A runner's shoe stomps into a deep brown puddle on a forest trail, throwing a big splash of wet mud into the air. The leg above the sock is already spattered brown.

1363.words: stone (noun): a lump or mass of hard rock
1363.asset_description: A hand holds a flat, smooth grey stone above a calm misty lake at sunrise, with ripple rings on the water from stones already skimmed.

2045.words: tall (adjective): great in height, from the ground up
2045.asset_description: Several very tall grey standing stones rise from a misty green field under a heavy dark storm sky, towering over the flat grass around them.

2121.asset_description: A tall tower of big rocks balanced on top of each other stands on a grassy mountain meadow, with snowy peaks and a pine tree behind it at sunset.

2164.words: woods (noun): an area of land covered with trees
2164.asset_description: A vividly colored stylized scene of tall dark tree trunks with glowing red, orange and blue autumn leaves, and a small path leading between the trees toward bright light.

2214.words: through (preposition): from one side of an opening to the other
2214.asset_description: In a surreal pink desert, a natural hole in a red rock formation frames a small distant castle seen through it, with pink blossom trees growing on the rocks.

2297.words: shore (noun): the land along the edge of the sea or a lake
2297.asset_description: A stylized night beach scene: dark silhouetted palm trees lean over a shore where waves roll in, under a huge glowing moon and a dramatic red-and-pink cloudy sky.

2306.words: countryside (noun): land with fields and villages, away from towns
2306.asset_description: A soft storybook painting of two small children holding hands on a dirt path, looking out over endless rolling green hills, scattered trees and a misty river valley at sunset.

2663.words: shadow (noun): the dark shape you make by blocking light
2663.asset_description: A cowboy in a wide hat stands with his back to us on a stony path in front of a huge setting sun, and his long dark shadow stretches down the path toward the viewer between the grass and hills.

2800.words: bubble (noun): a small ball of gas inside a liquid
2800.asset_description: A painted tropical beach at sunset: turquoise waves roll onto pale sand, palm-covered cliffs stand on the right, and one huge rainbow-sheened soap bubble floats in the sky with many smaller bubbles around it.

4005.words: frozen (adjective): turned to ice or completely covered in ice
4005.asset_description: A first-person view looking down the body of a climber in a red jacket standing on a glacier. Both gloved hands hold ice axes and the boots below wear steel crampons biting into the surface. The climber swings an axe into a bulging wall of blue-white ice and works up it.

4010.words: climb (verb): to go upward, step by step
4010.asset_description: A woman with a blonde ponytail climbs an overhanging white limestone cliff, filmed from above so the forest sits far below her. Her chalked fingers pull on small pockets in the stone while her feet smear against the wall. A rope runs from her harness down through quickdraws clipped to the face.

4015.words: bank (noun): the sloping land beside a river or lake
4015.asset_description: A flock of sheep grazes on the steep grassy sides of a narrow stream running through a misty green valley. One by one the sheep gather at the edge, then leap the water and land on the grass opposite. A shepherd and a black-and-white dog stand among the flock on the far side.

4088.words: wide (adjective): having a great distance from one side to the other
4088.asset_description: A steady shot taken from the very brink of an enormous waterfall on a bright day. A broad sheet of deep green water slides towards the camera and pours over a long curved edge that stretches far away across the frame. White foam breaks along the top, and a huge white cloud of spray rises from below and fills the right-hand half of the picture. Blue sky and small clouds sit above the far shore.

4198.words: deep (adverb): far down, to a great depth
4198.asset_description: A first-person shot on a narrow concrete pier over bright turquoise sea. The person walks up to a round shaft in the concrete and looks straight down into it: a dark green mossy hole going far down out of sight. They lower themselves in and drop down the shaft, the walls rushing past, the round opening of daylight shrinking above their black trainers. At the bottom the shaft opens under water and they come out over pale sand with orange coral patches on the seabed, still looking down at their own feet.

4233.words: stone (noun): rock cut into blocks for building
4233.asset_description: A drone films a tall bridge built of stone blocks, its arches and piers rising out of a green jungle gorge, with an enormous waterfall pouring down the cliff directly behind it. A freight train with a blue locomotive and dark red wagons rolls slowly across the top of the stonework. The camera pulls back to show the full height of the falls, the water breaking into white threads over the rock while the train crosses in front of them.

4247.words: well (noun): a deep hole dug to get water
4247.asset_description: A drone looks down on a huge flat field of bright green rice. In the middle of it sits a round stone well full of dark water, with a narrow footpath leading to it through the crop. A line of boys in red shorts stands along the well's stone rim; one after another they jump in, each landing with a white burst of spray. The last shot is straight down from above: five of them float on their backs in the round pool of water in a star shape, the green field all around.

4354.words: kick (noun): a blow with the foot
4354.asset_description: A woodcut-style illustration of an autumn wood in ochre, orange and brown. A woman in a chunky knitted jumper, a long knitted scarf and lace-up boots leans back against a thick tree trunk with one hand, swings her right leg forward and sends a fan of dry orange and red leaves flying up off the path in front of her. More leaves spiral down from the bare branches overhead. A squirrel sits on a fallen log beside the leaf-covered path further back, and acorns and chestnuts lie among the leaves in the foreground.

4485.words: powerful (adjective): having great power or force
4485.asset_description: A young man in a red checked jacket films himself on a Canadian trip. He first paddles a red canoe across a glassy turquoise lake ringed by snowy peaks. He then stands on a viewing platform in a blue plastic poncho with an enormous waterfall thundering right behind him, the whole curve of it churning white and throwing spray and mist over him while he laughs. Finally he walks through a forest of blazing red and orange maples and holds a single red leaf up to the camera.

4491.words: below (adverb): in or to a lower place
4491.asset_description: An illustration of an enormous layered canyon at sunset, drawn in bands of orange, red and brown. On a rock ledge at the right edge stands a tiny figure in a conical hat leaning on a walking stick. From up there the ground drops away in step after step of striped cliff to a narrow green river winding along the bottom of the canyon far underneath, with tall rock spires rising out of the depths and a red sun in the swirling sky.

4544.words: contrast (noun): the difference between things that are compared
4544.asset_description: An illustration split straight down the middle into two opposite halves. The left half is burnt orange desert: cracked dry ground, bare dead trees, a white blazing sun and grey rocky hills. The right half is deep blue ice: jagged frozen slabs, snow-laden fir trees, falling snow and heavy grey cloud. Down the seam between them rises a column of white steam shot through with glowing blue lines. A metal machine stands on each side, one in the sand, one on the ice, and a metal platform runs along the bottom of the frame.

4826.words: dam (noun): a barrier built to hold back water
4826.asset_description: A wide concrete dam wall sits across a green valley in the rain. Brown floodwater fills the reservoir behind it right up to the lip and pours over the top in two huge falls, crashing into the gorge below and throwing up white spray and mist. A small building and a road run along the crest of the dam.
4826.transcript: Wow, look how the dam starts to overflow.

4833.words: coast (noun): the land right along the edge of the sea
4833.asset_description: A follow-cam view behind a skateboarder in a helmet and gloves riding down an empty coastal road at sunset. The road curves along the side of a dry hillside, and on the right the land drops away to the sea, which runs out to a golden horizon. The rider crouches, puts a hand out through the bends and keeps rolling down towards the water.

4989.words: hill (noun): a raised piece of land, smaller than a mountain
4989.asset_description: Filmed from behind a rope barrier at the foot of a grassy ridge. First one armoured fighter with a red banner appears on the crest, then a long line of re-enactors with coloured flags comes over the top and charges down the slope toward the camera, passing a white canvas tent. Spectators in the foreground film it on their phones.

5001.words: landscape (noun): a wide view of natural scenery
5001.asset_description: A woman in a striped headscarf rides a train and looks out of the window at a river and dry hills sliding past. She then rides in a crowded minibus with bundles of luggage strapped overhead. Finally she hikes up a stony mountain path with a canvas backpack and a walking stick and stops on the ridge, where the whole valley opens out below her: a blue-painted village spread over the slope and bare brown mountains running to the horizon.

5005.words: bay (noun): a part of the sea curving into the land
5005.asset_description: A young woman in a navy polo shirt sits in a coastal watch station with nautical charts pinned to the wall and a brass bell beside the window. She scans the water through binoculars. Through the glass the sea curves inland between two green headlands, sheltered water dotted with moored yachts, small boats and orange buoys, with the open sea beyond. An orange rescue boat powers out across the water leaving a long white wake, and she lowers the binoculars and points at it.

5096.words: ground (noun): the solid surface of the earth you stand on
5096.asset_description: A pencil sketch of a woodland floor seen close up. A large mushroom with a thick stalk and a smooth domed cap grows straight out of the ground, its gills drawn in fine lines underneath. A hand comes in from the right and a finger touches the base of the stalk at ground level. Fallen leaves, twigs and smaller mushrooms cover the earth all around, with bare trees sketched softly in the background.

5201.words: reflect (verb): to send an image or light back
5201.asset_description: A woman in a pink jacket and a woollen bobble hat stands on a flooded salt flat so still that it works like a mirror: her whole body, the snow-capped volcano and every cloud appear again upside down in the water below her. She crouches down, touches the surface with one fingertip so rings spread out, then stands up and walks away, small against the doubled sky.

5214.words: desert (noun): a huge dry area of sand where little grows
5214.asset_description: A red-haired woman in a yellow raincoat travels through three places. She cycles along an Amsterdam canal past gabled houses and rows of parked bicycles, then rides an electric scooter down a palm-lined seaside boardwalk under a blue sky, and finally sits on a camel plodding over bare orange sand dunes at sunset, a line of other camels behind her in the empty desert.

5323.words: stone (noun): a lump or mass of hard rock
5323.asset_description: Two children sit on a wooden jetty at a turquoise mountain lake. A man picks up a large grey stone lying on the boards, carries it to the edge with both hands and hurls it into the water, throwing up a huge white splash. He then jumps in himself and surfaces in the lake.

41.words: argument (noun): an angry talk where people disagree
41.asset_description: In a Pixar-style 3D animation, a couple hanging a picture frame shout at each other about where it should go, pointing fingers forehead to forehead with steam rising, then cool off, laugh and hang the picture together.
41.transcript: I said to the left! No! It's perfect here!

285.words: family (noun): parents and their children as a group
285.asset_description: In a 2D cartoon, a grandpa sets a camera on a tripod in the yard while a big multi-generation family gathers on the porch at dinner. He starts the timer, hurries over to join grandma, parents, kids and the dog, and the camera flashes for the group photo.
285.transcript: Everybody, together now... Move up, move up! Cheese!

349.words: grandfather (noun): the father of your mother or father
349.asset_description: A white-bearded old man in a cap spends the day with his young grandson: they reel in a fish on a lake dock, finish a wooden birdhouse in his workshop, and play chess in a park before he hugs the boy.

350.words: grandson (noun): the son of your son or daughter
350.asset_description: An animated young man with a backpack arrives at the family house at night; his father welcomes him at the door and calls to the tiny grandmother in her armchair, who reaches up, cups her grown grandson's face and hugs him.
350.transcript: Mom, look who came. Oh, my boy's boy. Hi, Gran.

454.words: love (noun): a strong feeling of caring for someone
454.asset_description: A young man welcomes an exhausted, cold woman home on a rainy evening, wraps a blanket around her shoulders and helps her out of her boots. He hands her a bowl of warm soup, strokes her head and holds her as she falls asleep on his shoulder.

513.words: outside (adverb): not inside a building, out in the open air
513.asset_description: On a sunny savanna, a family carries their table, chairs, a woven mat and a big pot of food out of their small house onto the grass. They set everything up in the open air and sit down to eat together in front of the house.

684.words: sister (noun): a girl or woman with the same parents as you
684.asset_description: In a hand-drawn farmhouse kitchen a girl comes home through the door and her sister jumps up from breakfast to hug her; they pose together and then their mother joins the hug under a family portrait.
684.transcript: Oh, finally! Mom, I'm back! My two girls.

842.words: baby (noun): a very young child who cannot walk or talk yet
842.asset_description: A mother sits on the living-room floor with her baby, who reaches for colorful wooden alphabet letters scattered on the wood floor. The baby coos and grabs at the toys while the mother smiles.

873.words: wife (noun): the woman someone is married to
873.asset_description: A married couple enjoys a morning at home: the woman flips a pancake while her husband claps, they clink coffee mugs, and she straightens his tie with her wedding ring in view before they flop onto the sofa laughing.

919.words: aunt (noun): the sister of your mother or father
919.asset_description: A cheerful middle-aged woman in a patterned apron laughs and holds a wooden spoon as she dances hand-in-hand with a smiling teenage girl in a warm, steamy home kitchen with pots on the stove.

958.words: bride (noun): the woman getting married that day
958.asset_description: A smiling bride in a white dress and long veil stands in a bright bedroom holding a bouquet of white roses, a mirror and flowers behind her.

961.words: brother (noun): a boy or man with the same parents as you
961.asset_description: In a sunny backyard a young man laughs while pulling his younger brother into a playful headlock hug, both cracking up.

1013.words: cousin (noun): the child of your aunt or uncle
1013.asset_description: A boy and a girl of similar age lie side by side on their stomachs on sunny garden grass, laughing hard together with their sneakers kicked up behind them.

1030.asset_description: A little girl in a linen dress hands a small bunch of wildflowers to her smiling father as he kneels beside her in a sunny summer meadow.

1040.words: divorced (adjective): no longer married to your husband or wife
1040.asset_description: A sad woman sits on the bed sliding the wedding ring off her finger while, in the background, the man wheels his suitcase out through the bedroom door.

1110.words: granddaughter (noun): the daughter of your son or daughter
1110.asset_description: A little girl in a blue dress kneels on a wooden garden bench and kisses her white-haired grandmother's cheek while hugging her; the grandmother laughs in the golden evening light.

1112.words: grandmother (noun): the mother of your mother or father
1112.asset_description: A grey-haired woman in a blue apron smiles as she and a small child knead bread dough together on a floury kitchen counter, with a rolling pin and mixing bowl nearby.

1136.words: home (noun): the house or flat someone is living in
1136.asset_description: A man with a duffel bag over his shoulder hugs a woman tightly in the open doorway of a warm, lamp-lit house at dusk, with coats and shoes visible in the hallway behind them.

1188.words: married (adjective): having a husband or wife
1188.asset_description: A just-married bride in a white dress and groom in a navy suit laugh and dance close together at an outdoor garden wedding while guests watch and confetti falls.

1202.words: mother (noun): a woman who has given birth to a child
1202.asset_description: A woman lifts a laughing toddler in her arms in a bright living room, touching noses with him. The baby grabs her face while she smiles, a warm mother-and-child moment.

1227.words: parent (noun): a father or mother of a child
1227.asset_description: A father jogs beside his small son on a park path at sunset, one hand reaching out to steady the boy, who wears a helmet and rides a little red bike.

1342.words: son (noun): a male child of his parents
1342.asset_description: A grey-haired father warmly hugs his adult son, who holds a travel bag, at a garden gate while a golden dog jumps up at them.

1419.words: twin (noun): one of two children born at the same time
1419.asset_description: Two young women with the same face, matching wavy brown hair and identical beige linen dresses sit close together against a white wall, laughing at the same moment.

1420.words: uncle (noun): the brother of your father or mother
1420.asset_description: A young man carries a laughing little boy on his shoulders through a sunny backyard; the boy stretches both arms high in the air.

1704.words: christmas (noun): the winter holiday on 25 December
1704.asset_description: Art Nouveau card of a mother holding a child on her lap while a winged cherub sits below playing a harp, framed by vines; the text reads 'Wishing you a happy Christmas'.

1783.words: child (noun): a young person, a boy or a girl
1783.asset_description: A classic painting of a bearded man in long robes sitting outdoors and gently embracing four small children who lean against his lap.

2188.words: cry (verb): to shed tears because of sadness or pain
2188.asset_description: A hand-drawn illustration of a mother happily pedaling a red bicycle while a small boy sits on the rear rack behind her, crying loudly with his mouth wide open and eyes squeezed shut.

2549.asset_description: A watercolor drawing of a smiling father carrying his laughing son on his shoulders; both raise their fists high in the air in celebration on a city street.

3645.words: photo (noun): a print of a person or scene
3645.asset_description: Illustration of an astronaut sitting at a desk inside a spaceship, looking out of the big window at the Earth far away. On the desk in front of him stand a framed photo of a family holding hands at sunset, a mug and a notebook.

4108.words: husband (noun): a married man, a woman's partner in marriage
4108.asset_description: An animated city street. A tiny round red car covered in printed smiley faces is parked at the kerb. Inside sit two cartoon birds: a blue-green pigeon in the passenger seat, grinning, and a white and pink bird at the wheel wearing white gloves, glaring furiously ahead. The white bird scowls at the car while the pigeon beams. The camera pulls back to show the whole car from the side, with the words 'I'm her husband.' written large along the red door, and the white bird standing outside on the pavement with folded wings while the pigeon waves happily from the driver's window.
4108.transcript: Do you love your new car? I hate it! It's so embarrassing! But it's so cute!

4182.asset_description: A young man in a cap crouches on a big garden lawn and sprays purple paint onto the grass through a hose-fed spray gun, leaving coloured shapes behind him. He then leads an elderly white-haired woman, blindfolded with a red cloth, across the freshly painted grass. She takes the blindfold off, gasps with both hands at her face, then sits and lies back on the lawn laughing while a drone rises above her. The camera pulls up to reveal the whole lawn painted as a giant picture reading HAPPY 100 BIRTHDAY GRANPA with orange stars and blue gift boxes.
4182.transcript: It is Grandpa's 100th birthday. Time to surprise her with a huge gift.

4183.words: gift (noun): something you are given for free
4183.asset_description: A young man walks an elderly white-haired woman along a garden path towards a gift box taller than she is, wrapped in white paper with a wide red ribbon and a big red bow. He points at it and she pulls the front panel open like a door. A second young man steps out of the box holding a huge bunch of red heart-shaped balloons and spreads his arms. She raises her hands to her face, then hugs him tightly while the first man stands smiling beside them.
4183.transcript: Time to surprise grandma with the best birthday gift ever. Surprise! Happy birthday, young lady. I love you.

4305.asset_description: A backyard party at sunset. A man in a denim shirt and backwards cap flips burgers on a smoking barbecue. He then turns and holds out a plate with a huge stacked burger to a small boy in a striped t-shirt, who throws his fists up and shouts with delight. The man plays catch on the lawn with a leather glove, and finally sits on the tailgate of a red pickup while the guests behind him cheer with raised cups.

4443.words: wedding (noun): the event at which a marriage ceremony happens
4443.asset_description: In a bright room two women do up the long row of small buttons on the back of a young woman's white gown, then lower a veil over her dark hair while she smiles. The scene cuts outside to a garden hung with festoon lights and palm trees, where guests in suits and pastel dresses sit in white chairs on either side of a stone path. The young woman walks slowly down the middle between them, veil over her face, holding a big bouquet of white roses, and the seated guests turn and smile at her as she passes.

4610.words: dad (noun): an informal word for father
4610.asset_description: A warm illustration set in the hallway of an old house. A little girl in a red patterned dress and pigtails comes flying down the staircase, one arm swinging a leather school satchel, the other stretched out ahead of her. At the bottom a man in a tweed jacket and tie has dropped into a crouch with both arms wide open to catch her, grinning up at her. A grandfather clock, a coat rack with hats and coats, a patterned rug and the front door fill the hall behind them.

4611.asset_description: A young girl and her mother are baking together in a bright kitchen. Their hands crack an egg into a glass bowl of flour with a whisk in it. The girl, flour on her nose, holds up a crayon drawing of her family and shows it to her mother, who beams at her. They hug tightly, the drawing still in the mother's hand. Then the girl high-fives and dances with two men in the kitchen. The clip ends with several families walking hand in hand across a sunlit park.

4727.asset_description: A man in a blue polo shirt spends a sunny day with his children in a suburban garden and park. He jogs alongside a child in a helmet learning to ride a blue bike, holding the handlebar. He crouches on the grass and lifts a baby high over his head, then sets the baby on his shoulders and stands up, both of them laughing. He plays catch with an older boy who throws a yellow ball back to him, and the shot lifts away over the neighbourhood to a wide green park full of families.

4774.words: generation (noun): all the people of about the same age alive now
4774.asset_description: A cartoon garden scene under a blossoming apple tree hung with bunting. A white-haired old woman sits laughing in a floral armchair; a grown man in a shirt and brown trousers stands behind her laughing with his head back; a younger man holds a small boy in dungarees up in the air, and the boy throws his arms wide as a red and yellow beach ball flies above them. A scruffy little dog stands on the grass and a picnic table with a checked cloth sits to the right.

4781.words: marry (verb): to take someone as your husband or wife
4781.asset_description: An outdoor garden ceremony. A blonde bride in a white dress and veil, tears on her cheeks, slides a ring onto the finger of a groom in a black suit while he laughs with joy. They kiss under a tall flower arch. Confetti falls as they turn hand in hand and walk back down the aisle between rows of clapping guests, past flower arrangements and lavender, and at the end the whole wedding party throws their arms in the air and cheers.

4794.words: grandmother (noun): the mother of your mother or father
4794.asset_description: A white-haired woman in a flowered apron and oven gloves lifts a hot tray of chocolate-chip cookies out of the oven in a wooden cabin kitchen while a small girl behind her presses her hands together and gasps. Two girls crowd in beside her and she hands each of them a cookie from the tray. She then sits in a wing armchair with a picture book open on her lap, one girl asleep against her shoulder and the other leaning in wide-eyed as she turns the pages. In the last shot she sits at the head of a long garden table with the girls and other adults, all clinking teacups over a plate of the cookies.
4794.transcript: - You can't even look in there.

5089.words: mother (noun): a woman who has given birth to a child
5089.asset_description: A red-haired woman in an apron is shown through a day with her children. She lifts a laughing toddler in a pink shirt up into the air in the living room, then flips pancakes at the stove while two small girls reach up for them, then kneels on the carpet and holds a girl's leg to look at a grazed knee. At the end she hugs the children goodbye on the pavement outside a school, among other parents and children with backpacks.

5134.words: parent (noun): a father or mother of a child
5134.asset_description: Four short scenes of a mother and a father looking after their children. The mother spoons food from a bowl into a baby's mouth in a high chair while the father steadies the chair. Both of them kneel on a rug and help two toddlers stack a tall tower of coloured wooden blocks. At night the mother leans over a bed and tucks a boy under a blue duvet, and the father sits beside the next bed reading a picture book to a girl. Finally children run and swing in a sunny playground while the adults stand and watch.

5254.words: partner (noun): the person you are married to
5254.asset_description: In a green park an old man in a flat cap and tweed jacket dances along a path with his fists up, beaming. An old woman with white hair in a lilac cardigan leans down over a bed of bright orange marigolds and looks at them closely while a cyclist rides past behind her. Then several elderly couples dance together on a wide paved terrace under a blue sky with white clouds: one white-haired man holds his wife by the hand and waist and turns her, and the pair in the foreground hold each other by the shoulders, laughing into each other's faces as they dance.

5310.words: son (noun): a male child of his parents
5310.asset_description: A boy stands with his father at the open bonnet of a car in a bright garage; the father hands him a spanner and both grin. The same boy is then hugged tight by his mother in a white kitchen, kicks a football back and forth with his father on the driveway, and finally plays with other children on a park lawn while the parents watch.

5441.words: uncle (noun): the brother of your father or mother
5441.asset_description: A family barbecue in a green backyard. A big bearded man in sunglasses and a bright Hawaiian shirt runs a small boy around the lawn in a wheelbarrow while the boy throws his arms up and shouts. At the grill another man in a blue T-shirt turns the meat; two little girls stand in front of the smoke holding handfuls of marshmallows and grin at the camera. The bearded man then sits down at the picnic table and arm-wrestles one of the girls, letting her push his hand down while she laughs, and the clip ends wide on the whole family carrying children on their shoulders around the smoking grill and the loaded picnic table.

84.words: belt (noun): a strap you wear around your waist
84.asset_description: In a hand-painted seaside cottage a man's loose trousers keep slipping down; he panics, grabs a brown leather belt hanging on a chair, threads it through the loops, buckles it and happily dances now that his trousers stay up.

100.words: boots (noun): strong shoes that cover your ankle or leg
100.asset_description: A hiker laces up tall brown leather boots on a muddy hill path, then stomps through puddles and mud and climbs onto wet rocks with a border collie alongside; the group continues up the green trail in their boots.

126.words: button (noun): a small round thing that fastens clothes
126.asset_description: In a tailor's workshop a jar of spare buttons is poured out and one button is held up to the light; a man then buttons his blue shirt completely crooked while the tailor counts 'one, two, three - all wrong', and she refastens it properly so the shirt finally sits straight.

138.words: cap (noun): a soft hat with a stiff part at the front
138.asset_description: On a sunny tropical street a man squints and shields his eyes until his friend in a teal cap hands him a coral one; he puts it on with relief, briefly tries it backwards, laughs and turns the brim forward again.

177.words: coat (noun): a warm jacket you wear over your clothes outside
177.asset_description: On a frosty bridge a woman swings a long camel coat over her sweater and scarf, slips her arms in, buttons it up, pops the collar and ties the belt. She twirls to show it off while her friend gives a thumbs up, then they walk off.
177.transcript: Now I'm ready. Do your worst!

181.words: collar (noun): the part of a shirt that goes around your neck
181.asset_description: A young man in a white shirt pops his collar up straight and poses proudly while his friend reacts in shock; after saying "Leave it up. No!" he folds the collar back down flat.

194.words: cotton (noun): a soft white plant fiber used to make cloth
194.asset_description: In a cotton field at golden hour, a young couple picks a fluffy white cotton boll, holds it up to the light and feels how soft it is, then presses it against the man's white t-shirt as he laughs "that's my shirt", and the woman blows the fluff off her palm.

242.words: dress (noun): a one-piece item of clothing with a skirt
242.asset_description: A red summer dress hangs on a hanger under a lemon tree while a hand points out that it is all one piece. A young woman then wears it in the courtyard, checks herself in a mirror and twirls so the skirt flares out while a man applauds.
242.transcript: All one piece? Whoa! Spin again!

288.words: fashion (noun): the style of clothes that is popular now
288.asset_description: Two models in elegant oversized suits, one cream and one taupe, pose and twirl for a phone photographer on a Paris street. They adjust their jackets, strut past cafe terraces like on a runway, and a little dog in a sweater trots along with them.

336.words: glasses (noun): a pair of lenses in a frame you wear to see
336.asset_description: On a park bench by a duck pond, a squinting red-haired woman guesses there are three ducks, then cleans her round glasses with a cloth, puts them on and gasps that there are actually seven.

390.words: hoodie (noun): a soft sweatshirt with a hood on the back
390.asset_description: By a foggy canal in the rain a young man pulls the hood of his navy hoodie over his head and tightens the drawstrings until only his grinning face shows, while his girlfriend in a maroon hoodie laughs; they walk off arm in arm.

408.words: jacket (noun): a short coat that covers your arms and top
408.asset_description: At a marina at sunset a man pulls a rust-brown jacket on over his sweater, zips it up and shows it off, then walks along the pier with his girlfriend.

435.words: leather (noun): animal skin used to make shoes, bags and jackets
435.asset_description: In a leather workshop, a craftswoman and a customer stretch a large tan hide that creaks between their hands; she brushes and polishes a leather belt, and he happily tries on a brown leather jacket.

496.words: necklace (noun): a chain or string of beads worn around your neck
496.asset_description: On a terrace full of pink flowers, a young woman holds up a colorful beaded necklace of red, blue and yellow strands. Her friends help her slip it over her head onto her white shirt, and she admires it in a small hand mirror, delighted.

512.words: outfit (noun): the set of clothes worn together
512.asset_description: A young woman and a guy lay clothes out on a bed, swapping pieces: a rust jacket, a cream blouse, dark jeans traded for cream trousers, white sneakers and a straw hat. She then wears the finished combination and checks herself in the mirror while he cheers.

563.words: pocket (noun): a small bag sewn into clothes to keep things in
563.asset_description: A red-haired young man by a stone wall pats himself down asking "Where are they?" and digs through the many pockets of his green jacket, pulling out random things like a pebble, a wrapper and a woolly glove. Finally he fishes his keys out of a pocket and holds them up in relief while his friend sips coffee.
563.transcript: Where are they? In your pocket.

635.words: sandals (noun): light open shoes held on with straps
635.asset_description: A woman buckles a pair of tan leather sandals on her bare feet on a sunny boardwalk; she and a man in brown sandals walk together by the water, she dips a sandalled foot near a tiled fountain, and the camera keeps returning to their strappy open shoes.

666.words: shirt (noun): a piece of clothing with buttons and a collar
666.asset_description: A young man takes a light-blue button-up shirt off a hanger, puts it on over his white T-shirt, buttons it up and fixes the collar and cuffs in front of a mirror while a woman watches approvingly and smooths the fabric.

668.words: shoes (noun): things you wear on your feet over socks
668.asset_description: A close-up shows someone sliding a foot into brown leather shoes with a shoe horn, lacing them up with a double knot, then walking out onto a brick street, splashing through a puddle and meeting a friend holding coffee.

679.words: silver (noun): a shiny grey precious metal
679.asset_description: In an anime workshop, a silver-haired woman takes tarnished black discs and a dull chain from a box and rubs them with a cloth until they shine bright mirror-silver; she puts on the gleaming silver earrings and chain and admires the sparkle.

685.words: size (noun): how big or small something is
685.asset_description: At a seaside hat stall a girl tries on straw hats: one is far too small, the next is comically huge and swallows her whole head, and finally the vendor hands her one that fits perfectly and she walks off happy.
685.transcript: Too small! Too big! This one fits.

689.words: skirt (noun): a piece of clothing that hangs down from the waist
689.asset_description: A woman in a park shows off a mustard-yellow pleated skirt: she holds the waistband, lifts the fabric to show how it hangs, walks down stone steps and twirls so the skirt flares out.

702.words: sneakers (noun): soft sports shoes with rubber soles
702.asset_description: In a Pixar-style 3D animation, a young red-haired woman in purple workout clothes laces up a pair of bright teal sneakers on a stone ledge, then happily bounds and jumps up the colorful hillside stairs of a seaside town.

753.words: suit (noun): a jacket and trousers that match
753.asset_description: In a tailor's fabric shop a man takes a bright blue suit from the rack, pulls on the jacket over his t-shirt, buttons it and turns proudly in front of the mirrors while his partner admires the fit.

759.words: sweater (noun): a warm knitted top with long sleeves
759.asset_description: On a rainy day indoors a red-haired woman unfolds a cream cable-knit sweater, presses it to her cheek, pulls it on over her shirt and snuggles into the collar with a hot mug beside her boyfriend.

762.words: t-shirt (noun): a simple top with short sleeves and no collar
762.asset_description: A man browses a drawer of folded shirts while a woman watches, picks out a teal T-shirt, sniffs it happily, pulls it on over his tank top and checks himself in the mirror as she applauds.
762.transcript: No. No. Maybe. That one. One second. Done.

766.words: tattoo (noun): a permanent picture inked into the skin
766.asset_description: In a tattoo studio, an artist peels the protective film off a woman's upper arm to reveal a fresh bird-and-rose tattoo. She gasps in delight, compares it with the paper sketch the artist holds up, and both give thumbs up.
766.transcript: Exactly like the sketch! It's forever!

782.words: tie (noun): a long strip of cloth worn around the collar
782.asset_description: A young woman knots a dark red tie around the collar of a man's white shirt, chanting "over, under, through"; the first knot comes out too short, so she redoes it and pats the finished tie flat.
782.transcript: Over. Under. Through. Too short. Over. Under. Through. There we go.

821.words: underwear (noun): the clothes worn next to your skin
821.asset_description: A cartoon lumberjack in a log cabin takes a white undershirt from a drawer and puts it on first, then piles on a sweater, puffy jacket, hat and scarf before stepping into a blizzard; back inside he strips down to his underwear and gives a cozy thumbs up.

893.words: zip (verb): to close a jacket or bag by sliding its fastener
893.asset_description: In an animated snowy town street, a blond young person in a teal puffer jacket grips the zipper pull with gloved hands and pulls it all the way up to the chin, then flips the hood up and grins as snow falls.

894.words: zipper (noun): a sliding fastener that closes clothes or bags
894.asset_description: Extreme close-up of the zipper on a rust-orange ski jacket. A blonde woman in a red beanie outside a snowy cabin fights with the stuck zipper, yanks it free and pulls it up over her chin, grinning at her friend before they walk off with ski poles.

1198.words: model (noun): a person who poses for a photographer
1198.asset_description: A tall woman in a flowing white gown walks a runway under spotlights while a seated audience watches and films her with phones. Classic fashion-show setting with a lit rig overhead.

1326.words: slippers (noun): soft warm shoes worn inside the house
1326.asset_description: A person in grey pyjama trousers sits on the edge of a bed sliding a foot into fluffy brown house slippers on a wooden bedroom floor.

1432.words: costume (noun): special clothes worn for a show or festival
1432.asset_description: A man sings into a microphone wearing a red hooded cape over a patched fairy-tale dress; a glass slipper stands on the coffee table and the wall behind is covered in storybook pictures.

1482.words: earrings (noun): pieces of jewellery you wear on your ears
1482.asset_description: Illustrated portrait of a young African woman wearing large gold hoop earrings, an animal-print headwrap and a bead necklace.

1643.words: hat (noun): headwear that protects the head from bad weather
1643.asset_description: A pencil-sketch portrait of a smiling man wearing a wide-brimmed cowboy hat, resting his arms in front of him.

1706.words: sunglasses (noun): dark spectacles that protect the eyes from the sun
1706.asset_description: Colorful stylized painting of a husky dog wearing round sunglasses whose lenses reflect a starry galaxy.

1713.words: feather (noun): one of the light soft things covering a bird
1713.asset_description: Painting of a Native American chief standing wrapped in a decorated robe, wearing a tall headdress made of many long feathers.

1728.words: fan (noun): a folding object you wave to move air
1728.asset_description: A vintage cabaret poster of a smiling dancer in a yellow skirt, striped bodice and black stockings kicking one leg up and holding a red folding fan high in her gloved hand.

1811.words: raincoat (noun): a waterproof coat you wear in the rain
1811.asset_description: A flat-style woman in a striped shirt stands among falling blue raindrops wearing a long yellow raincoat with the hood up.

1858.words: scarf (noun): a long piece of cloth you wear around your neck
1858.asset_description: A watercolor child in a red sweater and a long striped purple scarf floats upward while holding a big balloon painted like a starry night sky with a moon.

1936.words: flower crown (noun): a ring of blossoms you wear on your head
1936.asset_description: A vivid painted portrait of a woman with downcast closed eyes wearing a large crown of red, pink and orange flowers in her dark hair, with feather earrings and colorful painted streaks across her face.

1946.words: cool (adjective): stylish and relaxed in a way people admire
1946.asset_description: A bold flat pop-art poster of a cat lounging in big orange-framed sunglasses and a scarf, posing confidently against orange and teal shapes with red dots and squiggles.

2144.words: t-shirt (noun): a simple top with short sleeves and no collar
2144.asset_description: Anime-style young woman standing on a blurred city street wearing a mustard-yellow jacket over a white t-shirt, with a big navy scarf and a backpack.

2226.words: bracelet (noun): a band wrapped around the wrist
2226.asset_description: A blue-skinned deity-like man with long dark hair stands before a wall of orange flames, wearing stacked golden bracelets on both wrists, heavy necklaces, earrings and an ornate belt.

2269.words: blouse (noun): a loose light shirt worn by women
2269.asset_description: A young blonde woman in a loose white blouse with rolled sleeves and leather straps sits on a stone ledge high above a medieval town with steep grey roofs.

2273.words: jeans (noun): trousers made of strong blue cotton
2273.asset_description: A young woman with long dark hair walks through a rundown passage wearing a full denim outfit: a blue jean jacket over a t-shirt and heavily ripped blue jeans.

2285.words: sweatshirt (noun): a warm soft long-sleeved top, often oversized
2285.asset_description: Seen from behind at a low angle, a young woman with a messy bun walks through a narrow old alley wearing a big blue printed sweatshirt that covers her shorts, plus chunky sneakers and a small brown bag.

2295.words: sleeve (noun): the part of a garment that covers the arm
2295.asset_description: A red-haired young woman in a red-and-white gown with enormous wide flowing white sleeves stands in the wind in front of castle towers, red petals blowing around her.

2317.words: hood (noun): the part of a coat that covers your head
2317.asset_description: A young woman with long dark hair looks back over her shoulder on a night street of blurred lights; she wears a bright red cape with the hood pulled up over her head.

2349.words: dress up (phrase): to put on a costume to look like someone else
2349.asset_description: A big fluffy cat wearing a black witch hood lies in front of a white-haired girl in a witch hat with painted skull makeup, surrounded by glowing pumpkins and bats at night.

2393.words: high heels (noun): shoes with a tall thin part under the back
2393.asset_description: A stylized office woman with long dark hair, round glasses and gold hoop earrings stands by a desk in a floral blouse and belted teal pencil skirt, wearing black strappy high heels.

2395.words: vest (noun): clothing without sleeves worn over a shirt
2395.asset_description: A photoreal blond cowboy stands on a wooden porch at sunset wearing a black cowboy hat, a white shirt with rolled sleeves and a black leather vest with gold buttons, plus a big belt buckle.

2446.words: shoelaces (noun): strings that tie your shoes or boots closed
2446.asset_description: An ink-and-watercolor drawing of a pair of colorful high-top boots seen from above, each one tied with long mustard-yellow shoelaces finished in big loose bows.

2455.words: shorts (noun): trousers that end above the knee
2455.asset_description: A smiling young woman with shoulder-length ginger hair poses indoors in a white t-shirt and green denim shorts, one hand tucked into the front pocket of the shorts.

2607.words: wear (verb): to be dressed in something
2607.asset_description: Three fluffy cats stand upright like gentlemen in an autumn wood, wearing long coats, a red tie, a scarf and old-fashioned hats, posing solemnly for a portrait.

2690.words: diamond (noun): a very hard, sparkling stone used in jewelry
2690.asset_description: A glamour portrait of a dark-haired woman in a tall silver headdress and long drop earrings, both densely set with sparkling clear stones; a red rose sits at the side of the crown and grey floral tattoos cover her bare shoulder.

3147.words: cloth (noun): material made by weaving or knitting fibers
3147.asset_description: Illustration of a narrow sunlit alley between sandy mud-brick houses with several large blue cloths hanging to dry on a line stretched overhead; below, a man in a hat crouches over wet fabric among round baskets and jars.

3479.words: handbag (noun): a small bag for carrying your things
3479.asset_description: A woman in a white dress and straw hat sits at a small round cafe table outside a green door; a pink handbag with a gold clasp stands on the table beside her.

3519.words: earring (noun): a piece of jewellery worn on your ear
3519.asset_description: Boho profile portrait of a woman with her dark hair in a low bun and a large white teardrop earring hanging from her ear, surrounded by oversized pink flowers and green leaves.

3841.asset_description: A minimal illustration shows a white rabbit character standing in a big orange ball gown with ribbons swirling around it, while socks, trousers, a green top, a green dress and a pair of glasses float in the air around it on a cream background.

4003.words: pair (noun): two similar things that go together as a set
4003.asset_description: Top-down view of two people standing toe to toe on a wooden floor. One wears bright yellow slippers with big googly eyes and a pink tongue sticking out; the other wears a matching set in green. They shuffle their feet until the two sets line up facing each other like cartoon monsters.

4085.asset_description: An animated short about a man being transformed. He sits slumped on the sofa in a dark living room playing a video game while an angry woman stands behind him with her arms folded. She drags him out of the door. He then appears outside a smart townhouse in a navy suit and tie, standing tall and confident while two women look him over admiringly. A huge eye peers through a gap in the door. Finally the couple walk back into the house together.

4113.words: jewellery (noun): an adornment such as a ring or necklace
4113.asset_description: An animated city street at sunset with cartoon pigeons on the pavement. A small grey pigeon wears a glowing pink diamond ring that sparkles and casts pink light over its feathers. A white pigeon with pink-tinted feathers leans in beside it, admiring the ring with wide eyes and an open beak, while a huge dark pigeon with heavy eyelids looms over both of them in the background. The white pigeon presses herself against the grey one, then rears up, opens her beak wide and shouts with one wing raised. At the end the two walk off together side by side down the street, the ring still glowing between them.
4113.transcript: You fine. Hey, hey, back off. I'm his wife. I don't see any ring on that finger. You belong to the sky!

4137.words: yellow (noun): the yellow color, like a lemon
4137.asset_description: A pale lilac nursery with a white cot under a cream canopy, a round pink rug on the wooden floor and a cream armchair in the corner, filmed from the doorway. A bearded man is kneeling on the floor in an enormous bright yellow ball gown, the wide yellow skirt spread out all around him over the rug. In front of him a golden retriever sits in a red cape with a white ruff. The man leans down to the dog, picks up a yellow rubber bone from the rug and holds it out; the dog takes the yellow bone in its mouth and holds it there while he strokes its head and talks to it, the yellow skirt filling half the frame.

4212.words: brown (adjective): of a color like wood or earth
4212.asset_description: A woman and a man stand side by side in a bright white panelled room in front of a cream sofa, posing to camera. Their matching shirt-and-trouser outfits change from one look to the next: both in deep chocolate brown, then cream with a light brown shirt, then tan brown, then dark brown again, and finally pale grey with a beige shirt. The woman changes her small handbag with every outfit so that it matches, and the two lean together and smile between changes.
4212.transcript: Remember, taupe with white looks elegant. Wine with camel looks romantic. Mocha with ivory looks soft. Plum with grey looks striking. And sage with cream looks fresh.

4213.words: red (noun): the red color, like blood
4213.asset_description: Two women pose together in a white panelled room in matching floor-length satin evening gowns with a high slit. The gowns and accessories change from look to look: black gowns with gold heels and small gold bags, then black gowns with bright green heels and a green bag, then chocolate satin gowns with lilac heels and lilac bags, and finally deep red gowns, one with a long cape sleeve, worn with emerald necklace and earrings and a green clutch.
4213.transcript: Remember, black with gold is expected, but black with deep green looks richer. Chocolate with lavender looks interesting, and red with emerald looks striking.

4214.asset_description: A couple pose side by side in a white panelled room next to a potted olive tree, changing outfits between shots. They start in matching light blue: she in a light blue satin shirt tied at the waist with white trousers and a light blue bag, he in a light blue linen shirt with white trousers. Then she wears a blue draped top with brown flared trousers while he wears a brown polo with light blue trousers, then both are in chocolate brown and cream, and finally both wear dark green cable-knit jumpers, hers over a camel skirt with tall suede boots, his with camel chinos.
4214.transcript: Remember, light blue with white looks good, but light blue with brown is unbeatable. Chocolate with cream looks luxurious and forest green with camel looks next level.

4215.words: orange (noun): the orange color, like the fruit
4215.asset_description: A couple pose in a white panelled room, their outfits changing from shot to shot. First she wears an orange halter top with wide white trousers while he wears a white linen shirt with orange trousers. Then she is in an orange vest with navy wide trousers and he in a navy shirt with the same orange trousers. Next both are in pink, hers an off-shoulder puff-sleeved top with grey trousers, his a pink linen shirt with grey trousers. Finally she wears a rust top with a pleated olive skirt and he a sage shirt with rust trousers.
4215.transcript: Remember, coral with white looks fresh, but coral with teal looks striking. Powder pink with grey looks chic and olive with rust looks rich.

4216.words: white (noun): the lightest color, the opposite of black
4216.asset_description: A couple pose together in a white panelled room in front of a cream sofa. In the first look she wears a deep red satin gown and he an all-black shirt and trousers. Then she wears a sleeveless white tiered cotton dress with white heels while he wears an olive shirt with cream trousers, and they turn to face each other. In the last look she wears a long fitted black dress with black heels and he a tan shirt with dark brown trousers, his arm around her waist.
4216.transcript: Remember, if she is wearing red, he goes all black. Main character energy. If she wears white, olive and cream, old money. And if she wears black, taupe and chocolate, quiet luxury.

4272.words: gold (adjective): made from or covered with gold
4272.asset_description: A woman in a plain white shirt and black trousers stands in a clothes shop between rails of colourful dresses. One by one she puts on shining gold pieces: big gold hoop earrings, then fine gold chains at her neck, then a thick stack of gold bangles on her wrist, then a red belt with a heavy gold buckle. She finishes the look with a wide straw hat, sunglasses and two bags and presents herself to the camera.

4442.words: shoe (noun): footwear shaped to fit the foot
4442.asset_description: A hand-drawn illustration of a bright dressing room. A young woman in a long white gown with a veil spins on the spot, her wide skirt lifting and swinging out around her, and she holds a bunch of white daisies up in one hand. As the skirt swings up it uncovers her feet: she wears a pair of plain white shoes with a low heel, one flat on the carpet and one lifted behind her as she turns. Behind her are a tall gold-framed mirror, a bright window with cream curtains, vases of flowers and a dress bag hanging on a hook.

4655.asset_description: In a sunlit bedroom a bare-chested young man picks up a light blue shirt and pulls it on. He fastens the buttons one by one down the front, then swings a navy suit jacket over his shoulders and pushes his arms into the sleeves. He knots and straightens a dark tie at his collar, tugs the jacket into place, and finally stands in front of a mirror in the full suit, adjusting the tie one last time.

4704.words: hat (noun): headwear that protects the head from bad weather
4704.asset_description: A heavy bearded man sits bare-chested in a small wooden sauna wearing a thick grey fur hat with ear flaps and a white towel around his waist. In front of him a pit of grey stones glows orange in the middle. He reaches for a wooden bucket at his side, lifts a wooden ladle of water and tips it over the hot stones. A thick cloud of white steam bursts up and fills the whole cabin until he almost disappears in it. He sits back grinning and gasping, waving a hand through the steam, with a snowy window behind him.

4722.words: sunglasses (noun): dark spectacles that protect the eyes from the sun
4722.asset_description: An outdoor garden party on a lawn, with a floral arch, string lights and a cream sofa behind. Guests in summer dresses and pale suits stand in a group; several of the women wear dark sunglasses. One by one the women swoon and sag at the knees while the others grab them under the arms and hold them up. A man in a beige suit fans himself with a white plate. By the end everyone is lying on the grass and on cushions, still fanning themselves with plates.

4750.asset_description: A woman in pyjamas with a towel wrapped round her hair kneels on a wide white bed in a high-rise flat and folds washing. She holds up a tie-dye t-shirt, lays it flat and folds it, then folds a grey lace top. A wicker basket of clean washing sits beside her. The folded items grow into neat stacks, and by the end the whole bed is walled in by tall towers of folded clothes in every colour.

4845.words: cloth (noun): material made by weaving or knitting fibers
4845.asset_description: Close on two hands in a living room stitching a dark button onto the front of a pale blue shirt with a needle. Cut to a workroom where dark hands push a fine needle through the folded hem of a piece of natural linen, with spools of coloured thread on the shelf behind. Then a sewing machine foot runs a line of stitches along a folded cream panel. Next an embroidery hoop holds a big pink and red flower worked in coloured threads with green leaves. Finally a row of people in a hall lift a finished patchwork quilt above their heads and cheer.
4845.transcript: There we go. Nice and even. Pretty. Ta-da!

4864.words: uniform (noun): clothing a group wears to be identified
4864.asset_description: A young woman works at a laptop in a bright home office and raises one finger asking for quiet as she talks. Behind her a young man slips past the doorway, then another man carries a box through. Then an entire marching band files into the room in matching navy, orange and light blue uniforms, playing trumpets, a trombone, a sousaphone and a bass drum. She throws her hands up and shouts in disbelief while the band plays on around her desk.

4892.words: shorts (noun): trousers that end above the knee
4892.asset_description: A first-person ride down a water slide: bare legs in colourful swim shorts race feet-first through a blue chute past palm trees and a bright sky, then down a green flume into a burst of white water; the shot ends on the whole waterslide tower above a busy pool.

4910.words: scarf (noun): a long piece of cloth you wear around your neck
4910.asset_description: A young man in a packed football stadium films himself in the stands. His face is painted in two halves, blue-yellow and red, and a long striped team scarf in club colours hangs around his neck over his shirt. A wide shot shows the ring of the stadium full of fans with a flag being waved on a pole. He shouts and screams with joy, the fans around him leap up and hold a scarf overhead, and he ends hugging a friend and roaring at the camera.

5173.words: raincoat (noun): a waterproof coat you wear in the rain
5173.asset_description: A hand holds a metal bottle under a thin fall of water trickling off a mossy cliff and fills it; then a woman in a bright red hooded raincoat with an orange backpack walks along a wet path, reaches into the spray of a small waterfall, and finally stands in front of a huge waterfall, mouth open, looking up at it.

5217.words: vest (noun): clothing without sleeves worn over a shirt
5217.asset_description: A smiling man in a yellow high-visibility vest pulled on over his t-shirt stands on a terracotta tiled roof above an Italian old town; the camera pans away from him across a sea of red-tiled roofs, bell towers and a green dome under a clear blue sky, then comes back to him as he throws an arm out toward the view.

5286.words: sweatshirt (noun): a warm soft long-sleeved top, often oversized
5286.asset_description: Two young women in a bedroom hung with fairy lights play tug-of-war over a lilac hooded sweatshirt, both laughing. They then bunch it up between them and pull faces at a phone held out at arm's length for a selfie. In the last third they sit on the bed and one plaits the other's hair while she gives a thumbs-up.

5294.words: slippers (noun): soft warm shoes worn inside the house
5294.asset_description: A woman in checked pyjamas and a beige cardigan stands barefoot on a cold tiled hallway floor, hopping from foot to foot and hugging herself, shivering. A close-up shows her feet stepping into a pair of white fluffy sheep-face slippers on the wooden floor. She then walks comfortably down the hallway towards the camera in the slippers, relaxed and smiling.

5328.words: blouse (noun): a loose light shirt worn by women
5328.asset_description: A young woman in a walk-in wardrobe lifts a loose peach-coloured women's shirt with ruffles down the front off the rail and holds it up in front of her, sniffing it and smiling. She sprays it with a small glass atomiser, then takes a large white spray bottle and mists the whole rail of hanging clothes, walking along the rack from the pale shirts to the bright dresses. At the end she stands back in the middle of the wardrobe, phone in hand, looking pleased at the rows of clothes.

5357.words: fancy (adjective): decorated, expensive-looking and not plain
5357.asset_description: A battered pram with patched fabric and rusty wheels rolls along a park path. Then a woman in a beige blazer pushes a plain modern grey stroller with a small fluffy dog sitting in it and the caption 500 euro appears. Finally a man in white robes pushes an ornate chrome carriage-style stroller with buttoned leather upholstery, the same dog inside wearing sunglasses, captioned 5000 euro, while the woman stares open-mouthed.

5489.words: wear (verb): to be dressed in something
5489.asset_description: In a bright clothing boutique lined with rails of coats, a woman poses for the camera in one outfit after another. She is first dressed in an oversized denim jacket and a colourful scarf, then in a long red coat, then in a silver sequinned mini dress, then in a thick knitted coat, and finally in an enormous feathered coat with a matching feather hat. Between each look the shot cuts and she is dressed in the next piece.

15.words: pill (noun): a small round medicine that you swallow
15.asset_description: In a cartoon mountain cabin, a man sits at a table holding his aching head. His friend hands him a small white pill and pours a glass of water; he swallows the pill, drinks, and soon smiles feeling better.

195.words: coughing (noun): loud bursts of air from your throat when ill
195.asset_description: A woman wrapped in blankets sits on an armchair coughing and holding her scratchy throat; her partner brings her a steaming mug of honey-lemon tea, she sips it carefully and finally smiles with a thumbs up as a cat jumps on her lap.

521.words: pain (noun): the feeling you have when your body is hurt
521.asset_description: A barefoot young man carrying a laundry basket stubs his toe on a metal bed frame, drops the laundry, cries out and sits on the floor clutching his hurt foot.

674.asset_description: A young woman wrapped in a blanket sits on a sofa blowing her nose into tissues and rubbing her aching head; a man brings her a steaming mug of tea, tucks a blanket around her, and she sips it looking miserable.

704.words: sneeze (verb): to blow air out of your nose suddenly
704.asset_description: In a hand-painted anime meadow, a young man holding a big bouquet of dandelions builds up to an enormous sneeze that blows his straw hat off and scatters dandelion seeds everywhere, while a girl beside him first ducks, then giggles as he wipes his nose with a handkerchief.

705.words: sneezing (noun): blowing air out of your nose suddenly
705.asset_description: At a flower market, a young woman smells the tulip bouquet her boyfriend gave her and keeps sneezing into her elbow while he laughs; moments later he catches it too and sneezes himself, leaving both of them laughing among the flower stalls.

904.words: allergy (noun): a bad body reaction to pollen or dust
904.asset_description: At a sunlit outdoor flower market, a young woman holds a wildflower bouquet at arm's length and pinches her nose with a screwed-up face as a visible cloud of pollen drifts off the flowers.

1012.words: cough (verb): to push air out of your throat with a loud noise
1012.asset_description: On a cold rainy city street at dusk, a woman wrapped in a thick scarf holds a thermos and coughs hard into the crook of her elbow, eyes squeezed shut.

1074.words: fever (noun): a high body temperature when you are ill
1074.asset_description: A pale, teary woman wrapped in a knitted blanket sits on a sofa while a man rests his hand on her forehead and holds up a digital thermometer; tissues and a steaming mug sit on the table.

1126.words: headache (noun): a pain in your head
1126.asset_description: A man at a desk at night pushes his glasses up and presses his fingers against both temples, eyes squeezed shut in pain, with a laptop and desk lamp in front of him.

1193.words: medicine (noun): something you take that treats an illness
1193.asset_description: A pencil-sketch illustration of a sick girl wrapped in a blanket opening her mouth while a hand pours dark liquid medicine from a bottle onto a measuring spoon.

1398.words: thermometer (noun): an instrument that measures temperature
1398.asset_description: A black-and-white rubber-hose cartoon woman lies sick in bed with a steam cloud puffing from her head, sucking on a large glass thermometer she holds to her mouth.

4405.words: help (noun): the activity of doing something for someone's need
4405.asset_description: A student sits at a desk in front of a laptop and a stack of textbooks when he feels something on his upper lip and finds his nose is bleeding. He grabs a tissue and presses it to his nostrils, tipping his head. A friend comes over, pulls more tissues from the box on the desk and hands them to him, staying beside him while he holds them to his nose; the used tissues in the box are spotted with blood.

4452.words: hurt (verb): to be the source of pain
4452.asset_description: A young footballer in a white and blue striped shirt sits on a bench in a changing room with his leg pulled up. Low on his shin is a big dark purple mark, and he screws up his face and sucks in his breath as he touches it. A team-mate crouches beside him, points at the mark and winces too, then hands him a blue ice pack. The player presses the ice pack against his shin, flinches and grits his teeth, then holds it there and breathes out slowly while the pain settles.

4567.words: ill (adjective): affected by a physical or mental problem
4567.asset_description: A soft cartoon of a young woman standing in a bright room with a bookshelf, potted plants and a sunlit window behind her. She wears an olive green jumper over a white collared shirt. She has turned her head away, screwed her eyes shut and pulled up her arm to cough hard into the crook of her elbow, her cheeks flushed pink, with little motion lines drawn beside her face.

4575.words: cold (noun): a mild viral infection of the nose and throat
4575.asset_description: A reading room in a library, with tall wooden shelves of books and other students working at the tables behind. A young woman in a beige cardigan sits at a table with an open book, a pen, her glasses and a water bottle in front of her. She presses her hand over her mouth, her eyes watering and her face screwed up, then bends forward over the table and coughs hard into her fist and into the crook of her sleeve, several times. The students behind her keep reading.

4733.words: temperature (noun): the degree of hotness or coldness of something
4733.asset_description: A watercolour illustration of a boy lying ill in bed. He is propped on a pillow under a checked quilt with a glass thermometer in his mouth and a folded blue cloth laid across his forehead. His cheeks and nose are painted bright red and orange wavy lines rise from his head to show the heat coming off him. A lamp glows on the wooden bedside table beside the bed.

5128.words: hurt (noun): damage to the body from an accident
5128.asset_description: In a bright living room a young man in a grey tracksuit bangs his leg on the corner of the sofa. He throws his head back with his mouth wide open, hops on one foot into the hallway, doubles over and clutches his shin with both hands. He slides down the wall by the doorframe, sits on the floor with his face screwed up and keeps holding the sore leg.

5301.words: allergy (noun): a bad body reaction to pollen or dust
5301.asset_description: A young woman in a yellow dress stands in a huge summer meadow full of yellow, white and blue wildflowers. She sneezes hard into her cupped hands, screws her eyes shut, wipes under her nose and presses a hand to her chest with a miserable, streaming-eyed face while the pollen-heavy field goes on around her and other people wander through the flowers in the background.

111.words: boxing (noun): a sport where two people fight with their fists
111.asset_description: A young woman in red boxing gloves trains in a gym: she punches her coach's pads next to the ring, works the heavy bag, hits the speed ball and laughs happily between rounds.

266.words: energy (noun): the strength to be active and do things
266.asset_description: At an outdoor group workout a woman powers through burpees and star jumps, sprints up and down a long flight of stone steps and does box jumps while others catch their breath. She keeps bouncing and laughing while the rest of the group slumps over exhausted.

277.words: exercise (noun): moving your body to get fit and strong
277.asset_description: In a sunny garden a woman in workout clothes goes through her routine: jumping jacks, jogging on the spot, toe touches and side stretches. She finishes facing the camera with a big smile and two thumbs up, saying she does her exercise every day.
277.transcript: I do my exercise every day. It is good for me.

356.words: gym (noun): a place with machines where you work out
356.asset_description: A young woman with a braid and a big gym bag walks into a bright fitness center, passing rows of treadmills with runners, racks of dumbbells and cable machines, then drops her bag and looks around with excited hands on her hips.

414.words: jump (verb): to push yourself off the ground into the air
414.asset_description: At a track meet a young athlete sprints toward the high-jump bar, jumps and arches backwards over it, lands on the blue mat and springs up screaming with joy while teammates celebrate.

422.words: kicking (noun): hitting something again and again with your foot
422.asset_description: In a hand-painted anime scene, a young woman with a braid trains in an open wooden shelter by the sea, repeatedly kicking a hanging punching bag with high, powerful kicks.

440.words: lifting (noun): raising something heavy up off the ground
440.asset_description: In a 3D-animated gym, a huge strongman grips a loaded barbell, strains as he pulls it from the floor, and presses it triumphantly over his head with a proud grin before setting it down.

468.words: mat (noun): a soft flat piece you lie or stand on
