468.asset_description: On a sunny rooftop terrace, a woman unrolls a purple yoga mat onto the tiles and starts stretching on it. A man joins with his own green mat, and the two do yoga poses side by side on their mats, finishing lying down relaxed.

481.words: mirror (noun): a piece of glass where you see yourself
481.asset_description: A young man in a gym flexes and poses in front of the big wall mirror, moving in sync with his reflection like a game. Friends in yellow and purple shirts gather around and everyone flexes at the mirror, laughing.

488.words: muscle (noun): a body part that makes you move and gives strength
488.asset_description: In a gym, a skinny red-haired teen flexes his thin arms and groans at how small they look. A fit woman steps in and flexes visibly bigger biceps next to him, then a huge bearded bodybuilder flexes enormous muscles while the teen's jaw drops in shock.

613.words: ring (noun): the square area where boxers fight
613.asset_description: A young Muay Thai fighter in blue gloves climbs through the ropes into a boxing ring at a gym, bounces and shadowboxes around the canvas, then leans on the ropes laughing while his coach splashes him with water.

626.words: runner (noun): a person who races on foot
626.asset_description: A female athlete in an orange kit with a race number runs a road race along a waterfront boardwalk: she grabs a paper cup of water at an aid station, drinks while running, checks her sports watch, and pushes toward the barriered finish area past cheering spectators.

640.words: scale (noun): a device for weighing things
640.asset_description: In a gym, a muscular woman steps barefoot onto a big white dial scale, then picks up two dumbbells and gapes in mock shock as the needle jumps higher; a giant bodybuilder takes her place and flexes his biceps at the spinning needle while she laughs and points.

724.words: splash (noun): water flying up when something hits it
724.asset_description: At a packed outdoor pool, divers jump from high boards and towers one after another; each landing throws up a bigger and bigger burst of water while spectators film, ending with an enormous column of water.

749.words: stretch (verb): to pull your body long to loosen your muscles
749.asset_description: Two runners in a birch park warm up: they reach their arms high overhead, lean to the side, bend down to touch their toes, and help each other with a partner stretch before jogging off.

797.words: track (noun): an oval path for running races
797.asset_description: Relay runners train on a red stadium running track at sunset: a woman sprints around the curve with a baton and hands it to a teammate, he runs on down the marked lanes into the low sun, and the last runner crosses with arms spread while the team cheers.

807.words: treadmill (noun): a gym machine with a moving belt to run on
807.asset_description: A young woman with a red hair bun runs on a treadmill in a bright gym, breathing hard as the pace picks up. She finishes the run, slows the machine with the console buttons and wipes her forehead with relief.

869.words: weight (noun): a heavy object you lift to build strength
869.asset_description: In a garage gym a woman carries a heavy round plate, swings a kettlebell, and a big man heaves a huge stone ball onto a wooden box with a shout. The two then flex their arms proudly beside the box.

882.words: workout (noun): a session of hard exercise to get fit
882.asset_description: In a Pixar-style animated gym, a woman in a purple tank top powers through a full workout — barbell squats, push-ups, kettlebell swings, punching-bag hits and pull-ups — cheered on by her small dog, then collapses happily on the mat shouting that she is done.
882.transcript: One more! One more! Come on! Done! Ha ha!

1025.words: cyclist (noun): a person who rides a bicycle
1025.asset_description: A woman in a helmet and cycling kit leans her gravel bike into a corner on a wet forest road, spray kicking up behind the wheels.

1073.words: female (adjective): being a woman or a girl
1073.asset_description: A young woman with a ponytail leaps between holds on an indoor bouldering wall, chalk dust in the air and crash pads below.

1375.words: sweat (noun): the salty fluid your skin lets out when hot
1375.asset_description: A female boxer with braided hair throws a punch in a dark gym ring, and a spray of sweat flies off her glistening arm and glove. Her skin is visibly wet from the hard workout.

1699.words: swim (verb): to move through water with your body
1699.asset_description: Grey monochrome illustration of a person swimming across calm water toward a glowing white treble clef floating on the surface.

2378.words: relax (verb): to calm down and let your body feel loose
2378.asset_description: A young woman with long auburn hair sits cross-legged and barefoot in loose clothes, eyes closed and face serene, in front of a huge glowing pale moon in a soft dusty sky.

2602.words: ski (verb): to slide over snow on long narrow boards
2602.asset_description: A group of skiers in bright orange and blue gear races down a steep snowy mountain slope, kicking up big clouds of powder snow beneath jagged peaks.

2708.words: strong (adjective): having more power or strength than normal
2708.asset_description: A fantasy painting of the monkey-faced god Hanuman crouching on a rock in a misty canyon, bare-chested with a heavily muscled torso and arms, wearing a gold crown, gold armbands and an orange wrap.

2795.words: climb (verb): to go upward, step by step
2795.asset_description: A poster-style picture in flat colour: the black silhouette of a rock climber hangs from the underside of a dark overhanging cliff, one arm stretched up to a hold and legs bent, against a striped sunset sky of red, orange, yellow and blue.

2877.words: to climb (verb): to go up something using hands and feet
2877.asset_description: Against a burning orange and yellow sunset sky, the black silhouette of a climber hangs from a rope under the overhanging edge of a cliff, one hand reaching up the rope and gear clipped to his harness.

2914.words: to stretch (verb): to pull your body out long to feel looser
2914.asset_description: A minimal poster on a sage-green background: a dark cut-out silhouette of a person sitting on the ground with both legs stretched out and both arms reaching high above the head, hands meeting under a small bird shape.

3101.words: to jump (verb): to push off the ground into the air
3101.asset_description: A laughing cartoon girl in an orange T-shirt and blue shorts is up in the air with both feet off the grass, swinging a skipping rope over her head in a sunny park.

3126.words: boxer (noun): a person who fights with gloves in a ring
3126.asset_description: Cartoon drawing of a serious young man standing in a boxing ring in red shorts and red boxing gloves, fists raised in a guard position; the ropes of the ring run behind him against a blue background.

3136.words: to swim (verb): to move through water using your arms and legs
3136.asset_description: Cartoon of a woman in a dark swimsuit and red swimming cap doing front crawl in a wide blue lake, arms reaching forward and water splashing around her; green hills stand on the far shore.

3216.words: to run (verb): to move fast on your feet
3216.asset_description: Stylised illustration of a man and a woman running side by side in profile against a white background; their bodies are drawn as flowing red, pink and orange patterns and both wear running shoes, arms bent and legs stretched mid-stride.

3412.words: to lift (verb): to raise something up off the ground
3412.asset_description: Retro cartoon poster of a young woman in a red dress with a red headband and a yellow flower in her hair, standing against a pale green wall and holding a long teal barbell with big weight plates up across her shoulders.

3592.words: to exercise (verb): to move your body in a planned way to get fit
3592.asset_description: Bright flat vector illustration on a red background: one woman in a pink top and yellow leggings holds a wide squat with her hands on her hips while another in a blue and yellow sports kit balances sideways on one hand.

4136.words: to exercise (verb): to move your body in a planned way to get fit
4136.asset_description: A home gym with black walls, a squat rack, a red bench and a rack of weights along the wall. A big tattooed man in a white cap and blue T-shirt tries to train with four golden retrievers loose in the room. Lying on the rubber floor working an ab roller, he is swamped by dogs licking his face. He then lies back on the red bench and presses two heavy metal dumbbells straight up over his chest, arms locked out, while one dog climbs up and stands on his stomach and another pushes its nose into his side. At the end he does press-ups on the floor with his hands either side of a dog lying flat underneath him and two more lying on each side.
4136.transcript: Today I'm going to attempt to work out with four golden retrievers. Let's see how it goes.

4271.words: athlete (noun): a person trained to compete in sports
4271.asset_description: A sprinter in a yellow and green vest drives out of the starting blocks on the red track of a packed Olympic stadium, body low and arms pumping. He straightens up, lengthens his stride and runs at full speed down his lane while the camera tracks alongside him, the crowd and the white stadium roof behind.

4479.words: hard (adjective): not easy, needing great effort
4479.asset_description: A close shot from the front of a red-haired woman in a black and green cycling jersey riding a spin bike in a packed gym class. She is bent over the handlebars, face red and mouth open, pushing the pedals as fast as she can while other riders work in the rows behind her. She keeps glancing down at the little blue console on the handlebars, and at the end she takes one hand off the bars and claps it to her forehead in disbelief at the number on the screen.

4545.words: strength (noun): being physically or mentally strong
4545.asset_description: A woman in a pink vest climbs an overhanging limestone crag above a valley. She hangs off small holds by her fingertips with her arms taut and her feet smeared against the rock, a rope clipped to her harness running down below her and a chalk bag on her back. Two friends stand on the ground far below beside a crash pad, watching. She works her way up the bulge, pulls over the top of the block and looks back down, grinning.

4673.asset_description: A black-and-white cartoon in an old gym. A skinny character with thin rubber-hose arms and legs tries to lift one huge dumbbell in one gloved hand. The weight drags his arm and shoulder down, his knees buckle, his face is screwed up and drops of sweat fly off his head. Racks of barbells and dumbbells and a much bigger dumbbell lying on the floor fill the room around him.

4697.asset_description: A stark black, white and yellow illustration of a sprinter in the first instant of a race. He is driving out of the starting blocks in a packed floodlit stadium, front knee still on the track, back leg extended, one arm thrown up. A burst of yellow light and jagged lightning bolts explodes from the blocks where his foot pushes off, and white lines streak backwards along the lanes behind him. A spotlight beams down and the crowd is a silhouette in the stands.

4711.words: effort (noun): the hard work you put into something
4711.asset_description: A rower drives a narrow single scull across flat water in a navy racing suit. He hauls both oars through the stroke with his arms and shoulders straining, teeth bared and forehead screwed up. The camera closes in until only his face fills the frame: eyes squeezed shut, cheeks tight, mouth open and gasping, skin shining with sweat, hair stuck to his forehead. A line of spectators stands on the far bank under a blue sky.

4742.words: strong (adjective): having more power or strength than normal
4742.asset_description: An outdoor bootcamp session on a grass field at golden hour, with pull-up bars, mats and kettlebells set out and a trainer and other athletes working in the background. A woman in a dark red sports bra and leggings, with visible arm and stomach muscles, swings two heavy battle ropes up and down with both arms, her jaw set. She then swings a large black kettlebell up between her legs with both hands, breathing hard. Finally she jumps up onto a tall wooden plyo box, lands on top of it, straightens up with her arms thrown open and shouts in triumph while the trainer claps behind her.

5215.words: cycling (noun): the sport of travelling on a bicycle
5215.asset_description: A woman in a colourful cycling kit and a white helmet rides a road bike fast along a coastal mountain road; the camera tracks her from the front while grey cliffs, a fjord and green slopes pass behind her, other riders roll along the road ahead, and she finishes by riding across a bridge over the water, still pedalling hard.

5326.words: coach (noun): someone in charge of training an athlete or team
5326.asset_description: In a gymnastics hall with a vaulting horse, a balance beam and blue landing mats, a young gymnast in training kit lands badly and sits down on the mat with her face screwed up in pain, clutching her bare foot. An older woman in a grey training shirt kneels beside her, takes the foot in her hands and winds a beige elastic bandage around the ankle, fastening it with tape. When the ankle is strapped the woman puts an arm around the gymnast's shoulders and holds her while she cries.

5354.words: class (noun): teaching given as a series of lessons
5354.asset_description: A group workout on a park lawn at golden hour, big trees behind and low sun flaring through the leaves. A woman in a grey crop top stands at the front with both arms stretched overhead, hands clasped, leaning to one side, and half a dozen people in gym clothes behind her copy the move. They drop into deep kneeling lunges with a hand on the front knee, then all jump on the spot swinging their arms up over their heads, then settle into wide side lunges with both arms held straight out, everyone moving together.
5354.transcript: That's the spot. Mmm, that feels good. So good.

13.words: napkin (noun): a piece of cloth or paper to wipe your mouth
13.asset_description: An animated waitress at an outdoor restaurant folds a white napkin into an elegant fan shape and presents it on a plate with a proud 'Ta-da'. She then tastes soup, dabs her mouth with a napkin, tucks one into her collar and sits down happily.

26.words: straw (noun): a thin tube you drink through
26.asset_description: A cartoon man at a beach bar stretches a striped bendy straw, drops it into his iced juice and slurps the whole glass empty through it in seconds; he turns the empty glass upside down and proudly points the straw at the camera.

46.words: apple (noun): a round fruit with red or green skin
46.asset_description: In an orchard a woman picks a big dark-red apple from the tree, polishes it on a cloth and bites into it with delight; later she and a friend slice it in half on a tree stump and each eat a piece.

62.words: bag (noun): a soft container you carry things in
62.asset_description: A cartoon man with sunglasses and a moustache packs apples, a baguette, a sandwich and a water bottle into a big tan bag on a picnic blanket; an apple drops out, he picks it up, puts it back and closes the bag.

67.words: banana (noun): a long curved yellow fruit you peel
67.asset_description: On a tropical balcony a man picks a banana from a hanging bunch, and a woman shows him how to open it; he pinches the bottom end, peels it, takes a bite and grins at the camera.
67.transcript: Flip it, pinch! Works every time!

83.words: beer (noun): an alcoholic drink made from grain
83.asset_description: In a beer garden a man pours a bottle of golden beer into a tilted glass, straightens it for a perfect foam head and levels the foam with a knife, then clinks glasses with a woman at a picnic table and they drink.
83.transcript: Tilt and straighten in. Perfect foam.

107.words: bowl (noun): a round deep dish for soup or cereal
107.asset_description: A cartoon boy with glasses takes a blue bowl down from the kitchen cupboard, pours in cereal and milk, then lifts the bowl with both hands and drinks the last milk straight from it.

114.words: bread (noun): a baked food made from flour and water
114.asset_description: Two bakers pull a golden round loaf out of a wood-fired stone oven on a wooden peel, knock on the crust to check it, then tear the warm bread open with steam rising from the soft inside and taste it.

115.words: breakfast (noun): the first meal of the day
115.asset_description: A couple in pajamas makes breakfast at sunrise: they fry eggs, butter the toast, drizzle honey on porridge with berries and pour orange juice, then carry it all outside and eat together at a garden table while a rooster struts by.

120.words: burger (noun): a round piece of meat served in a bread roll
120.asset_description: At an outdoor evening grill a man fries a beef patty, melts cheese on it and stacks a tall burger with lettuce, tomato, sauce and onion rings; a young woman grabs it with both hands and takes big happy bites.
120.transcript: Stack it high. Both hands worth it.

125.words: butter (noun): a soft yellow food made from cream
125.asset_description: A woman tries to spread butter straight from the fridge and the hard lump tears a hole right through the bread slice, which she shows to the camera outraged; the couple softens the butter by the toaster and she then spreads it smoothly and eats the toast happily.
125.transcript: Too hard, look! Now it melts.

128.words: cake (noun): a sweet baked food, often for birthdays
128.asset_description: At a birthday party a woman in a paper crown blows out the candles on a cream cake decorated with berries while her friends cheer; they cut thick slices and everyone digs in together.
128.transcript: Make a wish! First life, mine!

150.words: cereal (noun): breakfast food made from grain, eaten with milk
150.asset_description: In a kitchen a man pours cornflakes into a bowl and insists on eating them dry, crunching loudly, while a red-haired woman pours milk into her bowl; he tries the milk version too and they both eat their cereal.
150.transcript: Dry first! Listen! Now the milk.

155.words: cheese (noun): a food made from milk, often yellow
155.asset_description: In a chalet kitchen a woman cuts a wedge from a whole wheel of cheese and bites into it; then she and a man grate cheese, fry grilled cheese sandwiches and pull the halves apart to show the long stretchy cheese strings.
155.transcript: Wait for it. Wait. The stretch!

157.words: chewing gum (noun): a soft sweet you keep biting but never swallow
157.asset_description: On a seaside pier a woman unwraps a pink stick of chewing gum, pops it in her mouth, chews and then blows a big pink bubble; the man beside her takes a piece and blows a bubble too.

158.words: chewing (noun): biting food again and again in your mouth
158.asset_description: A couple on a park bench bite sticky caramel candies on sticks and chew with exaggerated effort, their jaws straining as the toffee stretches and glues their teeth, while a squirrel watches from the bench.
158.transcript: One, two, three! I'm going! Round two!

162.words: chocolate (noun): a sweet brown food made from cocoa
162.asset_description: In a winter cabin a man snaps a chocolate bar into squares with a crisp snap, lets one melt in his mouth, then melts chocolate in a pot and pours it over a bowl of strawberries, which he shares with a woman.
162.transcript: That's snap. Perfect. Mmm, gone. Just melted.

163.words: chopsticks (noun): a pair of thin wooden rods for picking up food
163.asset_description: In an animated lantern-lit dumpling restaurant a girl shows a boy how to hold chopsticks in his hand. He practices the grip slowly, finally picks a steamed dumpling from the bamboo basket with them, eats it and both cheer.
163.transcript: Hold them like this slowly slowly. Oh, I did it

179.words: coffee (noun): a hot dark drink made from roasted beans
179.asset_description: A yawning, half-asleep man shuffles into the kitchen and brews coffee in a moka pot on the stove. He pours the dark coffee into a cup, takes one sip and his eyes snap wide open - instantly awake, he salutes and marches off ready for the day.
179.transcript: Ugh, can't function. Awake, let's go!

190.words: cookie (noun): a small flat sweet baked snack
190.asset_description: A young woman takes a tray of chocolate-chunk cookies out of the oven, holds one up to the camera, dunks it in her hot drink counting "one, two, three, out", then eats cookies at the table with a friend while a cat sleeps on the windowsill.
190.transcript: One, two, three, out! It's gone.

206.words: cucumber (noun): a long green vegetable often eaten in salads
206.asset_description: In a kitchen a man snaps a cucumber in half with a loud crack, peels it over a bowl and cuts it into thin round slices; a woman then holds two slices over her eyes like at a spa before eating one, and the slices are tossed into a salad.

207.words: cup (noun): a small container with a handle for hot drinks
207.asset_description: At a wooden tea table, hot tea is poured from a clay teapot into a small green ceramic cup; a woman lifts the warm cup in her hands, sips from it and smiles at the man sitting across from her.

223.words: delivery (noun): bringing food or goods to someone's door
223.asset_description: A young couple lounging with their cat jumps up excitedly and races down the hallway when the doorbell rings. A helmeted courier at the rainy doorstep hands them boxes of hot food, and they hurry back to the couch to open the steaming takeout and eat.
223.transcript: It's here! Go go! It's still hot!

228.words: dinner (noun): the main meal of the evening
228.asset_description: On a candlelit seaside terrace at dusk, a woman carries a steaming pot to a set table with salad, bread and plates, calling everyone over. Friends gather, serve the stew, pass bread, raise their glasses in a toast, and eat together under string lights.

244.words: drink (noun): a liquid you swallow, like juice or water
244.asset_description: A thirsty man staggers up to a street fruit stand where a vendor squeezes oranges into a tall glass. He gulps the fresh juice down in one go, sighs with relief, and happily asks for another while a parrot watches from the stand.

256.words: eating (noun): putting food in your mouth and swallowing it
256.asset_description: A couple on tiny plastic stools at an Asian night-market stall lift noodles, greens and broth to their mouths from big soup bowls, slurping happily. They eat everything, the woman even drinks straight from the bowl, and both pat comically swollen full bellies at the end.

296.words: fish (noun): a water animal with fins, often eaten as food
296.asset_description: On a beach at sunset, a man grills a whole fish in a wire basket over glowing coals next to a fishing boat, then squeezes lemon over it. A woman lifts a flaky white piece with a fork, tastes it and closes her eyes with delight.
296.transcript: From the sea! Look! White! It flakes!

308.words: food (noun): things that people and animals eat
308.asset_description: At a long wooden table in a stone-walled courtyard, friends share a big spread of food: fresh flatbread torn open, steaming meat stew ladled onto plates, dumplings, white cheese, grapes and pomegranates. They dip bread in the stew, pass plates around and eat together, saying 'So much, look! Dig in!'

311.words: fork (noun): a tool with points for picking up food
311.asset_description: At a candlelit restaurant table, a woman holds a silver fork up to the camera, then twirls a huge coil of spaghetti onto it while her date watches wide-eyed. She proudly lifts the loaded fork, eats the pasta, and then spears salad leaves and a cherry tomato with it, saying 'Twirl, twirl, twirl. Not one noodle lost.'
311.transcript: Twirl, twirl, twirl. Not one noodle lost.

317.words: french fries (noun): thin strips of potato cooked in hot oil
317.asset_description: At an outdoor food stand by a canal, a vendor lowers a basket of pale potato sticks into bubbling oil. He lifts out golden crispy fries, fills a white paper cone, sprinkles salt over them, and a customer in a beanie blows on a hot fry and eats it with delight, saying 'Crispy! Perfect!'
317.transcript: Easy. In they go. Crispy! Perfect!

321.words: fruit (noun): sweet food from plants, like apples
321.asset_description: A young woman at an open-air market stall admires a mango, hanging bananas and grapes, fills her basket with a pineapple and oranges, then happily bites into a peach saying it is juicy.

334.words: glass (noun): a see-through cup for cold drinks
334.asset_description: On a sunny tiled terrace, a woman peers through an empty glass joking "I can see you!", fills it with ice cubes and fresh lemonade, hooks a lemon slice on the rim and drinks; she and a friend clink their glasses.
334.transcript: I can see you! Ah, ice cold!

389.words: honey (noun): a sweet sticky food made by bees
389.asset_description: On a seaside terrace at sunset a couple watches thick golden honey drip slowly from a wooden dipper into a jar, drizzles it over a slice of toast with cream, and the man licks a sticky finger and happily eats a piece.
389.transcript: - Slow, look at it go. - Whoa! Stuck. Worth it.

399.words: ice cream (noun): a cold sweet frozen food made from milk
399.asset_description: At a sunny seaside stand a vendor hands a man a tall cone with scoops of vanilla and strawberry ice cream; as it starts melting down his hand he licks it frantically while his girlfriend holds her own cone and laughs.

410.words: jam (noun): a sweet spread made from fruit and sugar
410.asset_description: At a sunny breakfast table a woman opens a jar of dark berry jam, lifts a dripping spoonful, spreads it thickly across a slice of toast bread and tastes it while her partner watches happily.

413.words: juice (noun): the liquid you get by pressing fruit
413.asset_description: In a sunny courtyard a man halves a pomegranate, presses it in a hand juicer so ruby-red juice streams into a glass, then drinks it and shares a glass with a woman under the pomegranate tree.
413.transcript: Look at that color. Pure fruit. Wow.

416.words: ketchup (noun): a thick red tomato sauce for fries
416.asset_description: In a retro diner a man shakes and smacks a stubborn glass ketchup bottle over a plate of fries until the ketchup finally pours out in a big red pool; he dips a fry and eats it, delighted.
416.transcript: - Come on, come on. - There it goes.

438.asset_description: Under a lemon tree by the sea, a woman cuts a lemon into wedges; she and a man each bite one and pull twisted sour faces, then squeeze the juice into a jug with sugar and ice and toast with fresh lemonade.
438.transcript: Just one lick. Sour, so sour!

439.words: lemonade (noun): a cold sweet drink made with sour yellow fruit
439.asset_description: On a summer porch, a big glass jar of lemonade with lemon slices, mint and ice is stirred and poured into tall glasses; a woman takes a long refreshing drink and friends clink their glasses for a refill.
439.transcript: Ice cold, here it comes! Refill please!

471.words: meat (noun): food that comes from animals
471.asset_description: At a backyard brick barbecue at sunset, a man in an apron grills ribs, a thick steak and sausages over glowing coals, turning them with tongs while they sizzle. He piles the browned pieces onto a wooden board and carries the board of grilled meat toward a set table while a dog watches.
471.transcript: Listen that sound Golden to the table

478.words: milk (noun): the white drink that comes from cows
478.asset_description: In a farmhouse kitchen with green fields outside, a woman opens a glass bottle of fresh milk and pours it into a tall glass. She gulps it all down and turns around wearing a huge white milk moustache, then she and a man clink their glasses, both sporting milk moustaches, while a cat laps milk from a bowl.
478.transcript: Pour it all. The moustache classic.

480.words: mineral water (noun): bottled drink from a natural spring, often fizzy
480.asset_description: At a cafe table by a fountain, a woman twists the cap off a green glass bottle of mineral water and pours it fizzing over ice into a glass. She listens to the bubbles, sips, giggles at the tickle, and pours a glass for her friend so they can clink and drink together.

505.words: nut (noun): a dry fruit with a hard shell and a seed inside
505.asset_description: A couple sits at a wooden garden table in autumn with a bowl of walnuts. The man cracks one open with a metal nutcracker, shows the two shell halves with the kernel inside, and they both snack on the nuts happily.

509.words: oil (noun): a liquid from plants that you use in cooking
509.asset_description: In a sunny Greek-style kitchen, golden olive oil is poured slowly from a bottle into a dish, pooling in circles. Tomato slices are laid in the oil, and a couple dips chunks of fresh bread into a small bowl of it and eats with delight.

535.words: pasta (noun): an Italian food made from flour, water and eggs
535.asset_description: In an Italian kitchen a chef fans dry spaghetti into a big pot, boils and tastes it, lifts the strands with tongs into a pan of tomato sauce, then serves a tall twirled tower of pasta on a plate that a woman happily slurps.
535.transcript: Find it! In they go! Now twirl it!

573.words: pouring (noun): making a liquid flow out of a container
573.asset_description: A young barman in an apron pours orange juice from a big plastic jug into a row of glasses on a wooden counter, filling them one by one. He shows off by pouring from higher and higher - "Steady, steady. Not a drop!" - while a woman watches open-mouthed, and every glass ends up neatly filled.
573.transcript: (upbeat music) - Steady, steady. - Not a drop!

631.words: salad (noun): a cold mix of raw vegetables like lettuce
631.asset_description: A young man in a kitchen tears lettuce into a bowl, slices cucumber, cherry tomatoes and peppers, adds red onion and white cheese, and tosses everything with two spoons; he lines up a row of bowls and a friend tastes one with a fork, nodding approval.

636.words: sandwich (noun): two pieces of bread with food between them
636.asset_description: At a lakeside picnic a woman builds a sandwich on a wooden board: she butters white bread, layers ham, cheese, tomato, lettuce and cucumber, presses a second slice on top and cuts it in half to show the striped filling, then happily takes a bite while a duck watches.
636.transcript: layer layer layer crown look at those stripes

638.words: sauce (noun): a thick liquid you pour over food for flavour
638.asset_description: At an outdoor table by a vineyard, a man ladles bright green herb sauce from a stone bowl over a plate of grilled potatoes, aubergine and pepper; egged on by his partner shouting for more, he keeps pouring until the whole plate is flooded in sauce, and they taste it laughing.

639.words: sausage (noun): minced meat pressed into a long thin skin
639.asset_description: At a campsite between mountains and a fjord, a man fries a row of sausages in a black pan on a small camp stove, turning them with tongs until browned; he lifts one on a fork, pops it into a long bun and a woman wrapped in a blanket takes a happy bite.
639.transcript: Roll them. Roll them. Snap. Hear that?

657.words: serve (verb): to bring food or drinks to someone at a table
657.asset_description: A Pixar-style animated woman carries a tray of steaming noodle bowls across a sunset terrace, sets a bowl in front of a delighted man at the table saying 'Here you go', then pours water from a clay jug into his glass.

670.asset_description: In a Pixar-style 3D supermarket, a young woman with curly red hair pushes a cart along the shelves, picks out apples, bread and a carton of milk, pays the cashier with coins and walks off happily with her bag.

698.words: smoothie (noun): a thick cold drink of blended fruit
698.asset_description: A woman at a juice bar blends berries and fruit into a thick purple drink, pours it into tall glasses, tops each with a strawberry, sips through a straw, and her friends clink their glasses together.

712.asset_description: At a rooftop picnic, a man suspects his friend shook his orange soda can, holds it to his ear and listens before daring to open it; nothing explodes, so he pours the fizzy orange soda over ice, drinks, and grins in relief.

716.words: soup spoon (noun): a big round spoon for eating hot liquid food
716.asset_description: A man lines up a teaspoon, a soup spoon and a giant ladle on a wooden table, then eats his bowl of vegetable soup testing them by size: tiny sips with the teaspoon, proper spoonfuls with the soup spoon, and finally huge comic mouthfuls straight from the ladle until the bowl is empty.
716.transcript: That's not nothing! Now you're eating!

717.words: soup (noun): a hot liquid food made from vegetables or meat
717.asset_description: In a cozy log cabin, a woman tastes steaming tomato soup from a big pot, ladles it into a bowl, swirls cream on top and hands it to a man wrapped in a blanket on the sofa, who blows on each hot spoonful and eats it happily with a cat beside him.
717.transcript: hot hot hot careful warms everything

721.words: spilling (noun): the act of letting liquid fall out by accident
721.asset_description: A cartoon woman at an outdoor picnic table laughs and waves, knocking over a full glass of water; the water floods the whole table and drips onto the grass while she and a boy stare in shock.

750.words: string (noun): a thin cord for tying things
750.asset_description: In a sunny bakery a worker pulls white string from a spool, loops and crosses it around a white pastry box, ties a neat bow, and the customer carries the box away hanging from the string.

752.words: sugar (noun): sweet white grains you add to food and drinks
752.asset_description: A woman sips black coffee in a cafe and grimaces at the bitter taste; her partner spoons white sugar from a small bowl into the cup and stirs it, and her next sip makes her smile.
752.transcript: Whoo strong for courage Now it's right

767.words: tea (noun): a hot drink made by soaking dried leaves
767.asset_description: On a Moroccan-style tiled table, a couple spoons dried leaves and fresh mint into a glass teapot, pours in hot water, watches the brew turn amber, then pours the tea into small glasses from high up and sips it together.
767.transcript: Look, they're dancing! From up here, steady.

777.words: thirsty (adjective): needing or wanting something to drink
777.asset_description: A young vegetable seller at a busy market clutches his dry throat, tips up his water bottle and finds it empty, then gratefully takes a glass of water a hand passes him and gulps it down in one go.

790.words: tomato (noun): a soft red fruit used in salads and sauces
790.asset_description: At sunset in a garden, a man picks a big ripe tomato off the vine, smells it, then slices it into a stack on a wooden board, salts it and adds a basil leaf; he bites into a juicy slice and shares the board with a woman.
790.transcript: still warm smell that juicy look at it

876.words: wine (noun): an alcoholic drink made from grapes
876.asset_description: In a vineyard a woman touches a bunch of dark grapes on the vine, then pours red wine from a bottle into a glass at a small table. She swirls it, smells it, sips, and clinks glasses with a man as the sun sets over the rows of vines.
876.transcript: Swirl and smell. The grapes right there.

889.words: yogurt (noun): a thick creamy food made from milk
889.asset_description: At a kitchen table a woman turns a jar of thick white yogurt upside down to show it does not pour, spoons the creamy yogurt into a bowl, drizzles honey and adds berries and oats, then eats a big spoonful while her boyfriend watches amazed.

974.words: cafe (noun): a small restaurant selling drinks and snacks
974.asset_description: A barista pours steamed milk into a cup behind the counter of a cozy sunlit cafe with hanging plants, a chalkboard, and customers sitting at small tables by the window; a pastry waits on a plate.

1219.words: nobody (phrase): not any person at all
1219.asset_description: A long dinner table fully set with plates, glasses and lit candles in an old dining room, one wine glass tipped over and a napkin falling — but nobody is sitting on any of the chairs and the door stands open.

1378.words: swiss (adjective): from or made in Switzerland
1378.asset_description: A woman in a cream knit sweater sits in a rustic wooden chalet and lifts a long fork with melted cheese stretching from a steaming fondue pot. Skis, cowbells and leather straps hang on the log walls, and snow shows through the window.

1483.words: strawberry (noun): a soft red fruit with tiny seeds on it
1483.asset_description: Botanical illustration of a strawberry plant: red berries, white flowers and dark green leaves on thin stems.

1505.words: supermarket (noun): a big store selling food and household goods
1505.asset_description: Retro 1950s illustration: a smiling woman at a supermarket checkout unloads cans and boxes while a cashier helps her; shelves and shoppers behind.

1522.words: basket (noun): a woven container with handles
1522.asset_description: A vintage painting of a smiling girl in a blue dress sitting under a tree with a small dog beside her, holding a wicker basket full of red cherries.

1629.words: pineapple (noun): a big sweet tropical fruit with spiky skin
1629.asset_description: A single upright pineapple with green spiky leaves, rendered in soft watercolor washes of orange, green and pink on a pale background.

1897.words: pumpkin (noun): a big round orange vegetable with thick skin
1897.asset_description: A folk-art illustration of three pumpkins stacked from big green to small orange, with a black crow perched on top.

2041.words: bottle (noun): a plastic or glass container for liquids
2041.asset_description: A dark glass bottle with a mushroom-shaped cork stands on a wooden table; a forest at sunset is painted across the glass so the sun seems to glow inside it.

2052.words: mug (noun): a big cup with a handle for hot drinks
2052.asset_description: An ornate silver mug stands on a pile of thick old books while a glowing blue ribbon of steam spirals high above it in a dark fantasy hall.

2669.words: teapot (noun): a container with a spout for pouring tea
2669.asset_description: A watercolour of a corner shop where shelves are packed with old china teapots, jugs and cups; on the wooden table below stand a blue globe and a big dark globe next to an open book, with an arched window showing an old town outside.

2771.words: eat (verb): to take in solid food
2771.asset_description: A cute 3D-rendered white mouse stands upright on a sunny beach, holding a waffle cone of pink and yellow ice cream in both front paws with its mouth open and tongue out, palm trees and turquoise sea behind it.

3079.words: to drink (verb): to take in liquids
3079.asset_description: Cartoon of a middle-aged man in a dark green jumper sitting in a red diner booth, lifting a white mug to his mouth and sipping from it; a window shows green hills outside.

3122.words: pizza (noun): Italian bread dough baked with sauce and cheese
3122.asset_description: Cartoon illustration of a whole cheese pizza cut into eight slices, sitting on a pale plate on an orange diner table; behind it are a booth bench, a counter with round stools and a window.

3124.words: hot dog (noun): a sausage in a long soft bread roll
3124.asset_description: Cartoon illustration of a hot dog on a white plate on an orange diner table: a sausage in a long bun with a zigzag of yellow mustard on top, with a booth, table and hanging lamps behind.

3125.words: hot chocolate (noun): a sweet warm drink made from cocoa
3125.asset_description: Flat painterly illustration of a tall glass mug of thick brown hot chocolate topped with a swirl of whipped cream and chocolate sauce, with a cinnamon stick poking out; chunks of chocolate lie on the table beside it.

3242.words: popcorn (noun): corn heated until it bursts into white pieces
3242.asset_description: Thickly painted picture of two black-and-white cats lying side by side in a bed under pink and blue covers, one wearing pink headphones; in front of them on the duvet sit a bowl of popcorn, a small dish of popcorn, a TV remote, a water bottle and an open book.

3441.words: watermelon (noun): a very big green fruit, red and juicy inside
3441.asset_description: Stylised fashion illustration of a woman in a pink suit leaning on a wooden market crate that is piled with big striped green watermelons.

3806.words: cherry (noun): a small round red fruit with a stone
3806.asset_description: An illustration on a dark background shows a short glass of deep red drink with pale ice cubes floating in it and two red cherries on a leafy stem hooked over the rim, with a yellow sparkle beside the glass.

4040.words: meal (noun): the food you eat at one time
4040.asset_description: A couple sit at a square table with a white cloth on a beach at dusk, palm trees and the sea behind them and a lantern with a lit candle in the middle of the table. A waiter in a white jacket sets down their food and steps back. In front of the woman is a plate of green salad; in front of the man a burger with a pile of chips. He picks the burger up in both hands and takes a big bite, then grins at the camera. The two of them talk and laugh over their plates with wine glasses beside them.

4053.words: corn (noun): a tall cereal plant with kernels on large ears
4053.asset_description: On a white marble worktop two ribbed mugs of black coffee stand side by side, one teal and one orange, with a large knife lying behind them. The knife slices straight down through the orange mug, and the two halves fall open to show layers of sponge and chocolate inside: it is a cake. The shot changes to three pale ears of corn lying in a row on the marble, their husks still attached. The knife comes down through the middle ear and cuts it lengthways, opening it to reveal that it too is a cake, with a yellow sponge inside and rounded yellow dots along the cut face.

4106.words: hungry (adjective): feeling a need to eat food
4106.asset_description: A bearded man sits at a wooden dining table in front of a big white plate piled with creamy spaghetti. A brown dachshund is propped up behind him with its head peeping over his shoulder. Each time the man lifts a forkful of spaghetti, the dog stretches its neck around and grabs the strands from the fork before they reach his mouth, so the spaghetti hangs from the dog's jaws. The man pulls faces at the camera, wide-eyed and then laughing, while the dog keeps licking its lips and going back for more.

4208.asset_description: A hamster sits on a grey sofa in a dim room and works through one small meal after another straight to camera: a cheeseburger with a red paper cup of soda, a red pot of instant noodles eaten with chopsticks, a pink tub of yoghurt with a spoon, a corn dog covered in ketchup, then a slice of strawberry cream cake with a fork, ending with cream on its nose. Finally it lies flat on its back on the sofa with its belly up, crisps scattered all around it and an open bag of Lay's tipped over on the floor.

4353.words: dessert (noun): a sweet dish served at the end of a meal
4353.asset_description: A young pastry chef in a white chef's jacket and a white bow tie stands at a marble counter in an ornate café. He holds a jug high and pours a thick stream of dark chocolate glaze over the top of a round sponge cake that sits on a white marble cake stand; the glaze runs down the sides. He smooths the top flat with a long palette knife, then pipes a chocolate signature across it from a paper piping bag. He slides a knife under a wedge and lifts it clear of the cake, showing the dark layers inside. In the last shot he holds a white plate up to the camera with the slice on it next to a tall swirl of whipped cream, smiling.

4407.words: healthy (adjective): having good health in body or mind
4407.asset_description: A young man in a neon sports vest stands at a kitchen counter and drops sliced banana into a blender jug already filled with chunks of mango, then adds raspberries and a big handful of fresh spinach. He clamps the lid on and runs the machine until everything turns into a thick orange drink, pours it into a tall glass and holds the full glass up to the camera.

4429.words: restaurant (noun): a building where people go to eat
4429.asset_description: A close up on a marble kitchen counter: a cardboard box tips and coloured cereal rings tumble down into a large turquoise bowl, and one pink ring drops last into the milk. The video then cuts to a wood panelled noodle restaurant with two orange paper lanterns glowing on the wall behind. A woman in a grey shirt sits at a dark wooden table holding an enormous white bowl of ramen with both hands, mouth open in delight. She lifts a thick bundle of noodles clear of the broth with chopsticks, steam rising, then dips the chopsticks back into the bowl.

4446.words: glass (noun): a hard transparent solid that breaks easily
4446.asset_description: Inside a dark wooden pub, a smiling man in a grey coat leans across a wooden table and knocks his tall glass against another one held by the person filming. Both glasses are full of amber beer with a white head, and you can see the light coming straight through the clear glass and the drink inside. Behind him the pub is fitted with panels of frosted, patterned glass above the bar and beside the windows, with a dartboard, brass beer taps and other drinkers laughing in the background.

4467.words: ham (noun): meat from the thigh of a pig, usually smoked
4467.asset_description: A woodcut-style illustration of a butcher at work behind his block. He wears a white shirt with rolled sleeves and a green striped apron, and has a heavy moustache. One hand holds a raw steak flat on a thick wooden chopping block while the other swings a big cleaver up above his head, ready to bring it down. Behind him a rail runs across the wall with strings of sausages and whole cured hams hanging from steel hooks, a slab of meat on the bone at the right, and three knives on a wall rack.

4474.words: menu (noun): a list of dishes available at a restaurant
4474.asset_description: A woman with red hair spends a morning over coffee and cake. She stands at a café counter under two large black boards headed COFFEE, listing the drinks in two columns with prices beside them, and slides a small glass of espresso on a saucer towards the camera. She then holds a white cup while milk is poured into it from a steel jug, drawing a leaf in the foam, and lifts the finished cappuccino up to the camera with wide eyes. Finally she sits in a grand mirrored café with chandeliers, a silver tray in front of her holding a slice of layered chocolate cake and her coffee, and eats a forkful.

4476.words: hall (noun): a large entrance or reception room
4476.asset_description: A red-haired woman in a beige turtleneck stands at a coffee bar and knocks back a small espresso, setting the glass down on a saucer. A barista then pours steamed milk into the cup she is holding, drawing a leaf in the foam. The shot opens out into a huge ornate cafe hall with chandeliers, arches, marble tables, a cake trolley and newspapers on a rack, where she sits at a marble table with her cappuccino, smiling and looking around the room.

4581.words: candy (noun): a sweet made of flavored sugar
4581.asset_description: A cartoon of a den built out of blankets over a sofa in a sunlit living room. Inside it a boy in a blue hoodie holds up a lit torch and points at a stack of cushions, while a girl in dungarees kneels beside him laughing with her hand at her mouth as she eats a sweet. A striped bowl heaped with wrapped and jelly sweets floats between them, with loose sweets scattered around it, under a string of paper stars and hearts. Teddy bears sit on the sofa behind.

4641.words: diet (noun): a chosen selection of foods to eat
4641.asset_description: A young man in a blue apron stands at a white kitchen counter with an open box of two chocolate doughnuts on one side and a bowl of strawberries on the other, and points away from the doughnuts. He puts out three empty plastic food containers and fills them with chicken, quinoa, sliced cucumber and cherry tomatoes, then stacks the filled containers into a tall tower and sets the bowl of strawberries on top.

4657.words: to drink (verb): to take in liquids
4657.asset_description: In a busy covered street market a woman in an orange vest top sips iced tea from a clear plastic cup through a straw, her cheeks pulling in as she draws the liquid up. She then holds a whole green coconut in both hands and drinks from the straw pushed into its top, tipping it towards her mouth. Finally she lifts a plastic water bottle high, puts it to her lips and swallows in long gulps, then lowers it and breathes out, smiling.

4678.words: eat (verb): to take in solid food
4678.asset_description: A run of close-up shots of different people eating. A bearded man bites into a dripping cheeseburger in a fast-food restaurant; a woman lifts a mouthful of ramen noodles out of a bowl with chopsticks and sucks them in; a man in a canteen forks food off a plate of fried fish, chips and salad; a boy with curly hair takes a bite out of an enormous triple cheeseburger held in both hands.

4679.asset_description: A young man in a turquoise T-shirt and a backwards cap sits at a metal counter in a busy taqueria, with cooks working behind him. Two tacos sit on paper in front of him. He bites into a folded taco, chews with his eyes closed and his eyebrows raised, licks the sauce off his fingers, eats the second one, and finally sits back with his hand on his chest over an empty paper smeared with red sauce.

4683.asset_description: A grinning young cook in a white coat and a white cap builds a big bowl of koshari on a steel counter in a busy restaurant. He starts from a white bowl of cooked rice, tips brown lentils out of a ladle onto it, piles tubes of pasta round the edge, then pours a big ladle of red tomato sauce over the whole heap and tops it with crispy fried onions. Loose grains of rice are scattered all over the counter.

4715.words: watermelon (noun): a very big green fruit, red and juicy inside
4715.asset_description: A man and a woman in clear safety goggles stand at a weathered picnic table in a sunny park with a big green striped watermelon on it. Taking turns, they stretch coloured rubber bands over the melon one at a time until dozens of them squeeze a tight belt around its middle and the fruit bulges out above and below. They lean back from the table grinning and flinching. The melon bursts: the green rind splits into curved shards and bright red flesh sprays across the whole table and out onto the grass. The two of them jump back, clench their fists and shout with delight.

4725.words: pizza (noun): Italian bread dough baked with sauce and cheese
4725.asset_description: A sunlit farmhouse kitchen where three generations make pizza together. A man stretches a disc of dough in the air while a small boy presses his own ball of dough on the floured worktop and a grandmother rolls out another with a wooden rolling pin. Then a woman and a man carry two finished margherita pizzas out of the oven. The scene moves outside at night to a long table under string lights, where a steaming margherita is set down in front of the whole family and everyone clinks glasses of red wine over the food.

4880.words: bottle (noun): a plastic or glass container for liquids
4880.asset_description: From the edge of a tall rooftop the camera looks straight down at a car park deck far below, where a small blue water balloon falls and bursts. A grinning young man leans over the parapet holding a watermelon with the city skyline behind him, drops it, and it splatters on the concrete. Then a sack bursts on the deck and finally he tips a big water bottle over the edge and it explodes into spray far below.

4923.words: seat (verb): to show someone to a seat
4923.asset_description: A blonde young woman in a white shirt and a black waist apron smiles at the camera inside a warm, candlelit restaurant. She walks through the dining room holding leather menu folders under one arm, passing seated guests and a bar. She reaches an empty wooden table, lays the menus down on the two chairs and gestures at the table with an open hand. A couple follows her in and takes the places she has shown them while she stands beside the table.
4923.transcript: Right this way, best seat in the house.

4939.words: golden (adjective): shining with the bright yellow colour of gold
4939.asset_description: A young baker presses a ball of pale dough on a floured wooden table while low sun pours through the window behind him. A board of dough balls is slid towards the mouth of a glowing brick oven. He wipes his floury forehead with the back of his hand in front of the fire. A tray comes out full of croissants baked to a deep golden brown, and he holds a steaming round loaf with a golden crust towards the camera.

4969.words: cafe (noun): a small restaurant selling drinks and snacks
4969.asset_description: At small round tables on the pavement outside a city cafe, an older woman with white hair sits reading a book and sipping a cup of coffee. A young man in a colourful shirt at the next table talks at her, waves his hands, leans over her book and finally holds his phone in front of her, but she never looks up from her page. He slumps back in his chair while a waiter passes behind them.

5019.words: beef (noun): meat from an adult cow
5019.asset_description: In a busy Korean barbecue restaurant a young woman in a white shirt and black apron stands at a round table grill; thick red marbled slices of beef sit on the mesh over a tall flame, ringed by dozens of small dishes of kimchi, greens and sauces. She turns and moves the slices with tongs until they brown, then lays a piece on a lettuce leaf, folds it into a parcel and holds it out to the camera while the guests behind her clap and laugh.

5066.words: sample (noun): a small part that shows what the whole is like
5066.asset_description: A young man stands at an outdoor fruit stand in front of a mosque and picks up an orange while the vendor in an apron stacks more oranges behind him. He moves on to an olive stall and takes one single olive from a big metal tray to taste it, chewing and reacting to the flavour. He then walks through a covered spice bazaar past rows of coloured spice mounds and holds up his mesh bag of oranges to the camera.

5109.words: sweet (adjective): having the taste of sugar
5109.asset_description: On a rooftop terrace at sunset a young woman in a denim jacket carries a tray of a dozen frosted cupcakes, cream swirls topped with chocolate, past strings of bulb lights. She sets the tray on a wooden table beside a small card that reads Welcome, walks to the glass door and knocks, then comes back, sits down alone at the table with the city skyline glowing behind her and reaches for the tray.

5155.words: lunch (noun): a meal eaten in the middle of the day
5155.asset_description: A woman in a blue shirt lowers a large empty white plate onto a wooden dining table by a sunny window. A serving spoon lifts rigatoni and spaghetti in tomato sauce out of a pan and sets a portion on the plate, finished with a basil leaf. The camera pulls back over a long table laid with cutlery and many identical plates of pasta, a family already seated around it in the midday light, and the woman spreads her arms to invite everyone to eat.

5176.words: mug (noun): a big cup with a handle for hot drinks
5176.asset_description: A run of pours in a kitchen: dark coffee streams from a carafe into a big white mug standing on the counter, pale pancake batter is poured into a black frying pan on the stove, golden syrup is drizzled over a tall stack of pancakes, and finally sparkling wine is poured into the top glass of a champagne tower.

5177.words: teapot (noun): a container with a spout for pouring tea
5177.asset_description: A young woman with red braids in denim dungarees leans over a wooden garden table and pours tea from a white teapot into a small cup on a saucer, then pours orange juice from a glass jug into a row of tall glasses, and finally tips a clay pitcher of juice into a large glass bowl.

5258.words: bar (noun): a place where alcoholic drinks are served
5258.asset_description: A rooftop bar at sunset. A laughing young woman in a bright patterned shirt stands behind a long counter and shakes a metal cocktail shaker beside her ear. A whole row of people along the counter shakes shakers with her in the same rhythm. Strings of light bulbs hang overhead, the sea and a pink sky are behind them, and glasses, juice bottles and steel tins stand on the counter.

5270.words: supermarket (noun): a big store selling food and household goods
5270.asset_description: A young woman in a supermarket aisle grabs cereal boxes off the shelves and throws them into her trolley as she pushes it down the aisle. The pile in the trolley grows shot by shot until, at the checkout, she stands beside a trolley stacked with a tower of cereal boxes far above her head.

116.asset_description: A Pixar-style craftsman in goggles gleefully smashes blue ceramic tiles with a hammer, breaking a whole stack into small shards; he accidentally knocks a clay pot off the bench so it shatters too, then arranges the broken pieces into a colorful mosaic sun.

247.asset_description: In a sunlit stone courtyard, an animated boy holds a red apple high in the air, opens his hand and lets it fall. The apple bounces on the paving stones and he bends over his knees to look down at where it landed.

1501.words: pour (verb): to make a liquid flow out of a container
1501.asset_description: Painting of a dark-haired woman in a long green dress pouring bright green liquid from a wide bowl into the water below her feet.

1887.words: push (verb): to move something with force
1887.asset_description: A vintage cartoon of a man leaning hard to push an overloaded two-wheeled cart labeled 'To Morrow', piled with barrels and bundles marked as tomorrow's burdens.

2322.words: broken (adjective): cracked or in pieces, no longer whole
2322.asset_description: A close-up of a woman's pale face with one glowing orange eye, half of the portrait covered in shattered glass and mirror shards that break the image into hanging fragments.

2906.words: to carry (verb): to hold something and take it with you
2906.asset_description: Seen from below against a blue sky with white clouds, a young woman in a red top and white trousers stands holding a large taped cardboard box in both arms, a backpack on her shoulders, looking up ahead.

3642.words: to pull (verb): to cause something to move by pulling
3642.asset_description: Flat retro illustration: an astronaut stands on a small moon, leans right back and pulls hard on a long string that is tied to a huge planet above him. A spool of string sits behind him and a little blackboard stands on the ground.

4034.words: trap (noun): a device that catches an animal
4034.asset_description: The tiled floor of a shop stacked with boxed toys is covered with dozens of black mousetraps, all set and laid out in rows. A man in a white shirt and shorts, blindfolded and holding a red foam bat, swings it around trying to hit a second man who is creeping between the traps in bare feet. The second man dodges away and steps carefully over the traps, but ends up sprawled on the floor among them while the blindfolded man swings again.

4100.words: hole (noun): an opening into or through something
4100.asset_description: A quiet bedroom with pale green walls, a wooden bed, a rug and a bedside table with a red digital clock. A man lies stretched out on the bed. Suddenly the ceiling bursts open and an enormous steel coil spring shoots down through it, punching a ragged hole in the plasterboard and driving straight through the floorboards into another hole below. Broken laths and clouds of white mattress stuffing rain down over the room. The man is left face-down on the floor in the debris, then picks himself up, stands and brushes the fluff off his clothes.

4195.asset_description: A first-person shot from the seat of a red mobility scooter driving down an empty asphalt road between warehouses, straight into a low sun. The rider's hands are on the handlebars and a basket sits on the steering column. The steering column starts to come loose and sinks down; the basket and the handlebars drop away. In the last shots the scooter has come apart completely: a wheel, the basket, the red body panels and the handlebar lie scattered on the road in front of the rider, whose feet are still on the footplate.

4359.words: can (noun): a sealed metal container for food or drink
4359.asset_description: A black-and-white retro cartoon of a city pavement. A wide-eyed boy in a white shirt and dark shorts has tripped and is falling backwards, both white-gloved hands flung out and his mouth open in shock, one shoe kicking up in the air. In front of him a big paper grocery bag has split down the side, and its contents are flying out: three round metal tins with ribbed lids and paper labels, a baguette, a sliced loaf, a jar and several apples, with a stream of liquid spraying out of one tin. Another apple bounces along the pavement to the right. A curved street lamp, a shop awning, a blank hanging shop sign and two blurred passers-by fill the background.

4500.asset_description: A montage of people snatching things out of the air at the last moment. A young woman in a park pulls a falling tennis ball into her chest; a goalkeeper in green throws himself sideways and pins the ball to the grass in front of the goal; a young man in a kitchen shoots out a hand and grabs a plastic bottle before it hits the floor; a woman in a garden takes a whole watermelon out of the air with both hands; a boy lying on the grass stops a huge beach ball above his face with his hands and feet.

4571.words: push (verb): to move something with force
4571.asset_description: A fishing beach with a big wooden boat sitting high on timber skids. A crowd of villagers, men and women of all ages, put their shoulders and hands against the hull and shove it forward down the rollers towards the sea, straining with their heels dug into the sand. An old man in a blue shirt walks ahead of them hauling on a wooden beam and shouting the count. The boat runs down the skids and reaches the water, and the group ends up in a circle in the shallows, hugging each other and cheering.

4665.words: accident (noun): an unfortunate mishap causing damage or injury
4665.asset_description: A run of small mishaps, one after another. A black phone lies face down on a wooden kitchen floor where it has just landed. On a city pavement a girl holds an ice cream cone with only half a scoop left, the rest of it splattered pink on the ground beside her feet. In an office a woman in a blue blouse throws up her hands in panic as a whole file of white papers flies out of her arms and scatters through the air. In a kitchen a man's plastic bag splits and oranges, peaches and a jar roll out across the tiled floor. Finally a watermelon bursts open on a market street, pink flesh and juice sprayed in a wide splash, while shoppers jump back with their hands over their mouths.

4701.asset_description: A young man in a bucket hat kneels on the wet sand beside a tall, carefully carved sandcastle with towers, battlements and arched gates; kite surfers are out on the sea behind him. The surf runs in around the base of the castle. Each wave eats away more of it: first the outer walls slump, then the towers collapse one after another, until only a shapeless lump of wet sand and one small stump are left in the foam, and he sits back on his heels looking at it.

4741.words: to pull (verb): to cause something to move by pulling
4741.asset_description: A young man in yellow waterproof dungarees stands in a small blue and orange wooden fishing boat on open sea below green cliffs. He leans right back with both hands on a fishing rod that is bent almost double, dragging the line up out of the water until a large silver fish breaks the surface on the hook and swings over the side of the boat. He then works a round landing net, hauling it up out of the water and swinging it in over a wooden crate on the deck, where several silver fish are already lying. At the end he lifts the full crate up towards the camera with both hands and grins.

80.words: beard (noun): hair that grows on a man's chin and cheeks
80.asset_description: At an outdoor tea table a man proudly combs and strokes his chest-length black beard while his bald, clean-faced friend rubs his own bare chin and mimes despair; they compare, laugh and take a phone photo with the comb in the beard.

182.words: comb (noun): a flat tool with thin teeth to tidy your hair
182.asset_description: On a porch, a young man holds an orange comb up to the camera, then combs his slicked-back dark hair while checking himself in a small wall mirror, saying his hair is "straight as a ruler".
182.transcript: Listen, twang. Straight as a ruler.

357.words: hairbrush (noun): a tool for making your hair smooth and tidy
357.asset_description: A young woman winces as she drags a wooden hairbrush through a tangle in her long hair while her friend cheers her on; stroke by stroke the hair turns smooth and shiny, she shakes it out and playfully sings into the brush like a microphone.

601.words: razor (noun): a sharp tool for cutting hair off your skin
601.asset_description: A man with shaving foam on his face shaves with an electric razor at a bathroom mirror while his impatient friend behind him taps his watch and hands him a shirt.
601.transcript: (upbeat music) - Whose morning magic? (upbeat music) - Smooth in seconds.

647.words: scissors (noun): a tool with two sharp blades that open and close
647.asset_description: In a home kitchen a mother holds up a pair of scissors, then trims her daughter's bangs with comb and scissors while the girl sits under a towel cape; the girl checks the straight new fringe in a hand mirror and beams.

659.words: shampoo (noun): a liquid soap for washing your hair
659.asset_description: In an animated hair salon, a green-haired stylist pumps shampoo from a bottle into her hand and lathers a client's black hair into an absurd swirling foam tower like soft-serve ice cream, then rinses it out and reveals a giant glossy hairstyle with a thumbs-up.

663.words: shaving foam (noun): a white cream you put on before using a razor
663.asset_description: In a bathroom, a young man sprays a tall swirl of white foam from a can into his palm while his friend watches in exaggerated amazement, then he slathers it over his cheeks and chin like a fluffy foam beard in front of the mirror.

664.words: shaving (noun): cutting hair off your face with a blade
664.asset_description: In a barbershop, a woman barber brushes white lather onto a reclining man's stubbled face, carefully scrapes it off with a straight razor, then pats scented oil onto his smooth cheeks while he jokes that it stinks.

1520.words: curly (adjective): growing in curls instead of straight
1520.asset_description: A vintage painting of a young woman with very long curly blond hair, wearing a pearl necklace and holding pink roses in front of flowering greenery.

1523.asset_description: A romantic painting of a young woman reclining with one arm above her head, her very long wavy blonde hair spread out with pink and white flowers tucked into it.

1593.words: haircut (noun): the shape and style your hair is cut in
1593.asset_description: A futuristic profile portrait of a woman with a sleek teal-blue bob haircut with lighter stripes; her head sits inside a transparent glass dome and her neck is made of robotic cables.

1870.words: hair (noun): the threadlike growth covering the head
1870.asset_description: A minimalist flat portrait of a pale woman with red lips and very long straight dark-blue hair flowing down her whole body, a branch of blue leaves lying across it.

1906.words: blue (adjective): the color between green and violet
1906.asset_description: A stylized painting of a young woman with long deep-blue hair and blue eyes, wearing a pale green robe, surrounded by orange and pink flowers.

2095.words: long (adjective): measuring a lot from one end to the other
2095.asset_description: An Art-Nouveau-style portrait of a young woman in profile with extremely long flowing teal hair full of small red flowers, framed by an ornate arch with a castle and sea behind her.

2284.words: hairstyle (noun): the way someone's hair is cut and arranged
2284.asset_description: A portrait of a young woman whose enormous flowing hair is transformed into a spectacular arrangement of colorful feathers, leaves and swirling ornaments in blue, orange and pink.

2477.words: messy (adjective): dirty and not in any order
2477.asset_description: An anime close-up of a teenage boy with extremely messy, wind-tossed brown hair sticking out in every direction, wearing a white hoodie and green jacket with backpack straps, as petals blow down a sunset street behind him.

4084.words: head (noun): the upper part of the body, above the neck
4084.asset_description: An animated bald man in a red robe stands in a gold and green marble bathroom in front of a large mirror, holding up a small gold jar. A hairless sphynx cat sits on the washbasin beside him. A golden drop falls onto the cat's bare head and onto the man's bald head. Both heads sprout enormous hair: the man grows long thick black curls, the cat grows a golden lion's mane. The two admire themselves in the mirror.

4131.words: green (noun): the green color, like grass
4131.asset_description: A barber's shop with a deep green wall filling the whole background, a mirror and a framed picture hanging on the green paint, and green plants on the counter. A chimpanzee sits in the chair in a green cape with its eyes shut and a big round afro. A ginger cat in a white coat, standing on a wooden stool, works through the hair with a hot styling tool that sends up a puff of steam. The afro comes out sleek and straight, cut into a shiny black bob, and the chimpanzee turns to the camera and grins with the green wall and the green cape all around it.

4132.words: brush (verb): to rub something with a brush
4132.asset_description: A marble salon with warm lights and shelves of bottles. A lion sits in a salon chair in a black cape with its head tipped back over a white washbasin. A ginger cat in a white coat sits on its head and works white foam into the mane, then rinses it out with a shower head, so the wet mane hangs down dark and heavy into the basin. The cat then takes a large wooden hairbrush and pulls it down through the long wet mane, stroke after stroke, working out the tangles from the top of the head to the ends hanging over the basin. In the last shots the lion sits up facing the camera with the mane brushed out full and dry, and the cat perched on a stool beside it.

4134.words: fat (adjective): having a lot of flesh on the body
4134.asset_description: A barber's shop with a mirror and shelves of bottles. On the black leather seat of the barber's chair sits a very round, very plump hedgehog, so fat that its little legs and paws stick out sideways from a body shaped almost like a ball, with a big round belly hanging over its feet. A ginger cat in a white coat and red bow tie leans in with a pair of electric clippers and runs them over the hedgehog's back, shaving off all the spines. They fall away onto the seat and leave a completely bare, smooth, pale, round body sitting there. The hedgehog looks down at itself, its eyes go wide and its mouth drops open in horror, while the cat covers its own face with a paw.

4374.asset_description: A cartoon of a barber's shop. The barber, in apron and waistcoat, stands over a seated customer holding a buzzing electric clipper in his right hand, its yellow cable trailing down to the socket and little motion lines coming off the head, while in his left hand he holds a plain wooden comb. Behind him are a big oval mirror, a striped barber's pole and shelves of bottles.

4383.words: thick (adjective): not thin, wide from one surface to the other
4383.asset_description: In a barbershop a young man in a white shirt strokes his freshly shaved chin. The shot cuts to a barber at work, then to a customer whose enormous black beard is being combed out — it is dense and bushy and hangs well down his chest. Then the door opens and an older man walks in with a beard so full and long that it reaches past his waist, and he holds it up proudly for the camera.

4553.words: hair (noun): the threadlike growth covering the head
4553.asset_description: A woman in lilac pyjamas stands in a sunlit room full of houseplants and draws a pale wooden brush down her very long dark hair, sweeping it forward over her shoulder. She turns, laughing, then kneels on a patterned rug and brushes her golden retriever's coat with the same brush, finishing with her arm around the dog as both look at the camera.

4630.words: haircut (noun): the shape and style your hair is cut in
4630.asset_description: In a barbershop, a barber holds up a small spiral-bound notepad with a curved shape drawn on it and points at it with a pencil. He then works on a young man's hair with red electric clippers, shaving a sharp line into the side and fading the sides down. At the end the client turns his head and we see the finished cut: curly hair on top, shaved sides and a clean shaved line curving above the ear.

5082.words: hairstyle (noun): the way someone's hair is cut and arranged
5082.asset_description: A young woman in a coral top and a chunky yellow bead necklace dabs powder onto her cheek from a compact in a bright hallway, her hair piled up in a high bun. She leans towards a round gold-framed mirror on the wall, smooths her hair back with one hand and talks to her reflection, then adjusts the necklace at her throat. She turns to a large vanity mirror ringed with light bulbs, and in the last shot her hair has been arranged into two big rounded buns, which she shows off to the camera beside her reflection.

5481.words: pink (adjective): a light shade of red
5481.asset_description: A smiling young woman with long bright pink hair kneels in a tiled laundry room beside an open front-loading washing machine. Her pink hair fills most of the frame as she lifts coloured clothes out of a laundry basket and pushes them into the drum. The camera then shows the closed machine with the wash turning behind the round glass door, and finally, filmed from inside the drum, she pulls out a clean white t-shirt and holds it up to her face.

39.words: ambulance (noun): a vehicle that takes sick people to hospital
39.asset_description: From a street cafe a man shields his eyes and watches an ambulance drive up a pastel-colored street and pull over; two paramedics in high-vis uniforms climb out with a red medical bag and stride off toward their call.

68.words: bandage (noun): a strip of soft cloth wrapped around a wound
68.asset_description: On the bench of a sports hall, a physio wraps an elastic bandage around a handball player's wrist and hand, fixes the end, and the player flexes her wrist and gives a thumbs up and a smile.

360.words: hand sanitizer (noun): a gel that kills germs on your skin
360.asset_description: On a moving train a young woman pumps clear gel from a small bottle into her palm, rubs her hands, then gives one pump to her seatmate; with clean hands the two happily share samosas from a tin and sip tea.
360.transcript: One pump each. Rub, rub, rub. Mmm.

556.words: plaster (noun): a small sticky strip that covers a cut
556.asset_description: A red-haired woman winces and shows a cut finger in a kitchen; a man opens a small first-aid tin, peels the backing off an adhesive plaster, wraps it around her fingertip and playfully blows on the bandaged finger.
556.transcript: Ow! Tiny cut! I've got this. All wrapped up.

947.words: bleeding (noun): losing blood from a cut or wound
947.asset_description: A young man sits on a gym bench pressing a tissue with red spots to his bleeding nose while a friend hands him a fresh tissue.

950.words: blood (noun): the red liquid that flows through your body
950.asset_description: A relaxed man donates blood in a clinic chair, squeezing a red stress ball while a tube runs from his arm; a nurse holds up the filling blood bag.

1001.words: clinic (noun): a small medical center you visit without staying
1001.asset_description: A smiling doctor with a stethoscope around her neck opens a wooden door and waves a waiting patient in from a bright waiting room with chairs and potted plants.

1079.words: first aid (noun): quick help given to someone hurt or ill
1079.asset_description: Comic-style scene: a man kneels and tears open a bandage packet to treat a cyclist's scraped, bleeding elbow; an open first aid kit with rolls of bandage, scissors and plasters lies on the ground next to a fallen bicycle.

1127.words: health (noun): the state of your body, being well and not ill
1127.asset_description: A watercolor-style illustration of a girl in a green jacket leaping joyfully over a flowery hillside at sunrise, arms flung wide, dandelion seeds and droplets swirling around her.

1138.words: hospital (noun): a health facility where patients get treatment
1138.asset_description: A nurse in blue scrubs pushes an empty wheeled gurney down a bright, sunlit hospital corridor with wide doors and signs along the walls.

1232.words: patient (noun): a person who needs medical care
1232.asset_description: A man in a black T-shirt sits on an exam table in a doctor's office breathing with closed eyes while a doctor's hand presses a stethoscope to his back.

1238.words: pharmacy (noun): a shop where you buy medicine
1238.asset_description: In a cozy hand-painted shop, a pharmacist in a white coat stands on a stool reaching for a medicine box on a wooden shelf full of bottles and jars, while a customer waits at the counter under a glowing green cross.

1405.words: tooth (noun): one of the hard white parts in your jaws
1405.asset_description: A man lies back in a dental chair with his mouth wide open while a dentist in a mask and gloves examines his teeth with a small mirror and probe under the lamp.

1450.words: visitor (noun): someone who comes to visit you
1450.asset_description: A man sits in a chair beside a hospital bed, holding a small bunch of wildflowers and the hand of the woman lying in the bed, smiling at her.

1684.words: mask (noun): a cover you wear over your face
1684.asset_description: The Mona Lisa painting altered so that she wears a white medical face mask over her mouth and nose.

2457.words: nurse (noun): a person who cares for sick people in a hospital
2457.asset_description: Portrait of a young woman in a white nurse uniform and a white cap with a red cross, a stethoscope around her neck, standing in a blurred hospital corridor.

2478.words: doctor (noun): a person licensed to give medical care
