2478.asset_description: A cheerful cartoon woman with huge curly red hair and glasses sits at a clinic desk in a white medical shirt with a stethoscope around her neck, smiling at the viewer; shelves of medical supplies fill the gray office.

3194.words: dentist (noun): a person whose job is to fix and clean teeth
3194.asset_description: Simple crayon-style drawing of a patient lying in a green dental chair with his mouth wide open under a bright lamp, while a figure in a white coat, blue cap and face mask leans over him with a small mirror and drill; a poster of a tooth hangs on the wall.

4302.words: emergency (noun): a sudden crisis that needs immediate action
4302.asset_description: A neon-lit city street at night in heavy rain. An ambulance with red and blue roof lights stands in a flooded road, its rear doors thrown wide open and the bright interior visible. Two paramedics in reflective coats push a wheeled stretcher up to the open back of the vehicle. Bystanders in hooded coats watch from the pavement while traffic light streaks reflect in the wet asphalt.

4303.words: medical (adjective): relating to medicine and doctors
4303.asset_description: A sunny narrow street of old apartment buildings with wrought-iron balconies. A white emergency vehicle marked with orange stripes and blue star-of-life symbols is parked at the kerb with its blue lights flashing. The camera moves in on the bonnet and windscreen, then two crew members in yellow high-visibility jackets walk across the road carrying a red bag toward a cafe terrace where people sit at tables.

4369.words: tape (noun): a long thin strip of cloth or paper for fastening
4369.asset_description: In a clinic a woman in blue scrubs winds a long white cloth strip around a man's hand and wrist, pulling it tight in overlapping turns; more rolls of the same white strip sit on the counter behind. The camera pulls back and the joke lands: colleagues have wound the strip round and round his whole body and head until only his face shows, and everyone is laughing while two more people keep unrolling.

4525.words: help (verb): to give help or assistance to someone
4525.asset_description: At a pavement cafe a young man in an olive T-shirt takes a bite of a croissant and it goes down the wrong way: his eyes go wide, he grabs his throat and cannot breathe. The woman next to him jumps up, gets behind him, wraps her arms round his middle and pulls sharply in and up several times while he bends forward over the table. It comes up, he sits back gasping and coughing, and she keeps one hand on his shoulder and holds a glass of water to his mouth while he drinks. Other diners and a waiter look over.

4593.words: hospital (noun): a health facility where patients get treatment
4593.asset_description: A young man in a navy tracksuit walks down a long, bright hospital corridor on two metal crutches, with a grey walking boot strapped onto one foot. He swings himself forward step by step towards the camera. Behind him a nurse in white scrubs follows with a clipboard, watching him walk. Windows line one wall and handrails run along both sides of the corridor.

4707.words: patient (noun): a person who needs medical care
4707.asset_description: A free health check under a white gazebo at a school fair. A young woman in a white nurse's tunic leans over a seated young man and shines a small lit instrument into his ear. He tips his head back, opens his mouth wide and she presses his tongue down with a wooden stick and looks into his throat. She then straps a blue blood pressure cuff around his upper arm and listens while he sits still and smiles. Other students queue behind the table, watching and giving a thumbs up.
4707.transcript: Look up, say uh-uh. - Uh. - All good?

4734.words: care (noun): the work of looking after someone
4734.asset_description: A young woman lies ill on a sofa under a thick grey blanket in a lamp-lit living room, her face flushed red and a thermometer in her mouth. An older woman sits beside her, holds the thermometer steady and reads a second one, frowning at the number. She puts a hand on the young woman's forehead to feel how hot she is, then lays a folded damp cloth across it and smooths it into place, staying at her side the whole time.

4926.words: dentist (noun): a person whose job is to fix and clean teeth
4926.asset_description: In a bright dental surgery a woman in teal scrubs reaches up and swings the big round examination lamp over a man lying back in the treatment chair. Wearing latex gloves she leans over him with a small round mouth mirror and looks at his teeth while he keeps his mouth open. A close-up shows a toothbrush with blue bristles brushing along his front teeth. She then holds a round hand mirror up so he can see, and finishes by giving a thumbs-up next to the mirror.

4980.words: to breathe (verb): to draw air into your lungs and let it out
4980.asset_description: On a hilltop above green fields under a clear blue sky a woman tilts her head back, closes her eyes and breathes in deeply; a man holds a mug of coffee under his nose and breathes in the steam; a woman with curly hair pushes her nose into a bunch of bright flowers; a man leans open-mouthed over a fresh loaf of bread; finally a group of friends stands in a circle with their arms spread wide, heads back, all taking a deep breath together.

5073.words: medicine (noun): something you take that treats an illness
5073.asset_description: A young woman in a grey hoodie sits at a kitchen table with a box of tablets, an open pill case, a glass of water and a brown medicine bottle in front of her. She pours the brown syrup onto a spoon, swallows it, screws up her face in disgust and sticks out her tongue, gulps down the water, shudders, and finally screws the cap back on the bottle.

5113.words: advice (noun): an idea about the best action to take
5113.asset_description: In a bright consulting room a woman in a teal polo shirt and glasses sets bowls of food down on a wooden table in front of a young man in a yellow t-shirt: a bowl of spinach, tomatoes and a yellow pepper, a bowl of brown rice, a grilled fish on a plate, a bowl of mixed nuts and a tall glass of milk. A food pyramid poster hangs on the wall behind them. She points at the food and talks him through it; he leans in, looks at each dish and nods, and she puts a hand on his shoulder as they finish.

5141.words: doctor (noun): a person licensed to give medical care
5141.asset_description: In a bright surgery, a man in a white coat examines a young man in a checked shirt sitting on the examination couch. He holds the patient's mouth open and looks down his throat, then listens to his back with a stethoscope, then wraps a blue blood-pressure cuff around his upper arm. He gives a thumbs up; the young man laughs and flexes his bicep, and the doctor hands him a small colourful card.

5149.words: pharmacy (noun): a shop where you buy medicine
5149.asset_description: A young man with a red, sore nose stands at a lit pharmacy window under a green cross sign while a hand behind the glass passes him a small box of medicine. He then waits inside a modern pharmacy under a red digital queue-number display, carrying a paper bag, and pays at a self-service terminal. Finally he stands open-mouthed inside a grand old pharmacy whose walls are floor-to-ceiling wooden drawers, watching a pharmacist in a white coat climb a tall wooden ladder to fetch something from the top row.

14.words: page (noun): one side of a sheet of paper in a book
14.asset_description: Hands flip through an empty notebook, then use tweezers to arrange a pressed yellow flower and green leaves on the bottom corner of a page, brushing glue to fix the decoration in place.
14.transcript: I make my page pretty. I add flowers to it.

34.words: activity (noun): something you do for fun or exercise
34.asset_description: A bored couple lies upside down on the sofa, then suddenly jumps up and runs into the sunny garden to play badminton; they chase and dive for the shuttlecock, laughing, until they collapse happily on the grass while their dog runs around them.
34.transcript: We're so bored. Best afternoon ever!

99.words: book (noun): a set of printed pages inside a cover to read
99.asset_description: A red-haired woman curled up on a cozy window seat under a tartan blanket with a cat reads a green hardcover book, turning the pages; her friend points at it approvingly over a mug, and she finishes the last page and hugs the book happily.
99.transcript: One more page. The end. Wow.

144.words: catch (verb): to take hold of something moving through the air
144.asset_description: In a hand-painted anime scene, a barefoot boy on a grassy seaside hill reaches up with both arms and catches a red ball, grins, then throws it back to an unseen friend.

169.words: clay (noun): soft wet earth shaped and baked into pots
169.asset_description: In a pottery studio full of vases a woman presses a wet lump of clay onto a spinning wheel. Her muddy hands squeeze and pull the clay upward until it opens into a bowl shape, and she admires the finished piece while a cat watches.

212.words: dancer (noun): a person who moves to music as art or as a job
212.asset_description: In a mirrored dance studio, a young woman stretches her leg on the barre, then launches into an energetic hip-hop routine with floor moves and footwork, finishing breathless with a laugh and two peace signs at the camera.

241.words: drawing (noun): making pictures with a pencil or pen
241.asset_description: An animated young man sits on stone steps in an Italian seaside town, sketching the pastel harbor houses in a spiral notebook. He pauses, erases a line, keeps shading, and finally holds up the finished pencil drawing next to the real view for an impressed passerby.

297.words: fishing (noun): catching water animals with a rod or net
297.asset_description: A couple sits on a wooden dock at a mirror-calm forest lake with a fishing rod out. The rod bends, they reel in and scoop a silvery trout with a landing net, admire it together, then gently release it back into the water and high-five.

324.words: gaming (noun): playing on a console or computer
324.asset_description: In an anime-style living room at night, a pink-haired girl and a guy in a red varsity jacket battle with game controllers; he panics while she wins and throws her fist up cheering.

346.words: golf (noun): a game of hitting a small ball into holes
346.asset_description: On a links course at sunset a woman chips the ball onto the green, lines up a putt beside the flagstick, and the ball rolls in; she and her caddie throw their arms up and celebrate.

364.words: artist (noun): a person who draws or paints pictures
364.asset_description: A young man in denim overalls scribbles colorful lines with an orange pencil on a sketchbook, then looks up at the camera grinning and says 'I am not an artist' while proudly showing his messy drawing.

383.words: hiking (noun): walking a long way in nature for fun
383.asset_description: A cartoon pair of hikers with big backpacks and trekking poles climb a mountain trail, cross a stream on stones, add a rock to a stone cairn and cheer with raised arms on a cliff-top summit above snowy peaks.

386.words: hobby (noun): something you do for fun in your free time
386.asset_description: In a home workshop a man carefully paints a small wooden model boat; a woman admires it and he shows her whole shelves of model ships, planes and a windmill he has built, and she applauds.
386.transcript: Steady steady there. You made all these?

419.words: kick (verb): to hit something with your foot
419.asset_description: On a rooftop at sunset two animated friends kick a blue-and-white ball back and forth, bouncing it off their feet and knees in playful keep-ups; one kick sends it bouncing off the water tank.

429.words: land (verb): to come down to the ground after flying
429.asset_description: In a cel-animated scene, a woman under a pink parachute glides over hills, touches down running on a grassy field, cheers with raised fists, and high-fives a friend after the perfect landing.

456.words: magazine (noun): a thin paper book with photos, printed monthly
456.asset_description: Two young women sit in a salon-style room with a stack of glossy magazines spread on a table. They flip through the colorful pages together, point at photos, gasp at a beautiful one and playfully claim it.

464.words: marker (noun): a pen with a thick soft tip
464.asset_description: Under a garden pavilion, a woman draws thick bright pink strokes on paper with a chunky marker, then adds more colors from a jar of markers to make a sun poster. She hangs the finished poster on a post and a man admires how bold it looks from across the lawn.
464.transcript: So bold! I can see it from here!

503.words: notebook (noun): a book with empty pages for writing in
503.asset_description: Two young women sit at a desk with pens and washi tape; one unwraps a brand-new mint-green notebook and flips through its blank pages. She then writes the first line in it with a pen while her friend claps excitedly.

522.words: painting (noun): making a picture with a brush and colours
522.asset_description: On a sunny Santorini terrace, a young woman at an easel mixes blue paint and paints a seascape of the coast in front of her, then smiles and presents the finished painting, joking it is better than the real view.
522.transcript: Big, bold, blue. Better than the real one.

602.words: reading (noun): the activity of looking at and taking in text
602.asset_description: An animated red-haired girl with glasses reads a thick book at a table on a night train through snowy mountains; a plot twist makes her gasp and cover her mouth before she sips cocoa and keeps reading.

681.words: singing (noun): making music with your voice
681.asset_description: A bearded man and a woman drive through a desert valley and sing along loudly together, pumping fists and laughing as they belt the song.
681.transcript: Everybody, second verse! One, two la la la la la! We should start a band.

687.words: skateboard (noun): a short board with four wheels you ride on
687.asset_description: A curly-haired teen on a sunset city plaza takes his skateboard, shows it to the camera, then rides it across the stone square and lands a little jump before skating off toward the view.

801.words: trampoline (noun): a stretchy mat on a frame you bounce on
801.asset_description: A young woman in a coral outfit bounces higher and higher on a netted backyard trampoline while a friend watches from the grass. She does a straddle jump with arms spread, then flops flat onto her back on the mat as he applauds.

862.words: watching (noun): looking at something for a while, like a film
862.asset_description: A couple sits on a sofa with a bowl of popcorn, eyes locked on the TV in front of them. They gasp, clutch a blanket and lean toward the screen as the tense film grips them.

887.words: write (verb): to put words on paper with a pen
887.asset_description: Close-up of a woman's hand opening a lined journal on a wooden table and writing a cursive line starting with 'Dear' with a black pen, then laying the pen in the closed-up notebook. Voiceover: she likes to write in her book every day and writing makes her happy.
887.transcript: I like to write. I write in my book every day. Writing makes me happy.

977.words: camera (noun): the equipment you use for taking photographs
977.asset_description: A young woman with windblown hair stands on a rooftop above a city street at sunset, holding a vintage camera up to her eye with fingerless gloves as she lines up a shot.

1484.words: music (noun): an art form of instrumental or vocal tones
1484.asset_description: A yellowed old page of printed sheet music, filled with staves and piano notes.

1497.words: violin (noun): a small string instrument played with a bow
1497.asset_description: Vintage collage: a violin drawn over an old sheet-music page titled 'A Rose From You', with roses in the corner.

1549.words: paint (noun): a coloured substance you put on a surface
1549.asset_description: A watercolor portrait of a young woman's face emerging from colorful splashes, blots and long drips of paint in pink, blue and yellow.

1551.words: guitar (noun): a stringed instrument with six strings
1551.asset_description: A bare arm rises out of a sea of clouds holding up a white electric guitar by the neck, with a huge glowing moon and starry sky behind it.

1560.words: swing (noun): a seat hanging on ropes that moves back and forth
1560.asset_description: A watercolor sketch of a young woman seen from behind, standing at a rope swing with a wooden seat, holding a small bunch of dried flowers behind her back.

1584.words: dance (verb): to move your body to music
1584.asset_description: A painterly portrait of a woman posing mid-dance with one arm raised high and the other stretched out; her flowing red skirt dissolves into giant flower petals around her legs.

1703.words: read (verb): to look at written words and understand them
1703.asset_description: A girl in a green sweater and red skirt floats against a white brick wall reading a book that beams out a blue night sky with a moon and stars; her shadow dances behind her.

1802.words: note (noun): a sign for a single sound in written music
1802.asset_description: A surreal collage of an acoustic guitar with a tree growing from its neck; a waterfall of musical notes pours out of the sound hole and staves full of notes curl across the sky while birds fly around a full moon.

1889.words: move (verb): to change location, to travel or proceed
1889.asset_description: A photo-art image of a red-haired woman in a bright green outfit frozen mid-dance, hair flying, with glowing shards scattering around her on a dark background.

1914.words: piano (noun): a large instrument you play by pressing keys
1914.asset_description: A watercolor-style image of a black grand piano with its lid open, dark paint strokes and drips splashing around it.

1974.words: ballerina (noun): a girl who dances ballet on her toes
1974.asset_description: A black paint-splash silhouette of a ballerina in a tutu dances on her toes with arms spread, against a purple background full of glowing colorful light circles.

1976.words: skate (verb): to glide over ice wearing ice skates
1976.asset_description: Four children in winter clothes skate on a frozen pond in a snowy forest decorated with strings of glowing orange lights, while squirrels and plump birds watch from the trees and snow falls.

1992.words: listen (verb): to hear something on purpose
1992.asset_description: A woman shown from behind in silhouette wears large green headphones over her dark hair, standing against a glowing yellow-green background with faint fir trees.

2177.words: dj (noun): someone who plays and mixes recorded music
2177.asset_description: A bearded young man in a leather jacket and big headphones stands at a mixing console full of knobs and sliders, playing music on a warmly lit night street with a streetlamp and full moon behind him.

2300.asset_description: A black electric guitar stands upright completely surrounded by roaring orange flames and embers, with smoke and a blue spotlight behind it.

2324.words: sing (verb): to make music with your voice by singing
2324.asset_description: A young man in sunglasses and a shiny purple jacket holds a microphone to his open mouth and sings, with bright pink and orange rays and clouds exploding behind him.

2357.words: black and white (phrase): with no colors, only dark and light shades
2357.asset_description: A detailed black-and-white line drawing, like a coloring book page, of a two-story wooden house with a porch, long stairs and a garden full of bushes and trees.

2512.words: coloring book (noun): a set of outline pictures for kids to paint in
2512.asset_description: A detailed black-and-white coloring book page shows a fairy-tale mushroom house with round windows, a wooden door, stone steps and garden plants, all drawn in clean uncolored outlines.

2583.words: enjoy (verb): to get pleasure from something
2583.asset_description: A pop-art woman with curly hair and big blue-and-yellow headphones tilts her head back with closed eyes and a blissful face, lost in her music against a bold pink-and-yellow background.

2805.words: draw (verb): to make a picture with a pencil or pen
2805.asset_description: A soft watercolour illustration of a small boy in a knitted sweater and jeans sitting at a wooden table, holding a pencil above a white sheet of paper and looking up with a shy smile.

2850.words: drum (noun): a musical instrument you hit to make a beat
2850.asset_description: A black-and-white shot from below of a masked performer in a studded leather vest on a smoky stage; he holds a stick up in one hand and throws the other arm in the air behind a big drum kit with cymbals on both sides.

2861.words: to read (verb): to look at words and understand them
2861.asset_description: A cartoon girl in a yellow coat, scarf and pointed hat sits back on a purple sofa with a blanket over the arm, holding an open blue book in both hands and smiling; a bookcase stands behind her and a pumpkin sits on the rug.

2890.words: to ski (verb): to slide over snow on long thin boards
2890.asset_description: A painted Christmas card scene: Santa Claus in his red suit slides down a snowy slope on red skis, gripping a pole in each hand, with a rucksack full of wrapped presents on his back and snowy fir trees behind him.

3022.words: chess (noun): a board game where you try to trap the king
3022.asset_description: A classical-style painting of a blonde girl in a red dress and white apron kneeling at a round table, resting her chin on her hand and staring hard at a chessboard full of black and white pieces on a black-and-white tiled floor.

3063.words: to listen (verb): to pay attention to a sound
3063.asset_description: Japanese-poster-style illustration of a woman in a red kimono sitting on a cherry-blossom branch above blue water, eyes closed and one hand on her big headphones, with Mount Fuji and a bridge behind her.

3180.words: to skate (verb): to glide over ice on special boots
3180.asset_description: Cartoon of a girl in a blue coat, red hat, scarf and mittens gliding across a frozen lake on white ice skates, one leg lifted behind her and arms out for balance, with snowy banks and fir trees behind.

3281.words: kite (noun): a cloth wing on strings pulled by the wind
3281.asset_description: Bright vector-style poster of a kitesurfer riding a board across the sea at sunset, held up by a large purple kite on long lines; a city skyline sits on the horizon behind him.

3303.words: paper plane (noun): a folded sheet you throw so it flies
3303.asset_description: Soft pencil illustration of a smiling boy running through long grass under a cloudy sky, arm stretched up after letting go of a paper plane that glides away above him.

3341.words: trumpet (noun): a brass instrument you blow into
3341.asset_description: Loose watercolour of three young musicians standing together in jackets: one holds a big orange double bass, one stands with his hands in his pockets and one sits holding a golden trumpet on his knee.

3418.words: drums (noun): a set of round instruments you hit with sticks
3418.asset_description: Flat vector poster in orange and blue of a woman with her hair in a bun sitting behind a big drum kit; she holds two sticks over the drums and cymbals while sun rays and clouds burst behind her.

4011.words: audience (noun): the people watching a show or a talk
4011.asset_description: A golden retriever puppy sits on a log holding a small wooden guitar and strumming it, mouth open as if singing. A ring of giant pandas sits in the bamboo enclosure in front of it, watching. The scene then cuts to the same puppy playing on a rock while king penguins and their chicks gather round in an aquarium.

4026.words: smooth (adjective): with a surface free of bumps or roughness
4026.asset_description: A woman in a yellow top and white flared trousers stands barefoot on a wooden-topped hydrofoil board that is lifted clear of the water on a thin mast. The harbour water is completely flat and mirror-like, reflecting her and the palm trees, and she glides across it leaving only a thin line of ripples. She rides past a breakwater of grey concrete blocks and a marina, then comes back in and steps off onto a floating plastic dock.

4044.words: practice (verb): to learn something by repetition
4044.asset_description: At a floodlit driving range at night, a woman in a red hoodie, grey leggings, white trainers and a white cap stands on a green mat with a club, a ball teed up in front of her. She settles into her stance, swings the club back over her shoulder and hits the ball out into the dark field, then follows through and watches it fly. A man in a beige hoodie stands on the next bay watching her.

4095.words: movie (noun): a story told with moving pictures and sound
4095.asset_description: A behind-the-scenes clip from a film shoot in a red-rock desert at dusk. First the finished-looking action: a yellow muscle car races down an empty desert highway chased by a police car with flashing lights, then a shot from inside the car looking out through the windscreen at the setting sun. Then the camera pulls back to the reality: a young crew in hoodies and jeans stand in the sand around a monitor on a wheeled cart, watching the same shot play back, some holding tablets and notes. The last shot shows two pickup trucks parked on a dirt track under an orange and pink sunset sky.
4095.transcript: Not long ago, folks figured a big picture took a big camera. So this little thing shot all that? Big movies, little camera.

4151.words: art (noun): the products of human creativity
4151.asset_description: A hand holds a bright pink marker over a pencil drawing of a sports car on white paper lying on a wooden table. The hand fills in the bonnet of the car with pink strokes, and the drawing slowly turns from grey lines into a solid pink car. A close-up shows the finished front of the car with its black air vents. At the end the finished picture of the pink car stands on a small wooden easel on the table, with a framed picture of a blue car hanging on the wall above it.

4163.words: talk (verb): to exchange thoughts with someone
4163.asset_description: A man in a dark shirt sits on a metal bar stool in a dim garage beside a yellow classic Lamborghini, speaking to someone off camera about the car while a work lamp glows on the wall behind him. The shot cuts to a close-up travelling along the car's yellow rear deck and its black engine louvres, then back to the man, who reaches out and rests a hand on the bodywork while he keeps talking.
4163.transcript: I have always loved mechanical things. The Lamborghini Miura was the first real supercar. You do not just drive it, you have to tame it. It makes you feel in charge.

4248.asset_description: A huge artificial wave pool inside a hall, with a steel roof, rows of ceiling lights and windows along the upper wall. A big turquoise wave rolls across the pool and a person on an orange board rides down its face before the white foam swallows them. The wave collapses into churning white water that fills the frame, and the person is left swimming through the foam. Staff in red stand watching on the concrete deck above.

4279.words: theatre (noun): a building where plays or films are shown
4279.asset_description: An art-deco poster of a theatre interior. A man in a gold and black geometric suit stands alone in a bright spotlight on the stage, one hand pressed to his heart and the other flung out, head thrown back as he declaims. Heavy crimson and gold curtains are swagged back on either side of the stage, and rows of empty seats stretch away into the dark behind him.

4294.words: low (adverb): in a low position, near the ground
4294.asset_description: A plane spotter in a keffiyeh with a DSLR on a strap stands at an airport perimeter fence looking up and grinning; a twin-engine airliner crosses just above the fence behind him, and then a far bigger four-engine jumbo passes directly over his head with its landing gear down, so close that its belly and wheels fill the whole frame while he ducks and laughs.

4322.words: dance (noun): an artistic form of moving to music
4322.asset_description: A charcoal and pencil sketch of a street scene: a man in a dark suit and a woman in a long dark dress dance a tango in the middle of a cobbled street, her body arched back against his arm, their faces almost touching. Behind them a musician in a flat cap sits on a wooden chair playing a bandoneon. A flag with a sun in the middle hangs from a pole on the left, and tall wooden houses with balconies line the street.

4464.words: read (verb): to look at written words and understand them
4464.asset_description: A young woman waits at a bus stop in the countryside, leaning against the wooden post of an old timetable sign with green fields and an empty road behind her. She holds an open paperback in both hands and reads it, headphones round her neck, glancing up the road for the bus. The scene cuts to a modern glass bus shelter in a small town in the rain, where she sits on the bench with the book on her lap and points up at the printed timetable on the wall. Finally a blue city bus pulls in and a queue of people, her among them, steps aboard.

4481.words: focus (verb): to bring something to a central point
4481.asset_description: A young woman in a khaki jacket and fingerless gloves photographs her way through a city. She first holds a small silver compact camera up to her eye in front of a flower stall and winks as she takes a shot. She then walks a cobbled street with a big black DSLR round her neck and raises it to her eye, turning the lens barrel with her left hand as a cyclist passes behind her. Finally she crouches behind a huge telephoto lens mounted on a tripod at a viewpoint over the city rooftops, hand on the barrel and eye at the finder, then breaks into a delighted grin.

4530.words: film (noun): a story told with moving pictures and sound
4530.asset_description: A dark cinema drawn in black and white. At the front a wide screen glows bright blue with a blurred moving picture on it, and a broad beam from the projector cuts through the dark air above the rows of seats. Most of the seats are empty and a few silhouetted heads watch from the rows. In the middle a man has jumped up out of his seat and is hurling a bucket of popcorn into the air; the popcorn scatters through the beam and over the seats around him while the man in front of him ducks away.

4531.words: popcorn (noun): corn heated until it bursts into white pieces
4531.asset_description: A girl films herself going to the pictures. First, hands at the desk tear her printed ticket in half and give her back the stub. Then she walks along a dark carpeted passage with numbered doors opening off it, hers the one marked 2, carrying a big striped tub of popcorn in one arm with the ticket stub held between her teeth, and pushes through the black curtain at the end. Inside the auditorium she drops into a seat in the middle of the rows in front of the huge blank white screen, holds up the popcorn and pulls a delighted face at the camera.

4739.words: discover (verb): to discover that something is there
4739.asset_description: A woman in a mustard cardigan with round sunglasses pushed up on her head leans over a second-hand stall in a busy street market, with lit shop fronts and passers-by behind her. She rummages through a heap of old objects piled on a wooden crate: cloth, hardback books, old film cameras, a brass jug and a mosaic lamp. She pulls a dark wooden case out of the pile, sets it down and opens the lid, and her mouth falls open: inside, on red velvet, lies an enormous cut diamond. She lifts it out with both hands and holds it up in front of the open case, grinning.

4768.words: card (noun): a small piece of stiff paper used for games
4768.asset_description: A string of reaction shots in a living room strung with fairy lights. A woman claps a hand over her mouth beside a present with a red bow. A man on the sofa holds up two red-backed playing cards, eyes wide and mouth open, a game box on the table in front of him. A woman laughs with her mouth open, then covers her face as confetti falls around her over a board game. The last shot is the whole group on and around the sofa, all gasping at once at the board game on the coffee table.

4827.words: paint (noun): a coloured substance you put on a surface
4827.asset_description: A canvas on an easel holds a half-finished sunset over dark mountains. A hand drags a metal palette knife through a thick slab of bright orange paint, spreading it across the sky and leaving ridges of wet colour, then switches to a flat brush and blends the orange into the mountains until the sky glows.
4827.transcript: Wow, you paint that sunset so beautifully.

4834.words: toy (noun): a thing designed to be played with
4834.asset_description: Two teenage boys lean over a wooden table with their elbows on it, watching a black plastic battle dish. Inside it a yellow spinning top and a purple spinning top race around the bowl, knock into each other and keep spinning, and both boys grin and laugh as they follow them.

4838.words: throw (verb): to send something through the air
4838.asset_description: On a wide sunny beach a young woman in a bikini swings her arm and sends a small ball flying up over the sand. The shot cuts to a yellow ball high against the blue sky over the surf, then to her standing with legs apart and both arms raised as a watermelon-patterned ball drops towards her hands. A large red, white and blue beach ball sails through the air while a man runs under it, and finally she laughs as a rainbow-striped ball comes back at her and the man lands in the sand behind.

4850.words: camera (noun): the equipment you use for taking photographs
4850.asset_description: Over the top of a camera on a tripod, a woman in a striped summer dress stands smiling on a sunlit park lawn under tall trees. Cut to a macro shot of round dew drops beading along a green leaf in a flower bed. Then two hands hold up a black DSLR with a big flash on top and shoot into a sunset over rolling hills, the sun low and orange on the horizon. The same shot holds as the sun drops further. Finally a young man in a straw hat and green shirt turns a big black camera with a long lens towards the viewer at a red-carpet event.

4859.words: piece (noun): a separate part of something bigger
4859.asset_description: A woman in a big cardigan and glasses leans over a table scattered with jigsaw pieces in a bright room full of plants and bookshelves. She picks up single pieces and presses them into the picture, the puzzle grows onto the wall, and finally it covers the whole floor as she fits the last pieces in the middle.

4861.words: listen (verb): to hear something on purpose
4861.asset_description: A woman in a field vest and big headphones holds a furry microphone and a handheld recorder close to a singing bird in a wood. She crouches to record a stream over stones, raises a long boom microphone up into the green canopy, and finally records beside a thundering waterfall, beaming.

4869.words: design (noun): working out the form of something in a sketch
4869.asset_description: A young woman with curly hair draws a swirling logo letter on a tablet with a stylus at a sunny desk. She then stands over a table fanned out with dozens of colour swatch cards and smiles at the camera. At an iMac she arranges a colourful poster layout with a colour wheel open beside it. A hand turns a sketchbook page showing a pencil drawing of a woman in a long flowing gown. Finally she poses in front of a huge colourful mural in a gallery while visitors look at it.
4869.transcript: Ooh, nice. This one. Perfect. Love it. Ta-da!

4914.words: guitar (noun): a stringed instrument with six strings
4914.asset_description: A young man sits on a bench in a city plaza between office towers, playing a wooden acoustic instrument with six strings, one hand on the fretboard, the other strumming over the sound hole. A runner in a race bib jogs past. Office workers with shopping bags stop and gather in a half circle around him, clapping and smiling; a toddler dances in front; two people hold up phones to film him as he keeps playing and singing.

4945.words: sing (verb): to make music with your voice by singing
4945.asset_description: A young woman in an oversized band T-shirt presses a pair of big headphones to her ears in a recording booth strung with warm fairy lights. She leans into a large studio microphone behind a pop filter and belts out a note with her eyes shut and her mouth wide open. A cut shows an older man at a mixing desk pushing the faders. She keeps singing with her arms flung out, then laughs and looks over at a screen where the man behind the glass is clapping.

5033.words: drum (noun): a musical instrument you hit to make a beat
5033.asset_description: A carnival parade fills a wide street hung with rainbow bunting between balconies packed with spectators. A woman in a huge rainbow feather headdress and a silver bodysuit walks down the centre line of the road at the front with her arms flung wide. Behind her, rows of drummers in white outfits and rainbow-striped trousers carry big rainbow-painted drums strapped at the waist and beat them with sticks as they advance, with a dense crowd stretching back down the street.

5035.words: talent (noun): natural abilities or qualities you have
5035.asset_description: In a sunny park a young person in a rainbow tie-dye tracksuit bends down and picks up three pastel balls from the grass, then straightens up and juggles them in a smooth cascade. Three friends sit on the lawn behind and watch, smiling. The juggler grins wide as the balls arc above their head.

5097.words: music (noun): an art form of instrumental or vocal tones
5097.asset_description: A young red-haired street performer in a denim jacket covered in enamel badges plays an acoustic guitar on a cobbled street at golden hour. An open guitar case lies on the stones in front of him. A small crowd of passers-by has stopped in a loose semicircle to listen, including a woman holding a toddler. He strums hard, throws his strumming hand up over his head, then leans back into the guitar and sings while the onlookers smile and clap.

5099.words: photo (noun): a print of a person or scene
5099.asset_description: In a flat with a huge political world map on the wall, housemates take turns stepping up to it. Each one holds a small square instant print showing their own face and a little paper flag, and presses both onto the map over the country they come from. A man in a green football shirt sticks his onto northern Europe, a woman with a camera round her neck presses hers onto Africa, a long-haired man adds one near Japan, a blonde woman adds one over South America. The map fills up with flags and small portraits, and at the end the whole group crowds behind the framed map, holds it up and takes a selfie with it.

5125.words: stage (verb): to perform a play on a stage
5125.asset_description: Filmed from the seats of an old theatre, a play is being performed on the lit stage. A costumed actor with a moustache sits on a golden throne wearing a metal helmet while actors dressed as ragged peasants storm him with makeshift weapons. They tip the throne over and he tumbles onto a white mattress laid on the boards; a woman in rags holds the helmet up over her head and the whole auditorium rises, cheering and applauding.

5130.words: kite (noun): a cloth wing on strings pulled by the wind
5130.asset_description: A young travel vlogger films himself on a trip. First he walks beside a truck covered in bright hand-painted flowers with a peacock painted on its side, and puts his hand on it. Then he stands at a wooden railing under strings of prayer flags, looking out at a snow-covered mountain range lit orange by the sun above a deep valley. Finally, on a city rooftop at sunset with domes and minarets behind him, he holds a string and flies a red kite while dozens of coloured kites fill the sky around him.

5194.words: novel (noun): a long fictional story printed as a book
5194.asset_description: A young blonde woman sits curled up on a grey sofa in a bright living room, a white curtained window behind her. She holds a thick paperback open in both hands and reads it, her lips moving slightly as her eyes track the lines. She smiles at something on the page and turns over a page. At the end she closes the book, holds it on her lap and looks up and away with a satisfied smile.

5230.words: doll (noun): a small toy made to look like a person
5230.asset_description: A woman in a fur-flapped hat and a burgundy winter coat stands with her arms spread wide in a snowy square in front of a cathedral with coloured onion domes. She is then on a train, holding a glass of black tea in a metal holder and sipping it while snow-covered birch woods slide past the window. Finally she is at an evening winter market strung with fairy lights, smiling as she twists open a small painted wooden doll and holds up the two halves and the smaller doll from inside it.

5282.words: song (noun): a short piece of music with words
5282.asset_description: Four scenes of people performing music with words. A grey-haired busker plays an acoustic guitar and sings into a microphone on a cobbled Lisbon street while a crowd stands round listening. A woman in a colourful apron sings into a wooden spoon in her kitchen while pots simmer behind her. Four friends belt out a number together in a car at night with the city lights behind them. Finally a performer in a white suit sings into a microphone on a huge arena stage in front of a packed, floodlit crowd.

5321.words: skate (verb): to glide over ice wearing ice skates
5321.asset_description: A figure skater in a navy outfit glides across an ice rink with one leg stretched out behind him, pulls his arms in to his chest and spins fast on one skate, then slows, straightens up and glides away across the ice.

5399.words: play (noun): a story that actors perform on a stage
5399.asset_description: A loose watercolour of a theatre seen from the side. Two actors in tunics, boots and capes perform on a wooden stage: one stands with his arm flung out and his cloak flying, the other strides towards him. Heavy red curtains are drawn back on either side, a painted forest backdrop hangs behind them, footlights glow along the front edge of the stage, and rows of seated people and gilded balcony boxes fill the auditorium.

5400.words: opera (noun): a drama sung to music with an orchestra
5400.asset_description: A woman in a green velvet dress sits in the audience of a plain little hall, clapping as two men in waistcoats bow on a low wooden platform; she turns to the camera, delighted. Then she is alone in a large empty auditorium of red seats, looking up at the stage. Finally she leans on the red-and-gold rail of a box in a grand horseshoe-shaped opera house, a chandelier above her, tiers of gilded balconies around her and the orchestra playing in the pit below the closed red curtain.

5487.words: surfing (noun): the sport of riding a surfboard on waves
5487.asset_description: A high-contrast black-and-white illustration of a giant ocean wave curling over into a hollow barrel; inside the glowing turquoise tube a tiny silhouetted surfer crouches on a surfboard, riding along the face of the wave. Spray flies off the crest above and dark rocks and choppy water fill the foreground.

76.words: battery (noun): a small object that stores power for devices
76.asset_description: In a cabin a woman clicks a dead flashlight, unscrews it and tips out the old batteries; she and her friend compare them with fresh ones, load the new batteries in, and the flashlight lights up the table as they cheer.

119.words: bulb (noun): the glass part of a lamp that gives light
119.asset_description: In a cozy evening living room a man unscrews the dead bulb from a small table lamp, takes a new bulb out of its cardboard box, screws it in, and the lamp glows warmly while his partner watches from the sofa with tea and the cat looks on.

154.words: charger (noun): a device that puts power back into a battery
154.asset_description: A woman panics dramatically because her phone battery is dying; a man digs a white charger out of a messy drawer, plugs it into the wall socket and connects the phone, and they relax on the sofa giving a thumbs up as it charges.

316.words: freezer (noun): a very cold box that keeps food frozen
316.asset_description: In a wooden cabin kitchen, a woman pulls open the bottom freezer drawer of a fridge and icy mist pours out, making her gasp 'You can see the cold!'. She lifts out a rock-solid bag of frozen peas, a man taps a tub of ice cream with a spoon, and they show a bag of frost-covered berries before closing the drawer.
316.transcript: Look! You can see the cold! Rock solid!

365.words: headphones (noun): things you wear over your ears to hear music
365.asset_description: A girl in a kitchen puts on big white headphones and dances while singing into a wooden spoon; her friend tries to talk to her but she shouts that she can't hear him, then holds one earcup to his ear so they can listen together.
365.transcript: Can't hear you! One for you!

477.words: microwave (noun): a small box that heats food very fast
477.asset_description: Late at night, a young couple slides a plate of leftovers into a silver microwave, turns the dial and presses their faces close to watch the food spin, counting down until the ding. He pulls the plate out and immediately shovels in a steaming forkful while she laughs.
477.transcript: Spin little dinner! Three, two, one! Ding! It's time!

547.words: phone (noun): a device you use to call and talk to people
547.asset_description: On a rooftop terrace at dusk, a phone rings on a wooden table while two young women drink tea; one grabs it excitedly, answers the call and paces around chatting happily with her hand pressed to her cheek.

562.words: plug (noun): the end of a cable you push into a socket
562.asset_description: A couple's floor lamp goes dark, and they frown and investigate. Following the cable, they find the white two-pin plug lying loose on the floor, hold it up to the camera saying "Well, there's why", then push it into the wall socket and the lamp lights up again.
562.transcript: Well, there's why. Let there be light!

607.words: refrigerator (noun): a cold box in the kitchen that keeps food fresh
607.asset_description: A couple opens their new empty refrigerator, enjoys the cold air, then fills the shelves with milk bottles, leafy greens, eggs and cheese before proudly posing beside the closed fridge.
607.transcript: Cold air heaven! All of it fresh!

764.words: tablet (noun): a flat computer with a touch screen
764.asset_description: An animated young man in a desert diner holds up a tablet and draws on its white screen with his finger, sketching a cactus that fills in green, then leans back happily comparing his drawing with the real cactus outside the window.

789.words: toaster (noun): a machine that makes bread brown and crispy
789.asset_description: Two men lower bread slices into a stainless-steel toaster, turn its dial and lean in nose-to-nose, staring dead-serious at the glowing slots until the toast pops high into the air; one snatches a slice from the air and they grin and bite into their toast.
789.transcript: Down and glow. Pop! Cut it!

814.words: turn off (verb): to stop a machine or light with a switch
814.asset_description: In a cozy attic room at dusk, an animated girl with round glasses pulls the cord of the hanging light bulb so it goes dark, then presses the button on a standing fan and its blades spin to a stop. She smiles, satisfied, by the darkened window.

818.words: typing (noun): pressing keys to write on a keyboard
818.asset_description: In a library, a young woman hammers away at a laptop keyboard at absurd speed while the guy next to her watches with his jaw dropping. Her fingers fly over the keys, he asks how she is that fast, and she throws her arms up in triumph when she finishes.
818.transcript: How are you that fast? And done.

823.words: screen (noun): the flat glass part of a computer, TV or phone
823.asset_description: In a bright open-plan office a desktop monitor shows a colorful marketing dashboard with charts, and a hand reaches in and points at the screen while someone works at the keyboard.

841.words: melt (verb): to turn from solid to liquid when heated
841.asset_description: A bored young woman scoops ice cubes into a glass kettle and switches it on to melt them, watching until the ice turns to water. She celebrates, then pours the little jug of melted water into a huge swimming pool.

1006.words: coffee maker (noun): a kitchen machine for brewing hot drinks
1006.asset_description: A young man in his kitchen lifts the glass carafe from a black drip coffee maker while coffee still pours down, leaving a spilled coffee ring and grounds on the wooden counter next to empty mugs.

1158.words: kettle (noun): the pot you boil water in for tea or coffee
1158.asset_description: A man at a wooden kitchen table pours steaming hot water from a stainless-steel electric kettle into a white mug.

1379.words: switch (noun): a device that turns the electricity on or off
1379.asset_description: A close-up of a hand reaching out with one finger to flip a white wall switch in a hallway. A warm brass wall lamp glows above, and keys hang on a hook nearby.

1435.words: microphone (noun): a device you speak into to make your voice louder
1435.asset_description: In a bright living room with framed art on the wall, a young man sings into a microphone on a tall stand with a cable running down it, while friends listen from sofas.

1579.words: smartphone (noun): a mobile phone that works like a small computer
1579.asset_description: A 3D render of many identical smartphones with glowing app screens leaned against each other to build a three-story house of cards on a dark blue surface.

1592.words: robot (noun): a mechanism that can move automatically
1592.asset_description: A close-up portrait of a humanoid robot head assembled from riveted metal plates, mechanical eye lenses, cables and blue metal lips, painted in a collage style.

1831.words: light bulb (noun): a glass ball in a lamp that glows when switched on
1831.asset_description: A hanging glass light bulb contains a tiny winter world: a snowy hill with a small wooden cabin and a Christmas tree, snowflakes filling the glass.

1932.words: computer (noun): an electronic machine for work, games and the web
1932.asset_description: A flat cartoon illustration of a tidy study corner: a desktop computer stands centered on a red desk with drawers, flanked by a lamp, potted plants, a bookshelf and a map of France on the green wall.

2207.words: point (verb): to indicate a direction or thing with your finger
2207.asset_description: A dark blue halftone illustration of a robotic hand with its index finger extended, pointing at a glowing screen of text floating in the dark.

2500.words: laptop (noun): a small computer you can carry and fold shut
2500.asset_description: A man in a dark hoodie sits at a desk typing on a glowing laptop, his face in shadow, with walls of blue digital code lighting up the dark room behind him.

2950.words: radio (noun): a device that plays music and news from the air
2950.asset_description: An old brown portable radio with a carrying handle, dials and a tuning window sits glowing on a stone slab, while a swarm of bright orange butterflies and light trails streams up out of it into a misty sky.

4133.words: fridge (noun): an electric refrigerator that keeps food cold
4133.asset_description: A kitchen with white cupboards and a dark polished wooden floor. A tall stainless steel fridge with a double door, an ice and water dispenser in the left-hand door and a freezer drawer underneath stands against the wall, and a raised metal dog bowl in a wooden stand sits next to it. A man in pink pyjamas crouches down on the floor in front of the fridge next to a golden retriever that is lying there, strokes its back and talks to it. He goes down onto his knees, then lies right down on the floor with his arms round the dog and his head against it, while a second golden retriever lies stretched out on the floor in the foreground.

4289.asset_description: A cartoon of an oversized wall air conditioner blasting a wide white stream of freezing air down into a bedroom; a young woman in a T-shirt and shorts is blown back onto her heels with her hair standing straight up and her mouth open in shock, sheets of paper fly off the desk and the curtain whips sideways, while warm sunlight glows outside the window.

4671.words: machine (noun): a thing with moving metal parts built to work
4671.asset_description: A bearded man in a checked shirt stands in a small laundry room between two white front-loading machines with stacks of folded towels above them. He hauls a huge rainbow-striped blanket out of the top of one machine, pushes it into the round drum of the other and shuts the door. The drum spins and the colourful blanket tumbles round behind the glass. He opens the door again and hugs the warm blanket to his chest.

4986.words: bright (adjective): giving off a lot of light
4986.asset_description: A woman in a white shirt aims a cordless drill at a wall while a man in a blue polo holds a spirit level against a black bracket and then reaches up towards the ceiling. The two of them carry a large black screen across the room, hang it on the wall and switch it on, and it lights up in strong blue. In the last shot the room is dark and a wall of nine mounted screens glows bright blue, lighting up both of their faces and the plastic sheet spread over the floor.

5006.words: kettle (noun): the pot you boil water in for tea or coffee
5006.asset_description: An older woman in a patchwork apron fills a stainless steel electric kettle from the kitchen tap, then sets it back on its round base on the worktop, where a red light comes on and it starts to boil. She carries it to a wooden table where five brightly patterned mugs stand in a row, each with a teabag in it, and pours the boiling water into one mug after another.

5022.words: shine (verb): to be bright by casting or reflecting light
5022.asset_description: Three lit interiors in a row. First a dark study at night where a bent desk lamp throws a warm pool of light over stacked books, folders and a laptop while someone works at the desk. Then a colourful living room where a woman reaches to a tall floor lamp with a wide drum shade and it comes on, filling the room with warm light. Last a grand marble hall where a woman in a long silver gown stands under an enormous crystal chandelier that blazes above her and casts sparkling reflections on the polished floor.

5046.words: television (noun): broadcasting moving pictures to a screen
5046.asset_description: A cartoon illustration of three young people watching television in a living room at night. The glow of the screen, just out of frame at the left, lights the whole room blue. A man in a yellow jumper leaps up off the sofa with both arms raised, sending a bowl of popcorn flying so the kernels rain down through the air, a woman in a blue dress on the sofa punches the air, and a man in a green polo shirt sprawls back laughing. Behind them are a floor lamp with an orange shade, a bookshelf and a striped rug.

5266.words: telephone (noun): equipment you use to talk to someone far away
5266.asset_description: A retro cartoon illustration of a living room. A woman in a blue jumper and brown skirt bends forward with both gloved hands pressed to her open mouth, her eyes wide and her hair flying back, with jagged shock lines drawn around her head. On the floor beside her stands a cream rotary telephone; its handset has been dropped and hangs swinging on its coiled cord, with motion lines showing it still moving. A brown sofa and a table lamp stand behind her.

5407.words: toilet (noun): the bathroom fixture you sit on to pee
5407.asset_description: At a house party lit by coloured lights, a young woman in a sequin jacket stands in the narrow hallway knocking on a closed white door with her phone in her other hand. Nothing happens, so she waits and checks the phone. Behind her a queue builds up as several other guests line up along the hallway. Finally the door swings open onto a small bathroom with a white toilet bowl and a towel beside it, and the next guest squeezes past her to get in.

35.words: actor (noun): a man who plays roles in films or plays
35.asset_description: On a film set a young man gets his makeup done in a director's chair, steps to his mark in front of the camera, and after the clapperboard snaps he performs an intense, tearful scene straight into the lens; the crew applauds and he bows and celebrates.

52.words: assistant (noun): a person whose job is to help someone
52.asset_description: In a Pixar-style 3D animation, a photographer shoots a model in a desert canyon while his assistant hands him the long lens, holds up the reflector, passes him a drink and gets a grateful thumbs-up.
52.transcript: Long lens, please. Already here. Light, light. A bit left. You are the best.

170.words: cleaner (noun): a person whose job is to tidy and wash rooms
170.asset_description: An animated hotel cleaner in a lilac uniform pushes her cart with towels into a messy seaside room. She throws fresh sheets over the bed, fluffs pillows, sprays and wipes the window, vacuums the carpet and gives a proud thumbs up in the spotless room.

261.words: electrician (noun): a worker who fixes wires and power in homes
261.asset_description: During a blackout, a woman in a hard hat and hi-vis vest works on an open fuse box in a dark hallway while a family lights the scene with phone flashlights. She snips wires, fits a new breaker and flips it, the lights come back on and everyone cheers.

265.words: employee (noun): a person who works for a company or a boss
265.asset_description: In a night-time office a young worker with a badge lanyard hauls stacks of papers through his tasks as the clock spins. His silver-haired boss pats his shoulder, shakes his hand and hands him a pay envelope, and he celebrates with a coworker.
265.transcript: Great month, Kenji. Thank you, boss! Payday! Let's go!

267.words: engineer (noun): a person who plans and builds machines
267.asset_description: In an electronics lab a young man in glasses assembles a small robotic arm, tightens parts and types code on a laptop. The arm picks up a white cube and places it in a tray, and he pumps his fist while colleagues in lab coats applaud.

472.words: mechanic (noun): a person whose job is to fix cars
472.asset_description: In a garage workshop, a bearded man in dark overalls works on a teal car: he checks the underside on the lift with a wrench, leans under the open hood, and unbolts a wheel hub with a power tool. He closes the hood, pats the car and smiles, job done.

490.words: musician (noun): a person who plays an instrument or sings
490.asset_description: On a cobblestone street at sunset, a red-haired young busker strums an acoustic guitar and sings to a circle of people. The crowd films him with their phones and applauds, and his open guitar case with coins lies at his feet.

582.words: proud (adjective): pleased and happy about something you did
582.asset_description: In a carpentry workshop a young woman finishes a wooden chair, presses the seat to test it, puts her hands on her hips and admires it. She sits down, crosses her arms and beams with pride while an older colleague congratulates her.

630.words: sailor (noun): a person who works on a ship or boat
630.asset_description: A cheerful sailor in an orange jacket and life vest works on the deck of a wooden sailboat in a misty fjord: she winds a thick rope around a winch, laughs as spray bursts over the bow under the raised sails, then takes the ship's wheel and raises a fist in triumph.

680.words: singer (noun): a person whose job is to perform songs
680.asset_description: In a recording studio, a young woman wearing headphones sings her heart out into a large studio microphone, one hand on her headphones, while producers work at the mixing desk behind the glass; she finishes the take laughing happily.

714.words: soldier (noun): a person who fights in an army
714.asset_description: A young soldier in dress uniform walks through airport arrival doors with a duffel bag, spots his family waiting with a heart-painted sign, drops the bag and runs to them, ending in a big tearful group hug.

786.asset_description: A construction worker hauls a heavy wooden crate up a narrow staircase onto a sunny rooftop, straining and wiping sweat from his face; after setting the crate down he slumps onto a step, arms hanging over his knees, panting and gasping "that's it."

806.words: tray (noun): a flat board for carrying food and drinks
806.asset_description: A waitress in a cafe loads a wooden tray with coffee cups, a copper pot, glasses and cake, then carries it high overhead on one hand across the busy room, dodging a customer. She sets the fully loaded tray down on a table without spilling a drop and the guests applaud.
806.transcript: Up high, steady. Not one drop.

838.words: pilot (noun): a person who flies a plane
838.asset_description: A young man in a brown leather pilot jacket struts through an airport terminal past admiring cabin crew, then poses selfie-style in front of a huge jet engine at sunset, running a hand through his hair.

852.words: waiter (noun): a person who brings food in a restaurant
852.asset_description: An animated mustachioed waiter in a bow tie dashes through a cozy restaurant balancing a tower of steaming plates on one hand. He weaves between tables, serves the dishes to delighted elderly guests and takes a proud little bow.
852.transcript: That looks amazing! Enjoy your meal!

898.words: actress (noun): a woman who plays roles in films or plays
898.asset_description: A woman in a flowing emerald-green gown spins toward a large cinema camera on a film set, hair in motion, while a hand holds a clapperboard at the edge of the frame and crew members work under studio lights.

926.words: baker (noun): someone who bakes bread and cakes as a job
926.asset_description: A young man in a flour-dusted apron pulls fresh round loaves of bread out of a big oven on a long wooden peel, with racks of baked bread behind him.

954.words: boss (noun): a person who is in control of workers
954.asset_description: A woman in a navy suit stands at the head of a conference table and addresses five seated employees who all look up at her attentively.

963.words: builder (noun): a person whose job is making houses and walls
963.asset_description: Seen from above, a builder in a hi-vis vest and white hard hat spreads mortar with a trowel along a brick wall on a construction site, a crane in the background.

967.words: bus driver (noun): a person who takes passengers around a city route
967.asset_description: A friendly bus driver in a blue uniform sits at the big steering wheel of his bus and turns around smiling to welcome boarding passengers.

990.asset_description: A woman in a white jacket and tall chef's hat leans over a plate in a professional steel kitchen, carefully placing garnish on a dish with tweezers while a pan steams beside her.

1057.words: employer (noun): a person or company that pays people to work
1057.asset_description: A laughing woman in a dark suit stands behind a desk in a corner office at sunset, shaking a new arrival's hand and gesturing at the workplace with her other arm.

1067.words: expert (noun): a person with special knowledge or skill
1067.asset_description: A gray-haired watchmaker with a black loupe pressed to his eye holds an open pocket watch right in front of his face and examines its golden mechanism with a fine tool.

1071.words: farmer (noun): a person who operates a farm
1071.asset_description: A man in a straw hat pitches hay with a fork next to a loaded trailer and tractor, standing in a golden wheat field at sunset.

1078.words: firefighter (noun): a person whose job is putting out fires
1078.asset_description: A firefighter in full helmet and turnout gear hauls a heavy hose across a wet road, with smoke and orange flames rising from a building behind him.

1082.words: fisherman (noun): a person who catches fish as a job
1082.asset_description: A bearded man in yellow waterproof overalls hauls a net bulging with fish over the side of a boat on rough sea, seagulls circling and a crate of fish on deck.

1100.words: gardener (noun): a person who looks after a garden
1100.asset_description: A woman in a tool-filled work apron, with soil smudged on her face and arms, prunes a pink rose with secateurs in a walled garden stacked with terracotta pots.

1154.words: journalist (noun): a person who writes or reports the news
1154.asset_description: Outside on some steps, a woman in a trench coat with a press badge holds out a voice recorder and grips a notebook, surrounded by other reporters pointing microphones at someone.

1185.words: manager (noun): the person in charge who tells a team what to do
1185.asset_description: A woman in a smart grey suit walks through a bright modern office carrying an open laptop, turning to give directions to two colleagues near a board of sticky notes.

1221.words: officer (noun): a person who holds a position of authority
1221.asset_description: A woman in a dark dress uniform and peaked cap stands at attention saluting on a wet parade ground, with rows of saluting soldiers and flags behind her.

1225.words: painter (noun): a person who puts colour on walls as a job
1225.asset_description: A smiling woman in paint-splattered overalls and a backwards cap balances on a stepladder holding a roller loaded with teal paint, one hand on the bare white wall, a paint tray on the floor below.

1241.words: photographer (noun): someone who takes photos as their job
1241.asset_description: A woman lies flat on her stomach on wet cobblestones in an old alley, shooting with a big camera pointed at the viewer, feet kicked up behind her, while a man in a red jacket walks by in the background.

1254.words: plumber (noun): a worker who fixes pipes and sinks
1254.asset_description: A man in blue overalls kneels by an open kitchen cabinet and tightens the curved pipe under the sink with a large wrench, an open toolbox spread on the floor beside him.

1263.words: postman (noun): a person whose job is to bring letters to houses
1263.asset_description: A postman in a blue uniform and cap pushes a bundle of letters through the brass slot of a front door, his leather shoulder bag stuffed with envelopes and his red bicycle parked behind him.

1267.words: professional (adjective): smart and serious in the way you work or look
1267.asset_description: A young woman in a smart dark coat strides through a glass-tower business district holding a coffee cup and a leather folder, surrounded by men in suits walking to work.

1304.words: secretary (noun): a person who answers calls and does office work
1304.asset_description: In a retro wood-panelled office, a man in a shirt and tie holds a telephone receiver to his shoulder while stamping a document, a tall stack of folders beside him and papers flying off the desk.

1306.words: seller (noun): someone who exchanges goods for money
1306.asset_description: A laughing moustached vendor in a leather apron at a covered vegetable market holds out a paper bag with a tomato on top, his other hand on a brass weighing bowl, crates of peppers and figs around him.

1312.words: shop assistant (noun): a person who helps customers in a store
1312.asset_description: A shop assistant in a grey apron with a measuring tape around her neck reaches up to a hanging mustard coat on a clothes rack, holding wooden hangers, while a customer gestures in the background.

1386.words: taxi driver (noun): a person paid to take people places by car
1386.asset_description: A smiling middle-aged man in a blue shirt leans out of the window of his yellow cab, waving at the camera. Tall city buildings and more yellow taxis line the street behind him.

1422.words: to point (verb): to show where something is with your finger
1422.asset_description: A hand points with the index finger at a colorful contest banner displayed on a computer monitor in a bright office.

1424.words: colleague (noun): a person you work with at your job
1424.asset_description: In an open-plan office, a young man sits at a computer while an older man in a blue shirt stands beside him; both look toward the camera, with more workers at desks behind.

1442.words: office (noun): a place of business where people do office work
1442.asset_description: In a bright open-plan office full of desks and plants, a smiling woman in a navy suit holds a tablet and pen while talking with a gray-haired man seated at a desk with a laptop, coffee and papers.

1457.words: waitress (noun): a woman who serves food to guests in a restaurant
1457.asset_description: A smiling waitress in a blue diner uniform and white apron sets a cherry-topped milkshake on a table while balancing plates of breakfast food on her other arm.

1473.words: worker (noun): a person who works at a job
1473.asset_description: A man in grey coveralls, gloves and safety goggles steadies a long steel beam hanging from chains in a factory hall while sparks fly from a colleague grinding metal behind him.

1476.words: writer (noun): a person who creates books or stories as a job
1476.asset_description: A young man in a denim shirt sits at a wooden desk at night, typing on a vintage typewriter and pulling out a page, surrounded by stacks of books, a lamp, a coffee mug and a crumpled paper ball.

1583.words: astronaut (noun): a person in a sealed suit who travels in space
1583.asset_description: An astronaut in a white spacesuit floats away from the viewer through black space, reaching one hand toward a glowing blue spiral galaxy.

1792.words: build (verb): to make something by combining parts
1792.asset_description: An old engraving of many muscular workers carrying bricks, beams and tools in the foreground while a huge round tower rises behind them.

1991.words: type (verb): to write using a keyboard
1991.asset_description: A painterly bearded man in a green suit sits at a desk typing on a computer keyboard under a small desk lamp, seen from the side against a colorful blurred wall.

2123.words: factory (noun): a building where machines make things
2123.asset_description: Enormous brass steampunk machinery fills a narrow street: towers of pipes, tanks, wheels and ladders rising several stories high, with a tiny figure at the bottom for scale.

2967.words: vet (noun): a doctor who treats animals
2967.asset_description: A bright cartoon of a smiling woman in green scrubs with a stethoscope round her neck, resting her hand on a happy tan French bulldog that sits on a metal examination table.

3195.words: to work (verb): to do physical or mental work for a purpose
3195.asset_description: Blue-toned painting of a man in a shirt and tie sitting at an office desk late at night, holding a pen to his lips and studying a sheet of charts; a laptop, calculator, folders and more papers cover the desk, a clock hangs on the wall and a crescent moon shines through the window.

4049.words: load (noun): the weight that is carried
4049.asset_description: On a wide white-sand beach under a clear blue sky, a man in red shorts crouches between two tall stacks of turquoise sun loungers. He lifts both stacks at once onto his shoulders and walks across the sand carrying them, the loungers towering far above his head so only his legs and red shorts are visible beneath. He crosses the empty beach past parasols and the sea, then sets the whole load down and lines the loungers up in a row with the others.

4087.words: work (noun): activity done to make or do something
4087.asset_description: A series of shots of tabby cats dressed in grey business suits living a full office life. Two of them sit side by side on the blue seats of a commuter train between human passengers. One types at a laptop in an open-plan office, walled in by towering stacks of paper. Two stand chatting with paper cups by the coffee machine and the water cooler. Two sit at a boardroom table watching a bar-chart presentation on a projector screen. In the last shot a cat in striped pyjamas works on a laptop in bed at night, surrounded by scattered documents.
4087.transcript: As you can see, the Q3 projections are quite stable.

4320.words: plan (noun): a scale drawing of a building
4320.asset_description: A watercolour of a bright studio with tall windows. A man in a light blue shirt leans over a large wooden table covered with big sheets of technical drawings showing rooms and walls in fine line. He steadies a metal rule with one hand and draws along it with a yellow pencil. Rolled-up sheets, a second pencil, an eraser and an angled desk lamp lie on the table, and a small white card model of a flat-roofed house stands on a base board at the right.

4337.words: phone (verb): to get in touch with someone by telephone
4337.asset_description: An anime-style drawing of an office corridor with glass-walled meeting rooms. A young woman in a teal trouser suit hurries straight towards the camera with a mobile phone wedged between her ear and her shoulder, mouth open in mid-sentence. She clutches a stack of buff folders against her chest with one arm and balances a cardboard tray of four takeaway coffee cups on the other hand. Loose sheets of paper and pens fly out behind her, and two colleagues stand talking further down the corridor.

4349.words: guard (noun): a person who keeps watch over something
4349.asset_description: A young man in the red-and-yellow uniform of a surf rescue service — yellow shirt, red shorts and a yellow-and-red cap — runs down the wet sand towards the sea carrying a rescue board. He paddles out, gets to his feet and rides a clean green wave, crouching low with one arm out for balance, then drives up through the white water with spray flying around him. In the last shot he walks back out of the shallows straight at the camera, grinning, holding the tall yellow rescue board upright beside him; a yellow flag banner stands on the beach behind.

4366.words: job (noun): the main activity you do to earn money
4366.asset_description: A watercolour of a man at work in a bakery. He wears a flour-dusted apron over rolled-up sleeves and holds a long wooden peel with two golden loaves on the end, sliding them out of a glowing brick oven. Smoke drifts up, baguettes hang from a rail, finished rolls sit on the shelves behind him and sacks of flour stand below. He is smiling as he works.

4425.words: order (verb): to direct somebody to do something with authority
4425.asset_description: A comic book style drawing of a meeting room high in a futuristic city. A tall robot in a business suit leans right over a glass table, one metal hand slammed flat on the surface hard enough to send a cracking flash out from under it, the other arm flung out pointing at the screen on the wall behind him. His visor glows and his mouth is set in a hard grin. A cup has been knocked over and a pen has bounced into the air. Around the table three other robots shrink back, hands raised to their heads, glowing tablets in front of them.

4426.asset_description: A woman in a navy trouser suit stands at a whiteboard covered in hand drawn line graphs and pie charts and points at one rising red line while a colleague listens from the table. She turns and walks down the long glass walled room to a table where six colleagues sit with laptops and folders. She leans across the table, hands over a red folder and shakes a colleague's hand. Finally she stands at the head of the table with her arms folded, smiling into the camera while the team works behind her.

4455.words: site (noun): the piece of land where something is located
4455.asset_description: A drawn scene of a piece of open ground where a house is going up. Metal scaffolding poles rise on the left over a half-built brick wall, a concrete mixer turns on its stand, and two wheelbarrows full of wet mortar stand on the bare earth. In the middle a man in an orange hard hat and a yellow high-visibility vest kneels on the ground, spreading mortar with a trowel and setting a brick into place, with a spirit level lying along the top of the courses and a stack of spare bricks beside him.

4504.words: success (noun): an event that achieves its intended purpose
4504.asset_description: An open-plan office where a team has just hit its target. On a big wall screen a dashboard shows a figure ending in 000, and a man and a woman in front of it throw their arms out at each other in delight. Confetti bursts from the ceiling over the desks; the whole team jumps up from their laptops, high-fives across the tables and hugs, balloons bounce around the room, and at the end they lift a colleague up on their arms while everyone cheers.

4512.words: list (noun): an ordered set of names or items
4512.asset_description: A young warehouse worker in an orange hi-vis vest, with a pencil behind his ear, holds a clipboard with a printed sheet of rows and boxes on it. He works down the sheet with a red pen, putting a tick in one box after another as he compares it with the cardboard boxes coming past him on a roller conveyor. He then walks along the aisle between tall racks of pallets, reaching up to the boxes on a shelf and marking his sheet again, with forklifts moving in the background.

4637.words: destroy (verb): to cause the destruction of something
4637.asset_description: A woman in a white hard hat and a yellow high-visibility jacket stands behind a red-and-white barrier and films herself in front of a red brick building. Behind her an excavator with a large claw tears at the top floor of the building; clouds of dust rise and bricks and beams fall into a growing heap of rubble. By the end the upper part of the house has gone and she holds up her phone showing the collapse.

4714.words: expert (noun): a person with special knowledge or skill
4714.asset_description: An elderly man in a tweed waistcoat and bow tie sits at a table in a hall full of onlookers, handling a painted porcelain vase in white cotton gloves. He lifts it up and tips it to look at its base, then screws a small brass eyeglass into his eye socket and studies the flowers painted on the side from a few centimetres away, turning the vase slowly in his gloved hands. He sets it down on the table, looks up at the couple sitting opposite and tells them what he has found while the crowd of older visitors behind him leans in, mouths open.

4726.words: farmer (noun): a person who operates a farm
4726.asset_description: An older man in a flat cap, checked shirt and rubber boots works his vegetable plot at sunset beside a sunflower field. He bends down and pulls carrots out of the dark soil by their green tops, then throws handfuls of grain out across a freshly seeded bed. He carries a wooden crate along the rows while a dog runs past, and finally stands behind a wooden hand cart loaded with cabbages, marrows and a crate of carrots, smiling and giving a thumbs up.
