4746.words: photographer (noun): someone who takes photos as their job
4746.asset_description: A viewing spot at the end of an airport runway under a bright blue sky, with a row of parked airliners on the apron behind. Two men stand on a low concrete wall with big white telephoto lenses on tripods, one crouched behind his camera with his eye to the viewfinder, tracking a jumbo jet as it comes in to land; a third watches beside them. A young man with bleached hair in a denim jacket leans back in the foreground filming himself and staring straight up. The aircraft passes directly overhead, so low that its whole underside, four engines and lowered landing gear fill the frame, while the photographers swing their lenses up to follow it and the man raises one finger and points at it.

4767.words: gardener (noun): a person who looks after a garden
4767.asset_description: A woman in a wide straw hat, white shirt and a denim work apron with tools in the pockets clips a round clipped bush with a pair of long shears in a formal park garden. She works her way along a row of the round bushes, then swaps the shears for a metal watering can and pours a fan of water over a long bed of pink and white flowers. She finishes walking down the gravel path between the clipped bushes towards the camera, smiling, shears in her gloved hand.

4842.words: to work (verb): to do physical or mental work for a purpose
4842.asset_description: A woman in a blue t-shirt stands at a white kitchen sink with the tap running hard into the basin. Cut to a workshop, where a woman in dark overalls kneels on a sawdust-covered floor and drives a cordless drill into the leg of a wooden chair. Then a pair of hands on a grey table hold an opened blue phone with its back off, the battery and circuit board exposed. A teenager in a checked shirt leans over the engine bay of an old blue car in a driveway with a spanner, and finally he punches the air and shouts beside the open bonnet.

4856.words: teacher (noun): a person whose job is teaching
4856.asset_description: A woman with glasses and a pencil in her bun sits at a desk in an empty classroom marking a pupil's paper with a red pen. She corrects sheet after sheet and stacks of marked papers rise on the desk until towers of paper wall her in and she looks up, overwhelmed.

4857.words: worker (noun): a person who works at a job
4857.asset_description: A man in a yellow hi-vis vest and white gloves stands in a warehouse holding a handheld barcode scanner. He frowns at it, shakes it, then scans the label on a cardboard box and a red VERIFIED stamp appears; he goes on scanning boxes moving along a long conveyor belt between tall storage racks.

4911.words: owner (noun): someone who owns a business
4911.asset_description: A blonde woman holds up a ring of keys in front of her face and smiles behind them. She pushes open the glass door of a small cafe that still has a CLOSED sign hanging on it and steps inside. She ties a grey apron behind her neck over her white shirt, then walks along the wooden counter past the espresso machine and the pastry display case, spreads her arms to show the room, and laughs with her hands raised in the empty cafe that is now hers.

4938.words: waitress (noun): a woman who serves food to guests in a restaurant
4938.asset_description: On a sunny café terrace a young woman in a white shirt and striped apron carries plates between wooden tables where guests are sitting. A couple at a table laugh and raise their coffee cups. She walks to a table by the railing and sets down a plate of dessert. A close shot shows a hand writing an order in a spiral notepad with a pencil, next to a cappuccino and a jar of white flowers. She turns to the camera and smiles, a pencil stuck in her hair.

4941.words: firefighter (noun): a person whose job is putting out fires
4941.asset_description: A young firefighter in full turnout gear slides down the brass pole of a fire station and walks out past the bay doors in helmet and jacket. Outside, an extension ladder leans against a tree with a ginger cat sitting on a branch; the firefighter climbs it, lifts the cat down and hands it to a relieved man waiting below. The clip ends with the firefighter smiling in front of the red fire engine while the man holds the cat.

4978.asset_description: A young street-food cook works a wok at a night market stall: a huge column of flame leaps from the pan as he tosses fried rice, he cracks an egg into the wok and stirs it with a ladle, flips the pan into another burst of fire, then plates the rice with a fried egg on top and satay skewers beside it and spreads his arms proudly behind the finished plate.

4979.words: office (noun): a place of business where people do office work
4979.asset_description: An open-plan office full of desks, monitors and desk phones: a man in a blue shirt coughs into his hand at his desk, a colleague standing behind him coughs too, a woman at another desk looks unwell while a colleague reaches over with a pen, and further down the room two more women blow their noses into tissues at their screens while everyone else keeps working.

5058.words: postman (noun): a person whose job is to bring letters to houses
5058.asset_description: A teenage boy in a navy hoodie walks up to a black roadside mailbox, pulls the flap down and finds it empty, pulls a face and walks off. A postman in a blue postal uniform and cap, with a mail bag over his shoulder, comes along the street and pushes a bundle of letters into the same box. The boy comes running back delighted, opens it again and hauls out a thick stack of envelopes and a brown parcel.

5062.words: boss (noun): a person who is in control of workers
5062.asset_description: A woman in a burgundy trouser suit strides through a busy open-plan office carrying a tablet, pointing and giving instructions to people at their desks. She stops beside a seated colleague and shows him something on the tablet screen. Next she stands at a whiteboard in front of four colleagues and draws a rising line graph with a blue marker, explaining it and pointing at the peak. Finally she stands among the desks, hands on the tablet, talking to the room while everyone works at their screens.

5126.words: business (noun): a company and the people who work in it
5126.asset_description: A loose watercolour and ink drawing of a small corner shop with a striped awning and a wide glass front full of shelves of goods. On the stone step in front of the open door a middle-aged man in a shirt, braces and work trousers laughs with his arms flung wide, a key held in one raised hand, as if showing off the place he owns. A geranium in a terracotta pot stands beside him on the pavement.

5251.words: type (verb): to write using a keyboard
5251.asset_description: An older woman with short white hair and red glasses sits behind a curved wooden reception counter in a busy open-plan office. She holds a corded telephone handset to her ear with one hand while her other hand moves over the keys of a keyboard on the counter in front of her. She then leans over an open ring notebook and writes in it with a pencil, still on the phone, and presses a rubber stamp down onto a sheet of paper. At the end she laughs and raises her hand to greet someone off camera. Behind her, colleagues work at desks with monitors and rows of files.

5291.words: businessman (noun): a man who works in business, often in a suit
5291.asset_description: Inside a full airliner cabin. A blonde woman sleeps slumped against the window with her mouth open, then the shot pans back through the rows: a bearded man in a suit sleeps with a grey neck pillow, a man in a hoodie sleeps behind him, and further back rows of men in suits and jackets doze in their seats down the length of the dim cabin.

5330.words: spy (noun): a person who secretly finds out information
5330.asset_description: At a Paris pavement cafe a man in a beige trench coat, straw hat and dark sunglasses sits at a small round table behind a wide-open newspaper with a cup of coffee in front of him. A long black camera lens pushes through a torn hole in the middle of the newspaper and points down the street; he leans out from behind a lamppost to take another photograph, then hides the camera behind the paper again. A waiter in a waistcoat and tie walks up behind him and stands watching over his shoulder.

238.words: steal (verb): to take something that is not yours
238.asset_description: Doorbell camera footage shows a delivery man in a yellow hi-vis vest jogging up the path to drop off a package next to a crate of drink cans on the doorstep. Instead of just leaving it, he pulls a can out of the customer's pack for himself and sprints away down the path with it.

1167.words: lawyer (noun): a person whose job is to practice law
1167.asset_description: A man in a dark suit and tie stands in an office lined with shelves of matching law books, holding an open case folder and gesturing as he speaks.

1256.words: police officer (noun): a person in uniform who makes people obey the law
1256.asset_description: A smiling police officer in a black uniform, peaked cap and gloves stands on a shopping street and points the way with an outstretched arm.

1266.words: president (noun): the leader of a country or a big company
1266.asset_description: A grey-haired woman in a suit gives a passionate speech at a wooden podium with a raised fist, flanked by tall flags while a crowd of press photographers fires camera flashes at her.

1434.words: thief (noun): a person who steals things
1434.asset_description: A masked man dressed in black hangs from a chandelier clutching a loot bag while, below him, a caped singer performs at a microphone and costumed guests dance.

1545.words: queen (noun): a woman who rules a country, or a king's wife
1545.asset_description: An ornate vintage illustration of a red-haired queen in a jeweled gown and huge white lace ruff, wearing a crown and holding a golden scepter in front of a heraldic patterned wall.

1655.words: crown (noun): a gold ring worn on the head by a king or queen
1655.asset_description: An old engraving of a woman wearing a tall golden crown and holding a scepter, with a child on her lap resting a hand on a globe; rays of light shine behind them.

1695.words: gun (noun): a weapon that fires a bullet at high speed
1695.asset_description: Digital painting of a young woman in a dark backless outfit standing in purple smoke, holding a gun pointed down at her side.

1731.words: arrow (noun): the thin feathered stick you shoot from a bow
1731.asset_description: A poster-style painting of a Joan-of-Arc-like figure in a white robe holding a banner on a battlefield while several arrows fly past and pierce the flag, with rows of spears behind.

1911.words: princess (noun): the daughter of a king or queen
1911.asset_description: A digital painting of a young royal woman with blond-and-black hair pinned up with a gold ornament, wearing a lace choker and a dark blue gown.

2128.words: shoot (verb): to hit something with a missile from a weapon
2128.asset_description: Ancient-Egyptian-style illustration of a pharaoh riding a war chariot pulled by a rearing horse, drawing his bow to shoot an arrow, with hieroglyphs above.

2318.words: sword (noun): a long metal blade with a handle for fighting
2318.asset_description: An anime-style painting of a young woman in a blue kimono gripping a long curved sword in front of her; her hair and robes swirl inside a rush of splashing blue water.

3240.words: to shout (verb): to speak in a loud voice
3240.asset_description: Grainy screenprint-style poster of a man in a dark suit and tie standing in front of a huge red and black target; he holds a megaphone up over his face and shouts into it, and the black paint drips down the background.

4122.words: rob (verb): to take something by force from its owner
4122.asset_description: A flat cartoon in stick-figure style. Behind a service counter a plain white figure stands with a clipboard in front of him. Through the window behind him a black masked figure smashes the glass, and shards fall on the floor. The masked figure climbs in, points a revolver over the counter and shouts at the clerk, who stares back without moving. After the clerk answers him, the masked figure lowers the gun, turns away and walks back out through the broken window, past the parked cars in the street, leaving the shattered glass and the untouched counter behind.
4122.transcript: Nobody move! Give me all your money! Where's the vault? We don't have one. Then what do you keep here? Samples. Sorry. Wrong bank.

4217.words: police (noun): the force of police officers
4217.asset_description: A corgi drives a small green go-kart straight down the middle of a quiet suburban street of brick houses, its tongue hanging out and its paws up on the steering wheel. Behind it a white police car with POLICE across the bonnet chases it with its blue and red lights flashing, getting closer and closer until it fills the shot right behind the kart, while the corgi keeps driving without looking back.

4331.words: march (noun): walking with regular steps in a procession
4331.asset_description: A low camera on a road looks up at columns of cadets in dark green dress uniforms with gold trim, red stripes and white gloves, all stepping forward in perfect time down the centre line of a city street. A woman officer leads one column. The camera then pulls back to show the columns filling a wide boulevard between tall buildings, with drummers carrying side drums at the front. In the last shots a crowd stands packed behind metal barriers on the pavement, waving white, blue and red flags and clapping as the columns pass.

4576.words: count (verb): to find out the number or amount of something
4576.asset_description: A large hall with long tables covered in stacks of paper. A young woman in a green sari with a lanyard sits at one table, a pen in her hand, lifting sheet after sheet off a tall stack and marking a tally sheet on a clipboard in front of her. The camera pulls back to show dozens of people down both sides of the tables doing the same, each behind their own towers of paper, with observers standing along the walls. At the end she raises a hand in the air.

4623.words: vote (noun): a choice made by counting people in favor
4623.asset_description: A cartoon of an election count. A tall wooden ballot box painted in red, white and blue stripes is tipped on its side above a long wooden trestle table, and folded paper slips pour out of it onto the tabletop. A heap of the slips has already built up in the middle and more flutter through the air. Smiling officials in suits and hats stand along both sides of the table with their hands out, ready to spread the pile and sort it. Behind a rope barrier a crowd of onlookers watches, and banners hang on the brick wall above them.

4730.words: committee (noun): a special group chosen to consider a matter
4730.asset_description: A photograph taken from above of nine people in business suits seated around a large round wooden conference table in a formal wood-panelled room. Small national flags of different countries stand on the table in front of empty places, each beside a folder and a sheet of paper. The nine lean in from all sides of the table and stack their hands together in the middle, talking as they do it, while a loose sheet of paper falls through the air over the table.

4927.words: lawyer (noun): a person whose job is to practice law
4927.asset_description: A tall stack of thick hardback volumes sits on a polished wooden table in front of floor-to-ceiling shelves of matching legal books. A woman with a low ponytail in a navy suit and white shirt smiles to one side. She stands behind the table and lifts a black leather briefcase onto it with both hands. Outside, seen from behind, she climbs the wide stone steps of a courthouse with loose papers under one arm and the briefcase in her hand. At the top she shakes hands with a man in a dark suit, smiling.

4983.words: officer (noun): a person who holds a position of authority
4983.asset_description: At a mountain border crossing a man in a light blue uniform with rank stars on his shoulders and white gloves opens a passport and studies the photo page. At a metal table he shines a small torch into an open suitcase and lifts out the folded clothes one by one. He then walks along the side of a camper van with a gloved hand on the bodywork, lies flat on the road to shine his torch underneath it, and slides back out beside a clipboard while a second man in the same uniform works behind him.

4988.words: attack (noun): a military move against an enemy with weapons
4988.asset_description: A crowd of medieval re-enactors in helmets and tunics pours down a long grassy field toward a camp of white canvas tents. A man in full plate armour runs at the front holding a tall blue banner, and hundreds of fighters with shields and spears follow him downhill while spectators watch from behind ropes at the top of the field.

5010.words: king (noun): a man who rules a kingdom
5010.asset_description: In a stone hall lined with guards in bearskin hats, a man in a red velvet robe walks up a red carpet to a golden throne. He sits down and a gold crown is placed on his head, then he strides back through the hall smiling. He steps onto a castle balcony above a huge crowd and raises his arms while the crowd cheers below the towers and flags.

5136.words: debate (noun): a discussion with reasons for and against
5136.asset_description: A wood-panelled debating chamber with green leather benches. A man in a dark suit stands up on a bench, arm outstretched, arguing loudly across the floor. On the benches opposite, rows of seated politicians shout back and wave sheets of paper in the air. A public gallery runs above, and a brass despatch box sits on the table in the foreground.

5143.words: peace (noun): the state of having no war
5143.asset_description: A stained-glass panel in strong leaded colours. Two soldiers in helmets and different uniforms - one in green, one in grey - lean towards each other over a churned strip of ground and shake hands, their heads bowed. Both of their rifles are stuck muzzle-down in the earth in front of them. Above their joined hands a large white dove flies out of a burst of blue and yellow light with a green sprig in its beak. Behind them are broken fence posts and green fields, and red, blue and purple wildflowers grow out of the bare soil in the foreground.

5224.words: royal (adjective): belonging to a king or queen
5224.asset_description: A heavy-set king in a gold crown and a crimson fur-trimmed cape sits on a carved wooden throne in a stone castle hall, holding a golden sceptre; servants carry a tray of goblets and food to him past armoured guards. Musicians in doublets sit on the steps below his throne playing lutes and a drum for him. The shot then cuts to a vast cathedral seen from behind the throne, where hundreds of people in medieval dress line the nave and, in the last seconds, all bow low to him at once.

5299.words: illegal (adjective): not allowed by law or the rules
5299.asset_description: An elderly woman in a headscarf pushes a checked suitcase onto the belt at an airport checkpoint while a long queue waits behind her. An officer in uniform opens the case and it is packed with sausages, cheese and jars of pickles - none of it allowed through. On the scanner monitor the outline of a chicken leg shows up inside the bag. The officer holds the case open and speaks to her while she clutches a jar and looks up at him.

5456.words: permission (noun): approval that lets you do something
5456.asset_description: A young man in a grey shirt sits at an outdoor counter under palm trees with a passport, an envelope and printed forms in front of him, pressing his hands together hopefully. Inside an airport terminal he then holds the passport open to a page with his photo on it, eyes wide. He steps up to an officer beside a metal detector, who reaches out for the document, and finally he walks through the gateway grinning and holding up a small card.

50.words: jar (noun): a small glass pot with a lid
50.asset_description: A black-gloved hand pipes thick swirls of pastel whipped body-butter cream from a piping bag into small clear jars on a white table; rows of already-filled jars stand in the background.

447.words: lip balm (noun): a stick of cream that keeps your mouth soft
447.asset_description: On a snowy winter street, a woman with a coffee cup winces at her cracked dry lips, then rubs a lip balm stick over them and smiles because they feel smooth again. She hands the stick to her friend, who tries it too.

457.words: makeup (noun): creams and colours put on the face to look good
457.asset_description: A woman in a satin robe sits at a lit vanity mirror with a big eyeshadow palette. A makeup artist dips a brush into the colors, sweeps blush over her cheeks and shadow onto her eyelids, and they admire the glowing finished look in the mirror.

492.words: nail polish (noun): coloured paint for your fingernails
492.asset_description: At a sunny patio table with iced drinks, a woman shakes a bottle of coral nail polish, opens it and carefully paints her fingernails with the little brush. She blows on the wet nails and waves her hand stiffly, refusing to touch anything while her friend teases her.

546.words: perfume (noun): a liquid with a nice smell you put on your skin
546.asset_description: In an ornate Moroccan-style courtyard at night, a young woman sprays perfume from a small amber bottle onto her wrist and neck, then playfully sprays big clouds of it at her friend, who laughs, waves the mist away and finally gives a thumbs up.
546.transcript: Smells amazing. Too much, too much.

574.words: powder (noun): a very fine dry dust, like flour or makeup
574.asset_description: A woman dips a fat makeup brush into a clear jar of loose face powder and taps it, sending up a visible dusty cloud - "A whole cloud!" - which makes her friend gasp. She then gently brushes the powder over the friend's cheeks and nose and declares her "All set".

688.words: skin (noun): the outer layer that covers your body
688.asset_description: A young woman does her skincare routine: she pats cream onto her face in the bathroom, pumps lotion into her palm and rubs it along her arms, then finishes on a balcony stroking her glowing cheeks.

1785.words: beautiful (adjective): delighting the senses, very nice to look at
1785.asset_description: A stylized portrait of a young woman with big curly blonde hair, deep red lips and silver jewelry, resting her hand under her chin and gazing upward.

2152.words: lipstick (noun): colour you paint on your lips
2152.asset_description: Bold vector portrait of a woman with windblown black hair and closed eyes, her bright red lipstick the only color on her face, against a big red circle.

4211.words: cheek (noun): either side of the face below the eyes
4211.asset_description: A hamster in a fluffy pink bow headband goes through a skincare routine at a white bathroom basin. It drinks through a straw from a pink tumbler, presses the pump of a yellow soap bottle, then washes and pats its face with both paws. It takes a cotton pad from a blue TONER PAD box, squeezes drops from a pink Facial Serum pipette over its head, and finishes by pressing both paws into its round cheeks, with two drops of serum still sitting on them.

32.words: word (noun): a group of letters that has a meaning
32.asset_description: A couple on a couch films themselves playing a word game: a letter B pops up on screen, they think hard, pull faces and race to shout words that start with B, cheering and celebrating after each answer.
32.transcript: We play a word game. Say a word fast. Barber. Bowling!

40.words: answer (noun): what you say or write back to a question
40.asset_description: A woman spreads a deck of white cards into a fan on the table, asks a question, and draws one card as her answer; it reads 'You have to wait' and she stares at the camera in annoyed disbelief.
40.transcript: I ask a question. The card gives me my answer. Really? Again?

775.words: thinking (noun): using your mind to work something out
775.asset_description: A man at an outdoor chess table frowns at the board, strokes his chin, taps his temple and even stands up and paces while his amused opponent waits. At last the idea comes, he makes his move and both players react excitedly.
775.transcript: Wait, wait, almost... There it is!

1489.words: fairy (noun): a small magic person with wings from stories
1489.asset_description: A blonde woman in a white dress with big glowing transparent wings sits on dark moss at night; a green frog sits beside her.

1618.words: angel (noun): a holy winged being that protects people
1618.asset_description: Black-and-white religious engraving: a robed figure with a halo rises above the clouds holding a banner, while winged angels float on both sides of him and a crowd of people kneels below.

1689.words: jesus (noun): the central figure of the Christian faith
1689.asset_description: Colour-tinted illustration of a bearded long-haired man in a long white robe standing barefoot on rocks in front of a dark cave opening, arms spread wide.

1849.words: magic (noun): power that makes impossible things happen
1849.asset_description: A dark fantasy portrait of a blue-skinned woman in a white lace hood, a glowing magic light bursting from her chest while a neon insect fairy hovers beside her over red sparks.

1853.words: dragon (noun): a huge scaly beast from old stories
1853.asset_description: A neon glitch-art portrait of a woman's face in blue and pink; beside her a small white dragon breathes a jet of fire inside a pink neon triangle.

1857.words: easter (noun): the spring holiday when Christians remember Jesus
1857.asset_description: A flat gold-and-black Easter poster: Jesus with open arms in front of a dark hill with three crosses and a huge golden sun, with the words 'HE IS RISEN' above.

2010.words: story (noun): a tale about people and events
2010.asset_description: An open book lies on a desk between library shelves, and a glowing magical forest with sparkling lights rises out of its pages toward the ceiling.

2278.words: look up (phrase): to raise your eyes to see something above
2278.asset_description: A softly painted portrait of a bearded long-haired man in a pale robe with his chin lifted and his eyes turned upwards, surrounded by clouds of pink, orange and purple colour.

2394.words: choose (verb): to pick one thing from several choices
2394.asset_description: A small dark figure stands at night where a glowing road splits into looping winding branches across misty green fields, with a painted arrow on the asphalt and a moonbeam shining down ahead.

2579.asset_description: A retro collage of a woman in an orange patterned turtleneck with a coiled robot neck, wearing a huge vintage machine with two round speakers over her eyes, against a pink cosmic sky.

2694.words: think (verb): to use your mind to form ideas
2694.asset_description: The side profile of a young woman against a black background, head tilted down and one index finger resting on her lower lip, with glowing pink, blue and green neon lines running through her long hair.

2973.words: idea (noun): a new thought about what to do
2973.asset_description: A dark blue graphic illustration of an open hand reaching upwards, with a bright yellow light bulb glowing and shooting out rays just above the fingertips; faint circuit lines run over the wrist.

3049.words: question (noun): something you ask to get an answer
3049.asset_description: Simple black ink sketch of a boy resting his chin on his hand with a puzzled face; a big blue speech bubble with a white question mark floats above his head.

3052.words: to think (verb): to use your head to work something out
3052.asset_description: Soft anime-style painting of a red-haired boy at a school desk, chin on his hand, staring up out of the window with an open exercise book in front of him; a big empty thought cloud floats above his head.

3311.words: tunnel (noun): a passage cut under the ground for traffic
3311.asset_description: Dramatic painted illustration of a barefoot woman in a white dress walking away from the viewer into a huge swirling tunnel of rock and cloud, with lightning on the walls and a bright light glowing at the far end.

4399.words: dream (verb): to have a daydream or fantasy
4399.asset_description: At dusk a woman in a denim jacket stands at a lit bus-stop panel showing a giant cheeseburger, her mouth open and her hand on the glass as if she could eat it. From a car window a billboard slides past against an orange sunset, showing a big white house with palm trees and a pool. Then at night she stands alone in Times Square with her arms out, looking up at a stack of glowing screens advertising burgers and perfume.

4654.words: doubt (noun): the state of being unsure
4654.asset_description: In a bright flat a woman stares hard at a wooden shelf that has just been screwed to the white wall, her brow furrowed and her mouth twisted in disbelief. Behind her a man holding a screwdriver smiles and gestures at his work. She raises a white mug, edges it slowly onto the shelf and lets go, watching to see if it holds. The shelf holds the mug; she steps back, folds her arms and looks at it sideways, still unconvinced.

4824.words: pretend (verb): to make believe something is real
4824.asset_description: A girl in full equestrian competition kit - black show jacket, white breeches, tall black boots and a riding helmet - gallops on her own two legs across the sand of an indoor riding arena, holding a stuffed hobby horse on a stick between her knees as if she were riding it. She is laughing, and a wooden pole lies on the sand behind her.

4854.words: solve (verb): to find the solution to a problem
4854.asset_description: A young man with wild hair and glasses stands at a huge blackboard in a university lecture hall full of students. He writes chalk equations fast, checks a pocket calculator, keeps writing, punches the air, and by the end the entire wall-sized blackboard is filled with mathematics while he stands back in front of it.

4855.words: remember (verb): to recall something from your memory
4855.asset_description: A young man in glasses with headphones round his neck sits at a desk holding small word cards. He taps his temple, reads a card, flips it over and drops it, and the cards multiply until the desk is buried and the wall behind him is papered with them.

4862.words: choose (verb): to pick one thing from several choices
4862.asset_description: At a busy outdoor market a woman in a headwrap holds up two apples, one in each hand, then puts them on the two pans of a brass balance to see which she wants. She does the same with two melons, then two sacks on a market scale, and finally two huge pumpkins on a wooden beam that tips to one side.
4862.transcript: Hmm, this one or this one?

4863.words: plan (noun): a series of steps to reach a goal
4863.asset_description: In an office a woman sticks a green sticky note onto a square of a huge wall calendar, then sits and writes in a colour-tabbed planner. She adds more notes to the calendar, and the wall grows into an enormous grid covered with hundreds of coloured notes while she stands with her hands on her hips looking up at it.

4872.words: rating (noun): a score showing the value of something
4872.asset_description: A woman in a leather cap and khaki jacket sits at a table set with small bowls of food, holding a clipboard and a pen. She stamps rows of stars onto small white cards with a rubber stamp and holds one up, wide-eyed. The table fills with dozens of cards each showing five stars, some black and some gold. The final wide shot reveals the table and the whole wall behind her covered with hundreds of identical five-star cards.

4975.words: different (adjective): unlike something else in nature or quality
4975.asset_description: A tide of commuters in grey and navy suits with briefcases crosses a street between glass office towers; in the middle of them walks one young woman in a bright turquoise coat, red beret, yellow headphones and yellow boots, the only colour in the crowd. She perches on a concrete bollard while the suits stream past behind her, sips an orange juice and smiles into the camera.

5028.words: difficult (adjective): not easy, needing a lot of effort to do
5028.asset_description: In a wood-panelled courtroom a man in a grey suit heaves armfuls of heavy leather-bound volumes onto the bench beside a set of brass scales and a gavel, and the pile keeps growing. A close shot shows one thick book lying open on the stack, its pages dense with tiny print, with rows of seated people behind it. In the last shot the stack has become a tower taller than the people, the judge sits beside it and the whole room stands staring.

5131.words: focus (verb): to direct your attention on something
5131.asset_description: A pen-and-ink drawing of a narrow alley between old brick houses. A young man in a shalwar kameez swings a cricket bat at a tennis ball that is right in front of the bat face; his eyes are locked on the ball and his brow is furrowed. Boys sit on a wall behind him watching, another man watches from a doorstep, tangled electric wires cross overhead and dust puffs up around his feet.

5206.words: evidence (noun): your reason for belief or disbelief
5206.asset_description: In a library aisle a young woman in glasses builds an investigation board on a cork wall: she pins up notes and photographs, links them with red string, gasps as something clicks, flips through a sheaf of papers with a pen in her mouth, and steps back to look at the finished web of pinned pages, printed photos and sticky notes. Bookshelves, a laptop and stacks of books and papers surround her.

5361.words: easy (adjective): needing little effort, not difficult
5361.asset_description: A woman in a striped top stands in a hallway with a small teal hard-shell cabin case, pulling its handle up, then heaves a much bigger navy soft suitcase down next to it and gestures at the two. The shot cuts to an airport hall where she is pushing a trolley loaded with six stacked suitcases in different colours, leaning into it with a strained face while the top case tips off the pile.

5401.words: wonder (verb): to want to know something
5401.asset_description: A black-and-white montage of five people puzzling over something they want to figure out: a young woman in a kitchen holds a pen against her chin and stares upward with a frown; a man at a chess board in a library hovers his hand over a piece; a teenager in a hoodie presses a hand over his eyes; a student in a jumper bites her pen over an open notebook; finally a young woman at a kitchen table gasps with delight and starts writing on her papers.

25.words: stapler (noun): a tool that joins papers with small metal clips
25.asset_description: A retro cartoon office worker taps a stack of pages, staples them with his red stapler, then faces an absurdly tall tower of paper; he reloads the stapler with fresh staples, works through the pile and triumphantly lifts the stapled stack overhead.

210.words: customer (noun): a person who buys things in a shop
210.asset_description: In an electronics store a woman compares two boxed headphones, unboxes and tries on the white pair with delight, then takes them to the counter where the cashier bags them and she pays by card.

268.words: envelope (noun): a paper cover you put a letter in
268.asset_description: By candlelight two women fold a handwritten letter and slide it into a cream paper envelope. They drip red sealing wax on the flap, press a stamp into it and admire the sealed envelope, one giving it a kiss.

344.words: gold (noun): a precious yellow metal worth a lot
344.asset_description: An animated jeweler in a plum suit lifts a heavy gold bar onto her counter, polishes it until it shines and admires her reflection in it, then drapes a gold chain and slips on gold bangles, hugging the bar possessively.

527.words: parcel (noun): a box or package sent by post
527.asset_description: A courier in a yellow vest hands a surprised red-haired woman a brown paper parcel tied with string at her garden gate; she carries it to the front door, shakes it curiously while a man watches, then opens the box and pulls out the tissue-wrapped contents excitedly.

604.words: receipt (noun): a piece of paper that shows what you paid
604.asset_description: In a hand-painted village grocery, a cashier rings up a man's basket of fruit and the old register prints an endless receipt that spirals around his body; he studies the huge list, then rolls it up and pockets it.
604.transcript: Oh, dear. Sorry. It's still going. Here, keep it, please.

731.words: stamp (noun): a small sticker you put on a letter to post it
731.asset_description: On a sunny Indian street, a man peels one flower stamp off a full sheet, sticks it onto the corner of an envelope, and a woman then drops the letter into a red pillar postbox with a crow perched on top.
731.transcript: This little thing sends it. Off you go.

738.words: sticky note (noun): a small square of paper you stick up as a reminder
738.asset_description: A man draws a lunchbox inside a heart on a pink sticky note, peels it off the pad and presses it onto the fridge door; his partner comes home, spots the pink square, smiles, and opens the fridge to find the packed lunchbox waiting.

857.words: wallet (noun): a small flat case for money and cards
857.asset_description: In a hand-painted anime town, a woman's brown wallet slips out of her bag onto the cobblestones. A man on a bicycle spots it, picks it up, checks the cards and coins inside and rides after her to return it at the fountain; she thanks him with a flower.
857.transcript: Hey! You dropped this! Oh no! Thank you! One flower then!

891.words: expensive (adjective): costing a lot of money
891.asset_description: Outside a hotel at night a young man in a yellow shirt is caught fiddling with the silver hood ornament of a light-blue Rolls-Royce; warned off-camera that the car is so expensive — about 400 grand — his eyes go wide, he points at the ornament in disbelief, then leans down and strokes the hood, apologizing to the car.
891.transcript: Hey! Don't touch that! This thing is so expensive. How much? Like 400 grand. Oh! Oh no, sorry baby.

916.words: atm (noun): the machine in the street that gives you cash
916.asset_description: On a rainy evening street, a woman in a dark coat stands at a cash machine set into a brick wall, wallet in one hand as she takes banknotes from the ATM slot, city lights blurred behind her.

1485.words: sell (verb): to give something in exchange for money
1485.asset_description: A white house behind a big 'House for Sale' sign planted on the green front lawn.

1885.words: rich (adjective): having a lot of money and material wealth
1885.asset_description: A vintage cartoon: a smug man labeled 'Monopoly' smokes on top of a huge tower of money bags marked with dollar signs while a small policeman labeled 'Law' shakes his fist far below.

2220.words: count (verb): to find out the number or amount of something
2220.asset_description: A bearded man in a dark vest sits at a table covered with banknotes, counting a stack of bills in his hands.

2559.words: coin (noun): a flat metal piece used as money
2559.asset_description: A glowing tree whose leaves are golden coins stands in a dark forest; coins spill off the branches through the air and cover the whole ground in a thick shining layer.

2818.words: money (noun): coins and paper notes you use to pay
2818.asset_description: A 3D-animated little girl with big curly hair and dungarees sits at a table completely covered in euro banknotes, more notes fluttering down through the air around her while she stares wide-eyed at the camera.

3040.words: pile (noun): a heap of things placed on top of each other
3040.asset_description: Cartoon illustration of a tired young man with messy hair and glasses sitting at a desk with a laptop and a mug; huge stacks of papers tower on the desk and on the floor around him, with more sheets pinned to the wall.

3200.words: letter (noun): a written message you send to a person
3200.asset_description: Thick-brushed painting of a writing desk seen from above: a big sheet of paper covered in handwriting lies in the middle with a black pen on it, surrounded by an open notebook, a pink book, an ink bottle, a jar of pencils, a coffee mug and a vase of leaves.

4041.words: buy (verb): to obtain something by paying for it
4041.asset_description: A couple walk hand in hand down the bright marble concourse of a shopping mall, she in a short gold dress and he in a white t-shirt and shorts. She stops in front of a lit shop window full of long evening gowns on mannequins and pulls him back towards it. Her face fills the frame with a hopeful, pleading look; his face follows, tight-lipped and reluctant. In the last shot the two of them walk out of the shop again, both loaded down with big paper carrier bags in each hand.

4243.words: pay (verb): to give money for goods or services
4243.asset_description: A black cat in a red apron works behind a street hot dog stand while a husky stands at the grill behind it turning sausages with tongs. A customer's hand holds a turquoise bank card out to the card reader on the counter. The cat lays a sausage into a long bun, then squeezes a zigzag of ketchup along it from a red bottle, and finally lifts the finished hot dog up to the camera.

4315.words: price (noun): the amount of money something is sold for
4315.asset_description: A woman in a beige trench coat walks through flats one after another. First a cramped room with a bed pushed against the wall, a boiler above it, a radiator and a small cooker by a narrow window. Then a small living room with a grey sofa and a balcony door, where she sits down and the caption 1,200 EUR appears over her. Finally she stands in a vast empty glass-walled floor high above a city, turning to look around with her mouth open as the caption 10,000 EUR appears.

4338.words: cash (noun): money in the form of bills or coins
4338.asset_description: A comic-style night scene in the rain. A wet grey cash machine is set into a concrete wall, its screen glowing pink and blue, a bank card sticking half out of the card slot at the top. A fan of banknotes is spraying out of the money slot in the middle of the machine, and one more note flutters away through the air on the left. A young woman in fingerless gloves reaches for the flying note with one hand while her other hand rests on the keypad. Behind her the wet street reflects neon city lights.

4339.words: bank (noun): a financial institution that keeps and lends money
4339.asset_description: A woman in a beige blazer pushes a card into the slot of a cash machine on a busy street, then keys something in. The clip cuts to her walking up to a row of cash machines inside a bright hall, each set into the wall under its own lit sign, and then to a longer row of machines with different bank logos above them where travellers with suitcases stand waiting to use them. Finally she stands in front of one of the machines fanning a thick stack of banknotes in both hands, mouth open in delight.

4385.words: cost (verb): to be priced at a certain amount
4385.asset_description: A price comparison of three beds. First a caption reading €50 over a bare mattress lying on the carpet, where a young man flops down and curls up on it. Then €800 over an ordinary double bed with a colourful patterned duvet, where a woman sits up smiling. Finally €20,000 over a huge four-poster bed in a dark red room, where a man in a silk robe throws himself backwards onto the covers.

4495.words: cost (noun): the total spent for goods or services
4495.asset_description: A three-part comparison shot on a suburban street. A young man in a hoodie and jeans leans proudly on the roof of a rusty old brown car while the caption 500 EUR sits over it. Cut to a woman in a business suit unlocking a clean silver saloon, captioned 20,000 EUR. Cut to a red Ferrari with both butterfly doors standing wide open, and a man in a tailored suit strolling up to it, captioned 500,000 EUR.

4497.words: hand (verb): to place something into someone's hands
4497.asset_description: A soft illustration of a small village shop seen from the customer's side of the counter. A dark-haired young shop worker in a floral apron leans over the wooden counter and holds out a single coin between his fingers, while the customer's two open hands reach up from the bottom of the frame to take it. In his other hand he holds a jar he has just scanned. Behind him a conveyor belt carries apples, a pear, oranges and packets towards a paper grocery bag, and shelves of bottles and jars fill the wall.

4612.words: sell (verb): to give something in exchange for money
4612.asset_description: A busy street market. A moustached stallholder in a shirt and waistcoat stands behind a huge pyramid of peaches and holds one up to a young customer, turning it in his fingers to show it off. The customer leans in over the fruit. The vendor then piles peaches into a cardboard box and hands it across the stall. Brass hanging scales sway above the display, other stalls and shoppers fill the street behind.
4612.transcript: Oh, wow. For you, the best.

4968.words: card (noun): a card that shows your identity
4968.asset_description: In a busy public office a young woman with long red hair stands at a service counter, gasps with excitement and picks up a small plastic card that has just been issued to her. She turns it over, reads it, then holds it up beside her face so the photo on the card and her own face are seen together, gives a thumbs up, and the people waiting behind her clap.

5013.words: cheap (adjective): low in price, not costing much
5013.asset_description: Three kitchens are compared with a price caption over each one. First a frail old man stirs a pot on a single gas burner in a shabby room with peeling walls, captioned 500 euro. Then a woman in a bright white family kitchen pulls a tray of cookies out of the oven, captioned 10,000 euro. Last a man stands at the marble island of a glass-walled penthouse kitchen with the city skyline behind him, captioned 100,000 euro.

5014.words: rich (adjective): having a lot of money and material wealth
5014.asset_description: Three cooks in three very different kitchens. An old man in a vest tastes soup from a wooden spoon over a battered pot on a gas ring in a tiled, run-down room, then cracks an egg into it. A woman in a bright white kitchen lifts a baked cheesy dish out of the oven with oven gloves. Finally a man in a black turtleneck tosses peppers in a frying pan in a penthouse kitchen with copper pans hanging overhead and the night skyline in the windows, then spreads his arms wide.

5057.words: mail (noun): letters and packages sent by post
5057.asset_description: A soft watercolour of a girl on a village path at sunset. She reaches up and pulls open the flap of a big wooden mailbox on a tall post, and a fan of letters bursts out of it; more envelopes drift through the pink sky and one large envelope floats past the bottom of the frame. Hedges, a tiled cottage roof and a half-timbered house sit behind her.

5059.words: letter (noun): a written message you send to a person
5059.asset_description: A young man in a navy hoodie stands at a black roadside mailbox with its red flag up and pulls the front hatch open; the box is empty. A postal worker in a blue jacket and cap arrives and pushes a thick block of white envelopes and a brown parcel into the box, filling it completely. The man reaches back in, drags out the enormous stack of letters and holds it against his chest, mouth open in delight.

5139.words: blank (adjective): with nothing written or printed on it
5139.asset_description: A young man in an airport holds an open passport towards the camera and fans the pages: every page is plain white, with nothing on it. He grins, then hands the passport across an immigration counter where an officer's stamp and a screen sit. Later, at a table, he opens the same passport to show pages now crowded with coloured entry stamps and visas, before flicking through it again.

5248.words: rent (noun): a payment you make to use something
5248.asset_description: A young woman in a coral jacket rides a stand-up electric scooter along a sunlit seaside promenade, grinning at the camera with the blue sea and a stone breakwater behind her. She then stands beside a long rank of parked rental e-scooters at the water's edge, tapping her phone; a close-up over her shoulder shows the rental app open on the screen with a circular logo and a blue button. Finally a wide shot shows a palm-lined promenade with a dozen people riding hired e-scooters past the trees.

5309.asset_description: A woman in a grey blazer and glasses sits at her desk in a large open-plan office and looks down in surprise: a takeaway coffee cup and a wrapped pastry have appeared next to her keyboard. She picks up a small white card propped against them and holds it up — a smiley face is drawn on it in pen. She looks around over the top of her monitor at the rows of cubicles where her colleagues are working, then stands holding the coffee, scanning the room to work out who left it. She ends up back at her desk with the cup in both hands, smiling.

5425.words: deal (noun): a single instance of buying or selling
5425.asset_description: Outdoors in a sunny garden full of palms, a young woman in a teal blazer and a young man in a grey suit sit side by side at a long wooden table, each with an open document folder in front of them. A crowd of colleagues in business clothes stands packed behind their chairs. Two small desk flags, one teal and one orange, sit at the front edge of the table. Both sign their documents, the colleagues clap, and then the two stand up and shake hands.

5474.words: coin (noun): a flat metal piece used as money
5474.asset_description: A close shot shows a man's hands sliding a blue-green card out of a brown leather wallet beside a payment terminal with a glowing green ring in a shop. He looks up and smiles, holding the open wallet. At an open-air market he hands the card across crates of oranges, apples and plums to the stallholder while holding a paper bag. Then, over a wooden table, he holds a small brown coin purse upside down and a stream of coins pours out of it into a spreading heap. In the last shot he pushes the coins apart with one finger, sorting the copper and silver pieces on the table while the empty purse hangs in his other hand.

45.words: angry (adjective): feeling very mad and upset with someone
45.asset_description: A woman walks into a laundromat and finds her wet clothes thrown out of the machine onto the floor; she picks them up, then confronts the man who did it, glaring and shouting at him with a furious face.

101.words: bored (adjective): tired and unhappy because nothing is fun
101.asset_description: A young woman sits alone on a row of waiting-room chairs under a wall clock. She fiddles with her keys, sighs, stares at the ceiling and slowly slumps sideways in her seat as the wait drags on.

187.words: confused (adjective): not able to understand what is going on
187.asset_description: A young woman with big round glasses sits among flat-pack furniture parts, turning a huge instruction sheet around, holding up two boards that clearly do not match, and finally shrugging at the wobbly half-built shelf, asking "What?".

205.words: crying (noun): letting tears fall because you feel sad
205.asset_description: A couple sits on a couch under a blanket watching a sad film; the woman cries and wipes her tears with tissues, the man tears up too, and they end up hugging and smiling through the tears.
205.transcript: It's just so sad. I know, me too.

290.words: feeling (noun): an emotion, like joy or sadness
290.asset_description: In a crowded football fan pub, a woman watches a match with her hand pressed to her chest, going from nervous dread to closed-eyed tension. When the goal comes she erupts, screaming with joy and near tears as the whole bar celebrates around her.

362.words: happy (adjective): feeling good and full of joy
362.asset_description: A young woman in a green dress skips out of a shop and dances through a sunny Greek seaside street, laughing and greeting people, juggles a peach at a fruit stand, then sits by the harbor eating it and petting a dog, beaming the whole time.

391.words: hope (noun): a feeling that something good will happen
391.asset_description: A young woman stands barefoot on a harbor wall, shading her eyes and clasping her hands to her chest as she anxiously scans the sea; when a small fishing boat finally appears her worried face melts into joy and she throws her arms up.

431.words: lazy (adjective): not wanting to work or make any effort
431.asset_description: A man in pajamas lies sprawled on a couch next to snacks and refuses to get up; instead of standing he grabs a broom to drag the TV remote closer, then stretches his whole body off the couch to reach it with his fingertips.

453.words: lonely (adjective): sad because you are all alone
453.asset_description: A teenage boy sets down his tray and eats a plate of peas all by himself in a huge empty school cafeteria. He looks around asking if anyone is there, answers himself that it is just him, and the wide shot shows rows and rows of empty tables around him.

628.words: sadness (noun): the feeling of being unhappy
628.asset_description: A tearful woman in a green cardigan packs the books of her little bookshop into cardboard boxes, tapes one shut and looks around at the emptying shelves; overcome, she covers her mouth, hugs one last book to her chest and sinks to the floor crying among the boxes.

655.words: serious (adjective): not laughing or joking, calm and thoughtful
655.asset_description: A hand-drawn animated calligrapher keeps a stern, focused face while two friends try everything to distract her - popping up with party hats, horns and spoons over their eyes; she never smiles, paints one perfect brush stroke, and stares them down while they wilt.
655.transcript: Come on, smile! Not now. I'm working. Okay.

693.words: sleepy (adjective): tired and ready to fall asleep
693.asset_description: A woman with purple hair rides a night train: she yawns into her hands again and again, rubs her eyes, and slowly her head sinks against the window until she dozes off with a notebook on her lap.
693.transcript: (upbeat music) Oops. Just five more minutes.

695.words: smiling (noun): the act of turning up the corners of your mouth
695.asset_description: In a 2D cartoon, a glum woman on a sunny ferry rests her chin on her hand while an old sailor beams at her; her frown slowly melts into a wide smile until the whole bench of passengers is smiling and laughing together.

757.words: surprise (noun): something nice you did not expect
757.asset_description: On a rooftop terrace a man hands a woman a plain cardboard box; she opens it, gasps with her hands over her mouth, and lifts out a tiny puppy she was not expecting, hugging it with delight.

828.words: surprised (adjective): feeling shock at something unexpected
828.asset_description: Two young women sit with coffees at a marble table in a busy cafe; one listens and grins while the blonde makes a big surprised face with her mouth open, and they both burst out laughing.

1389.words: tear (noun): a drop of water that falls from your eye
1389.asset_description: A close-up of a woman's face in profile as she gazes out of a rain-flecked train window. Several tears run down her cheek and hang from her chin while she looks sad and lost in thought.

1589.asset_description: An abstract digital portrait of a pale figure with wild orange-and-white hair bowing its head, eyes downcast and mouth turned down, above a tangle of dark thorny strokes.

1675.words: alone (adjective): kept apart from others, on your own
1675.asset_description: A silhouette of a man standing alone next to a bare tree on an empty dark field, against a huge yellow and purple watercolor sky.

2529.words: gentle (adjective): kind, calm and soft in the way you act
2529.asset_description: A soft pastel portrait of a long-haired bearded man in flowing white and beige robes, eyes lowered with a gentle calm expression, framed by delicate flowers and thin golden halo rings.

2765.words: smile (verb): to spread your lips to show you are pleased
2765.asset_description: A glossy illustration of baby Krishna: a plump blue-skinned child with big brown eyes and a warm closed-lip smile, wearing a golden headband with peacock feathers and flowers, holding a small flute with a pink rose on it against his chest.

3489.asset_description: A woman in a bright orange off-shoulder dress, headscarf and white sunglasses sits in a yellow rowing boat on green water, laughing with her head back and a glass of sparkling wine in her hand.

4036.words: smile (noun): a face with the corners of the mouth turned up
4036.asset_description: By a resort swimming pool at sunset, a woman in a short gold dress poses with one hand in her hair while a man in a white vest crouches down to photograph her with his phone. The camera closes in on her face and she smiles broadly at the lens, showing her teeth, with gold hoop earrings and palm trees behind her. The two of them then lean together over the phone to look at the photos, laughing, and she gives a thumbs up. In the last shot she walks back towards the pool and he lifts the phone to take another picture.

4259.words: face (noun): the front of the head, from forehead to chin
4259.asset_description: A stop-motion woolly sheep with a curly white fleece, a fluffy tuft on its head and an orange knitted scarf stands against a bright blue sky dotted with white clouds. It starts with a flat, bored face and heavy eyelids, then opens its mouth wide in a shout that shows its square teeth. Its face settles into a hard frown, the eyebrows pulled down over the eyes, and the camera pushes in until only the scowling face fills the screen.

4263.words: admire (verb): to feel admiration for someone
4263.asset_description: Two small fluffy cartoon birds, one green and one blue, sit side by side on the shiny floor of a bright shop, eyes shut and bored. A tall pink bird with an enormous swept-up quiff struts past above them. Their eyes fly open and they follow her with a wide, dazzled stare, then turn to each other with a knowing, impressed look.

4275.words: complain (verb): to express displeasure or unhappiness
4275.asset_description: A shopping centre car park in bright sun. A white car has hit the rear side of a grey saloon, tearing a long crease through the wing and cracking the tail light, with black debris on the tarmac. An older woman in a light blue shirt grabs her head, shouts, and then keeps pointing and talking at the damage and at the young man beside her, while he crouches to photograph the torn panel with his phone and writes on a form propped on the other car's boot.

4316.words: sorry (adjective): feeling regret over something you did
4316.asset_description: An office desk by a window. A young man in a knitted vest and glasses sits with his head bowed low over the desk, holding a wrapped bunch of white and yellow tulips; a large brown puddle of spilled coffee covers the laptop keyboard beside him. He sits up, grimaces at the mess and points at himself as he speaks, then mops the keyboard with a cloth. A woman colleague comes and stands over him with her arms folded; he bows deeply and holds the tulips up to her, and she takes them.
4316.transcript: I'm so sorry. My fault, all mine.

4345.words: joy (noun): the emotion of great happiness
4345.asset_description: A woman in a bright multicoloured patterned jacket steps through an open front door carrying a tall stack of wrapped presents with big bows. Two children run at her in the hallway and she laughs down at them. She then holds the phone out for a selfie with a boy and a girl pressed to either cheek — all three have their eyes wide and their mouths open in a scream of delight. She dances through the living room with the children pulling at her hands. The last shot pulls back on a full birthday party: a ceiling of coloured balloons, guests dancing, and a birthday cake with lit candles surrounded by wrapped presents on the coffee table.

4628.asset_description: A young man with red hair in a green jumper stands at a living room window beside a packed wicker picnic basket. He gestures out at the street, where rain is running down the glass and the parked cars and brick houses are grey and wet. He drops a last apple into the basket, then lifts out the folded tartan blanket and hugs it against his chest, his face falling as he looks down. He turns away, sinks onto the arm of a chair by the radiator, and ends up slumped in the armchair with the blanket over his knees, chin on his hand, staring out at the wet street.

4720.asset_description: A group of teenagers crowd a phone held at arm's length in a bright classroom and take turns pulling faces into it. A girl with curly hair pushes her lips out in a fish pout and rolls her eyes sideways. A boy in glasses shoves his face right up to the lens, then grins with his mouth wide open. A girl with rainbow braids stares with her eyes stretched as wide as they go and her lips pushed forward. At the end the three of them squeeze their heads together and burst out laughing at the camera, mouths wide open, one of them showing her braces, while classmates work at the desks behind.

4724.asset_description: A woman in black sportswear at a trampoline park. She sits in a pit of red, blue, yellow and green foam cubes with her mouth wide open, laughing hard. She climbs out, walks along the ledge, then jumps back in and lands among the blocks, still laughing with her eyes screwed shut. At the end two women lie side by side in the foam pit laughing together.

4744.words: to relax (verb): to rest and let your body go calm
4744.asset_description: A pale turquoise salt lake with bare desert hills behind it. A woman in an orange swimsuit and a wide straw sun hat lies on her back on the surface of the water, arms spread out, not sinking, with a yellow rubber duck bobbing at her shoulder. Behind her three more people lie on their backs in a row in the same way, two of them with their hands folded behind their heads and their eyes closed. The woman drifts, then opens a glossy magazine and holds it up above her face and reads it while she is still lying flat on the water, her feet sticking up at the front of the shot.

4757.words: freedom (noun): the feeling of being free and held by nothing
4757.asset_description: A teenager in a plaid shirt leaps down a flight of stone steps outside a big brick building with both arms flung wide and his mouth open in a shout. He vaults over a metal farm gate onto a country lane at golden hour. He rides a bicycle down an empty road through open fields with both hands off the bars and his arms stretched out to the sides. At the end he stands with the bike on a grassy hilltop above a wide valley, tips his head back to the setting sun and throws his arms open.

4788.words: shocked (adjective): very surprised and upset by something bad
4788.asset_description: A busy hair salon. A stylist with long braids leans down and cups her hand to the ear of a client sitting under a leopard-print cape; the client's eyes go wide and her mouth drops open. The client is moved under a dome hair dryer and the two keep talking closely. Two women in the background stare with open mouths at a man having his hair clipped by a barber. At the salon's front desk a receptionist looks up from her computer with her mouth open, then the stylist is back beside the client under the dryer, both wide-eyed.

4819.words: grateful (adjective): feeling or showing thanks to someone
4819.asset_description: A drawing of a wet cobbled street in the rain. A boy in a hooded raincoat crouches down and holds a big umbrella up over an elderly woman in a brown coat whose shopping has burst out of her bag. She is bent over next to him holding what is left of the bag; she is smiling warmly at him with her free arm laid around his shoulders while oranges, tins and a packet lie scattered in the puddles around their feet.

5069.words: enjoy (verb): to get pleasure from something
5069.asset_description: A man in a pale shirt sits in a leather armchair in a lobby with green plants and a small water feature behind him. An older woman in a uniform polo shirt stands behind the chair and kneads his shoulders and neck with both hands. His face goes from a tight grimace to a slack, blissful expression as he tips his head back with his eyes closed and smiles.

5110.words: quiet (adjective): with almost no activity going on
5110.asset_description: A watercolour painting of an empty wooden park bench standing on a path in a misty park. Bare grey trees fade into the fog behind it, fallen brown and orange leaves cover the ground, long shadows stretch across the path, and a single dried leaf lies alone on the seat of the bench. There is not a single person anywhere in the scene.

5200.words: lively (adjective): full of life and energy
5200.asset_description: Inside a bright living room several young people burst into motion one after another. A woman throws off a grey blanket on the sofa with a huge grin, a man springs forward out of an orange armchair, another drops to the carpet and pumps out press-ups, and then the whole group jumps, high-fives, claps and cheers around the coffee table.

5285.words: happiness (noun): the feeling of joy and contentment
5285.asset_description: A loose watercolour of a young woman in a long blue-and-yellow dress swinging a small girl around by both hands in a sunny garden. Both are laughing, the girl's legs fly out behind her and her hair and ribbon stream sideways. Washing hangs on a line behind them, flowers grow at the edges and an empty wooden swing hangs from a tree.

5362.words: silly (adjective): foolish in a funny, ludicrous way
5362.asset_description: A young man with curly hair in an open cream shirt walks a whitewashed island street and lifts a pair of round dark sunglasses onto his face. He stops at a spinning rack of sunglasses outside a shop, tries on a pair of aviators, and then puts on enormous red heart-shaped sunglasses that cover half his face. He walks on to the harbour and poses proudly beside a blue and white fishing boat, pointing at himself while still wearing them.

5404.words: greedy (adjective): wanting far more money than you need
5404.asset_description: A young man in a bright kitchen leans over a stainless-steel toaster and pushes the lever down. Two slices of toast pop up and he gasps with delight, then lifts them onto a white plate. He keeps going: slice after slice comes out of the toaster and he adds each one to the plate until the toast has grown into a tower far taller than the toaster itself. He grins over the top of the stack, buttering the topmost slice and reaching for still more.

5452.words: peaceful (adjective): not disturbed by fighting or trouble
5452.asset_description: A man wrapped in a thick checked blanket stands alone at the end of a wooden pier on a mountain lake, sipping slowly from a metal mug. Thick white mist hangs over the water at first; as it drifts away the turquoise lake, the pine forest and the snow-topped rock faces appear behind him, perfectly still and mirrored in the water. He keeps looking out, drinking, and nothing else moves.

61.words: backward (adverb): in the direction behind you
61.asset_description: In a hand-painted animation, an elderly woman and a big bearded man walk backward down an autumn park avenue, arms out for balance, glancing over their shoulders while a duck watches; they finish with a high five.
61.transcript: Don't look! Just walk! I told you!

122.words: bus stop (noun): a spot on a street to wait for public transport
122.asset_description: Three cartoon commuters wait impatiently under a bus-stop shelter on a foggy street; an orange double-decker bus finally pulls up, they board, and the bus drives off leaving the stop empty.
122.transcript: Ten more minutes! Fininally, here it comes!

202.words: cross (verb): to go from one side of a road to the other
202.asset_description: A man shows how to cross a city street: first he walks while staring at his phone and gets a big red WRONG mark, then he looks left and right and walks on the white crosswalk lines, earning green CORRECT ticks and giving a thumbs up.
202.transcript: How do I cross the street? First, I look left and right. Then I cross on the white lines. Now, I cross safely.

246.words: driving (noun): controlling a car as it moves along
246.asset_description: From inside the car, a woman's hands guide the steering wheel along an empty coastal road, easing smoothly through a bend with the sea ahead. She parks, and her passenger turns around smiling to praise the smooth drive.
246.transcript: Easy through the bend. Smoothest park ever.

301.words: float (verb): to stay on top of water without sinking
301.asset_description: A bearded man in blue swim shorts lies on his back on a calm mountain lake, arms spread wide, floating peacefully. A small yellow bird lands on his belly and then his head, and he grins and gives a thumbs up.

339.words: go (verb): to move from one place to another
339.asset_description: In a 3D-animated town, a girl in a red raincoat steps out of a blue door with her bag, waves "Bye! See you!" to her mother and goes off down the colorful cobblestone street.

368.words: helicopter (noun): an aircraft with spinning blades on top
368.asset_description: In a Pixar-style animation, a smiling pilot lifts off from a mountain helipad in a red helicopter, lowers a wooden crate on a cable to a cheering older couple at an alpine hut, then flies away past a snowy peak.
368.transcript: (dramatic music) - Woo hoo! (upbeat music) - Hey! (dramatic music)

369.words: ride (verb): to sit on and control a bike, horse or motorbike
369.asset_description: Helmet-camera view from a rider riding a sport motorcycle down an empty country road between green hedges; the handlebars and dashboard are visible as cars pass in the opposite lane.

436.words: left (adverb): toward the side where your heart is
436.asset_description: On a hand-painted seaside terrace, a dance teacher leads a line of villagers; they all point their arms to the left and step together in that direction, repeating the side-steps as a group.
436.transcript: And step this side. Step together. Step, step. Other side. That way.

528.words: park (verb): to stop a car and leave it in a place
528.asset_description: In a colorful cartoon beach town a young woman carefully steers her teal car into a street parking space between two cars, turns the key off, and steps out beaming while a man on the curb applauds her neat parking.

592.words: pushing (noun): the act of moving something away from you
592.asset_description: Two young men lean into the back doors of a white van on a residential street, counting and pushing with all their strength. The van slowly rolls away down the road and they stand up, laugh and high-five.

612.words: right (adverb): toward the side opposite to left
612.asset_description: At an animated night street market a food-cart vendor gives a lost backpacker directions, pointing firmly to the right past the stalls; he starts off the wrong way, she spins him around to the correct side, and he heads off right with a thumbs-up.
612.transcript: That way! Pass the fountain! Thank you! No, no! This side! Aha!

624.words: run (verb): to move fast on your feet
624.asset_description: In a hand-painted anime park scene, a girl in a blue dress sprints at full speed across the grass chasing her straw hat as the wind blows it away; she dives, tumbles, pins the hat down and puts it back on with a triumphant smile.

837.words: taxi (noun): a car you pay to drive you somewhere
837.asset_description: From inside a yellow taxi, the driver weaves through busy city traffic and squeezes the cab through an impossibly narrow alley between buildings, then grins back at his passenger, proud of the shortcut.
837.transcript: [MUSIC PLAYING] This taxi driver deserves a tip.

843.asset_description: In a colorful hillside street, two girls on a balcony haul a fruit basket up on a rope while their friend below cheers. She then climbs up a tall ladder to join them, and together they watch a hot-air balloon rise up into the sky.

851.words: wait (verb): to stay somewhere until something happens
851.asset_description: A young woman waits for the bus at a bus stop, getting more and more bored: she checks her phone, slumps, lies upside down across the bench and hugs her knees. At last the bus appears down the road and she jumps up, smiling.
851.transcript: I wait for the bus. I look at the time. I wait and wait.

853.words: walk (verb): to go somewhere on foot, step by step
853.asset_description: A woman in a cream sweatsuit walks along a path through a sunny city park by a lake, filmed from behind and beside her. A jogger runs past, the skyline shows across the water, and she turns to the camera, smiles and waves as she keeps walking.
853.transcript: [Music] I like to walk. I walk in the park every day.

895.words: accident (noun): an unfortunate mishap causing damage or injury
895.asset_description: A multi-lane highway at sunset is completely blocked, hundreds of cars stopped bumper to bumper toward a hazy city skyline. One driver leans out of his window to see what is blocking the road ahead.

942.words: bicycle (noun): a vehicle with two wheels moved by pedals
942.asset_description: A man in a dark jacket rides a bicycle down a tree-lined city street at golden hour, autumn leaves scattered on the road and a van behind him.

981.words: car (noun): a motor vehicle with four wheels
981.asset_description: A man in sunglasses leans his arm out of the window of a classic green sports car as it rounds a bend on a coastal road, with cliffs and the sea behind him and leaves swirling off the asphalt.

1203.words: motorbike (noun): a two-wheeled motor vehicle you ride
1203.asset_description: A man in a leather jacket and helmet leans his motorbike into a curve on a coastal road at sunset, sparks flying from the low footpeg as the sea glows behind him.

1303.words: scooter (noun): a light motorbike with a small engine
1303.asset_description: A young woman in a sundress and white helmet rides a pale-blue vintage scooter down a cobbled Italian street, autumn leaves swirling behind her.

1355.words: steering wheel (noun): the round thing you turn to drive a car
1355.asset_description: A tired-looking woman grips the steering wheel of her car at night, head bowed, with blurred city lights and rain on the windscreen around her.

1371.words: subway (noun): an underground train in a city
1371.asset_description: A young man in a dark coat walks along an underground station platform inside a white-tiled tunnel. A subway train rushes past him in a blur of light and color.

1411.words: tram (noun): an electric city train on rails in the street
1411.asset_description: A smiling woman in a suede jacket leans out of the open door of an old green-and-cream tram as it rolls along rails on a cobbled European street.

1415.words: truck (noun): a big road vehicle for hauling things
1415.asset_description: A driver in a plaid shirt climbs up into the cab of a big silver semi truck with a long white trailer, parked at a desert fuel station with red rock cliffs behind.

1751.words: sign (noun): a big board that shows advertisements
1751.asset_description: A flat vector illustration of a wooden signpost with four arrow-shaped signs stacked on it, each filled with a landscape scene of sunset skies, birds, mountains and forest.

1780.words: bike (noun): a vehicle with two wheels that you pedal
1780.asset_description: A doodle of a blond boy riding a bike downhill past a fir tree and mountains while a small dog chases him with its tongue out; hand-written text reads 'It's summer time' and 'Oh yeah!'.

2084.words: railway (noun): the line that runs trains for passengers
2084.asset_description: A modern passenger train runs along wet railway tracks at night in a rainy futuristic city, the rails reflecting orange and blue lights from the skyline.

2172.words: sports car (noun): a fast low car built for speed and fun
2172.asset_description: A sleek dark-blue sports car faces the camera with glowing headlights while an explosion of blue, yellow and pink paint-like waves bursts around it on a black background.

2237.asset_description: A low yellow sports car covered in red, black and teal racing graphics sits in a striped futuristic tunnel that mirrors its colors.

2312.words: race car (noun): a very fast car built for racing on a track
2312.asset_description: A red open-wheel formula race car with a helmeted driver speeds down a sunlit boulevard lined with tall palm trees, a hazy city skyline in the distance.

2351.words: drive (verb): to operate or control a vehicle
2351.asset_description: A green vintage car drives down an empty road between orange autumn trees, with layered mountains and big clouds in the distance.

2356.words: toward (preposition): in the direction of something
2356.asset_description: A straight purple highway rises through clouds, leading directly toward a huge dark planet that fills the starry sky ahead.

2360.words: fast (adjective): moving or able to move very quickly
2360.asset_description: A low red racing car with a big rear wing and glowing headlights sits on a wet road under a dramatic red sunset sky full of clouds, drawn in bold anime style.

2367.words: dirty (adjective): covered with dirt or grime
2367.asset_description: A green sports car covered in dirt, grime and fallen leaves sits on broken wooden planks in an overgrown abandoned village, with a ruined wooden tower and birds in the sky behind it.

2375.words: half (noun): one of two equal parts of something
2375.asset_description: A supercar shown from the front, split exactly down the middle: the left half is dark grey and the right half is bright golden yellow, with colorful smoke above and a mirror reflection below.

2656.words: bus (noun): a vehicle that carries many passengers
2656.asset_description: A loose watercolour painting of a London street where two bright red double-decker buses drive between tall pale stone buildings, with a black street lamp on the right.

3057.words: to walk (verb): to move along on foot at a normal speed
3057.asset_description: Simple cartoon of a bearded man in a blue jumper and jeans striding along a sandy path that curves through a green park with trees and bushes under a blue sky.

3266.words: to ride (verb): to sit on a bike or horse and move along
3266.asset_description: Vector illustration seen from behind of a woman in a white t-shirt riding a bicycle along a red cycle path beside a blue bay, with sailing boats on the water and green rocky mountains ahead.

4018.words: scooter (noun): a light motorbike with a small engine
4018.asset_description: Filmed over a car bonnet on a dirt track running between tall golden reeds at sunset. A mint-green scooter rides ahead with two small dogs aboard, one in a blue cap.
