The dogs hop down and mill about on the track, then climb back on and the scooter tips over into the reeds at the edge.

4022.words: fly (verb): to travel through the air
4022.asset_description: A small white propeller plane is airborne over a city, with a river and a distant skyline behind it and rows of houses far below. A woman in a pink shirt sits in the open doorway, then steps out onto the wing and stands upright with her arms spread wide while the plane keeps flying. She crouches back down, holds the wing with both hands and climbs back inside. The plane flies on alone with the pilot visible in the cockpit.

4028.asset_description: A brown and white bulldog rides away from the camera on a small skateboard along the wet road of a campsite lined with parked caravans and pickup trucks. It pushes with one back leg past an American flag and a big mossy oak, gets smaller in the distance, then swings round and comes back the other way. In the last shot it rides straight towards the camera with its tongue out.
4028.transcript: You go. All right, we're going right, Grayson, this way. All right, let's go get a treat.

4035.words: step (verb): to move by taking a step
4035.asset_description: A first-person view looks down at the filmer's own feet in black sandals on an outdoor water obstacle course, above a pool of green water. He steps from one floating blue and white block to the next along a line of them, arms out to keep his balance. He crosses a narrow beam, then reaches a tall red tower covered in scale-shaped panels and takes hold of a thick white rope with both hands to pull himself up. At the top he stands behind a red railing looking down over the whole course.

4092.words: down (adverb): from a higher to a lower place
4092.asset_description: A helmet-camera view from a road bike at sunset. The rider's tanned arms grip the drop handlebars, and ahead of them a long, steep flight of worn stone steps drops away down the face of a red cliff towards the sea. The sun sits low on the horizon, laying a golden path across the water. The bike bumps down step after step, the stone blurring beneath the front wheel, until the steps end and the rider rolls out onto a dark dirt path by a low stone wall.

4097.asset_description: A helmet-camera view from a mountain bike on a dry dirt jump park under a blue sky. Ahead of the camera another rider hurtles up a huge sloping ramp of packed orange earth and launches high into the air, hanging above the ridge. The point-of-view rider races after him down the trail, the ground blurring past the front tyre as he drops through bermed corners and along the side of a green and brown hill, chasing the rider ahead across the jumps.

4099.words: back (adverb): to or toward where you were before
4099.asset_description: Filmed through a car windscreen in slow traffic on a busy city street under a concrete overpass, with shops and signs along the roadside. Ahead, a motorbike carries a tall stack of mattresses with a brown street dog riding on top. The load slides off and lands flat on the tarmac, and the dog jumps down and stands beside it. A man in a red shirt helps the rider heave the mattresses back onto the bike. As soon as they are strapped on, the dog climbs back up on top and the motorbike pulls away through the traffic.
4099.transcript: I'm telling you. Look at this. He's mad at the dog for dropping the mattress. Now they load it back up. And look, the dog hops right back on. There they go.

4147.asset_description: At night in an empty car park in front of a fast-food restaurant, a man in a dark hoodie and cap runs towards a lit-up yellow arch sign. He grabs the sign, pulls it free and hurries back across the tarmac carrying the big yellow piece under his arm. He shoves it through the door of a waiting car, climbs in after it, and the last shot is his face inside the car, laughing, with the yellow sign filling half the frame.
4147.transcript: Start the car, go, go, go!

4153.words: highway (noun): a major road for motor traffic
4153.asset_description: Filmed from inside a car driving on a highway, the shot looks over the bonnet at a bright blue sports car with a big rear wing driving in the same lane ahead. The highway runs straight ahead with white lane markings and a metal crash barrier on the left, green fields and villages on both sides. In front of them stands a wall of grey rocky mountains with snow on the peaks and a long white band of cloud lying across the slopes.

4159.words: high (adverb): at a great height in the air
4159.asset_description: A point-of-view shot from someone hanging in a harness, with their bare legs and blue-soled trainers dangling in the bottom of the frame. They sweep fast over a steep green mountain meadow, the grass blurring underneath them, and then the ground drops away and they are flying high above a valley. Dark pine forest runs down both sides, a small road winds through the fields below, and the grey rocky peaks of the Dolomites stand against a deep blue sky.

4160.words: disappear (verb): to get lost or vanish without warning
4160.asset_description: A red sports car with a big black rear wing stands on a narrow strip of tarmac running through orange desert sand, with electricity pylons along the horizon. The car accelerates hard away from the camera and throws up an enormous cloud of orange sand behind it that fills the whole screen. As the sand thins out the car is only a small red dot far down the road, and in the last shot the sand and haze have swallowed it completely and the road is empty.

4164.words: brake (noun): a device used to slow or stop a vehicle
4164.asset_description: A green Lamborghini takes a corner on a race circuit, running over the red-and-white kerb. A close-up then fills the frame with one spinning black wheel: a big red brake caliper is clamped on the dark disc behind the spokes and the yellow wheel-nut turns in the middle. The car is seen from behind on the damp track with its wide rear wing, and the camera finally pans off into a blur of grass and tarmac.

4165.words: speed (noun): how fast something moves, distance per time
4165.asset_description: A young blond man, filmed from the passenger seat of a sports car, drives along a mountain road while he talks; through the side window beside him the trees and the verge rush past as a green blur. The shot cuts outside to a yellow supercar coming fast round a bend below a rock face and a wall of pine forest, then back to him at the wheel.
4165.transcript: The most important thing is the connection with the car. Every action gets an immediate response. This thing is pure fun, like entering a different dimension.

4166.words: enter (verb): to come or go into a place
4166.asset_description: Outside a stone villa with clipped hedges in the evening sun, a man in a black tank top walks up to a red Ferrari, opens the low door and lowers himself into the red leather seat. A close-up shows his hand on the switches beside the steering wheel and the lit instrument dials. He then sits behind the wheel, looking straight ahead through the windscreen.

4194.words: ride (noun): a journey in a vehicle
4194.asset_description: On a large mown lawn at golden hour, a grown woman in sunglasses, a white t-shirt and white trainers sits in a tiny pink toy jeep, far too small for her, with her legs folded up over the bonnet. She drives it slowly across the grass past a huge old oak tree, filmed from a vehicle following behind her. She steers around, waves an arm, and carries on away from the camera towards a weeping willow, a row of tall poplars and two wooden sheds in the evening light.

4231.words: window (noun): the glass opening in the side of a vehicle
4231.asset_description: At night the camera looks at the closed side window of a dark red pickup truck. The glass is completely fogged up, with only vague golden shapes moving behind it. The window clears and shows two golden retrievers in the cab, both wearing baseball caps, one with a paw up on the door, as pale smoke drifts out around them. They sit there staring out. Then the truck pulls away and speeds off down a dark road.
4231.transcript: You know why I pulled you over? I don't know. But something's wrong with the stop sign. It won't turn green. Step out of the vehicle. Dispatch, I got a vehicle fleeing.

4352.words: turn (noun): the act of changing direction
4352.asset_description: A bold comic-book illustration of a skier coming down a steep white slope. She wears a red, white and blue race suit, a blue helmet and mirrored goggles, and is leaning hard into a change of direction: her knees are bent, her body is tipped over towards the inside of the curve, both skis are up on their edges and a thick wall of snow sprays up off them to her left. Both poles trail behind her and speed lines streak down the slope. Above and behind, a cable lift carries red and yellow cabins over dark pine trees, with white mountain peaks and a few clouds in the blue sky.

4397.asset_description: A young man in a green jacket films himself riding an old city bike through Amsterdam. He pedals over a brick street lined with narrow gabled houses and parked bikes, then along a canal with boats moored under bare trees, then past a brick building and in through a wide entrance. Inside he rides down the aisle of an enormous multi-storey bicycle park, racks of bikes stacked to the ceiling on both sides, and points up at them.

4463.words: welcome (verb): to greet someone on arrival
4463.asset_description: A soft pastel cartoon of the inside of a bus, seen from behind the passengers. The driver sits at the wheel in a dark blue uniform and peaked cap, smiling broadly with one hand raised in a wave to the people getting on. A ticket roll unspools from the dashboard beside him. In the foreground, a woman in pink, two small children and a boy holding a fluffy dog look up at him, one child waving back. Sunlight comes through the windscreen and the open door.

4587.words: cyclist (noun): a person who rides a bicycle
4587.asset_description: A man in a red jacket films himself from the handlebars as he rides. First he sits on his bike on a sandy track between green fields, looking up at a level-crossing sign against a blue sky. Then he is stopped at the edge of a village road, one hand on the handlebar, watching cars go past a traffic light. Finally he is at a big city junction under tram wires, with traffic lights, cars turning and a crowd of people waiting on the far pavement, his mouth open in surprise.

4603.words: road (noun): an open public way for travel by vehicles
4603.asset_description: A road cyclist in a teal kit and a white helmet rides down a narrow tarmac road that winds through green tropical hills. The camera holds on him from the front as he drives on the pedals, then swings to the side as he tucks low over the handlebars; behind him the road curves away with a crash barrier along its edge. He leans hard through a bend, then straightens up on a long descent with mountains and cloud filling the horizon.

4658.words: drive (verb): to operate or control a vehicle
4658.asset_description: A point-of-view shot from inside an open-topped vintage car: two tanned hands hold the thin black steering wheel while the car rolls down a narrow cobbled village street between whitewashed houses with people walking ahead. The road opens onto a coastal highway with the blue sea and cliffs on the left, and the wheel turns as the car follows the bends. The camera then shows the driver herself, a woman in a colourful shirt and sunglasses, one hand on the wheel, looking out at the ocean as she drives along the clifftop road.

4659.words: car (noun): a motor vehicle with four wheels
4659.asset_description: A sequence of drivers seen from inside their vehicles. A man in a suit holds the steering wheel of a saloon car crawling through city traffic, with rows of cars and brake lights ahead and skyscrapers above. A woman smiles at the wheel of a white box van stopped at a red traffic light in a suburban street, then pulls away as the light turns green. A couple sit in a blue convertible parked above the ocean, and a bearded man in a checked shirt drives a car along a winding forest road at sunset with his window down.

4675.words: careful (adjective): showing caution, care or attention
4675.asset_description: A black-and-white cartoon of an Amsterdam canal street. A wide-eyed young man in a coat and a striped scarf races over the hump of a cobbled canal bridge on an old bicycle, so fast that both wheels have left the ground and he is flying. A wooden crate of tulips is strapped to the back rack and the flowers and petals are shooting out behind him. Tall gabled houses, parked bicycles chained to the railing and a houseboat on the canal fill the background.

4689.words: boat (noun): a small vessel for travel on water
4689.asset_description: A young man in a yellow raincoat leans over the varnished wooden rail of a small boat, an orange life ring hanging beside him. The water is grey-green and snow-covered mountains stand on the far shore. A dark shape rises under the surface and a barnacled humpback whale lifts its head out of the water alongside the hull. The whale slips back down and leaves a wide swirl of white foam turning on the water next to the boat.

4723.words: fall (verb): to descend freely under gravity
4723.asset_description: An indoor trampoline park with a huge pit of coloured foam cubes. A man in orange shorts lies half buried in the cubes, laughing. Others run to the edge and drop off it, dropping through the air into the pit and disappearing under the blocks. More people leap in one after another, landing on their backs and sides among the foam, until several of them are lying in the pit surrounded by scattered cubes.

4830.words: swim (verb): to move through water with your body
4830.asset_description: Two freedivers in black wetsuits and long fins move through clear blue open water along a thin vertical line. One is far below in the dark blue, the other kicks upward towards the bright surface, and by the end both are near the top with sunlight breaking through the water above them.

4839.words: move (verb): to change location, to travel or proceed
4839.asset_description: A montage of one young man shifting heavy things. He leans into the back of a small silver car on a suburban street and shoves it along the kerb. Next he is behind a supermarket trolley in a car park, driving it forward across the tarmac. Then he stands behind a child on a playground swing and sends him forward. In a warehouse he braces his shoulder against a huge wooden crate and tips it along the floor, and finally a group of friends put their hands on a giant stone ball on a grassy hill and roll it over the grass.

4875.words: truck (noun): a big road vehicle for hauling things
4875.asset_description: Outside a suburban house a woman in work gloves carries a cardboard box down the drive past a wall of stacked boxes, then a tower of five boxes. Behind her a large white box truck stands open with a ramp down; she and two other movers slide boxes and a brown leather sofa up the ramp into the truck's cargo hold, which is already packed with boxes.

4881.words: bus (noun): a vehicle that carries many passengers
4881.asset_description: A woman braces her hands against the back of a small silver car and shoves it along the street. The shot widens and a line of people is pushing the back of a long city bus, number 230, with its destination sign lit, along the road; then a group pushes the back of a lorry trailer, and finally a whole row of people leans into an enormous round boulder in the road.

4894.words: still (adjective): completely without movement, like flat water
4894.asset_description: In a school sports hall a teenage boy in a grey shirt stands motionless on the centre line of the basketball court; the camera pulls back and more and more students appear standing in the same frozen pose, until an aerial view shows the whole hall filled with rows of unmoving students.

4916.words: bicycle (noun): a vehicle with two wheels moved by pedals
4916.asset_description: A low camera close to the boards shows two two-wheeled pedal vehicles rolling side by side along a wooden seaside pier, a young man and a young woman pedalling and laughing above them. They hold the camera at arm's length for a selfie with the beach and palm trees behind. They get off, and on the pier she spins and he catches her; they hold each other by the railing, then stand together grinning at the camera with the sun setting over the sea.

4933.words: wheel (noun): a round frame that turns on an axle
4933.asset_description: A young man in a light blue shirt and dark tie sits in the driver's seat of a city bus at a depot, both hands on the large black steering wheel. He turns the wheel as the bus rolls out; a low shot from behind the wheel shows the dashboard and the road ahead. Back inside, passengers sit in blue seats behind him while he keeps one hand on the wheel and presses a red button on the console, smiling and speaking towards the door.

4951.words: home (adverb): to the place where your home is
4951.asset_description: A watercolour illustration seen from a dark hallway looking through an open front door into a warmly lit entrance hall. A young man in a dark coat and scarf has just stepped inside, keys still dangling from his hand, and is leaning down towards a golden dog that has run up to him with its tail swinging. Behind him are coats on hooks, boots lined up under a shelf and a wall of framed family photos under a glowing ceiling lamp.

5004.words: spring (verb): to move forward in big leaps
5004.asset_description: A watercolour of red desert at sunset. A kangaroo is caught in mid-air, both back feet off the ground, driving itself forward in a long bound across the red sand, its heavy tail streaming out behind it for balance. A joey's head pokes out of the pouch on its belly. Dust puffs up where its feet just left the ground, low saltbushes dot the sand and pink clouds fill the sky.

5032.words: ahead (adverb): in front of the others
5032.asset_description: On an alpine trail below snowy peaks a woman in a red jacket holds an open map, raises her arm and points along the path, and a line of hikers with poles and backpacks walks behind her. She steps first across a stream on stones while the group waits on the bank and watches her line. Then a women's rowing four cuts across a turquoise lake, the woman in the bow setting the stroke and finally punching a fist into the air.

5063.words: column (noun): a line of people following one after another
5063.asset_description: A military band in black ceremonial uniforms with red-striped trousers and peaked caps moves down a city street in formation, legs swinging up high in unison and white-gloved arms swinging, brass instruments raised. An officer with a sword strides at the front. Behind steel barriers a dense crowd films and waves Indian flags. The shot then cuts to a wide view down a flag-lined avenue where a huge column of uniformed ranks stretches into the distance, watched by a grandfather holding a child in the foreground.

5091.words: motorbike (noun): a two-wheeled motor vehicle you ride
5091.asset_description: A young man in a black leather jacket and jeans rides a small green two-wheeler through a sunny town, sitting up at the handlebars with the round headlight in front of him. He then stands astride a big black machine at a lookout above the sea. In the last part the camera rides with a whole group of riders in helmets and leather jackets as they roll down a coastal road above blue water.

5138.words: train (noun): railway cars joined together that carry people
5138.asset_description: A young woman in a mustard beanie climbs the steps into a train while a member of staff helps lift her hard-shell suitcase; another train and travellers with luggage are on the platform behind her. Inside, she walks down the narrow carriage corridor holding her ticket, heaves the suitcase onto the overhead rack, then sits by the window and watches the platform and rails slide past as the train pulls away.

5145.words: tram (noun): an electric city train on rails in the street
5145.asset_description: A young man in an orange hooded jacket with a bag strapped across his chest walks quickly along a brick pavement in a Dutch city, past shoppers and parked bicycles. He steps off the kerb and crosses a wide zebra crossing while the light shows red for cars, then hurries down a narrow lane lined with flower stalls full of tulips and bunches in buckets. He comes out on a big paved square where a long blue and white electric train runs along rails in the street right behind him, with cyclists passing in front of it. He looks down at his wrist as he keeps walking with the tram still rolling past behind him.

5265.words: container (noun): any object used to hold things
5265.asset_description: A young man with a camera round his neck stands on a wooden jetty in a container port. A small motorboat passes behind him while gantry cranes and stacks of steel shipping containers fill the far bank. He raises a pair of binoculars and watches a green ship loaded with containers glide past, then the white bow of an enormous cruise ship slides in right beside the jetty and he tips his head further and further back, open-mouthed, as its decks pass above him.

5347.words: stop (noun): the act of stopping something
5347.asset_description: A traffic policeman in a khaki uniform and peaked cap stands on the centre line of a busy Indian street. He raises a white-gloved palm towards the oncoming traffic and the scooters, motorbikes and cars slow and come to a halt in front of him. A city bus rolls up and stops right behind him, and he then stretches both arms out sideways to hold the two lanes still.

5430.words: fast (adjective): moving or able to move very quickly
5430.asset_description: A selfie-stick POV of a young woman riding a road bike at speed on a mountain road. She rushes out of a dark tunnel into green forest, keeps pedalling along the open road, races through a white-tiled underpass, then through a lit road tunnel where a car passes her, and finally approaches another arched tunnel mouth. The road, walls and trees stream past her the whole time while she grins into the camera.

92.words: blanket (noun): a large warm cover for a bed
92.asset_description: In a snowy-log-cabin living room a woman throws a huge chunky knit blanket over herself on the sofa and snuggles in; a man walks up, she opens the blanket, and they end up wrapped in it together holding mugs of tea.
92.transcript: Warm at last! Share the cover!

136.words: candle (noun): a stick of wax with a string you light
136.asset_description: In a cozy wooden cabin a hand lights a tall candle on the dinner table with a match; a couple leans in to admire the warm glow, then they blow it out together and watch the thin trail of smoke rise.
136.transcript: What a warm glow. Make a wish.

140.words: carpet (noun): a thick soft cover for a floor
140.asset_description: A 3D-animated couple pushes a big rolled-up green carpet across an empty room until it unrolls over the wooden floor; they crawl onto it, flop down on the soft pile with happy sighs and high-five.

152.words: chair (noun): a seat for one person, with a back
152.asset_description: A woman tries out a new teal swivel chair at a desk: she sits down, sinks into the cushion, leans the backrest far back, spins a full circle with her arms out, then invites the man watching to sit in it too.
152.transcript: Whoa, it sinks! Yay! Full circle!

175.words: clock (noun): a device on a wall or table showing the time
175.asset_description: A couple hangs a round wall clock in their kitchen, nudging it until it sits straight. The woman sets the hands, they lean in to hear it tick, then check the time and toast with their coffee mugs.

225.words: desk (noun): a table you sit at to work or study
225.asset_description: A woman clears a pile of clothes off a wooden desk, wipes the top clean, then sets it up with a lamp, laptop, pen cup, plant and notebook. She proudly sits down at the ready workspace next to a man, calling it her command post, while a cat walks across the desktop.

395.words: house (noun): a building where a family lives
395.asset_description: In a hand-drawn cartoon a cheerful couple carries moving boxes up the path into a yellow two-story house with a red roof and green door; the windows light up room by room and they fling open an upstairs window and wave their arms in joy.

443.words: light (noun): the brightness that lets you see things
443.asset_description: Two young people explore a pitch-dark attic with a flashlight, its beam sweeping over a covered armchair and an old rocking horse. Then they open the window shutter and warm sunlight floods the whole room.

911.words: apartment (noun): a set of rooms to live in inside a building
911.asset_description: A smiling woman carrying a vintage suitcase steps into a bright modern apartment with a small kitchen, a beige sofa and sheer curtains, the balcony door open onto rooftops of neighboring buildings.

914.words: armchair (noun): a big soft chair with supports for your arms
914.asset_description: A man in a cream sweater flops back into a plush velvet armchair in a cozy living room, legs swinging up in the air and a cushion sliding off, a floor lamp glowing warmly beside him.

927.words: balcony (noun): an open platform with a railing on a building
927.asset_description: Seen from the street below, a woman shakes out a striped rug over the railing of her balcony on an old apartment building with green shutters and flower pots.

934.words: bathtub (noun): a large container you fill with water to wash in
934.asset_description: A woman in a black swimsuit drops into a white bathtub with her legs up, sending water splashing over the rim onto the mat.

938.words: bed (noun): the piece of furniture you sleep on
938.asset_description: A woman in pajamas stands behind a wooden double bed and throws a white sheet into the air so it billows over the bare mattress.

939.words: bedroom (noun): the room you sleep in
939.asset_description: A laughing woman sits on a rumpled bed and tosses a pillow into the air in a bright bedroom with a nightstand, alarm clock, lamp and open wardrobe.

1022.words: cushion (noun): a soft pillow-like pad you sit or lean on
1022.asset_description: A man kneels by his sofa and punches a big beige cushion into shape; a few small feathers fly out of it.

1123.words: hallway (noun): a long narrow space with doors to rooms
1123.asset_description: A young woman in a slip dress and socks dances down a warm wooden hallway in a house, lined with white doors, framed pictures and coats hanging on hooks.

1166.words: lamp (noun): an artificial source of light
1166.asset_description: In a dim living room, a woman lifts a large lamp with a glowing bulb and fabric shade to place it on a small wooden table by the sofa.

1175.words: living room (noun): the room in a home where people sit and relax
1175.asset_description: A top-down view of a cozy living room: three friends around a sofa and coffee table, one tossing popcorn from a bowl, with a TV, rug, lamps and a big plant.

1242.words: picture (noun): a photo or drawing, often in a frame
1242.asset_description: A woman carefully hangs a large framed landscape picture on a bare wall, adjusting it with both hands, with a mallet, spirit level and a box of screws nearby.

1287.words: room (noun): a space inside a building with walls and a floor
1287.asset_description: Through a doorway, a barefoot woman dances happily in an empty sunlit room with a wooden floor; a stepladder, a paint bucket and moving boxes stand by the wall.

1337.words: sofa (noun): a long soft seat for more than one person
1337.asset_description: Seen from above, three young friends laugh and play-wrestle among cushions on a big grey sofa in a bright living room.

1638.words: curtain (noun): a piece of cloth that hangs across a window
1638.asset_description: Heavy dark purple curtains with tassels and roses frame a stone arch and balcony railing that open onto a moonlit sea with rocks in the mist.

1812.words: look (verb): to turn your eyes toward something
1812.asset_description: A minimal illustration of a girl in a white dress seen from behind, looking out of a yellow window at falling white flakes; a blue cat sits beside her looking out too.

1990.words: comfortable (adjective): giving a feeling of physical well-being
1990.asset_description: A plump golden tufted armchair stands invitingly in a narrow library corridor between towering curved bookshelves, lit by a tall arched window.

2053.words: shelf (noun): a flat horizontal surface for holding objects
2053.asset_description: Four wooden shelves are packed with rows of old dusty glass bottles in green, amber and grey, painted in a muted vintage style.

2056.words: full (adjective): containing as much as is possible
2056.asset_description: A corner of a study with floor-to-ceiling wooden shelves completely full of old books, lit by an arched window, with a red poster on the wall and a wooden floor.

2073.words: shine (verb): to be bright by casting or reflecting light
2073.asset_description: Warm golden sunlight shines through a tall arched window into an old study, lighting a desk piled with books between a bookshelf wall and shelves of jars and bottles.

2079.asset_description: Tall wooden bookcases with carved golden-brown frames stand on a wooden parquet floor, every shelf packed with rows of old books.

2809.words: teacup (noun): a small cup with a handle for hot drinks
2809.asset_description: A cosy night-time illustration: a young woman with long wavy hair sits at a desk between tall bookshelves, eyes closed, holding a small pale-green cup in both hands over an open book, a lamp and a moonlit window behind her.

3064.words: to open (verb): to make something become open
3064.asset_description: Flat vector illustration seen from behind: a woman in a long pale nightshirt pulls two curtains apart with both hands, showing a dark blue night sky and a big white moon.

3779.words: toy (noun): a thing designed to be played with
3779.asset_description: A cartoon-style drawing of a worn patchwork rabbit soft toy sitting on a wooden floor in an empty room, its brown and green cloth pieces held together with visible stitches, lit by a single beam of light.

4083.words: middle (noun): the central area of something
4083.asset_description: An animated shot filmed straight down onto a bed at night. A woman and a bearded man sleep on either side, with a small pug lying between them. The pug slowly stretches out and spreads its legs, pushing the two people further and further towards the edges of the bed. By the end the humans have been pushed off completely — only their hands still grip the sides of the mattress — and the pug lies alone, spread out flat in the exact middle of the bed.

4129.words: home (noun): the house or flat someone is living in
4129.asset_description: A grey-blue front door swings open from the inside, showing the hallway of the house behind it: polished wooden floorboards, a carpeted staircase with a striped runner and pictures on the wall. A golden retriever puppy in a mint green bucket hat, a purple harness and a red lead comes trotting out of the hallway, over the threshold and down the brick front steps of the house. Outside, it walks along the pavement in the sunshine with its owner's legs and red lead beside it, past a wooden fence, front gardens and a parked car, tongue out and hat still on.

4221.words: couch (noun): an upholstered seat for more than one person
4221.asset_description: A small green cartoon lizard carries a white bowl of colourful star-shaped cereal across a dark living room to a big grey couch, licking its lips. It climbs up the side of the couch with the bowl, gets the bowl onto the cushion, then pulls itself up and settles into the corner of the couch. It tucks a plaid blanket around itself, picks up the remote control, and sits back against the cushions eating from the bowl with the light of the television flickering on its face.

4329.words: furniture (noun): the furnishings that make a room ready to use
4329.asset_description: Three short shots of people sitting down in different rooms. First a young man perches on a small pale upholstered chair in a bare corner of an empty room. Then an older woman lowers herself onto a large sofa piled with patterned cushions in a bright living room full of plants, a side table and a window seat. Finally an older man sinks back into a big brown leather armchair in a room lined with tall bookcases, stretching his legs out in front of him.

4386.words: poster (noun): a sign put up in a public place as an advert
4386.asset_description: Three bedrooms one after another. The first is a small room whose walls are completely covered with band and film posters and fairy lights; a lad in a hoodie lies back on the bed next to an acoustic guitar. The second is a bare Japanese room with tatami mats, where a woman kneels and lays out a futon. The third is a grand wood-panelled bedroom where a man in a robe pulls open heavy curtains beside a four-poster bed.

4387.words: compare (verb): to examine how things are similar or different
4387.asset_description: Three very different bedrooms are put side by side. First a teenager's room with a poster-covered wall and two guitars, where a lad throws himself onto a narrow bed. Then a bare Japanese room with tatami mats, where a woman unfolds a white futon on the floor. Finally a dark luxury hotel bedroom with wood panelling, where a man in a robe opens the curtains onto a sea view and drops backwards onto the enormous bed.

4674.words: shelf (noun): a flat horizontal surface for holding objects
4674.asset_description: An elderly man in a waistcoat and glasses cleans a crowded antique shop full of clocks. He beats a feather duster over a gilded mantel clock on a table, then reaches up and runs the duster along the wooden shelves of a tall bookcase packed with old books, small framed pictures and wall clocks. Clouds of grey dust rise into the light from the window and drift across the armchair in front of him.

4738.words: everywhere (adverb): in all places, all around you
4738.asset_description: A young woman kneels on the tiled floor of a small hostel room with bunk beds and digs frantically through a black backpack, pulling out handfuls of clothes and throwing them behind her. She lifts the mattress and pillow of the lower bunk and pushes her head under the bed frame to look underneath. A wide shot shows the whole room afterwards: clothes, caps and shoes lie scattered over the entire floor, from the door to the window, with almost no bare tiles left. She then sits in the middle of the scattered clothes holding a red passport, stares at it open-mouthed, and finally hugs it to her chest and laughs.

4764.words: sofa (noun): a long soft seat for more than one person
4764.asset_description: A young woman and a young man sit side by side on a dark green sofa in a plain living room, each holding a lit-up game controller and staring at the screen off camera. A blue bowl of crisps sits on the cushion between them. She jumps up onto the sofa with a fist in the air, cheering, and crisps scatter over the seat; he throws his head back laughing. They drop back down onto the cushions still playing.

4828.words: wall (noun): a flat side of a room, taller than its thickness
4828.asset_description: A man in a green T-shirt works across a tall bare plasterboard wall in an attic room, rolling dark green paint onto it with a long-handled roller. Half the wall is already an even green block, the other half is still grey plasterboard with white filler stripes, and a dust sheet covers the floor at his feet.
4828.transcript: Look, you paint that big wall green so evenly.

4837.words: table (noun): furniture with a flat top and legs
4837.asset_description: A group of friends sit around a long wooden dining table by a bright window, covered with dishes: a whole roast chicken, a pizza in its box, bowls of salad, pasta and fries, a round loaf of bread and glasses of beer. They pass plates of grilled vegetables across the table to each other, one woman holds out a slice of pizza, hands tear pieces off the loaf, and the camera pulls back to show the whole laden table with everyone smiling and reaching over it.

4847.words: floor (noun): the flat inside surface of a room you walk on
4847.asset_description: A blue spin mop is pushed across beige kitchen tiles, leaving a wet shine between the grout lines. Cut to a woman in a grey shirt bending over a flat mop in a cream-tiled corridor. Then an older woman with white hair drags a wide dust mop down the aisle of a shop between shelves of bottles. Next a woman works a long-handled mop across the vast polished concrete of an empty warehouse, the ceiling lights reflected in it. Finally she sits down on the gleaming warehouse floor with her arms thrown wide.
4847.transcript: So clean. Got it. Almost there. Looking good.

4952.words: bed (noun): the piece of furniture you sleep on
4952.asset_description: A hand pushes down a door handle and opens a flat door. A young man with a backpack and a rolling suitcase steps into a narrow hallway; a golden retriever jumps up at him and he crouches to stroke it. An older woman in an apron comes out of the kitchen and they hug for several seconds while the dog sits at their feet. The last shot is a bedroom with a warm lamp and a bookshelf, where he drops backwards onto the bed and lies spread out on the quilt.

4965.words: bathroom (noun): a room with a bath or shower and a washbasin
4965.asset_description: A teenage boy in mint-green pyjamas stands in a tiled bathroom in front of a white washbasin with a mirror, a shower cubicle and a towel rail. He brushes his teeth with a blue toothbrush, leans over the basin and spits, then lathers his hands with soap and rinses them under the tap, splashes water on his face, dries his face with a small towel and smiles at the camera.

5047.words: living room (noun): the room in a home where people sit and relax
5047.asset_description: An evening in a family living room. A young man sits on a grey corner sofa with a remote control in his hand, laughing at the television, while other people move around in the kitchen behind him. A red-haired woman runs in and flops down beside him, and a young man in a blue T-shirt sits down with a big bowl of popcorn. A woman brings a thick blue blanket over and spreads it across all four of them, and they settle in shoulder to shoulder under it, eating popcorn and watching the screen. A wall clock, a lamp, a picture and the kitchen are visible behind the sofa.

5151.words: frame (noun): a decorated border that surrounds a picture
5151.asset_description: An elderly man in a patterned cardigan stands by a bright window holding up a small painting of a mountain valley in a silver moulded border, turning it so the camera can see it. He carries it to a hallway wall already filled with dozens of bordered landscape pictures, lifts it onto a hook and nudges the edges until it hangs straight among the others. He steps back and stands beside the finished wall, which runs the whole length of the hallway.

5152.words: bedroom (noun): the room you sleep in
5152.asset_description: A young woman in a white t-shirt and jeans stands in a small yellow-walled room with a curtained window and an empty wooden bed frame, and pats a single white pillow down onto the bare slats. She then starts flinging brightly coloured pillows onto the frame one after another — pink, turquoise, yellow, green, cream — until they are heaped high above the bed. She walks up to the heap, laughing, and finally drops backwards into it so that only her face and one hand still show above the colours.

5218.words: room (noun): a space inside a building with walls and a floor
5218.asset_description: A girl in a mustard cardigan opens one door after another in an old house: a dark panelled study, a small yellow kitchen, a bedroom with a patchwork quilt on the bed, and finally a tall vaulted hall with arched windows, which she walks into and turns around in.

5263.words: photograph (noun): a printed picture of a person or scene
5263.asset_description: A woman films herself putting up and styling a set of floating oak shelves on a white wall. She runs her hand along a bare shelf, then stacks colourful hardback books in piles on the boards, stands a framed family photo in front of them, and sets a pale ceramic vase and a trailing pothos plant on the shelves. At the end she steps back and looks up at the finished wall of shelves full of books, frames and plants.

5306.words: comfortable (adjective): giving a feeling of physical well-being
5306.asset_description: A man in a denim shirt is slouched deep into a brown armchair in a carpeted room, knees up and socked feet resting on the seat, talking to someone off camera. The shot cuts to a living room where he sits sunk into a patterned sofa beside a woman while a small boy leans against them. The room then fills: more and more people arrive and drop onto the sofas, sprawling across the cushions and each other, laughing, until the whole sectional is packed with a dozen or more friends lying back with their legs stretched out over the arms and over one another.

331.asset_description: In a hand-painted anime street in the rain, a mustached man in a suit kneels to gather an old lady's spilled oranges, shelters her under his umbrella, opens the cafe door for her with "After you, please" and tips his hat as she thanks him.
331.transcript: Allow me, madam. After you, please. Oh, how kind!

333.words: girl (noun): a female child or a young woman
333.asset_description: On a school playground, a girl with yellow ribbons in her pigtails skips rope, hops through a chalk hopscotch grid and jumps in a hula hoop while other girls watch; at the end she throws her arms up and her friends run in for a group hug.
333.transcript: (bell ringing) - Hump, hump, two foot stretch, hump. Yes! (cheering)

458.asset_description: On an old European town square, the camera moves between different men: a young man in a denim jacket scattering pigeons, a huge bearded man in an apron carrying a wooden crate, old men playing chess, and a man in a suit who shakes hands and hugs the young man.

744.words: stranger (noun): a person you do not know at all
744.asset_description: On a rainy city street a woman drops her papers at a bus stop and an unknown man kneels to help gather them, shelters her under his umbrella, and walks her to the red double-decker bus, where she waves goodbye.

1120.words: guy (noun): a man, often a young one
1120.asset_description: A young man in a black hoodie and beanie stands in an apartment hallway, holding a pizza box in one hand and tossing his keys into the air with the other, one foot propped against the door.

1133.words: helper (noun): a person who helps someone
1133.asset_description: A young person in a denim jacket walks arm in arm with an elderly woman in a flat cap along a sidewalk, supporting her arm and carrying her tote bag.

1163.words: lady (noun): a polite name for any woman
1163.asset_description: An elegant older woman in a grey suit and white gloves walks up a red-carpeted marble staircase at a grand evening party, with a chandelier and guests below.

1183.words: male (adjective): being a man or a boy
1183.asset_description: A muscular young man in a cap and dark vest rows a single racing scull across a misty river, pulling the oars through calm water.

1235.words: people (noun): any group of human beings together
1235.asset_description: A huge night-time festival crowd fills a city square under strings of warm lights, hundreds of people cheering with raised arms as confetti falls.

1237.words: person (noun): a man, woman or child
1237.asset_description: One man in a long dark coat and scarf walks alone across a wide, completely empty crosswalk between misty skyscrapers.

1321.words: sir (noun): a polite word for talking to a man
1321.asset_description: In an elegant restaurant, a young waiter lifts a silver cloche to serve a steaming dish to a smiling elderly gentleman at a candlelit table.

1340.words: somebody (noun): a person, when you don't say who
1340.asset_description: An unidentifiable figure in a hooded parka walks away down a foggy cobblestone street at night, lit only by a hazy streetlamp.

1519.words: pretty (adjective): nice to look at, attractive in a gentle way
1519.asset_description: Vintage collage of a pretty young woman with curly hair and small flowers woven into her hair, wearing a soft pink dress.

1562.words: cowboy (noun): a man who rides a horse and looks after cattle
1562.asset_description: A flat minimalist scene: the black silhouette of a man in a wide-brimmed hat riding a horse along a ridge, framed by a huge yellow setting sun against an orange sky.

1669.words: wing (noun): a movable body part used for flying
1669.asset_description: A pencil drawing of an angel statue with two large feathered wings and a flowing robe, overlaid with fine geometric construction lines.

1734.words: superhero (noun): a caped character with special powers
1734.asset_description: A dark digital artwork of Spider-Man in his red web-patterned suit and mask, shown from the chest up with yellow and green smoke swirling around him.

1892.words: old (adjective): having lived for a long time
1892.asset_description: A painterly stylized image of an old man with a wrinkled face, flat cap and red cardigan standing in a doorway of a narrow alley, one hand resting on a thin stick.

2088.words: handsome (adjective): good-looking, used about a man
2088.asset_description: A painted close-up portrait of a strikingly handsome man with long wavy brown hair, blue eyes and a full beard, wearing a draped beige robe.

2232.words: peaceful (adjective): not disturbed by fighting or trouble
2232.asset_description: A golden Buddha statue sits cross-legged in meditation before a carved lotus halo, with glowing golden petals drifting through the air.

2326.words: prince (noun): the son of a king or queen
2326.asset_description: A cute big-eyed child figure with wild blue hair wears a tall golden crown, layers of gold necklaces and bracelets and silky blue-and-gold clothes, standing barefoot among floating flower petals.

2345.words: wizard (noun): a man in stories who can do magic
2345.asset_description: An old man with a very long white beard and glowing white eyes stands in grey robes against a dark starry background, a ring of orange fire blazing around his head.

2365.words: metal (noun): a hard shiny material like iron or steel
2365.asset_description: A close-up of a superhero in a glossy red and silver metal armor suit with glowing white eyes and a glowing chest light, surrounded by red energy streaks on a dark background.

2497.words: santa claus (noun): the jolly man in red who brings Christmas presents
2497.asset_description: Santa Claus in his red suit and hat sits on a chair beside a wooden table stacked with wrapped presents, with snow-covered fir trees behind him.

3003.words: crowd (noun): a large group of people packed together
3003.asset_description: A soft painted picture of many brown silhouetted figures packed together against a pale wall, all with their heads tilted back and their arms and open hands stretched up into the air.

3724.asset_description: Watercolour portrait of a young woman with very short hair in a bright patterned dress, looking at the viewer; behind her are mud-brick huts with thatched roofs, banana plants and a sandy village yard.

4110.words: clown (noun): a person who amuses others with silly behavior
4110.asset_description: A circus ring filmed from the dark audience seats. An elephant stands on a low round pedestal in a beam of light. Beside it stands a clown in a yellow and purple polka-dot costume with a bright orange wig, huge yellow shoes and a white painted face, next to a man in a dark red suit. A big dark cloth drops over the elephant and hides it completely; the clown throws both arms up in the air towards the audience. When the cloth is pulled away, a white tiger is sitting on the pedestal instead. The clown lies down on the sawdust beside the tiger with its legs in the air while the audience films on their phones.

4276.asset_description: A very old woman with white hair, in a lilac coat and scarf, walks slowly up a narrow cobbled street of tiled houses with a wooden walking stick. A young man in an apron and a nurse in blue scrubs walk on either side of her, each holding an arm, and several neighbours follow behind. At the top they help her up the stone steps to a blue tiled doorway, and she turns round at the door, smiling, with the little group gathered round her.

4311.words: young (adjective): in an early period of life
4311.asset_description: An outdoor basketball court on a bright summer day. A young man with curly hair in a grey vest laughs as he bounces the ball, watched by a semicircle of onlookers. A man in a business suit leaps and lays the ball into the hoop. The young man then passes the ball to a white-haired elderly woman holding shopping bags, who shoots; everyone looks up as the ball drops through the net, and a courier in a yellow jacket rides up on a bike to take his turn while the crowd claps.

4430.asset_description: A soft cartoon of a small child with thick curly brown hair, big brown eyes and pink cheeks, laughing with his mouth wide open. He wears a yellow t shirt, rolled up blue denim shorts, white socks and red trainers, and he is caught mid run with both arms flung out and one foot lifted behind him. In front of his other foot sits a large ball painted with red, blue and yellow stripes and dots. Behind him are rounded green trees, pale grass and a soft blue sky with two white clouds.

4451.words: teenager (noun): a juvenile, between puberty and maturity
4451.asset_description: Two boys of about sixteen or seventeen lie side by side over the back of a sofa in a living room, game controllers in their hands, playing a shooting game on a big television. One pulls a furious face and bares his teeth at the screen while the other laughs. They drop the controllers and start grappling, arms round each other's necks, shouting and laughing, and end up in a hug. The clip cuts to a garden where a group of boys the same age, in shorts and t-shirts, stand barefoot on the grass around a brick oven and a barbecue.

4487.words: kind (adjective): having a considerate and helpful nature
4487.asset_description: A young man in a bobble hat and a red checked jacket films himself through a snowy day. He is first out on a frozen pond with a hockey stick, gently taking shots at a small child in an orange jacket who is playing goalie in front of a net. He is next shovelling the snow off a path in front of a house while an elderly woman stands in the doorway waving and calling thanks to him. Finally he is at an outdoor table with a huge stack of pancakes he has made, pouring syrup over it while four delighted children lean in around him with empty plates.

4709.words: group (noun): a number of people or things taken as a unit
4709.asset_description: A young man in a bucket hat climbs into a minibus with a small yellow flag clipped to the dashboard, then turns to the camera grinning and waves a paper ticket and a wristband in the air. The shot cuts to his own view in the bow of a wooden longtail boat racing across bright turquoise water between tall green limestone cliffs. Finally he stands with about ten other people, all in the same wide-brimmed hats and daypacks, packed together on a stone viewing platform in front of a wide waterfall; they crouch, throw their arms up and cheer at the camera together.

4776.words: polite (adjective): showing good manners towards other people
4776.asset_description: A sepia engraving of a man standing on a tree-lined park path. He wears a long tailored coat over a waistcoat, a bow tie and a tall top hat, and has a waxed moustache. With one gloved hand he lifts the top hat off his head in greeting, smiling slightly at the viewer, while his other gloved hand rests on the curved handle of a walking cane. Bare trees and a railing line the path behind him.

4777.words: helpful (adjective): providing useful help to other people
4777.asset_description: A silver-haired man in a grey three-piece suit moves through a city. He holds a cafe door open and waves someone ahead of him inside. In a marble shopping arcade he bends down and picks up a blue patterned scarf that a passer-by has dropped. At a rainy tram stop an elderly woman is standing with heavy paper shopping bags and loose oranges; he steps in and opens his black umbrella over her head. Finally, on a tram, he lifts his straw hat to a seated woman.

4884.words: point (verb): to indicate a direction or thing with your finger
4884.asset_description: A young woman standing in a crowd stares upward and points one finger at the sky; the people beside her raise their arms and point at the same spot; the camera pulls back over an old city square where hundreds of people all point straight up together.

4909.words: famous (adjective): widely known and admired by people
4909.asset_description: A young woman films herself in a packed street party at sunset, laughing into the camera with people pressed all around her. She climbs a green lamppost and pulls herself up above the crowd while people below film her on their phones. A wide shot shows the whole street filled with thousands of people facing the low sun. She grins into the lens, then stands raised above the crowd with her arms up while everyone below cheers with their hands in the air and confetti falls through the golden light.

5009.words: child (noun): a young person, a boy or a girl
5009.asset_description: A red-haired boy grins as he slides down a blue playground slide on a sunny day. He then runs across the grass of a park lawn and kicks a black-and-white football, and walks back with the climbing frame behind him. The camera pans over an empty park path and ends on the playground with the ball lying on the lawn.

5011.words: old (adjective): having lived for a long time
5011.asset_description: On a Paris cafe terrace two women in coats hug at a table set with coffee cups. Then an elderly grey-haired couple sits on a green bench by the street; the man cups the woman's cheek and they kiss for a long moment. Finally a young couple kisses in front of the Eiffel Tower, the man dipping the woman backwards while guests at the cafe tables clap.

5021.words: lady (noun): a polite name for any woman
5021.asset_description: An outdoor tea party on a lawn in front of parkland. A young woman in a long pale floral Regency dress and a straw bonnet, her hair in ringlets, stands at a laid table, then sits and pours tea from a white porcelain teapot into painted cups. She passes a plate of scones with jam across the table to a man in a jacket who wipes his hands on a linen napkin, and at the end she raises her teacup with the others and smiles into the camera.

5031.words: leader (noun): a person who guides others
5031.asset_description: A black-and-white linocut print on tan paper. A bearded man in a fur-lined hood and a heavy coat stands high on a snowy ridge with one boot up on the rock, gripping an ice axe and throwing his free arm out to point at the peak ahead. Below and behind him a roped line of smaller climbers works its way up the slope. Carved swirls of cloud and a low sun fill the sky.

5092.words: helper (noun): a person who helps someone
5092.asset_description: A young woman in a grey t-shirt and black work gloves carries a large cardboard box down a driveway towards an open removal truck on a sunny suburban street. She walks back up the ramp, and two other people join her: one man inside the truck and one on the ground help her push a brown leather sofa in beside the stacked boxes. She then lifts another box up into the truck and finally turns to the camera, grinning and out of breath.

5147.words: people (noun): any group of human beings together
5147.asset_description: A low shot follows the legs of men and women in dark suits carrying shopping bags as they stride across a wide striped crossing. The camera then moves into a covered market arcade so full that shoulders and backpacks touch: shoppers in coats and school blazers press slowly past stalls hung with food and signs. Finally the view rises above a huge city junction, where hundreds of walkers pour off every kerb at once and fill the whole crossing from both directions under tall buildings and video screens, until the road cannot be seen for the moving mass of them.

5180.words: speaker (noun): someone who speaks to a group of people
5180.asset_description: A charcoal drawing of a man in a dark suit and tie standing at a tall wooden lectern on a stage; a spotlight falls on him from behind heavy drawn curtains, flags stand on either side, and he raises one open hand as he talks into a slim microphone.

5186.words: public (noun): people in general, taken as a whole
5186.asset_description: A colourful cartoon of a busy town square seen from above. Ordinary people of every age fill it: two old men feed pigeons from benches, a jogger in a headband runs past, a woman pushes a pram, a man in a suit checks his watch, a boy cycles by in a green helmet, a long-haired busker plays guitar by a stone fountain, teenagers chat at the fountain rim, and shoppers walk in front of a row of pastel shopfronts. A pigeon sits on the frame at the top.

5253.words: senior (adjective): older, or higher in rank than others
5253.asset_description: In a sunny green park, an old man with white hair, a flat cap and a beige suit strides and bounces along the path with his arms swinging, laughing at the camera. A grey-haired man in a cycling jersey pedals a bicycle along the same tree-lined path. Then a group of about ten white-haired women and men in summer dresses and light clothes stand spread out on a paved square doing a dance-exercise class together, arms stretched out to the side, all moving in time under the trees.

5281.words: star (noun): someone who is very skilled and famous
5281.asset_description: A bright neon poster shows a young man in a shiny jacket on stage, eyes shut and mouth wide open as he belts into a hand-held microphone. Crossed beams of pink, yellow and blue spotlight sweep behind him and one arm is flung up above his head. Along the bottom the black silhouettes of a packed audience reach their hands up towards him.

5305.words: society (noun): a large social group with its own culture
5305.asset_description: A cream-and-black woodcut-style print showing a whole town at work at once, laid out as one connected scene. At the top a fisherman hauls a net from a rowing boat while the sun rises over a village of small houses and a town hall. Below, a driver leans out of a steam locomotive holding a lantern. In the middle a teacher stands at a blackboard with a book, pointing, while two children write on it. A baker in an apron pulls loaves from a brick oven and hands a wrapped parcel to a young workman, who in turn passes bread on. A doctor in a white coat listens to a seated patient's chest. At the bottom a bricklayer builds a wall and a farmer in a straw hat swings a scythe through wheat, with tied sheaves stacked beside him.

5390.words: youth (noun): a young person, especially a young man or boy
5390.asset_description: Handheld phone footage at a sunny skatepark and the adjoining basketball court. A boy in a dark hooded sweatshirt rides a skateboard across the concrete and steps off; another boy stands watching him from the far side of the bowl while more boys wait on the grass. Three boys shoot a basketball at an outdoor hoop. Then about ten teenage boys in hoodies and caps press into a tight ring around one phone, pointing at the screen, shouting and laughing, a backpack lying on the grass at their feet.

5398.words: chain (noun): a series of things linked together
5398.asset_description: A woodcut-style print of the Earth as a globe, its continents and swirling blue oceans carved in fine lines, with tall sailing ships crossing the water. A ring of people of many ages and skin tones stands right around the rim of the globe, each holding the hands of the two beside them so the ring is unbroken all the way round. Behind them the dark sky is full of stars, crescent moons and a few birds.

5499.asset_description: A sunny open-air street market lined with fruit and vegetable stalls and tall old apartment blocks. A young woman in a red summer dress spins round on the pavement, hair flying, laughing. A second woman in a neon-yellow sports top and black leggings jogs towards the camera down the same street. An elderly white-haired woman leans out of a first-floor window onto a balcony packed with red geraniums, watering can in hand, smiling down. Back at street level the woman in red meets a woman in a navy business suit carrying a briefcase; they talk face to face beside a stall of tomatoes, then stand together with shopping bags while the woman in red waves at the camera.

10.words: leaf (noun): one of the flat green parts growing on a tree
10.asset_description: A cartoon botanist in a greenhouse admires a giant green leaf, tracing its glowing veins in wonder. He presses it flat on a table, and when water suddenly pours from above he holds the huge leaf over his head like an umbrella.

123.words: bush (noun): a plant like a small low tree with many branches
123.asset_description: A woman picks blueberries from tall leafy bushes on a berry farm when a blackbird suddenly flutters out of the branches and startles her; a man joins her and they taste the berries together.

141.words: carrot (noun): a long orange vegetable that grows underground
141.asset_description: A woman in a garden strains to pull a comically huge carrot out of a raised bed, rinses the dirt off with a watering can while a man helps, then bites into the giant carrot with a loud crunch.
141.transcript: Pull! Pull! Pull! Crunched so sweet!

303.words: flower (noun): the colourful part of a plant
303.asset_description: A red-haired woman in a mustard sweater sits by a window holding a paper-wrapped bouquet of pink and white flowers. She touches a pink rose, then holds a single pink daisy-like flower up to the camera and by her face, saying she gives you a pretty flower.
303.transcript: This flower is for you. I give you a pretty flower.

326.words: garden (noun): a piece of land by a house for plants
326.asset_description: A woman in an apron tours her backyard garden at sunset: she waters lettuce beds, picks a ripe tomato by the greenhouse, shells fresh peas into her palm and smells the pink roses.

327.words: gardening (noun): the work of growing plants and flowers
327.asset_description: A man in gloves does gardening in a raised bed: he digs a hole, un-pots a seedling, plants and waters it, then later picks a ripe tomato, bites into it and high-fives his gardening partner.
327.transcript: There, grow well. Still warm from the sun.

351.words: grass (noun): the green plants that cover lawns and fields
351.asset_description: Two barefoot teenagers stand on a freshly mown striped lawn, try to whistle through blades of grass held between their thumbs, laugh, then flop down and stretch out side by side on the soft green lawn.

426.words: ladder (noun): a set of steps you lean on a wall to climb
426.asset_description: In an orchard, a man leans a wooden ladder against an apple tree and holds it steady while a young woman climbs the rungs, picks a red apple from a high branch, and they both take a bite.
426.transcript: (upbeat music) - Hold it steady! Got it! (upbeat music)

489.words: mushroom (noun): a fungus with a round cap on a short stem
489.asset_description: In an autumn forest, a couple with a wicker basket crouches over the leaf-covered ground where the woman points out a cluster of brown mushrooms with dewy caps. They then find a bright red mushroom with white spots glowing in the sunbeams and marvel at it without picking it, while a squirrel darts past.

555.words: plant (noun): a living green thing that grows in soil
555.asset_description: In a bright plant-filled apartment, a woman waters a potted plant with a gold watering can, wipes its big green leaves with a cloth, then she and a man excitedly point at a fresh new leaf shooting up from a pot while a cat watches.
555.transcript: Look at that! A new one!

567.words: pond (noun): a small area of still water
567.asset_description: Two young people kneel at the mossy stone edge of a small garden pond ringed by ferns and purple irises. They point excitedly ("Oh wow. Whoa!") at orange goldfish gliding under the lily pads, and a fish splashes, sending ripples across the still water.

572.words: potato (noun): a round vegetable that grows under the ground
572.asset_description: In a vegetable garden, a man levers a leafy potato plant out of the dark soil with a spade ("Easy and lift!") and golden potatoes tumble from its roots. A woman kneels down, picks the potatoes out of the dirt admiring how many there are, and together they fill a metal bucket with the harvest.
572.transcript: Easy and lift! Look how many!

620.words: rose (noun): a flower with a sweet smell and thorns on its stem
620.asset_description: In a misty rose field at sunrise a woman cradles a large pink rose in her hands, closes her eyes to smell it with delight, then holds up its long stem and points carefully at the sharp thorns.

621.words: row (noun): a line of things or people next to each other
621.asset_description: Farm workers in sun hats kneel in a field at dawn, transplanting seedlings along a stretched string so the plants form a perfectly straight line; a drone shot reveals dozens of workers planting one long straight line across the field. One says the line is nice and even.
621.transcript: Nice and even. All in one line.

696.words: smoke (noun): the grey cloud that rises from something burning
696.asset_description: A couple burns a pile of autumn leaves in their backyard; a huge column of thick grey smoke billows up, drifts over the man until he is completely wrapped in it, and he coughs and waves it away while the woman laughs.

867.words: watering (noun): giving plants a drink so they grow
867.asset_description: On a rooftop terrace at sunset, a couple fills a metal watering can at a tap and pours water over their potted tomatoes and herbs. A droopy basil plant gets a good shower and they lean in happily as it revives.
867.transcript: Heavy, but worth it. Look, it's coming back!

885.words: worm (noun): a long thin soft animal that lives in soil
885.asset_description: Macro shot in a rain-wet garden bed: a pink earthworm rises out of the dark soil under big green leaves, wriggles across the dirt past a small snail and pebbles, then burrows back down until only its tail tip sticks up. Music only, no speech.

957.words: branch (noun): a stem growing out from a plant's main stem
957.asset_description: A thick blossoming branch stretches across a spring orchard sky with a rope swing hanging from it and a small robin perched at its tip.

973.words: cactus (noun): a desert plant covered in sharp spines
973.asset_description: A tall saguaro cactus with several arms stands in a desert at sunset; a small bird lands on one arm next to a pink cactus flower, and the low sun casts long shadows on the sand.

1543.words: cabbage (noun): a big round vegetable with thick green leaves
1543.asset_description: A painting of a woman in an apron and pink bonnet standing in a cottage garden full of cabbages, holding a cut cabbage under one arm and a knife in her hand, while children watch from the gate.

1559.words: sunflower (noun): a very tall flower with a big round yellow head
1559.asset_description: A stylized version of Van Gogh's Sunflowers: a yellow vase signed Vincent holding a bouquet of large yellow sunflowers on a yellow table against a pale wall.

1585.words: white (adjective): having the color of snow or milk
1585.asset_description: A loose watercolor painting of five large white rose blossoms surrounded by blue-green leaves and stems.

1847.words: christmas tree (noun): a pine decorated with lights for the holidays
1847.asset_description: A flat minimal card: three green Christmas trees topped with yellow stars on a dark green background dotted with falling snow.

1862.words: vase (noun): a container you put flowers in
1862.asset_description: A gouache painting of a grey classical vase on a dark background, holding a bouquet of pink roses, red berries and green eucalyptus leaves.

1966.words: path (noun): a narrow marked way that you walk along
1966.asset_description: A cobblestone path leads through two ruined stone arches overgrown with pink and purple flowers, with glowing misty light beyond them.

1985.words: bright (adjective): strong and full of color, easy to see
1985.asset_description: A huge fantasy tree with a dark twisting rainbow-sheened trunk carries clouds of bright red foliage that fill the whole sky.

2012.words: entrance (noun): something that gives you a way to get in
2012.asset_description: A dreamy painting of a garden entrance: an archway covered in purple flowers stands over a misty stone path, framed by candle-lit columns and an iron gate half-open on one side.

2091.words: pine tree (noun): a tall tree with needles and cones
2091.asset_description: One tall frost-covered pine tree stands in the middle of a purple night forest, a giant glowing full moon filling the sky directly behind it.

2113.words: yellow (adjective): the color between green and orange
2113.asset_description: A white dove perches on bright yellow flowers against a black background, with a large yellow rose and green leaves behind its head.

2327.words: palm tree (noun): a tall tree with no branches and big top leaves
2327.asset_description: A red sports car stands on a wet beach road at sunset, surrounded by tall dark palm trees against an orange-and-purple starry sky.

2358.words: farm (noun): land where people grow food and keep animals
2358.asset_description: A folk-art painting of a hillside farm: red flower fields along a fenced dirt path, farmhouses with red roofs among cypress trees, and a big sun setting over water and mountains.

2483.words: dried (adjective): with all the water taken out to keep it
2483.asset_description: A bunch of dried, faded flowers with brittle stems and curling leaves lies pressed on the yellowed page of a big old book.

2651.words: spots (noun): small round marks on a surface
2651.asset_description: A little house built inside a giant mushroom whose red cap is covered in white spots stands in a night forest; its windows and door glow warm orange, a butterfly flies past and the full moon shines behind bare trees.

2666.words: flowerpot (noun): a clay container that a plant grows in
2666.asset_description: A dark-haired woman in a black corset dress walks down a cobbled village lane at sunset between old half-timbered houses, past stone steps lined with terracotta flowerpots full of red flowers.

2693.words: grow (verb): to get bigger gradually, the way a plant does
2693.asset_description: A fantasy painting of a huge tree rising out of the pages of an open book on a wooden table; its trunk and rainbow-coloured leaves are built from glowing glass pieces, with a valley and clouds behind.

2915.words: to plant (verb): to put seeds or young plants into the ground
2915.asset_description: A loose watercolour of a woman in a sun hat and a bearded man in a cap, both in green work aprons, leaning over a wooden bed of orange and yellow flowers and working the plants with their hands.

3644.words: to water (verb): to give a plant a drink so it can grow
3644.asset_description: Illustration of a red desert planet at night with a huge pink planet in the sky. An astronaut kneels on the red ground and pours water from a small blue watering can onto a tiny green seedling that glows in the dust.

4128.words: yard (noun): the enclosed land around a house
4128.asset_description: A sunny back yard behind a house, closed in on all sides by a tall wooden fence, with a brick paved path along the house and a patch of green and dry grass in front of it. A pale golden retriever puppy comes trotting along the brick paving towards the camera, ears flapping and tongue out, then steps down off the paving onto the grass of the yard and keeps coming, tail up. It bounds the last few steps through the grass and drops down right in front of the lens, filling the frame with its face, panting happily in the sunshine.

4269.words: dry (adjective): free from liquid or moisture
4269.asset_description: A woman in a bright patterned tunic and blue headscarf stands over a raised bed of bone-dry earth in a courtyard full of terracotta pots. The soil is pale and split into a web of deep cracks. Wearing gardening gloves she tips water from a clay jug and then from a brass watering can; the water vanishes straight into the cracks, spreading dark wet patches until the whole bed is soaked and brown.

4413.words: smell (noun): the sensation you get from odors in the nose
4413.asset_description: A woman in a cream coat holds a cluster of pale pink cherry blossoms up to her face, closes her eyes and breathes in the scent; a bee is crawling over the petals. She lowers the branch and smiles, standing under a huge cherry tree in full flower, then walks into an avenue where the blossoming branches meet overhead and spreads her arms wide.

4613.words: earth (noun): the loose soft material of the land surface
4613.asset_description: An allotment garden under a grey sky. An older man in a flat cap and body warmer tips a black bucket of kitchen scraps onto a heap inside a wooden compost bin: carrot tops, apples and banana skins scatter over the surface. He then works a spade into the heap and lifts up great forkfuls of dark crumbly earth, turning it over so the older, rotted material underneath comes to the top. Raised beds of cabbages and a greenhouse stand behind him.

4766.words: garden (verb): to work in the garden
4766.asset_description: An elderly woman in a straw hat, blue cardigan and a floral apron pushes open a wooden garden gate under an archway of roses and comes down the path. She walks between tall pink and white hollyhocks, then bends over a bed of tomato plants tied to bamboo canes and turns the ripe red fruit over in her hand. Further along she works between beds of marigolds and dahlias beside a wheelbarrow heaped with cut flowers, then stands in the middle of the beds and throws her arms open.

4814.words: to pick (verb): to take leaves or fruit off a plant
4814.asset_description: In a vegetable garden a hand takes a big red tomato off a staked plant hung with green and red fruit. A man drops the tomato into a wicker basket that already holds cucumbers and more tomatoes. In the next shot a man turns the soil with a spade and pale potatoes come up out of the dark earth. A woman in a headscarf kneels behind a full basket and holds a large potato up to the camera in surprise, and finally a couple tip a basket of peppers onto a wheelbarrow already heaped with tomatoes, cucumbers, peppers and potatoes.

4848.words: grow (verb): to get bigger gradually, the way a plant does
4848.asset_description: Gloved hands press the soil around a small green seedling just set into a terracotta pot on a patio, with other pots and plants behind. Cut to a watering can pouring a wide spray over a raised bed packed with orange, pink and purple flowers beside a wooden house. Then a woman in gloves closes a pair of red secateurs on a stem inside a tall glossy hedge. Next she bends over a vegetable patch and takes hold of a large orange pumpkin among the broad leaves, and finally she straightens up holding the pumpkin against her chest and grins.
4848.transcript: In you go. Drink up. Ta-da! Look at that.

5153.words: bed (noun): a plot of ground where plants are growing
5153.asset_description: Two young people work outdoors in a sunny hillside garden, bent over a long raised wooden bed filled with dark soil. He presses small green seedlings into the soil one by one while she loosens the earth beside him with a hand trowel, and a row of identical seedlings appears down the length of the bed. A wide shot shows several parallel raised beds, one of them already planted, and the two of them stepping back with their tools to look at the finished rows.

5308.words: sunflower (noun): a very tall flower with a big round yellow head
5308.asset_description: A young woman in a cream cardigan sits at a kitchen table biting into a chocolate-chip cookie, a plate of more cookies in front of her and fairy lights strung on the wall behind. Something makes her look up; she gets up, still holding the cookie, and pads down the hallway to the front door in slippers. She presses her face to the peephole and squints through it. She opens the door and a delivery man in an orange high-visibility jacket and helmet is standing there holding an enormous bunch of sunflowers — big round yellow heads on long green stems. Her mouth falls open in delight and she takes the bunch in both arms.

5329.words: seed (noun): the small hard part that grows into a plant
5329.asset_description: A man's open palm fills the frame holding one small pale seed that has split open, with a white root curling out of it and two tiny green leaves. He crouches over a black seed tray of soil blocks where the same seeds have pushed up as bent green shoots, laughing and pointing at one of them with his finger. The shot pulls back to show him standing behind the tray of seedlings with a large green field stretching to the horizon behind him at dusk.

5486.words: flowerpot (noun): a clay container that a plant grows in
5486.asset_description: An elderly man in a flat cap and body warmer stands at a greenhouse windowsill holding a metal watering can over a terracotta flowerpot with a pale green succulent growing in it. He then waters a garden bed full of pink, yellow and red zinnias and pansies from the same can, moves on to a raised bed of leafy vegetables and waters those too, and finally stands back with a hand on his hip looking over the watered garden.

1.words: break (noun): a short rest from work or study
1.asset_description: A young man studying at a desk with an open textbook takes a break to look at his phone, laughing at what he sees. His amusement slowly turns into wide-eyed panic as he realizes how much study time his short break has eaten.
1.transcript: I take a short break But I must study now

3.words: class (noun): teaching given as a series of lessons
3.asset_description: A teacher writes a quadratic equation on a chalkboard; every time she turns her back, her class erupts into total chaos with students dancing on desks and throwing paper. When she turns around with her coffee mug, everyone is sitting quietly, leaving her baffled.
3.transcript: I look away for one second. My class is crazy!

4.words: course (noun): a series of lessons on one subject
4.asset_description: A young woman sits at a table at home with an iced coffee, opens her laptop and calmly works through an online course, sipping and typing.
4.transcript: I am at home. I take a course online.

11.words: library (noun): a place full of books you can read or borrow
