11.asset_description: A woman in a mustard coat walks through a grand old library, gazing up in awe at endless shelves and a huge circular tower packed with thousands of books.
11.transcript: This library is beautiful. Look at all the books.

19.words: ruler (noun): a flat stick for measuring and drawing lines
19.asset_description: A student at a classroom desk needs a straight line but has no ruler. He comically tries the edge of a thick book and a calculator and even searches under the desks, until he finally gets a wooden ruler and happily draws a perfect straight line.
19.transcript: A ruler makes us a straight line. I have no ruler!

21.words: school (noun): a place where children go to learn
21.asset_description: A first-person tour of a school: walking up to the entrance doors at sunrise, through locker-lined hallways, past a classroom of chatting students, the library shelves and the cafeteria line, ending outside on the lawn in front of the school building.
21.transcript: This is my school. Come and see it.

22.words: scientist (noun): a person who studies nature and does experiments
22.asset_description: In a hallway of research posters a student glances at one and walks on, but a scientist in a white lab coat and safety glasses stops, inspects every chart up close, points at curves, scribbles notes on a clipboard and beams with excitement.
22.transcript: A normal person looks fast. A scientist looks at everything.

27.words: student (noun): a person who learns at a school or college
27.asset_description: A young woman in a red beret and glasses studies at a desk stacked with books while her mug of coffee steams; she reads for so long the coffee goes cold, so she comically dumps an ice tray into it, throws the window open and drinks it iced without stopping her studying.
27.transcript: I am a student. I study until my coffee is cold.

28.words: subject (noun): a thing you learn at school, like maths
28.asset_description: A presenter in a cream blazer shows school subjects in quick cuts: equations on a blackboard, a calculator, paint and brush strokes, piano keys and sheet music, a glowing chemistry flask, then she leans on a stack of textbooks and talks to the camera.
28.transcript: School has many subjects. Some subjects are very hard.

29.words: telescope (noun): a tube with lenses for seeing far things
29.asset_description: At night a woman in a beanie sets up a telescope on a tripod in her backyard and looks through it at the moon; magnified views show craters and a bright meteor streaking past a crescent moon, and she looks up amazed and tells the camera what she saw.
29.transcript: I look at the moon with my telescope. I see something amazing!

30.words: textbook (noun): a book used for learning a school subject
30.asset_description: A student sits at a small desk flipping through an enormous, thick textbook, turning page after page with a bored face; the pages never seem to end, and she finally gives up and falls asleep with her head on the book.
30.transcript: My textbook is very long. It is so boring.

31.words: university (noun): a place to study for a degree after school
31.asset_description: A huge university lecture hall is packed with hundreds of students on laptops and phones in week one; the camera then shows the same auditorium in week five, with row after row of empty seats and only a couple of students left.
31.transcript: In week one, my university is full. In week five, it is empty.

42.words: exam (noun): a test of what you know at school
42.asset_description: A young man in a basketball jersey sits at a dim table completely covered in exam papers and worksheets; he leans over the pages, flips through them and gives up, walking away from the table.
42.transcript: This exam's too hard, I just believe.

129.words: calculator (noun): a small device that does maths for you
129.asset_description: A man films himself at his kitchen counter presenting his big desk calculator, admits he is bad at math, and demonstratively types 5 + 3 on it to get the answer 8.
129.transcript: Okay, this is my calculator. I am bad at math. I use the calculator for small numbers.

171.asset_description: In a black-and-white street interview a host quizzes young people with a microphone. A boy answers an easy question and a green 'Correct' pops up twice; a girl struggles with a simple math question and gets a red 'Wrong' before everyone laughs together.
171.transcript: Alright easy one. What color is the sky blue? Okay, what is 23 plus 87 105 This answer is correct that answer is wrong

270.words: eraser (noun): a small rubber thing that removes pencil marks
270.asset_description: A girl excitedly shows a little Mount Fuji eraser in its Japanese box, then rubs out pencil scribbles on lined paper, leaving a pile of grey shavings. As she uses it the blue eraser wears into a snow-capped mountain shape and she holds up the tiny Fuji proudly.
270.transcript: Look at my cute eraser. I use the eraser and the eraser becomes a little mountain. So pretty.

388.words: homework (noun): tasks a teacher gives you to do after school
388.asset_description: A tired teenage girl in glasses sits at a desk at night, chin propped on her hand over a pile of worksheets, sighs that tonight she does homework and then more homework, and starts writing with her pen.
388.transcript: Tonight I do homework. Then I do more homework.

404.words: classroom (noun): a room where a teacher teaches students
404.asset_description: A teenage boy sits calmly at his desk with a tablet in a bright classroom while behind him classmates wrestle and pile on top of each other in growing chaos.

538.words: pen (noun): a thin tool you write with in ink
538.asset_description: A young man in a beanie holds a green click pen up to the camera, clicks the button, then writes stripes in blue, red and other colors on a lined notebook and grins about how cool the multi-color pen is.
538.transcript: Look at my pen. This pen is so cool. I click the pen and I write in many colors.

541.words: pencil (noun): a thin wooden tool you write or draw with
541.asset_description: A young woman in a beret sketches a mountain landscape with a yellow pencil in an open notebook at a sunny wooden table, while a bearded man watches and applauds her finished drawing.

576.words: pray (verb): to speak to a god
576.asset_description: A stressed student at a desk piled with textbooks and a laptop presses her palms together, looks up at the ceiling and begs "Please, I pray for a good grade... I want to pass my exam". She dramatically pleads into the camera with clasped hands and desperate eyes.
576.transcript: Please, I pray for a good grade. I pray and I pray. I want to pass my exam, please, or pass my--

646.words: science (noun): the study of how nature and the world work
646.asset_description: A woman in a lab coat, safety goggles and purple gloves says she loves science, mixes two blue liquids in a beaker, and a huge tower of orange foam erupts out of it; she reacts wide-eyed with delight and holds up the foam-filled tube in triumph.
646.transcript: I love science. Look what happens.

662.words: sharpener (noun): a small tool that gives a pencil a sharp point
662.asset_description: At a wooden table on a grassy steppe with a horse grazing behind, a young woman shows a blunt pencil, a man twists it in a small sharpener so a wood shaving curls out, and she holds up the now needle-sharp pencil before drawing in a notebook.
662.transcript: Blunt as a spoon. Needle point.

719.words: space (noun): the empty area beyond the sky, with stars
719.asset_description: Two teenagers recline in planetarium seats as the dome above them fills with a glowing Milky Way star field; they gaze up open-mouthed while the galaxy slowly drifts overhead.

995.words: classmate (noun): a student in the same class at school as you
995.asset_description: In a classroom with a chalkboard, a girl leans over to whisper a secret to the boy next to her, who covers his mouth and laughs over an open notebook.

1248.words: planet (noun): a large round world that circles a star
1248.asset_description: At night under a starry sky, an amazed young woman in a beanie points at a small screen on her telescope that shows the ringed planet Saturn, her face lit red by a lantern.

1268.words: professor (noun): a teacher of the highest rank at a university
1268.asset_description: An elderly man in glasses and a tweed jacket lectures in a packed university hall, gesturing with one hand and holding a clicker, with rows of students and a big projection screen behind him.

1613.words: rocket (noun): a vehicle shaped like a tube that flies into space
1613.asset_description: Three rockets rise on white trails of smoke over misty desert mountains at sunset, with a huge planet and the setting sun on the orange horizon.

1661.words: time (noun): what clocks measure, in hours and minutes
1661.asset_description: A golden astronomical clock with Roman numerals, zodiac animals and several hands, printed on old stained parchment.

1709.words: teacher (noun): a person whose job is teaching
1709.asset_description: Cartoon classroom where a teacher stands by the green board explaining with a raised hand while students sit at wooden desks with open books.

1710.words: blackboard (noun): a dark wall surface teachers write on in chalk
1710.asset_description: Cartoon of a teacher gesturing toward a big empty green blackboard on a stand while pupils watch and laugh from their desks.

1827.words: math (noun): the study of numbers and shapes
1827.asset_description: A black cat sits with its back turned in a corner where both walls and even the floor are covered in scribbled math formulas, graphs and equations.

1834.words: teach (verb): to help someone learn a skill or subject
1834.asset_description: A blue-skinned god stands on a giant open book at sunset, raising one finger to the sky as he teaches a kneeling warrior who listens with folded hands.

1922.words: study (verb): to learn about a subject by reading
1922.asset_description: An old black-and-white engraving of a woman seated at a reading stand, hand pressed to her forehead as she pores over a huge open book; bookshelves fill the wall and two winged cherubs play with books at her feet.

1923.words: bookshelf (noun): shelves where books stand side by side
1923.asset_description: A cozy library aisle with tall bookshelves packed with colorful books on both sides; in the middle a stack of open books sits on a chair and a glowing jack-o-lantern rests on the floor under a full moon.

2107.words: spaceship (noun): a large vehicle that travels through space
2107.asset_description: The empty retro sci-fi interior of a spaceship: curved metal panels, vents and consoles in green light around a large round glowing porthole window.

2127.words: table (noun): furniture with a flat top and legs
2127.asset_description: Vintage black-and-white line drawing of a girl sitting at a carved wooden table with an open book on it, an owl perched on her chair back and a large window behind her.

2136.words: glove (noun): a covering for your hand with fingers
2136.asset_description: Comic-style astronaut floating in space wearing bright red gloves, a reflective black visor and an American flag patch on the sleeve, with ringed planets behind.

2440.words: electricity (noun): the energy made by moving electrons
2440.asset_description: A bearded man in glasses and work overalls stands in a workshop holding three glowing light bulbs while white and blue electric sparks crackle all around him and between the bulbs.

2472.words: uniform (noun): clothing a group wears to be identified
2472.asset_description: An anime girl with short dark blue hair stands leaning back against a metal railing, wearing a Japanese school uniform — white sailor-collar blouse, navy neckerchief and pleated navy skirt — with pale buildings behind her.

2481.words: globe (noun): a small round model of the Earth on a stand
2481.asset_description: A smiling cartoon teacher with glasses and a brown jacket stands in a classroom holding a globe of the Earth in both hands.

2594.words: learn (verb): to get new knowledge or skills
2594.asset_description: A silver robot with glowing orange eyes sits in a chair holding an open red book with a picture of a robot in it, studying the page closely.

2678.words: paper (noun): thin sheets you write, print or draw on
2678.asset_description: A watercolour of a small study where a laptop sits on a wooden desk buried under loose sheets and thick piles of paper, in front of a tall arched window showing a full moon over a night city.

2781.words: carry (verb): to move while holding something in your hands
2781.asset_description: A watercolour of a smiling schoolgirl in a blue shirt and skirt walking down a sunny street; she wears a big blue backpack on her shoulders and holds a second heavy blue bag in her hand, with a red bus and parked cars beside her.

3034.words: to study (verb): to learn by reading and practising
3034.asset_description: A black-and-white manga-style drawing of a girl with glasses and a messy bun, still wearing her backpack, bent over a wooden school desk writing on papers in a bare classroom with notices pinned to the wall.

3035.words: test (noun): a set of questions to check what you know
3035.asset_description: A dense pen-and-ink drawing of a classroom where rows of pupils sit at wooden desks bent over sheets of paper; the girl in front holds a pencil and writes on her sheet with her head lowered.

4298.words: straight (adverb): in a direct line, without deviation
4298.asset_description: In a school gym a boy in white PE kit shuffles his trainers forward until his toes touch a coloured line painted on the parquet floor; the camera then pans along a whole class of boys standing shoulder to shoulder with every pair of shoes exactly on the same line, forming one perfectly straight row, while a teacher in a red tracksuit with a whistle walks down the line checking it.

4335.asset_description: In a tiered lecture hall a young woman in a mustard jumper and round glasses sits at a desk in the middle rows, throws one arm straight up and speaks towards the front, eyebrows up. Around her the other students sit taking notes. Then more and more hands go up around her, until in the last shots the whole hall — row after row of students — has a hand in the air, all looking towards the front and speaking at once.

4421.words: bone (noun): the rigid tissue that makes up the skeleton
4421.asset_description: In a classroom a girl in a mustard jumper holds a small white bone up close to the camera between her finger and thumb, other pupils working at desks behind her. She turns to a hanging plastic skeleton and lifts a long thigh bone off a grey tray with both hands, turning it so the knobbly ends show; more long bones lie on the tray beside her. The scene cuts to a museum hall where she looks up open-mouthed at the huge mounted skeleton of a dinosaur and points up at its ribcage.

4535.asset_description: A school classroom during class. Two teenagers lean over an open spiral notebook on a desk; the pages are covered in handwritten algebra. The boy in glasses points at a line with a blue pen and the girl writes. Behind them the room is full of desks. A boy walks up the side of the room and lobs a balled-up sheet of paper at a grey bin by the whiteboard; the students at the desks turn and laugh. A wide shot shows the whole class seated in rows, writing in their books.

4565.words: globe (noun): an object shaped like a ball
4565.asset_description: An anime-style painting of the inside of a spacecraft. A child in an orange spacesuit with a white life-support pack and a tether floats up to a big round porthole, seen from behind, with both gloved hands pressed against the glass. Filling the window is the earth as one enormous blue and green ball, wrapped in white cloud, with the land masses spread across it. Instrument panels with glowing screens and bundles of cable line the walls, and a strip of black starry sky shows through a second window above.

4782.words: playground (noun): an open area where people go to play
4782.asset_description: A sunny asphalt school yard fenced in behind a low building. A girl in denim dungarees with yellow ribbons in her bunches runs up and then hops along a hopscotch grid chalked on the ground, landing with both feet in the numbered squares. Other children swing a long skipping rope to one side, a boy bounces a ball at the back and a teacher watches from behind. At the end her friends rush in and pile into a laughing group hug around her.

4851.words: ancient (adjective): very old, from thousands of years ago
4851.asset_description: A red-haired woman in a khaki shirt and bush hat lies over a patch of desert sand and sweeps a wide brush across it, uncovering a small round coin. She brushes again and the sand falls away from a flat grey slab. The slab turns out to be a stone tablet carved with rows of hieroglyphs, and she scrapes along its edge with a pointed trowel, mouth open in amazement. Finally she stands in a sandy excavation pit beside a colossal carved pharaoh's head, with other workers climbing over the stone around it.

4891.words: campus (noun): the grounds and buildings of a university
4891.asset_description: On a sunny university lawn a blonde student in a white crop top leans far to one side towards the camera and laughs; her friends lean the same way beside her; the camera pulls back to show dozens of students on the grass all leaning sideways in the same pose, with big shade trees, walkways and university buildings behind them.

4929.words: grade (noun): the value your school work is given
4929.asset_description: Seen from behind, a student in a grey hoodie with a backpack runs along a sunlit path across a university campus. He hurries down the aisle of a full lecture theatre towards the speaker at the lectern. A close-up shows his hand writing lines in blue pen in a spiral notebook, with a yellow highlighter and a laptop beside it. A stack of library books and a steaming paper coffee cup stand on a table between the shelves. In the last shot he stands up at his classroom desk with his fist in the air, a paper marked with a large red A on the desk in front of him, while the other students clap and cheer.

5024.words: dictionary (noun): a book that lists words and what they mean
5024.asset_description: In a fairy-lit cafe a curly-haired woman sits at a table with small national flags and thick decorated dictionaries, greets the camera brightly, then jumps up and runs across the room. She sits down opposite a woman in a kimono who bows with pressed palms over an open book, then stands holding a huge stack of dictionaries, each spine carrying a different language. At the end the whole cafe raises coffee cups around her and her tower of books.

5036.words: learn (verb): to get new knowledge or skills
5036.asset_description: In a courtyard between brightly painted apartment blocks a young man in a rust hoodie tries to juggle two balls, fumbles and grabs his head in embarrassment while a young woman in a denim jacket beside him holds more balls and shows him how. He tries again, tossing one ball up and catching it, gets a little further each time, and at the end both of them laugh and she claps.

5115.words: study (verb): to look at something in detail
5115.asset_description: In a meadow full of wild flowers a young woman in an olive rain jacket and a cap, her red hair in plaits, crouches down to a fallen wooden log lying in the grass. She holds a magnifying glass over a small green insect sitting on the bark and moves in close, her eye almost against the lens, studying it from a few centimetres away. Then she turns to an open notebook lying in the grass, full of pencil drawings of insects, and adds a new sketch with her pencil.

5244.words: classmate (noun): a student in the same class at school as you
5244.asset_description: Two teenage boys in navy school hoodies meet in a school corridor lined with coloured lockers and do a clasped-hand shake, laughing. Outside they sit on a wooden bench with their backpacks open, unwrapping a sandwich and holding a red apple while they talk. The shot then widens to the school field, where a crowd of students in the same navy uniform play football on the grass in front of the school building.

5403.words: time (noun): what clocks measure, in hours and minutes
5403.asset_description: A young woman in a beige trench coat stands at a glass tram shelter and runs her finger down a printed timetable, then looks at her wristwatch and smiles. At a station concourse she reads a large departure board full of times and writes in a small spiral notepad. Back on the platform she compares the posted timetable with her watch again while a red train pulls in behind her.

166.asset_description: On a beach at dusk a woman drags a stick through the sand all the way around to draw a huge circle. Friends line it with white shells, then the whole group stands along the ring holding shoulders, forming a human circle seen from above.
166.transcript: All the way round. It's closed!

192.words: corner (noun): the place where two streets meet
192.asset_description: On a construction site, two young people run their hands along the corner of a concrete pillar, fit a triangular wooden board perfectly into the corner between two walls saying "perfect fit", then play peek-a-boo around the corner of tall concrete walls and surprise each other.

675.words: side (noun): the left or right part of something
675.asset_description: In a boatyard, a young man rolls blue paint along the white side of a big wooden boat; more workers join in with rollers until the whole side of the hull is painted bright blue from bow to stern.

743.words: straight (adjective): not bent or curved, in a direct line
743.asset_description: Two bricklayers lay a row of bricks exactly along a stretched string line; the woman sights down the perfectly straight row, winks, then points down a road that runs dead straight to the horizon.

1649.asset_description: A psychedelic drawing where a girl with a teddy bear walks up a rainbow-striped path to a crooked house; trees, ground and sky all glow in wild rainbow colors.

2340.words: strange (adjective): unusual and hard to understand
2340.asset_description: A watercolor drawing of an impossible house made of many mismatched towers, balconies, ladders and pipes stacked on top of each other on a rocky island above water.

2353.words: giant (adjective): far bigger than normal for its kind
2353.asset_description: Giant pink and red mushrooms tower like trees over a small blue river winding through a dense fantasy forest full of flowers and moss.

2572.words: triangle (noun): a flat shape with three straight sides
2572.asset_description: A lone silhouetted man stands on a dark path facing giant glowing neon triangles nested inside each other, floating in front of a futuristic night city.

3747.words: spot (noun): a small round mark with a different colour
3747.asset_description: Painted portrait of a grinning dalmatian puppy with a wide open smile, big shiny eyes and floppy ears, its white fur covered in round black spots, against a sparkling cream background.

4116.words: small (adjective): below average in size or number
4116.asset_description: A car park by the sea. A bearded man in a flat cap and navy jacket pushes a bright red bubble car by hand out of a parking space; the little car is so low that it barely reaches his waist and it is dwarfed on both sides by two enormous black SUVs. He rolls it out, climbs in through the front and drives it along a coastal road, its three wheels and glass bubble roof tiny against the wide blue bay. He parks under a big spreading tree and sits on a bench beside it, with the city skyline across the water, then drives slowly away down the path.

4191.words: tower (verb): to appear very tall and large
4191.asset_description: A young man in a black t-shirt jumps up and down with his arms spread wide on the concrete of a launch site at sunset. Behind him, filling the whole frame, stands an enormous stainless-steel rocket lying on its transporter, so big that he only reaches the height of its lower fins. The shot cuts to a low angle looking straight up the shining rocket into the pink evening sky, then to the rocket standing tall in silhouette between two palm trees with the sun behind it. Back at the transporter he jumps again with both fists in the air.

4394.asset_description: In a garden a woman holds a clear plastic strip in both hands and pulls the ends down so that it curves into an arch in front of her face, pulling a delighted expression. She does the same with a thick tree branch, hauling it down into a curve over her head. Then on the grass a girl in a leotard drops backwards into a full crab position with her whole body arched, while the woman crouches beside her with her mouth open.

4660.words: pile (noun): a heap of things placed on top of each other
4660.asset_description: In a shopping centre a woman in a long red coat staggers along the polished floor with an enormous armful of shopping: stacked gift boxes, hat boxes, paper carrier bags, a scarf and a hat all balanced against her chest, so high they hide her face. A lipstick falls and rolls away on the tiles. The load tips and everything slides out of her arms, boxes and bags tumbling down and spreading across the floor around her feet. She ends up standing over a wide heap of boxes stacked and scattered on the tiles, throwing her hands up.

4663.words: drop (noun): a small round shape, like a bead of liquid
4663.asset_description: A pastel cartoon in soft pinks and greens. A hand in a blue sleeve squeezes the pink rubber bulb of a glass pipette held above a child's forehead. A single large rounded bead of clear liquid has just left the glass tube and hangs in the air, catching the light, with a smaller one still forming at the tip. Below it the child tilts her face up with her eyes shut tight and her mouth pursed, waiting for it to land. A labelled glass bottle stands on a shelf behind them.

4758.words: full (adjective): containing as much as is possible
4758.asset_description: A man in a cream sweater opens a tall fridge-freezer in a bright white kitchen and looks at completely bare shelves. The camera drops to an empty freezer drawer holding only one ice-cube tray. Then hands start loading the shelves: bags of frozen vegetables and berries, tubs, boxes and packets, until every shelf and drawer is packed. The last shot is a wide of the double doors open on a fridge stuffed from top to bottom while the man beams at it.

4797.words: little (adjective): below average in number or quantity
4797.asset_description: At an outdoor restaurant on an Italian street a young waiter in a white shirt and dark apron stands over a checked tablecloth and grates a large block of hard cheese onto a plate of spaghetti with tomato sauce. He keeps going, grinning, as the diner beside him leans in laughing and the cheese buries the pasta. The camera holds on the plate as the shavings pile higher and higher until the food has disappeared under a huge white cone of grated cheese that rises above the wine glasses. In the last shot he holds up the cheese block and grater beside the mountain of cheese and smiles at the camera.

4801.words: tall (adjective): great in height, from the ground up
4801.asset_description: A woman in a conical straw hat and a green apron waters a tray of tiny seedlings in a greenhouse, then waters tomato plants hung with red tomatoes, then stands beside a sunflower far taller than she is and looks up at its big yellow head.

4807.words: orange (adjective): having the color between red and yellow
4807.asset_description: A man in a bright orange sleeveless sports top sits at a weathered wooden table on a sunny sports field and drinks a small glass of orange juice in one go, then lifts the whole glass jug and tips it up over his face, draining it in big greedy gulps, and finally puts it down and breathes out with the empty glasses and the empty jug in front of him.

4844.words: half (noun): one of two equal parts of something
4844.asset_description: In a bright kitchen a young chef in a blue apron runs a long knife through a white onion on a wooden board, leaving a heap of onion rings. Cut to a garden table where an older man in a grey polo presses a knife down through a whole watermelon until the green rind splits in two. Then a bearded man in a checked shirt swings an axe into a big log on a woodpile and it splits open. Finally a woman standing in a huge orange pumpkin in a field raises a long blade over her head and brings it down, and the pumpkin lies open in two seedy halves on the grass.

4895.words: opposite (adjective): directly across from each other
4895.asset_description: A dense crowd stands on a paved city plaza in the evening sun; as the camera lifts, the crowd resolves into two enormous lines of people standing directly across from one another on either side of a wide empty strip of pavement that runs down the whole avenue between office buildings.

4899.asset_description: A hand pulls a carrot out of dark garden soil and it comes up as long as an arm; next two gardeners heave out a white radish taller than they are, with a mass of roots hanging off it; finally a whole group of gardeners lifts a full-grown tree straight out of the ground in a back garden.

5000.words: thin (adjective): not thick from one surface to the other
5000.asset_description: A sushi counter clip. A young chef in a white jacket and a white headband leans over a wooden block and cuts thin flat slices off a long orange fillet of raw fish with a narrow knife. He then presses a handful of rice into shape in his palm and lays the orange slice over it, torches the finished pieces with a small blowtorch, sets a piece down on a grey plate in front of the camera and grins.

5052.words: light (adjective): having little physical weight, not heavy
5052.asset_description: An inked, muted illustration of a railway station hall. A porter's trolley is stacked far too high with battered leather suitcases, canvas bundles and tied sacks, and the whole tower is sliding off. Cases tumble through the air, one lands open on the tiled floor with a wheel spinning away, and a man in a dark jacket throws both hands up as the baggage rains down on him. Blurred travellers and a second trolley stand in the background under the arched glass roof.

5080.words: yellow (adjective): the color between green and orange
5080.asset_description: A young woman in a bright yellow sundress stands in a small clothes boutique in front of a tall wooden-framed mirror and looks at her reflection. She takes a mirror selfie with her phone in front of racks of clothes, then leans towards a vanity mirror ringed with bulbs and checks her face, then spins so the yellow skirt flares out between two mirrors. In the last shot she stands in a room lined with mirrors on the walls and floor, so the yellow dress is repeated in every direction.

5081.words: purple (adjective): the color between red and blue
5081.asset_description: A young man in a blue hoodie stands in a hallway and inspects a silver ring through a small jeweller's magnifier, frowning at it. A blonde woman in a grey t-shirt tucks her hair behind her ear in front of a round black-framed bathroom mirror. A dark-haired woman in a fitted purple dress then walks through a dining room under a chandelier, stops at a tall gold-framed mirror and turns side-on to check how the purple dress fits, and finally looks over her shoulder at the back of it and laughs.

5084.words: green (adjective): the color between blue and yellow
5084.asset_description: At a fashion show, a model with a shaved head and large gold hoop earrings walks straight towards the camera down the runway in a floor-length, loose, shiny green gown with wide draped sleeves. Photographers and seated guests along both sides hold up phones to film her. She comes close enough for the green fabric to fill the frame and looks into the lens, then turns and walks away so the back of the gown swings behind her.

5283.words: tower (noun): anything shaped like a tall column
5283.asset_description: A woman in a bright patchwork shirt and headwrap lowers a huge column of colourful plates into a steel kitchen sink, adding more plates to the top of the stack. Water pours over the tall pile and white foam runs down its sides. She rinses the plates one by one and slots them into the draining rack, and the camera ends on the empty gleaming sink and its drain as she smiles down at it.

5415.words: red (adjective): the color at the end of the spectrum
5415.asset_description: A delivery rider on a scooter waits at a city junction, filmed head-on. The traffic light on the pole behind him shows green, then switches to red - the round red lamp and the red pedestrian figure lit up right above his helmet - and he stays sitting still on the bike. When it goes green again he looks up and rides on. The clip ends on a wide view down a six-lane avenue where rows of motorbikes and cars wait under a line of traffic lights.

5464.words: slim (adjective): having a slender, thin body
5464.asset_description: A watercolour and ink drawing of a woman's body from the neck to the knees. She wears a fitted blue-grey long-sleeved top and dark grey jeans. Her build is narrow and slender: the top follows a thin torso that pulls in above the hips. Her right hand rests flat on her side just above the hip, her left arm hangs down. The background is a plain cream wash.

23.words: speech (noun): a formal talk given to an audience
23.asset_description: An animated woman in a green suit stands at a wooden podium with a microphone in a grand hall and gives a heartfelt speech; she gestures, toasts to the next ten years, and the seated audience smiles and applauds.
23.transcript: Thank you all for coming. You changed my whole life. For the payoff, here's to the next ten years!

57.words: back (noun): the part of a place farthest from the front
57.asset_description: Three friends with popcorn leave the crowded rows near the stage of an open-air amphitheater and climb the stairs all the way up, then sit happily in a completely empty row at the back, far from the concert.

131.words: call (verb): to phone someone and talk to them
131.asset_description: A 3D-animated woman on a flower-covered rooftop balcony answers her phone and has a lively, joyful call with a friend, gasping, laughing and finally promising to see them soon before hugging the phone.
131.transcript: Hello, it's me! No way! Really? Me too. See you soon.

145.words: catching (noun): taking hold of something thrown to you
145.asset_description: A man and a woman throw an orange ball back and forth on a sunny beach, each catching it in the air; the man dives into the sand to catch a long throw and they high-five and laugh.

148.words: celebrate (verb): to do something fun for a special day
148.asset_description: In a hand-painted anime garden at night with paper lanterns, a girl blows out the candles on her birthday cake while two friends clap; a confetti popper goes off and the three hug and cheer.

165.words: cinema (noun): a place where you watch films on a big screen
165.asset_description: Two animated teenagers find their seats in a dark movie theater with a bucket of popcorn. They watch a space cartoon on the big screen, gasp and laugh with wide eyes while munching popcorn in the red seats.

186.words: concert (noun): a show where musicians play live music
186.asset_description: At an open-air concert in a park at sunset, a band plays on a small stage with bunting while a cheering crowd claps and raises their arms; a young woman with a bandana sings along, and a small dog sits on someone's shoulder.

199.words: crash (verb): to hit something hard with a loud noise
199.asset_description: At a night funfair, a man in a bright yellow shirt drives a red bumper car, shouts with joy as he crashes into his friends' bumper cars again and again, and finally cheers into the camera with both arms raised.
199.transcript: I DRIVE THE BUMPER CAR! CRASH! I CRASH INTO MY FRIEND! SO FUN!

213.words: dancing (noun): moving your body to the beat of music
213.asset_description: A woman cooking in a retro kitchen starts swaying and twirling her colorful skirt; her partner joins her and the two dance salsa together around the kitchen, ending with a laughing dip.
213.transcript: (upbeat music) - Come on, you know you want to. - Okay, I love this.

292.words: fight (noun): a struggle where people hit or push each other
292.asset_description: A young couple stands on a bed in a sunny attic bedroom and starts a pillow fight, swinging and blocking with big white pillows. A pillow bursts, feathers explode everywhere, and they collapse laughing on the feather-covered bed, one conceding that the other wins.

353.words: guest (noun): a person you invite to your home
353.asset_description: In a cozy anime apartment on a rainy evening, a host in an apron opens the door to a woman who arrives with a potted flower as a gift; he takes her wet coat, leads her to a candlelit table, drapes her napkin and pours her water before they toast.
353.transcript: Come in, come in! These are for you! Sit, this seat is yours. It smells amazing!

396.words: hug (noun): a close hold with your arms around someone
396.asset_description: At airport arrivals an excited man waits with a small gift as a young woman drops her suitcase and runs to him; they crash into a huge spinning hug and hold each other tight, laughing that they missed each other.
396.transcript: There she is! I missed you so much!

423.words: kiss (verb): to touch someone with your lips to show love
423.asset_description: At a picnic in a poppy field, a young woman blows a kiss to her boyfriend; he playfully catches it, kisses her hand, and then gently kisses her forehead.
423.transcript: Caught it forever mine Best afternoon ever

531.words: party (noun): a get-together where people eat, drink and dance
531.asset_description: At sunset a group of friends holds a garden party with bunting, balloons, a snack table and lemonade; they dance on the grass with a dog running around, throw confetti and raise their cups in a toast.

568.words: pool (noun): a big tank of water that you swim in
568.asset_description: At a sunny outdoor swimming pool ringed by pink flowering bushes, a woman relaxes on an orange inflatable ring while two guys cannonball off the edge one after another, sending up huge splashes and laughter. Afterwards the men float on their backs beside her in the turquoise water.

623.words: rude (adjective): not polite, showing no respect for others
623.asset_description: A young man in a cafe drops into a chair, puts his muddy boots up on the table next to his croissant, and stays glued to his phone while the waitress serves him; he mutters a dismissive remark instead of thanking her and later shoves past other customers on his way out.

697.words: smoking (noun): breathing in from a lit cigarette
697.asset_description: Outside a bar at night a bearded man smokes a cigarette and taps the ash into an ashtray; nearby a woman lights an older woman's cigarette, and the smokers stand together puffing clouds under the street lights.

715.words: someone (noun): a person, but you do not know or say who
715.asset_description: A woman arrives at her office desk and finds a coffee, a fresh bun and a smiley-face sticky note that someone left for her; she scans the open-plan office and questions a coworker trying to work out who it was, then gives up and happily sips the coffee holding the note.

899.words: afternoon (noun): the part of the day between noon and evening
899.asset_description: Three young friends lounge on a blanket in a sunlit green park on a warm afternoon, laughing as one of them dangles grapes and a straw hat flies through the air between them.

1064.words: everybody (noun): all people, each person in a group
1064.asset_description: At a street party with colorful bunting and long dinner tables, every single person in the crowd raises their arms and cheers while a couple dances in the middle under falling petals.

1107.words: girlfriend (noun): a young woman you are dating
1107.asset_description: A young man hugs his laughing girlfriend from behind in a garden strung with warm fairy lights at dusk; she holds his cheek and beams at the camera.

1215.words: neighbor (noun): a person who lives next door or near you
1215.asset_description: Two middle-aged men in t-shirts lean on the wooden garden fence between their suburban houses and chat, one holding gardening gloves and both laughing.

1319.words: single (adjective): not married or in a relationship
1319.asset_description: A woman sits alone and content at a small cafe table by the window, eyes closed with a peaceful smile, one cup of coffee in front of her and an empty saucer opposite.

1396.words: theater (noun): a building where people watch plays
1396.asset_description: A woman in a dark suit stands on stage behind sweeping red velvet curtains, looking out over the empty gilded auditorium of a grand old theater with rows of red seats and balconies.

1429.words: to sing (verb): to make music with your voice
1429.asset_description: A young man with curly hair sings into a microphone on a stand in a cozy lamp-lit living room while friends sit on sofas around him and watch.

1433.words: to dance (verb): to move your body to music
1433.asset_description: Two people in feathered Native American costumes dance in a living room while a man in a red cape and fairy-tale dress sings into a microphone behind them.

1575.words: couple (noun): two people in a romantic relationship
1575.asset_description: On a dark hilltop between pine trees, the silhouettes of a man and a woman embrace, she on tiptoe with one leg raised, holding an umbrella under a crescent moon, shooting stars and a flock of birds.

1800.words: hide (verb): to keep yourself or something from being seen
1800.asset_description: A young man and woman hide the lower halves of their faces behind an open book, glancing at each other with amused eyes.

1863.words: hang (verb): to attach something high up so it drops down
1863.asset_description: A silhouetted couple sits on a swing whose ropes hang from a huge full moon, floating high above a glowing night city.

2101.words: together (adverb): with each other, close or touching
2101.asset_description: A watercolor city scene in falling snow: a couple walks close together down a wet street under two orange umbrellas, other pedestrians and old lampposts fading into the white haze.

2224.words: hold hands (phrase): to walk or stand with your fingers joined
2224.asset_description: Seen from behind, a young couple in blue and red jackets holds hands on a rainy city street, with umbrellas, wet reflections and glowing lanterns around them.

2330.words: give (verb): to cause someone to have something
2330.asset_description: A woman's outstretched arm holds up three yellow flowers against a plain bright blue background, offering them toward the viewer.

2333.words: in love (phrase): having strong romantic feelings for someone
2333.asset_description: A young man and woman hold each other closely among falling orange autumn leaves, faces almost touching, both smiling with closed eyes.

2480.words: present (noun): a gift you give someone
2480.asset_description: A red vintage car drives through falling snow with a Christmas tree and a tall stack of colorful wrapped presents piled on its roof.

2492.words: busy (adjective): full of people and activity
2492.asset_description: A snowy Christmas village is busy with life: lit houses, decorated trees, a blue car, and dozens of people and animals walking, shopping and playing in the snow.

2516.words: year (noun): a period of twelve months
2516.asset_description: A lone figure stands on a mountain top above a sea of clouds and raises one arm toward the glowing golden numbers 2024 burning in the night sky, with a huge spiral galaxy swirling behind them.

2749.words: bar (noun): a place where alcoholic drinks are served
2749.asset_description: A painting seen from behind of a woman with very long curly red hair in a cream dress, sitting on a round stool at a polished wooden counter; shelves of bottles, glasses of red wine, red walls and a chandelier fill the room.

2788.words: blow (verb): to push air out of your mouth to move something
2788.asset_description: A glowing meadow scene: a kneeling girl with translucent insect wings, a yellow-green dress and a flower crown holds a flat palm in front of her pursed lips and blows petals and butterflies into the air, where they form the words happy birthday.

2887.words: fireworks (noun): things that explode in the sky with colour
2887.asset_description: A watercolour of a row of brightly coloured narrow houses with lit windows under a deep blue night sky, where red, gold and blue fireworks burst above the rooftops around the golden number 2025.

3024.words: to hold hands (phrase): to link your fingers with another person's
3024.asset_description: A cropped anime-style drawing on a black background showing a boy from behind in a white shirt and dark jeans, his hand reaching back and gripping the hand of a person in a pink sleeve beside him.

3141.words: group (noun): a number of people or things taken as a unit
3141.asset_description: Flat minimal illustration seen from above: five people in autumn-coloured clothes sit in a circle on low benches and on the floor, facing each other in conversation, with long soft shadows on a plain beige floor.

3390.words: to kiss (verb): to touch someone with your lips
3390.asset_description: Anime-style illustration of a young couple standing in a garden full of red roses with a wooden gazebo behind them; the man in a cream jacket and yellow scarf holds the woman in a pink dress by the waist as they kiss with their eyes closed.

3629.words: to shake hands (phrase): to grip another person's palm to greet them
3629.asset_description: Retro sci-fi poster: an astronaut in a white suit and helmet stands on a grey planet and shakes hands with a tall thin green-yellow alien. Domed buildings, a crescent moon and a ringed planet fill the starry sky behind them.

4007.words: dark (noun): when there is no light
4007.asset_description: At night a group of young men stand on a concrete ledge above a river, lighting the scene only with their phone torches. One of them takes off, tucks into a front flip and lands on a round trampoline set on the dirt below. The others lean over the ledge, sweeping their torch beams into the blackness, and two pale animal shapes appear far off on the track.

4038.words: love (verb): to have great affection for someone
4038.asset_description: A convertible car drives at night along a resort road lined with lit palm trees and low houses. Inside, a young man drives with one hand on the wheel and a young woman in a pale yellow cardigan sits beside him; they glance at each other and smile. She reaches across and lays her hand palm up on his knee, he takes it, and they hold hands over the centre console. The last shot is a close-up of their two hands raised together with the fingers interlocked.

4056.words: celebration (noun): a joyful event to mark a happy occasion
4056.asset_description: At night on a city pavement in front of a brick wall, a woman in a black dress and black high heels holds a bottle of champagne with both hands, laughing. She works the cork loose and the bottle erupts: a thick white jet of foam shoots several metres into the air and rains back down over the pavement. She screams, crouches down and holds the gushing bottle out in front of her at arm's length while the foam keeps fountaining up and spreads in a wide white pool across the paving stones.

4101.words: show (verb): to present something to an interested audience
4101.asset_description: A circus arena in a spotlight, with rows of the audience in silhouette. A performer in a blue costume stands on a gold pedestal and lifts a huge sheet of white cloth above their head, then opens their arms so the cloth falls into an enormous cone around them, spreading across the ring like a gown. The crowd hold up phones to film. The white cloth is then whipped away and in its place a giant peacock tail opens out in orange, white and green with a blue wheel at its centre, and the audience raise their hands and cheer.

4104.words: kiss (noun): the act of caressing someone with the lips
4104.asset_description: An animated park scene with cartoon pigeons. A small grey pigeon stands beside a much larger dark blue pigeon that leans over it; the small one glares up with narrowed eyes. A white pigeon with pink feathers stands next to it, half-closing her eyes. The camera holds close on the small grey pigeon while its eyebrows lower and its face turns sour. At the end the white pigeon leans in and presses her beak to its cheek in a kiss; the grey pigeon's cheeks turn bright red and it keeps scowling while blushing.
4104.transcript: What's up? He was asking for directions. Cool, cool, cool, cool. Were you jealous?

4105.words: boyfriend (noun): the man a girl or young woman is in love with
4105.asset_description: An animated city street at sunset. A young woman with long black hair, a black leather jacket, cream trousers and a small red shoulder bag walks along the pavement, smiling and touching her hair. Ahead of her a young man in a leather jacket leans against a black car holding a huge bouquet of pink and cream peonies. She sees him, stops, and covers her mouth with her hand, eyes wide. He steps forward and holds the flowers out to her; she buries her face in the bouquet, then they stand close together behind the flowers, smiling at each other in the golden light.

4179.words: birthday (noun): the yearly celebration of the day you were born
4179.asset_description: A white-haired woman in a blue blouse sits at a table behind a large white cake with blue piping and three silver candles shaped as a 1, a 0 and a 0. Hands hang a colourful HAPPY BIRTHDAY banner on the black wall behind her and balloons show at the edges of the frame. Wearing a small tiara and a pair of pixel sunglasses, she blows the candles out one after another and then laughs at the camera.

4181.words: offer (verb): to make something available to someone
4181.asset_description: In an empty car park at sunset an old woman in a bright pink cardigan sits on a red mobility scooter. Someone in front of her holds out a round turquoise cake covered in rainbow sprinkles on a white board and presses silver 1, 0 and 0 candles into the icing. She drives the scooter after the cake, laughing, and reaches out both hands for the plate as it is held towards her.

4317.words: apologize (verb): to admit your faults and say sorry
4317.asset_description: A cafe table by a window. A man in a camel coat and a woman in a black polo neck both freeze open-mouthed as spilled drink spreads across the wooden table and soaks the open sketchbook in front of her. He leans in talking fast, pulls napkins from the holder and blots the wet page, then lifts the book clear. He comes back with a cup of coffee, sets it down in front of her and speaks with his hands open; she turns to him and smiles.

4373.asset_description: A man sits at a small street bar as a bottle of beer is slid to him across the wooden counter. Inside, under coloured lights, a barman shakes a metal shaker and strains an orange drink into a wide glass in front of him. The clip ends on a rooftop at dusk where a group of friends have come together along a long marble counter under strings of bulbs and all reach in to clink their glasses.

4393.words: chat (verb): to talk in a friendly, relaxed way
4393.asset_description: An older man in a flat cap sits on a wooden bench in a park, opens a paper bag of grain and scatters it on the path, and pigeons crowd around his feet. The shot moves to a seafront promenade with palm trees, where he sits on a metal bench by the blue sea with the bag still in his hand, and then he is sitting shoulder to shoulder with two other older men on the bench, all of them talking and laughing together.

4439.words: festival (noun): a day or period set aside for celebration
4439.asset_description: A photograph taken at dusk in a narrow cobbled street between old colonial houses with lit windows and glowing wall lamps. In the middle a young drummer marches towards the camera wearing an enormous headdress of green, blue and gold feathers and a matching feathered shoulder piece over a bare chest, a big wooden barrel drum slung at his waist and a beater raised in his hand. Behind and beside him a whole band of drummers in bright shirts play more drums, dancers in gold costumes move among them, and paper streamers in green, yellow and pink fly through the air with bunting strung overhead and the low sun burning at the end of the street.

4490.words: prepare (verb): to make ready in advance
4490.asset_description: A woman in a green dress sits at a long wooden dining table that has already been laid with plates and cutlery. She strikes a match and holds it to the wick of a tall cream candle in a grey holder until it catches. She then works her way down the table lighting one candle after another with the match. In the last shots the room is dark, the whole row of candles is burning down the middle of the laid table, and she sits at the end of it looking down the table and smiling, waiting for her guests.

4503.asset_description: A birthday party in a small flat decorated with paper chains, fairy lights and balloons. A woman in a pink dress and a silver party hat stands in the doorway while friends hold a white and black drip cake in front of her and light the row of candles. She closes her eyes for a second, then leans forward and blows the candles out; smoke rises from the cake, everyone throws up their arms and cheers, and her friends crowd in to hug her around the table.

4597.words: culture (noun): the tastes in art and manners of a social group
4597.asset_description: A watercolour of an evening folk festival under a canopy strung with paper lanterns. Two couples in embroidered shirts and waistcoats dance in the middle of a wooden floor; the woman in front spins so hard that her striped red skirt and the coloured ribbons in her flower crown fly out around her. On the right a fiddler draws his bow, in the foreground a drummer beats a big frame drum, and market stalls hung with pottery and woven cloth stand behind, where other people clap along.

4608.words: crowd (noun): a large group of people packed together
4608.asset_description: A run of street-dance scenes. A breakdancer flips upside down on a sunny city plaza inside a ring of people who clap and film him. Then women in wide rainbow-coloured folk skirts spin in the middle of a street while onlookers press in on both sides. Next about ten dancers move as one down the aisle of a shopping centre, with shoppers gathering along the sides. Finally the camera lifts to show hundreds of people filling a whole city square at dusk, all dancing the same steps in rows that run back to the buildings.

4615.asset_description: A room is being decorated for a party. Two hands press a paper chain against a white wall, running through red, orange, yellow, green and blue links. Pale pink and deep blue balloons are stuck to the wall above a grey sofa. The rainbow chain is then strung in a curve above a row of grey triangular bunting. In the evening the room is lit up: a man on a stepladder hangs bright garlands under a canopy of fairy lights while a woman holds a pink balloon, and the whole floor disappears under hundreds of pink, blue, orange, yellow and silver balloons.

4644.words: excuse (noun): a defense of some bad behavior or failure
4644.asset_description: A young man in a black jacket stands in a hallway looking at his phone with a pained face as he apologises. In the kitchen behind him another young man in a stained apron is serving a hot pan of stew onto a table laid for three, under a paper banner reading 'Congratulations'. The friend leaves through the door; the cook is left standing alone at the table, then sits down by himself in front of the untouched dish and the single candle.
4644.transcript: I'm so sorry. Work. Right. Sorry.

4712.words: blow (verb): to push air out of your mouth to move something
4712.asset_description: A young man puts his mouth close to a window furred with white frost and breathes hard on the glass until a clear round hole opens in it and his face shows through. He is then at a party with friends around him, leaning over a birthday cake covered in lit candles; he purses his lips, breathes out hard and the flames go out. Next he leans over a row of coloured paper party blowers on a white table and puffs them so they uncoil and shoot out one after another. Finally a long table crowded with dozens of candles and a room full of friends all lean in and puff together, then cheer with their arms up under the streamers and fairy lights.

4780.words: separate (adjective): independent, not joined to each other
4780.asset_description: A plain office with a venetian blind. A man and a woman sit side by side at a wooden table, each with their own printed document and pen in front of them, and each signs their own sheet. They then twist the wedding rings off their fingers and set the two rings down on the bare table between the papers. Both stand, turn away from each other, and walk out of the room through two different grey doors, leaving the two documents, the two pens and the two rings behind on the table.

4783.words: couple (noun): two people in a romantic relationship
4783.asset_description: A young woman with curly hair carries a small chocolate cake with one lit candle up behind a young man sitting indoors; he turns and his mouth falls open. The scene cuts to an outdoor basketball court at sunset where he dribbles a ball with the low sun behind him, then to the same woman standing under the hoop holding up a handmade sign with a red heart on it and cheering. In the last shots the two of them stand face to face with white cake frosting smeared over their cheeks and chins, laughing, then lean into the camera together with a lit dome and Paris rooftops behind them.

4784.words: give (verb): to cause someone to have something
4784.asset_description: A large family party in a house hung with cut-paper bunting. A man holds out a wrapped present with a purple bow to a very old woman, who takes it with both hands while relatives watch and smile. She is then handed an open tin of chocolate-chip cookies by a middle-aged woman in a floral shirt. A young woman opens a photo album and gasps at a picture inside while an older man looks over her shoulder. In the final shots the whole family crowds around a table loaded with food and passes small wrapped boxes from hand to hand across it.

4820.words: same (adjective): the same one, not a different one
4820.asset_description: Two young women meet face to face in a club with purple and pink neon lights behind them. They are wearing exactly the same patterned mini dress, and they stare at each other's dress with their mouths open. The blonde one shouts angrily at the other, then her face breaks into a smile as they talk it over; the dark haired one starts to cry and laugh at once, and the two of them fall into a long hug in their matching dresses.
4820.transcript: Stress. Tim is coming today. Tim? Really? Then I'll go home and change. This is the strongest friendship.

4822.words: message (noun): a short written or spoken communication
4822.asset_description: A young woman in a white summer playsuit sits on the edge of a bed typing on her phone with both thumbs and grinning at the screen. She carries on reading and typing standing in a bright kitchen, laughing at what she reads. Back in the bedroom she sits cross legged on the bed holding the phone and beaming into the camera, then throws herself backwards onto the covers kicking her legs in the air, and finally pulls the white duvet right over herself so only a foot sticks out.

4840.words: hide (verb): to keep yourself or something from being seen
4840.asset_description: A dark room where someone is pressed behind a heavy beige curtain with only a hand showing at the gap. Cut to an office, where a grinning man in a blue polo shirt is folded up under a desk with his arms round his knees. Then a small boy in a red shirt presses himself against a wide tree trunk in a park and peers round it with wide eyes. A quiet living room with an empty fireplace swings past, and finally a whole group of people leap up from behind a sofa with their arms in the air as confetti falls.

4897.words: join (verb): to become part of a group
4897.asset_description: On a city square a small group of friends huddles in a tight group hug with their arms around each other; passers-by walk over and wrap their arms around the outside, and more and more people keep attaching themselves until a large mass of people is pressed into one huge hug.
4897.transcript: Yes! Yes! Yes! Yes! Yes! Yes! Yes!

4922.words: host (noun): the person who invites guests and cares for them
4922.asset_description: A young man in a waistcoat and shirt opens the door of his flat and waves people in. He gathers their coats in his arms and hangs them on hooks in the hall. In the kitchen he slides two tall glasses of sparkling water across the counter towards the camera. At a candlelit table set with pasta, salad, bread and wine, the guests laugh together; he stands at the head of the table and lifts his glass to them.

4924.words: familiar (adjective): easily recognized because you know it well
4924.asset_description: A young woman in an oversized beige sweater stands on a city pavement beside a pastel coffee kiosk, looking down at her phone. She glances up at a man in a denim jacket and her face opens in recognition; both of them point at each other and start talking. They shake hands warmly next to the kiosk window, then stand facing each other holding takeaway coffee cups and carry on chatting.

4954.words: visit (noun): going to see someone for a short time
4954.asset_description: A woman in a bright yellow raincoat walks away from the camera across a car park towards a modern hospital with a red cross sign, carrying tulips and a round balloon, with an ambulance parked at the side. She goes through the sliding glass doors, along a long white corridor past open ward doors, and pushes open the door of a patient room. Inside, a young woman in a hospital gown is sitting up in bed; she claps her hands and beams when she sees the flowers and the balloon.

4993.words: alone (adjective): kept apart from others, on your own
4993.asset_description: A woman in a chunky cream jumper paddles a red canoe straight toward the camera across a huge, glassy blue lake. The drone pulls back and up and she is the only person on the water. She reaches a tiny rock island with a single pine tree on it, steps out and stands there by herself, the whole scene mirrored in the still water.

5012.words: romance (noun): a loving relationship between two people
5012.asset_description: At a Paris cafe two young women in coats lean in close over a marble bistro table holding two cappuccinos. Then an elderly couple at a cafe table hold each other's faces and kiss. Next a young couple kisses in front of the Eiffel Tower, the man leaning the woman backwards, and they end in a long hug on the pavement while cafe guests watch.

5025.words: joke (noun): a funny remark that causes laughter
5025.asset_description: In a university lecture room a student with bright blue hair looks at something on his phone and starts laughing. The classmates around him crack up too, one throwing his head back, until the whole room is roaring. Then a teacher walks in and stands at the whiteboard, the class sits back down at their laptops, and one boy is left lying on the floor between the desks still shaking.

5044.words: hear (verb): to notice a sound with your ears
5044.asset_description: A montage of people taking in sounds. A young man in a sunlit room wears big over-ear headphones, eyes closed and smiling as music plays. Two women sit over coffee in a cafe, one talking with her hand at her temple while the other leans in towards her. A man in a blue shirt presses the side of his face and a cupped hand against a closed office door in a corridor, eyes wide. Finally a festival crowd stands in front of a lit stage at dusk, some of them pressing their hands over their ears.
5044.transcript: God, save that for the camera.

5068.words: bride (noun): the woman getting married that day
5068.asset_description: A wedding ceremony on a beach under a white rose arch, with the sea and cliffs behind. The bride, in a long white dress and a veil, slides a ring onto the groom's finger while he smiles down at her. He then takes her face in his hands and they kiss; the seated guests stand and applaud, and the two hold hands and laugh together under the arch.

5074.words: introduce (verb): to make people come to know each other
5074.asset_description: A woman in an orange blazer walks into a bright open-plan office on her first day, carrying a cardboard box of desk things. One colleague after another steps up to shake her hand while she balances the box on one arm, and at the end the whole team stands around her, smiling and applauding as she shakes yet another hand.
5074.transcript: Hi there, nice to meet you. Welcome aboard!

5076.words: member (noun): one of the persons who joined a group
5076.asset_description: A young man with a backpack holds his card against the reader at a gym turnstile; a green tick lights up and he walks through into the gym. The clip cuts to a library chess club, where a smiling elderly woman arrives at a table of chess boards, sits down, and the other players wave, make a move on the board and applaud her as one of them.

5250.asset_description: A drawn illustration of a smiling woman sitting at a wooden desk in a bright office. She wears a headset and also holds the handset of a corded desk telephone to her ear with one hand while she writes in an open notebook with the other. Behind her a round wall clock hangs above a filing cabinet stacked with coloured ring binders, and a window throws pale light across the wall. On the desk stand a coffee mug, a wooden paper tray holding a stack of blank sheets, a small potted plant and the edge of a keyboard.

5271.words: cry (noun): a loud shout or call
5271.asset_description: Three hikers with big backpacks stand at a wooden railing on the rim of the Grand Canyon under a clear blue sky. One after another they cup their hands round their mouths and yell out over the canyon with their mouths wide open, then all three yell together with their arms flung out towards the drop.

5277.words: agree (verb): to be in agreement with someone
5277.asset_description: A boy and a girl run through a living room, then whisper and laugh together under a white sheet stretched into a den. At a table they both grip the same chocolate-chip cookie and pull, faces screwed up, until it breaks into two halves and each keeps one. The clip ends in a sunny back garden where a big group of children run across the grass and then flop down in one laughing pile.

5287.words: silence (noun): when no one is speaking
5287.asset_description: Two teenagers in a bedroom hold up a sparkly silver top and laugh, then lean into the camera and blow a kiss. One sits behind the other on the bed and plaits her hair. The clip cuts to a living room where about fifteen girls are packed onto a sofa and the floor, all shouting and laughing at the camera at the same time.

5318.words: speak (verb): to express something in speech
5318.asset_description: A young woman in a red blazer stands on a low wooden platform in a European city square and speaks into a microphone on a stand. A crowd presses around her, many of them filming with their phones. She gestures with one arm while she talks, then raises her fist and the crowd claps.

5348.words: thank (verb): to express gratitude to someone
5348.asset_description: On a wet London street a young woman's sheets of paper are scattered across the road; a young man kneels down, gathers them up and hands them back, and she smiles at him. Later, at a bus stop in the rain, an older man in a suit holds his umbrella over her head and points out the right bus. A red double-decker pulls in, and as she steps aboard she turns back, waves and thanks him while he keeps the umbrella up.

5381.words: conversation (noun): an informal exchange of ideas by speaking
5381.asset_description: Four short scenes of people speaking with each other. A man in a hoodie walks along a busy New York street with a phone at his ear, answering and gesturing with his free hand. Two women in a cafe lean towards each other over their cappuccinos, one telling something and the other reacting with wide eyes. An elderly woman and a middle-aged man stand on either side of a white picket fence in a sunny front garden and lean in to talk across it. Finally a family around a lit dinner table talk over each other, pointing and laughing.

5382.words: discuss (verb): to talk about something and examine it
5382.asset_description: At a long cafe table on a sunlit Italian piazza, a grey-haired woman in glasses turns to the young man beside her and makes a point with both hands while he answers her back. More friends arrive and sit down along the same table of espresso cups and water glasses, and each of them joins in, leaning forward, putting a view to the others and answering what is said, until the whole table is turned in towards the middle, gesturing and laughing.
5382.transcript: No way! No way! No way! Is that so?

5457.words: visitor (noun): someone who comes to visit you
5457.asset_description: A young woman with a long red braid and a young man carrying a pink and blue box walk up to a small blue wooden cottage buried in hanging flowers. The bright blue door opens and an old woman in a headscarf leans out, beaming at them; she comes onto the step and the two young people wrap her in a hug. Inside the low wooden kitchen they lift a cream cake out of its box onto a small table beside a jar of sunflowers, the young woman pours from a white kettle into enamel mugs, and all three lean over the cake together, laughing.

5495.words: rumor (noun): a story passed around by word of mouth
5495.asset_description: In a grand old library reading room with green banker's lamps and tall bookshelves, a student in a shirt and striped tie leans across the long table, cups his hand around his mouth and passes something on to the next person. One after another the students at the table turn sideways, listen, react with wide eyes and a smirk, and pass it along the row. The last shot shows the whole row of students leaning in and giggling over their open books.

5506.words: dance (noun): a party where people meet to dance
5506.asset_description: Outdoors at sunset on a street basketball court beside a graffiti wall. A girl in a tie-dye set dances and dribbles a basketball while the friends around her clap and dance with her; the camera pulls back and the gathering keeps growing until a huge crowd fills the whole street, everyone dancing with their arms in the air, while a skateboarder rolls through the middle.

342.words: goggles (noun): big glasses with a band that cover your eyes
342.asset_description: An animated girl at an indoor pool straps blue swim goggles over her eyes, gives a thumbs up to her coach, then dives in and swims underwater wearing them.
342.transcript: Strap on! Nice and tight! Now I can see! Ha! Two big circles!

370.words: helmet (noun): a hard hat that protects your head
370.asset_description: A girl at a skatepark shows a red helmet to the camera, puts it on and clicks the chin strap, then tries a skateboard, tumbles onto a blue crash mat and sits up smiling, tapping the helmet to show she is fine.

401.words: ice skates (noun): boots with blades for gliding on frozen water
401.asset_description: A young woman laces up white ice skates on a frozen lake, then glides off and does a spraying stop, laughing with a friend nearby.

597.words: racket (noun): a bat with strings for hitting a ball
597.asset_description: On a tennis court a young woman in pink holds a black racket up to the camera, peers through the strings, spins and flips it in her hand, bounces a ball on the strings and then hits a forehand over the net, smiling.

617.words: rollerblades (noun): boots with a line of small wheels for skating
617.asset_description: A young woman buckles on purple rollerblades in a park full of fallen jacaranda petals, skates along the path toward the camera, crouches into a fast glide and stops with a petal spray beside a man on a bench, grabbing his drink.

707.words: snowboard (noun): a wide board for sliding down slopes in winter
707.asset_description: On a sunny mountain slope above a fjord, a rider in a turquoise suit straps both boots onto an orange snowboard, rides off carving down the piste, and stops with a playful spray of snow next to a friend sitting on the slope.
707.transcript: Just this. All good. No way!

756.words: surfboard (noun): the long board you stand on to ride waves
756.asset_description: On a tropical beach a woman rubs wax onto her long white surfboard, carries it into the sea, paddles out lying on it, pops up to ride a small wave, and hugs the board laughing in the shallows.

1048.words: dumbbell (noun): a short bar with a weight at each end
1048.asset_description: A focused young man in a gray tank top curls a heavy iron dumbbell with one arm in a dark gym, veins standing out on his forearm.

1917.words: speed (noun): how fast something moves, distance per time
1917.asset_description: A flat vector poster of a person in profile wearing a red racing helmet with an orange lightning-style logo and a thin headset microphone, against a big pale circle.

2060.words: skis (noun): a pair of long narrow boards for moving on snow
2060.asset_description: A pair of red-and-yellow skis with two ski poles stands upright in the snow on a slope, with layered blue mountains and a pale sun behind them.

3357.words: net (noun): a wall of string with holes across a court
3357.asset_description: Simple pencil drawing of a tennis court: an umpire in a cap sits writing at the top of a tall wooden chair beside the net, while a small player crouches ready on the far side of the court.

4033.words: club (noun): a thick stick that is larger at one end
4033.asset_description: A strip of green artificial putting turf is laid across the carpet of a living room. In the foreground a pink golf ball sits on a wooden tee stuck into a red toy brick. At the far end a man in a purple t-shirt lines up with a golf club, swings it and hits a ball down the strip. He immediately throws both arms straight up, jumps and runs off to the side while a friend sitting on the floor cheers with him.

4288.words: target (noun): a point or object to shoot at
4288.asset_description: A young archer stands on an open grass steppe drawing a recurve bow back to her cheek with one eye squeezed shut in concentration; the shot cuts down the range to three round black-and-white bullseye targets standing in the grass with green hills behind them, then back to her holding her aim while teammates in tracksuits watch from behind.

4304.words: football (noun): the oval ball used in American football
4304.asset_description: Golden evening light on a suburban street. A bearded man in a cream-and-brown varsity jacket and a grey cap has just released an oval brown ball, which hangs in the air at the top right of the frame. Behind him a white clapboard house flies a striped flag from its porch, a chrome-sided diner stands across the road and an old muscle car is parked at the kerb.

5267.words: gun (noun): a weapon that fires a bullet at high speed
5267.asset_description: At a biathlon shooting range, a female athlete in a turquoise race suit lies prone on a mat in the snow with her rifle resting on its stand. She sights along the barrel at a row of five round metal targets set out across the snow, works the bolt and fires. Officials and other athletes stand behind her by the fencing, and at the end she pushes herself up off the mat, smiling.

5288.words: ski (noun): narrow runners used in pairs to glide on snow
5288.asset_description: A skier in a red one-piece suit and helmet carves down a wide groomed piste in bright sun, throwing up a spray of snow on every turn. The camera follows from the side; behind him are snow-covered alpine peaks, a chairlift line and dozens of other skiers spread across the slope.

5293.words: glove (noun): the handwear used to catch a baseball
5293.asset_description: Baseball action in a sunlit stadium: a runner in a white uniform slides feet first through the dirt towards the plate in a cloud of dust; an infielder in a colourful cap crouches low with a leather mitt on his hand as the umpire watches; the runner dives full length head first and reaches the base; the fielder scoops the ball into his glove; a final dive sends dust flying across the base line.

112.words: brave (adjective): not afraid to do something scary or hard
112.asset_description: In a cartoon park a big goose steals a family's picnic basket; while her parents cower behind the fence, a small red-haired girl clenches her fists, marches straight at the goose, stares it down and takes the basket back - then her parents lift her up like a champion with a trophy.
112.transcript: It's coming! Run! Okay, my turn.

214.words: dangerous (adjective): likely to hurt you or cause harm
214.asset_description: In a cartoon winter scene, a boy steps off a dock onto a frozen lake past a warning sign; the ice cracks under his boot and breaks into floes while he wobbles in panic, until his friend pulls him back to the dock and they sit catching their breath.
214.transcript: Stop! Come back! Slowly! New spider out! Slowly! Never again!

381.words: scare (verb): to make someone feel afraid
381.asset_description: A young man stands at a bathroom sink about to eat a grape when a hidden partner jumps out and yells, making him freeze wide-eyed with his mouth open in shock.

498.words: nervous (adjective): worried and a bit scared about what will happen
498.asset_description: Backstage in the dark wings, a young musician with an acoustic guitar peeks through the curtain at the bright stage. He gulps water, breathes with wide anxious eyes and a hand on his chest, and when the stage manager points him on, he steels himself and walks out in front of the crowd.

629.words: safe (adjective): protected from danger, where nothing can hurt you
629.asset_description: Two hikers stumble out of a snowstorm into a stone mountain hut; one bolts the heavy wooden door, hangs up the wet jackets and watches the storm rage outside the window, then they feed the log stove and sit with steaming mugs, sighing with relief that they are fine now.

644.asset_description: A woman with a tote bag walks alone through a dim underground parking garage, hears something, calls out 'Who's there?', lights her phone flashlight, then presses her back against a pillar with wide eyes and both hands clamped over her mouth.

1641.asset_description: A pale woman with clown make-up, a red wig and striped stockings stands in a foggy wasteland with a crow beside her, while two huge yellow reptile eyes glare down from the dark sky.
