1658.asset_description: A dark gothic stone archway covered with red roses opens into a misty glowing corridor; red candles burn on both sides of a black-and-white checkered floor.

1781.words: halloween (noun): the autumn night of scary costumes and pumpkins
1781.asset_description: A dark scene of an old wooden haunted house on a hill with glowing windows, surrounded by bare twisted trees, pumpkins, gravestones and a full moon.

1788.words: monster (noun): a frightening creature that is not real
1788.asset_description: Old engraving of the open sea: a scaly serpent-like creature with a fanged, lion-faced head rears out of the waves carrying a woman and a small winged child, while two faces in the clouds blow wind across the water toward a distant town.

1921.words: shocked (adjective): very surprised and upset by something bad
1921.asset_description: A painting in the style of The Scream: a pale figure with huge round eyes and a wide-open mouth screams on a swirling road by the water under a red-streaked sky.

2038.asset_description: A screenprint-style poster in only red, black and grey: a girl in a red hood stands wide-eyed and afraid in a dark forest before a full moon, with a large red bird beside her and a sinister red-eyed bird looming above.

2314.words: ghost (noun): the spirit of a dead person
2314.asset_description: A textured storybook illustration of a classic white sheet ghost with two black oval eyes standing among green and golden leafy plants under a sparkling night sky.

2425.words: frame (noun): a decorated border that surrounds a picture
2425.asset_description: A black cat sits inside an ornate dark frame decorated with black roses and vines, with a spooky gothic castle rising in the mist behind it.

2964.words: to breathe (verb): to draw air into your lungs and let it out
2964.asset_description: A warm flat illustration of a woman sitting cross-legged on the floor of a dim bedroom at night, eyes closed, one hand on her chest and one on her stomach, with a lit candle and a glowing lamp beside her.

3041.words: worried (adjective): feeling nervous that something bad may happen
3041.asset_description: Cartoon of a wide-eyed boy at a cluttered desk with a laptop and a mug of coffee, frowning anxiously; the wall behind him is plastered with papers, notes and magazine pages.

3809.words: help (verb): to give help or assistance to someone
3809.asset_description: A flat vector illustration shows a single dark-skinned hand reaching up out of deep blue water with bubbles rising around it, towards a red-and-white life ring floating on the surface above.

4075.words: danger (noun): the condition of being open to harm
4075.asset_description: A drone looks straight down at turquoise open sea. In the middle of the frame one woman in a dark swimsuit floats face down on the surface with her arms stretched out to the sides and her legs together, completely still. All around her, filling the whole picture, dozens of large sharks swim in every direction, some passing directly under her body, others crossing within a metre of her hands and feet. The camera holds and slowly drifts; the sharks keep circling and criss-crossing around her and she never moves.

4729.asset_description: Two young women walk through a dark haunted-house corridor at a funfair, hung with fake cobwebs and strings of coloured lights. They cling to each other with their eyes wide and their mouths open, edging forward. A masked figure in a white mask appears in the corridor behind them and they bolt, running towards the camera through a black curtain. They burst out into the daylight of the fairground, still gripping each other's hands, panting with their hands pressed to their chests.

72.words: basketball (noun): a team game of throwing a ball through a hoop
72.asset_description: In a Pixar-style street court a tall girl in a yellow jersey dribbles between two defenders, drives to the hoop, leaps and dunks the ball, then hangs on the rim as everyone hugs and celebrates.
72.transcript: Hey! No way! Woohoo! Oh God! That was good!

274.words: everyone (noun): all the people in a place
274.asset_description: In a packed football stadium a fan with a painted face and rainbow scarf screams with joy, and the camera pulls back over the stands. Every single person in the huge crowd is on their feet cheering with raised arms at the same moment.

309.words: football (noun): a game where two teams kick a ball into a goal
309.asset_description: Young people play barefoot football on a beach at sunset. A woman in a green shirt dribbles past defenders in the sand and shoots at a goal by the water; the keeper dives and shouts 'No way!' as the ball flies past. She drops to her knees celebrating and her friends pile on her in a hug.

323.words: game (noun): a sports match with rules and a score
323.asset_description: Friends play a pickup basketball game on an outdoor court at sunset; a red-haired woman dribbles past defenders, the ball drops through the hoop and her team hugs and cheers.

340.words: goal (noun): the net that players kick the ball into
340.asset_description: Friends carry a white goal frame onto a cobblestone town square and set it up; a young man dribbles and kicks the ball past the diving keeper into the goal, and the players jump and celebrate while two old men watch from a bench.

373.words: stadium (noun): a big sports ground with seats all around
373.asset_description: A blond man in a gray lion-print shirt walks up a concrete tunnel and stairs and comes out inside a huge stadium packed with fans in red, then stands looking out over the green football pitch.

385.words: hit (verb): to bring your hand or a bat hard against something
385.asset_description: A 3D-animated girl in a baseball uniform swings her bat at home plate, hits the ball high into the sunset sky and sprints toward first base while the crowd watches.

400.words: ice hockey (noun): a team game on frozen water with sticks and a puck
400.asset_description: At an indoor rink a girl in a maroon jersey number 9 skates the puck around an orange cone, exchanges passes with a teammate and shoots past the goalie; the two players hug against the boards while fans cheer behind the glass.

445.words: line (noun): a long thin mark on a surface
445.asset_description: A young woman in wellies pushes a line-marking machine across a grass sports field, painting fresh white paint onto the grass. A drone shot then shows the long straight white line she has drawn across the whole pitch.

532.words: pass (verb): to kick or throw a ball to someone on your team
532.asset_description: On a paved plaza in a colorful mountain town, players in teal shirts play street football against a defender; the man passes the ball to his teammate, she takes it, shoots at the small goal and the two celebrate with a hug.

558.words: play (verb): to take part in a game or sport
558.asset_description: An animated group of friends plays volleyball in a sunny park: a man dives for the ball and loses his hat, a woman leaps to spike over the net, and the mixed teams end up laughing and hugging on the grass.

559.words: player (noun): a person who takes part in a game or sport
559.asset_description: Under floodlights at night, a football player in a yellow kit dribbles past a defender in blue, fires the ball into the goal, then slides on his knees screaming with joy as teammates pile on top of him.

589.words: pulling (noun): the act of moving something toward you with force
589.asset_description: At a village tug-of-war a man and a woman strain backwards pulling a thick rope until the red marker crosses the chalk line. They win, collapse on the grass laughing, and the onlookers applaud while a dog runs over.

768.words: team (noun): a group of people who work or play together
768.asset_description: In a Ghibli-style anime scene, a rowing crew in matching teal shirts pulls their oars in perfect unison across a misty lake at sunrise, the small coxswain shouting the rhythm. They cross the finish, raise their oars together and lift her up in celebration.
768.transcript: Together and hold! All six now! Yeah! Yeah! That was all of us!

770.words: tennis (noun): a game of hitting a ball over a net with rackets
770.asset_description: A woman in tennis whites serves and rallies against an opponent on an orange clay court lined with cypress trees, sprinting between shots, diving full length for a ball and ending on her knees catching it as onlookers applaud.

800.words: training (noun): practising a sport to get better at it
800.asset_description: Footballers run an evening training session on a floodlit pitch: one dribbles a ball through orange cones while the coach shouts "again!", the squad hops through an agility ladder in bibs, does sit-up drills, and finally collapses on their backs laughing.

871.words: wheelchair (noun): a chair on wheels for someone who cannot walk
871.asset_description: A basketball player in a sports wheelchair speeds across an indoor court, dribbling beside his wheels. He rolls to the hoop, shoots and scores, then fist-pumps and celebrates with a teammate in another wheelchair.

1004.words: coach (noun): someone in charge of training an athlete or team
1004.asset_description: A man with a whistle in his mouth and a clipboard under his arm crouches at the edge of a floodlit pitch, arms spread wide, shouting instructions at players training behind him in the evening cold.

1803.words: throw (verb): to send something through the air
1803.asset_description: A young baseball pitcher in a blue jersey stands on top of a giant baseball and winds up to throw the ball, sand swirling around him under a dramatic sky.

2233.words: baseball (noun): a game where you hit a ball with a bat and run
2233.asset_description: A blonde woman in a striped baseball jersey and matching pants poses holding two big leather baseball gloves, one in each hand.

3127.words: to throw (verb): to make something fly by moving your arm fast
3127.asset_description: Cartoon of a baseball player in a white uniform and red cap on a field, legs wide apart, arm stretched back holding a white ball just before he throws it; a glove is on his other hand.

3274.words: table tennis (noun): a game with small bats and a light plastic ball
3274.asset_description: Stylised illustration of the corner of a blue table tennis table with its dark net stretched across the middle; a red wooden bat and a small white ball lie on the near half, and the table's shadow falls across the floor.

3294.words: to kick (verb): to hit something with your foot
3294.asset_description: Pencil sketch of a footballer in shirt and shorts swinging his leg back over the grass, about to kick a black-and-white football lying beside his standing foot.

3379.words: ball (noun): a round object you hit, throw or kick in games
3379.asset_description: Stylised illustration of a boy in a yellow shirt and green shorts running up to a pale football on bare orange ground in front of a weathered orange wall, while an older boy walks towards him in the background.

4135.words: ball (noun): a round object you hit, throw or kick in games
4135.asset_description: A football pitch of bright green grass with white markings, laid impossibly high in the air with nothing but sky and a distant lake and forest far below its edges. A young woman in a dark football shirt, black shorts and long socks stands over a white and blue ball on the centre spot. She runs up and strikes the round ball towards the goal at the far end, where the keeper dives across. Then she keeps running, straight on across the pitch to where the green grass simply stops, spreads her arms out wide and leaps off the edge, and the shot follows her turning over and over as she falls through empty blue sky.

4154.words: sport (noun): an active game with physical competition
4154.asset_description: On an orange clay court at night, a woman in a black top, white skirt and blue cap serves a tennis ball. She throws the ball high above her head, swings the racket up and hits it, then runs forward into the court. Floodlights light the court, a green fence runs behind her and palm trees and a lit apartment block stand behind that, with two people watching from a balcony. She then waits with the racket in both hands and plays a forehand back.

4264.words: volleyball (noun): a game where two teams hit a ball over a high net
4264.asset_description: A point-of-view shot down a quiet suburban street lined with parked cars and clipped hedges under a blue sky full of white clouds. The camera holder's ringed hands push a yellow and blue volleyball up out of frame; a person in white clothes standing further down the road sets it back, and the ball drops into the waiting hands again.

4268.words: fan (noun): an enthusiastic supporter of a sport
4268.asset_description: In a pale living room a big brown dog sits bolt upright on the sofa like a person, front paws resting on a small black and white football, head turned to a wall-mounted television showing a live football match. A man in checked pyjama trousers lies stretched out on the sofa behind it, half watching. A low table in front holds white roses in a vase and two mugs.

4917.words: shoot (verb): to hit something with a missile from a weapon
4917.asset_description: Two players in padded red and blue overalls and full-face masks face off on a sandy paintball field littered with spent capsules. They bump fists, then sprint apart behind paint-splattered wooden barriers. The red player crouches behind a board holding a paintball marker, then leans out, points the marker and fires. A pink burst of paint explodes across the blue player's chest; he drops to his knees with his hands up while the red player walks past with the marker at his side.

5429.words: trust (verb): to have confidence in other people
5429.asset_description: In a bright sports hall, a blonde woman in black training clothes stands on a wooden plyo box with her arms folded and her eyes shut. A group of men and women in gym gear form two facing lines below her and stretch their arms out with their palms up, hands interlocked. She lets herself fall straight backwards without looking; the group catches her in their linked hands and lowers her gently. Everyone laughs and claps and she grins.

17.words: project (noun): a planned piece of work that takes time
17.asset_description: A group of friends in a field measures and marks planks, drills them together, raises wall frames, and step by step builds a complete wooden shed, celebrating together in front of the finished build.
17.transcript: We build a wooden shed. It is a big project.

118.words: building (noun): the work of making something from parts
118.asset_description: A couple at a community garden builds a raised wooden planter: they hold the frame square, screw the boards together with a cordless drill, check the top with a spirit level, fill it with soil from a wheelbarrow and plant two seedlings, finishing with a high-five.
118.transcript: Hold it square, go! Dead level!

295.words: mix (verb): to stir things together so they become one
295.asset_description: First-person view into a blue bucket as a hand folds and stirs thick pale joint compound with a putty knife. The paste is scooped, turned and smoothed over and over until it looks creamy, in a slow oddly satisfying rhythm.

358.words: hammer (noun): a tool for hitting nails
358.asset_description: In a garage workshop a man sets a nail on the roof of a small wooden birdhouse and drives it in with careful hammer taps while a friend watches; he runs his hand over the flush nail head and the two fist-bump over the finished build.

469.words: matches (noun): small sticks that make fire when struck
469.asset_description: In a cozy wooden cabin at night, a woman slides open a box of matches, takes one out and strikes it, and it flares up on the first try while her friend watches. She uses the burning match to light an oil lamp on the table, then drops the spent match into a clay pot.
469.transcript: (upbeat music) - One good strike. (gasps) - First try. (upbeat music)

618.words: rope (noun): a thick strong cord made of twisted strands
618.asset_description: A cartoon farmer carries a coil of rope, knots it around the wheel of a cart stuck in mud, and pulls hard together with a second farmer until the cart jerks free and both tumble laughing onto the grass, rope in hand.
618.transcript: Tight. Very tight. Ready? Heave! It's coming! It's coming! Woo-hoo!

622.words: rubber band (noun): a small stretchy loop that holds things together
622.asset_description: At a market herb stall, a young woman stretches an orange rubber band wide between her thumbs while a man watches amazed, then she snaps it around a bundle of fresh cilantro to hold the stems together and lifts the tied bunch.

791.words: tool (noun): a thing you hold to help you fix or make things
791.asset_description: Two men fix a bicycle mounted upside down outdoors next to a pegboard hung with tools; one grabs pliers and gets told "nope, wrong one", then browses the wrenches, screwdriver and hammer, picks the right wrench and holds it up grinning before turning the bolt.
791.transcript: Nope, wrong one. That one, done.

1286.words: roof (noun): the protective covering on top of a building
1286.asset_description: Seen from above, a workman stands on the sloped tiled roof of a house next to a brick chimney and a ladder, tossing debris off the edge while holding a roof tile.

1459.words: wall (noun): a flat side of a room, taller than its thickness
1459.asset_description: A man in a paint-splattered T-shirt rolls white paint onto a large bare wall in a room being renovated; a ladder and a paint tin stand nearby.

1467.words: wheel (noun): a round frame that turns on an axle
1467.asset_description: A mechanic in denim overalls rolls a car wheel with a silver rim across a garage floor toward a jacked-up car; a lug nut bounces on the concrete beside it.

1840.words: machine (noun): a thing with moving metal parts built to work
1840.asset_description: A steampunk wall of rusty interlocking gears, pipes and glowing amber buttons built around a large ornate clock face.

3118.words: axe (noun): a tool with a heavy blade for chopping
3118.asset_description: A cartoon man in a red checked shirt, jeans and a cap swings an axe into the trunk of a big tree in a forest, wood chips flying off where the blade bites in.

3157.words: brick (noun): a hard block of baked clay for building walls
3157.asset_description: Cartoon of a smiling builder in a yellow helmet and blue overalls standing behind a half-finished red brick wall, holding a brick up in one hand and spreading grey cement along the top row with a trowel in the other.

3653.words: to fix (verb): to put something broken back together
3653.asset_description: Cute cartoon: an astronaut sits on a little moon and screws a glowing crescent moon back together with a screwdriver. A fluffy orange creature holds a star beside him and a small green alien carries a box of spare stars, with screws and a toolbox on the ground.

3828.words: match (noun): a small stick that makes fire when struck
3828.asset_description: A bold vector illustration shows a chimpanzee facing the viewer and calmly holding up a burning match in one hand, with a bright flame and a thin curl of smoke rising beside its face.

4112.words: block (noun): a solid piece of something with flat sides
4112.asset_description: A close shot of an unfinished wall built from large pale building blocks with thin mortar joints between them, under a window that looks out over a foggy green field. A hand in a grey work glove holds a cut-off clear plastic bottle flat against the blocks, directly under the tip of a drill. The drill bores into the block and the grey dust falls straight down into the bottle instead of onto the floor. When the drilling stops, the hand lifts the bottle away to show a neat round hole in the block and a heap of grey dust collected inside the bottle.

4120.words: board (noun): a long flat piece of sawn timber
4120.asset_description: A close overhead shot outdoors. A pale wooden board with a round hole cut through the middle is laid flat across the top of a big carved wooden bowl, with a crate of whole walnuts behind it. A hand picks a walnut out of the crate and sets it in the hole in the board so it sits held in place. A hammer swings down and cracks the walnut; the pieces of shell and the kernel drop straight through the hole into the bowl underneath. The hand fetches another walnut and does it again, and the bowl below slowly fills up with broken shells and pale nut kernels.

4161.words: front (noun): the side that faces forward
4161.asset_description: Two old sports cars stand nose to nose on a concrete driveway in front of a tall green hedge. The camera holds on the front of an orange car on the left, with its round chrome headlight and chrome mirror, and the front of a yellow car on the right, with its indicator and chrome bumper. The camera moves slowly so the two fronts almost touch in the middle of the frame. At the end a man in dark blue overalls and a cap leans over the front of the yellow car and works on it.

4685.words: repair (verb): to fix something by replacing a broken part
4685.asset_description: A comic-style illustration on a building site. A young workman in a yellow hard hat sits on a metal stepladder in front of an open grey fuse box on a wooden wall, with a small screwdriver held in his teeth. He holds red-handled pliers in one gloved hand and a bundle of cut red, green and blue wires in the other, and looks up at the row of circuit breakers he is working on. Coils of cable hang over his shoulder and lie on the floor, with a tool belt on his hip and a work light behind him.

4686.words: repair (noun): the act of making something work again
4686.asset_description: A dark flat with no power. A woman in a yellow hard hat with a headlamp stands at a wall panel, holding a pair of pliers and a bundle of coloured wires. Close-ups show gloved hands stripping a red wire and pushing it into a circuit breaker set into a broken-open wall box. A family stands in the dark hallway behind her lighting the corridor with phone torches. She works at the fuse panel, then turns to the camera smiling as the flat lights come back on.

4732.words: build (verb): to make something by combining parts
4732.asset_description: A man in a work shirt builds a wooden fence across a sunny back garden. He holds a squared timber post upright, then screws a horizontal rail into it with a cordless drill. He knocks a post into place with a yellow rubber mallet along a run of fence that already carries rows of vertical palings, checks the top rail with a spirit level, and works along a string line pegged into the fresh soil. At the end the finished fence runs the full length of the lawn and he leans over the top of it and smiles.

4843.words: structure (noun): a thing built from many parts
4843.asset_description: On a trestle table in a sunny garden a man taps a hammer against a small wooden birdhouse, holding a finger over the round entrance hole. He steps back and turns the finished birdhouse, with its pitched roof, little porch and railings, to the camera. Cut to a lawn where about eight people crouch around a huge folded grey tarpaulin and spread it out flat. Then the same group heave a tall triangular timber wall frame upright, and finally they stand back on the grass looking up at the finished wooden house frame standing on its slab.

5020.words: replace (verb): to put a new thing in place of a broken one
5020.asset_description: In a bright flat a young woman points up at a ceiling fitting whose bare bulb is dead. She and a young man carry in an aluminium stepladder and open it under the fitting; she climbs the steps while he steadies the frame, screws a new bulb into the socket and it lights up warm and bright. They look up at the working light, then fold the ladder away.

5129.words: cover (noun): a sheet put over a thing to shelter it
5129.asset_description: An empty room being redecorated: the furniture is hidden under grey plastic sheeting and the floor is spread with white dust sheets. A young man in paint-spattered dungarees, headphones round his neck, rolls terracotta paint over a grey wall with a roller on a pole. He works across and up until the whole wall is orange, then reaches up and starts peeling the masking tape off the top edge.

5204.asset_description: Two people in paint-spattered dungarees work on a wrecked room whose walls are bare plaster with old paint peeling off in sheets. One hammers at a battered built-in shelf unit, the woman rolls fresh paint onto a wall while the man smooths the plaster beside her with a trowel, the camera pans across the wet cream paint, and then the same room appears finished: smooth painted walls, new wooden shelves, a plant and a clean tiled floor, with the two of them standing in it looking pleased.

5408.words: kit (noun): a case holding a set of things you need
5408.asset_description: A woman in a denim shirt and a patterned headband stands in an open garage with a wooden kitchen chair in front of her; she presses on the seat and it wobbles. She turns to a red hard case on the bench and opens it: inside, held in moulded slots, are rows of screwdrivers, spanners, pliers and sockets. She lifts one screwdriver out of the case, tightens the loose joint under the chair, stands the chair back up and sits down on it to show it holds.

38.words: airport (noun): a place where planes take off and land
38.asset_description: A Pixar-style ground marshaller in an orange vest waves his batons on the runway of a busy airport; a smiling cartoon plane taxis right up to him while other planes take off past the control tower behind them.

48.words: arrive (verb): to reach a place at the end of a trip
48.asset_description: A man films himself arriving at a beach resort: he walks up the palm-lined path, cheers at the entrance, unlocks his room door with a key card, tours the room and steps onto the balcony overlooking the turquoise sea.
48.transcript: I arrived this is my hotel. I am so happy to arrive here look at the sea

58.words: backpack (noun): a bag with two straps you wear on your shoulders
58.asset_description: In an anime style, a girl on old stone steps packs clothes and a bottle into a large orange backpack, swings it onto her back, clicks the chest and waist buckles, and hikes up through the town to a lookout over the rooftops.

78.words: beach (noun): an area of sand or stones next to the sea
78.asset_description: Bare feet walk along warm sand by the surf; a hand lets sand pour through its fingers, then a young man and woman build a sandcastle with a bucket and red spade until a wave washes it, and they run laughing into the sea.

81.words: beauty (noun): the quality of being very pleasing to look at
81.asset_description: A young couple wanders through whitewashed Santorini lanes at sunset; the woman smells pink bougainvillea flowers, admires her smiling face in a hand mirror and twirls in a white dress on a terrace above the sea while they take in the glowing view.

104.words: bottom (noun): the ground under the sea, a lake or a river
104.asset_description: A freediver in a black swimsuit and mask dives down through clear tropical water, swims to the sandy sea floor, picks up a dark stone from the bottom and surfaces to show it to the camera.

134.words: camping (noun): sleeping outdoors in a tent for fun
134.asset_description: A couple sets up camp in a pine forest at sunset: they thread the tent poles, raise the tent, hammer in the pegs, inflate a sleeping pad, hang a lantern inside and finally sit in the doorway with steaming mugs.
134.transcript: There she goes! Best bed ever.

142.words: castle (noun): a large old stone building with strong walls
142.asset_description: Two animated tourists cross a lowering drawbridge into a large stone castle on a lake, explore the walled courtyard with knight armor, the fireplace hall and a throne, then look out over the land from the top of a tower.
142.transcript: It is so big! King's lived here! Look at that view!

245.words: drinking (noun): taking liquid into your mouth and swallowing
245.asset_description: Two young hikers with backpacks take turns drinking from a steel bottle at a mountain hut, the woman gulping so fast she gasps. They refill the bottle at a stone fountain and drink again side by side at a railing in front of jagged Dolomite peaks.

287.words: far (adverb): a long way from here
287.asset_description: Three hikers stand on an endless flat steppe while one shields her eyes and points at a tiny settlement on the horizon. They keep walking toward it, and wide shots show them as small dots with the village still far away in the distance.

294.words: fire (noun): the flames, heat and light from burning
294.asset_description: At dusk by a forest lake, a couple sits around a stone-ringed campfire roasting marshmallows on long sticks. One drops a fresh log onto the flames, the fire flares up and a big cloud of orange sparks rises into the evening sky as they watch in awe.

306.asset_description: A young couple sits at an airplane window during takeoff, pointing excitedly as the runway drops away and fields shrink below. The plane climbs through clouds, and above a golden sea of clouds at sunset they press their hands to the window and cheer, saying they are up in a whole sky ocean.
306.transcript: We're up! We're up! Look, a whole sky ocean.

330.words: gate (noun): the door where you get on a plane
330.asset_description: In a 3D-animated airport, a girl with a rolling suitcase sprints across the terminal to the boarding gate asking if she is too late; the smiling agent scans her pass just in time and she runs down the jet bridge onto the plane, waving back.
330.transcript: Am I too late? Just in time. Go go! Thank you!

405.words: inside (adverb): into or in a building or room
405.asset_description: One by one, snow-dusted friends hurry through the door of a log cabin and shut it against the storm; soon the whole group stands inside by the wood stove with firewood and a steaming pot.

407.words: island (noun): a piece of land with water all around it
407.asset_description: A couple on a boat points excitedly at a small tropical island, jumps into the clear shallow water, and runs up the white beach as birds fly over the palm trees.

428.words: lake (noun): a large area of water with land all around it
428.asset_description: At a mirror-calm mountain lake at sunset, someone skips a stone across the water, then a young couple pushes a wooden canoe from the shore and paddles out toward the glowing peaks.
428.transcript: Tick. Tick, tick, tick, tick. No way!

430.words: language (noun): the words people use to speak and write
430.asset_description: In a hand-painted harbor scene, a traveling girl greets an old fisherman who answers in a foreign language she does not know; he patiently teaches her his words, she repeats them, and they happily shake hands.
430.transcript: Good morning, sir. Hmm? No, no. Maluna. Maluna! Taki-e. Nalubo. Taki-e.

449.words: listening (noun): paying attention to sounds you hear
449.asset_description: Two hikers with backpacks stop on a forest trail, shush each other and cup their hands behind their ears. They stand frozen, listening for a sound in the trees, then point up excitedly when they finally hear it.
449.transcript: Shh, hear that? There it is. Wow, wow.

462.words: map (noun): a drawing of an area that shows roads and places
462.asset_description: In an animated old European town, a young man and a girl in a red beret unfold a big paper street map, trace the route on it with a finger, then run through the alleys and cheer when they find the fountain it led to.
462.transcript: Where are we now? One turn, two turns. Here, turn left twice. There it is!

486.asset_description: A drone view shows a huge snow-capped mountain with a zigzag trail climbing through forest. Then a hiker's point of view walks over rocky ground above a sea of clouds, and finally two hikers stand on the snowy summit raising their trekking poles in celebration.
486.transcript: Oh wow, the valley floor dropped away dramatically.

502.words: north (noun): the direction toward the top of a map
502.asset_description: Two cartoon hikers in winter parkas stand in a rocky arctic landscape and check a golden compass whose needle settles on N. The woman points the way, and they hike off toward mountains under the northern lights.
502.transcript: There. It stopped. This way? Straight ahead. Come on. [whistling] [music playing]

533.words: passport (noun): an official book you show when you travel abroad
533.asset_description: In a cartoon airport a woman in a pink jacket hands her blue passport to a border officer, who flips through the stamped pages, checks her photo against her big grin, stamps a page and gives it back; she kisses the passport and rolls her suitcase through the gate.

554.words: place (noun): a spot or area where you can be
554.asset_description: A young woman carries a rolled mat along a wide tropical beach, scans the shore for the right spot, announces she has found it, unrolls the mat under a white umbrella and sits down facing the sea.

560.words: fountain (noun): a structure that shoots water into the air
560.asset_description: A young woman takes an excited nighttime selfie in a crowded square, then the camera swings around to reveal the illuminated Trevi Fountain, panning over its turquoise water and marble statues.

609.words: rest (verb): to stop and sit or lie down to get energy back
609.asset_description: Two cartoon hikers with huge backpacks trudge up a hill, drop their packs and flop onto the grass; they lie back on the hilltop above a patchwork valley, sighing happily and refusing to get up yet.
609.transcript: Ah, nothing. Beautiful nothing. Shall we go down? Five more minutes.

652.words: sea (noun): the huge area of salty water that covers the earth
652.asset_description: Waves splash over white coastal rocks by clear turquoise water; a young couple runs off the smooth rocks and jumps into the sea, surfacing and swimming while one laughs that the water is salty.

671.words: shouting (noun): calling out in a very loud voice
671.asset_description: Two hikers with backpacks stand on green terraced mountain slopes with a llama behind them, cup their hands around their mouths and shout 'Hello!' across the valley at the top of their lungs, then laugh and rub their sore throats.

785.words: timetable (noun): a list of times when trains or buses leave
785.asset_description: A cartoon boy with a shoulder bag stands on a rural station platform studying a big wall timetable showing trains next to clock faces; he compares it with his wristwatch, spots his departure and points at the row, then runs down the platform and hops aboard the green steam train just in time.

804.words: travel (verb): to go to other places, often far away
804.asset_description: A POV journey: rolling a suitcase through an airport hall, holding up passports with boarding passes, walking down the plane aisle, watching clouds through the window, then stepping out among palm trees at a sunny tropical destination. The traveler says she loves to travel, takes a plane and sees new places.
804.transcript: I love to travel. I take a plane and I see new places.

805.words: traveling (noun): going on trips to other places
805.asset_description: A young couple with rolling suitcases sprints along an alpine platform and jumps onto a train just in time. They heave their bags onto the overhead rack, flop into seats, and excitedly unfold a paper map while snowy mountains and a lake slide past the window.
805.transcript: That's ours! Run! And? We're off! We're really going!

825.words: view (noun): the land or sea you can see from a place
825.asset_description: A golden dog on a leash sits beside its owner in a flowery alpine meadow, both facing a panorama of jagged rocky peaks under a blue sky; near the end the dog turns back and licks the owner's hand.

832.words: unpack (verb): to take things out of a bag or case
832.asset_description: A cartoon man in a plaid shirt opens his suitcase on a hostel bed and unpacks it: folded clothes onto the shelf, a towel on the hook, a plush octopus by the pillow, and then an impossibly long striped scarf that keeps coming until it piles up on the floor.

833.words: unpacking (noun): taking things out of a bag or suitcase
833.asset_description: A young couple kneels by a suitcase in a bright living room after a trip; the man happily pulls out clothes and shoes, celebrates that a seashell survived, the woman tries on a straw hat, and they tip the whole case out until a cat walks over the clothes pile.

863.words: water bottle (noun): a container you carry to drink from on the go
863.asset_description: A hiker at a wooden alpine fountain unscrews her metal bottle, fills it under the spout, takes a long drink and slides the bottle into her backpack's side pocket before walking on toward the mountains.
863.transcript: Glug, glug, glug, glug. Mountain cold.

866.words: waterfall (noun): water falling straight down from a high rock
866.asset_description: Two hikers in rain jackets walk across green Icelandic terrain toward a tall waterfall pouring off a cliff. They stop on the black rocks at its base, where a rainbow hangs in the spray, and spread their arms in awe.

884.words: world (noun): everything on Earth, all people and places
884.asset_description: A sweeping dusk panorama over Istanbul — the curving waterway, ferries, domes and lit minarets — then a couple on a rooftop terrace gazes over the endless sea of city lights and the woman spreads her arm toward the horizon. Music only, no speech.

902.words: airplane (noun): an aircraft with fixed wings, powered by jets
902.asset_description: A huge four-engine jet passes very low overhead in golden evening light while a woman in a black coat and scarf below raises her arms toward it, runway approach lights and a fence behind her.

907.words: anybody (noun): any person at all, it does not matter who
907.asset_description: A man in a long coat stands alone among wooden benches in a grand, completely empty station hall, hands cupped around his mouth as he shouts, while startled pigeons scatter into the air around him.

952.words: boat (noun): a small vessel for travel on water
952.asset_description: A bearded man rows a wooden rowing boat across a calm misty lake at sunrise, water dripping from both raised oars.

989.words: check in (phrase): to register at a desk before a flight or stay
989.asset_description: At an airport check-in counter, a woman lifts her beige suitcase toward the baggage belt while holding her passport; behind the desk a man in a suit works at the computer under rows of departure screens.

1084.words: flight (noun): a journey traveling by air in a plane
1084.asset_description: A white passenger jet climbs steeply into a blue sky just after takeoff, landing gear still down and thin clouds streaming past.

1119.words: guide (noun): a person who shows tourists around a place
1119.asset_description: A young man holds an open umbrella raised high over his head and gestures as he talks to a group of older tourists on a cobbled square in front of a huge Gothic cathedral, pigeons flying past.

1141.words: hotel (noun): a building where travelers pay to stay
1141.asset_description: A uniformed doorman holds the door of a grand hotel entrance at dusk while a woman in a beige coat walks out with a leather suitcase past a brass luggage trolley.

1179.words: luggage (noun): bags you carry your things in when traveling
1179.asset_description: A man in dark clothes pushes an airport trolley stacked high with suitcases and travel bags through a bright glass terminal.

1208.words: museum (noun): a building for displaying valuable old objects
1208.asset_description: A woman in a long coat turns in a grand marble museum hall and looks up at a towering dinosaur skeleton. Glass display cases and other visitors fill the columned gallery.

1230.words: passenger (noun): a traveler riding in a vehicle, not driving it
1230.asset_description: A young woman with headphones sleeps leaning against a rainy train window at night, a paper coffee cup loosely held in her hand and the lit carriage behind her.

1278.words: reception (noun): the front desk where guests check in
1278.asset_description: A receptionist behind a wooden hotel front desk hands a room key to a guest; behind her is a wall of key pigeonholes, and a brass bell sits on the counter.

1311.words: ship (noun): a large vessel that carries passengers or goods
1311.asset_description: A young woman with a travel bag stands on a dock waving up at a huge ocean liner with a big funnel, seagulls flying around its bow at sunset.

1354.words: station (noun): a place with special equipment for one purpose
1354.asset_description: A man with a brown leather suitcase hurries along the platform of a grand old railway station under a huge clock, scattering pigeons, with a train waiting beside him.

1372.words: suitcase (noun): a large case with a handle for carrying clothes
1372.asset_description: A woman in a long coat and scarf stands in a grand glass-roofed railway station, pulling a large grey hard-shell suitcase on wheels. A Departures board and other travellers are visible behind her.

1498.words: balloon (noun): a big bag filled with hot air that carries people
1498.asset_description: Vintage Italian poster: two men ride in the basket of a big hot-air balloon marked 'Italia'; one waves his hat.

1525.words: train (noun): railway cars joined together that carry people
1525.asset_description: A dramatic digital painting of a black steam locomotive rushing head-on toward the viewer, its headlight glowing, surrounded by billowing red and blue smoke and sparks.

1529.words: tower (noun): a tall narrow building or part of one
1529.asset_description: A vintage travel poster of Naples showing two massive round castle towers in warm sunlight, with a smoking volcano across the bay in the background.

1530.words: town (noun): a place with houses and shops, smaller than a city
1530.asset_description: A vintage travel poster of Assisi: an old stone hilltop town with a church tower, seen through an arched window shape, overlooking a wide patchwork valley.

1567.words: plane (noun): an aircraft with fixed wings and engines
1567.asset_description: A flat vector poster: an orange passenger jet seen from below climbing straight up, leaving two long pale contrail stripes on a plain magenta background.

1568.words: sail (verb): to travel on water in a boat pushed by the wind
1568.asset_description: The black silhouette of an old three-masted sailing ship on a wavy sea, framed by a huge glowing blue moon against a black sky.

1581.words: van (noun): a boxy road vehicle for carrying people or things
1581.asset_description: A retro minimalist scene: the dark silhouette of a classic camper van with a surfboard on its roof parked under two palm trees, in front of a huge pale sun.

1647.words: postcard (noun): a card with a picture you write on and send
1647.asset_description: A vintage postcard with torn white edges and handwritten greetings at the bottom, showing a painting of a woman in a long yellow dress reaching up to pink flowers by a stone balustrade.

1667.words: paris (noun): the capital city of France
1667.asset_description: A colorful ink-and-watercolor painting of Paris at night: the Eiffel Tower shines golden above glass domes and lit rooftops under a starry pink-blue sky.

1670.words: london (noun): the capital city of England
1670.asset_description: A textured painting of Big Ben's clock tower with a red double-decker bus driving past on the street below under a grey sky.

1672.words: prague (noun): the capital city of the Czech Republic
1672.asset_description: A watercolor of Prague at dusk: the floodlit castle hill with the dark spires of St Vitus Cathedral rises above old houses, and lights reflect in the river below.

1747.words: tent (noun): a shelter of cloth stretched over poles
1747.asset_description: A flat vector camping poster with an orange tent pitched on a green hill in the foreground, a tall pine beside it, a flock of birds, snowy mountains and a big orange sun behind.

1832.words: take a photo (phrase): to make a picture with a camera or phone
1832.asset_description: A small girl in a red coat stands on a dark rock under a starry night sky and raises her phone to take a photo of a glowing beam of northern lights near the moon and a striped lighthouse.

1958.asset_description: A sunlit painting of a Mediterranean village lane where wide stone stairs climb between old plastered houses with terracotta roofs, blue and white shutters, and pots of pink flowers lining the steps.

1965.words: cabin (noun): a small simple wooden house
1965.asset_description: A small wooden cabin with a snow-covered roof sits among tall snowy pine trees, with a sharp sunlit mountain peak rising behind it.

1970.asset_description: A tiny wooden hut with a snow-covered roof and a latched plank door stands on a snowy forest path, with snowy peaks and pine trees behind it.

2099.words: tree house (noun): a small hut built high up among branches
2099.asset_description: A round thatched-roof house with glowing windows is built high on the trunk of a huge tree deep in a green jungle, with a ladder and walkway leading up to it.

2114.words: across (preposition): from one side to the other side
2114.asset_description: An arched wooden footbridge stretches across a calm stream between glowing wooden cabins in a misty evening forest, warm window light reflecting on the water.

2236.words: palace (noun): a large grand house where a king lives
2236.asset_description: A glowing Asian palace with tiered towers stands among misty peaks and orange-and-pink trees under a huge full moon, with a river and small bridge in front.

2282.words: sailing (noun): the sport of travelling on a boat with wind power
2282.asset_description: A barefoot woman in a white dress sits on the bow of a wooden sailing boat gliding over the sea at sunset, with a large curved sail and rigging rising behind her.

2406.words: jeep (noun): a strong car for driving on rough roads
2406.asset_description: A pale green off-road jeep loaded with suitcases and bags on its roof rack stands on a dirt trail, with a green mountain and a lake behind it under a sunny sky.

2451.words: eiffel tower (noun): the famous tall iron landmark in Paris
2451.asset_description: A black-and-cream ink illustration of the Eiffel Tower rising over a riverside promenade, with small silhouetted pedestrians below and a bird flying past the top.

2687.words: swimming pool (noun): a big basin of water for doing laps and playing
2687.asset_description: A two-storey Mediterranean stone villa with wooden shutters, an iron balcony and climbing greenery, seen from across a bright turquoise swimming pool with sun loungers and a parasol on the wooden deck beside it.

3447.words: statue (noun): a figure of a person or creature made of stone
3447.asset_description: Vector poster of a huge Easter Island stone head standing on a hill at dusk, with the Milky Way and thousands of stars above it and pink clouds on the horizon.

3685.words: hot-air balloon (noun): a huge cloth balloon that lifts a basket
3685.asset_description: Illustration of a dozen striped hot-air balloons floating over a rocky valley of tall pointed stone towers, with small houses, trees, cars and tiny tourists below.

3740.words: swimming ring (noun): a blown-up tube that keeps you floating in water
3740.asset_description: Flat illustration seen from behind of a girl in a swimming costume running on the sand towards the sea with her arms out and a red and white swimming ring around her waist, a pale sun in the sky.

4047.words: holiday (noun): leisure time away from work for rest or fun
4047.asset_description: A couple lies together on a wide cushioned daybed under a wooden pavilion at a beach resort, with an infinity pool, palm trees and the sea behind them and the sky orange and pink at sunset. The man in a white sleeveless top and sunglasses holds a phone; the woman beside him in a green bikini and a white shirt talks and gestures, then pulls her sunglasses down onto her face. She settles against his chest and he puts his arm around her while they watch the sunset.

4052.words: record (verb): to make a record of something to keep
4052.asset_description: On a white-sand beach with palm trees and shallow turquoise water, a couple in white pose for a phone that stands on a small tripod in the sand in the foreground; the phone's screen shows the shot it is taking of them. They stand arm in arm making peace signs at the lens. The woman then walks straight up to the phone, frowns and reaches down to adjust it, then goes back and they pose again. At the end they both laugh and give a thumbs-up as a small dog runs into the frame behind them.

4058.words: trip (noun): a journey somewhere and back
4058.asset_description: A man in a red cap and white t-shirt lifts a single small brown suitcase onto a white bed in a bedroom and closes it. He carries it out to a blue SUV standing on a sunny driveway with its boot open. He then turns and sees a woman in a black dress wheeling out a tower of about ten stacked suitcases in pink, green, teal, blue and black, balanced far above her head. He stands in front of it with his mouth open and his hands raised, staring up at the tower while she waits beside it.
4058.transcript: Okay, babe, you ready? We're only there for one night. My shoes. I'll be back. No, no.

4115.words: tourist (noun): someone who travels for pleasure
4115.asset_description: A tiled seaside promenade at night, lit by the lights of souvenir stalls. Racks of sunglasses and rows of straw sun hats stand outside the shops on one side, dark pine trees rise on the other, and the lights of the bay glow further along. A young couple walks away from the camera down the promenade with his arm around her shoulders. He reaches over and ruffles the top of her head; she ducks away, spins round with her blonde hair flying, and laughs. He puts his arm back around her and they walk on together past the stalls.

4124.words: van (noun): a boxy road vehicle for carrying people or things
4124.asset_description: A series of shots from life in a camper van. A curly-haired young man leans out of the open side door of a white van with a shaggy grey dog beside him, the blue ocean and a beach behind them. A drone shot follows the van along a winding coastal road at sunset. Then, on a bare clifftop at dusk, three friends sit on folding chairs around a small open fire built inside a ring of pale stones; the flames burn orange in the middle of the circle and light their faces while a dog sleeps on a blanket beside them and the van stands with its door open behind. Later the friends and the dog sprint across the wet sand of a beach, and at the end they sit together on the open tailgate of the van watching the sun drop into the sea.
4124.transcript: Hey kids, it's your dad here. I've been on the road for four years now. The things that make life special aren't the things you own, they're the people beside you and the memories you make along the way.

4140.words: adventure (noun): a wild and exciting experience
4140.asset_description: A run of shots from a trip with friends in wild green hill country. A young man throws himself head first off a high concrete ledge and drops towards the dark water far below; a point-of-view shot from the ledge looks straight down at the white ring of foam where he hit the surface. Someone in an orange shorts and a blue jacket runs down a steep grassy slope in driving wind and mist towards a braided river below. At dusk three friends sit in a row on a narrow wooden plank bridge over a rushing white river, watching the moon over a mountain wall lit orange by the last sun. In the final shot four of them stand on a grassy ridge at sunset with their arms flung wide, one grinning into the camera as the sky burns orange behind them.

4293.words: jet (noun): an airplane powered by jet engines
4293.asset_description: A watercolour of a twin-engine passenger jet climbing steeply away just after take-off with its landing gear still down, filling the sky above an airport; below it runs a long runway with centre-line markings, an orange windsock on a pole, a lit runway edge light, and in the distance the control tower and terminal with parked aircraft, all under peach-coloured evening clouds with a flock of small birds.

4314.words: orange (noun): a round orange citrus fruit
4314.asset_description: A watercolour of a bright holiday flat seen from the open front door, the key still in the lock. A young man with a backpack wheels a large suitcase in across the terracotta tiles. At the far end a woman pushes open the louvered balcony doors onto a blue sea view and the net curtains billow inward. On the tiled kitchen counter in the foreground stands a bowl holding four round orange fruits and a bunch of purple grapes; a beige sofa with folded towels sits beside it.

4358.asset_description: A young man in a blue bandana headband and a khaki shirt stands on a sunlit ridge path and holds up a small flat black shoulder pouch in both hands, laughing at how little it is. The clip cuts and he is swinging on a large black expedition rucksack, gripping both shoulder straps. It cuts again and the pack has grown into a tower far above his head: a rolled sleeping mat strapped across the top, and blackened pots, pans and a kettle hung all over the sides and bottom. He leans forward under it with both hands hooked into the straps, knees bent, grinning at the camera as he walks up the ridge; other walkers follow far behind on the path.

4362.words: belt (noun): a loop of flexible material running between wheels
4362.asset_description: A neon-lit illustration of an airport arrivals hall at night. A long metal conveyor belt curves through the middle of the frame carrying suitcases and bags along it. A hooded traveller lifts a hard-shell suitcase off the moving belt; behind the railing a crowd with umbrellas waits and watches, lit by pink and blue screens overhead. Empty luggage trolleys stand along the wall.

4416.words: ticket (noun): a document that lets you ride or enter somewhere
4416.asset_description: At a check-in desk a small printer pushes out a long strip of boarding passes and a hand circles the gate number on it with a blue pen. A traveller with long braids takes hers, reads it and smiles, then holds the printed card against the scanner at the automatic gate until the light turns green. She walks down the jet bridge, through the aircraft door past the crew, and along the aisle looking for her seat.

4417.words: travel (noun): the act of going from one place to another
4417.asset_description: A blonde woman with a red backpack steps up through the doors of a tram, holding the handrail, and turns back to the camera from inside. Next she walks along a gangway onto a small blue and white ferry moored at a sunny harbour. Finally she climbs the aircraft steps onto a plane on the runway and turns at the top of the stairs to wave before going in.

4445.words: bridge (noun): a structure that lets people cross a river or road
4445.asset_description: A young couple walk hand in hand through a wooden garden arch, then lean on a mossy stone wall looking out over the water at a long stone bridge with tall arches carrying a road across a bay. The camera drops to show three pairs of trainers standing side by side on the concrete, then the couple stand together at the red railings of a huge red suspension bridge, holding hands and looking up at its towers and cables as the road runs away from them across the water. The man turns to the camera by one of the red towers, laughing and pointing up at it.

4499.words: visit (verb): to go to see a place
4499.asset_description: A red-haired young man in a cream cable-knit jumper and a backpack films himself on a selfie stick as he goes round several castles. He runs up a steep grassy slope towards a stone tower and touches the old wall, laughing. The camera then sweeps through a castle courtyard hung with coloured banners, and finally he walks up a path through trees towards an enormous turreted castle on a hill, grinning back at the camera.

4509.words: weigh (verb): to have a certain weight
4509.asset_description: A traveller in a cream polo shirt and sunglasses moves through the steps of arriving. First he lowers a brown leather holdall onto a small counter scale, whose display reads 12.95 while a member of staff scans the tag. Then he takes his boarding pass from a hand across the desk, signs a form at a marble hotel reception with a smiling receptionist, and taps his way through a self-service machine in the terminal. He ends up walking off through the hall carrying his bags.

4510.words: check (verb): to examine something to see if it is right
4510.asset_description: A young woman in a khaki leather jacket stands in the middle of a busy airport hall under an enormous departures board full of flight times and destinations. She holds a boarding pass in both hands, looks down and reads it carefully, then lifts her head and scans across the rows on the board, frowning slightly as she compares the two. When she finds what she is looking for she smiles, drops her hands and walks away past the other passengers with their trolleys.

4513.words: suitcase (noun): a large case with a handle for carrying clothes
4513.asset_description: A blonde woman in a khaki jacket stands with her suitcase in an airport hall in front of a wall of departure boards listing destinations and times. She reaches up and points at one of the rows, then looks down at her watch to see how much time she has left, opens her passport with the tickets inside and reads them, and finally looks back up at the board again with a satisfied smile.

4522.words: tour (noun): a journey all the way around a place
4522.asset_description: A traveller films herself right through a trip. First she is up on the Great Wall in a turquoise jacket, cap and rucksack, laughing at the camera with the wall snaking over green hills behind her. Then she lies back in a wooden boat drifting down a wide river between tall grey karst peaks in the rain, a fisherman poling past on a raft. Then it is night in a crowded street market under red and yellow neon signs, where she lifts a soup dumpling out of a bamboo steamer with chopsticks and grins at the camera.

4529.words: color (noun): what things look like from the light they reflect
4529.asset_description: A woman in a long cream lace dress pushes open the heavy wooden doors of a small chapel and steps inside. In a large cathedral she takes a lit candle and touches it to the wick of another one on an iron stand until a row of flames burns beside her. Then she walks down the middle of the nave, and the whole stone floor and the pillars around her are covered in patches of red, blue, green and yellow thrown down by the stained-glass windows; she stops among them, looks up at the windows and turns slowly while the patches fall across her white dress.

4551.words: camp (verb): to live in a tent
4551.asset_description: A campsite on a pine-fringed lake shore under a blue sky. A blond man in a red fleece stands beside a pitched orange dome tent, grinning, then bends down and crawls in head first. A green tent and another group of campers sit further along the shore. The orange tent sags, then folds flat with only his boots sticking out of the door. He sits up under the collapsed fabric, the whole tent draped over him, and looks round laughing.

4562.words: direction (noun): the line leading to a place
4562.asset_description: A red-haired woman in a wool jumper stands on an open moor of purple heather, holding an open brass pocket compass close to her face and frowning at the needle. She crouches down and holds it flat in both palms until it settles, then straightens up, sets her jaw and strides off across the heather. The last shot shows her at sea, gripping a large ship's compass in its binnacle with the horizon behind her.

4590.words: vacation (noun): leisure time away from work for rest or fun
4590.asset_description: A cartoon of the top deck of a big white passenger ship at sunset. A woman in a pink swimsuit leaps off the edge into the deck pool and throws up a huge splash. Around the pool stand rows of red, blue and yellow sun loungers under red-and-white striped parasols on the wooden deck, and a steward in a white uniform and cap carries a tray of cocktails along it. Two striped funnels rise behind, seagulls circle, and beyond the rail the sea is turquoise with a palm island and a big orange sun on the horizon.

4591.words: ship (noun): a large vessel that carries passengers or goods
4591.asset_description: A woman in a straw visor pulls a suitcase up a metal gangway towards an enormous white passenger ship, its many decks of balconies and its orange lifeboats filling the frame behind her. She walks along the ship's wooden promenade deck with a keycard on a lanyard, someone dives into the pool on the top deck between the two funnels, and she eats at a buffet beside the panoramic windows with green cliffs sliding past outside. At sunset she stands at the deck rail with her suitcase as the ship sails through a bay of rocky islands.

4606.words: tower (noun): a tall narrow building or part of one
4606.asset_description: A young man in an olive jacket films himself with a selfie stick as he travels. First he stands on a stone bridge at sunrise, the river orange behind him and a domed church and a tall gothic tower on the far bank. Then he stands in a crowded square looking straight up at the face of an astronomical clock set into a stone tower, with pigeons bursting into the air around it. Finally he sits in a wood-beamed beer hall, lifts a litre tankard, drinks and laughs with the men beside him.

4621.words: passenger (noun): a traveler riding in a vehicle, not driving it
4621.asset_description: An airport departure lounge in daylight. A woman with long silver hair, a brown hoodie and a navy travel pillow round her neck stands under two big blue departure boards and tilts her head back at them in despair. She drops into one of the seats. All around her other travellers wait: men in suits sprawled asleep across the chairs with their heads back, people slumped over their bags. Suitcases, empty coffee cups and water bottles are scattered over the tiled floor and planes stand at the stands outside the glass wall.

4627.words: leave (verb): to go away from a place
4627.asset_description: A stout older man in a flat cap and shirtsleeves waves a white handkerchief above his head, three times over. First he stands beside a city tram stop as a long white tram slides away from the kerb past him. Then he is on a station platform under the overhead wires as a red and cream train pulls out along the track. Finally he stands alone on a stone quay in the sun, waving up at an enormous white cruise ship as it moves off its berth into the deep blue sea, a lighthouse in the distance.

4634.words: reach (verb): to arrive at a destination
4634.asset_description: A watercolour illustration of a young woman with a backpack standing at the end of a sandy coastal path, seen from behind with both arms thrown up in the air. Below and ahead of her lies a colourful seaside town of pastel houses around a turquoise bay full of small boats, with hills and a warm orange sky behind. Wildflowers grow beside the path in the foreground.

4667.words: plane (noun): an aircraft with fixed wings and engines
4667.asset_description: Seen from directly below, a small white and red propeller aeroplane passes low across a clear blue sky and lets a wooden crate fall from underneath it. The crate floats down on a rainbow parachute into open green grassland, where a woman in a striped robe runs up laughing to take it. The aircraft banks and comes round again, its wings and propellers clear against the sky, dropping a line of further crates under coloured parachutes. It flies over a settlement of white round tents while villagers and horses gather in the grass and a woman spreads her arms wide beneath the falling loads.

4681.words: lamp (noun): an artificial source of light
4681.asset_description: A traveller films herself through a trip in Egypt. First she rides a camel in front of the pyramids with a scarf over her hair. Then she walks through a covered bazaar where hundreds of coloured mosaic-glass lamps hang from the ceiling and the walls, glowing red, blue, orange and green; she reaches up, takes hold of a big blue glass lamp and turns it in her hand, laughing. Finally she stands on the deck of a wooden sailing boat at sunset with her arms spread wide.

4716.words: explore (verb): to travel through a new place to see it
4716.asset_description: A man with a headlamp, a khaki shirt and a backpack pushes his way through thick jungle, ducking under hanging vines and climbing over roots on a muddy path, looking around him all the time. He then wades along a dark dripping rock tunnel with only his headlamp lighting the walls. He comes out on a wet boulder at the mouth of a cave: sunbeams cut down through the opening onto a turquoise pool with a tall waterfall pouring into it. He stands on the rock, machete in one hand, and throws his arms wide, staring up at what he has found.

4751.words: guide (noun): a person who shows tourists around a place
4751.asset_description: A woman in an orange jumper films herself while holding a yellow umbrella high above her head so the group behind her can see it. She walks backwards down a narrow cobbled lane between yellow and white houses, and a small group of visitors follows her. She leads them past a yellow tram on rails, along a busy street with more people trailing behind, and turns back to smile at them while a stray dog trots alongside.

4771.words: palace (noun): a large grand house where a king lives
4771.asset_description: A red-haired woman in a bright green raincoat opens a series of ever grander gates. First a low white picket gate in a cottage flower garden, then a heavy wooden farm gate with sheep grazing behind it, then tall black iron gates opening onto an avenue of clipped hedges. Finally she grips a huge gold-painted gate and looks through it at an enormous stately palace, then turns to the camera smiling with the palace and its wide gravel forecourt behind her.

4956.words: reception (noun): the front desk where guests check in
4956.asset_description: A young woman with a large trekking backpack walks in through the open door of a hostel and up to the front desk, where a member of staff stands behind the counter in a small room lined with leaflets, posters and a drinks fridge. Next she is at a huge painted world map on the wall, laughing as she presses a small marker onto it. She then walks into a dorm room with wooden bunk beds and a locker, greeted by two other travellers on the bunks. Finally she steps onto a rooftop terrace at sunset where friends are sitting at a wooden table, and the group eats a big pan of paella together as the sun goes down over the city.

4957.words: hotel (noun): a building where travelers pay to stay
4957.asset_description: A three-tier montage of places to stay. A young backpacker with a big rucksack leans out of the doorway of a shabby wooden roadside place under a pink and blue neon HOTEL sign. Cut to a woman in a grey suit wheeling a silver suitcase out of a revolving glass door into a bright marble lobby, with the caption 150 EUR over her. Cut to an elderly man in a dark suit with a walking stick greeted by a uniformed doorman in front of a floodlit palace facade with a fountain, then walking through a chandelier-lit marble hall, caption 2,000 EUR.

5023.words: airplane (noun): an aircraft with fixed wings, powered by jets
5023.asset_description: A young man with bleached hair in a blue rain jacket stands at a wire fence beside an airfield under a clear sky, filming himself with a gull perched on a fence post in front of him. A small white propeller plane comes down and touches its wheels on the runway behind him. Then a huge four-engine airliner drops in very low right over his head, wheels out, and lands on the runway; he turns to watch it, throws both fists in the air and shouts in delight.

5162.words: beautiful (adjective): delighting the senses, very nice to look at
5162.asset_description: A young man in an orange jacket stands with both arms spread wide on a cobbled square in front of a twin-towered brick church while a flock of pigeons flies up around him, then looks back at the camera from a wooden fence above a bright turquoise lake ringed with pine trees and mountains, then sits at a wooden table in a log restaurant behind a big white plate stacked with browned dumplings and forks them into his mouth with wide eyes.

5212.words: station (noun): a place with special equipment for one purpose
5212.asset_description: Under the glass roof of a big railway station a family waits on the platform: a father in a cap, a mother in tears and a teenage son holding up a hand-drawn welcome sign, trains standing at the platforms behind them. A young woman with a rucksack and a duffel bag comes running out through the Arrivals doorway, drops her bag and throws herself into their arms. The four of them stand hugging on the platform, crying and laughing.

5314.words: basket (noun): a woven container with handles
5314.asset_description: A young woman with a camera round her neck browses a souvenir stall on a Paris riverside. She picks up a small metal Eiffel Tower, then lifts a snow globe with a tower inside and looks at it up close. In the last shots she holds a large woven straw basket with two round handles, loaded with metal towers, fridge magnets and postcards, while an older woman behind the stall puts a red beret on her head.

5315.words: postcard (noun): a card with a picture you write on and send
5315.asset_description: A young woman stands in a souvenir kiosk hung with racks of picture cards, holding up a small metal Eiffel Tower keychain while the smiling stallholder watches. She holds a snow globe up against the sky by the river, then tries on a red and a navy beret in front of a mirror. At the end she carries two straw baskets and a thick fan of picture cards showing Paris landmarks, spreading them out towards the camera.

5338.words: stay (verb): to stay put in one certain place
5338.asset_description: A price caption rises with every scene. At 10 euros a backpacker climbs barefoot onto a metal bunk in a crowded hostel dormitory. At 100 euros a woman in a suit opens the door of a bright hotel room with a city view and walks in past the big white bed. At 10,000 euros an older couple step out through glass doors onto the deck of an overwater villa with a glass floor over turquoise water, then sit together on the bed above the sea, laughing.

5431.words: balloon (noun): a big bag filled with hot air that carries people
5431.asset_description: A travel montage. A red-haired woman films herself from the wicker basket of a hot air balloon at dawn over Cappadocia, with dozens of striped balloons drifting at different heights above the rock valley and its stone spires. The clip then cuts to a covered bazaar lined with blue patterned ceramics and hanging glass lamps, where her finger points at the shelves, and finally to her on a ferry deck at dusk sipping a tulip glass of Turkish tea while gulls fly past over the water.

5447.words: remote (adjective): located far away in space
5447.asset_description: A single dusty old pickup truck is parked on the shoulder of a two-lane road that runs dead straight into an empty desert, with nothing else in sight in any direction: no houses, no other cars, no people, just scrub, sand and huge red rock buttes standing far off on the horizon in the low evening sun. A young woman in a denim jacket and jeans steps up onto the truck's front wheel and reaches for the roof, her hair blown sideways. A small flag on a pole is fixed behind the cab and flaps in the wind. The road's faded yellow centre line runs away to the far horizon.

56.words: autumn (noun): the season after summer when leaves fall
56.asset_description: In a park blanketed in orange leaves, a woman in a mustard coat catches falling leaves and throws them in the air; a man rakes a huge leaf pile and she runs and jumps into it, sinking in and laughing.

180.words: cold (adjective): having a low temperature, not warm
180.asset_description: A woman ice-fishing on a frozen lake shivers with visible breath as she drills a hole in the ice. She holds her bare red hand over the hole, quickly pulls it back, rubs her arms, buries her chin in her scarf and hugs herself against the freezing air.

255.words: east (noun): the direction where the sun comes up
255.asset_description: Before dawn on a rocky summit, a woman wrapped in a blanket points to a thin red stripe on the horizon. A small group with warm drinks stands facing that side of the sky as the glow grows and the sun finally rises over the sea of clouds, and they cheer with raised arms.

307.words: fog (noun): thick cloud near the ground that hides things
307.asset_description: A woman in a red beanie and a man in a dark jacket play hide-and-seek in a foggy field by a stone wall. The man walks off into the thick fog until he disappears completely and she calls 'Where are you?', then he runs back out of the mist yelling 'Boo!' as a sheep appears nearby.

367.words: heat (noun): hot weather or a high temperature
367.asset_description: A sweating couple stands in a sun-baked white village square; the man's orange ice pop melts while he eats it, the woman fans herself with a hand fan saying how hot it is, and they both lean into the cool mist of a stone fountain.

394.asset_description: A sweat-soaked man in blistering sun fans himself with a sheet of paper, wipes his face with a towel, pours bottled water over his head and finally spreads his arms in front of a big standing fan, ending slumped with his face against it.

402.words: ice (noun): water that has frozen hard
402.asset_description: A couple crouches on a frozen lake, marveling at bubbles trapped in the clear black ice and touching the surface; the woman then slides across it while the man cheers.

444.words: lightning (noun): the bright electric flash in a storm sky
444.asset_description: Two friends stand at a screened porch railing at night watching a tropical storm over the sea. Huge lightning bolts flash between the palm trees and they point at the sky, shouting and laughing at each strike.
444.transcript: (upbeat music) - Whoa! - There! (thunder) (laughing) - Did you see that?

580.words: protect (verb): to keep someone or something safe from harm
580.asset_description: In a 3D-animated storm on a lake pier, a tall strong woman whips off her orange coat and stretches it over a smaller bespectacled woman carrying a picnic basket, shouting "Get under here! You're soaked! I've got you!". She shields her from the pouring rain all the way to a stone boathouse, then wraps the coat around her shoulders and hugs her.
580.transcript: Get under here! You're soaked! I've got you!

588.words: puddle (noun): a small pool of rain water on the ground
588.asset_description: On a narrow street after rain, people in red and black rubber boots and bright raincoats jump together into a big puddle that mirrors the blue sky. The splash sends ripples across the water while they laugh.

598.words: rain (noun): water that falls from clouds in drops
598.asset_description: Heavy monsoon rain pours on a village street where paper boats float down the running gutter. Two teenagers shelter under a roof, then the girl steps out into the downpour, spreads her arms and dances, soaked and laughing, while the boy and a dog join her.

690.words: sky (noun): the space above the earth where you see clouds
690.asset_description: A young couple in a green field tilts their heads back to gaze at a huge blue sky with wispy clouds and tiny birds; the camera sweeps up across the clouds and they end up lying in the grass looking up.

706.words: snow (noun): soft white frozen flakes that fall in winter
706.asset_description: In a snowy village street at dusk, a young couple catches a snowflake on a white mitten, tilts their heads back to catch falling snow on their tongues, then flops onto the fresh snow and lies there laughing.

726.words: spring (noun): the season after winter when plants grow
726.asset_description: A young couple sits under cherry trees in full bloom as petals rain down; fresh green buds open on a branch, a duck leads ducklings across a pond, the man peels off his jacket in the new warmth and they lie back on petal-covered grass.

741.words: storm (noun): very bad weather with strong wind and rain
741.asset_description: A couple sits cozily by a window with mugs of tea while outside a violent storm bends a birch tree, rolls a barrel down the street and sends huge waves crashing over a harbor pier.
741.transcript: [MUSIC PLAYING] Whoa! [MUSIC PLAYING] Listen to it.

781.words: thunder (noun): the loud noise after lightning in a storm
781.asset_description: A couple sits at a candlelit table in a rustic stone kitchen while a storm darkens the window behind them; lightning flashes and they count "one, two, three" on their fingers waiting for the boom, then throw up their hands when it hits, while their big dog hides under the table.

819.words: umbrella (noun): a folding cover that keeps rain off you
819.asset_description: On a rainy shopping street, a woman pops open a big red umbrella just in time and smiles up at it as the rain patters down. A soaked man in a hood dashes over asking for room, ducks under, and the two walk off sharing the umbrella.
819.transcript: Just in time. Room for me?

870.words: west (noun): the direction where the sun goes down
870.asset_description: A group of friends stands at a wooden railing over the sea at dusk. One of them points at the setting sun on the horizon, and they all watch quietly as it sinks and the sky turns dark orange, clapping at the end.

875.words: wind (noun): moving air you feel outside
875.asset_description: On a green field with bending poplars and a windmill, a couple's hair whips around and the woman's yellow scarf is torn off and flies across the grass. Sheets on a clothesline billow wildly, and she leans her whole body against the gusts, laughing.

878.words: winter (noun): the coldest season of the year
878.asset_description: Two friends sled down a snowy slope past snow-covered pines, tumble laughing into a drift, then build a small snowman with a carrot nose above a snow-covered alpine village. At dusk they sit on their sleds watching the village lights come on.

1003.words: cloud (noun): a white or grey mass of water drops up in the sky
1003.asset_description: One huge puffy white cloud floats in a deep blue sky above rolling golden-brown hills that carry its shadow.

1274.words: rainbow (noun): an arc of colours in the sky after a shower
1274.asset_description: A huge rainbow arcs across the sky over green rolling hills while a woman in a rain jacket walks through a sunlit grassy valley below it.

1353.words: star (noun): a body of hot gases that shines in the sky
