1353.asset_description: A silhouetted camper stands beside his glowing tent on a mountain ridge at dusk and points up at one very bright star in the deep blue sky.

1373.words: summer (noun): the warmest season of the year
1373.asset_description: On a bright sunny day, a young man leaps off a wooden lake dock, tucking his knees mid-air, while a group of friends cheer from the water below. Blue sky, sparkling lake and green pine shores set a classic hot-season scene.

1390.words: moon (noun): the big round light in the sky at night
1390.asset_description: A giant glowing full moon dominates the night sky, with craters clearly visible and thin clouds drifting across it. A tiny silhouetted hiker with a backpack stands on a dark mountain ridge, reaching an arm up toward it.

1394.words: sun (noun): the light and rays of the sun
1394.asset_description: An enormous orange sun hangs low over a calm sea, its light making a golden path across the water. Birds fly across the glowing disc while a swimmer wades out of the shallows in silhouette.

1466.words: weather (noun): the state of the sky: sun, rain, wind, clouds
1466.asset_description: A woman in a dark hooded coat holds her hood against the wind on a grassy hilltop; behind her a dark rain cloud pours on one side of the sky while golden sun rays break through on the other.

1502.words: sunset (noun): the evening moment when the sun goes down
1502.asset_description: Simple watercolor doodle of a couple sitting close together with an arm around each other, watching a red sun sink into the sea.

1674.words: purple (adjective): the color between red and blue
1674.asset_description: A flat vector night scene: a huge purple sky completely full of tiny stars above dark purple hills and the silhouette of a small gazebo with a glowing lamp.

1724.words: hold (verb): to have something in your hands or grip
1724.asset_description: An Art Nouveau painting of a woman with long golden hair and poppies in her hair, sitting against a starry floral background and holding the glowing full moon in her raised hand.

1931.words: rainy (adjective): with a lot of water falling from the clouds
1931.asset_description: A moody abstract painting of a city street in the rain, all in teal and blue: a lamppost and power lines above a flooded, mirror-wet pavement streaked with glowing reflections, tiny figures blurred in the drizzle.

1952.words: full moon (noun): the whole bright round disc seen in the night sky
1952.asset_description: A blue-toned painting of a single bare twisted tree standing in a misty field, lit from behind by a huge glowing full moon whose moonlight swirls through the whole night sky.

1953.words: snowflake (noun): a single small ice crystal that falls as snow
1953.asset_description: A photoreal portrait of a pale young woman with long white hair and icy blue eyes wearing a crown of large blue snowflakes, while soft snowflakes drift through the frosty blue air around her.

2042.asset_description: A twisted old tree spreads its branches in front of an enormous glowing full moon that fills almost the whole night sky above a moonlit grove.

2046.words: snowy (adjective): covered with snow or full of falling snow
2046.asset_description: Snow falls through a dark forest of bare trees at night; the ground is white, and a full moon and stars shine in the deep blue sky between the branches.

2057.words: chimney (noun): a pipe on a roof that lets smoke out
2057.asset_description: A stone cottage buried in deep snow at night, its windows glowing warm yellow, with a big stone chimney rising from the snow-covered roof into the icy mist.

2096.words: red (adjective): the color at the end of the spectrum
2096.asset_description: A lone car drives down a dark desert road while the entire sky, clouds and mountains glow deep red around a low white sun; bare trees stand in silhouette.

2124.words: road (noun): an open public way for travel by vehicles
2124.asset_description: Watercolor scene of a woman with an umbrella walking down a wet country road in the rain, past a stone house and green fields under a willow tree.

2175.asset_description: A quiet minimalist night scene: black silhouettes of pine trees line the bottom edge against a starry teal sky with a full moon and a soft yellow glow on the horizon.

2254.words: frozen (adjective): turned to ice or completely covered in ice
2254.asset_description: A queen in a long icy gown stands before a huge frozen palace covered in snow and icicles. Frozen orbs and crystals float around her under a glowing ringed sphere in the sky.

2450.words: thunderstorm (noun): a storm with lightning and loud rumbling
2450.asset_description: Massive purple-blue storm clouds fill the sky while a bright bolt of lightning strikes downward; the whole scene is mirrored in still water below.

2490.words: snowman (noun): a winter figure made of big white frozen balls
2490.asset_description: A cheerful snowman with a carrot nose, coal buttons, a black top hat and a red scarf stands in the snow while snowflakes fall around him.

3277.words: to hold (verb): to have something in your hands
3277.asset_description: Painted night scene of a child standing in tall dark grass with their back to us, arms stretched up, holding a big glowing yellow star in both hands under a deep blue starry sky.

3458.words: stars (noun): the bright points of light in the night sky
3458.asset_description: Low-angle vector poster of a row of Easter Island stone heads at night, with a deep blue sky full of white stars and a bright band of light crossing it.

3640.words: to shine (verb): to point light at something
3640.asset_description: Minimal illustration of a striped lighthouse standing on a small piece of rock floating in a black starry sky. Its lamp shines a wide beam of yellow light out into the dark, and a tiny astronaut sits on the rock beside it.

3658.words: windy (adjective): with a lot of wind blowing
3658.asset_description: Flat-colour poster of Patagonia: sharp snow-streaked rock towers rise behind a blue lake, and in the front the yellow grass and a lone tree are all bent over to one side by the strong wind.

4074.words: sun (noun): the light and rays of the sun
4074.asset_description: A short sequence shot at the end of the day. A laughing woman in a red swimsuit sits chest-deep in a calm lagoon with the low sun blazing behind her and lighting up her wet hair. The camera drops to water level, where the sun sits just above a sand dune and lays a long band of light across the ripples, with a wooden boat moored to one side. Two red kites hang against the orange sky, then a kitesurfer skims across the shallow water in the sunlight, followed by a point-of-view shot of hands on the control bar. The last shot is a huge orange moon behind a row of wind turbines.

4102.words: sunshine (noun): the warm light and rays of the sun
4102.asset_description: An illustrated clip. A thin man sits on a wooden chair at a small desk in a bare room, typing on a laptop. Through the big window in front of him the outside is bright: a yellow sun in a blue sky, a purple kite flying on a string, and a green ocean wave rolling in. His head tips back toward the sunny sky while his hands stay on the keyboard. His body then stretches further and further out of the chair toward the window until the chair tips over and he is pulled almost horizontal, hands still on the laptop, drawn toward the sunshine outside.

4142.words: rain (verb): to fall as rain from the sky
4142.asset_description: A short montage of outdoor moments. A big wave breaks over a wall of sand and floods a dug-out pool on the beach at sunset while people watch from the ridge; a man is washed over by the foam. Then a woman floats in a grey-green sea with raindrops hitting the water all around her. Then an empty wet road runs straight into an orange sunset over a snowy plain. Finally a woman in a white shirt and denim skirt spins barefoot and laughing on a wet mountain road in the rain, green cliffs and mist behind her.

4292.asset_description: A soft watercolour of a young woman standing in a sunlit meadow with her eyes closed and her face tipped up; huge dandelion clocks in the foreground are shedding clouds of white seed parachutes that drift sideways across the picture on the moving air, her hair is lifted to one side, and golden sunbeams slant down through the grass and wildflowers.

4381.words: warm (adjective): having a comfortable degree of heat
4381.asset_description: A pastel cartoon beach on a bright sunny day. Striped parasols and towels are spread out over the yellow sand, with a bucket and spade beside one of them. A girl in a swimsuit and wrap skirt runs barefoot along the water's edge with her hair streaming behind her, while a beach ball bounces beside her. Seagulls glide overhead and a big sun hangs over the sea.

4447.words: wet (adjective): covered or soaked with water
4447.asset_description: An older man in a flat cap and a waxed green jacket stands in a line of people at a city bus stop. The pavement is dark and shining with water, puddles have collected along the kerb, and everyone in the queue is holding a black umbrella up over their head. The camera moves under his umbrella and you can see the drops running off its edge and beading on the stretched fabric while a red double-decker bus passes on the wet road behind. The clip then cuts to the same man indoors in a warm pub, stirring a cup of tea and dunking a biscuit into it.

4717.asset_description: A man with a headlamp pushes between huge elephant ear leaves in a green jungle, then the picture goes almost completely black: nothing can be seen except the white glare of his headlamp and a faint outline of his face and shirt. He crouches in the blackness beside a wet rock wall, the small beam picking out drips and stones a metre in front of him. He walks on through the black tunnel towards a bright opening at the far end, a silhouette against the light, and steps out onto a boulder in front of a wide waterfall falling into a turquoise pool, where he spreads his arms and looks up.

4748.words: cloud (noun): a white or grey mass of water drops up in the sky
4748.asset_description: A steady shot filmed through an aircraft window in flight. The white wing with its upturned winglet cuts across the frame against a deep blue sky. Below it, white masses of water vapour drift past far above the ground: at first scattered puffs with fields and roads visible in the gaps between them, then thicker banks, and by the end an unbroken white layer stretching to the horizon so that the land is completely hidden and only the flat white top and the blue sky above it can be seen.

4849.words: summer (noun): the warmest season of the year
4849.asset_description: A hand tips a metal watering can over two terracotta pots of green herbs on a sunlit window sill, with trees in full leaf outside the open window. Cut to a close shot of a hand turning the knob on a sprinkler head standing in bright green grass. The sprinkler sends a tall jet of water arcing over a lawn with a stone fountain and flower beds behind. Then a girl reaches up to a hanging basket spilling pink and green foliage against a blue sky. Finally a man and two children run through the spray of a garden sprinkler, with a rainbow in the mist.
4849.transcript: There you go. Drink up. Up here too.

4896.words: shadow (noun): the dark shape you make by blocking light
4896.asset_description: A group of friends crouches together in a circle on a sunlit cobbled square; a moment later everyone is running outward in every direction in front of a domed basilica, and the low sun throws a long dark shadow with sharp edges behind each runner on the pale stones.

4901.words: blue (adjective): the color between green and violet
4901.asset_description: Seen from the top of a pale sea cliff, a woman dives head first off the edge into deep blue water under a blue sky; the sea below shades from turquoise to dark blue, and one after another more people leap off the cliff and hit the blue surface, leaving rings of white foam.

5118.words: sunlight (noun): the light that comes from the sun
5118.asset_description: Low morning sun pours through an open kitchen window over a dark worktop and a sink, with two potted herbs on the sill and rooftops beyond. A young man in a loose white shirt turns and walks down a bright hallway with a strip of sunlight across the parquet floor. He reaches the tall French windows, pushes them open and stands in the doorway as the sun floods over him. He steps out onto the small balcony, arms spread, and looks over the sunlit Paris rooftops with the sun low in a clear blue sky.

5189.words: weather (noun): the state of the sky: sun, rain, wind, clouds
5189.asset_description: A wet cobbled street outside a Paris cafe under a grey sky. An elderly man with a white moustache, a flat cap and a beige trench coat holds his bare palm out flat to feel whether it is still raining, a folded red umbrella under his arm. Drops keep falling, so he lifts the umbrella, opens it with a snap over his head and stands under it, smiling at the camera while rain streaks past and other people pass behind him with their own umbrellas up.

5190.words: windy (adjective): with a lot of wind blowing
5190.asset_description: A young woman stands in the pouring rain on a wet village street wearing a clear plastic rain jacket, grinning at the camera. She then appears in a bright yellow raincoat, doing up the front and pulling the hood up over her hair while rain falls around her. In the last part she stands on a seafront promenade in an orange raincoat and spotted rubber boots, grey sky above, big waves smashing over the railing behind her, and she spreads her arms wide as the wind and spray hit her.

5191.words: snowy (adjective): covered with snow or full of falling snow
5191.asset_description: On a flat white plain that is covered in snow to the horizon, a woman in a thick orange polar parka with a fur-trimmed hood holds a rope on a metal flagpole. A Norwegian flag climbs the pole against a deep blue sky. Two more people in the same orange parkas pull on the rope together to hoist the flag while others stand around holding mugs, a small hut on the snow behind them. The flag reaches the top and flaps in the wind above the group.

5228.words: snow (verb): to fall as snow from the sky
5228.asset_description: A drawn illustration of a wide open city square in the middle of a heavy snowfall: thick white flakes fall across the whole picture and the cobblestones are buried under deep snow. A woman in a fur hat, a long fur-trimmed coat, mittens and boots pushes forward through the snow, her long scarf and coat blown sideways by the wind. Behind her stand a many-domed cathedral, a red brick tower and a flag on a pole, all of them white with settled snow, under a grey sky.

5237.words: star (noun): a body of hot gases that shines in the sky
5237.asset_description: A short travel clip. A man in a beige tunic and a checked headscarf sprints up the crest of a red dune at dusk, then stands at a sandstone cliff face and touches carved figures and inscriptions cut into the rock. The clip ends at night by a campfire in the desert, under a sky thick with stars, where someone pours tea from a brass pot into his small cup and he lifts it towards the camera.

5303.words: snowflake (noun): a single small ice crystal that falls as snow
5303.asset_description: A woman in a yellow coat, striped knitted hat, scarf and mittens stands in a snowy city square in front of a white church with golden domes. She holds out a dark mitten flat in front of her and lets the falling snow land on it, leaning in to look closely at the single white crystals caught on the wool, laughing as more come down around her. At the end she turns away and walks off across the snow-covered square.

5439.words: grey (adjective): a color between white and black
5439.asset_description: A rainy street in a Japanese city, everything in the shot somewhere between white and black. The sky is a flat grey ceiling of cloud, the wet road and the concrete buildings are grey, and the only colour is the rainbow-striped umbrella a young man in a beige coat shakes open over his head. He swaps it for a plain dark grey umbrella and walks up the middle of the shining wet road as the rain gets heavier, until four men in suits crowd together under that one grey umbrella, shoulder to shoulder in the downpour, the city behind them washed out to grey.

473.words: medal (noun): a round metal prize you wear around your neck
473.asset_description: At an outdoor race ceremony with palm trees and bunting, an official takes a gold medal on a striped ribbon from a case and hangs it around a sweaty runner's neck. She lifts the medal, stares at it in disbelief, playfully bites it and then throws her arms up cheering.

596.words: race (noun): a contest to see who is fastest
596.asset_description: Sprinters in bright kit crouch in starting blocks on a stadium track, burst out together and sprint down the straight. The leader breaks the finish tape and the group slows, laughing and hugging each other.

610.words: ribbon (noun): a narrow strip of cloth tied in a bow
610.asset_description: At a village vegetable show a judge carries a rosette with long blue, red and yellow ribbons past the entries and pins the blue prize ribbon onto a giant pumpkin; the young grower gasps and hugs her winning pumpkin while the crowd claps.

811.words: trophy (noun): a cup or prize you get for winning
811.asset_description: A women's indoor soccer team in blue jerseys sprints toward a golden cup waiting on a stand in a packed arena. One player lifts the trophy over her head screaming with joy, then the whole team hoists it together under falling confetti while the crowd cheers.

877.words: winner (noun): the person who comes first in a race or game
877.asset_description: In an animated mud obstacle race, a muddy woman in an orange top strains ahead of two rivals and breaks the white finish tape first. She screams with joy, receives a gold trophy, kisses it and is lifted on her competitors' shoulders under falling confetti.
877.transcript: First! You were first! This was mine!

1178.words: loser (noun): the person or team that does not win
1178.asset_description: A tennis player kneels on the clay court with a towel draped over his bowed head, racket in hand, while his opponent celebrates with raised arms in the background.

3135.words: to win (verb): to be the winner in a contest
3135.asset_description: Cartoon of a happy girl in a red vest and dark shorts running on a red athletics track and breaking through the red finish tape with her arms thrown wide open.

4389.words: start (verb): to take the first step in doing something
4389.asset_description: A swimming race in an indoor pool. A row of swimmers launch off the starting blocks together, but one swimmer is left standing alone on his block. An official on the poolside waves an arm at him, he goes into the water and swims a length, then climbs out at the wall, picks up his goggles and walks away along the tiles looking furious.

4410.words: contest (noun): an event where a winner is chosen from contestants
4410.asset_description: An extreme close-up of a wide-open eye opens the clip. Friends in a living room sit facing each other in pairs, nose to nose, eyes stretched wide, each trying to outlast the other without shutting their eyes. One pair after another is shown straining. Finally somebody loses, and the whole room bursts out laughing and points at the loser.
4410.transcript: Oh, I blinked. You blinked. Don't blink.

4515.words: to win (verb): to be the winner in a contest
4515.asset_description: A young blond runner in a blue technical T-shirt stands in a sunny park just after a road race, race number 299 pinned to his front. A volunteer in a yellow hi-vis vest lifts a medal on a red-and-white ribbon over his head; he ducks into it, looks down at the medal hanging on his chest and gasps, then clenches his fist and grins into the camera. Other runners walk past behind him under the trees.

5122.words: achieve (verb): to gain something by real effort
5122.asset_description: A short montage of young people finishing hard things. A woman in leggings hangs high on an indoor climbing wall and reaches for the last hold at the top. A young man in a gym drives a loaded barbell up out of a deep front squat, straining. A runner in black crosses a finish line on a red track with both arms thrown up and her mouth open in a shout while spectators watch. A young man in a sports hall presses the last piece into a big floor puzzle and beams straight at the camera. A woman finishes a set of floor exercises on a turf pitch, and finally a group of athletes crowd into a selfie with their fists raised, all shouting in celebration.

5225.words: finish (verb): to bring something to an end
5225.asset_description: A woman in an orange race vest with a number bib runs along a grey waterfront promenade on a cold overcast day. She takes a white paper cup, drinks from it while still running, then glances down at the watch on her wrist. In the last seconds she comes down the closed-off finishing straight past an orange cone, spectators packed behind metal barriers clapping her in, and crosses the blue finish line with her arms lifted, a second runner far behind her.

36.words: adore (verb): to love someone or something very much
36.asset_description: In a cozy Pixar-style living room a woman scoops up her chubby orange cat, lifts it into the sunlight, hugs it tightly against her cheek and kisses its head while the cat squeezes its eyes shut contentedly.

75.words: flap (verb): to move wings up and down quickly to fly
75.asset_description: A fruit bat hangs head-down from a cave roof, then opens and beats its big leathery wings; it drops into the air and beats them across a red sunset sky where a whole stream of bats is doing the same over the water.

160.words: nest (noun): the straw bed a bird makes to sit on its eggs
160.asset_description: A red hen pecks her way across a whitewashed courtyard and steps into a little wooden coop, settles down onto a ring of straw and shuffles into it; when she stands up a brown egg is lying in the straw, and a woman lifts it into her basket.

235.words: fetch (verb): to run after something and bring it back
235.asset_description: A woman shows a red ball to a golden retriever and throws it across the garden; the dog sprints after it under the apple tree, snaps it up in its mouth, trots the whole way back to her and drops it at her feet before rolling over for a belly rub.

779.words: otter (noun): a playful furry animal that lives by water
779.asset_description: A small otter rests its head and webbed paws on a person's bare arm, gazing into the camera. It snuggles against the person's sleeve, blinks sleepily and closes its eyes contentedly as a hand strokes its cheek.

817.words: side by side (phrase): next to each other, close together in a row
817.asset_description: A fluffy white cat and a black cat sit side by side on a concrete block by the shore, seen from behind, calmly watching the waves roll in at dusk. They stay pressed close together the whole time, tails hanging over the edge.

986.words: caterpillar (noun): the young worm-like form of a butterfly
986.asset_description: Macro shot of a green caterpillar arching its body on the edge of a bright green leaf and chewing a hole into it, with crumbs falling against a blurred green background.

1425.words: leash (noun): a strap you hold to control a dog
1425.asset_description: Seen from a hiker's point of view, a hand grips a worn leash attached to a golden retriever sitting in a flower meadow, both facing jagged Dolomite peaks.

1495.words: unicorn (noun): an imaginary horse with one horn
1495.asset_description: White silhouette of a rearing unicorn with a long straight horn, on a dark gray background.

1597.words: underwater (adverb): below the surface of the water
1597.asset_description: A realistic mural-style painting of a dog that has just dived in: its wide-eyed face is fully underwater, surrounded by rising bubbles, with the rippling surface visible above.

1611.words: dove (noun): the white bird used as a sign of peace
1611.asset_description: The silhouette of a dove with wide open wings glows in the center of brilliant golden rays of light streaming through clouds.

1630.words: octopus (noun): the sea animal with eight long arms
1630.asset_description: A watercolor octopus in pink, purple and blue spreads its eight curling arms with spotted suckers across a white background.

1639.words: stable (noun): a building where farm animals are kept
1639.asset_description: A dense old engraving of the nativity: a glowing baby lies on straw beside his mother inside a wooden stable, surrounded by a crowd of shepherds, an ox and sheep.

1681.words: peacock (noun): a large bird with a long shiny blue-green tail
1681.asset_description: Detailed illustration of a peacock perched on a branch under green leaves, its long patterned tail feathers hanging down against a sparkling green background.

1696.words: eagle (noun): a large strong bird that hunts
1696.asset_description: Black-and-white engraving of a bald eagle perched on a branch above its nest of sticks, where two chicks look up at it.

1846.words: crane (noun): a large white bird with a long neck and legs
1846.asset_description: A white crane with spread wings and trailing legs flies across a big yellow sun on a teal textured sky, golden hill outlines below.

1865.words: fin (noun): the thin part a fish uses to swim
1865.asset_description: A gouache painting of a blue betta fish curving upward, its huge flowing blue-and-purple fins and tail spreading like silk around its body.

1876.words: fishbowl (noun): a round glass bowl where pet fish live
1876.asset_description: An illustrated girl in a green jacket wears a round glass fishbowl on her head like a helmet, two red goldfish swimming inside it around her dark hair, orange stars floating behind her.

1905.words: curious (adjective): wanting to know what is going on
1905.asset_description: A flat illustration of three cat faces - black, white and brown - stacked one above another, peeking out from behind a pale stripe and staring at the viewer.

1908.words: heron (noun): a tall water bird with long legs and beak
1908.asset_description: A minimal ink illustration of a gray heron with a long curved neck and pointed red beak standing on a bare branch.

1947.words: mane (noun): the long thick hair round a lion's neck
1947.asset_description: A vibrant digital painting of a lion facing the viewer, its enormous flowing mane rendered in rainbow streaks of pink, orange, blue and green against a purple background.

1968.words: raven (noun): a large black bird like a big crow
1968.asset_description: A pale dark-haired woman in a cloak of black feathers stares forward with tattooed skin while two black ravens fly around her against a gloomy sky.

1999.words: fur (noun): the soft thick hair covering an animal
1999.asset_description: A close-up portrait of a white wolf with thick fluffy fur and amber eyes looking straight at us from a dark forest, with orange autumn leaves drifting around its head.

2077.words: stare (verb): to look at something for a long time
2077.asset_description: An owl with huge amber eyes stares straight at the viewer, its grey and white feathers dissolving into soft abstract shapes on a dark purple background.

2089.words: antlers (noun): the branching horns on a deer's head
2089.asset_description: Three deer stand on a snowy hill in silhouette against a giant glowing full moon; the large stag in the middle shows off huge branching antlers.

2119.words: pattern (noun): a repeated design of shapes and colors
2119.asset_description: An extreme close-up of an ornate owl whose feathers form striking red, white and brown patterns of rings and stripes around its amber eyes, red flowers sitting on its head.

2120.words: perch (verb): to sit on a branch or a ledge, like a bird
2120.asset_description: A small brown-and-cream songbird sits gripping a thin branch with pink blossom clusters and green leaves, against a soft pink and blue backdrop.

2135.asset_description: A psychedelic cat portrait where the fur, face and ears are built entirely from swirling golden ornamental patterns, surrounded by vivid flowers and leaves on a dark background.

2159.words: majestic (adjective): grand and impressive, like a king
2159.asset_description: Side profile of a cat gazing upward, its fur drawn as glowing teal and orange flame-like strands against a black background, chin lifted in a proud pose.

2178.words: peek (verb): to take a quick secret look from hiding
2178.asset_description: A flat graphic illustration of a black cat and a white cat peeking out from behind big green monstera leaves, only their narrowed eyes and whiskers visible.

2184.words: roar (verb): to make a loud, deep angry cry
2184.asset_description: An expressive painting of a tiger with its mouth wide open in a roar, long white fangs bared, orange fur splashed against a teal-blue abstract background.

2213.words: ram (noun): a male sheep with big curved horns
2213.asset_description: An ornate paper-quilling artwork of a ram's head with huge spiraling horns, its neck dissolving into swirls and paper flowers on a dark plum background.

2242.words: flock (noun): a group of birds together
2242.asset_description: Three horizontal perches, each crowded with small colorful songbirds sitting side by side. Dozens of red, blue, yellow and brown birds fill the picture.

2382.words: scales (noun): the hard shiny plates on a fish's skin
2382.asset_description: An anime mermaid with long silver hair sits on dark rocks in bright turquoise water, her long tail covered in shimmering blue scales curling down into the sea.

2413.words: cub (noun): the baby of a wild animal like a wolf
2413.asset_description: A small girl in a red hooded cloak kneels in a night forest of white birch trees hung with glowing orange lanterns, gently hugging a grey wolf cub.

2418.words: songbird (noun): a small bird known for its singing
2418.asset_description: In a Japanese woodblock style, a small blue-and-orange songbird perches on a dark branch covered in bright orange blossoms against a pale sky.

2429.words: stag (noun): an adult male deer with large antlers
2429.asset_description: A dark stag with tall branching antlers stands in a shallow stream at sunset, its reflection in the water, surrounded by autumn bushes and bare trees.

2433.words: gallop (verb): how a horse runs at its fastest speed
2433.asset_description: A powerful white horse gallops straight toward the viewer with its long mane flying in the wind, kicking up dust in front of misty mountains.

2495.words: sparrow (noun): a small brown bird you see everywhere
2495.asset_description: Two small brown sparrow-like birds perch on a branch that carries pink blossoms and bright red berries against a soft green background.

2536.words: chimpanzee (noun): a large clever African ape with dark hair
2536.asset_description: A drawn chimpanzee wearing a green jacket over a red shirt sits on an orange motorcycle, gripping the handlebars and staring calmly ahead like a serious biker.

2543.words: tusk (noun): one of the two long teeth of an elephant
2543.asset_description: A pale pastel elephant with an ornate orange head decoration faces the viewer; two long white tusks curve out on each side of its trunk, framed by big pink and blue flowers.

2600.words: beetle (noun): an insect with a hard shiny back
2600.asset_description: Two large orange-and-green spotted beetles crawl over big green leaves surrounded by small orange flowers against a blue sky.

2675.words: paw (noun): the soft foot of a cat or a dog
2675.asset_description: A watercolour of a striped tabby cat sitting at a wooden table in a forest with a big open book in front of it; the cat rests one striped paw on the open pages, next to an orange cup and a pencil.

2728.words: cuddle (verb): to hold someone close in a soft, loving way
2728.asset_description: A soft illustration of a cream-and-ginger rabbit sitting with its eyes closed, holding a small orange fox kit against its chest; both animals have pink cheeks and sit among grey-green leaves and white flowers.

2738.words: exotic (adjective): from a faraway place and unusual
2738.asset_description: A brilliantly coloured macaw with green, yellow, orange and blue feathers and a huge grey beak sits among tropical leaves and pink flowers, wearing a pair of black over-ear headphones.

2744.words: crest (noun): the fan of feathers on a bird's head
2744.asset_description: A close-up of a peacock's head and neck in deep blue, with a fan of thin feathers standing up on its head, a white beak and its huge tail feathers with green-and-blue eye spots spread out behind it.

2766.words: cobra (noun): a poisonous snake that spreads its neck skin
2766.asset_description: A golden-lit painting of the god Shiva sitting with eyes closed, holding a tall trident in one hand, with a hooded cobra rearing up at his shoulder and a thick scaled snake body coiled across his lap.

2894.asset_description: A soft painted scene in a sunlit grove: a long-haired bearded man in flowing robes walks through the grass carrying a white lamb in one arm while holding a small boy's hand with the other.

2900.words: wolf (noun): a wild animal like a big dog that hunts in packs
2900.asset_description: A night forest scene: a long-haired woman sits cross-legged on the ground beside a small glowing lantern, looking up at a huge glowing white wolf that sits facing her, with a second smaller wolf behind it.

2925.words: beak (noun): the hard pointed mouth part of a bird
2925.asset_description: Close-up of a turquoise bird-like creature with a long grey pointed beak, a big orange eye and pale feathers standing up on its head, wearing an armoured collar.

3198.words: aquarium (noun): a glass tank of water where fish are kept
3198.asset_description: Ornate Renaissance-style painting of a workshop full of instruments and glass jars where a man and a woman in old-fashioned clothes lean over a long glass tank of green water with small fish swimming inside; more figures work at benches behind them and globes and sea creatures decorate the border.

3235.words: koala (noun): a small grey Australian animal living in trees
3235.asset_description: Bright cartoon illustration of a fluffy grey koala with huge shiny eyes sitting on a fallen log over a stream, holding a bunch of red and white roses against its chest, with green leaves and a blue sky around it.

3306.words: rooster (noun): a male chicken that crows in the morning
3306.asset_description: Pencil sketch of a rooster with a big comb and long tail feathers standing proudly on top of a globe of the Earth, its beak open as if crowing.

3317.words: alpaca (noun): a woolly farm animal with a long neck
3317.asset_description: Flat illustration of a young woman in a white shirt and jeans sitting on dry grass in a hilly field, smiling at the camera while a curious brown alpaca leans its long neck down beside her.

3362.words: raccoon (noun): a grey animal with a black mask of fur
3362.asset_description: Watercolour and ink portrait of a young raccoon with grey fur, round ears and the dark mask across its eyes, resting its two clawed front paws on a wooden ledge and staring at the viewer; muted green and cream washes behind it.

3368.words: sloth (noun): a slow tree animal with long curved claws
3368.asset_description: Thick-brushstroke acrylic painting of a smiling sloth gripping a tree branch with its long curved claws; its fur is painted in bright orange, purple, green and blue strokes against a yellow and blue background.

3382.words: parrot (noun): a bright tropical bird with a curved beak
3382.asset_description: Pixar-style 3D cartoon of a plump red macaw with blue, yellow and green wing feathers standing on a sunny beach, beak open in a wide grin and a black pirate eye patch strapped over one eye; palm trees sway behind it.

3383.words: chick (noun): a baby bird, especially a baby hen
3383.asset_description: Glossy 3D cartoon of a fluffy yellow chick standing on a small surfboard as it rides a turquoise wave, wings spread for balance; pastel painted Easter eggs float in the water and fly through the air around it.

3392.words: owl (noun): a round-faced bird that hunts at night
3392.asset_description: Detailed night illustration of a fluffy white owl with huge yellow eyes and ear tufts perched on a snow-covered branch, beak slightly open; icicles hang from the branches and snow falls under a small bright moon.

3469.words: cheetah (noun): a slim spotted wild cat that runs very fast
3469.asset_description: A spotted cheetah sits upright on a dark mound in the savannah, tail curled down, looking out over orange hills as the sun sets behind a lone flat tree.

3473.words: flamingo (noun): a tall pink water bird with a bent beak
3473.asset_description: Graphic sunset scene: a dark flamingo silhouette stands in shallow still water on its long thin legs, beside the zigzag reflection of a big yellow sun.

3522.words: jellyfish (noun): a soft see-through sea animal with tentacles
3522.asset_description: Glowing digital painting of a single jellyfish floating in dark water, its pink and orange bell lit up and long pink tentacles trailing down past rocks and bubbles.

3556.words: llama (noun): a tall woolly Andean animal that carries loads
3556.asset_description: Painted Andean scene: three woolly llamas with patterned blankets stand on a stone terrace next to a man in a striped poncho and straw hat, above green farming terraces and a mountain village.

3561.words: donkey (noun): a small grey animal with long ears
3561.asset_description: Sepia painting of an old colonial town: a man in a striped poncho and straw hat leads a loaded donkey down a cobbled street of tiled houses and shop signs, with a church dome and a smoking volcano beyond.

3564.words: reindeer (noun): a large deer with antlers from the cold north
3564.asset_description: Painted winter camp scene in Lapland: reindeer with big antlers stand in the snow around skin tents and a sledge while a man in embroidered clothes sits by a fire with a pot hanging over the flames.

3586.words: tortoise (noun): a slow land animal with a hard shell
3586.asset_description: Pale painted scene of a tropical coast: a giant tortoise with a domed shell walks slowly over smooth pink boulders beside calm blue water, with palm leaves and a small island behind.

3589.words: gorilla (noun): a very large black ape with huge arms
3589.asset_description: Muted green illustration of a big dark gorilla sitting quietly among tall bamboo stems and leaves in a misty forest, looking to the side.

3590.words: ostrich (noun): a huge bird with long legs that cannot fly
3590.asset_description: Pale washed-out painting of a flat stony desert: a black-and-white ostrich walks across the sand on long legs with a second one further away, under a big cloud and a flat-topped hill.

3733.words: scorpion (noun): a desert animal with claws and a stinging tail
3733.asset_description: Loose ink and dark-red watercolour drawing of a scorpion seen from above on pale paper, its claws forward and its segmented tail curled up over its back.

3734.words: horn (noun): a hard pointed growth on an animal's head
3734.asset_description: Black ink and grey wash drawing of the head of a wild sheep in profile, with one huge horn curling in a full spiral beside its face.

3735.words: meerkat (noun): a small desert animal that stands upright
3735.asset_description: Warm painted portrait of a fluffy meerkat standing upright with its small front paws held together in front of its chest, tilting its head and smiling at the viewer against a golden glowing background.

3770.words: crow (noun): a big all-black bird with a harsh call
3770.asset_description: A glossy black crow with a long tail perches on a dark shape, head turned to the right, against a moody grey sky with faint circles and swirling clouds behind it.

3772.words: dragon (noun): a huge scaly beast from old stories
3772.asset_description: An extreme close-up of a dragon's face built entirely from pale blue ice crystals, with spiky scales, a ridged snout and narrow yellow-green eyes staring straight ahead.

4025.words: chase (verb): to go after someone to catch them
4025.asset_description: A fluffy grey kitten stands on a windowsill next to a wooden toy tower made of stacked spiral ramps, with bare winter trees outside the window. A small green ball rolls down the ramps and the kitten swats at it with one paw, then follows it round the tower to the bottom tray. It bats the ball again, rears up on its hind legs to reach the top ramp, and finally leans right over the top bowl and takes the ball in its mouth.

4059.words: feed (verb): to give food to someone or an animal
4059.asset_description: Filmed from the driver's seat through the windscreen of a safari vehicle on a dirt track in the bush, with the steering wheel and dashboard in the foreground. A single yellow banana has been stood upright on the bonnet. A large baboon walks along the bonnet towards it and sits down beside it; a second and then a third baboon climb up and sit in a row, all staring at the banana with more of the troop on the track behind. One of them finally reaches out, takes the banana and starts to eat it while the others crowd in around it.

4061.words: jaw (noun): the bones of the mouth that hold the teeth
4061.asset_description: An underwater shot in clear blue-green water with sunlight streaming down from the surface. A large great white shark swims straight towards the camera, head-on and filling the frame, its pale underside and pointed pectoral fins spread wide. As it comes closer the camera looks up into its face and its mouth opens slightly, showing the wide jaw lined with rows of triangular white teeth. At the last moment the shark turns and passes overhead, and the screen fills with churning white bubbles below the bright surface.

4064.words: pole (noun): a long round rod of wood or metal
4064.asset_description: Two hands hold a small green parakeet that is wearing a tiny camera on its chest, sitting on someone's knee beside a road. Behind it a tall wooden pole carries power lines across a green field, and a huge untidy nest of sticks is balanced on top of the pole. The bird is let go and flies straight at the pole, the nest growing larger and larger until the bird slips in through a gap in the twigs. Inside the dark nest the camera passes through a tunnel of straw and comes out in a lit chamber where four young green parakeets sit around a small wooden table set with three little bowls of seed.

4068.words: stroke (verb): to touch lightly again and again
4068.asset_description: An underwater shot in clear blue water just above a white sandy seabed. A large tiger shark, its grey back marked with dark vertical bars, cruises slowly from left to right across the frame. A freediver in a bikini, mask and long fins swims down beside it, matching its speed, and reaches out with one hand. She lays her palm on the shark's back near the dorsal fin and runs it slowly along the animal's flank as the two glide side by side over the sand. She keeps her hand on it for several seconds before the shark turns away.

4073.words: stick (noun): a thin length of wood
4073.asset_description: An animated autumn park with orange trees and benches. A plump teal and purple pigeon stands with its eyes closed and a soft smile. A large angry white hen with a red comb stands over three yellow chicks and swings a wooden stick at the pigeon; the next shot shows the pigeon wide-eyed with the stick pressed across its beak. A yellow chick has fallen asleep tucked into the pigeon's blue chest feathers with the stick lying across it. The hen lowers the stick and walks off with her chicks, and the teal pigeon turns to a white and pink pigeon beside it, their wings touching.

4086.words: bite (verb): to cut or grip something with your teeth
4086.asset_description: A simple cartoon set in a dark blue house at night. A mosquito with an angry face hovers by a door next to a glowing red plug-in insect repeller, then next to a wall socket, unbothered by it. It flies on to a bedroom where a person sleeps under a blue blanket with the crescent moon in the window, and lands on the sleeper's bald head. In close-up the mosquito braces its legs and drives its long proboscis down to bite. The last shot is the little white house from outside.

4103.asset_description: A black Labrador puppy is in a kitchen doorway behind an orange cardboard screen. On a flat sheet of cardboard in front of it stands a single upright sausage, with small dark plastic figures beside it. The puppy peeps around the orange screen at the sausage and holds still for a long time, only watching and edging closer. After several seconds it finally gives in, lunges forward, takes the sausage in its mouth and chews it, then sits back on the cardboard with its mouth open and only a hole left where the sausage stood.

4143.words: bin (noun): a container, usually with a lid
4143.asset_description: The camera looks straight down into a big grey wheelie bin standing on a path in front of green bushes. A raccoon is sitting at the bottom of the bin next to a crumpled green rubbish bag. It looks up at the camera, then stands up on its back legs and stretches both front paws up the smooth inside wall, trying to get out. It slips back down, turns around and curls up, then sits up again and stares at the camera.

4149.words: giant (noun): a creature of huge size
4149.asset_description: An animated cartoon. A small fluffy beaver-like animal with big round eyes falls backwards through a nest of sticks, then tumbles through a grey sky far above the ground. It lands flat on its face on the scaly grey head of an enormous reptile that is floating in a misty lake in front of a pine forest. The little animal sits up, sees the reptile's huge yellow eye opening right under it, and screams with its mouth wide open before running away over the water.

4158.words: giant (adjective): far bigger than normal for its kind
4158.asset_description: An animated scene split half above and half below the surface of a bright turquoise sea, with rocky islands in the background. A small brown otter clings to a green bamboo pole that stands straight up out of the water. Behind it a huge grey fish with a wide grin and heavy eyelids floats at the surface, filling most of the frame. The big fish sinks slowly out of sight below the otter, then rises again grinning, and finally disappears completely, leaving the little otter alone hugging the pole.

4171.words: creep (verb): to move slowly and low to the ground
4171.asset_description: A grey wolf steps out of dense dark leaves onto a stony riverbank and comes slowly towards the camera with its head low. The shot cuts to a close-up of a brown hen, then to two yellow chicks beside a green bamboo tube on the gravel. Back on the wolf, it lies down with its muzzle flat on the wet stones, its amber eyes still following what is happening in front of it.

4173.words: chase (noun): the act of pursuing someone to capture them
4173.asset_description: A hen crosses a rope bridge over a deep canyon with a row of yellow chicks tucked along her wings. A big grey wolf comes onto the planks behind her with its teeth bared and runs her down. The bridge gives way: the hen is left hanging from the rope by one wing while the wolf drops away into the mist below. She pulls herself back up and walks on across the bridge towards the sunrise.

4174.words: defend (verb): to act against an attack
4174.asset_description: A hen carries three yellow chicks in her wings out of a burning barn, beating her wings at the flames in the doorway. Later, under a full moon over a pine forest, the three chicks sit alone on the grass while mice and a red fox creep out of the dark towards them. The hen plants herself in front of the chicks and spreads both wings wide to block the way.

4175.words: sneak (verb): to go quietly so nobody notices
4175.asset_description: In deep snow at sunset a brown hen creeps low along a drift past a pile of sleeping wolves, one of them curled around a pale egg-shaped stone. She burrows into the snow until only her red comb shows above the surface, waits there, and then stands up covered in snow with a hard stare. The last shot has her out in the open on the pink snow, facing two wolves between bare black trees.

4176.words: glow (verb): to shine with a soft light
4176.asset_description: Inside a dark burrow a yellow chick holds a glass jar with a single firefly glowing inside it, and the small flame of the insect lights up its face and its huge eyes. The chick carries the jar to the round mouth of the burrow and looks out at a whole forest filled with thousands of drifting sparks under a full moon. The hen comes and stands beside it in the glow.

4178.words: generous (adjective): willing to give and share with others
4178.asset_description: A hen pecks along a trail of yellow corn spilled over snowy boards beside a wooden fence and squeezes through the gap. She then looks down into a round hole dug in the earth, with a small blue-grey mouse standing at the bottom looking up, and pushes the corn down into it. At the bottom of the hole a family of mice gathers round a big heap of corn lit by a candle.

4180.asset_description: An elderly woman in a pink shirt walks a full-grown alligator on a red leash down a tiled colonnade in the sun. A young man carrying a small black puppy stops her and points out that the animal on the leash is an alligator and that her actual dog is right there in his arms. She looks down at it, says she forgot her glasses, and carries on walking.
4180.transcript: What are you doing? I'm walking the dog. That's an alligator. Your dog is right here. Oh, I forgot my glasses.

4192.words: fish (verb): to catch or try to catch fish
4192.asset_description: A bald eagle glides low straight towards the camera over flat grey-green sea water, with a dark forested shore behind it. It holds its wings out wide and drops its yellow feet, watching the surface. As it reaches the camera it swings its talons forward, skims the water, and lifts away with a silver fish gripped in both feet, water spraying behind it.

4203.words: rescue (verb): to free someone from harm
4203.asset_description: A shirtless man in neon green swim shorts stands over a shark stranded in the wet sand at the edge of a turquoise sea. He grips it by the tail, hauls it backwards through the shallow water until it is deep enough to swim, lets go, and steps back to watch it move off on its own into the waves.

4210.words: hold (verb): to have something in your hands or grip
4210.asset_description: A hamster stands on a sunlit wooden kitchen counter with a chocolate-coated ice cream bar in each paw. It keeps the two bars up in front of its face, hiding everything but its ears and whiskers, and holds them there while the sun comes through the window behind it. Then it brings them down and holds them up and out to either side, grinning wide at the camera, with a bite taken out of the bar on the right.

4219.words: beast (noun): a living animal that can move by itself
4219.asset_description: Filmed from the back of a huge scaled animal, as a rider would see it. The creature is dark red and black with rows of spines down its neck, horns on its head and an amber eye, and it stands on a cliff above a fjord with a leather saddle and harness strapped over its shoulders. It turns its head, then throws itself off the cliff; the shot dives with it down a gorge past a waterfall, skims low over the water between rock walls, and flies on through fog towards a distant spired castle.

4222.words: wave (verb): to signal with your hand
4222.asset_description: A small green cartoon gecko stands in a bright circle of light, seen as if through a peephole. It raises one hand and waves at the camera, then breaks into a dance, spinning and throwing its arms out. It settles, folds its arms across its chest and grins with its eyes shut, then leans right up to the lens until its face fills the frame.

4226.words: hunt (verb): to pursue wild animals for food or sport
4226.asset_description: A huge dinosaur crouches at the muddy edge of a jungle river below a tall waterfall and lowers its head to drink. Under the brown water a giant crocodile glides straight towards the camera with its jaws closed. The crocodile explodes out of the shallows in a wall of spray and locks onto the dinosaur, which rears up on its hind legs with the thrashing crocodile hanging from it. A wide shot shows more crocodiles cutting through the water towards the struggle.

4229.words: free (verb): to let someone out of confinement
4229.asset_description: A snow monkey with a red face sits hunched on a snowy wooden railing in a forest, sealed inside a thick shell of clear ice that covers its whole body. A person in a dark blue coat and yellow work gloves leans in and taps at the ice with a small hammer. The shell cracks, and the person lifts the whole hollow casing of ice off the monkey and holds it up, dripping with icicles. Underneath, the monkey shakes itself out on the railing, loose and dry.

4237.words: barn (noun): a farm building for storing grain or animals
4237.asset_description: Inside a long barn with grey metal stalls down both sides of a concrete aisle, a toddler in jeans and a cream jumper toddles up to a wooden crate full of carrots and pulls one out. He carries it down the aisle, holding it up in the air, to where a black horse has its head out over a stall door. The horse stretches down and takes the carrot from his hand, and the little boy claps his hands and laughs.
4237.transcript: Give it to Verspy. Good job, buddy.

4240.asset_description: In a carpeted living room next to a white curtain, one husky rolls on its back with its paws in the air while a second husky stands over it, nosing at it. The two of them then stand side by side facing each other, almost identical black and white dogs with the same markings and the same pale blue eyes. One lifts a paw and paws at the other's chest. The camera closes in on one of them looking straight into the lens.

4244.words: charge (verb): to rush at someone in a sudden attack
4244.asset_description: Filmed from inside a car at sunset. On a gravel track beside a wooden fence a big brown longhorn bull walks along with a small white dog next to it, kicking up dust. The bull turns on the dog and they tumble together in a cloud of dust. Cut to two young men in the car, mouths wide open screaming and laughing. The bull then runs straight down the track towards the car, horns forward, and pushes its huge shaggy head right up against the open car window until its nose and horns fill the whole frame.

4256.words: scratch (verb): to rub skin with your fingernails
4256.asset_description: A grey kangaroo stands upright on a green hillside pasture under a grey sky, with gum trees and a fence in the distance. A person's hand reaches in from the side and scratches the kangaroo's chest and neck with the fingers. The kangaroo half closes its eyes and leans into the hand, then slowly sinks down and lies flat out on the grass, stretching its long back legs and heavy tail behind it while the hand keeps scratching its head and neck.

4258.words: steel (noun): a strong metal made of iron and a little carbon
4258.asset_description: A long curved steel slide runs down a green mountain meadow, its polished grey chute filling the bottom half of the frame, with dark pine forest and hills behind. A spotted fawn lies curled up in the steel chute at the top of the slide. It sits up and looks straight down the slide at the camera with its ears out, settles back down into the chute, then gets to its feet and walks off into the tall grass beside the slide.

4262.words: wildlife (noun): wild animals and other living things
4262.asset_description: A mother brown bear and two cubs walk along a wide grey sand flat at low tide, below a steep mountainside streaked with snow, with pale glacial water behind them. A black raven stands on the sand nearby, spreads its wings and hops aside as the cubs trot past. The family walks on along the shoreline and away from the camera.

4267.asset_description: A small white Pomeranian stands on a dark grooming table in front of a window looking onto a sunny green garden. A groomer works round it with scissors, snipping the straggly hair on its back and legs; little tufts of white fur drop onto the table. The dog pants happily, screws its eyes shut while its face is cupped and shaped, and ends up with a perfectly round, smooth, even coat.

4282.words: shelter (noun): a place that cares for animals with no home
4282.asset_description: A couple crouches at a wire kennel door inside an animal rescue centre and greets a tan dog through the mesh; a staff member in a green polo shirt opens the kennel and the couple hug the dog; at the front desk the same woman stamps their adoption paperwork; the couple then walk the dog out on a red leash down the bright corridor and out through the exit.
4282.transcript: It's him. He's all yours. Let's go home.

4325.words: cattle (noun): cows and bulls as a group of farm animals
4325.asset_description: A colourful illustration of an open grassy plain. A young man in a wide-brimmed hat, poncho and baggy trousers stands with his back half turned, whirling a set of weighted cords above his head. A brown horse rears up in a cloud of dust behind him on the left. Across the middle of the plain several dark cows graze in a loose group, and behind them stand purple mountains. On the right a light-blue and white flag flies from a pole beside a saddle blanket with a gourd and a metal kettle on it.

4341.asset_description: The same red-haired young man sits on a promenade bench eating from a paper cone of chips while a gull watches from the bench beside him. A gull dives at the back of his head and his eyes go wide; two more come in low and he ducks down over the cone. Then he is up and running hard away down the promenade, cone clutched to his chest and head down, with gulls flying after him on both sides, and in the last shot the whole flock is up in the air chasing him along the seafront.

4346.asset_description: A photographic outback scene at sunset. A man in a wide-brimmed bush hat and dusty work clothes walks across bare red sand with a canvas duffel bag slung over one shoulder, turning to look back over his shoulder at the camera; his boot kicks up a puff of red dust. Behind and to his right a mob of five or six grey kangaroos is bounding past through the spinifex grass, each caught in mid-air with its long tail out behind it and its back legs tucked under. A huge red rock monolith glows orange in the low sun on the horizon, with scattered trees and dry golden grass in front of it.

4382.words: salmon (noun): a large food fish of northern waters
4382.asset_description: A black-and-white charcoal drawing of a grizzly bear standing upright in a shallow river. A large salmon leaps out of the water in front of it with drops flying off its body, and the bear reaches out with its claws to grab the fish. Pine trees and mist fill the background.

4516.words: hay (noun): dried grass used as food for animals
4516.asset_description: A soft pastel cartoon inside a wooden barn. A plump speckled brown-and-white hen has just launched herself off her nest and hangs in mid-air with her wings spread, eyes shut and beak open, loose feathers drifting around her. Below her sits a round nest built of dried yellow grass with three pale eggs in it and two more eggs on the ground beside it. The whole barn floor is covered in the same loose dried yellow grass and more of it is heaped in the stalls behind.

4584.words: trail (noun): a track or mark left by something passing
4584.asset_description: Early morning on a wide sandy beach. A newly hatched sea turtle drags itself down the wet sand towards the water, and behind it a long double line of flipper prints runs back up the beach, with more hatchlings strung out along the same track. A woman in a khaki shirt and a red headband kneels behind them with both hands pressed to her mouth, delighted. In the last shots the white foam of a wave washes up over the sand and reaches the turtles.

4772.words: flock (noun): a group of birds together
4772.asset_description: An orange and pink sunset over a flat coastal marsh. An enormous mass of starlings wheels across the sky, thousands of dark specks moving as one body and changing shape from a curl to an S to a wide spiral. People stand along a wooden boardwalk watching; an older woman in a plaid coat and beret points up at the birds while a grey-haired man beside her stares open-mouthed at the sky.

5039.words: cage (noun): a box of metal bars that shuts an animal in
5039.asset_description: At sunrise on a city rooftop an old man with a white beard stands in front of a tall stack of wooden and wire bird cages with small birds inside, and unlatches the little doors one after another. Birds burst out of the cages and the sky fills with a huge flock. He holds an empty cage in his arms and looks up, and the crowd of people behind him watches the birds circle over the city.

5043.words: silent (adjective): with no sound at all
5043.asset_description: A hand-drawn illustration of a male lion standing on the edge of a rocky cliff above an African savanna. His mouth is wide open in a full roar, showing teeth and tongue, and his dark mane is blown back by the wind, drawn as curling white lines around him. Below and behind him dry grass, flat-topped acacia trees and purple hills stretch to the horizon, where a big orange sun is rising.

5061.words: aquarium (noun): a glass tank of water where fish are kept
5061.asset_description: A young man in a white thobe rides an escalator up through a vast, bright shopping centre, looking around and laughing. He steps off into a huge circular atrium with balconies on many floors and glass capsule lifts running up the middle. He then walks to a railing in front of an enormous glass fish tank: sharks and rays glide through blue water above a stone tunnel, with an ice rink and skaters below. He spreads both arms wide and stares up at the sharks, open-mouthed.

5114.words: flamingo (noun): a tall pink water bird with a bent beak
5114.asset_description: Inside a wooden birdwatching hide, four people crowd at the open window looking out over a shallow lake. An older man with a white moustache bends to a spotting scope on a tripod, a young woman with green hair holds binoculars, a man beside her stares out, and someone writes in a notebook on the ledge. Outside, hundreds of tall pink birds with long legs stand in the water, and the whole flock lifts off and flies low across the lake with their pink and black wings spread.

5144.words: dove (noun): the white bird used as a sign of peace
5144.asset_description: Two elderly men in suits meet in front of a tall white stone monument under a clear blue sky, shake hands warmly and then pull each other into a long hug while a crowd of onlookers watches. Rows of schoolgirls in navy uniforms line both sides of the paved square, each holding a wicker basket with white birds sitting inside. The girls tip the baskets open and the white birds burst upwards, first a handful and then dozens, until the whole sky above the monument is filled with them. The two men stand together at the centre looking up at the birds.

5240.words: wing (noun): a movable body part used for flying
5240.asset_description: A falconry clip in the desert at dusk. A young man in a white thobe and a red-checked headscarf swings a lure on a long cord over his head. A falcon flies in low across the sand, beats its wings and drops onto his raised gloved fist, spreading both wings wide as it settles. He laughs, then feeds it small pieces of meat from his fingers. Friends and a pickup truck stand behind him, and camp tents sit among the dunes.

5259.words: fur (noun): the soft thick hair covering an animal
5259.asset_description: A wooden jetty on a mountain lake. A woman with pink hair holds a paper coffee cup and leans on the boards next to a small brown dachshund, her mouth open in surprise. A very large white mountain dog, soaked from the water, steps onto the jetty and shakes the water out of its thick white coat, the hair standing out in all directions. The woman laughs and covers her mouth while a bearded man behind her strokes the dog.

85.words: betray (verb): to break someone's trust after promising help
85.asset_description: In a 3D-animated hay field a kid pinky-promises a big farmer to catch him; the man does a trust fall, the kid steps aside and he crashes into the hay, sitting up covered in straw and betrayed while the kid grins.
85.transcript: Ready? I trust you. I promise. Fall back! You promised me!

183.words: comfort (verb): to make a sad person feel better
183.asset_description: In an animated night scene, a young woman cries on brownstone steps; her friend sits down, puts an arm around her, hands her a tissue and a mug of hot cocoa, and she slowly smiles again.
183.transcript: Hey, I'm here. It's just so hard. I know. Come here. Thank you. Really.

584.words: prove (verb): to show that something is true by demonstrating it
584.asset_description: A 3D-animated young woman faces a doubting friend who stands with crossed arms. She kicks up into a perfect handstand, holds it while his face turns from smug to amazed, then lands; he applauds and admits she won.
584.transcript: No way! Okay, okay, you win.

787.words: to judge (verb): to form a critical opinion about someone
787.asset_description: In a bright cafe, a woman with iced drinks glances sideways at her friend, raises her eyebrows as the voiceover says her friend did something silly "but I do not judge her", then breaks into a warm smile and the two clink their glasses.
787.transcript: My friend does something silly, but I do not judge her.

2586.words: friendship (noun): the bond between friends who care for each other
2586.asset_description: On a rainy city street, a giant battered robot bends down to gently hold hands with a little girl in a red dress holding a red umbrella.

4415.words: compliment (noun): a remark expressing praise or admiration
4415.asset_description: In a café strung with fairy lights, a young woman with bright red cheeks hides her face behind both hands, then peeks out and gives a small embarrassed wave. Another woman opens a handwritten note, reads it and goes pink to the ears, grinning at the page. At a table of cappuccinos the whole group laughs together, everyone's cheeks flushed, as they say nice things to each other.

4498.words: sign (verb): to mark with your signature
4498.asset_description: A group of teenagers sit around a low table in a school common room. One boy in a navy hoodie holds out his left arm, which is in a white plaster cast supported by a sling. His friends take coloured felt-tip pens out of a white cup and write their names and messages on the cast, one adding a yellow sun and another a scribbled signature. By the end the cast is covered in names and drawings in green, orange, blue and red, and the boy holds his arm up and laughs at it.

4558.words: support (noun): help given to a person or cause
4558.asset_description: A dim living room strung with fairy lights at dusk. A young man sits on a sofa wrapped in a striped knitted blanket, crying, holding a mug of tea in both hands. A friend beside him puts an arm round his shoulders and talks quietly to him. Two more friends sit down on either side, then a fourth, and they all lean in and hold him while he keeps crying with the mug in his hands.
4558.transcript: Hey, hey. It's okay. We're here. Thanks.

4559.words: console (verb): to give emotional strength to someone sad
4559.asset_description: A room lit by blue and orange fairy lights. A red-haired young man sits on a sofa under a striped blanket, crying, holding a yellow mug in both hands. A friend rests a hand on his shoulder, then a young woman sits down beside him and rubs his arm, and two more friends close in from behind. They wrap their arms around him together in one tight group hug, faces pressed against his shoulders, while he goes on crying.

4753.words: forgive (verb): to stop blaming someone and forgive them
4753.asset_description: Two young men stand on a suburban pavement beside a low brick wall with a road bike leaning against it. One in a navy hoodie stands with his arms folded tight and his jaw set, refusing to look up. The other, in black with a takeaway coffee cup, leans on the wall and talks to him steadily. The folded arms drop, the first one looks down and half-smiles, and the two step together into a long hug over the wall.

5363.words: aid (verb): to give help to someone
5363.asset_description: An exhausted female runner wearing race bib 134 is held up under both arms by a man in a grey cap and a young woman in a rainbow tri-suit at the end of a city road race. Spectators behind metal barriers clap and shout. The three walk her forward together across the finish line, then stop and fall into a tight group hug, crying and laughing.

94.words: blink (verb): to quickly close and open your eyes
94.asset_description: In a cel-animated diner a couple has a staring contest over milkshakes; the man's eye waters and twitches until he finally blinks, the woman points at him in triumph and teases him, and they both burst out laughing.
94.transcript: Shut! Open! Shut! Open! Ha! Gotcha! You too!

455.words: lungs (noun): the two organs in your chest you breathe with
455.asset_description: A woman in sportswear stands in a park, hands at her chest, taking slow deep breaths in and out. Then she blows into a red balloon and, with her mighty breath, inflates it to a comically gigantic size and lifts it overhead, laughing.

642.words: scar (noun): a permanent mark on the skin from a healed wound
642.asset_description: Three animated friends sit around crates of mugs on a beach pier at sunset comparing scars: a red-haired woman rolls up her sleeve to show a forearm scar from a hot pan, a bearded man shows a bigger one on his arm, and a third friend tops them both with a huge scar along his shin.
642.transcript: Hot pan, two years ago. Hah, mine is bigger. Boys, look at this. [gasping] [laughing]

723.words: spine (noun): the column of bones down the middle of the back
723.asset_description: In a clinic, a young man with back pain bends over; a doctor points down the row of vertebrae on a skeleton model, then the man straightens his back, stands tall and feels better.
723.transcript: Bone, bone, bone, all the way down. Now stand up tall. Ooh, much better.

991.words: chest (noun): the front upper part of the body
991.asset_description: A shirtless man in black swim shorts stretches his arms up at the edge of a misty lake at dawn; the frame centers on his bare muscular chest and stomach.

1015.words: calf (noun): the thick muscle at the back of your lower leg
1015.asset_description: A runner in a vest and shorts has dropped to one knee on a sunlit running track and grips the back of his lower leg with both hands, his face screwed up in pain.

1131.words: heel (noun): the rounded back part of the foot
1131.asset_description: A close-up of two bare feet rising onto tiptoe on a wooden floor, both heels lifted high off the ground so their rounded backs face the camera.

1135.words: hip (noun): the part where the leg joins the waist
1135.asset_description: In a warm dance hall a young woman spins so her patterned skirt flares out, one hand pressed firmly on her hip while couples dance in the background.

1944.words: ribs (noun): the curved bones around your chest
1944.asset_description: A Day-of-the-Dead style vector artwork of a white skeleton among pink and red flowers; its chest is open to show the full cage of ribs, and its skull is decorated with flower patterns over one eye.

2234.words: muscles (noun): the strong parts that move your body
2234.asset_description: A shirtless long-haired barbarian with huge chest and arm muscles stands in a rocky canyon, gripping a sword and wearing a fur-trimmed red kilt.

2556.words: brain (noun): the organ in the head we think with
2556.asset_description: A dark digital poster: the giant profile of a man's head fills the frame and the whole brain area glows with red and blue points of light joined by fine lines, like a network. A tiny silhouetted man in a coat stands far below, looking up at it.

2658.words: fist (noun): a hand with the fingers closed tightly
2658.asset_description: A muscular bearded sea god in a blue cloth and golden armour stands in crashing waves under storm clouds, holding a golden trident in one hand and raising his other hand clenched into a fist.

2712.words: anatomy (noun): the study of how a body is built inside
2712.asset_description: A collage-style artwork split down the middle: the left half is a painted young woman's freckled face, the right half is a pale anatomical drawing of the same head in profile with the folded brain and nerves labelled on graph paper.

2731.words: pupil (noun): the black hole that lets light into the eye
2731.asset_description: A giant human eye fills the frame in the dark; its bright blue iris is drawn with fine radiating fibres around a black pupil, and glowing neon circles, numbers and circuit lines surround the eye.

2779.words: iris (noun): the coloured ring around the pupil
2779.asset_description: An extreme close-up of a young woman's face: one wide blue-green eye fills the middle of the picture with every fibre of the coloured ring visible, while dark cloth and glowing golden flowers cover the lower half of her face.

2847.words: lung (noun): one of the two organs you breathe with
2847.asset_description: A man seen from the side stands on a sunlit forest path; his chest is shown as if transparent, with a pair of glowing green lungs branching inside it like the trees behind him.

4080.words: wrist (noun): the joint between the hand and the arm
4080.asset_description: An animated scene in a home. A mother in a purple jumper stands behind her small daughter, who sits scowling in a pink hoodie with her arms folded. The mother gathers a handful of the girl's long brown hair in one fist and holds it up, looking around with a worried face for something to tie it with. She leans over and rummages through an open wooden drawer, then searches a dressing table lit by round bulbs around a mirror, pushing aside bottles and tubes. She presses a hand to her forehead in despair. Then she notices three grey hair ties looped around her own wrist, and a close-up shows her fingers hooking one off her wrist as she smiles.

4460.words: palm (noun): the inner surface of the hand
4460.asset_description: A beach at nightfall, the sky already deep blue and the sea barely visible. A woman in a pale jacket crouches over a small teepee of thin sticks ringed with white stones and feeds the little flame at its centre. The fire grows until it is the only light in the shot, throwing orange light onto her face, her hands and the stones while everything beyond stays dark. She sits back on her heels and holds both palms out to the flames as sparks rise.

4583.words: calf (noun): the thick muscle at the back of your lower leg
4583.asset_description: A floodlit five-a-side pitch at night. A player in a pale blue kit runs onto the ball, then suddenly pulls up and drops onto the grass, rolling onto his side and grabbing the back of his lower leg with both hands, his face screwed up. A man in a grey training vest runs on, kneels beside him, takes hold of his ankle and lower leg and pushes the foot back to stretch the muscle out while the player grimaces and clenches his fist. Team-mates stand watching in the background.

4592.words: foot (noun): the part of the leg below the ankle
4592.asset_description: Sunset in a vineyard. A hand squeezes a bunch of dark grapes until purple juice runs down the wrist and arm and drips into a crate below. A woman in a red top and an older man tip a crate of grapes into a big wooden vat. Then bare feet come down into the grapes: close shots show the soles and toes pressing and turning in the fruit, the ankles and lower legs stained purple, and finally the two of them stand in the vat and stomp up and down together, laughing, with the rolled-up jeans above their bare feet.

4684.words: elbow (noun): the joint between the forearm and upper arm
4684.asset_description: In a bright open-plan office with plants and laptops, colleagues greet each other by bumping elbows instead of shaking hands. A woman raises her bent arm and taps her elbow against a man's; a bearded man in a blue shirt bumps elbows with her and laughs; then the whole team stands up along the desks, everyone with one arm bent and lifted, and they touch elbows down the row, laughing.

4818.words: heel (noun): the rounded back part of the foot
4818.asset_description: In a gym with a wooden floor, a finger points in close-up at a foot in a navy sock that has a thin stiletto spike fixed under the rounded back part of the foot, so the sock stands on a heel with no shoe around it. The camera pulls back to show three people in matching navy gym shirts trying to walk across the floor on these spikes, arms held out for balance, wobbling and laughing, one man in shorts leading and a woman and an older man following behind him.

4867.words: thumb (noun): the short thick finger on your hand
4867.asset_description: A montage of people making videos. A young man in a gaming chair with a headset shouts happily at a ring light, a lit keyboard in front of him. A woman in a kitchen holds up a big pan of chicken and vegetables toward the camera. A girl on a sofa laughs and holds both thumbs up close to the lens. A young man sings loudly into a studio microphone with an electric guitar. Finally a performer stands on a huge arena stage with arms raised, confetti falling, filmed by two camera operators.

4950.words: hip (noun): the part where the leg joins the waist
4950.asset_description: In a mirrored dance studio a young woman in a bright red crop top and short red skirt stands facing the camera with both hands planted on either side of her body just below her waist. Around her a young man in a grey T-shirt and black shorts and two other dancers copy the same position, hands flat on the sides of their bodies below the waist. The man steps up beside her, holds the pose with a serious face, and by the end both of them are laughing while the class keeps its hands in place.

4963.words: finger (noun): any of the long parts on your hand, not the thumb
4963.asset_description: A bright empty room during a move, with flat-pack furniture parts, screws and cardboard boxes on the floor. A red-haired woman in dungarees sits on the floor gripping one hand in the other, squeezing her hurt finger and screwing up her face. She stands, shakes the hand out, then bangs her bare toe on the leg of the half-built table and hops. Later she carries a white wardrobe with a man, who ends up clutching his own arm while she grabs her foot again.

5055.words: organ (noun): a body part in an animal with its own function
