5055.asset_description: A flat cartoon drawing on a mint-green background: a pair of pink lungs seen from the front, with the windpipe branching down into both sides and pale blue airway trees drawn inside each half. Curling light-blue lines and dots swirl around them to suggest air moving in and out. Nothing else is in the frame.

5342.words: tongue (noun): the soft muscular part inside your mouth
5342.asset_description: In a bright kitchen a woman helps a girl hold a piping bag and pipe pink swirls onto a tray of cupcakes. The woman then dabs a fingerful of frosting onto the girl's outstretched tongue and both of them laugh. Later the woman braids the girl's hair while a man watches from the background; the girl holds up a crayon drawing of three figures under a red heart and shows it to her, they talk, and the two end in a long hug.

5402.words: throat (noun): the passage to your stomach and lungs
5402.asset_description: In a clinic a female doctor in a white coat and headscarf holds a wooden tongue depressor and looks into the wide-open mouth of a young man in a pink polo shirt. He then stands at a water cooler and drinks from a bottle with his hand on his chest; a close-up shows his neck and Adam's apple moving as he swallows, his head tilted back. At the end he faces the camera and speaks, looking relieved.

5465.words: waist (noun): the narrow middle of the body above the hips
5465.asset_description: In a fabric shop lined with stacked bolts of cloth and a wall of coloured thread spools, a smiling young woman in a rust-orange jumpsuit stands while an older man with a yellow tape measure runs it around the narrow middle of her body and reads the number. The shot moves in close on her middle as she fastens a wide woven red belt around it. She then steps back and spins a hula hoop around the same part of her body, laughing with her arms raised, a sewing machine and workbench behind her.

516.words: overflow (verb): when liquid rises over the edge and spills out
516.asset_description: In a cel-animated kitchen, a man fills the sink to wash dishes but looks away, and the foamy water rises over the rim and pours onto the floor. He rushes back to shut the tap and stands sheepishly in a big puddle.

673.words: shrink (verb): to become smaller, like clothes washed too hot
673.asset_description: In a Ghibli-style anime laundry room, a red-haired girl loads her big red sweater into the washing machine, then pulls it out again shrunk to doll size and holds the tiny sweater up in horrified disbelief.

763.words: tablecloth (noun): a cloth spread over a table to cover it
763.asset_description: On a seaside terrace at sunset, a couple throws a white tablecloth high into the air, lets it float down over a wooden table, smooths it flat and then sets plates and glasses on top; a cat walks across at the end.
763.transcript: Three, up and over. Smooth, perfect.

1037.words: detergent (noun): a liquid or powder used for washing up
1037.asset_description: A woman at a kitchen sink tips a big bottle and pours green washing-up detergent into a sink already piled with foam and dirty plates.

3072.words: to rake (verb): to pull leaves together with a long tool
3072.asset_description: Cartoon of a grey striped cat standing on its back legs and holding a wooden rake, pulling orange autumn leaves into a pile under bright orange trees.

3638.words: to mop (verb): to clean a floor with a wet mop
3638.asset_description: Illustration of an empty planetarium with planets and stars painted across the dome. An astronaut pushes a mop across the shiny floor with a bucket on wheels beside him and a yellow wet-floor sign to the right.

3647.words: to wipe (verb): to clean a surface by rubbing it with a cloth
3647.asset_description: Retro-style illustration: an astronaut stands on a window-cleaner's platform hanging on ropes in space and wipes the surface of the huge cratered moon with a cloth, leaving a clean shining patch. A bucket sits beside his feet.

4252.words: concrete (noun): a hard building material made with cement
4252.asset_description: A back garden with a large above-ground pool standing on a wide concrete patio, its slabs marked out by straight joint lines. A young man in sunglasses lies on a patterned Persian rug spread on the concrete, propped on one elbow under a small black umbrella, sipping an orange drink through a straw. Behind him another man in a white T-shirt scrubs the wet concrete with a long-handled deck brush, pushing white soapy foam across the slabs. More rugs lie drying on the concrete and the whole patio is covered in suds and water.

4342.words: haul (verb): to pull something slowly and heavily
4342.asset_description: A pencil-sketch attic under sloping roof beams. A young woman in a work shirt and loose trousers has both hands on the rope handle of a heavy wooden trunk and is dragging it across the bare floorboards towards the viewer, leaning her whole weight back and bending her knees. Dust rises in clouds around the trunk and off the torn dust sheet it has pulled off the furniture. Behind her stand two stacked suitcases with an oil lantern on top, a rocking chair, rolled rugs and a small dirty window; cobwebs hang from the beams in the foreground.

4379.words: tub (noun): a large open container you fill with water to wash
4379.asset_description: A stained-glass style picture of a woman cleaning a bathroom. She leans over a big white roll-top bath in yellow rubber gloves, scrubbing the inside with a stiff brush. The bath is full of white suds and they are spilling over the rim in a wave onto the tiled floor around her bare feet. A brass tap and shower fitting sit at the head of the bath, a towel hangs on the rail and a washbasin stands in the foreground.

4470.words: store (verb): to keep something for future use
4470.asset_description: A man in a light blue shirt stands at the white wall units of a bright kitchen with a patterned tile splashback. He opens the doors of an empty cupboard and shows the bare wooden shelves. He then puts the dishes away shelf by shelf: stacks of coloured plates, nests of green and blue bowls, a pile of purple plates lifted up from below. He closes the doors, opens them again, and the cupboard is now full — rainbow stacks of plates and bowls on the lower shelf and rows of coloured preserving jars along the upper one. He steps back and looks at it.

4532.words: trash (noun): worthless material to be thrown away
4532.asset_description: A woman in a bright patterned headwrap appears in three scenes. First she smiles as she posts a folded white paper through the slot of a grey ballot box in a bright classroom. Then she is in a park with two other women, working a long litter-picker to lift a plastic bottle and other thrown-away rubbish off the grass into the green bags they hold open. Then she stands outside a government building under a row of flags, opens a blue passport, reads it, hugs it to her chest and laughs, and finally walks through a busy city square still holding it.

4537.words: clear (verb): to rid a place of obstructions
4537.asset_description: A small Japanese flat crammed with things. A woman in a yellow apron works along a wooden shelf unit with a spray bottle and a cloth, taking down bottles and folded cloths. The floor around her is covered in clothes and open cardboard boxes; she bends down and packs armfuls of them away. Next she wipes a low wooden table with a blue cloth. The room is then shown from the door: the shelves are empty, the floor is bare, sunlight falls across the boards. She drops onto the sofa on her back, mouth open, done in.

4538.words: rest (noun): freedom from work or activity
4538.asset_description: A woman with curly hair and a knotted headband leans over a glass coffee table loaded with remote controls, magazines, tubes and sprays, scrubbing the glass with a white cloth. Spray bottles stand around her. She moves to the sofa and pulls the seat cushions straight, punching them back into shape. The living room is then shown from the doorway, empty and bare, with sun on the parquet and one rag left on the floor. She sits down on the sofa, leans back, stretches her legs out and stays there, looking round the finished room.

4540.words: equipment (noun): the things needed to do a job or service
4540.asset_description: Four short shots of people cleaning, each built around the kit they use. A woman in yellow rubber gloves pushes a blue sponge in circles through soapy water on a white kitchen worktop. A man in a grey uniform swings a round spin mop on a yellow pole across a glossy office floor while staff work at desks behind him. A window cleaner in a blue hard hat, orange safety harness and white gloves draws a squeegee down a skyscraper pane from a hanging cradle, the city far below. A man in a grey T-shirt bends over a wooden floor in an empty flat with a cloth, buckets and bottles lined up behind him.

4541.asset_description: A bathroom after a haircut. The white basin, the marble counter and the mirror are smeared all over with clippings of black hair; loose hair is stuck to the glass and lies in drifts on the floor. A man in a white vest wipes the counter and the basin with a grey cloth, rinses it under the tap, then wipes the mirror clean in wide strokes. By the end the mirror is clear, the marble is bare and the basin is white again, with a single spray bottle standing on the counter.

4639.words: liquid (adjective): having the characteristics of a liquid, flowing
4639.asset_description: A woodblock-style illustration of a hand tipping a dark bottle over a kitchen sink. A thick blue-green stream pours out of the bottle's neck in a smooth curve and falls into the sink, where it breaks into swirling waves and masses of white foam. A brass tap sits on the left and two patterned plates lean in the soapy water on the right.

4640.words: detergent (noun): a liquid or powder used for washing up
4640.asset_description: A man opens the blue cap of a rainbow-coloured bottle in a laundry room and pours thick blue liquid from it into the measuring cap. He pulls out the drawer of a white front-loading washing machine and tips the blue liquid in, then closes the drawer and starts the machine, which we see running with washing turning inside. At the end he holds up a clean white t-shirt and smiles.

4668.words: to smell (verb): to inhale the odor of something
4668.asset_description: On a sunny rooftop terrace above a deep blue sea, a grey-haired woman in a blue dress and a flowered apron hangs white washing on a rope line. She shakes out a white shirt, pegs it up, straightens it with both hands, and at the end lifts a white cloth to her nose, closes her eyes and breathes in the smell of it.

4669.words: laundry (noun): garments that can be cleaned by washing
4669.asset_description: A tiled terrace high above the sea. A white shirt hangs from a wooden peg on a line, moving in the wind. An older woman in a blue dress and a flowered apron lifts more white washing onto the line, pegs a white garment up with both hands, then gathers an armful of clean white clothes against her chest and looks out at the water, laughing.

4825.words: to wipe (verb): to clean a surface by rubbing it with a cloth
4825.asset_description: A wrecked kitchen is cleaned up. Spray foam is squirted over a black stove top covered in dried food, then a woman stacks dirty bowls and plates from a counter buried in washing-up, then a hand rubs a folded cloth over the white worktop in circles, and the last shots pan across the same kitchen completely clean and empty.
4825.transcript: Wow, you cleaned this whole messy kitchen so well.

4846.words: iron (verb): to press clothes smooth with a hot iron
4846.asset_description: A woman in a kitchen runs a steam iron over a white shirt spread on an ironing board by the window. Cut to a bedroom, where a man in a blue polo presses a pair of dark trousers laid flat across the end of the bed. Then an older woman at a wooden dining table works the iron over a stack of grey linen napkins. Next two women stand at opposite sides of a long table in a bright loft and run an iron each over a big white sheet. Finally the two of them hold the finished sheet up between them, hanging smooth and flat.

5086.asset_description: In a high-rise office a woman in a dark uniform, yellow rubber gloves and yellow shoes pushes a flat mop across a wide stone floor. The floor she has already done throws back a clear mirror image of the ceiling lights and the windows. Behind a glass wall a meeting is going on at a long table with people in suits, none of whom look up. She works her way backwards across the hall, leaving one long polished strip after another.

5123.words: flood (verb): to fill something too quickly and spill over
5123.asset_description: A cup under a coffee machine has filled past the brim and coffee is running out over the black worktop and pouring off the edge onto the kitchen floor. A young man in a purple hoodie rushes in and finds the kitchen sink filled to overflowing, the tap still running and white foam and water sheeting down the cupboard doors onto the tiles. He runs down the hallway to the bathroom, where the bathtub is full to the rim and a wall of foam is pouring over the side and spreading across the floor. He stands in the doorway with his hands in his hair, shouting, as the foam keeps rising out of the tub.

103.words: laundromat (noun): a shop of washing machines you pay to use
103.asset_description: A young man kills time at night in a room lined with big washing machines and dryers: he slumps on the steel folding counter, slides a coin about, checks the wall clock and finally stretches out flat across the plastic waiting chairs.

380.words: journey (noun): traveling a long way from one place to another
380.asset_description: A girl crosses the city step by step: she grabs a croissant and coffee, walks wet streets, swipes through the subway turnstile, rides the train, fights with a broken umbrella in the rain and climbs long stairs until she reaches a rooftop view at sunset and says it was worth it.
380.transcript: Gotta eat something first or I seriously won't make it. I really hope this is the right train. Okay, looks right. Of course it's raining. Almost there. But it was worth it.

905.words: alley (noun): a very narrow street between buildings
905.asset_description: A man in a leather jacket walks toward the camera along a narrow cobblestone alley squeezed between old plastered houses at dusk, laundry hanging on lines overhead and a cat crossing the stones in front of him.

943.words: billboard (noun): a huge board above a street where ads are posted
943.asset_description: A worker in a high-vis vest stands on a lift platform high above a busy city street, peeling a huge sheet of paper across a giant blank billboard.

1017.words: crosswalk (noun): the striped part of a road for crossing
1017.asset_description: Overhead view of a white-striped street crossing: a woman with a shoulder bag strides across the middle while other pedestrians enter from the sides and cars wait at the bottom edge.

1233.words: pedestrian (noun): a person walking in the street, not driving
1233.asset_description: A man in a camel coat strides across a striped crosswalk with a coffee cup in hand, cars waiting on the sunlit city street behind him.

1527.words: cathedral (noun): a very large and important church
1527.asset_description: A black-and-white watercolor of a grand baroque cathedral with a huge stone dome and small towers, surrounded by dark ink washes and splatters.

1538.words: column (noun): a tall upright post that holds up a building
1538.asset_description: An ancient-Egyptian-style illustration of a woman in a patterned robe and headdress holding two golden vessels, standing between two tall brightly decorated columns with plant-shaped tops.

1541.asset_description: A 3D render of a small white chapel with a cross and a tall pointed steeple standing in deep snow among frosted trees, with snowflakes falling and a little sled by the steps.

1623.words: skyscraper (noun): a very tall building with many floors
1623.asset_description: A blue watercolor view over Manhattan at dusk: dense skyscrapers with lit windows fill the frame, the Empire State Building towering above the rest.

1787.words: streetlight (noun): a tall lamp that lights a street at night
1787.asset_description: A young woman in a warm coat and red scarf stands under a tall glowing streetlight at night while snow falls thickly around her.

1843.words: neighborhood (noun): the streets and houses around your home
1843.asset_description: A child-style painting of the view through a dark window frame: colorful houses with snowy roofs and lit yellow windows under a night sky with a crescent moon.

1928.words: downtown (noun): the busy central business area of a city
1928.asset_description: A painterly night scene of a dense downtown street: towering buildings covered in glowing red neon signs and lit windows, a dark car in the foreground and a line of small silhouetted people on the wet pavement.

1957.words: cobblestones (noun): the round stones that pave old streets
1957.asset_description: An oil-style painting of an old-town lane at night: a huge glowing moon hangs in the misty blue sky while lantern light shimmers across the wet cobblestones paving the empty street between timbered houses.

2014.words: dusk (noun): the fading light just before night
2014.asset_description: A moody painting of an old European lane at fading light: a lone figure walks down the wet cobbled street between a timbered house and a huge hazy cathedral, windows glowing warm against the dimming yellow sky.

2024.words: neon (adjective): glowing in bright electric colours
2024.asset_description: A cyberpunk painting of a night street packed with dark silhouetted people walking on wet pavement, while tall buildings on both sides blaze with glowing neon signs in pink, blue and green.

2025.words: futuristic (adjective): looking modern, high-tech and from the future
2025.asset_description: A painting looking down into a canyon of towering futuristic buildings at night: layered balconies, glowing blue and purple lights and hazy skyscrapers stretching into the distance below.

2067.words: lamppost (noun): a tall street pole with a light on top
2067.asset_description: A single lamppost glows warm orange over a snowy park path at dusk, lighting the falling snow beside a large snow-covered pine tree and a small bench.

2086.words: festive (adjective): cheerful and decorated for a celebration
2086.asset_description: A snowy old-town street at dusk glowing with warm lanterns, decorated shopfronts, red wreaths and garlands, with a few people walking between the lit houses.

2087.words: skyline (noun): the outline of a city against the sky
2087.asset_description: A steampunk industrial city seen from above: dark ornate towers, spires and brass machinery rise out of thick fog against a pale morning sky.

2110.words: silhouette (noun): a dark outline against a bright background
2110.asset_description: The dark silhouette of a man in a long coat stands in a neon-lit cyberpunk street at night, glowing green and pink signs and skyscrapers towering around him and a car passing in front.

2118.words: fancy (adjective): decorated, expensive-looking and not plain
2118.asset_description: Two women with umbrellas walk down a wet, glowing old-town street lined with fancy golden shopfronts, ornate lamps, curling iron signs and rounded awnings, towers fading into the evening mist.

2181.asset_description: A painterly anime-style girl with an orange backpack glances back over her shoulder while standing in a crowded neon city street packed with people, glowing signs and tall buildings.

2227.words: glance (verb): to look at something quickly
2227.asset_description: A blonde girl in a bright red jacket glances back over her shoulder on a city street glowing with warm blurred lights.

2249.words: steampunk (adjective): a fantasy style of old brass machines and gears
2249.asset_description: A wide view over a fantastical steampunk city: huge brass towers covered in gears, pipes and balconies, wooden bridges full of tiny people, and a harbor with islands under a blue sky.

2268.words: tightrope (noun): a rope stretched high for acrobats to cross
2268.asset_description: A blonde woman in white balances barefoot-light on a thick rope stretched high above the rooftops of an old city, steadying herself with both hands on the rope.

2344.words: crooked (adjective): bent and leaning, not straight
2344.asset_description: A storybook night town of tall crooked houses leaning in every direction, with lit windows, a glowing lamppost on a winding cobblestone path and a crescent moon above.

2494.words: victorian (adjective): in the style of 19th-century England
2494.asset_description: A man in a long dark coat and top hat stands with his back to us in a snowy Victorian street at night, with gas lamps, old crooked houses and townspeople in period clothes.

2524.words: walking stick (noun): a stick you lean on to help you walk
2524.asset_description: A watercolor scene of two dark silhouettes, a hunched man leaning on a walking stick and a woman beside him, walking down a cobbled medieval street at sunset between lampposts and towers.

2533.words: misty (adjective): covered in thin fog that hides things
2533.asset_description: An old cobbled street of timber houses at dusk, lit by warm lanterns; the far end of the street disappears into a misty haze where small figures walk between glowing lights.

2548.words: barrel (noun): a big round wooden container
2548.asset_description: A quiet medieval stone courtyard with timber-roofed houses; big wooden barrels stand stacked by the doors and next to a wooden cart on the cobbled path.

2745.words: courtyard (noun): an open space with buildings all around it
2745.asset_description: A painterly view of an old stone building with a tall carved archway and open wrought-iron gates; warm light falls on the paved yard in front, where broken stone blocks lie among green plants.

2774.words: architecture (noun): the art and style of designing buildings
2774.asset_description: A collage of Cologne cathedral in warm browns: two tall gothic spires and a heavily decorated stone facade, a steel arch railway bridge crossing in front of it, and faint construction drawings of the towers filling the left side of the picture.

2837.words: bookstore (noun): a shop where books are sold
2837.asset_description: An anime-style illustration of a short-haired student in a sailor-collar top, pleated skirt and blue backpack standing among tall shelves packed with colourful new books, holding one open book and looking at the camera, more books stacked on the floor.

3803.words: tower (noun): a tall narrow building or part of one
3803.asset_description: A fantasy digital painting shows a tall round stone castle tower on a rocky hill above green valleys, with a huge glowing red dragon coiled around it, wings spread and fire streaming from its mouth at sunset.

4114.words: mall (noun): a large complex of shops
4114.asset_description: An animated shopping centre with polished floors, glass shopfronts and bright ceiling lights. A woman in a gold dress walks hand in hand with a very large, heavily built man in a white T-shirt and white shorts. She spots a gold dress on a mannequin in a lit shop window, spins round and pulls him towards it. Her face fills the screen, beaming with excitement; then his face fills the screen, eyebrows raised and mouth open in dismay. In the last shot she strides out of the shop holding a fan of pink and white bags while he trudges behind her with both hands full of shopping bags.

4162.words: plaza (noun): a public square in a town
4162.asset_description: A wide, wet stone plaza in Paris at sunset, with the Eiffel Tower rising straight ahead across the river and the columns of a large building on the right. A cream-coloured classic Porsche 911 stands alone on the empty paving in the foreground while the camera drifts slowly sideways past it. The orange sky is full of cloud, a flock of birds turns above the tower, and a few distant people stand at the far edge of the square.

4300.words: rubbish (noun): worthless material to be thrown away
4300.asset_description: An inked comic-book panel of a narrow night-time alley between two brick tenements: metal dustbins in the foreground are heaped over the rim with crumpled paper and waste, a hooded figure runs down the wet cobbles clutching a satchel, a ginger cat leaps off a dumpster lid, steam pours from a grate in the ground, and fire escapes and washing lines criss-cross the dark blue sky above.

4432.words: ignore (verb): to refuse to notice or acknowledge
4432.asset_description: A busy shopping street lined with shops. A woman in a mustard coat walks past a window plastered with big red SALE posters without turning her head; an older man in a tan jacket walks past the same window looking straight ahead. In the doorway a salesman in a suit leans out smiling and stretches an arm towards the passing shoppers, but the stream of people with their coffee cups and carrier bags keeps walking straight past him, nobody meeting his eye. In the last shot the camera pulls back to the wide shop front with SALE signs in both windows and the salesman sitting alone on a stool in the empty doorway.

4492.asset_description: A man in a long black coat carrying a cream folder walks across a wide cobbled square in the early morning light, scattering a group of pigeons that flap up around his feet. Behind him two rows of tall flag poles line the square and lead the eye to an enormous ornate stone building with a gilded dome and a statue on a column in front of it, lit gold by the low sun, with a red tram and cars passing along the road at its foot.

4585.asset_description: A woman in a red beret, a striped top and dark jeans, carrying a baguette under her arm, walks from one side of a narrow Paris street to the other over the white stripes on the road, past a red-awninged cafe. The shot then cuts to a wide boulevard in front of the Arc de Triomphe, where she walks the whole width of the road with a crowd of other people while the light is green and the cars wait, and steps up onto the far side.

4586.words: crosswalk (noun): the striped part of a road for crossing
4586.asset_description: A Paris street corner with a red-awninged cafe and a cyclist waiting. A woman in a red beret and a striped top, holding a baguette, walks towards the camera along the broad white bars painted across the road, with the pedestrian light green beside her. The shot then cuts to the wide bar-painted crossing in front of the Arc de Triomphe, filled with people walking across in both directions, and she walks up the middle of it towards the camera.

4589.words: pedestrian (noun): a person walking in the street, not driving
4589.asset_description: A Japanese city street. A woman in a coral trouser suit with a white shoulder bag walks across the white-barred crossing towards the camera while a black van waits at the red light and the walk signal shows green; other people on foot cross the side street behind her. The camera then rises high above a huge scramble junction, showing her alone in the middle of the painted bars, and finally the same junction with hundreds of people on foot streaming across it in every direction while the cars stand still.

4605.words: wire (noun): a metal line that carries electricity
4605.asset_description: A comic-style illustration of a red and cream tram running along rails set into a cobbled street. Its scissor-shaped arm is pressed up against the overhead line, and a burst of yellow lightning-bolt sparks flies off where the two pieces of metal touch. More lines run across the pink sunset sky to the corners of the frame. A girl in a yellow jacket leans out of an open tram window with her blue scarf streaming behind her, pigeons flap up from the cobbles in front of the tram, and a castle and a gothic tower stand on the hill behind.

4785.words: terrace (noun): an open paved area outside a building
4785.asset_description: A young woman on a sunlit paved terrace outside a house holds an empty stemmed glass up to the camera and smiles. In close-up, orange juice is poured from a jug into the glass until it is full, standing on a pale stone table beside plates and a second jug. The shot widens: the woman and a young man sit at the laid table on the terrace, oleander bushes and a low wall behind them, and raise their glasses of juice towards the camera.

4806.words: dome (noun): a round roof shaped like half a ball
4806.asset_description: A young man in a white shirt stands in front of the Trevi Fountain holding an open photo book up against the carved figures and the green water, sits on stone steps turning its bright-tabbed pages, then stands at an iron railing above the city and holds the book up beside a great domed church on the skyline before hugging the book to his chest and smiling at the view.

4893.asset_description: A young woman in a navy T-shirt sits smiling in the stands of a baseball stadium; the camera pulls back over row after row of seated fans in caps and team shirts, past a packed lower tier, and rises into a wide shot of the whole bowl filled with spectators to the very top.

4903.words: crowd (verb): to gather closely in large numbers
4903.asset_description: An aerial shot looking down on a wide, sunlit paved plaza in front of a glass building. At first single people walk across the tiles in every direction, casting long shadows. More and more people arrive, and the loose scattering turns into a dense mass that packs together in the middle of the square until the paving is barely visible.

4948.words: skyline (noun): the outline of a city against the sky
4948.asset_description: A young woman in a green satin robe stands at a floor-to-ceiling hotel window with the outline of a whole city of tower blocks stretching away behind her under a pale sky. Holding an open bronze powder compact in one hand, she sweeps a make-up brush high on her cheekbone, then along the bridge of her nose and her brow, and finally under her chin, checking herself between strokes with wide eyes and an open mouth. At the end she lowers the brush, smiles at the camera and holds the compact up beside her face.

4958.words: villa (noun): a large, expensive house with a garden
4958.asset_description: A price-ladder tour of homes. An old man in a cardigan stands at a garden gate and waves toward a battered wooden hut behind him, caption 10,000 EUR. Cut to a young couple walking up the path of a detached white suburban house with a black door and a mown front lawn. Cut to a woman in a cream suit opening the door of a modern architect house, then presenting a huge glass villa with a long black reflecting pool and fountain, caption 5,000,000 EUR.

4959.words: cottage (noun): a small simple house in the countryside
4959.asset_description: Three homes shown in turn. An old man in a flat cap holds the plank door of a small single-story wooden cottage with a tin roof and a stove pipe, a tall sunflower beside it. Cut to a couple in matching tan jackets walking hand in hand up the path of a white weatherboard cottage with a red front door and clipped hedges, then a blonde woman presenting the same row of cottages with an open arm. Cut to a woman in a white suit standing in the doorway of a black glass mansion behind a still reflecting pool with palm trees.

4995.words: sculpture (noun): a three-dimensional work of art
4995.asset_description: A watercolour cartoon of an Italian town square. In the middle a stone fountain sprays three jets of water over a carved group of human figures on its basin. A young man in a striped shirt rides a red scooter across the wet cobblestones past the fountain, a pizza stall behind him. Pigeons take off in the foreground, an Italian flag hangs on a pole on the left, and the Leaning Tower of Pisa and a cathedral dome rise over the tiled roofs.

5065.words: aisle (noun): a narrow walkway between rows of shelves
5065.asset_description: A young man films himself walking through a busy Turkish street market. He holds an orange up to the camera and grins, then passes a fishmonger working beside large hanging scale pans over trays of iced fish. He walks on past barrels of green olives carrying a mesh bag of oranges, and finally walks down the long vaulted aisle of a covered spice bazaar, with rows of stalls piled high with coloured spices on both sides of him.

5102.words: alley (noun): a very narrow street between buildings
5102.asset_description: A woman with a large hiking backpack walks through an old North African medina, following a map on her phone. She turns down a very narrow lane between tall ochre and blue walls, close enough to touch both sides, checking the screen and pointing at it. She keeps walking, squeezes past a man standing in the lane, then passes through a covered market passage hung with clothes and lined with stalls, and out through a low brick archway. At the end she comes out into a huge open square in front of a mosque with a tall minaret, looks at her phone again and smiles.

5117.words: bookstore (noun): a shop where books are sold
5117.asset_description: A young man in round glasses, a denim jacket and a backpack stands in a narrow aisle of a packed bookshop, tall shelves of books on both sides of him and knee-high stacks of new titles on the floor. He holds a thick hardback open in both hands and lets the pages riffle past his face, mouth open in amazement. He turns a pink-jacketed book over, flips through a second heavy volume, then hugs an enormous oversized book to his chest. At the end he holds a huge book open above his head and looks up as the pages fan out over him.
5117.transcript: Oh! Oh! Aha! Oh! Oh! Oh! Oh! Whoa!

5135.words: space (noun): an area kept for one particular purpose
5135.asset_description: On a narrow town street at golden hour a woman edges a small blue hatchback into a tight kerbside gap between a white car in front and another car behind, leaning out of the open driver's window as she manoeuvres. The car settles into the gap beside the paved pavement, with shop fronts and cafe tables behind it. She then gets out, shuts the door and walks away along the pavement in the low sun.

5142.words: neighborhood (noun): the streets and houses around your home
5142.asset_description: An older man in denim overalls stands on a stepladder outside a clapboard house and pins a string of red, white and blue triangular bunting under the porch roof, then hangs a large striped flag beside the front door. A wider shot shows the same thing happening along the whole street: other men on ladders at their own porches, flags on the houses opposite, and a small child with painted cheeks running across the front lawn behind a wooden picket fence. In the last shots the man stands on the pavement in the middle of the decorated street, bunting strung above him and neighbours waving from the gardens on both sides, and puts his hand flat on his chest.

5157.words: neighbourhood (noun): the nearby area around where you live
5157.asset_description: On a cobbled street in a hillside quarter of brightly painted houses, a young man in a yellow vest keeps a football up with his foot while a bigger man in a dark T-shirt watches him. People come out of the doorways and windows of the houses around them and a game starts in the middle of the street, with folded shirts and a small metal frame for goals and women watching from balconies and doorsteps. It ends with all the players running together into one laughing huddle in the road.

5167.words: tile (noun): a flat square piece covering a floor
5167.asset_description: A selfie-POV clip through a Portuguese city. A young man holds the camera at arm's length while riding on the open step of a yellow tram down a steep narrow street at sunset. Next he walks along a building whose whole facade is covered in blue-and-white painted tiles; he presses his palm flat against them and looks up the wall. Then he is at a marble cafe table, breaking into a sugar-dusted custard tart with a fork beside an espresso, and eating it with a delighted look at the camera.

5278.words: corner (noun): the place where two streets meet
5278.asset_description: A young man in a denim jacket with orange headphones round his neck walks along a city pavement past parked cars while a cyclist rides by. He reaches the corner where two streets cross, marked by a fire hydrant and chalk drawings on the paving, then steps out over the striped crossing into the middle of the busy junction, passing other pedestrians before walking on past cafe tables under red umbrellas.

5290.words: skyscraper (noun): a very tall building with many floors
5290.asset_description: A young woman in a beige trench coat with long braids walks along a palm-lined street in a hot, sunny Gulf city, tipping her head back to look up. Behind her rises a huge curved glass residential tower, and the clip ends on a slow tilt up the mirrored flanks of an enormous spire-topped skyscraper against the blue sky.

5313.words: neon (adjective): glowing in bright electric colours
5313.asset_description: A young woman in a pink and mint traditional Korean dress spins in front of a tiled palace gate in daylight. She then sits at a night street-food market strung with paper lanterns, eating an orange rice cake from a paper cup and pulling a wide-eyed face at the taste. The last shot is a night city crossing where whole building fronts are covered in glowing electric signs in red, blue and yellow; a bus passes behind her while she makes a small finger heart.

5351.words: streetlight (noun): a tall lamp that lights a street at night
5351.asset_description: Dusk on a road beside a bare-treed park. A woman in a red beret, a knitted scarf and a fur-hooded parka holds the camera at arm's length and pulls it along behind her, glancing back and laughing. Above and behind her an ornate cast-iron lamp on a tall post burns orange against the deep blue evening sky, and a line of the same lamps recedes along the road, their light pooling on the tarmac and the pavement. She leads on into a wide open square where strings of white lights hang overhead and more lit lamps stand along the edges.

5383.words: avenue (noun): a wide street in a town
5383.asset_description: A young woman in a leopard-print coat stands at the edge of a very wide city street, one arm raised to hail a cab. The camera looks straight down the avenue: several lanes wide, lined with tall buildings on both sides and packed with yellow taxis stretching to the horizon. She pulls a wheeled suitcase, turns to the camera grinning, then holds her arm out over the crosswalk again as taxis roll past her.

5412.words: pillar (noun): a tall upright post of stone
5412.asset_description: Phone footage of a guided tour through an ancient Greek hilltop site. The camera moves up a stone ramp between rows of huge fluted marble pillars that carry the roof of a ruined gateway, following a guide who holds a red umbrella up above the group. The tour walks out into an open ruined courtyard where tourists stop and photograph the walls, then the clip cuts to a viewpoint at sunset where a large crowd on a paved terrace looks across the city at the temple standing on its rock.

5414.words: rail (noun): a barrier made of a horizontal bar on supports
5414.asset_description: Phone footage from inside a car stuck in morning traffic. A schoolboy in a white shirt and dark tie sits by the open window with cars packed around him and leans out to look along the jammed lanes as scooters squeeze past. He then walks up the steps of a pedestrian footbridge and takes hold of its metal railing with both hands, standing at the horizontal bar between its upright supports and looking down at hundreds of cars filling every lane of the hazy motorway below.

5437.words: courtyard (noun): an open space with buildings all around it
5437.asset_description: A travel reel in three parts. First a young woman in a white embroidered shirt leads the camera by the hand through a field of sunflowers at sunset. Then she walks across a cobbled cathedral square as a flock of pigeons takes off around her in front of a white church with golden domes. Finally the clip ends in the paved courtyard of an old manor: the walls and arcades of the building close the space in on every side, strings of warm lights hang overhead, and a long table of guests in embroidered shirts claps and cheers as she lifts a big braided loaf of bread above her head.

5448.words: billboard (noun): a huge board above a street where ads are posted
5448.asset_description: A young man in a red jacket with a backpack turns on the spot in the middle of a busy city crossing, arms flung wide and mouth open in delight. All around and above him the building fronts are covered floor to roof in enormous lit advertising boards - bright pink, blue and white panels the size of whole walls, stacked one above the other and wrapped around the corners of the towers - while yellow taxis and crowds pass behind him. The clip then cuts to him leaning on the rail of a ferry, grinning, with a tall green statue on an island behind him, and finally to him standing on a rock at the rim of a huge red canyon at sunset with his arms raised.

5470.words: downtown (noun): the busy central business area of a city
5470.asset_description: A montage of people walking. First a low shot follows a woman in a navy business suit and nude high heels striding along a city sidewalk past taxis and office workers; then she is seen from behind crossing a street between glass skyscrapers in the financial district. The scene cuts to a bald hiker with a big backpack and trekking poles climbing a forest trail towards a mountain; then to a man in a blue t-shirt walking a golden retriever on a leash across a sunny park lawn; and finally to a high aerial view of a huge crowd streaming across the Shibuya-style crossing between illuminated billboards downtown.

65.words: baking sheet (noun): the flat metal tray you bake food on in the oven
65.asset_description: In a log-cabin kitchen a woman shows a black baking sheet, lines it with parchment, arranges potatoes, peppers and carrots in one layer, oils them and slides the sheet into the oven; later the couple pulls out the roasted vegetables and the man tastes one.
65.transcript: one layer always golden listen to it it's

93.words: blender (noun): the machine whose blades mix food into a drink
93.asset_description: A retro-cartoon man in a green tracksuit drops strawberries, a banana and milk into a blender, blends it into a pink smoothie, opens the lid and gets a blob of smoothie on his nose, tastes it, then pours the drink into a glass and gives a thumbs up.

124.words: spread (verb): to push soft food over a surface in a thin layer
124.asset_description: A 3D-animated girl saws a slab off an enormous block of butter and drags it across a slice of bread with a knife until the whole surface is covered in a glossy layer, then bites into it with her eyes closed in bliss.

220.words: defrost (verb): to let frozen food become soft again
220.asset_description: A cartoon man takes a rock-hard frozen fish out of the freezer and thunks it on the counter, then fills a bowl with water in the sink and soaks the fish until he can proudly hold up the floppy, defrosted fillet.

371.words: herb (noun): a plant like basil used to flavour food
371.asset_description: A couple picks fresh basil leaves from little potted plants on a windowsill by the sea, pinches and rubs them to smell the aroma, then scatters the leaves over a plate of spaghetti with tomato sauce.
371.transcript: Pinch rub smell Just a few leaves

641.words: scale (noun): a device for weighing things
641.asset_description: A young couple in a rustic kitchen weighs ingredients on a vintage kitchen scale, placing a bowl on it and pouring flour in while watching the dial. Then their tabby cat jumps onto the scale and sits on it, and they laugh.
641.transcript: Climbing. Climbing. Stop! Your turn apparently.

720.words: spice (noun): a strong-tasting powder used to flavour food
720.asset_description: At a night souk, a vendor scoops bright red spice powder from tall colored mounds into a paper cone; a couple sniffs it and the man's eyes go wide at how strong it is. At home they sprinkle the spice into a hot pan of oil, where it blooms into a red star, then cook peppers in it and taste the dish.
720.transcript: Wow, that's strong! Look at the color!

788.words: to microwave (verb): to heat food in a microwave oven
788.asset_description: In an anime kitchen at night, a green-haired boy puts a bowl of noodles into a microwave, starts it and watches the bowl spin and steam; he pulls the hot bowl out with an "ow, hot, hot!", puts on oven mitts, and a girl points at the microwave asking for hers next.
788.transcript: Ow! Hot, hot! My next please.

2634.words: cork (noun): the round plug that closes a bottle neck
2634.asset_description: A cluttered alchemist's table lit by a burning candle: glass bottles of amber liquid closed with corks, clay jugs, a stack of old books, deer antlers, cinnamon sticks and an open handwritten book, with a stone archway behind.

3098.words: barbecue (noun): cooking meat outdoors on a hot grill
3098.asset_description: A cartoon man in a red apron stands on a green lawn holding a long fork over a round black grill, where two burger patties and two sausages are cooking with grill marks on them.

4001.words: fighter (noun): a fast military plane that fights enemy aircraft
4001.asset_description: A hand lowers two slices of white bread into slots on the back of a grey model fighter jet standing on a granite kitchen counter. The heating elements inside the slots glow orange and a blue-and-orange flame roars out of the jet's exhaust nozzle like an afterburner. The flame dies down and the hand lifts out two browned slices.

4004.words: heat (verb): to make something hot or hotter
4004.asset_description: A hand drops two slices of bread into slots on the spine of a grey twin-engine model fighter jet parked on a granite kitchen counter. The elements glow orange, then long blue flames shoot from both exhaust nozzles. When the flames cut out, two golden-brown slices stand proud of the slots and the hand reaches in to take them.

4027.words: pie (noun): a dish baked in pastry
4027.asset_description: A man in a chef's hat carries a big glass bowl of red and green apples through a kitchen, followed by a black and white cow that is also wearing a chef's hat. At the counter he rolls out dough with a rolling pin while the cow watches over his shoulder and licks its nose. He lays overlapping apple slices in a neat circle inside a pastry-lined dish and slides it into the oven. At a wooden table the finished golden pie sits whole beside a glass of milk, and in the last shot the plate holds only crumbs while the man laughs and the cow leans in over the table.

4364.words: dough (noun): a flour mixture you can knead or roll
4364.asset_description: In a rustic kitchen a young woman and an older woman shape pale balls of dough and set them in rows on a baking tray dusted with flour. The older woman opens the oven and they slide the trays of raw dough inside. Later the oven is opened again and trays of golden baked croissants come out steaming, filling the table.

4418.words: burst (verb): to come open suddenly from pressure inside
4418.asset_description: In a rustic kitchen a woman in an embroidered blouse leans over a gas hob where a blue flame burns under a small saucepan. Beside it a big pot of water rolls at a full boil and white steam streams off the surface towards the window. She reaches for a huge lidded pot, lifts the heavy lid, and a thick white cloud of steam bursts up into her face; she rears back with her mouth open.

4458.words: disaster (noun): a state of extreme ruin and misfortune
4458.asset_description: A young man in a stained apron stands in a small home kitchen while everything he is cooking goes wrong at once. Two slices of toast, black and smoking, pop up in the toaster in the foreground. He turns to a frying pan of vegetables on the gas hob and pushes them around with a spatula, wincing. Smoke drifts across the room. He opens the oven and a cloud of smoke rolls out around a roasting bird; he flaps a blue-striped tea towel at the smoke, coughing, the kitchen hazy behind him.

4459.words: burning (noun): the act of burning something
4459.asset_description: Evening on a beach, sea and dark headland behind. A woman in a checked shirt sits at a low concrete fire pit holding long skewers of marshmallows over the fire. One marshmallow catches light and burns with a tall orange flame right in front of the camera; she pulls back, laughing and open-mouthed. She lowers the other skewers into the flames, and the fire builds until a column of fire and sparks fills the frame against the dark blue sky.

4524.words: fold (verb): to bend so that one part covers the other
4524.asset_description: An older woman in a red cardigan stands at a floured wooden table making dumplings. Her hands close a round wrapper over its filling and press the edge over on itself into a ridge of little pleats, and she sets each finished one down in neat rows on the tray in front of her, dozens of them. Her family gathers round her under a paper lantern and red decorations: a man, a woman and two small children in red, the children copying her hands. At the end the man lifts the lid off a bamboo steamer and steam billows up over a basket of finished dumplings while everyone leans in and laughs.

4554.words: flame (noun): the bright burning part of a fire or candle
4554.asset_description: A marshmallow on a stick chars over a toaster, then a bearded man in a strawberry-print apron turns rows of hot dogs on an outdoor barbecue with tongs. The grill erupts and a wall of orange flame leaps waist-high off the grate; the man keeps turning the sausages while a semicircle of relatives behind him stare open-mouthed.

4964.words: to taste (verb): to taste a little of something
4964.asset_description: In a modern kitchen at dusk, a man in a denim shirt with a towel over his shoulder lifts a spoonful of tomato-vegetable soup from a pot on the stove, blows on it and tastes it, then holds the spoon out for the woman beside him, who leans in and tastes it too. She smiles and nods. He then brings a bouquet of flowers out from behind his back; she gasps in delight, and they step onto the balcony and hug in front of the city lights.

5015.words: homemade (adjective): made at home by yourself, not bought
5015.asset_description: In a rustic kitchen with painted pottery on wooden shelves, a young woman in an apron and an older woman in a headscarf stand at a floured wooden table. They push and fold a large pale mass of bread dough with their hands, laughing together, until it is shaped into a smooth round loaf on the flour-dusted table.

5132.words: mixture (noun): a substance of two or more things mixed together
5132.asset_description: In a bright home kitchen a young man in a beanie makes a pancake. A knob of butter melts and slides across a large non-stick pan on the hob. He holds a ladle high over the pan and pours a thick pale batter into it in a steady stream; the batter spreads into a wide circle and bubbles rise on its surface. At the end he lifts the pan off the hob and tilts it towards the camera to show the browned pancake.

5199.words: follow (verb): to act in the way rules tell you
5199.asset_description: In a sunny kitchen a young woman in an apron and a green headscarf works through a handwritten page step by step. She leans over it and points at a line, chops cherry tomatoes on a board, tips them into a big bowl of cut vegetables, holds the page up and reads the next step, pours olive oil over the salad, then lays the page flat on the worktop and smiles at the finished bowl.

5438.words: filling (noun): any material that fills a space or container
5438.asset_description: A woman in a red embroidered apron makes dumplings on a big wooden table in a log kitchen. A white bowl of dark red fruit filling stands at her elbow next to a lump of dough and a row of flat dough circles; she takes each circle, closes it around a spoonful of the filling and presses the edge shut, laying the finished half-moons out in rows across the table. She carries a full board of them to a wide black pan of boiling water over an open fire while a small boy in an embroidered shirt watches, tastes one from a spoon over the steaming pan, and finally sets a wooden bowl of cooked dumplings on the table beside the bowl of red filling.

1211.words: nation (noun): a large group who share a country and an identity
1211.asset_description: A packed stadium stand where thousands of fans dressed in the same blue sing together with hands on their hearts and raise blue scarves. One young woman sings with tears on her face.

1595.words: pyramid (noun): a huge ancient building with triangle sides
1595.asset_description: A flat vector illustration of two large brown pyramids standing on orange sand dunes under a bright turquoise sky with white clouds.

1697.words: fan (noun): a folding object you wave to move air
1697.asset_description: Black-and-red vector art of a geisha in a kimono holding an open folding fan, surrounded by cherry blossoms and a Japanese character.

1794.words: feather (noun): one of the light soft things covering a bird
1794.asset_description: An Indian devotional image of a woman in an orange sari holding a long-necked string instrument, surrounded by large shimmering blue-and-gold peacock feathers.

2231.words: sphinx (noun): an Egyptian statue: human head, lion body
2231.asset_description: A giant golden sphinx statue towers over a sandy Egyptian plain, with pyramids and a small temple in the distance under a deep blue sky.

2384.words: kingdom (noun): a land that a king or queen rules
2384.asset_description: A whimsical storybook landscape: a castle with orange roofs and small flags stands on a hill above a village of crooked houses, with a winding white path, tiny people and a deer below.

2486.words: hieroglyphs (noun): the picture symbols of ancient Egyptian writing
2486.asset_description: An ancient Egyptian queen with long braided hair, a golden headdress and gold jewelry stands before a sandstone wall carved full of hieroglyphs.

2551.words: miami (noun): the Florida beach city of neon and palms
2551.asset_description: A retro sports car is parked on a wet street lined with palm trees and glowing pink-and-blue neon hotel signs, under a dramatic sunset sky full of dark clouds.

2622.words: statue of liberty (noun): a green statue of a woman holding a torch
2622.asset_description: A cute isometric 3D miniature of Liberty Island: the green Statue of Liberty holds up her torch and tablet on a stone base, surrounded by tiny red autumn trees, toy cars, boats and a city skyline across the water.

2716.words: big ben (noun): the famous clock tower in London
2716.asset_description: A flat-colour illustration looking down a sunny tree-lined riverside path towards the tall stone clock tower of the Palace of Westminster, with the arched bridge and a Union Jack flag beside it under a blue sky.

2776.words: torch (noun): a stick with a flame burning at the top
2776.asset_description: A grey printed image of the Statue of Liberty, arm stretched high with the burning torch, tablet under the other arm, pasted onto a background of old newspaper pages splashed with bright red paint.

3552.words: japan (noun): the East Asian country of Mount Fuji
3552.asset_description: Soft Japanese-style illustration of a village lane in spring: a woman in a pink kimono with a paper parasol walks past wooden houses, a red pagoda and a small red bridge, under cherry blossom with snowy Mount Fuji behind.

3562.words: egypt (noun): the country of the pyramids and the Nile
3562.asset_description: Golden painting of ancient Egypt: a woman in a white dress sits on a stone terrace above the Nile, watching sailing boats on the river, with a painted temple, an obelisk and the pyramids in the distance.

3567.words: peru (noun): the South American country of Machu Picchu
3567.asset_description: Simplified flat poster of the Machu Picchu ruins: wide stone terraces and one small stone hut sit on a ridge in front of a steep green peak, with a red sun in a cream sky.

4483.words: log (noun): a piece of a tree trunk with the branches cut off
4483.asset_description: An illustration seen from behind of a woman in a red checked jacket running across a frozen lake, ice skates slung over her shoulder and a hockey stick in her hand. On the right bank stands a small cabin built of stacked round tree trunks with snow on its roof and smoke rising from the chimney, next to a Canadian flag on a pole. Snowy pines and a rocky peak fill the background and red maple leaves blow across the ice.

4577.words: country (noun): the territory of a nation
4577.asset_description: An ink drawing on aged paper. A woman in a blue robe and a conical straw hat stands on a rocky cliff edge with her arm stretched out towards the land below her. Beneath her lies a wide valley: a patchwork of green and gold fields, a broad river winding through it, small villages of tiled roofs, and a walled town on a hill in the distance. Snow-capped mountains close the horizon, birds fly below the cliff and tall grass leans in the wind in the foreground.

4687.words: embassy (noun): a building where ambassadors live or work
4687.asset_description: Dusk in a European city, seen through the bars of a tall black iron gate. Behind the gate stands a lit stone building with arched windows and a flag on a pole above the entrance. A woman in a beige trench coat stands at the gate and hands a stack of cream-coloured document envelopes through to a man in a dark uniform and peaked cap. A parked car and lamplit street are visible behind her.

4972.words: patriotic (adjective): inspired by love for your country
4972.asset_description: At night outside a lit domed parliament building, an officer in white uniform raises a pale blue and yellow national flag up a white pole; the crowd below holds up matching flags and phone lights, fireworks fan out over the dome, and a young woman with her country's colours painted on both cheeks screams with delight in the middle of the flag-waving crowd.

5079.words: pyramid (noun): a huge ancient building with triangle sides
5079.asset_description: A young woman with a straw tote bag walks away from the camera down a cobbled Mexican street strung overhead with rows of coloured paper banners. She then stands at a fruit market stall hung with bananas and stacked with oranges and limes and takes a large bite of a taco, pulling a delighted face. She climbs a wide flight of worn stone steps on an ancient ruin, and at the top she turns to the camera and throws both arms wide, with a huge stone pyramid rising out of green jungle behind her.

20.words: schedule (noun): a plan of the things you must do and when
20.asset_description: Four labeled items lie on the floor representing a full schedule: a textbook 'Revise', a laptop 'Work', a gym backpack 'Gym' and a pillow 'Sleep'. A hand hovers over the choices and, one by one, everything disappears until it grabs the pillow - sleep wins.
20.transcript: My schedule is very full, but I choose sleep.

710.words: suds (noun): the white bubbles that soap makes in water
710.asset_description: In a sunny courtyard a young woman rubs a soap bar under a brass tap until the white suds in her hands swell into a huge cloud; a man watches open-mouthed and applauds before she rinses the suds down the basin.

888.words: yawning (noun): opening the mouth wide and breathing in when tired
888.asset_description: A sleepy couple in pajamas stands in a morning kitchen with coffee mugs; the man does a huge stretching yawn, apologizes, and the woman immediately catches it and yawns too — they keep passing the yawn back and forth until even their dog joins in.

4209.words: sleep (noun): the natural state of rest at night
4209.asset_description: Two hamsters lie on a thick white fluffy blanket in a warm, dimly lit room strung with fairy lights. The one on the left wears round glasses and taps at a small silver laptop, still awake and working. The one on the right has a white sheet face mask over its face and a pink bow headband, and lies on its side with its eyes shut, not moving, deep in sleep while the other works on beside it.

5209.words: lounge (verb): to sit or lie back comfortably doing nothing
5209.asset_description: A run of people settling into total idleness: a construction worker in a hi-vis vest drops back onto a living-room sofa with his boots up; a woman lies stretched out in a white hammock under palm trees with her hands behind her head; a shirtless man reclines on a striped beach lounger under an umbrella, sipping from a can; a man lies flat in a green field under a blue sky; a woman lounges in a hammock on the sand as the sun sets over the sea.

5243.words: schedule (verb): to plan a time for an activity or event
5243.asset_description: A woman in a beige blazer works at a huge blank month calendar drawn on a white office wall. She writes in a tabbed spiral notebook on the desk, then presses coloured sticky notes into the empty date squares one after another until the whole month is covered in pink, orange, green and blue notes, and steps back to look at the finished plan.

5274.asset_description: A young man in a grey vest stands at the door of a yellow-and-turquoise tiled shower and turns the tap. Water pours from the shower head; he holds his hand under the stream to test the temperature and pulls it back. Then he is under the shower himself, bare-chested and drenched, water running down his face and body as he works shampoo into his hair.

5304.words: dirt (noun): mud, dust or grime that makes something unclean
5304.asset_description: A woman in a bright tiled kitchen holds both palms up to the camera, pulling a disgusted face: her hands and fingers are covered in thick dark brown grime. She steps to the white sink, turns on the tap and rubs a bar of purple soap over one filthy palm until white foam builds up. She scrubs the foam between her hands, then rinses both hands under the running water while dark specks wash into the basin. At the end she holds up the bar of soap in one hand and a completely clean pink palm in the other, smiling.

8.words: keycard (noun): a plastic card that unlocks an electronic lock
8.asset_description: An anime woman wheels her suitcase down a hotel corridor and taps her keycard on a door reader, which flashes red. She checks the card, tries the correct door, the reader turns green, and she opens the door to her room.

418.words: keychain (noun): a small ring or charm that holds your keys
418.asset_description: At a market stall full of keyrings a woman pries open a metal ring, threads her keys onto it one by one, clips on a fluffy red pompom charm, spins the finished keychain on her finger and drops it in her bag.

1481.words: archway (noun): a curved opening in a wall that you walk through
1481.asset_description: A painted sand castle rises into pink and blue clouds; at its base a curved opening with a barred gate leads inside, and a second wide arch is cut through the wall under the long flight of steps.

1995.words: doorway (noun): the opening in a wall where a door is
1995.asset_description: A tall arched doorway in a swirling colorful corridor glows blue-white with a moonlit otherworldly scene inside it, with worn stone steps leading up to the light.

2141.words: basement (noun): a room below ground level in a building
2141.asset_description: A grimy industrial wall where metal pipes run along the ceiling and down the sides, around an open metal door glowing teal from the room inside.

2473.words: wreath (noun): a ring of leaves hung up as decoration
2473.asset_description: A flat papercut-style illustration of a pink house on a snowy night: a green Christmas wreath hangs around its red front door, string lights run along the roofs, and snow-dusted fir trees with red baubles stand on both sides.

2698.words: shutters (noun): wooden panels outside a window that fold shut
2698.asset_description: A painting looking out of an open window with wide green louvred panels folded back on both sides; beyond them lies a flowery village lane of stone cottages, while a bluebird sits on the sill and a steaming cup of coffee and a jug of lavender stand on a little white table inside.

4193.words: underground (adjective): under the level of the ground
4193.asset_description: On the brick-paved forecourt of a large brick country house, a whole section of the paving tilts up on a hinge like a huge trapdoor. A dark green Porsche sports car reverses down the opening onto the platform below the paving. The brick lid lowers back over it until the forecourt looks solid again. The last shots are inside the space below the drive: the car parked in a concrete room lit by warm orange wall lights, with the brick ceiling above it.

4423.words: barrier (noun): a structure that blocks free movement
4423.asset_description: A sunlit desert checkpoint photographed from the side. A long red and white striped boom bar is raised at a steep angle across the top of the frame, its counterweight end low on the left. Under it a person in an olive jacket with a canvas backpack walks over a broad white line painted on the cracked asphalt, kicking up a small puff of dust. A white concrete marker post stands to the left, a plain wooden guard hut to the right, and behind them a chain link fence and bare brown mountains under a clear blue sky.

5008.words: unlock (verb): to open the lock of something with a key
5008.asset_description: A woman in denim dungarees with a lanyard round her neck opens a brass letterbox set into a stone wall and takes a key out of it. She turns the key in the brass plate of a tall black door, then holds up a huge ring of old keys and picks through them. She fits another key into an ornate wooden door with a heavy iron handle, turns it, and pushes the double doors open onto a sunlit garden path with ivy-covered walls.

5048.asset_description: An elderly woman in a colourful headscarf works at a pair of tall black wooden doors studded with iron and hung with two heavy ring handles. A thick chain is threaded through the rings and closed with a big iron padlock, and she turns a key in it with both hands, a huge bunch of keys hanging at her belt. In between there is a shot of her standing on a wall above the old town holding a whole watermelon over a wooden crate, with a church tower and tiled roofs behind her. She goes back to the doors and works the padlock again, and the doors stay firmly shut the whole time.

5449.words: doorway (noun): the opening in a wall where a door is
5449.asset_description: A woman in a pale blue dress arrives at an old stone house. A hand holding a bunch of keys opens the flap of a brass letterbox set into the stone wall. She then goes to a tall wooden double door and fits a key into it, working the lock. At a second, darker wooden door she pushes a huge iron key into the lock beside an iron bar and a padlock, turns it with both hands and lifts the bar clear. Finally she pulls both heavy leaves of the door apart and stands in the middle of the open stone opening they leave in the wall, with the sunlit courtyard behind her - a cypress tree, wisteria on the wall and gravel underfoot.

137.words: canyon (noun): a deep narrow valley with steep rock walls
137.asset_description: A couple hikes through a narrow slot canyon with wavy orange rock walls; they run their hands over the smooth stone and look up at the thin strip of sky, cupping their mouths to shout and hear the echo.

176.words: coal (noun): the black rock that you burn for heat
176.asset_description: By a wood stove in a snowy cottage a man picks shiny black lumps of coal from a metal bucket, showing the black dust on his hands to a laughing woman. He loads the coal into the stove with tongs and the fire flares up bright orange.

376.words: wilderness (noun): a wild natural area where nobody lives
376.asset_description: A drone glides low down a deep forested gorge, following a foaming grey river between bare layered rock walls with dense green slopes rising on both sides; there is no road, no building and no person anywhere in the shot.

470.words: meadow (noun): a field of wild grass and flowers
470.asset_description: A young couple wanders through a mountain field full of wild poppies, daisies and cornflowers, brushing their hands over the blooms. They watch a bee land in a red poppy, tuck a daisy behind his ear, and finally flop down laughing in the tall grass.

566.words: pollute (verb): to make water or air dirty and harmful
566.asset_description: In a hand-painted anime scene, a man tips a rusty barrel of brown sludge off his truck into a clean river between rice terraces; the muck spreads across the water while fish scatter and a chimney smokes in the hills. A girl in a yellow raincoat wading with a bucket finds the water fouled, covers her nose and says "Oh no!" sadly.

1366.words: stream (noun): a small narrow river running through land
1366.asset_description: A clear forest stream tumbles over mossy green rocks in little waterfalls, with sunlight through the trees and an orange autumn leaf riding the water.

1452.words: volcano (noun): a mountain that erupts fire and melted rock
1452.asset_description: A volcano erupts at night, shooting glowing orange sparks in arcs from its crater while streams of lava run down its dark slopes.

1574.words: lantern (noun): a lamp in a case that you hang or carry
1574.asset_description: A fantasy autumn forest at dusk: a golden glowing lantern hangs on a chain from a tree branch, with a second smaller lantern shining deeper among the trunks and tall grass.

1586.words: pollution (noun): dirt and smoke that make air and water unhealthy
1586.asset_description: A cartoon of a brown factory with two chimneys pumping thick gray smoke into the sky while cars puff exhaust on a road and a pipe pours green sludge into a blue river below.

1603.words: oil (noun): the black fuel drilled from under the sea
1603.asset_description: A flat vector oil platform stands on four thick legs in a dark blue sea, with a tall drilling tower and two cranes under a cloudy sky.

1650.words: cliff (noun): a high steep wall of rock
1650.asset_description: A watercolor painting of an old chateau standing on top of a huge steep rock cliff that drops down to trees and orange bushes.

1660.words: treasure (noun): a store of gold, jewels and valuable things
1660.asset_description: A flat vector scene under the sea: seaweed, coral and shells on the sandy bottom, an open treasure chest full of gold coins, and the dark hull of a boat floating far above.

1752.words: windmill (noun): a building with big sails turned by the wind
1752.asset_description: A flat night landscape of a windmill with lit yellow windows standing by a lake, with the moon, stars, shooting stars and a flock of birds above, all mirrored in the still water.

1851.words: valley (noun): the low land between mountains
1851.asset_description: Layered blue-grey mountain ridges fade into white haze, mist filling the valleys between the slopes and tiny pine trees standing on the dark hillsides.

1884.words: reflection (noun): the mirror image seen in water or glass
1884.asset_description: A flat vector landscape: pine and apple trees on a green strip in front of blue mountains, all perfectly mirrored upside down in the still water below.

1938.words: coast (noun): the land right along the edge of the sea
1938.asset_description: A minimalist flat aerial view of a coast: layered waves in blues and white roll diagonally onto a sandy brown shore, while a lone dark whale swims in the deep water below.

1971.words: peak (noun): the pointed top of a mountain
1971.asset_description: Sharp snow-streaked mountain peaks rise out of a thick rolling sea of white clouds under a deep green-blue sky.

2029.words: trail (noun): a rough path through the countryside
2029.asset_description: A misty painting of a wooden barn-like cabin with a snow-white roof standing beside a wet stony trail that curves past it into a foggy mountain valley lined with dark pines.

2062.words: balance (verb): to keep something steady so it does not fall
2062.asset_description: Smooth round stones are balanced carefully on top of each other in a tower on a grassy hill, with green valleys and huge snowy mountain peaks behind.

2116.words: seaweed (noun): green plants that grow in the sea
2116.asset_description: A painted close-up of a young woman's face underwater, long strands of green seaweed floating around her head and small bubbles rising past her cheek.

2133.words: pillar (noun): a tall upright post of stone
2133.asset_description: Tall pillars of stacked grey stones stand in deep snow in a forest clearing, surrounded by snow-covered pine trees and a mountain behind.

2143.words: boulder (noun): a very large rounded rock
2143.asset_description: A tall tower of huge grey boulders stacked on top of each other in deep snow, with snowy fir trees and a mountain peak under a cloudy sky.

2149.words: ridge (noun): the long top edge of a mountain or hill
2149.asset_description: Minimalist landscape in muted beige and grey: a pale sun behind clouds above rows of mountain ridges fading into the distance, each ridge a darker layer.

2156.words: horizon (noun): the far line where land seems to meet sky
2156.asset_description: Stylized fantasy landscape: the sun sits glowing on the horizon of a wide plain, framed by rocky cliffs, a ruined fortress and a dark tree hanging overhead.

2305.words: rocky (adjective): covered with rocks and stones
2305.asset_description: A watercolor scene of a winding stone path crossing a rugged rocky headland toward a red-and-white lighthouse, with turquoise waves crashing against the rocks below at sunset.

2315.words: landscape (noun): a wide view of natural scenery
2315.asset_description: A paper-quilling style artwork of a blue river winding through an autumn valley toward snowy mountains and a setting sun, every cloud and slope built from swirled paper strips.

2385.words: alien (adjective): coming from another planet, not from Earth
2385.asset_description: A purple alien landscape with jagged glowing peaks, floating white orbs, a winding luminous river and a huge orange planet filling the darkening sky.

2391.words: scenery (noun): the beautiful natural landscape around you
2391.asset_description: A Japanese-style landscape with a huge pale moon in a coral-red sky, dark twisted trees with red foliage on a rocky slope, and distant mountains and a lake below.

2430.words: flow (verb): to move along smoothly like water
2430.asset_description: A bright river flows in curves through a dark rocky valley toward the viewer, under a huge pale moon and a vividly red evening sky over mountains.

2435.words: pebble (noun): a small smooth round stone
2435.asset_description: A decorative landscape where a blue stream full of smooth round pebbles winds between tall orange flowers and round white buds under a big pale sun.

2458.words: farmhouse (noun): the main house on a farm, where the farmer lives
2458.asset_description: A watercolor of a two-story farmhouse with lit windows and a small cupola standing among fields at a dramatic sunset, with a dirt path and a long wooden rail fence leading toward it past two small sheds.

2466.words: crystal (noun): a clear hard stone with flat shiny faces
2466.asset_description: A smiling dark-haired girl wears a spectacular headdress and dress made of glowing translucent crystals in pink, blue and gold, holding a small ball of light in her palm against a starry darkness.

2474.words: foam (noun): the mass of small white bubbles on waves
2474.asset_description: An abstract painting of stormy sea water: teal and deep green waves curl over each other while thick creamy-white foam swirls and feathers across the whole canvas.

2560.words: miracle (noun): an amazing event that cannot be explained
2560.asset_description: A bearded man in a flowing white robe with a golden wreath walks on top of the ocean, waves splashing under his bare feet.

2604.words: lifeless (adjective): dead-looking, with no life or leaves
2604.asset_description: A bare, lifeless tree with twisting empty branches stands on a dark rocky outcrop under a huge green full moon and a surreal pink-and-orange collage sky, with snowy mountains behind.

2633.words: beam (noun): a line of light shining from something
2633.asset_description: A painted old tree with a wide crown stands in a dark field while bright rays of coloured light shoot out in all directions from a glowing point in its branches, lighting a golden path on the ground.

2702.words: nature (noun): the world of plants, water and mountains
2702.asset_description: A painted panorama of a bright green valley with a shallow stream winding through the grass, scattered trees, a tall white waterfall spraying from the rocks, snow-capped mountains behind and orange sunset clouds above.

2703.words: obelisk (noun): a very tall thin stone pillar with a point
2703.asset_description: An oil painting of an enormous black stone shaft rising to a point out of a snowy mountain pass under heavy grey clouds, with two tiny groups of travellers on the snow at its base for scale.

2724.words: jungle (noun): a thick tropical forest full of vines
2724.asset_description: A monkey-faced deity in a golden crown and orange cloth stands on a mossy rock holding a curved wooden staff, surrounded by huge tree trunks, hanging vines, ferns and misty green light.

2743.words: steep (adjective): rising or falling very sharply, almost straight
2743.asset_description: A sharp grey-and-pink mountain peak rises above a deep valley at dusk, with almost vertical rock faces on every side, a pale river far below and a rocky slope of loose stones in the foreground.

2823.words: still (adjective): completely without movement, like flat water
2823.asset_description: A clean minimal illustration of a small pink sailboat with two turquoise sails floating on flat pastel-coloured water at sunset, its shape mirrored almost perfectly in the smooth surface below.

2898.words: desert (noun): a huge dry area of sand where little grows
2898.asset_description: A flat vector illustration of rolling sand dunes under a pale blue sky with a big yellow sun; a crouching sphinx figure and two pale pyramids rise out of the sand in the middle of the frame.

3435.words: cave (noun): a large hole in rock you can go into
3435.asset_description: Flat vector seascape in bold blocks of colour: pale limestone cliffs rise from turquoise water, with two dark arched cave mouths opening at the waterline and a green pine tree growing on top of the rock.

3470.words: dune (noun): a hill of sand shaped by the wind
3470.asset_description: Simple graphic landscape: one big orange sand dune with a curved crest and a dark shadow side fills the frame, with purple mountains and a clear blue sky behind.

3541.words: waterfall (noun): water falling straight down from a high rock
3541.asset_description: Flat purple-toned poster of a single tall waterfall dropping from the edge of a high flat cliff down into a deep misty valley and a small lake.
