3559.words: island (noun): a piece of land with water all around it
3559.asset_description: Pale pastel poster of a tiny rocky island with a few cacti sitting alone in a huge mirror-flat lake, its shape reflected in the water, with purple mountains and thin clouds behind.

3676.words: bay (noun): a part of the sea curving into the land
3676.asset_description: Flat illustration of a tropical coast at sunset: a long curved bay of turquoise water runs between steep green limestone islands down to a white sand beach, with the sun low over the sea and jungle leaves in the foreground.

3750.words: pond (noun): a small area of still water
3750.asset_description: Fantasy painting of a still shallow pond in a misty violet forest, its glassy surface reflecting the trees and a white unicorn that stands in the shallows with its head lowered to the water.

4006.words: transparent (adjective): clear enough to see straight through
4006.asset_description: Bare feet walk along a bleached log lying just under the surface of a glass-clear alpine lake. The water is so transparent that the stones and sunken branches on the bottom stay sharp. The camera lifts to a snow-capped mountain mirrored in the still surface, then drops under the water, where a small orange frog swims towards the lens above the sunken log.

4060.words: flow (noun): the motion of a liquid or gas as it moves
4060.asset_description: A first-person view from a yellow kayak racing down a narrow jungle river, the paddler's blue sleeve and black paddle swinging in and out of shot. White water rushes past the nose of the boat between mossy rock walls and dense green foliage, with a rainbow hanging in the mist ahead. The kayak is carried straight over the lip of a waterfall and drops into the spray, the screen filling with white water; it comes out below in the mist and carries on downstream, where another paddler in a red kayak is running the same rapid ahead.

4066.words: dirt (noun): loose earth or soil on the ground
4066.asset_description: A green parrot stands on bare red earth while a hand lowers a tiny motocross helmet onto its head. The parrot hops onto a miniature dirt bike and rides off down a track of deep red-brown dirt that runs through open eucalyptus woodland. A low close-up shows the rear tyre spinning on the loose dirt as the bike speeds along, then the camera looks up from ground level as the parrot launches the bike off a mound of red dirt and lands, riding away over the ridge.

4067.words: mirror (verb): to reflect like a mirror
4067.asset_description: A wide shot of a lake at dusk under a clear blue and yellow sky. The water is completely flat and mirrors the dark line of fir trees on the far shore and the pale glow of the sky, so the treeline appears twice, once above the waterline and once below it. On the right a large rock juts out over the water and a person crouches in silhouette on its edge. They spring off, hit the water, and the smooth mirrored surface breaks into wide rings that travel outward. The swimmer's head appears in the middle of the rings and moves slowly across the lake as the water settles again.

4072.words: lagoon (noun): a calm pool of sea water behind rocks
4072.asset_description: A drone shot that starts close on three women in bright swimsuits standing together on a small strip of white sand, then climbs and pulls back. As it rises, two enormous grey limestone walls come into the frame on the left and right, rising sheer out of the sea and closing in on the little beach so that it sits at the bottom of a narrow slot. Palms and thick green jungle spill over the top of the beach behind them. In front, a shallow turquoise lagoon with dark patches of reef stretches out between the two rock walls towards the open sea.

4081.words: peak (noun): the pointed top of a mountain
4081.asset_description: A chest-mounted point-of-view shot from a skydiver sitting in the open door of a helicopter over the Alps. His own legs in a white padded suit and tan boots hang out over a wall of high mountains whose ridges and summits are thickly covered in white snow, with a bare green valley running between them and the sun blazing overhead. He drops away, and the helicopter tips over above him and shrinks into the deep blue sky as the snow-covered peaks and glaciers slide past below. Under canopy he comes down towards a bright green alpine meadow with a large orange landing cross laid out on the grass, his boots pointing at it.

4167.words: exit (noun): an opening you can escape through
4167.asset_description: A point-of-view ride on a chestnut horse in an orange bridle along a wet black-sand beach under a grey sky. The horse walks straight towards a black cliff and into the mouth of a sea cave, and the frame goes almost completely black except for the outline of the horse's ears. A bright doorway of daylight appears ahead, and horse and rider come out again onto the open black beach with a green headland beyond.

4188.words: slope (noun): an elevated slope of ground, a hillside
4188.asset_description: A single skier is a tiny dark figure high on a huge, smooth, untouched snow face under a deep blue sky. He skis down the long incline, throwing up a bright plume of powder snow behind him. The camera pulls back and the whole snow face is revealed dropping away at a steep angle from the ridge at the top all the way down towards the water, with snowy mountain peaks and a fjord catching the low orange sun on the far side.

4324.words: vast (adjective): unusually great in size or extent
4324.asset_description: A young man with curly hair and a light blue and white striped scarf walks along a colourful street, then sits at a shaded outdoor table drinking from a mate gourd through a metal straw. The clip then cuts to him standing alone at a viewing railing in front of an enormous wall of blue glacier ice that fills the whole frame behind him and stretches out of shot on both sides. He is tiny against it, and he throws both arms out wide.

4400.words: spot (verb): to catch sight of something
4400.asset_description: An anime-style drawing of a woman standing on a grassy clifftop above the sea, holding a battered pair of binoculars up to her eyes with both hands. The worn leather strap hangs down over her shoulders and her dark hair blows across her face. In each big round lens you can see what she has picked out far away: the open sea and a line of small birds flying over it.

4401.asset_description: A woman in a khaki field vest stands at the edge of a bright turquoise mountain lake and holds black binoculars to her eyes, scanning the far shore and the pine slopes behind it. She lowers them, reacts, and lifts them again. The scene cuts to a canyon overlook at dusk, where she steps up to a coin-operated tower viewer on a post, grips the handles and presses her face to the eyepiece to look at the rock formations miles away across the canyon.

4457.words: crouch (verb): to bend your knees down close to the ground
4457.asset_description: On a beach at dusk a young woman in a denim jacket crouches over a fire. The fire is ringed by a circle of big pale blocks of rough natural stone, laid one against the next on the sand to make a low wall around the flames, and their grainy, pitted surfaces are lit up orange by the fire inside. She leans over the stones and feeds thin sticks into the middle, the flames climb up between them, and she sits back on her heels with the stone ring glowing in front of her while the sea and two figures show dark behind.

4471.words: height (noun): how tall something is, its vertical size
4471.asset_description: A dramatic painted illustration of a cable car high in the mountains. A red and cream cabin hangs from a thick steel cable, tilted as it swings past a steel lattice pylon capped with icicles, with snow spraying off the wheels. Passengers in winter clothes look out of the windows and one points ahead; a figure in a yellow jacket leans out of a lower window. Far below, snow-covered peaks and small fir trees fill the bottom of the frame, and a second cabin hangs tiny in the distance. Swirling purple and blue clouds fill the sky around it.

4555.words: pine (noun): a tall evergreen tree with needles
4555.asset_description: A man in an orange puffer jacket and a fur trapper hat rides a small red cable car up a mountain, grinning at the camera as snow-laden conifers slide past the window below. He steps out at the station and boards a larger white gondola, then rides on over a ski slope, with rows of snow-covered pines lining the valley and jagged white peaks ahead.

4566.words: summit (noun): the top point of a mountain or hill
4566.asset_description: A photograph taken at sunrise from the highest rocks of a mountain. A woman in an olive jacket and a climbing harness pulls herself up over the last granite slabs, one hand flat on the rock and the other arm swung up behind her, her hair blown across her face by the wind. Below and behind her, ridge after ridge of bare mountain drops away into a hazy valley with a pale river winding through it, and the ranges fade into blue haze at the horizon under a streaked dawn sky.

4616.words: wood (noun): a large area densely covered with trees
4616.asset_description: A pencil sketch of a misty wood. Tall bare tree trunks rise on every side and thin branches criss-cross the pale sky, with fog drifting between them. In the middle a large stag with wide branching antlers rears up over a fallen mossy log, front hooves off the ground and head thrown back, its breath steaming in the cold air. Dry leaves swirl around its legs in the wind.

4629.words: endless (adjective): seeming to have no end, tiresomely long
4629.asset_description: A woodcut print in ochre, orange and brown. Sand dunes roll away one behind another, their curving ridges carved in fine parallel lines, until they blur into a flat line at the horizon with no end in sight. A tiny robed figure with a walking staff is climbing one of the ridges far off, no bigger than a thumbnail against the sand. In the foreground a bleached longhorn cattle skull lies half buried in the dune. A large stylised sun hangs in the empty yellow sky above.

4642.words: pit (noun): a sizeable hole in the ground
4642.asset_description: On a sunny beach a shirtless boy in yellow swim shorts digs into the sand with a metal spade while a light brown dog scrapes at the sand beside him. He throws shovelful after shovelful onto the mounds around him and the hole grows steadily deeper and wider. At the end he and the dog are both sitting down inside the finished hole, with only their heads and shoulders showing above the sand, the sea behind them.

4651.asset_description: A soft watercolour painting of the open sea at sunset. A grey bottlenose dolphin arcs through the air above the water, its body dripping, with a second dolphin breaking the surface just behind it. Below, green-blue waves catch the golden light and white spray rises where the dolphins left the water. The sky is peach and pink, with a low dark coastline on the horizon.

4653.words: mud (noun): soft wet earth, soil soaked with water
4653.asset_description: A man in a bright yellow raincoat and waterproof trousers stands in an open front doorway wearing tall green rubber boots caked in mud. He stamps his feet hard on the coir doormat on the step; a close shot shows the boots plastered in wet brown mud and clumps of it falling off onto the mat, which is left dotted with dark lumps. He then walks in through the doorway along a clean wooden hallway floor and stops, standing on the polished boards in his boots.

4745.words: flow (verb): to move along smoothly like water
4745.asset_description: A boy in a green t-shirt crouches on a bank of round pebbles beside a clear turquoise mountain river and sets a small white paper boat down on the water. The current takes it at once: the boat is carried out from the shallow pebbly edge into the deeper green water and moves steadily away downstream, turning slowly as the surface ripples past it. The camera follows it as it travels the length of the reach and passes under the arch of an old stone bridge, with white rapids visible upstream beyond the bridge, until the boy is left standing on the grassy bank watching it go.

4786.words: sparkle (verb): to shine with many small flashing points
4786.asset_description: A dark tropical beach at night. A woman in a white shirt stands at the water's edge where the breaking waves shine bright blue, and bends down towards them. She crouches and drags her fingers through the wet sand, and hundreds of tiny points of blue light flash on around her hand. She draws a curling spiral in the sand that glows blue and slowly fades. In the last shot she stands back as a wide sheet of water rushes in, the whole shoreline flashing with blue points of light under a full moon and palm trees.

4832.words: ridge (noun): the long top edge of a mountain or hill
4832.asset_description: A helmet-camera view straight down at a climber's red suit and boots as he stands on a knife-thin snow ridge. The ridge runs away from him in a long narrow crest of trodden snow that rises to a summit point, with a solid white sea of cloud far below on both sides and the curved horizon and deep blue sky beyond.
4832.transcript: I walk right along the top of the world.

4886.words: steep (adjective): rising or falling very sharply, almost straight
4886.asset_description: A young man with a large backpack and trekking poles pushes his way up a steep grassy mountain path; the camera follows him from behind and then from the front while the slope falls away below him to a wide alpine valley and rows of distant peaks.

4949.words: scenery (noun): the beautiful natural landscape around you
4949.asset_description: Two walkers with big backpacks and trekking poles climb a rust-coloured pine forest path, sunlight coming through the trunks behind them. The trees thin out and they pick their way up a bare grey rock slope with a wall of snow-covered peaks opening up across the valley behind them. They pull themselves up the last stones onto a narrow rocky crest under a deep blue sky, and stand at the top looking out over a huge white mountain range, raising their poles above their heads.

5105.words: ditch (noun): a long narrow channel dug into the earth
5105.asset_description: A painted illustration of flat Dutch countryside. A straight water-filled ditch runs from the foreground into the distance between raised grass banks. Three big windmills with red and white sails stand along the left and centre, a church tower far behind them. Ducks swim on the water and glide down to land on it. On the bank at the right a boy in a cap and red scarf cycles along a dirt path beside a strip of red and yellow tulips, and tall clouds fill the deep blue sky.

5106.words: windmill (noun): a building with big sails turned by the wind
5106.asset_description: A young woman with pink hair in a yellow raincoat cycles along an Amsterdam canal, laughing, with narrow gabled houses and moored boats behind her. She then walks away from the camera through a tulip field with her arms spread wide, a big windmill turning directly in front of her as the shot pushes in on the red and yellow rows. Finally she stands at a market stall holding a fresh stroopwafel, pulling it apart and biting into it while the waffle irons steam behind her.

5165.words: plastic (noun): a material that can be molded into objects
5165.asset_description: A woman in navy overalls and work gloves stands knee-deep in a brown river whose surface is covered with floating plastic bottles, plastic cups, plastic bags and white foam; a factory with a smoking chimney and pipes stands on the bank behind her. She bends down, pulls a plastic bottle out of the water, grimaces at it, and straightens up holding it while more rubbish drifts past along the shore.

5192.words: horizon (noun): the far line where land seems to meet sky
5192.asset_description: Close up on black gloved hands gripping a white rope on a flagpole, a red flag bunched at the top of the frame; behind, a flat field of snow runs out to a straight line where the white ground meets the blue sky. Three people in orange polar suits pull the rope together and the red flag climbs the pole. In the wide shots the empty snow plain stretches to that same distant line in every direction, with one small dark hut on it. The four of them finish standing at the foot of the pole, looking up at the flag.

5238.words: dune (noun): a hill of sand shaped by the wind
5238.asset_description: A selfie-style travel clip. A man in a beige tunic and checked headscarf holds the camera at arm's length on a red dune with the sun setting behind him, laughing and turning. He then stands at a sandstone cliff and runs his hand over huge human figures carved out of the rock, tilting his head back to see the top of them. At night he sits by a campfire under a starry sky while tea is poured into his cup, and he holds the cup up smiling.

5350.words: creek (noun): a small natural stream of water
5350.asset_description: A watercolour illustration of a wooded valley in summer. A narrow, shallow run of clear water winds between mossy boulders and pebbles, dropping over a small ledge into little waterfalls. A girl in a blue jacket, brown trousers and boots is caught in mid-air as she springs from one mossy rock to the next, arms flung out for balance, water splashing under her feet. Ferns, tree trunks and dappled green foliage fill the background and a few orange leaves drift on the surface.

5395.words: ranch (noun): a large farm where cattle are raised
5395.asset_description: A wide dry plain under a pale sky. A young ranch hand in a canvas jacket, denim shirt and leather chaps rides a bay horse at a trot along a barbed-wire fence, one gloved hand brushing the top of a fence post as he passes. The fence runs dead straight away to the horizon, dust drifts up behind the horse, and a windmill and flat-topped mesas stand far off in the haze.

5397.words: mighty (adjective): showing great strength or force
5397.asset_description: A woodblock-style print of an enormous dark blue wave rearing up over a rough sea. The crest curls right over and breaks into white foam and scattered droplets; smaller waves roll away behind it towards a flat horizon, and four seagulls glide against a pale, streaked sky.

5422.words: recycling (noun): making new products from used materials
5422.asset_description: A young man in a red beanie and a checked shirt sits on a park bench and squashes a piece of rubbish into a ball in his hands, then drops it into a round steel park bin beside the bench. He walks on past a big green metal dumpster on a city pavement, looking back at the camera. In a wide open square he throws a piece of rubbish in a high arc towards a long row of colour-coded bins, each marked with a recycling symbol, and watches it fly in.

5459.words: lava (noun): melted rock that flows out of a volcano
5459.asset_description: A dark ink-style illustration of an erupting mountain at night. A huge boiling cloud of ash rises from the crater, lit orange from below, and glowing molten streams run down every slope of the mountain in bright branching lines. Burning lumps of rock fly through the black sky trailing smoke. In the foreground the ground is cracked into plates with orange-hot rivers glowing in every crack.

91.words: blame (verb): to say someone is responsible for something bad
91.asset_description: In a 3D-animated kitchen a mother finds a flower pot knocked over with soil and paw prints on the floor and angrily points at her teenage son; he denies it and points at the dirt trail, and the paw prints lead both of them to point at the guilty cat under the table.
91.transcript: Yo you again what not me look right there Him it was him

442.words: teamwork (noun): people working together to get something done
442.asset_description: A young woman struggles alone with a huge cardboard box in an empty flat until a man steps in; they take one side each, raise the box over their heads together and set it on top of a growing stack, then celebrate the tower they built.
442.transcript: Heavier than it looked! One, two, three, up she goes!

649.words: scold (verb): to angrily tell someone off for a mistake
649.asset_description: In a hand-painted countryside scene, an old grandmother wags her finger and angrily tells off her grandson by the cabbage patch because he left the gate open and geese got in; he hangs his head, clutches his straw hat, apologizes and shuffles off to close the wooden gate.
649.transcript: Look at my cabbages! I forgot the gate. How many times? Sorry, Grandma.

736.words: stepbrother (noun): the son of your parent's new husband or wife
736.asset_description: At an outdoor garden wedding, a red-haired bride marries a bald mustached groom; afterwards her red-haired son and the groom's son are pushed together, exchange an awkward handshake and fist bump, then hug and join the new family photo.
736.transcript: So, you're the new one? Looks like it. Hi! One family now. Boys! Photo now!

737.words: stepfather (noun): the man married to your mother, not your dad
737.asset_description: A man bonds with his wife's son: he fixes the boy's blue bike in the driveway and gets a high-five, guides his hands to flip a pancake at the stove, and the boy then runs into his arms for a big hug while the mother watches happily from the doorway.

1316.words: sibling (noun): your brother or your sister
1316.asset_description: A young man sits with his arm around a young woman on a sunny porch, both laughing warmly together.

1358.words: stepmother (noun): the woman married to your father, not your mum
1358.asset_description: On a sunny porch, a smiling woman sits behind a young girl and braids her long hair while the girl grins back at the camera.

1359.words: stepsister (noun): the daughter of your parent's new partner
1359.asset_description: Two young women - one with dark curly hair, one blonde - lie on a bedroom carpet with their heads together, laughing hard in a bright white bedroom.

2605.words: cradle (verb): to hold someone gently in your arms
2605.asset_description: A long-haired bearded man in a white and gold robe gently cradles a wide-eyed baby against his chest, with a glowing halo of light behind his head.

2732.words: grandson (noun): the son of your son or daughter
2732.asset_description: A loose watercolour portrait of a grey-haired man with a white beard holding a small boy in a blue striped T-shirt on his lap; both look calmly past the viewer against splashes of blue and green paint.

2806.words: toddler (noun): a very small child, only a year or two old
2806.asset_description: A glossy illustration of a chubby round-cheeked little child dressed as the baby god Krishna - golden turban with a peacock feather, gold necklaces and bangles - holding both palms pressed together in front of the chest.

3513.words: bride (noun): the woman getting married that day
3513.asset_description: Minimal illustration of a woman seen from behind in a long white wedding dress with a very long veil trailing across the floor, standing in a pale arch against a dark wall.

4343.asset_description: A soft pastel cartoon of a bright child's playroom. A young woman with a brown ponytail in a rainbow-striped jumper spins on the spot with three small children hanging off her: a boy on her back, a toddler girl held out at arm's length in the air, and another girl clinging to her leg. All four have their mouths wide open, eyes screwed up, heads thrown back. A polka-dot party hat and a rainbow lollipop fly out of the spin. Balloons float at the left, cushions are scattered on the floor, and a wooden toy box full of teddy bears and building blocks stands by the wall.

4344.words: affection (noun): a warm feeling of liking someone
4344.asset_description: A warm, sunlit home kitchen photographed from the doorway. An older woman in a patterned apron stands behind a younger woman in a flour-dusted apron and hugs her from behind, both arms wrapped round her chest, their cheeks pressed together. Both are laughing with their eyes closed; there is flour on the younger one's face and on their hands. On the wooden kitchen island in front of them sits a black baking tray of golden pastries just out of the oven, with steam and a metal mixing bowl beside it. Open shelves of jars and spices line the walls, ladles and knives hang on rails, and an oven with a checked tea towel stands to the left.

4355.words: adorable (adjective): lovable in a sweet, childlike way
4355.asset_description: A soft pastel cartoon seen from above. A round-cheeked baby with one curl of hair, huge shining eyes and a wide open smile lies on its back on a white playmat printed with stars and little animal faces. It wears a pink top and a mint-green nappy, and it is waving both fists in the air and kicking its bare feet up so the toes point at the camera. A pink and blue rattle hovers just above it, still shaking. Adult hands reach in towards the baby from both bottom corners, and teddy bears, folded blankets and soft toys lie around the edge of the mat with sparkles drawn in the air.

4462.words: funeral (noun): a ceremony where a dead person is buried
4462.asset_description: A graveside in a cemetery on a grey day, bare trees and headstones behind. A family in black coats and dark suits stands around an open grave with a pale wooden coffin lowered into it. A woman in a black headscarf steps forward and lays a single white rose on the lid. An elderly man drops a handful of earth onto the coffin. Two workers in overalls shovel soil down onto it from both sides until a mound of brown earth covers the lid, the white rose still on top, while the mourners stand with their heads bowed.

4582.words: measure (verb): to find the size or measurements of something
4582.asset_description: A sunny back garden with a family party going on: picnic tables set with food and cups, and grown-ups and children all over the lawn. A boy and a blonde girl run towards each other across the grass and hug tightly, laughing into the camera. They then stand back to back, chins up, and an adult lays a flat ruler across the tops of their two heads to see which of them is taller. Other children run past behind them.

4646.words: divorce (noun): the legal ending of a marriage
4646.asset_description: A charcoal drawing of a wooden table seen close up. Two gold wedding rings lie on the bare tabletop. A large hand on the right has just set one ring down and is drawing back from it, while a second hand reaches in from the left towards the other ring. Behind them a city skyline is sketched in soft grey.

4775.words: newborn (adjective): born a very short time ago
4775.asset_description: A bright living room with plants on the windowsill. A white-haired woman in a cream cable sweater sits on a sofa cradling a tiny swaddled baby whose face is still red and crumpled, only days old. She smiles down at it. A second older woman sits beside her and rests a hand on the bundle, then a teenage boy and a young woman lean in from either side. All four gather around the baby and finally look up at the camera, smiling, the infant still asleep in the great-grandmother's arms.

5067.words: marriage (noun): the state of being a married couple
5067.asset_description: A cartoon bride and groom float in the air in front of a pastel flower arch, kissing. She wears a white gown, a veil and pearls and holds a bouquet up in one hand; he wears a black tuxedo. Confetti and ribbons fall around them while guests in the foreground clap and cheer with their eyes shut.

5090.words: nursery (noun): a room in a home for a baby
5090.asset_description: A claymation-style scene set in a small baby's room. A woman in a blue jumper kneels on a patterned rug and holds a baby in yellow striped pyjamas up in the air; both are laughing. Behind her stands a wooden cot with white bedding, and around the room there are wooden building blocks on the floor, a knitted purple elephant toy, a chest of drawers, a shelf with potted plants and a curtained window letting in warm light.

5107.words: cradle (verb): to hold someone gently in your arms
5107.asset_description: A mother and father stand cheek to cheek in a bright room, cradling their swaddled newborn in their arms and smiling down at it. The shot changes to the two of them leaning over a clear hospital bassinet with their reflections in the plastic and the newborn asleep inside. The camera then pulls back across a hospital nursery filled with rows and rows of identical bassinets, each holding a sleeping newborn, the rows stretching away down the ward.

5203.words: relative (noun): a person related by blood or marriage
5203.asset_description: A family arrives at a front door hung with a Christmas wreath. A man in a patterned jumper carries an iced cake in while more people come up the path behind him. Inside the hallway there are hugs and kisses on the cheek between grandparents, parents, teenagers and children, the hall fills up, and the whole group raises glasses together for a toast.

5275.words: selfish (adjective): only concerned with yourself, not with others
5275.asset_description: A claymation scene in a living room: a boy in a striped jumper and a girl in dungarees each grip one end of a TV remote and pull it towards themselves, scowling at each other. Two bowls of popcorn are knocked over and popcorn is flying through the air. A clay dog stands beside them watching, and a blank TV glows on the stand behind the sofa.

5276.words: sibling (noun): your brother or your sister
5276.asset_description: Two young sisters chase each other around the sofa of a bright living room. They then drape a big white blanket over the dining chairs to build a den and grin out at the camera from the gap underneath. Next they face each other across a kitchen counter, snarling over a single chocolate-chip cookie on a paper plate, and finally each of them bites into her own cookie, laughing at the camera above the empty plate.

5325.words: spouse (noun): a person's partner in marriage
5325.asset_description: A man and a woman, both wearing wedding rings, walk together down the hallway of a house carrying a paper grocery bag between them. In the kitchen they stand side by side at a wooden counter, each signing an official-looking document with a blue pen and smiling at each other's page. They high-five in the hallway, then walk to the front door hand in hand.

5440.words: nephew (noun): the son of your brother or sister
5440.asset_description: A blue ballpoint-pen drawing on cream paper. A grown bearded man in a denim jacket runs across a meadow with a kite reel in his raised hand, his cap blowing off behind him, and a small laughing boy in dungarees runs along beside him holding the string of a second kite. Two patterned diamond kites with long curling ribbon tails climb into a sky of drawn swirls above a low sun; dandelions and daisies fill the grass in the foreground.

227.words: diamond (noun): a very hard, sparkling stone used in jewelry
227.asset_description: A gloved jeweler holds a sparkling diamond in tweezers over a green velvet cushion while a red-haired customer gasps in amazement at how it catches the light. The jeweler inspects the stone through a loupe, then presents a finished diamond ring on the cushion and the woman covers her mouth in delight.
227.transcript: It's on fire! Hardest thing on earth.

283.words: fabric (noun): cloth material used for making clothes
283.asset_description: In a shop stacked with colorful wax-print cloth, a woman picks a patterned roll and the seller unrolls it across a wooden table. She feels the material between her fingers, he measures and cuts two meters, and she hugs her folded piece happily.

298.words: fitting room (noun): the curtained booth where you try on clothes
298.asset_description: In a clothes shop, a woman disappears behind a fitting room curtain and steps out in one outfit after another: a khaki jumpsuit that gets a thumbs down from her bored friend, a red dress, and finally a green jumpsuit that wins an excited thumbs up.

461.words: mannequin (noun): a life-size dummy that displays clothes in a shop
461.asset_description: Outside a shop with blue doors, two young people dress a white mannequin in a shirt and scarf and pose its arm up. A guy then stands next to it copying its raised-arm pose while they laugh.
461.transcript: (upbeat music) - Arm up, hold. Which one's next? (laughing)

549.words: piercing (noun): a small hole in the ear for wearing jewelry
549.asset_description: At a mirror with vanity lights, a young woman points to the small piercing holes in her ear, picks a gold hoop from a jewelry tray, fits it into an ear piercing and admires the rings in her ear with a thumbs up.
549.transcript: Four tiny holes. New ring day.

627.words: runway (noun): the long stage a model walks along
627.asset_description: A young woman in a blue slip dress over a white tee struts along a long white rug in a living room as if it were a fashion-show runway, posing with a hand on her hip and turning at the end while her friends film her and shout encouragement.
627.transcript: Whoo! Work it! And turn. Whoo!

678.words: silk (noun): smooth shiny cloth made from worm threads
678.asset_description: In a fabric shop stacked with cloth, two women admire a length of shiny emerald-green silk: they let it pour like water, toss it into the air, press its smooth surface to their cheeks, and laugh as it keeps sliding off the polished counter while a white cat watches.

751.words: style (noun): your own way of dressing and looking
751.asset_description: In an animated clothing store two friends in matching beige outfits offer a blue-haired punk girl the same jacket; she refuses and builds her own bold look with a yellow checkered jacket, red scarf and purple platform boots, posing in the mirror while the amazed friends end up draped in colorful scarves.
751.transcript: Wear this one, like ours. No, this is me. Wait! Me too!

778.words: thread (noun): a long thin strand of cotton for sewing
778.asset_description: In a sunny tailoring workshop, a young seamstress pulls a long red thread off a wooden spool while her colleague marvels at how thin it is. She threads it through fabric, sews a seam, snips the end with scissors and both hold up the finished cloth.

798.words: tracksuit (noun): a matching zip jacket and loose trousers
798.asset_description: A woman zips up a turquoise tracksuit jacket, tightens the matching drawstring trousers and dances in an old Italian alley under laundry lines; three friends in identical turquoise tracksuits join her and they strut and squat-dance down the cobbled street together.

809.words: trend (noun): a style that suddenly everyone follows
809.asset_description: Two friends walk through a European old town and realize with growing shock that everyone around them wears the same yellow bucket hat - cyclists, cafe guests, grandmas, even a passing corgi. The boy gives in, grabs a yellow hat from a street stand and proudly puts it on while his friend facepalms.
809.transcript: Everyone has one! And now me too!

816.words: tuxedo (noun): a formal black suit worn with a bow tie
816.asset_description: A woman in a green evening gown ties a black bow tie for a man in a white dress shirt. He pulls on the black jacket, buttons it and checks himself out in a full-length mirror, clearly impressed with the finished formal look.

1590.words: hood (noun): the part of a coat that covers your head
1590.asset_description: A stylized portrait of a person with closed eyes tilting their face up toward the light, wearing a large pointed hood whose fabric is filled with a starry night pattern.

1726.words: cape (noun): a loose sleeveless coat hanging from the shoulders
1726.asset_description: A vintage French postcard illustration of a performer in a purple embroidered costume and hat swirling a large red cape behind her, printed over handwritten letter text.

1738.words: veil (noun): a piece of cloth that covers the head
1738.asset_description: A fine engraving of a young woman with a long dark veil draped over her head and shoulders, her hands gently clasped at her chest as she looks down.

1972.words: turban (noun): a long cloth wound around the head
1972.asset_description: A young woman wears a tall jeweled blue turban, drop earrings and a gold necklace, standing in front of a glowing palace with hanging lanterns at dusk.

2013.words: gothic (adjective): in a dark dramatic style with black clothes
2013.asset_description: A painted portrait of a pale young woman with long black hair, heavy black eye makeup dripping down her cheeks, dark lips and faded roses woven into her hair and dark dress.

2082.words: cane (noun): a thin stick you lean on while walking
2082.asset_description: A Van-Gogh-style painting of a bearded man in a long yellow coat and straw hat standing on a country path, holding a thin walking cane in one hand.

2100.words: gown (noun): a long formal dress worn to a ball
2100.asset_description: A smiling blonde princess in a huge flowing blue ball gown with puffed sleeves walks through a garden of purple flowers, holding the wide skirt with both hands.

2104.words: jewelry (noun): necklaces, earrings and rings that you wear
2104.asset_description: A painted portrait of an ancient Egyptian queen covered in gold jewelry: a jeweled headdress, long golden earrings, a wide gold collar necklace and arm bands, with dramatic black eyeliner.

2112.words: blazer (noun): a smart formal jacket worn over a shirt
2112.asset_description: A painted portrait of a young professional woman with short elegant brown hair, pearl earrings and natural makeup, wearing a bright yellow blazer over a white shirt in front of blurred spring trees.

2117.words: pocket watch (noun): a round watch carried on a chain
2117.asset_description: A Victorian steampunk couple strides through a foggy street, the man in a top hat and long dark coat with a large golden pocket watch hanging on a chain at his chest, an airship floating behind them.

2158.words: headscarf (noun): a cloth wrapped around the head
2158.asset_description: Vivid pop-art portrait of a Black woman wearing a bright orange headscarf wrapped around her head and neck, with a gold earring, against bold pink, yellow and black shapes.

2199.words: delicate (adjective): fine, soft and easily damaged
2199.asset_description: A pale, porcelain-like woman in a flowing white outfit stands wrapped in clouds of delicate pink roses and wispy translucent fabric that dissolves into smoke around her.

2200.words: elegant (adjective): graceful and stylish to look at
2200.asset_description: A young woman with flowers in her long brown hair stands in a flowing blue-and-orange gown against an explosion of colorful paint splashes.

2202.words: smart (adjective): neat and well-dressed, not scruffy
2202.asset_description: A young man in a crisp white blazer over a black shirt stands on a sunny street corner beside shop shelves stacked with round boxes.

2248.words: graceful (adjective): moving in a smooth, beautiful, elegant way
2248.asset_description: A woman with closed eyes floats gracefully in front of a huge pale moon, her long hair spreading out and her silver-and-peach gown flowing around her like silk. Small glowing lanterns hang on threads beside her.

2251.words: robe (noun): a long loose piece of clothing
2251.asset_description: A young blond angel with huge white wings stands against a sunny blue sky. He wears a long white robe tied with a wide golden belt and a delicate crown of white feathers.

2274.words: lace (noun): fine cloth with open patterns of threads
2274.asset_description: A blonde angel with large white wings stands before misty cliffs and waterfalls, wearing a long white dress with an ornate lace collar and embroidered lace bodice, and a crown of white flowers.

2275.words: outfit (noun): the set of clothes worn together
2275.asset_description: Seen from a low angle, a girl in a red jacket, teal t-shirt and ripped jeans walks toward the camera through a narrow rundown alley, her chunky black sneakers filling the foreground.

2288.words: crop top (noun): a short top that leaves the stomach bare
2288.asset_description: A short-haired young woman stands at a marina in a sporty yellow zip jacket worn open over a black crop top and black shorts, her midriff bare, with white sailboats and yachts on the water behind her.

2296.words: floral (adjective): decorated with a flower pattern
2296.asset_description: An anime-style young woman with long auburn hair wears an orange dress covered in a white floral print, standing before a wall of large orange and white flowers with butterflies around her.

2354.words: headdress (noun): a decorated head covering for ceremonies
2354.asset_description: A serene blue-skinned goddess figure with closed eyes and gold makeup wears a huge ornate golden headdress, framed by a fan of peacock feathers and gold flowers.

2359.words: traditional (adjective): done or worn as it was long ago
2359.asset_description: A serene couple styled as Indian deities in traditional dress: he in a blue turban, she in a tall golden crown, both covered in gold necklaces, bracelets and ornate makeup.

2383.words: gem (noun): a beautiful precious stone used in jewellery
2383.asset_description: A blonde girl with bright blue eyes stands surrounded by swirling orange flames, her sheer dress and shoulder armor studded all over with colorful sparkling gems.

2390.words: stylish (adjective): dressed in a fashionable, attractive way
2390.asset_description: A photoreal young woman with long dark hair poses on a sunny beach in a black beaded top and long teal skirt, wearing big ornate earrings and stacks of bracelets, one hand in her pocket.

2411.words: ornate (adjective): covered in rich, detailed patterns
2411.asset_description: Close-up of a goddess-like woman wearing an extremely ornate golden crown, huge gold earrings and necklaces, red and pink flowers, and dramatic red eye makeup.

2422.words: overalls (noun): trousers with straps over the shoulders
2422.asset_description: A girl with curly pigtails and a pink headband sits in a library full of colorful bookshelves, wearing blue denim overalls and reading a big open book.

2528.words: top hat (noun): a tall formal hat with a flat top
2528.asset_description: A young woman with long curly auburn hair wears a shiny purple top hat, a grey blazer and a big purple bow at her neck, in front of a sunny yellow background full of candy-colored roses.

2532.words: ruffle (noun): a strip of frilly fabric used as trim
2532.asset_description: A pale young woman with curled hair, blue eyes and red lipstick wears a wide red hat with a black bow and a grey off-the-shoulder dress trimmed with soft grey ruffles.

2611.words: buckle (noun): the metal fastener that closes a belt
2611.asset_description: A dark-haired young man in heavy black plate armor stands in a smoky forest with orange embers flying around him, a wide leather belt with a metal buckle strapped across his waist.

2654.words: strap (noun): a narrow band that holds something in place
2654.asset_description: A retro poster of a dark-haired woman in a red space suit with a metal helmet ring around her neck; wide white straps run over her shoulders and across her chest, and a white rocket, the moon and Earth are behind her.

2714.words: straw hat (noun): a light summer hat woven from dried stalks
2714.asset_description: A painted portrait of a young woman in a wide woven sun hat and a pale slip dress standing under a lemon tree above a rocky coastline, with ripe lemons and white blossom hanging all around her.

2726.words: beads (noun): small round balls threaded on a string
2726.asset_description: A close-up painted portrait of a stern monkey-faced deity with a golden headpiece, orange face stripes and orange patterns on his shoulder; two long necklaces of round orange beads hang across his bare chest.

2777.words: brooch (noun): jewellery with a pin, fastened to clothes
2777.asset_description: A black-and-white portrait with only the red parts in colour: a woman wears a tall red and white patterned headwrap with a large silver jewelled brooch pinned at the front above her eyebrows, long silver drop earrings and a patterned shawl around her neck.

3718.words: hoodie (noun): a soft sweatshirt with a hood on the back
3718.asset_description: Grey ink-and-wash fashion sketch of a young man standing against a painted wall in a light hoodie under an open bomber jacket, wide jogging trousers, chunky trainers, sunglasses and a small crossbody bag.

4360.words: purse (noun): a container for carrying money and small items
4360.asset_description: A woman with long braids in a bright orange and blue patterned dress stands on a sunny city street with a plain tote over one shoulder. She holds a paper gift bag open by its handles and leans over it, eyes wide and mouth open with delight at what is inside. The clip cuts to her walking down the bright concourse of a shopping centre towards the camera with three or four paper shop bags hanging from each hand, past lit shopfronts. It ends on a rising escalator: she stands with bags stacked over both forearms and holds up a patterned brown leather handbag in one hand and a large black leather holdall in the other, grinning straight at the camera.

4799.words: tie (verb): to fasten something with a cord or string
4799.asset_description: An anime-style young man in a navy suit stands in front of a tall mirror and ties his black bow tie with white-gloved hands, grinning nervously with a sweat drop on his face; his jacket and a red rose lie over a wooden chair and an open suitcase sits on a dressing table behind him.

4888.words: barefoot (adjective): wearing nothing on your feet
4888.asset_description: A blonde young woman in a white sundress walks barefoot along the wet sand at the edge of the sea; shallow waves wash over her bare feet and she leaves footprints behind her; the camera pulls back to show a long line of people walking barefoot on the same shoreline.

4913.words: bracelet (noun): a band wrapped around the wrist
4913.asset_description: Two young women stand facing each other on a park lawn at sunset, hands pressed together, laughing. In close-up one of them fastens a woven beaded band around the other's wrist and adjusts it. They then throw their arms around each other, one climbs onto the other's back and they spin around on the grass with the low sun behind them.

4944.words: gown (noun): a long formal dress worn to a ball
4944.asset_description: A red-haired young woman sits at a dressing-room mirror ringed with bulbs and touches up her lips. She stands and spins so the long pale-gold skirt of her dress flares out, then walks away down a dark backstage corridor holding the skirt up. A wide shot shows her alone in a spotlight on a big empty theatre stage seen from the dark auditorium. Back in close-up she is handed a bunch of red roses, holds them out towards the camera, then bows over them in front of a red velvet curtain.

5030.words: costume (noun): special clothes worn for a show or festival
5030.asset_description: A street carnival in a city of tall shuttered houses hung with bunting. A woman in a rainbow feather costume walks down the middle of the road carrying a tall banner on a pole, smiling straight ahead, with a large crowd of people walking close behind her. Drummers in matching yellow and blue tops move along the road in rows with drums strapped to them, and the balconies on both sides are packed with people watching.

5178.words: headscarf (noun): a cloth wrapped around the head
5178.asset_description: In a white kitchen a woman in a navy headscarf opens the door of a tall built-in oven, turns to a baking tray of chocolate chip cookies on the counter beside her, lifts it, and slides it onto the rack inside the lit oven.

5242.words: elegant (adjective): graceful and stylish to look at
5242.asset_description: A woman in a silky champagne slip dress with a matching long satin robe stands at an open window in a Paris apartment. She sprays perfume onto her wrist, rubs her wrists together and sprays her neck, then walks slowly through the perfume mist, flicks her hair back and turns to the camera smiling. A table beside her is crowded with perfume bottles, and Paris rooftops are visible through the window.

5273.words: model (noun): a person who poses for a photographer
5273.asset_description: A male model walks a fashion-show runway in a yellow denim jacket over a purple shirt and green trousers with white and yellow trainers. The catwalk is painted in soft colour blocks and rows of guests sit along both sides filming him. He walks towards the camera, turns at the end, checks the watch on his wrist and poses smiling in sunglasses.

5298.words: blazer (noun): a smart formal jacket worn over a shirt
5298.asset_description: A young woman in a beige tailored jacket over a white top stands at a perfume counter in a brightly lit shop. She holds a paper test strip to her nose, then lifts a glass bottle and sniffs it, closes her eyes, waves the scent toward her face with her hand and reaches for another bottle on the display.

5317.words: ruffle (noun): a strip of frilly fabric used as trim
5317.asset_description: On a wooden stage at dusk, under a web of small hanging bulbs, a flamenco dancer performs in a black dress whose skirt is built from tier after tier of folded red and black frills. A guitarist plays seated at the side and two women watch and clap. As she turns and stamps, the layered frills lift and swirl out around her legs, filling most of the frame.

5327.words: cape (noun): a loose sleeveless coat hanging from the shoulders
5327.asset_description: In a brightly painted hair salon a client sits in the styling chair with a black sleeveless salon cape fastened at her neck and hanging over her shoulders and arms down to her lap. The stylist stands behind her and sprays a can of hairspray over the client's large curled updo, holding a comb in the other hand; a cloud of spray drifts over the hair. At the end the camera holds on the finished updo and the black cape covering the seated client's back.

5379.words: alter (verb): to change something to make it different
5379.asset_description: In a small tailor's shop lined with stacks of coloured cloth, an older tailor with a tape measure round his neck measures a young man who is wearing a new navy jacket. He then folds a piece of dark fabric on his table and marks a line on it with chalk, runs the piece through a sewing machine, and brings the changed jacket back to the young man, easing it onto his shoulders and talking him through what he has made different about it.

5442.words: sleeve (noun): the part of a garment that covers the arm
5442.asset_description: A very large bearded man stands just inside a log cabin with snow visible through the window and peels off his winter kit layer by layer. He holds his heavy black parka open, shrugs his arms out of its sleeves and drops it, unwinds a long grey knitted scarf from his neck, pulls off his grey beanie, then grabs the hem of his fleece top and drags it up over his head, his arms coming out of the sleeves last. He steps out of his padded black ski trousers, kicks a boot off, and ends standing barefoot in a green thermal base layer with the discarded clothes heaped on the bench behind him.

5466.words: formal (adjective): following the established rules, like formal dress
5466.asset_description: An illustration of a smart restaurant dining room in warm orange light, with brass chandeliers, wood panelling and tables under white cloths. A young waiter walks through it in the strict uniform of the trade: white shirt, black bow tie, black waistcoat, long white apron and black trousers, a folded white cloth over his forearm. He balances a tray of stacked plates and wine glasses high on one hand and sets a plate down with the other. Seated guests in jackets and dresses dine at candlelit tables.

5479.words: robe (noun): a long loose piece of clothing
5479.asset_description: A woman opens a built-in white closet full of tightly packed clothes on two rails with shoe boxes underneath. Another woman in a blue shirt pulls open the double doors of a tall wooden cupboard, revealing two rails of colourful blouses, shirts and trousers arranged by colour with storage boxes above and clear shoe boxes below. The film then cuts to a huge bright walk-in dressing room lined with shelves of folded knitwear, hanging suits and handbags: a woman stands in the doorway wearing a long champagne-coloured satin gown with wide sleeves and a tied belt reaching to her bare feet, throws her arms out wide and looks around the room in mock astonishment.

33.words: ache (noun): a continuous dull pain, like in a tooth
33.asset_description: A cartoon man sits in a clinic waiting room holding his swollen cheek in pain; he presses a cold pack against his jaw, groans with a toothache, and winces even harder when he tries to sip his hot coffee.

773.words: thermometer (noun): an instrument that measures temperature
773.asset_description: In a retro cartoon, a nurse shakes a glass thermometer and puts it in a sick man's mouth; the red line rockets up as his whole face glows red like a stoplight, so she dumps a bucket of ice on his head and the reading sinks back down.
773.transcript: Open under the tongue. Ah. Oh, you are very hot. Broo-hoo, cold.

1041.words: dizziness (noun): the sick feeling that everything is spinning
1041.asset_description: A woman in a kitchen shuts her eyes and presses one hand to her forehead while gripping the counter with the other hand to steady herself.

1149.words: insomnia (noun): not being able to fall asleep at night
1149.asset_description: Late at night a man lies in bed wide awake, staring at the ceiling with an arm over his forehead while a clock glows on the nightstand.

1213.words: nausea (noun): the sick feeling that you may vomit
1213.asset_description: A pale man grips the railing of a boat on rough grey seas and presses his hand over his mouth, clearly seasick and about to be ill.

1275.words: rash (noun): red itchy spots on the skin
1275.asset_description: A claymation man in a blue sweater grimaces while scratching a cluster of red bumps on his forearm, bits of red flying off; a tub labeled CREAM sits on the table beside him.

4299.words: react (verb): to show a response to something
4299.asset_description: A curly-haired young man sits in a living room with a big fluffy ginger cat on his lap; as he strokes it his eyes go red and streaming and he sneezes into a paper tissue; a woman in denim lifts the cat off him and carries it across the room, and he keeps sneezing and wiping his nose while she holds the cat at a distance.

4356.asset_description: A red-haired man in a green tartan shirt stands on a grassy hillside path, screwing his face up and reaching one arm back over his shoulder to rub the top of his own back, then reaching round with the other hand to press the small of his back. The clip cuts to him walking up a fern-lined dirt track with a large black rucksack on, laughing, with two other walkers on the path behind. In the last shots he gives a red-haired woman in a mustard fleece a piggyback along the same path, both of them laughing at the camera with green bracken all around.

4404.words: injury (noun): physical damage to the body from an accident
4404.asset_description: A grey-haired man in an apron is chopping vegetables in a rustic kitchen when he catches his finger with the knife. He winces, sucks the finger, then hurries to the sink and holds it under the running tap while the water runs pink. He dries it, tears open a small plaster and wraps it around the cut fingertip while a woman keeps cooking behind him.

4815.words: rub (verb): to move your hand over something with pressure
4815.asset_description: A woman in a cream blouse sits at a desk in a busy open-plan office with a monitor, keyboard and paper coffee cup in front of her. She presses her fingertips against both temples and moves them in small circles, screwing up her face. She keeps pressing, moving her hands up over her forehead and into her hair, then lowers her head into her hands and finally lays her head down on her folded arms on the desk while colleagues work behind her.

5042.words: painful (adjective): causing pain in your body or mind
5042.asset_description: Gym-goers come out of a glass gym door in sportswear, walking stiff-legged and grimacing. A man in a grey T-shirt holds the door and winces as he steps down, and a blonde woman in leggings hobbles out after him. A woman with curly hair lowers herself onto a street bench with her face screwed up, then sits rubbing her legs. At the end the whole group waddles down the pavement together with straight, sore legs.
5042.transcript: Ooh, my legs. Leg day. Ow, ow.

5101.words: nausea (noun): the sick feeling that you may vomit
5101.asset_description: A young blonde woman with a plaited ponytail stands on the open rear deck of a ferry, holding the handrail with the ship's white wake stretching away behind her across a cold blue sea. Her face is screwed up and she clamps both hands over her mouth, swallowing hard. She keeps her hands there, breathing through them, then gives up standing and sits down on the deck bench, doubled forward with both hands still pressed over her mouth while other passengers stand at the rail further back.

5193.words: rash (noun): red itchy spots on the skin
5193.asset_description: Two young women in gardening dungarees sit on a wooden bench in a green garden. One of them, red-haired, screws her face up in pain and holds out her bare forearm, which is covered in a patch of angry red blotchy spots, and scratches at it with her fingers. Her friend uncaps a white tube of cream and squeezes a blob onto the red patch, then it is rubbed into a white circle over the spots. The red-haired one winces and grimaces at the sting while her friend laughs beside her.

5368.words: suffer (verb): to be subjected to something bad
5368.asset_description: A cartoon-style illustration of a young person outdoors in blazing heat. The face is flushed deep red, big drops of sweat run down the forehead, cheeks and neck and fly off in all directions, the eyes are half shut and the teeth are clenched in a grimace. One hand is pressed against the forehead pushing the damp hair back, and the background is a blurred golden street glaring with sunlight.

5460.words: sickness (noun): when your body cannot function normally
5460.asset_description: At a funfair a young man staggers away from a spinning teacup ride with his hand clamped over his mouth and his eyes bulging. He hurries to a grey bin and doubles over it. More riders come off the ride the same way: a young woman covers her mouth with both hands, another man clamps his hand over his and bends forward, and soon a whole row of people is bent over the bins along the walkway while the carousel and the big wheel keep turning behind them.

132.words: calories (noun): the energy units in food you burn off by moving
132.asset_description: In a cartoon basement experiment a coach with a stopwatch feeds a man a tiny snack that makes a bulb glow faintly, then unveils a whole cake which he devours; he must pedal an exercise bike furiously to burn it all off, but the bulb still blazes bright while he collapses.
132.transcript: Small snack, small light. Ooh! Big one, please! Now burn it. All of it. No! It's still bright!

184.words: command (verb): to give someone an order they must obey
184.asset_description: In an animated sunset beach scene, a stern female coach commands a line of trainees with short orders like "Down", "Up", "Run"; they instantly drop into push-ups and sprint along the shore, and she raises her fist.
184.transcript: Down. Now. Yes, coach. Up. Run. Hold. Gone.

198.words: cramp (noun): a sudden painful tightening of a muscle
198.asset_description: During a night run on a stadium track, an animated woman suddenly grabs her calf mid-stride and cries "my leg is stuck"; she sits on the track clutching the muscle while her training partner pushes her foot back to stretch it, and after the pain fades she stands up with a thumbs up.
198.transcript: Ow! My leg is stuck! Hold on, push against me. It's going. Okay, okay. Better.

278.words: squat (noun): an exercise: bend your knees, then stand up
278.asset_description: At sunrise in a park a mixed group of young and older people stand in rows on the grass and drop together into a deep knee bend with hips down and hands at the chest, coming back up and repeating it in time before moving on to lunges and arm raises.

374.words: jog (verb): to run slowly at a steady pace for exercise
374.asset_description: A tattooed man in a dark 'running club' t-shirt and shorts jogs at a steady pace along an empty wet road at dawn, breathing calmly as street lamps and trees pass behind him.

474.words: meditation (noun): sitting still and breathing to calm the mind
474.asset_description: On a wooden deck surrounded by palm trees, a woman sits cross-legged on a mat with her eyes closed, breathing slowly. A whole group joins her on mats, someone strikes a singing bowl, and they all meditate together in silence as the sun sets behind the jungle.

590.words: punch (verb): to hit something hard with your fist
590.asset_description: In a boxing gym a young woman in red gloves throws fast combinations, punching the black focus pads her trainer holds up. She works through jabs and hooks in rhythm and finishes the round laughing with him.

727.words: sprint (verb): to run at full speed over a short distance
727.asset_description: An animated female runner powers down a stadium track at top speed, breaks the red finish tape ahead of the others, then bends over panting and breaks into a happy smile.

754.words: support (verb): to hold someone up and help them succeed
754.asset_description: In an anime rooftop scene a woman strains at a pull-up bar and cannot lift herself; her friend grips her feet from below and pushes her up until she finishes the pull-up, and they celebrate with a handshake.
754.transcript: I can't! I've got you! Push! I did it! Yes!

776.words: thirst (noun): the strong feeling of needing to drink
776.asset_description: A sweating cyclist stops on a scorching dirt track and tips his water bottle high over his open mouth, but only a last drop falls out. He grimaces with a dry mouth, stares longingly at sprinklers watering a distant field and keeps shaking the empty bottle.

1346.words: spit (verb): to force water or saliva out of your mouth
1346.asset_description: A shirtless boxer leans over the ring ropes in a dark gym and spits a stream of water into a plastic bucket held up by his hooded coach.

1413.words: treadmill (noun): a gym machine with a moving belt to run on
1413.asset_description: A woman with a flying ponytail runs on a treadmill in a modern gym at dusk, city lights visible through the tall windows; other people train on machines behind her.

1468.words: wheelchair (noun): a chair on wheels for someone who cannot walk
1468.asset_description: A focused athlete in a black T-shirt and gloves leans forward in a three-wheeled racing wheelchair, pushing its wheels at speed around an indoor track.

1881.words: meditate (verb): to sit quietly and calm your mind
1881.asset_description: A minimal watercolor drawing of a long-haired woman sitting cross-legged in the lotus position with her eyes closed, calm wavy blue washes behind her.

2115.words: yoga (noun): calm stretching poses with slow breathing
2115.asset_description: A simple line-art drawing of a faceless person in a blue sweater sitting cross-legged in a meditation pose against soft watercolor waves.

3293.words: to punch (verb): to hit hard with your closed hand
3293.asset_description: Charcoal sketch of a female boxer in a sports top and shorts wearing boxing gloves, one glove raised high after a punch and the other held up by her chin, with the ropes of the ring sketched behind her.

3314.words: to jog (verb): to run slowly and steadily for exercise
3314.asset_description: Vector illustration of a woman in a blue t-shirt, purple shorts, sunglasses and running shoes jogging along a road beside green bushes, a fitness watch on her wrist and earphones in her ears.

3494.words: to stretch (verb): to pull your body out long to feel looser
3494.asset_description: Warm silhouette poster: a woman stands on a hill in front of a huge pale sun and reaches both arms up over her head, a tall flowering agave stalk beside her.

3797.words: handstand (noun): standing upside down on your hands
3797.asset_description: A dark silhouette of a person balancing upside down on both hands in shallow water, legs split high in the air, with drops splashing up and ripples spreading around the hands, against a plain orange background.

4002.words: balance (noun): a steady state where you do not fall over
4002.asset_description: Two women type at computers in a bright open-plan office. The camera whips round to a long meeting table where a woman in a dark leotard holds a handstand on the tabletop, legs straight up in the air. Colleagues crowd both sides of the table, throwing their arms up, cheering and filming her on their phones.

4039.words: crawl (verb): to move slowly with the body near the ground
4039.asset_description: In a gym lit with purple and green neon, a man and a woman are down on their hands and toes at the start of a marked running track, joined by a long red resistance band. They crawl forwards along the track side by side with their hips low, the band stretching tighter behind them. The band pulls the woman back and she is dragged flat onto her stomach, then ends up sitting on the track laughing while the man stands over her holding the band.

4157.words: race (verb): to move fast in a race
4157.asset_description: On a wet tree-lined avenue covered with fallen brown leaves, hundreds of runners in numbered bibs race past the camera on both sides. In the middle of the road stands a small old woman in a beige coat and scarf, holding up a large piece of white cardboard with the handwritten words RUN IF YOU THINK I'M SEXY. She stands completely still, smiling, while the runners stream past her towards the start arch in the background.

4348.words: athletic (adjective): relating to athletes or sport
4348.asset_description: A photograph of a wide sandy beach on a clear day. A woman in a plain black one-piece swimsuit runs up out of the shallows with a pale, well-used surfboard clamped under her right arm. Her hair is wet and pushed back, her arms and legs are muscular, one foot is off the ground and sand sprays out from under her heel. A wave curls and breaks behind her. Two red-and-yellow patrol flags stand in the sand on either side of the frame, and a wooden lifeguard tower sits on the grassy dune behind.

4440.words: strike (verb): to deliver a sharp blow with the hand or fist
4440.asset_description: In a sunny garden dojo a woman in a white karate suit with a black belt stands barefoot on the mats, other students in white suits watching from the sides. She sets her fists, drops her weight and brings her hand down onto two wooden boards laid across a low wooden stand, splitting them. The stand is reloaded with a block of blue tiles and she raises her fist high above her head and drives it down through them. Finally she squares up to a tall stack of grey concrete slabs, strikes the top of the stack with her hand, and broken pieces fall away onto the mats.

4735.words: punch (noun): a blow with the fist
4735.asset_description: Soldiers in camouflage uniforms train in hand-to-hand combat on a churned muddy field under a grey sky. A woman in uniform drives blow after blow with her gloved fists into a black padded shield held up by a man in front of her. He then grabs her from behind around the chest and they grapple, stumbling in the mud. Around them dozens of other soldiers do the same drill in pairs on grey mats laid over the mud, and at the end she stands close to camera throwing punches into the air, breathing hard.

5038.words: pace (noun): how fast you are walking or running
5038.asset_description: A woman in teal running kit and a pink cap props one leg on a wooden railing on the Great Wall and stretches at sunrise. She then sets off up the long stone staircase, running at a steady even rhythm, breathing hard, with the watchtower and hills behind her and a few walkers far below.

5124.words: marathon (noun): a running race of about 42 kilometres
5124.asset_description: A phone-held point-of-view shot from inside a road race: the camera runs with the pack along a narrow cobbled street in an old town, passing other runners in numbered vests. Spectators stand behind metal barriers on both sides and clap as the runners go by. The camera drifts sideways past several runners, then holds on one runner in a blue vest striding away up the street between tall pastel buildings.

5207.words: sweat (noun): the salty fluid your skin lets out when hot
5207.asset_description: On a sunny alpine meadow below a wall of snow-covered peaks, two shirtless hikers with big backpacks toil up the grassy slope on trekking poles, skin glistening. One mops his face with his cap and sits down on a boulder, breathing hard; the other drops flat on his back in the grass with his arms out. They drink from water bottles and rest side by side, one sprawled on a wooden bench, the other on the rock.

5331.asset_description: A very muscular young woman stands at a thatched beach bar in front of a big glass jug on a wooden table. She squeezes an orange in her bare hands until the juice runs into the jug, then picks up a whole watermelon and crushes it between her hands until it bursts and its juice pours into the jug. At the end she turns to the camera and flexes her bicep while the guests behind her laugh and cheer with their drinks.

5355.words: trainer (noun): someone who trains other people or animals
5355.asset_description: Early morning in a misty park among tall thin trees, the sun burning through the haze. A woman in a coral top and leggings stands on a low stone platform leading a group of mostly older people through an exercise routine: arms stretched overhead with hands clasped, then a side bend, then bending down to touch her toes, with the whole group copying her behind. A large ginger cat walks along the stone ledge right beside her and stretches its front legs out with its back arched, matching her movement, then sits calmly at her feet while she and the group raise both arms to the sky.

5356.words: yoga (noun): calm stretching poses with slow breathing
5356.asset_description: A rooftop terrace at sunset, city blocks and potted plants along the parapet, the sun a bright disc low in a hazy orange sky. A woman in a plum top and leggings works through poses on a mat: she folds forward with straight legs and both palms flat on the mat, looking up at the camera; rises into a high lunge with both arms lifted overhead and her gaze up; leans back over a straight rear leg with one arm reaching behind her; sits into a wide-legged forward fold reaching for one foot; and finally lies chest-down along her front leg with both arms stretched out on the mat in front of her.

5369.words: tough (adjective): not given to gentleness or soft feelings
5369.asset_description: A young boxer stands in a dim boxing gym with punchbags and other fighters training behind him. His grey shirt is soaked through with a big dark patch of sweat down the chest, his face and hair are wet, and he talks straight into the camera between hard breaths without softening. At the end he lifts a white towel with hands wrapped in red boxing wraps and rubs it over his head.

5469.words: walker (noun): someone who walks for exercise or pleasure
5469.asset_description: An older woman with short white hair, a cap and a bright pink jacket makes her way on foot along a gravel path in a lakeside park, planting a Nordic walking pole with each hand as she goes. She passes another person on foot near a bench, then follows the path beside grey water with ducks on it, stops to look at the smartwatch on her wrist, and carries on past a stone fountain with hills and a town on the far shore.

5503.words: position (noun): the way the body and limbs are arranged
5503.asset_description: A bright living room with white curtains and a pale floor. A young woman in a purple sports bra and leggings squats with her arms held straight out in front of her, then drops onto a teal exercise mat and pushes up into a high plank with a phone timer and a water bottle on the floor beside her. She lowers onto her forearms into an elbow plank and holds it, face tight with effort as the timer counts up. At the end she drops flat onto her back on the mat, arms spread, breathing hard.

153.words: champagne (noun): a sparkling white wine opened at celebrations
153.asset_description: On a rooftop terrace at dusk, a man eases the cork out of a champagne bottle from an ice bucket; the cork pops into the sky, he fills a tray of flutes with fizzing champagne and the dressed-up friends toast and drink.
153.transcript: Careful, hear it! To us tonight!

161.words: chicken drumstick (noun): the lower leg of a cooked chicken that you eat
161.asset_description: A couple pull a golden roast bird out of the oven; the man carves it at the counter, twists off a whole leg, lifts it by the bone onto a plate and then holds it up and bites the meat straight off it while the dog watches.
161.transcript: Look at that gold! Hear it? Crispy!

164.words: dumpling (noun): a small steamed ball of dough with a filling
164.asset_description: At a night street-food table a bamboo steamer of pleated soup dumplings is opened; a woman demonstrates the chopstick grip and a man, eyes popping with delight, lifts one wobbling dumpling out of the basket and posts it whole into his mouth.
164.transcript: like this pinch got it look

178.words: cocktail (noun): a mixed drink shaken with fruit and ice
178.asset_description: At a sunset beach bar a bartender pours juice, squeezes lime and adds ice into a shaker, shakes it and strains a layered orange-red drink into a tall glass. He garnishes the cocktail with pineapple, a cherry and a paper umbrella, and a couple sips it through straws.

191.words: corkscrew (noun): a tool with a metal spiral for pulling corks
191.asset_description: In a candlelit kitchen a man twists a corkscrew into the cork of a wine bottle, folds the lever down and pulls the cork out with a pop, sniffs it, then pours red wine for himself and a woman and they toast.

506.words: nutrition (noun): healthy food and what it gives your body
506.asset_description: Two runners in sportswear build a colorful healthy plate in a kitchen: spinach, oats, tomato slices, avocado, berries, eggs and nuts arranged in rings. They taste it, celebrate, and jog out the door with their packs.

561.words: pleasure (noun): a feeling of enjoyment and delight
561.asset_description: A young woman in a grey beanie and red scarf bites into a fresh croissant outside a bakery, closes her eyes and savors it with a blissful face, saying "Oh wow". She then shares it with a friend on the bench, who tastes it and enjoys it just as much.

637.words: pomegranate (noun): a round red fruit full of juicy red seeds
637.asset_description: In an orchard, hands score the skin of a large red pomegranate with a knife, slice off its crown, and slowly pull the fruit open into flower-like segments packed with glistening red seeds, held above a crate of more pomegranates.

848.words: vinegar (noun): a sour liquid used to flavour food
848.asset_description: In a sunny garden a woman tastes a drop of vinegar from a small glass cruet and screws up her whole face at how sour it is, while her partner laughs. He then pours just a splash of it over their tomato salad and they toss it and eat happily.
848.transcript: So sour! Wow! Just a splash.

1766.words: blackberry (noun): a dark fruit made of many little parts
1766.asset_description: A vintage botanical watercolor of a bramble branch with ripe black and unripe red blackberries among green and yellow autumn leaves.

2126.words: spill (verb): to let liquid fall out of a container
2126.asset_description: Watercolor kitten leaning into a big mug of coffee, with brown coffee dripping down the sides of the mug and pooling on the table.

3090.words: groceries (noun): the food and drinks you buy for the house
3090.asset_description: A cartoon woman in a red T-shirt and jeans walks along the pavement away from a shop, carrying a brown paper bag with a baguette, a carrot and leafy greens sticking out of the top.

3486.words: coconut (noun): a big hard tropical nut with sweet juice inside
3486.asset_description: A woman in a red off-shoulder dress sits on a step in a sunny alley drinking from a green coconut with a straw, a straw basket bag next to her.

3639.words: stool (noun): a high seat with no back, used at a counter
3639.asset_description: Neon-lit diner floating alone in space. An astronaut sits on one of a row of round red stools at the long counter with a steaming cup in front of him, and a big ringed planet hangs in the black sky behind the windows.

3641.words: vending machine (noun): a machine you put money in to get a drink
3641.asset_description: Illustration of a red rocky planet at night. A lit drinks vending machine full of bottles and cans stands alone on the empty ground, and an astronaut stands in front of it looking at what is inside.

4207.words: deliver (verb): to bring something to a destination
4207.asset_description: A hamster in a pink bow lounges on a small sofa in a dim living room, laughing and then scrolling on a phone. A second hamster in round glasses comes in carrying a pizza box and sets it down on the low table in front of the sofa. The two press their cheeks together, then sit side by side wrapped in a checked blanket, each holding a slice of pepperoni pizza and eating while the television flickers behind them.

4223.words: spicy (adjective): having a hot, pungent taste
4223.asset_description: A green cartoon gecko leans over a white bowl heaped with small red chilli peppers and starts eating them. Its eyes bulge, its skin turns from green to orange to bright red, and a jet of flame shoots out of its open mouth over the bowl. It dives into a tall glass of water and sits curled up inside, still glowing red. Finally it slumps out of the bowl onto the table, back to green, dripping wet with its tongue hanging out.

4254.words: counter (noun): a long table where business is done
4254.asset_description: An animated fried chicken shop at dusk. A grumpy ginger cat in a white chef's hat and a stained white apron stands behind the metal counter, with lit menu boards of fried chicken above and a deep fryer full of bubbling oil set into the counter in front of it. A pigeon stands on the counter arguing with the cat, which scowls back with narrowed green eyes. The pigeon then flaps wildly, tips over the edge and drops into the bubbling fryer. A single feather floats down and the cat stares at it open-mouthed.
4254.transcript: One iced latte with oat milk. Ma'am, we only do fried chicken. No, sweetie. I said oat milk. The customer is always-- Fried pigeon, limited time.

4327.words: barbecue (noun): cooking meat outdoors on a hot grill
