4327.asset_description: Outdoors at sunset, a young man tends a large grill covered with sausages and racks of ribs over glowing embers. Behind him a long table with a white cloth is lined with friends and family sitting on both sides, drinks and plates in front of them, watching and clapping. He spoons green herb sauce over the meat, cuts into it with a long knife, then lifts a piece on the knife towards the camera with his mouth open in delight while the people at the table cheer.

4340.words: chips (noun): strips of potato fried in deep fat
4340.asset_description: A red-haired young man in a navy coat sits on a bench on a seaside promenade holding an open paper cone of thick golden fried potato strips and eating one. A large grey and white gull stands on the arm of the bench beside him, then leans in and pulls a strip straight out of the cone. More gulls swoop down at his head; he hunches over and curls both hands around the paper cone to shield it, and in the last shot a whole flock has him surrounded on the bench.

4402.words: appetite (noun): a feeling of craving food or something else
4402.asset_description: A young man in a tie-dye hoodie and a backwards cap sits on a picnic blanket in a sunny park and sinks his teeth into a red apple. He then attacks an enormous stacked cheeseburger taller than his head, sauce all over his chin, and follows it with a huge slice of watermelon. The shot widens: he and his friends are surrounded by a spread of burgers, fried chicken, corn and watermelon, all eating at once.

4408.words: taste (noun): the sensation you get from food on your tongue
4408.asset_description: A man in a neon vest fills a blender jug with banana slices, mango chunks, raspberries and spinach, blends it to a bright orange smoothie and pours it into a tall glass. He lifts the glass, takes a long drink and pulls it away with an orange smoothie moustache on his upper lip, grinning at how good it is.

4475.words: display (verb): to show something, make it visible
4475.asset_description: A warm ink-and-sepia drawing of a small café on a rainy evening. In the foreground the barista pours a stream of milk from a steel jug into a cup on the wooden counter while steam curls off the espresso machine behind him. Cups, mugs and saucers are set out in rows on the shelves above the machine and stacked along the counter. A cake stand with a glass dome shows a cut sponge cake with one slice missing, and a blank chalkboard sign stands beside it. At a small round table by the window a woman in a coat lifts a cup to her lips, with rain and warm street lights outside.

4607.words: copper (noun): a reddish-brown metal that bends easily
4607.asset_description: Inside a brewery a blonde woman in a denim shirt and apron pulls a beer. She holds a glass tankard under the tap and lets the beer run in, then works the handle so a thick white head builds up over the rim. Two full tankards stand on the steel drip tray. Behind her rise tall, round brewing vessels of polished reddish-brown metal that glow under the lights. She carries a tankard over to three waiting friends and the four of them clink glasses over an old wooden barrel.

4761.words: bacon (noun): salted and smoked meat from a pig's back
4761.asset_description: On a frozen lake under a low winter sun a man in an orange hooded parka cooks breakfast on a small portable gas stove. A single egg fries in a black pan; he lays strips of streaky bacon in beside it and they curl and brown. The shot widens to a large flat pan holding rows of bacon rashers around a heap of fried potato chunks and two fried eggs, which he lifts towards the camera, steaming in the cold air.

4996.words: cone (noun): any cone-shaped object you can hold
4996.asset_description: A sunny photo on the lawn in front of the cathedral and the Leaning Tower of Pisa. A young woman in a white summer dress and a straw hat walks towards the camera holding a pale ice cream in a pointed wafer cone in her raised hand. Pigeons walk on the grass around her and several take off with spread wings on both sides of her.

5018.words: tasty (adjective): pleasing to the sense of taste
5018.asset_description: A soft watercolour illustration: a young woman in a pale blue traditional Korean dress sits at a table, chopsticks in one hand lifting shredded green and orange vegetables, a spoon in the other carrying a dollop of thick red chilli paste over a steaming stone bowl of rice topped with beef, noodles, greens and a sunny fried egg; small side dishes stand blurred behind, and white steam curls up across the paper.

5034.words: spill (verb): to let liquid fall out of a container
5034.asset_description: A woman in a grey bathrobe holds up a white milk carton that is split at the seam; milk runs out of it and pools in a white puddle on the wooden table while she stares at it in dismay. She then crouches under a kitchen sink where water drips out of the plastic trap into a grey bucket. Finally she stands in a large stucco room where drips fall from the ceiling into a dozen coloured plastic bowls hung from strings, and she reaches up to steady one.

5075.words: sticky (adjective): having sticky properties, like glue
5075.asset_description: A man stands in a sunny Italian square holding a tall pink and white soft-serve ice cream. In the heat it melts faster than he can eat it: pink streams run down the cone, over his fingers and along his forearms, coating his hands. He licks at it desperately, then the whole scoop slides off the cone and splatters on the cobblestones, leaving him with sticky hands and an empty cone.

5078.words: pork (noun): meat that comes from a pig
5078.asset_description: At a night-time street food stand a cook in a checked shirt and white apron shaves slices of roasted pork off a tall vertical spit topped with a pineapple, letting them fall onto the hot griddle. He warms a tortilla on the plate, piles the shredded pork onto it with red salsa, showers it with chopped onion and coriander, and then holds out a plate of three finished tacos to the customer with his arms spread wide.

5083.words: berry (noun): small soft fruits that you can eat
5083.asset_description: Two young women bake together at a floury kitchen counter. The blonde one in denim dungarees whisks yellow egg in a small white bowl while the other, in a green hoodie, steadies a big cream mixing bowl of pale batter. They tip a heap of small red berries into the batter, then each take a wooden spoon and stir hard together. The mixture thickens and turns brown, and both of them laugh and pull faces at how heavy it has become.

5112.words: grain (noun): a small particle of a substance
5112.asset_description: A bold ink illustration over a wave-patterned background. Two hands in blue sleeves have just thrown food into the air above a wooden bowl that tips on a plank table: spinach leaves, halved tomatoes, walnuts and almonds, blueberries and red berries, slices of salmon, halved boiled eggs and a falling shower of small golden grains of rice or oats. A few loose grains have already landed in the empty bowl.

5208.words: cuisine (noun): a style of preparing food, or that food
5208.asset_description: A young man in a suit sits down to three very different meals in three countries. At a blue plastic table on a narrow southern street a pan of meatballs in tomato sauce lands in front of him; in a trattoria with red checked cloths a waiter lifts the lid of a steaming tagine of stew; at a rooftop restaurant above a night skyline a plated steak with vegetables is uncovered under a silver cloche. Each time his eyes go wide with amazement.

5322.words: spit (verb): to force water or saliva out of your mouth
5322.asset_description: A man in a dark red T-shirt sits at a kitchen counter and tastes a bowl of green soup. He pulls a face and sticks his tongue out, gulps water from a glass, wipes his mouth with a napkin, drinks from a white mug, and finally spits the soup out of his mouth over the counter.

5367.words: stuff (verb): to cram something into a tight space
5367.asset_description: At an outdoor eating contest a young woman with long braids in a tie-dye shirt tips a plastic cup of water into her mouth, her throat working as she gulps. She then takes a cheeseburger from the tray in front of her and forces bite after bite into her mouth as fast as she can, cheeks bulging, while a crowd behind the barrier claps and cheers. A wide shot shows a whole row of competitors doing the same along a long table.

5388.words: packet (noun): things wrapped together in one package
5388.asset_description: In a living room a tall young man in a band T-shirt holds a big orange packet of crisps high above his head, out of reach, mouth open in mock shock. A young woman in a football kit stretches up and grabs for it; he keeps swinging the packet away and laughing while she circles him. She finally gets both hands on it, walks off with it, and sits on the sofa holding the packet open and eating from it.
5388.transcript: Nope. Was always one step ahead. All good.

51.words: squeeze (verb): to press something firmly together with your hand
51.asset_description: Under a spotlight a hand presses into a flat disc of clear slime packed with colorful water beads, then grabs handfuls and squeezes them again and again so the slime bulges out between the fingers.

343.words: grab (verb): to take hold of something quickly and firmly
343.asset_description: A woman in a pool pulls her mask on, gives a thumbs up and dives; she swims down to a ring lying on the blue tiles, closes her fingers round it and snatches it up, then shoots to the surface holding it above her head.

619.words: lower (verb): to move something down slowly on a rope
619.asset_description: From a rooftop terrace a woman feeds a rope out hand over hand so that a wicker basket sinks slowly down the wall to the narrow street below, where a man waiting in the alley catches it and loads it with oranges.

2704.words: rubble (noun): broken stones left when a building falls
2704.asset_description: A ruined stone wall stands in thick blue fog, its tall doorway filled with blank white light; the ground in front is covered in broken blocks, fallen beams and dead branches.

4029.words: knock (verb): to hit something with a sharp blow
4029.asset_description: Three young men with white blindfolds sit in a row on concrete blocks in a red dirt yard, with a fourth man watching from a chair beside them. A big blue water bottle hangs from a rope above them and is pulled back and released, swinging down the line like a pendulum. It sweeps past the first two and slams into the third man, who is knocked backwards off his block with his legs in the air. He picks himself up and sits back down, and all four laugh.

4032.words: mess (noun): a state of confusion and untidiness
4032.asset_description: Three young men sit at a white table wearing pink sleep masks over their eyes, with a big clear plastic box in front of them. The one on the left lifts a smaller tub and tips a thick stream of bright green slime over the head of the man in the middle. The slime coats his hair and face and hangs down in long strings into the box below. He gropes about, lifts a whole stretched sheet of slime up over his head, and the box, the table and all three of them end up smeared with green goo while the other two shake with laughter.

4063.words: release (verb): to let something go from your grip
4063.asset_description: A man in a dark jacket and jeans hangs from two red webbing straps clipped to a harness across his chest, suspended in the air high above an unbroken sea of golden clouds at sunrise. He looks down between his boots. The straps let him go and he drops straight away from the camera, shrinking to a small dark speck against the cloud layer. The camera keeps looking down as he disappears into the clouds, and at the end a pale ledge slides into the bottom of the frame.

4091.words: crack (verb): to break on the surface without falling apart
4091.asset_description: A woman in a cream fleece jacket, white trousers and a cream beanie walks across the glassy black ice of a frozen lake, her reflection sharp beneath her feet. She opens a steel thermos, unscrews the cup, and pours steaming dark tea onto the ice. The hot liquid spreads across the surface and stains it brown. The camera looks straight down as fine white lines shoot out from the spot in every direction, until the ice is covered by a wide star of cracks under her feet.

4119.words: collapse (verb): to break down or fall apart
4119.asset_description: A misty beach at dawn, with dark pine trees on the shore and driftwood and seaweed on the wet sand. A figure has been built out of balanced grey and green beach stones: two stone legs, a rounded stone body, outstretched stone arms and a small stone head, standing on the wet sand with its reflection under it. It stands still for several seconds. Then one arm drops away, the head tips off, and the whole stack falls in on itself until nothing is left but a low heap of pebbles lying in the shallow water with the same trees and fog behind.

4185.asset_description: On a yellow woven placemat in a kitchen sits a small grey crocheted mouse with white eyes, pink ears, pink feet and a long pink tail. A hand lowers a white ceramic mug onto the mouse's back and lets go. The mug's weight pushes the mouse's body flat so that only its head, feet and tail stick out from under it, and the mug stands there like it is resting on a coaster. Behind it a plate of waffles with raspberries stands on the table.

4274.words: damage (noun): a change for the worse, harm done
4274.asset_description: In a sunny supermarket car park a white delivery van has run into the back corner of a grey car. The car's rear wing is caved in and the tail light is smashed against the van's bumper. Both drivers, in matching blue work shirts, get out and clutch their heads in dismay, then lean over the car's boot photographing the crushed panel with their phones and filling in a form.

4392.words: fall (noun): a sudden drop from standing up
4392.asset_description: A cartoon park in autumn. A man in a blue jacket and backpack has gone over the back of a wooden bench and is caught upside down in mid-air, arms out and one hand grabbing at a bin. His paper lunch bag and its contents fly out above him, orange leaves swirl around, and a fat pigeon on the back of the bench watches him go down.

4454.words: tip (verb): to cause something to tilt
4454.asset_description: A young man stirs a red bucket of foaming water with a wooden stick beside a car on a drive. The clip cuts to an orchard, where a woman lifts a metal bucket full of red apples, tilts it right over towards the camera and lets the apples pour out and roll all over a wooden picnic table; she then sits behind the scattered fruit and bites into one. In the last scene a man kneels on a beach, turns a striped bucket upside down onto the sand, lifts it away and leaves a sandcastle standing, then throws his arms up.

4473.words: yell (verb): to give a sudden loud cry
4473.asset_description: A black-and-white rubber-hose cartoon set in a desert. A tall saguaro cactus with a face and a daisy on its head stands on a rock, covered in long sharp spines, looking innocent. Beside it a small round-headed cartoon character in dungarees has just touched it: he holds up one bare hand with spark lines flying off the fingers, his mouth open in a yell and his eyes wide. He is already running away, one shoe flying off and puffs of dust behind his heels, under a blazing sun and desert buttes.

4505.words: backwards (adverb): toward the back or rear
4505.asset_description: A bright cartoon of a small boy who has tipped his chair too far. He is caught mid-fall, leaning back with the blue and yellow chair going over behind him, both front legs off the floor and his trainers kicking up in the air. His eyes and mouth are wide open, his arms fly out to the sides, and motion lines show the chair swinging over. Beside him is the table he was sitting at, a green chair still standing, and a patterned rug on the wooden floor.

4638.words: rubble (noun): broken stones left when a building falls
4638.asset_description: A woman in a white hard hat and yellow high-visibility jacket films herself in front of a brown brick house whose roof has already been torn open. A yellow excavator swings its arm into the top of the house; the roof and the front wall break away and crash down in a cloud of dust. She turns to watch as the house is reduced to a heap of broken bricks and splintered timber, then waves at the camera in front of the ruins.

4666.asset_description: Looking down from a rooftop parapet into the empty concrete courtyard of a multi-storey car park, with a blue ball lying far below. A young man in a black t-shirt leans over the wall holding a green watermelon and lets it go. He grins over the edge and watches it fall. The next shot shows an orange pumpkin bursting apart on the concrete, pulp flung out in a wide star around the point of impact, and then a second impact throws up a thick cloud of grey dust with the broken pumpkin at its centre. He leans over the parapet laughing at the mess below, with the city skyline behind him.

4829.words: chip (noun): a small piece broken off something
4829.asset_description: Close-up of an old wooden surface covered in cracked, blistered cream paint. A hand pushes a wide metal scraper under the paint and small chips and flakes break off and fall away, leaving patches of bare orange wood, and the scraper keeps going until a large area is stripped.
4829.transcript: Wow, you scrape all that old paint right off.

4966.words: split (verb): to separate something into parts
4966.asset_description: A stop-motion style winter scene: a thick white slab of ice hangs over dark water with long icicles under its edge. A hand in a red-and-blue striped mitten presses down on the slab, and the ice separates into two parts along a jagged crack running across it, with small ice crystals and shards flying up. A frozen lake and snow-covered hills sit in the background.

5054.words: lift (verb): to take hold of something and move it
5054.asset_description: Outdoors on a sunny day, a big man in a bright floral shirt swings a heavy duffel bag onto his shoulder, then leans hard into a luggage trolley loaded with three suitcases and a cool box and shoves it along the road. At a silver van he heaves case after case into the boot until it is crammed full, shuts it, and turns to the camera grinning and out of breath.

5100.words: stick (verb): to put or fix something in place
5100.asset_description: A big coloured world map hangs on a wall framed by fairy lights. Four flatmates come to it one after another. A man in a green football shirt presses a small green flag and a square instant print of his face onto the map. A woman in a red jumper with a camera round her neck points at a spot, then pushes her own print and a red flag onto it. A man in a yellow t-shirt reaches up and pushes a yellow flag and a print onto Asia. The camera pans across the map showing four portraits, each held on by a coloured flag, and ends with the four of them squeezed together in front of the map, mouths open, cheering at the camera.

5121.words: remove (verb): to take something off or out by lifting it
5121.asset_description: A woman in a white t-shirt bends down in a white kitchen and opens the oven door on a tray of golden muffins under the oven light. She reaches in and lifts the baking tray out, smiling at it. Cut to a man in a dark jumper in a wooden kitchen who opens the oven on a whole roast turkey and slides the roasting tin out towards himself. Finally a baker in a white coat and apron in a bakery draws a long wooden peel out of a deck oven and turns to the camera holding a board of six big fresh loaves.

5172.words: bang (verb): to hit something hard and violently
5172.asset_description: A rustic farm-shop kitchen with shelves of jars and crates of fruit. A young man in an apron slams both palms down onto a round of bread dough on a floured table. Then a pair of hands drives a heavy stone pestle down again and again into a mortar full of peppercorns and dried chillies. A woman in denim beats a djembe drum hard with her palms, laughing. Another man swings a heavy rubber mallet down onto the dough, and then pounds the pestle into the mortar with both fists.

5179.words: reach (verb): to move your arm forward to touch something
5179.asset_description: A woman in a navy headscarf and lilac sleeves stands beside an open built-in oven that glows orange inside; she carries a metal tray of pale dough balls over, stretches her free hand out toward the open oven to feel the heat, then slides the tray onto the rack and closes the door.

5239.words: release (noun): the act of setting someone or something free
5239.asset_description: A charcoal sketch. A young man in a long robe and a checked headscarf strides forward across desert ground with his gloved arm thrown up and out. A falcon is lifting off his glove, wings fully open, its leash swinging loose from his hand. A pickup truck waits on the sand behind him.

5297.words: ruin (noun): a state of total destruction
5297.asset_description: A woman with a backpack walks up a cobbled path to a hilltop castle that has fallen apart - roofless stone shells, broken walls and empty window holes standing against a sunrise. She stops among the broken walls and throws both arms open. The clip then cuts to her at a railing above a mountain lake, and finally to her leaning over the side of a wooden boat drifting through a narrow gorge, trailing her hand in the turquoise water.

5380.words: take (verb): to get something into your hands
5380.asset_description: A cardboard box with FREE STUFF written on the side stands on a low garden wall in a quiet suburban street. A cyclist in a racing jersey and helmet reaches in and lifts a table lamp out of it. A bearded man in a hoodie reaches in and lifts out an American football. An elderly woman with a walking stick lifts out a terracotta plant pot. Finally a young man with a backpack looks into the empty box, picks up the box itself and carries it away down the pavement.

5386.words: tear (verb): to separate something by pulling it apart
5386.asset_description: A woman in a grey suit stands at the head of a glass boardroom table, a row of men in suits seated on both sides. She holds a printed contract up in front of her and rips it in half, then drops a thick stack of paper onto the table and pulls sheet after sheet apart, letting the pieces fall. The table ends up covered in torn and crumpled paper. She walks out past a framed contract on an easel while the seated men stare.

5436.words: twist (verb): to move in a twisting motion
5436.asset_description: A run of short kitchen clips, each one showing hands turning something round on itself. A woman grips a soaked blue cloth with both fists and twists it in opposite directions over the sink until the water runs out of it; a pair of hands twists the metal lid off a jar of pickles; hands twist a rope of pale dough over on itself on a floured worktop; a young woman twists a long braid of dough while a friend watches; finally six teenagers line up along the counter, take hold of one enormous rope of dough and twist it together until flour bursts into the air.

5476.words: debris (noun): the bits left when something is destroyed
5476.asset_description: A photograph of a destroyed street in daylight. A woman in a dusty beige utility vest and dark trousers walks towards the camera over a slope of broken concrete, carrying a bundle of grey blankets pressed against her chest; her face and clothes are grey with dust. On both sides stand bombed concrete buildings with their fronts torn open and their floors collapsing, a burnt-out car sits on the left, and pale smoke drifts down the street. The whole foreground is a field of smashed concrete blocks, twisted steel reinforcing rods, broken cables and dust.

70.words: barber (noun): a person who cuts men's hair and beards
70.asset_description: In a Pixar-style barbershop a client sits with a giant afro and huge beard; the moustached barber trims it all with clippers, comb and scissors, then shows the neat new cut in a hand mirror and the delighted client admires himself.
70.transcript: Short on the sides, please. Say no more. Whoa! I look great!

398.words: hygiene (noun): keeping your body clean to stay healthy
398.asset_description: A boy in green pajamas goes through his bathroom routine: he brushes his teeth at the mirror, rinses his mouth, lathers his hands with soap, washes his face, dries off with a white towel and gives a happy thumbs up.

660.words: basin (noun): a wide round bowl you fill with water for washing
660.asset_description: A big white enamel basin stands on a wooden stool in a garden and everything happens over it: a woman leans her head down into it, her friend washes her hair above the water, the soapy water collects inside, and at the end a can of clean water is poured over her hair back into the basin.

874.words: wig (noun): false hair you wear on your head
874.asset_description: At a vanity mirror a young woman lifts a pink bob of fake hair off a white mannequin head and pulls it on over her own hair, striking poses. Her friend then claps a curly ginger one onto his shaved head and they both mug for the mirror.
874.transcript: Oh! A whole new me! And off it comes!

1806.words: bun (noun): hair twisted into a round knot on the head
1806.asset_description: A girl in a light blue hoodie is seen from behind, her dark hair parted and tied up into two round buns on top of her head.

1948.words: wavy (adjective): forming soft curves instead of lying straight
1948.asset_description: A romantic painterly portrait of a bare-shouldered young woman with closed eyes whose enormous wavy brown hair swirls around her whole body, dotted with tiny leaves and vines, against a golden cloudy sky.

1959.words: braid (noun): hair woven into one plaited strand
1959.asset_description: A painterly portrait of a young woman with windblown red hair wrapped in a flowing blue shawl; a long thick braid hangs over her shoulder down to her waist.

1979.words: dye (verb): to change the colour of hair or cloth
1979.asset_description: A portrait of a young woman with extremely long wavy purple hair flowing down past her chest, wearing a purple-and-green pirate hat with a small skull on it.

2150.words: ponytail (noun): hair tied back so it hangs like a tail
2150.asset_description: Side profile of a young woman with her brown hair tied up in a ponytail, standing at a tall window and gazing out over a wide green landscape at sunset, gear straps on her shoulder.

2162.asset_description: A close portrait of a young woman with long, glossy ginger hair styled in vintage waves and bright blue eyes, wearing a white blouse in front of a painted backdrop of yellow flowers.

2626.words: bald (adjective): having no hair on the head
2626.asset_description: A surreal painting of a completely bald human head in profile whose smooth skull and neck dissolve into a glowing night city and floating planets, with clouds and a sunset behind.

2629.words: pigtails (noun): hair tied in two bunches, one each side
2629.asset_description: A cartoon-style little girl with huge green eyes, two long braided pigtails and a mint bow lies on a bed and looks up from an open picture book, freckles scattered across her nose and cheeks.

2686.words: brunette (noun): a girl or woman with brown hair
2686.asset_description: A softly painted head-and-shoulders portrait of a young woman with very long, thick brown wavy hair catching warm golden light, pale blue eyes, and a light blue knit sweater, against a mottled blue background.

2688.words: dreadlocks (noun): long ropes of twisted hair
2688.asset_description: A watercolour full-body painting of a bearded African man standing barefoot in a tall feathered headdress, layered patchwork robes and beaded necklaces, with long dreadlocks hanging past his chest, against splashed washes of orange and green.

2740.words: moustache (noun): the hair a man grows on his upper lip
2740.asset_description: A muscular crowned figure with a thick white moustache and beard rides a large ram with curled horns past carved temple pillars, holding the animal's horn with one hand while dust and a crowd fill the background.

2826.words: ribbon (noun): a narrow strip of cloth tied in a bow
2826.asset_description: A storybook-style painting of a wide-eyed girl in round blue-and-yellow glasses holding a big open orange book, her dark hair tied up on top of her head with a bright yellow cloth bow.

3598.words: curly (adjective): growing in curls instead of straight
3598.asset_description: Blue ballpoint-pen drawing on cream paper of a young woman with big eyes and a thick mass of curly shoulder-length hair with a fringe, surrounded by small drawn leaves and hearts.

4130.words: flat (adjective): having a level surface with no slope
4130.asset_description: A bright marble barber's shop with lit mirrors and shelves of bottles. A gorilla sits in the barber's chair under a black cape, with an enormous round afro standing out around its head. A ginger cat in a white barber's coat and a red bow tie stands on the arm of the chair and runs a pair of electric clippers up the side of the afro, cutting a clean line into it. Clumps of black hair drop onto the cape. The cat works its way round, then swaps to scissors and trims across the top, and what is left is a squared-off block of hair with a perfectly level top, like a table top on the gorilla's head. The gorilla looks straight ahead, unimpressed, while the cat finishes and gives a small nod of approval.

4808.words: braid (noun): hair woven into one plaited strand
4808.asset_description: In a salon a stylist combs out a client's very long glossy black hair, then weaves a thick braid along the top of her head and down through the length of the hair; at the end the client stands up and swings the hair, which reaches almost to the floor, with the finished braid running over the crown.

4946.words: ponytail (noun): hair tied back so it hangs like a tail
4946.asset_description: A young woman in a cropped brown hoodie and matching sweatpants stands at the wooden barre of a mirrored dance studio, her long hair tied back in a ponytail that swings as she moves. She holds the barre and laughs, turns to face the mirrored wall, then drops to the floor into a low crouch with one leg extended, springs up into a jump with her knees tucked, spins with her back to the mirror, and finishes facing the camera out of breath and smiling.

5175.words: moustache (noun): the hair a man grows on his upper lip
5175.asset_description: In a busy restaurant a waiter with a thick black moustache, in a white shirt and dark apron, sets down a glass, then lifts a metal pot high above his head and pours a long thin stream of tea into a small tulip glass on the table without spilling, and finally lowers the pot and looks up.

5196.words: bun (noun): hair twisted into a round knot on the head
5196.asset_description: A young woman with glasses and her blonde hair twisted up into a round knot on top of her head stands reading a paperback in a moving tram, city buildings sliding past the windows. She then sits cross-legged on a park bench in autumn sunshine, the same knot of hair on top, reading and yawning behind her hand. In the last shots she is under a blanket in the dark with a single candle burning beside the open book, eyes wide behind her glasses, then grinning as she reads on.

5316.words: curly (adjective): growing in curls instead of straight
5316.asset_description: A young woman in a red dress with a backpack twirls under tiled arches beside a fountain. She then sits close to the camera at a bar counter with a glass of red wine, a plate of thin cured ham and a dish of fried potatoes; her thick dark hair grows in tight rings and springs around her face as she leans in, laughs and drinks. The clip ends on a mosaic rooftop terrace at sunset with her arms thrown open over the city.

174.words: clinic (noun): a small medical center you visit without staying
174.asset_description: A mother and her small son enter a health clinic, check in with the smiling receptionist at the desk, and wait on yellow chairs next to an old man with a cane until a doctor in a white coat opens the door and calls the boy in.

204.words: crutch (noun): a stick under the arm that helps you walk
204.asset_description: In a hospital corridor, a teenage boy with a grey medical boot on one foot walks on two metal crutches while nurses watch behind him; he gets faster and finishes with a happy little fist pump.

233.words: dislocate (verb): to push a bone out of its normal place in a joint
233.asset_description: In a hand-painted anime scene, a shirtless climber in a green helmet collapses onto a grassy hillside after a fall, grimacing and clutching his shoulder. A worried woman kneels beside him, touching the hurt arm as he winces in pain and holds the joint.

248.words: dropper (noun): a small glass tube with a bulb for giving drops
248.asset_description: In an animated old apothecary, a woman squeezes the bulb of a glass dropper, draws up liquid and counts three drops into a wooden spoon. She hands the dose to a red-bearded man wrapped in a blanket, who takes it and immediately looks better.
248.transcript: One. Two. Steady. Three drops. That's enough. But better already.

366.words: heal (verb): to become healthy again after an injury
366.asset_description: An animated woman in a red tracksuit unwraps a bandage from her forearm, opens and closes her hand to test it, then happily reaches up to gymnastic rings and pumps her fist because the arm has healed.

760.words: swell (verb): to grow bigger and puffy after an injury
760.asset_description: In a Pixar-style park scene a jogger hobbles to a bench, pulls off his sock, and watches his hurt ankle balloon into a huge round lump; he gasps, pokes it, and presses a blue ice pack on the swelling.

761.words: swelling (noun): a puffed-up part of the body after injury
761.asset_description: A young woman sits on a couch with her feet up; one foot and ankle are visibly red and puffy compared to the other. A shocked man points at the swollen foot and presses an ice pack onto it while she winces.

772.words: therapy (noun): treatment by talking to a professional
772.asset_description: A tearful young woman hugs a pillow in an armchair and talks to a grey-haired therapist who listens with a notebook. She cries, takes a tissue, gradually starts smiling, and leaves the session relieved, shaking the therapist's hand.

929.words: bandage (noun): a strip of soft cloth wrapped around a wound
929.asset_description: A young athlete sits on a gym bench and wraps a white gauze bandage around his chalky hand, holding the roll between his teeth to pull it tight.

949.words: blister (noun): a small bubble of skin filled with liquid
949.asset_description: On a forest trail one hiker holds her friend's bare foot and inspects a blister on the heel; the hiking boot and sock lie on the rock below.

962.words: bruise (noun): a dark purple mark left after a hit
962.asset_description: A football player sits on the night-time pitch grimacing as she pulls down her sock, a large purple bruise showing on her knee while a teammate looks on.

984.words: cast (noun): a hard cover that holds a broken bone still
984.asset_description: Close-up of two hands in blue medical gloves smoothing wet white plaster around a patient's forearm and hand over a steel tray; water drips from the fresh cast.

1093.words: fracture (noun): a break or crack in a bone
1093.asset_description: A finger points at a jagged dark crack running through a leg bone on a backlit X-ray image.

1147.words: infection (noun): a sore red swelling caused by germs
1147.asset_description: In an exam room, a doctor in a white coat points at a red, swollen patch on an older patient's elbow while explaining it to him.

1148.words: injection (noun): medicine put into the body with a needle
1148.asset_description: A nurse in blue scrubs and gloves hands a doctor a metal tray holding a syringe, a medicine vial and cotton balls, ready for a shot.

1299.words: scan (noun): a medical picture of the inside of your body
1299.asset_description: A smiling patient lies inside the ring of a large white CT scanner and gives a thumbs-up, while a technician waves from behind the control-room window.

1360.words: stethoscope (noun): the tool a doctor uses to listen to your heart
1360.asset_description: A doctor in blue scrubs presses the chest-piece of a coiled stethoscope to a man's chest and holds a finger to her lips, asking for silence while she listens.

1362.words: stitch (noun): a small loop of thread that closes a wound
1362.asset_description: A watercolor illustration of gloved hands using a curved needle and thread to sew a row of stitches into a cut on a patient's forearm, scissors and a metal tray nearby.

1381.words: syringe (noun): a tube with a needle used to inject medicine
1381.asset_description: A black-and-white comic-style illustration of a hand in a lab coat holding a syringe upright, squirting a thin jet of dark liquid from the needle. The other hand steadies a small medicine vial over a metal tray, with window blinds casting noir shadows.

1447.words: vaccine (noun): an injection that protects you from a disease
1447.asset_description: A claymation woman in a patterned sweater winces with one eye shut as a blue-gloved hand gives her an injection in the upper arm; a cart with vials stands behind her.

1451.words: vitamin (noun): a substance in food that keeps you healthy
1451.asset_description: A laughing woman in sportswear holds an orange gummy vitamin up in a bright kitchen while someone hands her the open jar; oranges, kiwis and berries cover the counter in front of her.

1477.words: x ray (noun): a photo of the inside of the body showing bones
1477.asset_description: A doctor with glasses stands in a dark clinic room and points at an X-ray image of a hand displayed on a bright lightbox on the wall.

3027.words: to heal (verb): to make a sick or hurt person well again
3027.asset_description: An oil-style painting of a long-haired man in robes gently touching the eyes of a kneeling old man with mud from a small bowl, while four bearded onlookers in headscarves watch from behind in a sandy village.

4411.words: treatment (noun): medical care given to help someone get better
4411.asset_description: High on a rocky mountain path with snow peaks behind her, a hiker with a big backpack limps to a rock and sits down, pulling off her boot. She rolls the sock down to show a raised, shiny blister on the back of her heel. Her companion crouches beside her, digs a plaster out of his pack and passes it to her; she peels it open and presses it carefully over the blister before easing the sock and boot back on.

4546.words: surgery (noun): a room where you see a doctor or dentist
4546.asset_description: A soft watercolour of a doctor's consulting room. A doctor in a white coat with a stethoscope round her neck stands with her back to us, one hand on a boy's knee. The boy sits on a green examination couch with his sleeve pushed up, holding his upper arm. Behind them are a cream cabinet with a tray of pens and papers, a blank framed notice on the wall and a potted plant. A blood-pressure cuff and its bulb lie on the counter in the foreground. Through the open door a woman and a small girl in yellow wait on chairs outside.

4547.words: waiting room (noun): a room with seats where people wait
4547.asset_description: A mother and her teenage son with a grey backpack walk up to a small pink and turquoise clinic with a blue cross sign over the door and go in. Inside they stop at a reception counter, where the boy presses a bell on the countertop. They then sit down on yellow plastic chairs against the wall. Beside them an elderly man waits with both hands on a walking stick; a low table in front of them holds magazines. Notices and certificates cover the wall and a round clock hangs above. A doctor in a white coat appears in the corridor doorway and they get up.

4648.words: examine (verb): to check someone's body for signs of illness
4648.asset_description: An illustration of a consulting room in which a woman in a white coat crouches in front of a small boy sitting on the examination couch. She holds the disc of her stethoscope against his chest and rests her other hand on his head while she listens; the boy holds a teddy bear and looks worried. Behind them are an eye chart, a shapes chart, a lamp and a glass cabinet of bottles; a reflex hammer and a lollipop lie on a metal tray in front.

4649.words: teddy (noun): a child's toy bear, plush and stuffed
4649.asset_description: An illustration of a small boy in a striped jumper and jeans sitting on a green examination couch, hugging a brown plush teddy bear against his chest with both arms. A man in a white coat leans over him and holds a stethoscope to the boy's chest while resting a hand on his head. In the room there is a glass cabinet of medicine bottles, a fern on top of it, and a second stethoscope, a lollipop and instruments on the counter in front.

4664.words: dose (noun): a measured portion of medicine taken at one time
4664.asset_description: A woman in a mint green jumper holds a glass pipette full of golden yellow oil over a tall glass of water on a kitchen counter. She squeezes the bulb and small yellow beads fall one at a time from the tip into the water, where they hang and sink as little spheres. She keeps counting them out, and the oil spreads into yellow swirls through the glass. She screws the pipette back into its brown bottle, lifts the glass, and drinks the cloudy yellow water by the window.

4740.words: wound (noun): a cut or open injury on the skin
4740.asset_description: A grey, overcast roadside scene drawn in comic style. A young man in a beanie and fingerless gloves kneels on the cracked tarmac and holds the forearm of a second person who is sitting in front of him wearing a cycling helmet and torn trousers. The second person's elbow and forearm are grazed open and bleeding red. The kneeling man holds up a sterile wipe packet he has just torn open; the empty wrapper flies away in the air behind him. An open green first-aid tin sits on the ground with rolls of gauze, plasters and scissors spilling out of it, a loose bandage roll unwinding across the tarmac. A bicycle lies on its side in the background and a figure watches from a distance.

4755.words: fracture (noun): a break or crack in a bone
4755.asset_description: In a clinic a doctor in a white coat stands at a lit X-ray viewer showing the bones of a hand and wrist. She points a pen at a thin dark line running across one of the bones. The young man beside her leans in and looks at the line on the film. He then sits back with his forearm in a thick white plaster cast held up in a blue sling, winces, and holds the casted arm against his chest.
4755.transcript: I'll show you this. Oh, I see.

4925.words: care (verb): to look after someone who needs care
4925.asset_description: A nurse in teal scrubs pushes a supply trolley down a bright hospital corridor while colleagues wave at her. At a bedside she holds a forehead thermometer to a middle-aged male patient's temple and reads it. She shakes out his pillow and slides it back behind his head, and he laughs. In close-up she winds a white bandage around his wrist above the drip line. Finally she holds up a small bottle of juice for him and he grins back at her.

4981.words: vaccine (noun): an injection that protects you from a disease
4981.asset_description: In a bright clinic room a queue of young people wait their turn. A young man pulls his sleeve up and grins over his shoulder while a syringe goes into his upper arm, then shows the round plaster stuck on the spot; a young woman in a black top takes hers the same way and points at her plaster; a woman in glasses gets her injection next; at the end the whole group lines up facing the camera and taps the plasters on their bare arms.
4981.transcript: Tiny pitch. Done. Ow, not bad. Brave. Yay!

5072.words: liquid (noun): a substance that is liquid, not solid or gas
5072.asset_description: A painted illustration: a pale woman wrapped in a green and red checked cardigan sits up at a bedside table while a second pair of hands tips a brown glass bottle and pours a thick brown liquid into a metal measuring spoon she is holding. A drop is falling from the spoon; a white mug and a folded blanket stand on the wooden table beside her.

5111.words: nurse (verb): to care for someone who is ill
5111.asset_description: A soft cartoon hospital room. A smiling woman in pink scrubs and a white cap, a thermometer tucked behind her ear and a clipboard under one arm, leans over a hospital bed in white gloves and adjusts the pillow of a small child who lies under a yellow blanket with a spotted rash on the arms and face. A drip bag hangs on a stand beside the bed, and a vase with a daisy and a glass of water stand on the bedside table.

5120.words: surgeon (noun): a doctor who does surgery
5120.asset_description: A team in blue scrubs, caps, masks and white gloves stands around a draped patient on an operating table under a large round surgical lamp. One of them leans over the opening in the drapes and works with instruments while the others hold retractors. A woman looks up at the camera as a scalpel is passed hand to hand over a metal tray; a heart monitor beside the table shows the pulse trace and the numbers 190, 20 and 99. The team keeps working around the table, then all of them look up at the camera and give a thumbs up.

5150.words: prescription (noun): directions a doctor writes down beforehand
5150.asset_description: A young man in a dark red bomber jacket walks into a small pharmacy past a lit green cross. At the counter he holds out a folded white slip of paper to the pharmacist in a white coat, who reads it, turns to the wall of medicine boxes behind her and picks out the packet the paper asks for. She comes back and hands him the medicine across the glass counter, and he takes it and smiles.

5320.words: demonstrate (verb): to show something to an audience
5320.asset_description: In a bright clinic a physiotherapist holds up a model of the human spine and shows it to a young man in a grey T-shirt, moving her finger along the vertebrae. She then points at his lower back, has him raise his arms and stretch, and he turns to the camera smiling.

5451.words: injection (noun): medicine put into the body with a needle
5451.asset_description: In a bright clinic waiting room a nurse in a white coat holds up a small glass vial and shows it to a young man in a green t-shirt sitting on a chair. She swabs his upper arm and pushes the needle of a syringe into it while he watches and smiles. A round plaster is stuck on the spot, and he stands up and flexes his bicep proudly while other patients wait in the background.

5458.words: vitamin (noun): a substance in food that keeps you healthy
5458.asset_description: In a bright kitchen a young woman in a grey sports top tips an orange jar labelled with a vitamin label and shakes a large white tablet into her palm. She drops the tablet into a tall glass of water on the counter; it fizzes hard, filling the glass with bubbles until the water turns bright orange. She stares at the glass with wide eyes, then lifts it, drinks, and pulls a satisfied face. A bowl of oranges and kiwis sits beside her.

5494.words: disabled (adjective): having a condition that limits what you can do
5494.asset_description: A soft watercolour illustration: a young man in a green jacket and patched brown corduroy trousers sits in a wheelchair and drives it forward himself, gripping the hand rim of the big spoked wheel, which is blurred with motion. A girl in a knitted scarf runs laughing beside him with her arms out. Autumn leaves fall around them onto a leaf-covered path; behind them are yellow trees and an old stone arch bridge.

106.words: aim (verb): to point a weapon carefully at your target
106.asset_description: In a mountain village field a young archer holds a tall bamboo bow at full draw, one eye down the shaft, holding steady on a distant hay bale for most of the clip before he lets the arrow go and follows its flight.

117.words: mosaic (noun): a picture made of small tiles set side by side
117.asset_description: In a pottery studio a couple smash a cloth-wrapped stack of plates with a mallet, then a man in gloves picks the flat shards out of the cloth and presses them one by one into a clay square, building a flower pattern; at the end the pair hold up the finished tiled panel.

217.words: dart (noun): a small pointed arrow you throw at a round board
217.asset_description: In a wood-paneled game room, a red-haired woman squints, aims and throws a turquoise dart; it flies across the room and sticks near the bullseye of the dartboard, and she cheers with her friends.

263.words: emerge (verb): to come into view from inside or under something
263.asset_description: A calm hand-painted mountain lake lies still until a splash breaks the surface and a swimmer in a teal cap and goggles bursts up out of the water. She lifts her goggles, grins and throws her arms up in triumph.

361.words: wrap (verb): to cover something in paper or material
361.asset_description: Top-down view of hands wrapping lollipops in pink and cream paper to look like flower buds, drawing a smiley face on one, then wrapping the whole bunch in white paper and tying a ribbon to finish a mini candy bouquet.

377.words: perform (verb): to sing, dance or play in front of people
377.asset_description: In a smoky blue-lit studio with a drum kit, amps and graffiti, a young woman in a crop top and baggy jeans performs for the camera: she sings, dances, points at the lens, plays the drums and poses on a leather couch like in a music video.

397.words: hunting (noun): following and trying to catch wild animals
397.asset_description: In an autumn forest a man and a woman in camouflage examine fresh deer tracks in the mud with their hunting dog, sneak behind a mossy log, scan the trees with binoculars and excitedly spot a stag standing among the leaves.
397.transcript: Fresh this morning. There, look at her.

548.words: photography (noun): the activity of taking pictures with a camera
548.asset_description: At golden hour in a narrow cobblestone street, a young woman directs a man posing against a sunlit wall, shoots him with a large camera, then the two lean over the camera screen together, pointing at the shots and celebrating the best one.
548.transcript: Three, two, hold! That one! That one!

845.asset_description: On a black-sand beach an animated girl draws a big spiral in the wet sand with a stick. A wave rolls in and the whole drawing vanishes without a trace; she gasps, draws it again, and the sea erases it again.

944.words: binoculars (noun): double lenses for seeing far-away things
944.asset_description: A wind-blown man on a mountain viewpoint holds a pair of black binoculars at his chest, a hazy valley with a river winding far below him.

996.words: clay (noun): soft wet earth shaped and baked into pots
996.asset_description: Close-up of muddy hands shaping a wet clay pot on a spinning potter's wheel, fingers smoothing the rim.

1096.words: gallery (noun): a room where art is shown to the public
1096.asset_description: A young woman in a long grey coat walks through a bright white museum hall, glancing back at the camera, with large abstract paintings hung along the wall and other visitors in the distance.

1427.words: to balance (verb): to keep your body steady so you don't fall
1427.asset_description: A man with climbing harness and carabiners walks along a thin rope stretched between two cliffs high above a valley, one chalk-covered hand raised for balance.

1438.words: podcast (noun): a talk show you record and stream online
1438.asset_description: A man in a blazer and studio headphones leans toward a professional microphone on a boom arm in a small acoustic-panelled studio, tennis courts visible outside the window.

1458.words: walker (noun): someone who walks for exercise or pleasure
1458.asset_description: An older man with trekking poles and a backpack strides up a gravel coastal path in the sunshine, a golden retriever carrying a stick trotting beside him.

1535.words: upside down (adverb): with the top part at the bottom
1535.asset_description: A grunge digital artwork of a shirtless breakdancer in jeans balancing upside down on one hand, legs kicked up into the air, with glowing outlines around his body.

1609.words: ballet (noun): the classical dance with graceful poses
1609.asset_description: The black silhouette of a ballerina balances on one pointed foot on a rock in calm water, arms and leg extended, with a crescent moon and a bird in the blue sky; her figure reflects in the ripples.

1717.words: instrument (noun): an object you play to make music
1717.asset_description: Soft watercolor of a single violin with four strings standing upright against a pale textured background.

1777.asset_description: A mixed-media illustration of a man in a wide hat and denim jacket looking down as he plays a banjo, with an orange paint splash on the wooden wall behind him.

1799.words: cello (noun): a large string instrument played sitting down
1799.asset_description: A vintage poster of four string-instrument silhouettes rising in size from small violins to a large dark cello, set over a background of old sheet music.

1833.words: lean (verb): to rest your body sideways on something
1833.asset_description: A cartoon boy in a lavender sweater sits under a starry night sky with a full moon and leans his head gently against an acoustic guitar standing beside him.

1854.words: string (noun): one of the thin wires you pluck on a guitar
1854.asset_description: A blue acoustic guitar painted on a black background, its white strings running down the long neck, with paint splatter and hand-drawn music notes floating beside it.

1915.words: bass (noun): the biggest string instrument, deepest sound
1915.asset_description: A watercolor-style image of an upright double bass with four strings and orange-brown wood, paint drips running off it.

2033.words: whirlpool (noun): water that spins round and pulls things down
2033.asset_description: A psychedelic painting of a blue electric guitar standing upright in a spinning whirlpool of dark water; fiery orange clouds and light beams blaze in the starry sky behind it.

2070.words: electric guitar (noun): a guitar that needs an amplifier to be heard
2070.asset_description: An electric guitar stands upright like a launching rocket, its neck shooting a beam of light into a blue starry sky while fiery orange clouds boil around its body.

2185.words: pianist (noun): a person who plays the piano
2185.asset_description: A vivid palette-knife painting of a young woman in a white dress with long blonde hair sitting on a stool, leaning over the keys of a black grand piano against a fiery orange background.

2195.words: watercolor (noun): water-based paint, and pictures made with it
2195.asset_description: A dreamy watercolor portrait of a young woman's face with soft washes, splashes and drips of pink, blue and orange bleeding out of her hair into the white paper.

2310.words: melody (noun): a line of musical notes that makes a tune
2310.asset_description: An ornate grand piano stands among dark clouds while a huge golden swirl of glowing liquid music rises from its open lid into a starry sky.

2350.words: carve (verb): to cut a shape into something hard
2350.asset_description: Three pumpkins with faces carved into them glow orange on the ground in front of a foggy grey haunted house at dusk, with bats flying above.

2388.words: gamer (noun): a person who plays video games a lot
2388.asset_description: A photoreal girl with long wavy pink hair lounges sideways in a big pink gaming chair wearing large white headphones, a white jacket and torn white tights, in a room full of pink decor.

2432.words: flamenco (noun): a fiery Spanish dance with fans and stamping
2432.asset_description: A dancer in a black top and red skirt strikes a dramatic flamenco pose, one arm raised high holding a red fan, while her legs fade into an unfinished pencil sketch.

2470.words: saxophone (noun): a curved metal wind instrument used in jazz
2470.asset_description: A shiny blue-toned saxophone floats upright against a dark background of swirling pink and blue smoke, its keys and curved bell catching the light.

2471.words: bookworm (noun): a person who reads all the time
2471.asset_description: A black-and-white ink drawing of a young woman with an elaborate curly updo and a bow at her collar, eyes lowered, absorbed in a huge open book; faint handwritten text and vines fill the background.

2493.words: quilt (noun): a warm cover sewn from many pieces of cloth
2493.asset_description: A whole countryside scene, with a farmhouse, pine trees, fields and hills, is sewn as a textured quilt out of stitched pieces of fabric.

2527.words: gas mask (noun): a mask that protects your face from dangerous air
2527.asset_description: A DJ wearing a black gas mask and headphones mixes music on a glowing turntable deck floating in space, with tentacles, planets and vinyl records swirling around him.

2550.words: cross-legged (adverb): sitting with your legs bent and crossed
2550.asset_description: A girl with long black hair sits cross-legged and barefoot among tall wildflowers, eyes closed, holding a big open blue book in her lap.

2581.words: flute (noun): a long thin instrument you blow across
2581.asset_description: A blue-skinned boy with a golden crown of peacock feathers and flowers smiles while playing a bamboo flute held to his lips with both hands.

2595.words: grand piano (noun): a large piano with a big lid that opens up
2595.asset_description: An impressionist painting of a black grand piano with its lid open standing alone on a wet city street at night, glowing buildings and a lit spire reflecting in the pavement.

2603.words: sheet music (noun): printed paper with the notes of a piece
2603.asset_description: A vintage poster shows silhouettes of violins and a cello layered over old handwritten sheet music full of staves and notes.

2618.words: handwriting (noun): words written by hand, not printed
2618.asset_description: An old book lies open on a cloth-covered wooden table, both pages covered in faded cursive handwriting, with a pale peach rose and sprigs of purple lavender resting on top of them.

2657.words: collage (noun): a picture made by gluing torn pieces together
2657.asset_description: A yellow bird with purple wings sits on a thin branch, made from cut and painted paper glued over a background of torn newspaper columns, sheet music and blocks of pink, blue and yellow paint.

2825.words: surrounded (adjective): with things or people on every side of you
2825.asset_description: A flat colourful illustration of a small boy in round glasses sitting cross-legged with an open book on his lap, completely enclosed on every side by walls of stacked red, yellow and blue books.

3061.words: record (noun): a flat black disc that plays music
3061.asset_description: Woodblock-style poster in teal and orange: a woman in a kimono with headphones on and eyes closed floats above a spinning vinyl record on a turntable, her hair and the music swirling into painted waves and clouds.

3082.words: ballerina (noun): a girl who dances ballet on her toes
3082.asset_description: Simple cartoon of a girl in a black leotard and pink skirt balancing on the tip of one pointe shoe with her arms raised, in a dance studio with a mirror and a barre.

3256.words: band (noun): a group of people who play music together
3256.asset_description: Cartoon of four young men playing a gig on a small club stage: a singer leans back with a microphone, a guitarist jumps in the air, another plays a red electric guitar and a drummer swings his sticks, under coloured lights and party bulbs.

3406.words: to dive (verb): to go down under the water head first
3406.asset_description: Half-above, half-below water picture of a tropical bay with palm trees and bright sun; under the surface a scuba diver with an air tank, mask and yellow fins swims over a rocky reef while a huge long-necked sea reptile glides past in the blue water.

3419.words: trumpet (noun): a brass instrument you blow into
3419.asset_description: Retro flat-colour poster of a man in a green jacket lifting a big golden brass horn to his lips and blowing into it; the wide bell of the instrument fills the top of the picture against an orange sky.

3420.words: double bass (noun): the biggest string instrument, played standing
3420.asset_description: Bold geometric poster of a woman with tied-back hair standing beside a huge red-and-blue string instrument that reaches above her head; one hand presses the strings on the neck while the other draws a long bow across them.

3422.words: orchestra (noun): a big group that plays classical music
3422.asset_description: Angular vector poster of a woman in an orange coat and heels standing on a low podium with a baton raised in one hand and the other hand open, surrounded by cellos, trumpets, trombones, a drum and two music stands.

3423.words: harp (noun): a tall instrument with strings you pluck
3423.asset_description: Flat vector illustration of a woman in a blue and yellow dress sitting on a stool, leaning into a tall decorated harp and plucking its long straight strings, with a pink and blue evening sky behind her.

3424.words: conductor (noun): the person who leads an orchestra on stage
3424.asset_description: Blue-and-gold vector poster seen from behind: a man in a long tailcoat stands with both arms spread wide, a thin baton in his right hand, while a row of golden violins, a harp and brass horns is played in front of him.

3428.words: violin (noun): a small string instrument played with a bow
3428.asset_description: Warm vector illustration of a woman in a long orange and blue dress with flowing hair, eyes closed, holding a violin under her chin and drawing the bow across the strings against a sunset-coloured background.

3431.words: clarinet (noun): a long black wind instrument with keys
3431.asset_description: Vector poster of a woman in a striped blue and orange dress standing on a round stage, head tilted back and eyes closed, blowing into a long black clarinet held up in both hands as painted sound waves ripple from its top.

3463.words: canoe (noun): a narrow boat you move with a paddle
3463.asset_description: Silhouette illustration of a man paddling a long narrow canoe across still water at sunset, the orange sun and its long reflection right behind him.

3633.words: to float (verb): to stay on top of water without sinking
3633.asset_description: Illustration of a quiet indoor swimming pool on a space station. An astronaut in a suit and helmet lies on his back on the still water with his arms spread out, drifting, while a huge ringed planet fills the window behind the pool.

3706.words: rollercoaster (noun): a fast fairground ride with steep drops
3706.asset_description: Flat cartoon of a mother, father, boy and girl sitting in a rollercoaster car gripping the safety bar, mouths wide open, with looping track, a big wheel and fair tents behind them.

4031.words: top (adjective): at the top or highest position
4031.asset_description: Three young men stand behind a blue ping-pong table in a games room, staring at a plastic bottle in front of them with two tennis balls balanced one on top of the other on its neck. One of them throws a third tennis ball, which arcs up over the table. It comes down and lands on the very top of the stack without knocking it over, so that three balls now sit in a column on the bottle. All three throw their arms up and shout in celebration.

4062.asset_description: A head-mounted point-of-view shot from a kitesurfer riding on a shallow lagoon at sunset. Two bare forearms reach forward into the frame and both hands close around the horizontal control bar of a kite, the lines running up out of shot. The orange sun sits low over a line of palm trees on the far shore and other kites are visible as small shapes in the purple sky. The rider leans back, the board carves and white spray sheets up across the lens, and the shot ends with the red kite canopy overhead as he skims across the water.

4069.words: rod (noun): a long thin bar of metal or wood
4069.asset_description: An animated scene on a wooden dock under a grey sky. A tall white pigeon with long eyelashes stands beside a small scruffy grey and green chick, and the chick holds a thin fishing rod with the line dropping down into the dark water. The camera looks down at the water, where rings spread from the float. A mermaid with long black hair rises out of the sea, a city skyline behind her, smiling with her eyes shut. She lifts the chick in her cupped hands and sets it gently back on the planks. The big white pigeon glares, spreads a wing over the chick and stares the mermaid down.

4070.words: wing (noun): one of the two side parts of an airplane
4070.asset_description: Inside the cramped white cabin of a small aeroplane, several people in swimwear and parachute rigs shuffle barefoot towards the open door. The shot cuts outside: two of them are hanging from the wing strut under the plane's long wing, high above a coastline, with the landing wheel beside them. They hold the strut with both hands, dangling in the wind, then let go one after the other and drop away. The camera stays with the plane, and the frame is filled by the underside of the wing with the blue sea, the white surf line and the flat coastal city far below.

4082.words: upside down (adverb): with the top part at the bottom
4082.asset_description: Filmed from inside the open door of a small plane flying high above a turquoise coral reef. A woman in a white and blue jumpsuit and harness hangs from the wing strut outside the plane, laughing, her legs swinging free in the open air. She swings under the wing, hangs upside down, and then lets go and drops away from the plane, shrinking to a tiny figure against the blue water far below.

4235.words: cast (verb): to put or send something out
4235.asset_description: A barefoot boy in a black t-shirt and blue shorts stands on the grass at the edge of a still lake at sunset. He whips a fishing rod forward over his head and the line arcs far out across the orange water. He follows through and stands watching the line settle, silhouetted against the sky. The shot then cuts to his hands close up, holding the rod and a silver reel wound with turquoise line, with the sunset and the far shore behind.

4295.words: photograph (verb): to take a picture on film or a camera
4295.asset_description: In the desert beside an airport, a man in a grey thobe and keffiyeh with a camera round his neck points up at an airliner coming in over the sand and the perimeter fence; he lifts the camera to his eye and shoots as the green-and-white jet passes low overhead with its gear down, then turns back to the lens grinning as the plane rolls out on the runway behind him.

4334.words: studio (noun): a workplace for practising or teaching an art
4334.asset_description: An oil painting of a bright, cluttered work room. A woman in a paint-spattered white smock stands at a tall wooden easel by a large window, a wooden palette loaded with yellow, blue and red paint balanced on her arm and a brush raised to the canvas. Blank stretched canvases lean in stacks against the walls and the easel, framed paintings hang behind her, jars of brushes stand on a stool and a low table, and squeezed tubes of paint lie on the table beside her.

4395.words: opponent (noun): a contestant you are matched against
4395.asset_description: Four friends sit around a coffee table playing a big fantasy board game covered in coloured miniatures. A woman with red hair leans over the board while the man beside her sips from a can. She reaches across and moves a piece into his territory, and he turns to the camera with his mouth wide open in disbelief while she smiles to herself.

4396.asset_description: A couple sit on a sofa playing a board game with red and blue pieces spread over a map board. He points at the board and talks, drinking from a green can; she quietly reaches over and moves her red pieces. When he looks back at the board his eyes go wide and his mouth drops open, and she sits back with a small satisfied smile while he keeps staring.

4482.words: shoot (verb): to make a film or photograph of something
4482.asset_description: A woman in a beige parka works her way around an old Italian city taking pictures. She first holds up a small white compact camera in front of a pavement flower stall stacked with buckets of tulips and roses. She then stands in a cobbled street below a stone tower with a black DSLR pressed to her face, taking shot after shot. In the last part she is up on a brick rooftop terrace behind a giant telephoto lens on a tripod, aiming it out over a sea of tiled roofs, then turning to the camera with a delighted laugh.

4536.words: craft (noun): the skilled practice of a practical job
4536.asset_description: Close-up of two clay-covered hands shaping a wet pot on a turning potter's wheel. The upper part is already a smooth thrown neck with curled clay handles; the lower part is still a rough lump. Specks of wet clay are flung across the wooden wheel head and the bench. Behind, out of focus, wooden shelves hold rows of finished pots and lumps of raw clay, with wooden tools lying on a bench.

4645.words: attach (verb): to fasten something so it is attached
4645.asset_description: Two hands work over a grey pegboard tray covered in brightly coloured plastic balls and rods. They press a blue ball onto each end of a short rod to make a dumbbell shape, drop a red ball into a green cup piece, and push finished pieces down into the holes of the tray. At the end they lift a tall column of balls and rods that have been joined end to end, with more joined shapes standing on the tray below.

4705.words: band (noun): a group of people who play music together
4705.asset_description: A sunlit colonial town square. A woman in a denim jacket films herself smiling and clapping while behind her a group of musicians in matching pale blue shirts play guitars and a tuba beside a stone fountain. A young waiter in a bow tie and apron carries a tray of glasses out of an archway and waves at the camera. The shot pulls back higher and higher: families, a policeman and small children gather in a ring around the players, and the whole plaza with its church tower and yellow and red buildings comes into view under a bright blue sky.

4762.words: gallery (noun): a room where art is shown to the public
4762.asset_description: A man carrying a leather briefcase walks through a doorway into a narrow white room hung with small framed drawings. He moves on into a larger white hall where other visitors stand in front of sculptures on plinths, and tips his head back to look up at a big block-coloured abstract canvas. The last shots put him alone in a vast glass-roofed hall, walking towards an enormous painting on the far wall and spreading his arms in front of it.

4763.words: gamer (noun): a person who plays video games a lot
4763.asset_description: A young man slouches on a sofa with a controller, playing a racing game on a big TV. Next a young woman sits at a desk in a dark room lit by pink and green RGB lights, hands on a glowing keyboard and mouse in front of a game on the monitor. Then a whole living room of friends leans towards the screen with controllers up, shouting. It ends in a packed esports arena where the crowd stands and cheers as a champion is shown on the giant screen above the stage.

4796.words: balance (verb): to keep something steady so it does not fall
4796.asset_description: A boy in a cap and blue T-shirt runs along a gravel path past flower beds, then leaps into the arms of an elderly man outside a modern house, who swings him up off the ground. The boy and a white-haired woman tip a metal watering can together over pink dahlias in the garden. At a wooden garden table the boy leans on his elbows and carefully leans two playing cards against each other into a standing triangle, with more cards laid flat on the boards in front of him. The last shot is the whole family in the back garden, children at the picnic table and on a rug on the lawn.

4947.words: portrait (noun): a picture that shows a person's face
4947.asset_description: Two hands squeeze a tube of acrylic paint so a ribbon of yellow lands on a wooden board already loaded with blobs of blue, red, purple, orange and white. A young woman in paint-spattered dungarees works at a big canvas on a wooden easel in a sunlit studio, sweeping red and green strokes on with a brush, then stepping back to look at the swirl of colour. The camera passes behind the easel and comes round to reveal a finished painted face - a woman with green eyes and multicoloured hair - while the artist throws both arms in the air beside it.

4962.words: binoculars (noun): double lenses for seeing far-away things
4962.asset_description: A foggy autumn forest floor covered in red and orange leaves. A bearded man in an orange beanie and a red checked jacket crouches and points at a deep hoof print in the mud, a pair of black binoculars hanging on his chest. He kneels behind a tree trunk, then raises the binoculars to his eyes in a close-up and scans the misty trees. He spots a stag with big antlers standing in the sunlit fog and lifts his camera to photograph it.

5064.words: trumpet (noun): a brass instrument you blow into
5064.asset_description: Close on a row of bandsmen in dark uniforms and white plumed helmets, each holding a golden brass instrument to his lips and blowing, fingers on the valves and the wide bells pointing forward. They play while walking in step down a street. The camera pulls back to show dozens more players in the same uniform filling the road, and behind the barriers a packed crowd waves Indian flags. The last shot looks down a long flag-lined avenue where the whole band stretches away in ranks.

5295.words: horn (noun): a thing you blow to make a loud noise
5295.asset_description: A blue ballpoint drawing in a notebook: a smiling man in an embroidered folk costume and sheepskin waistcoat stands on a patterned hillside, leaning back and blowing into a very long curved horn decorated with folk carvings that rises high above his head. Sheep run and graze around him, and wooden log cottages with smoking chimneys sit on the slope behind, under stylised clouds and rolling hills.

5344.words: quilt (noun): a warm cover sewn from many pieces of cloth
5344.asset_description: Close-ups of hand sewing: a needle and white thread pull a button tight on a checked shirt, a needle closes a rip in blue jeans, and a colourful flower is embroidered on white linen; a pocket knife points at a denim jacket button. Then a bright room of young women sitting on the floor with fabric squares, who lift a big finished patchwork quilt of many coloured pieces and cheer behind it.

5370.words: canoe (noun): a narrow boat you move with a paddle
5370.asset_description: A man paddles a narrow yellow boat across grey water at eye level with the surface, passing a smooth rock islet with red wooden houses on it. The clip then follows him walking down a narrow cobbled old-town street between orange and yellow buildings, one hand brushing the wall. Finally he sits at an outdoor wooden table and bites into a large cinnamon bun dusted with icing sugar, a glass of latte in front of him.

5375.words: swing (verb): to move something in a curve or arc to hit
5375.asset_description: A blonde woman in an orange shirt stands in a bay at a golf driving range and takes a full shot: the club travels in a wide arc over her shoulder and she watches the ball fly out over the green. The clip then cuts to a lake, where she grips a thick rope hanging from a gum tree, runs off the bank and rides the rope out over the water in a long curve before hanging from it above the lake.

5463.words: journal (noun): a daily written record of your experiences
5463.asset_description: A young man in a grey wool coat stands at the rail of a ship pulling away from a harbour town of red and white houses and waves back at the shore. Out on open grey water he wedges himself against the mast, opens a small black hardback book and writes in it with a blue pen, smiling as the waves break past. Later, in golden evening light, he stands at the white rail writing in the same book while the ship passes tall sea cliffs topped by a lighthouse, then looks up from the page in amazement.

5483.asset_description: A young woman with curly hair and a yellow top stands at a seafront railing at sunset holding binoculars. She points at something far off on the beach, then raises the binoculars to her eyes and searches along the shore. The scene changes to a packed stadium at dusk where she lowers the binoculars with her mouth open in surprise, and fireworks then rise and burst above the crowd while she stares up at them.

215.words: darkness (noun): the state when there is no light
215.asset_description: An animated couple is stacking plates in a stone kitchen when the ceiling lamp dies and the room falls into darkness during a rainy night; they feel around, find a lantern, strike a match and light it, ending with their faces glowing over the warm flame.

387.words: security camera (noun): a camera that films a home to keep it safe
387.asset_description: Grainy fixed-angle home security camera footage of a dark bedroom at night: a fluffy white dog lying on the rug gets up, barks, walks to the bed and props its front paws on it next to the sleeping owner.

575.words: power bank (noun): a portable battery you carry to charge your phone
575.asset_description: On a park bench, a young man despairs over his dead phone - "No plugs anywhere!" - throwing his hands up. His friend digs a power bank out of her bag ("Pocket power!"), they plug the phone into it on the bench, watch it charge and celebrate with a fist pump.

711.words: socket (noun): the outlet in a wall where you plug things in
711.asset_description: In a plant-filled cafe, a man's phone is nearly dead, so a woman points him to a white wall socket hidden behind a big monstera; he plugs the charger into the socket, leaves the phone charging on the floor, and they toast with iced coffees.

1686.words: charge (verb): to fill a phone or battery with electricity
1686.asset_description: Cartoon of a man whose head is a tablet, sitting against a wall scrolling on his phone while a cable runs from his back into a wall socket.

1808.words: headset (noun): a device worn on the head over eyes or ears
1808.asset_description: A pop-art boy in a blue hoodie wears a chunky futuristic headset that covers his eyes, with thick black cables running from it against a bright pink background.

1920.words: cyborg (noun): a being that is part human, part machine
1920.asset_description: A man seen from behind stands in a neon-lit futuristic city; his head and back are covered in glowing electronic implants, screens and wiring fused into his body.

1937.words: hacker (noun): a person who breaks into computers and code
