1937.asset_description: A neon illustration of a hooded figure with a glowing robotic face hunched over a bright holographic keyboard in a dark purple room, code symbols floating on the wall behind.

2072.words: cable (noun): a thick wire that carries power or data
2072.asset_description: A glowing monitor and keyboard sit on a desk in a dark room while dozens of glowing blue cables snake over the walls, the desk and the computer tower around them.

2139.words: laser (noun): a narrow beam of strong light from a machine
2139.asset_description: A futuristic woman in a sleek black-and-orange cyborg bodysuit stands facing the viewer while bright neon laser beams cross the dark space behind her.

2191.words: android (noun): a robot built to look like a human
2191.asset_description: A profile portrait of a female android whose head, neck and shoulders are made of intricate glowing circuits and wires, with a human-like face lit teal against a black background.

2218.words: circuit (noun): the path electricity follows on a board
2218.asset_description: A neon-blue anime boy wearing glowing headphones stares forward, surrounded on every side by luminous circuit-board lines and chips.

2256.words: mechanical (adjective): made of machine parts and worked by machine
2256.asset_description: A silver-haired cyborg girl stands under a blue sky, her arms and lower body built from black mechanical parts with glowing blue lights, and a huge machine rig with cannons behind her shoulders.

2428.words: monitor (noun): the screen you look at on a computer
2428.asset_description: A grey-haired man with glasses sits at a wooden desk in a home office, working at a computer with three large monitors showing documents and a world map.

2539.words: artificial intelligence (noun): computer systems that think and learn
2539.asset_description: A young woman's face merges into a machine: her transparent dome-shaped head is filled with glowing circuits and a blue core, and her metal body stands before a neon city of data.

2552.words: virtual reality (noun): a computer world seen through special goggles
2552.asset_description: A retro collage of a woman in a yellow turtleneck tilting her head back; the boxy virtual reality headset over her eyes shows a planet floating above a swirling ocean in space.

2631.words: lens (noun): the round glass in glasses or a camera
2631.asset_description: A brown-haired woman in steampunk clothes stands in front of a round window over a domed city, wearing a leather top hat with brass instruments on it and round tinted goggles over her eyes.

2649.words: goggles (noun): big glasses with a band that cover your eyes
2649.asset_description: An anime girl with pink and blue pigtails wearing a hoodie holds her hands up to the huge glowing goggles strapped over her eyes, surrounded by blue digital patterns.

2812.words: drone (noun): a small flying machine with a camera
2812.asset_description: A man stands with his back to us in a dark control room, facing a huge screen wall where a white four-propeller drone with a camera is displayed above technical diagrams and monitors.

2856.words: air conditioner (noun): a machine that cools the air in a room
2856.asset_description: An orange-toned illustration of an apartment wall covered in pipes and cables, with several boxy air conditioner units and their round fans bolted around one lit window; inside the window a short-haired girl sits with her knees up, reading.

4054.words: keyboard (noun): a set of keys on a piano or computer
4054.asset_description: A dark apartment block at night against a deep blue sky, with one window lit orange among all the black ones. The camera zooms in on that window: inside, a golden retriever is sitting upright on a black office chair at a desk, facing a screen, with its front paws resting on a keyboard. Wearing small glasses, it looks at the screen and moves its paws over the keys, tapping away as if working late.

4156.asset_description: In a garden a small black and white humanoid robot walks along a concrete path towards the camera, its arms swinging, while a young man in a red t-shirt and black shorts walks behind it with his hands out ready to catch it. The robot wobbles and starts to fall; the man rushes forward, dives onto the grass and grabs it. The last shots show the man lying flat on his back on the lawn, laughing, with the robot standing over him.
4156.transcript: Look at this robot. It does dance moves, all this stuff. Do something fun, buddy. He's falling. Grab him! Grab him!

4290.words: cool (verb): to make something cool or cooler
4290.asset_description: A heavy-set man in a sweat-soaked blue shirt lies slumped on a sofa fanning himself with a magazine and complaining about the heat; he points a remote at the wall air conditioner above him, the shot cuts to the unit switching on, and he stands up under it with his arms spread and his eyes closed as the cold air brings his temperature down.

4291.words: forehead (noun): the part of the face above the eyes
4291.asset_description: A bald man in a blue shirt with dark sweat patches lies back on the sofa of a bright living room and rolls a cold glass across his forehead, groaning; he looks up at the wall air conditioner, raises the remote and switches it on, then stands with his arms flung wide under the vent with his face tipped up, while the family cat watches from a shelf.

4368.words: light (verb): to make something lighter or brighter
4368.asset_description: A woman in a beige dress steps through open French doors onto a small rooftop terrace at sunset. She bends over the potted lemon tree and smaller plants along the railing. Then she reaches to the string of little bulbs looped along the railing and they come on, glowing warm against the darkening rooftops. She stands with an espresso cup watching the sun go down over the city.

4377.words: basement (noun): a room below ground level in a building
4377.asset_description: A young man stands at the bottom of a wooden staircase under the house, grinning up at the camera, and leads his friend down. They pass through a dim storeroom lined with metal shelves of paint tins and cardboard boxes, where the friend hugs himself and shivers, then along a dark corridor. He pushes a door open and the two of them stand looking at a home cinema: a big white screen on the wall with a projector above it, rows of leather seats and a popcorn machine.

4549.words: fuel (noun): a substance burned to produce energy
4549.asset_description: A charcoal drawing in blacks and greys. A bare forearm grips the wooden handle of a shovel and tips its load of chunky black lumps forward; the lumps and a shower of black dust fall through the air onto a big heap of the same shiny black rock below. Behind is a dim brick cellar lit by a single bare bulb hanging on a flex. Some of the lumps have spilled out over the drawn border onto the pale grey paper.

4865.words: lens (noun): the round glass in glasses or a camera
4865.asset_description: A young photographer kneels on sunlit grass in a park and aims a big camera with a long lens straight at the viewer. He then crouches in a city garden to photograph a pink rose from close up, skyscrapers behind him. A close shot shows the camera's rear screen with a sunset over a city, the camera sitting on a tripod. The sunset view fills the frame over the tripod. At night on a red carpet in a crowd he lifts the camera and grins.
4865.transcript: Perfect. Sharp. Got it. Amazing! Yes!

4866.words: drone (noun): a small flying machine with a camera
4866.asset_description: A man walks through Times Square holding a phone on a gimbal and filming himself. In a film studio a hand holds a clapperboard reading ACTION in front of a cinema camera on a tripod under a large softbox. A white drone with four propellers hovers low over a green field, flattening the grass beneath it. An aerial shot glides over rolling green and yellow farmland. Back in the studio the crew claps and cheers behind a camera operator.

4907.words: speaker (noun): a device that converts signals into sounds
4907.asset_description: Four shots of things shaking. A phone with a cracked screen buzzes on the boards of a wooden deck. A massage gun is pressed against a man's bare bicep and hammers into the muscle. A tracked machine's hydraulic breaker punches into gravel and asphalt, throwing up small stones. Finally a big black club speaker box hangs in a dark venue with dancers behind it, and a glass of water on the table in front of it ripples with the bass.

4934.words: headset (noun): a device worn on the head over eyes or ears
4934.asset_description: A woman in a pilot's uniform walks through a sunlit airport terminal pulling a silver suitcase. In the cockpit a hand reaches up to the overhead panel of switches. She then lifts a green headset with a microphone boom over her ears and settles it on her head under her cap. From behind, she flies the plane down the runway, and finally she faces the camera wearing the headset and gives a thumbs up.

5158.words: connect (verb): to join two people or things together
5158.asset_description: A young man with bleached hair crouches in a dark room and flicks a wall switch, then pushes a black cable into the back of a Samsung monitor, plugs another into a Nintendo Switch dock, and pushes a plug into the front of a PC tower while tidying the cables behind the desk. The monitor lights up with a blue wallpaper, the room glows purple, and he sits back in the gaming chair looking at the finished setup.

5376.words: switch (noun): a device that turns the electricity on or off
5376.asset_description: A young man in a denim shirt stands in a dark flat at night and reaches for a white plate on the wall by the door. The lights come on and he grins into the camera in the warm light. A close-up shows his hand pressing the small white rocker on the wall plate, and the last shot pans across the now brightly lit living room with its ceiling spots, floor lamp and dining table.

5433.words: turn on (verb): to make something work by flipping a switch
5433.asset_description: A young man in a yellow kurta walks backwards through a house at dusk, filming himself. He stops at a wall switch inside the veranda and flips it, then walks out into the garden past potted plants and palm trees to a switch box on a pole. He flips that one too and strings of fairy lights come on all across the house front, the palms and the garden, turning the blue evening bright. He looks up at the lights and grins.

5434.words: electricity (noun): the energy made by moving electrons
5434.asset_description: Inside a flat at dusk, a woman in an oversized mustard hoodie switches on one appliance after another. She flicks the steel kettle on its base, then the white desk fan on the kitchen counter, which starts spinning. She crouches on the floor and taps the button on a round robot vacuum until its blue light comes on and it starts moving. She picks up a white power strip from the sofa and pushes a plug into it, and the sockets light up. Coloured fairy lights come on along the walls and she throws her arms wide, laughing in the lit room.

5450.words: device (noun): a thing invented for a particular purpose
5450.asset_description: A young woman walks through her flat switching everything off at the wall: she pulls a black cable out of a socket beside a cabinet, then in the kitchen she reaches behind the worktop and pulls the plug of a toaster and a coffee machine, then a tall standing fan in the hallway, and finally the wall-mounted TV with its LED light strips, which go dark as she reaches up and disconnects it.

5505.words: film (noun): photographic material you take pictures on
5505.asset_description: A comic-style illustration of a dark, teal-lit hospital imaging room. A young medic in a glowing jacket holds a chest X-ray film up against a bright lightbox and studies it; a second X-ray film showing a hand floats in front of her, and the monitors around her display ECG traces and readouts.

230.words: director (noun): the person who runs a film and directs the actors
230.asset_description: In an animated seaside film set, a woman stands behind a big movie camera calling 'rolling' and then 'cut' with crossed arms as a costumed pirate actor overacts on deck. She walks over, demonstrates the movement she wants herself, then happily raises her fists when the take finally works.
230.transcript: And rolling! Cut! Cut! Too big! Sadder. Slower. Like this.

279.words: exert (verb): to use a lot of physical effort or strength
279.asset_description: A muscular anime villager strains every muscle to push a heavy cart loaded with sacks up a steep cobbled street, sweat flying and feet slipping on wet stones. He collapses onto the handle, then grits his teeth and raises a determined fist to keep going.

293.words: filmmaking (noun): the work of shooting and making movies
293.asset_description: On a rooftop at sunset, a small film crew shoots a scene: an actress stands by a light reflector while the director crouches at a camera on a tripod, a boom mic hangs overhead and a clapperboard snaps before the take. Afterwards the whole crew gathers behind the monitor and celebrates the shot.

452.words: logo (noun): the small symbol that represents a company
452.asset_description: In a bright startup office, a young woman draws a green leaf-in-hexagon design and proudly shows the finished sheet. She and her colleague peel it as stickers and stick their new company mark on a laptop, coffee cups, shipping boxes and even the sleeping dog's collar.
452.transcript: Our little mark. Stick it on everything.

459.words: manager (noun): the person in charge who tells a team what to do
459.asset_description: In an anime-style greenhouse full of white flowers, a woman in a green uniform holds a clipboard and assigns jobs to three workers, pointing one to the crates and one to the watering. She checks her list as they work, then the whole team celebrates a job well done.
459.transcript: You crates you water yes boss This one goes here great work team

467.words: master (noun): a person with great skill others learn from
467.asset_description: In an animated pottery workshop, students struggle as their clay keeps collapsing on the wheels. An old white-bearded master walks in, sits down and shapes a perfect tall vase with slow steady hands, then guides a student's hands until her pot works too, and the students bow to him.
467.transcript: mine keeps falling watch my hands slow very slow it's working

569.words: postmaster (noun): the person in charge of a post office
569.asset_description: In a 2D cartoon post office, a stern grey-haired woman in uniform with a ring of keys throws open the doors shouting "Open! Everybody in!" and bosses two clerks around. Parcels tumble off the shelves, she points orders while packages are weighed and stamped, the clerks answer "Yes boss!", and she wheels a cart of parcels out the front door.
569.transcript: Open! Everybody in! They're falling! Yes boss!

730.words: staff (noun): all the people who work for a place
730.asset_description: Inside a busy restaurant, the whole team works together: the chef passes plates over the kitchen counter, waiters carry stacked dishes to tables, a waitress throws a fresh tablecloth and lays cutlery, a barman serves coffee, and at the end the crew poses arm in arm.

826.words: film (verb): to record moving pictures with a camera
826.asset_description: A film crew in dark clothes shoots a scene in a bright office: one operator rides a camera dolly, another holds a boom microphone, and big studio lights surround a man sitting at a desk.

830.words: explain (verb): to make something clear to someone
830.asset_description: An older woman with grey hair stands over a young designer's desk, points at app mockups on his tablet and explains what to change; he looks up at her, nods and gets back to work with his stylus.
830.transcript: You have to add motion there.

831.words: speech (noun): a formal talk given to an audience
831.asset_description: A dark-haired woman in a navy suit stands at a wooden podium with a microphone in a packed auditorium, gesturing energetically as she speaks to the seated audience, then folds her hands and smiles.
831.transcript: It's not just about the message, but how we deliver it.

835.words: plumber (noun): a worker who fixes pipes and sinks
835.asset_description: A man in a blue polo kneels with his toolbox in a bathroom while the desperate homeowner begs him to help; he stares in wide-eyed panic, then wrenches the pipe under the sink until water blasts him in the face and he lands soaked on the floor.
835.transcript: You as a plumber are my only chance. I'll be honest, I will say I'm just an electrician. I'll fix it!

900.words: agent (noun): someone who handles business for others
900.asset_description: A confident man in a tailored grey suit and sunglasses strides through a marble hotel lobby talking on his phone and gesturing, leather satchel across his chest, with a luggage trolley and reception desk around him.

912.words: architect (noun): someone whose job is designing buildings
912.asset_description: A woman in a white hard hat and camel coat stands on the raw concrete floor of an unfinished high-rise, holding a large unrolled blueprint and gesturing out toward the city skyline, steel rebar stacked behind her.

970.words: butcher (noun): a person who cuts and sells meat
970.asset_description: A bearded middle-aged man in a striped apron stands at a wooden block in a small butcher shop, slicing a large cut of raw beef with a long knife while smiling at the camera; sausages hang by the meat counter behind him.

980.words: captain (noun): the person in command of a ship
980.asset_description: An older man in a navy uniform and peaked cap stands at the wooden steering wheel on the bridge of a ship, looking out over a rough grey-blue sea through the windows.

983.words: cashier (noun): the person who takes payments at a shop
983.asset_description: A young man in a green apron scans a glass jar over the red laser of a supermarket checkout while holding a pepper in his other hand; fruit and vegetables wait on the belt and a customer stands opposite.

998.words: clerk (noun): an office worker who handles papers and records
998.asset_description: An older man in glasses and a vest stands behind a vintage brass office counter, stamping a document while loose papers fly around him and folders pile up beside a desk lamp.

1007.words: colleague (noun): a person you work with at your job
1007.asset_description: In a bright open-plan office, a woman in a blazer points a marker at a whiteboard while the man beside her holds a laptop and gestures at the same spot as they discuss it together.

1010.words: contact (noun): someone you know who can help you at work
1010.asset_description: At a busy networking event, a smiling businesswoman and businessman shake hands while exchanging a business card, with suited people mingling in the blurred background.

1144.words: hunter (noun): a person who hunts wild animals
1144.asset_description: A man in an olive jacket and beanie kneels in tall misty grass holding binoculars at his chest, while his white-and-brown pointing dog freezes beside him, both staring intently ahead.

1170.words: librarian (noun): a person whose job is looking after books
1170.asset_description: A woman in a mustard cardigan stands on a tall wooden ladder in a grand old library, holding a stack of books under one arm while reaching a paper toward a high shelf.

1182.words: maid (noun): a woman whose job is cleaning hotel rooms
1182.asset_description: A young woman in a grey-and-white maid uniform with an apron throws a fresh white sheet over a hotel bed, her cleaning cart with folded towels in the foreground.

1307.words: servant (noun): a person paid to work in someone's house
1307.asset_description: A butler in a black tailcoat and white gloves strides through the double doors of a grand mansion hall, balancing a tray with silver-domed dishes on one hand and glancing back over his shoulder.

1383.words: tailor (noun): a person who makes and fits clothes
1383.asset_description: A young man with a yellow measuring tape draped around his neck and a pin cushion strapped to his wrist adjusts the shoulder of a half-finished jacket on a dress form. Sewing machines, spools of thread and bolts of fabric fill the sunny workshop.

1446.words: conference (noun): a big event where people meet to hear talks
1446.asset_description: A huge convention hall seen from above, packed with crowds of attendees wearing lanyards; a giant glowing atom logo hangs over a central stage where a speaker presents on screens.

1664.words: priest (noun): a man who leads services in a church
1664.asset_description: A painting inside a church: a priest in black robes sits in a carved wooden confessional and listens to a woman in a black veil kneeling beside it.

2372.words: exhausted (adjective): extremely tired with no energy left
2372.asset_description: A painting of a muscular worker in a dirty tank top, heavy boots and goggles pushed up on his head, slumped forward on a stone step among rubble, arms hanging over his knees and head bowed.

2562.words: detective (noun): a person whose job is to solve crimes
2562.asset_description: A man in a fedora hat, tie and long trench coat walks alone down a dark rainy city street at night, hands in his pockets, skyscrapers looming in the fog behind him.

2563.words: merchant (noun): a person who buys and sells goods
2563.asset_description: A man in a white head wrap and rich old-fashioned clothes sits at a wooden table by candlelight, carefully inspecting golden grains with a small tool, surrounded by glass bottles and jars.

2625.words: engineer (noun): a person who plans and builds machines
2625.asset_description: A double-exposure image: the grey silhouette of a man in a hard hat seen from the side, his head and shoulders filled with cranes, drilling towers and orange-lit industrial scaffolding at sunset.

2741.words: programmer (noun): a person who writes computer programs
2741.asset_description: A flat-vector night scene seen from behind: a person sits in an office chair at a desk, typing on a keyboard in front of a big monitor filled with lines of code, with a laptop beside it and a purple-and-red city skyline through the windows.

2793.words: businessman (noun): a man who works in business, often in a suit
2793.asset_description: A sepia ink drawing of a huge spiral staircase standing alone above a sketched city skyline: one man in a suit is halfway up with his hand on the rail, and two more men in suits stand talking on the small platform at the top.

2794.words: vet (noun): a doctor who treats animals
2794.asset_description: A watercolour-washed picture of a young woman in a white coat and surgical gloves, a stethoscope round her neck, cradling a ginger cat against her chest and looking down at it while the cat looks up at her.

2808.words: businesswoman (noun): a woman who works in business, dressed smartly
2808.asset_description: A watercolour-style illustration of a smiling woman in a white shirt, belt and grey pencil skirt standing in front of a white car on a city street, a dark document folder tucked in her hand, tall office buildings behind her.

2971.words: sticky note (noun): a small square of paper you stick up as a reminder
2971.asset_description: A dim blue office scene: a laptop and a phone stand on a desk in front of a window with the city outside, and dozens of pink, yellow and green sticky notes are stuck all over the glass and spread across the desktop.

3143.words: to dye (verb): to change the colour of cloth in liquid
3143.asset_description: Stylised illustration of a sunlit mud-brick courtyard where dozens of deep blue patterned cloths hang on lines to dry; a man sits at a low table working a piece of wet blue fabric, surrounded by round pots full of blue indigo.

3144.words: to weave (verb): to make cloth by crossing threads on a frame
3144.asset_description: Muted illustration on cream paper of a man sitting at a small wooden hand loom, working the threads with both hands while a red and orange patterned strip of cloth grows out of the frame in front of him.

3158.words: to weld (verb): to join metal by melting its edges
3158.asset_description: Cartoon of a worker in a dark protective mask, apron and thick yellow gloves leaning over a metal workbench, holding a torch against a steel plate while bright orange sparks fly up from the joint.

3272.words: briefcase (noun): a stiff flat case for carrying papers
3272.asset_description: Pencil sketch of a determined woman in a tailored trouser suit and heels striding forward, carrying a hard leather briefcase in one hand, with a faint city skyline drawn behind her.

4121.words: scene (noun): a series of pictures forming one part of a film
4121.asset_description: A film shoot in a stone quarry, seen from behind a big cinema camera on a rig in the foreground with its monitor turned towards us. Across the pit stand two tall concrete silos with a metal walkway running from them to the rock face. An orange fireball bursts out at the walkway and black smoke rises; a stuntman hanging on a wire swings away from it across the quarry. The metal walkway tears loose and crashes down the rock face, throwing up a huge cloud of pale dust that fills the pit while the camera keeps rolling and crew in yellow high-visibility vests watch from below.

4206.words: badge (noun): a small emblem that shows your rank or membership
4206.asset_description: A hamster in a pink bow spends a day as an office worker. It sits in a big black office chair at a desk covered in papers with a photo ID badge hanging round its neck on a lanyard, yawns hugely and then dozes off. It fills a small white cup at an office coffee machine, sits on a toilet holding a roll of paper under a framed FOCUS FLUSH FINISH sign, then at five o'clock jumps up at the card reader beside the office door with its badge and walks out through the glass door into the sunset.

4241.asset_description: A young man in a white pilot's shirt with gold striped shoulder boards and a green headset with a boom microphone sits in the cockpit and looks into the camera. The view swings forward through the windscreen: deep blue sky above a flat white deck of cloud stretching to the horizon. The aircraft sinks into the cloud until everything outside is featureless grey, then breaks out low over flat ground. Finally the nose lines up with a grey runway and the centre line and markings rush past underneath.

4250.words: warehouse (noun): a large building for storing goods
4250.asset_description: A tall storage warehouse with long aisles and racking stacked to the roof with wrapped pallets. In the foreground a chihuahua wearing a yellow hard hat and a yellow high-visibility vest stands on its hind legs looking off to the side. Behind it a golden retriever drives an orange forklift carrying pallets of bottled water, while another small dog in a hi-vis vest walks down the aisle. The forklift catches the stack and the pallets of water burst apart, spilling packs of bottles all over the concrete floor. The chihuahua turns to the camera with wide eyes.
4250.transcript: Okay, now back up slowly. Tranquilo, despacio. I don't know what you're saying. Speak English. Dios mio! I'm clocking out.

4280.words: filming (noun): the act of making a film
4280.asset_description: A retro poster-style illustration of a film set. A woman with wavy auburn hair, in a long golden off-the-shoulder gown, stands in front of a flat coloured backdrop with tears running down her cheek, one hand at her face and the other lifting her skirt. A big studio lamp on a tall stand shines on her from the left, a boom microphone hangs in from the right, and an empty wooden director's chair stands beside her.

4321.words: model (noun): a representation of something, often smaller
4321.asset_description: A glass-walled office. A woman in a headscarf and a beige blazer leans over a large technical drawing, holding a rule down and marking it with a yellow pencil while two colleagues lean in on either side. She then stands at a table holding a miniature city built in beige card and plastic, with tiny tower blocks, low houses, roads, green lawns and little trees, and reaches in to adjust one of the small towers. Finally she stands outdoors in a yellow hard hat, holding a drawing up in front of a real cluster of tall glass towers.

4517.words: pull (noun): the act of pulling something toward you
4517.asset_description: A dark woodcut-style print of a Victorian rooftop. A young sweep in a flat cap and long coat braces himself on the steep slate roof, one boot on the tiles and one against the brickwork, and grips a rope with both hands, one high and one low. The rope runs up over the tall brick chimney stack and down into one of its clay pots. Thick black smoke pours out of the pots and blows across a grey sky, and the roofs and chimneys of the town stand behind him.

4542.words: agreement (noun): a statement of promises exchanged
4542.asset_description: A glass-walled office tower. A man in a white kandura and headdress shakes hands with someone in the corridor by a glass door, next to a woman holding a takeaway coffee. Inside a meeting room a woman stands at a large screen showing a grid of bag and shoe designs while four people sit round the table with tablets and paper coffee cups. The man in the kandura holds up a tablet and talks the others through it. A close-up shows a hand sketching a design on a tablet with a stylus. At the end the man stands, leans across the table and shakes hands with a seated colleague while the others smile.
4542.transcript: Hmm, this one. We have a deal.

4556.words: praise (verb): to express approval of someone
4556.asset_description: An open-plan office. A laptop on a white desk shows a rising stock chart while two people type either side of it. A woman in a light blue shirt walks over with a takeaway coffee, leans across the desk and points at the chart on a man's screen, talking and laughing; he sits back and watches. The whole team then gathers round the desk in a half circle, standing and sitting, and applauds him while he grins at the laptop.

4643.words: production (noun): a show made for stage, screen or radio
4643.asset_description: In a bright apartment a woman in a padded gilet with headphones round her neck positions two actors by a window, putting a hand on the man's shoulder to move him. The shot widens to show the film crew at work: two large cameras on tripods, a camera operator in headphones, boom microphones over the actors and studio lights. The woman sits at a monitor watching the take, then punches the air, and the crew clap.

4682.words: trader (noun): someone who buys goods to sell them
4682.asset_description: A photograph in an old stone-arched spice market. A young man in a striped galabeya stands behind his open sacks of goods and pours bright orange-yellow turmeric from a big brass scoop into a sack heaped with the same powder, catching the falling stream with his other hand. Around him are more sacks with neat cones of red, yellow and orange spice, dried herbs and ginger root, with brass lanterns and a carved wooden screen behind.

4690.words: workplace (noun): a place where work is done
4690.asset_description: A drawn open-plan office. A young man in a blue jumper with an ID card on a lanyard sits at a wooden desk in a cubicle and types on a laptop. A steaming mug of coffee, a potted plant and an open notebook sit on the desk; the cubicle wall behind him is a cork board with sticky notes and a printed sheet. Sunlight comes through a big window on the left. Behind him more people sit at their own desks with computers, under a wall clock and shelves of files.

4691.words: colleague (noun): a person you work with at your job
4691.asset_description: A young man in a mustard jumper with a backpack and an ID card on a lanyard walks in through the glass entrance turnstile of an office building, smiling. In the open-plan office a bearded man carrying files walks up to him and they greet each other with a handshake and a clap on the arm. The young man then sits down at a desk in a long row of desks and works at a computer; other people are typing at desks around and behind him.

4693.words: hire (verb): to engage someone for work
4693.asset_description: A painted scene in a corner office at sunset. A confident man in a grey suit and tie stands behind a big wooden desk, one hand on the desktop, and leans forward to shake hands with a younger man in a brown jacket who sits with his back to us in the visitor's chair. A signed folder, papers and a telephone lie on the desk between them. Through the wide window behind him is a city skyline with traffic in the streets below.

4759.words: baker (noun): someone who bakes bread and cakes as a job
4759.asset_description: Rows of pale baguettes on a wire rack slide out of a glowing bakery oven. Trays of croissants and pains au chocolat are pushed into a shop window while a crowd in winter coats watches from the wet Paris street outside. A man in a shirt and a flour-smeared apron picks up a baguette, holds it to his ear like a telephone, then turns to the camera grinning and holds it up in front of the bakery door.

4868.words: program (verb): to write a computer program
4868.asset_description: A laptop on a desk shows lines of green code in a dark editor. A young man in a hoodie clenches his fist and cheers at his screen. He then sits at a two-monitor desk in an open office, typing code with both hands. In a dark room a whole team stands in front of a wall of monitors filled with code. When a huge green check mark appears on the central screen, the whole team throws their arms up and cheers.
4868.transcript: Aha! Got it! Nice! Almost there... It works!

4912.words: instructor (noun): a person whose job is teaching
4912.asset_description: In a wooden-floored dojo a woman in a white karate suit with a black belt stands in front of a class of students in white suits, who all bow together. She then demonstrates for them: she raises one knee and drives a high kick out to the side while the students behind her copy her stance. She holds a wooden board out at arm's length towards the class, calls out an instruction, and finally takes a wide stance with both arms out as the students watch and follow.

4940.words: butcher (noun): a person who cuts and sells meat
4940.asset_description: A young man in a red and white striped apron and a white cap stands behind the glass display counter of a butcher's shop, filled with trays of steaks, sausages and sliced meat. He holds a thick red steak up in front of a brass weighing scale and lays it on the tray. He folds brown paper around the meat on the white block, ties the parcel with red and white string, and hands it across the counter with a smile.

4974.words: seller (noun): someone who exchanges goods for money
4974.asset_description: A street tea stall hung with orange marigold garlands: a vendor in an orange kurta lifts a steel pan high above his head and pours a long unbroken stream of milky tea down into a jug at waist height without spilling a drop, repeating the trick while a tight semicircle of young men film him, laugh and applaud; he then fills small steel cups and hands them round.

4984.words: briefcase (noun): a stiff flat case for carrying papers
4984.asset_description: On a seaside promenade lined with palm trees an older woman with a grey plait, knee pads and elbow pads rolls along on a skateboard, laughing. A jogger passes her, then a man in a dark coat hops onto a board behind her and copies her, and finally a man in a business suit carrying a black briefcase in one hand steps onto a skateboard as well. All of them roll down the promenade together past the benches and the sea, grinning.

4987.words: present (verb): to give an exhibition of work to an audience
4987.asset_description: In a glass-walled meeting room high above the city a woman in a black suit stands at a whiteboard covered in coloured sticky notes and talks her colleagues through her work while they sit around a table full of laptops. One after another they cut in: a man raises a finger, others lean forward and talk over her, and she raises her voice to keep going. Then a young man walks in behind her with a tray of takeaway coffees, the whole table turns to the coffee, and she leans on the table looking defeated.

5056.words: maid (noun): a woman whose job is cleaning hotel rooms
5056.asset_description: A hotel housekeeper in a turquoise uniform with a pink-trimmed apron snaps a white sheet out over a bed and lets it settle, plumps and squares up the pillows, then folds two towels into a swan and tucks a pink frangipani flower against its neck. She steps back smiling, then goes back to her trolley of stacked towels and toiletries in the doorway.

5257.words: butler (noun): the head servant in a rich person's house
5257.asset_description: A pencil and charcoal drawing of a man in a black tailcoat, white waistcoat and bow tie standing in the hall of a grand house. He holds a silver tray with a teapot, a milk jug and a cup on it in one raised hand, a folded white cloth over his forearm and his other hand behind his back, his head bowed towards the tray. Behind him a chandelier hangs above a curving staircase between marble columns.

5292.words: productive (adjective): producing a lot of work
5292.asset_description: A montage of people falling asleep where they should be awake: a young man at a computer in an open-plan office yawns hugely, then drops face down onto his keyboard; a student in a grey hoodie and glasses sleeps on an open book in a library; a man in a jacket sits slumped back on a park bench in bright sunshine with his head tipped back, asleep; a man in a grey tracksuit sprawls yawning on a sofa beside a coffee table holding a twin-bell alarm clock and a phone.

5501.words: industry (noun): making goods and services to sell
5501.asset_description: A charcoal drawing of a large dim factory hall with a steel roof truss, hanging lamps and heavy machinery lining both walls. In the middle a man in a hard hat, dirty overalls and thick gloves leans into a hand truck loaded with wooden crates and a metal drum, pushing it forward across the concrete floor. Dust hangs in the light. More crates and a second hand truck stand in the foreground.

5502.words: storage (noun): the act of storing things somewhere
5502.asset_description: A large warehouse aisle with tall steel racking on both sides, full of shrink-wrapped pallets. A woman in a hi-vis vest and work gloves lifts cardboard boxes onto a wooden pallet beside a conveyor, building the load up layer by layer until it is chest high and wrapped in clear plastic film. She then takes the handle of an orange pallet truck, pumps it, and pulls the finished pallet away down the aisle past the racking, a forklift moving in the background.

149.words: censor (verb): to officially hide parts of a text from readers
149.asset_description: In a hand-drawn animated office, a stern clerk rolls black ink over lines of a man's handwritten letter, cuts a piece off with scissors and drops it in a drawer, then hands him back the letter covered in black bars as he protests it was only news.
149.transcript: That is my letter. This part must go. But it is only news. Not anymore.

167.words: citizen (noun): someone who legally belongs to a country
167.asset_description: A woman proudly drops her ballot into a voting box while officials watch, then joins volunteers picking up litter in a park, and finally stands beaming in front of a government building lined with flags.

168.words: citizenship (noun): the legal status of belonging to a country
168.asset_description: At an animated naturalization ceremony in a bright hall, adults from many countries wearing green sashes receive rolled certificates from an official. A tearful man clutches his scroll, families hug, and everyone waves little flags and cheers.
168.transcript: Welcome home, my friends. Welcome home, my friends. I belong here now. We are so proud!

188.words: constitution (noun): the basic written law of a country
188.asset_description: In an animated marble hall, a politician demands more power; a wigged official lifts a huge old book from a glass case, opens it on the desk and points at the page, and the man reads it and deflates because the law says no.
188.transcript: I want more power. Read this page. But I am powerful. The law says no.

193.words: corrupt (adjective): using power dishonestly to get money
193.asset_description: A 3D-animated official at a marble office desk refuses to stamp a woman's paper, then rubs his open hand hinting he wants something; she reluctantly hands over a small pouch of gold coins, he pockets it, happily stamps the document and waves her off.
193.transcript: Huh, big problem here. Something for me? Now it is perfect!

218.words: declare (verb): to announce something officially in public
218.asset_description: In an animated old town, a woman steps onto a stone balcony, unrolls a scroll and loudly declares to the gathered crowd that the new bridge is open; a bell ringer pulls the tower bell and the townspeople cheer and throw their hats in the air.
218.transcript: Hear this everyone! The new bridge is open!

348.words: government (noun): the group of people who officially rule a country
348.asset_description: In a cartoon state boardroom a grey-haired leader in a purple suit points at a chart, calls a vote and stern ministers in suits raise their hands, then she presses an official seal onto a decree and the cabinet shakes hands.
348.transcript: All in favor? Yes. Good. It is done.

565.words: politics (noun): the activity of elections and governing
565.asset_description: In an animated town square, two rival candidates - a woman in an orange suit and a man in teal with a green rosette - stand on crates shouting "Vote for me!" while the crowd waves orange and green fans. Votes are painted as orange and green bars on a big board; the orange side wins a rosette, and the two candidates shake hands saying "Well done. Good luck!".
565.transcript: Vote for me, friends! No! Vote for me! Yeah! Well done. Good luck!

581.words: protesting (noun): marching with signs to demand a change
581.asset_description: A crowd marches through a sunny city square carrying green flags, sunflowers and hand-painted signs of a tree, a water drop, a sun and green hearts. They link arms, chant together and raise the signs while cafe guests watch.
581.transcript: (upbeat music) - Hey, hey, hey, hey! - Sign's up, everyone! - All together, now! (cheering)

691.words: guard (verb): to watch over something so nobody takes it
691.asset_description: A soldier in camouflage chases a stranger away from his parked car, then struts and patrols around it swinging a wooden stick, pokes at the doors, climbs halfway through the window and tumbles onto the dirt road before laughing into the camera.
691.transcript: Hey! Get away from my car! Move! Go! (laughing)

699.words: smuggle (verb): to take something past a guard in secret
699.asset_description: In a hand-painted anime scene a farmer hides a big wheel of cheese under the hay in his cart, calmly wheels it up to a border checkpoint where a stern guard pats the hay and raises the barrier, then behind the rocks he pulls the cheese back out and grins in relief.

733.words: state (noun): a country with its own government
733.asset_description: In a grand marble hall, two animated leaders wearing sashes each press a wax seal onto a treaty document in front of their national banners, one teal with a circle and one orange with a triangle, then shake hands and pose side by side as their delegations applaud.
733.transcript: My country signs today. Mine signs too. Two free nations. Friends.

1526.words: warrior (noun): a person who fights in battles
1526.asset_description: A watercolor of an armored samurai warrior in a helmet holding a long blade, painted over an old textured page with faded printed letters and golden splashes.

1555.words: sword (noun): a long metal blade with a handle for fighting
1555.asset_description: A double-exposure artwork of a hooded figure bowing its head over a large sword held upright by the hilt, its body blended with crumbling castle ruins and a misty forest.

1666.words: pharaoh (noun): a king of ancient Egypt
1666.asset_description: An old engraving styled like a stone tablet showing the head of pharaoh Ramses in profile, wearing a striped royal headdress with a cobra on the forehead; hieroglyphs run below.

1693.words: knight (noun): a soldier in metal armour from the Middle Ages
1693.asset_description: Very dark engraving of an armored knight swinging a long sword over his head with both hands on a battlefield.

1725.words: cross (noun): two crossed beams used to crucify someone
1725.asset_description: A detailed engraving of Jesus with a crown of thorns having his garments taken by men on a hill; in the foreground a wooden cross lies on the ground with nails and a hammer beside it.

1741.words: emperor (noun): the man who rules a whole empire
1741.asset_description: A classical engraving of a Roman emperor's head in profile, with curly hair and a laurel wreath tied with a ribbon around it.

1742.words: shield (noun): a flat piece of armour held for protection
1742.asset_description: A mosaic-textured painting of the archangel Michael with dark wings, a plumed helmet and armour, holding a staff in one hand and a large round shield on his other arm.

1866.words: spy (noun): a person who secretly finds out information
1866.asset_description: A comic-style man with dark sunglasses and a stubble beard holds a black pistol up beside his face, colored square panels behind him.

1868.words: justice (noun): fair treatment of people by the law
1868.asset_description: A grey halftone engraving of the scales of justice standing on a desk beside a thick pile of law books.

1909.words: blade (noun): the flat cutting part of a knife
1909.asset_description: A painterly portrait of a woman in a black dress resting a long katana across her shoulders, its steel blade catching the light against a warm blurred background.

2134.words: empress (noun): a woman who rules an empire
2134.asset_description: Portrait of a regal dark-skinned empress wearing a huge ornate turquoise-and-gold headdress, heavy gold necklaces and jeweled earrings, staring sternly at the viewer inside a palace.

2154.words: general (noun): a top military commander who leads an army
2154.asset_description: An elderly Chinese general with a long white beard stands in ornate gold armor and a horned helmet, draped in teal cloth, in front of temple rooftops in the mist.

2328.words: throne (noun): the decorated chair of a king or queen
2328.asset_description: A blonde woman with large white angel wings and a jeweled headdress sits with crossed legs on a huge ornate golden throne, draped in white-and-gold robes.

2505.words: rifle (noun): a long gun you hold with two hands
2505.asset_description: A female soldier in camouflage gear, helmet and headset stares straight ahead while holding a long scoped rifle across her chest in the rain.

2717.words: parliament (noun): the building where politicians make laws
2717.asset_description: A watercolour of the long Gothic Houses of Parliament and its clock tower stretching along the Thames next to Westminster Bridge, with golden autumn branches in the top corner and the whole facade mirrored in the water.

2733.words: army (noun): a large group of soldiers who fight together
2733.asset_description: An armoured rider on a black horse gallops out of thick dust with his sword raised high, while other riders with raised swords charge beside him and fire and smoke burn on the left.

2815.words: battle (noun): a fight between two armies in a war
2815.asset_description: A dramatic illustration of a Spartan fighter in a crested helmet, breastplate and red cloak standing with a big round shield in swirling dust and smoke, with rows of other helmeted fighters and raised spears behind him.

4306.words: prison (noun): a place where persons are locked up for punishment
4306.asset_description: Tall metal gates topped with coiled razor wire swing open at sunset. Men walk out one by one carrying their belongings in cardboard boxes, past a uniformed officer standing in the gateway. Families waiting on the road outside rush forward; a woman throws her arms around a grey-bearded man and sobs, and soon the whole road is filled with couples and families holding each other in the low orange light.

4330.words: march (verb): to march in a procession
4330.asset_description: A photograph of a wide dirt parade ground under a clear blue sky. Rows and rows of young soldiers in matching tan uniforms and brown boots move forward in step, all with the same leg swung out and the same arm thrown straight up in front of them. One soldier at the front wears a tan helmet. Behind them the ranks stretch back to a long concrete wall with coloured flags on poles above it, and dust rises around their boots.

4332.words: arrest (verb): to take someone into custody
4332.asset_description: A comic sketch filmed outside a warehouse. A uniformed police officer stands behind a man dressed as a cartoon burglar — black and white striped suit and cap, black eye mask, a grey swag bag over his shoulder — and clicks handcuffs onto his wrists behind his back against a brick wall. As they walk, brightly coloured plastic gems and rubber chickens tumble out of the bag onto the ground. The officer then holds the burglar by the arm and walks him across the yard to a waiting police car and puts him in the back, with the film crew watching from the side.

4526.words: election (noun): a vote to choose a winner for a position
4526.asset_description: Inside a polling station. An older woman with red glasses and a flowered scarf stands in a cardboard voting booth with a yellow pencil in her hand and a long printed sheet of empty boxes on the shelf in front of her. She frowns down the sheet, taps the pencil against her lips and looks up while she thinks, then bends over the paper and puts a firm tick in one of the boxes. She straightens up out of the booth with the paper and the pencil and smiles. A queue of other voters waits behind her in the hall.

4533.words: court (noun): a room in which a law court sits
4533.asset_description: A photograph in a wood-panelled courtroom. A woman in a patterned dress stands in the middle of the floor in front of the bench and holds a large certificate with a ribbon seal up over her head with both arms, laughing. Behind her an older man in a suit and three other family members clap and wave small paper flags, two little boys among them, and paper confetti falls through the light from the tall window. A small flag stands on the desk beside a signed document, and seated guests watch from the front row.

4534.words: official (noun): a worker who holds an office
4534.asset_description: A citizenship ceremony in a bright hall. A row of people stand side by side with their right hands raised, each holding a small Canadian flag, reciting after someone at a lectern. They lower their hands and hug each other. A man in a dark suit wearing a heavy ceremonial chain of office steps along the row and hands each of them a folded certificate tied with a ribbon. A woman in a yellow headscarf takes hers and cries. At the end she raises both arms and cheers while a seated audience applauds.

4563.words: law (noun): a legal document of rules for an activity
4563.asset_description: A marble ceremonial hall with a Turkish flag and rows of schoolchildren in uniform singing. A woman in a maroon suit and white cotton gloves carries a huge leather-bound book with a gold emblem and gilt corners to a wooden lectern and sets it down. She opens the heavy cover and turns the pages, showing hand-written calligraphic text inside ornate coloured borders. The last shot holds on the open book standing upright with a red wax seal on the stand in front of it.

4602.words: search (verb): to search or seek something
4602.asset_description: A fine pen-and-ink drawing of a customs hall. An open suitcase on a metal bench shows neatly folded shirts and trousers; a uniformed officer in a peaked cap holds a rolled sleeping bag up above his head and squints at it. Beside him a worried traveller in a long coat stands with her hands clasped under her chin. To the right a second officer holds a spaniel on a lead, and the dog has its front paws up on the bench with its nose towards the case. Booths, striped barriers and a turnstile fill the background.

4624.words: majority (noun): more than half of the votes
4624.asset_description: A photograph looking down a packed town hall with a bare wooden floor and tall windows. More than a hundred people of all ages sit on rows of plain wooden chairs, and almost every one of them has a single hand raised straight up in the air to vote. Papers rest on their laps. A long empty table with stacks of paper and three chairs faces them at the front of the room. Sunlight falls in stripes across the floorboards between the rows.

4625.words: vote (verb): to express your choice for a candidate
4625.asset_description: A polling station set up in a school gymnasium. A clear plastic ballot box with a slot in the lid stands on a table, already half full of folded papers. A long queue of voters stretches back across the basketball court: an elderly man leaning on a white cane, a nurse in blue scrubs, a construction worker in a hi-vis vest and hard hat. Poll workers with red and blue rosettes hand out papers beside cardboard voting booths. A woman in a bright yellow raincoat walks up smiling, posts her folded ballot through the slot and punches the air.

4736.words: army (noun): a large group of soldiers who fight together
4736.asset_description: A large group of soldiers in matching camouflage uniforms train together on sand and black mats under a grey sky. In the foreground a woman in uniform with her hair in a tight bun hits a black padded shield held by a comrade, her gloved fists up in a guard. Behind her rows of other uniformed soldiers work in pairs across the whole ground, and one lifts another clean off her feet and throws her over her shoulder onto the mats. The clip ends on the woman still punching, with dozens more soldiers drilling behind her.

4754.words: protest (verb): to say words that show you disagree
4754.asset_description: An amateur football match on a worn grass pitch. A player in a dark maroon kit shoulder-barges a player in white off the ball and the white player goes down. The female referee in black points sharply at the offender. He turns to her with both palms raised, arguing and pleading that he did nothing. She raises a yellow card above her head; he keeps talking at her with his hands open, then walks off grimacing.

4789.words: authority (noun): the power to give orders and make decisions
4789.asset_description: A wood-panelled office with a huge political map of Africa covering the back wall, stuck with coloured pins. A woman in a green suit sits behind a broad polished desk; a man in a dark suit stands beside her holding out an open folder, and she gestures with a rubber stamp in her hand as she speaks to him. An assistant with a tablet stands to one side while the man works at the map behind her. She signs a document, presses the rubber stamp onto it, closes the folder and sits back alone at the desk facing the camera.

4790.words: conflict (noun): an open clash between two opposing sides
4790.asset_description: A dark ink-and-wash drawing of a long boardroom table in a panelled government room with heavy curtains and flags. Two men lean in from opposite sides of the table, faces twisted, shouting and jabbing their fingers at each other. Papers are strewn across the polished wood and one sheet is still in the air. Other men in suits sit or brace their hands on the table between them, and a woman with a folder has stopped in the open doorway at the back of the room.

5027.words: judge (noun): an official who settles questions in court
5027.asset_description: A wood-panelled courtroom lit by tall windows. A woman in a black robe sits behind the raised bench and brings a wooden gavel down onto its block, papers spread in front of her and a set of brass scales standing at the edge of the bench. In the foreground a stack of files lies on the counsel table.

5137.words: parliament (noun): the building where politicians make laws
5137.asset_description: Inside a large circular legislative chamber. A woman in a black suit stands among the seated members and raises her hand to vote. The camera pulls back to show the whole hall: hundreds of members in curved rows of desks, packed public balconies above, everyone standing and applauding. A man then speaks from the podium at the centre while the seated members listen.

5140.words: allow (verb): to give someone permission to do something
5140.asset_description: At an airport border control desk, an officer in a peaked cap and uniform takes a passport, opens it on the black counter and inks a rubber stamp. He presses the stamp down and a large green tick appears on the page. The traveller lifts the passport up: the whole spread is covered in blue ticks, coloured stamps, little aeroplanes and a green cross. A woman in a yellow beanie then holds the stamped passport up to the camera, free to walk on, with the queue of waiting travellers behind her.

5163.words: politician (noun): a leader who works in government
5163.asset_description: A black-and-white comic panel of a political meeting: two men in suits stand on wooden podiums either side of a flight of steps in a hall with tall columns and hanging banners, leaning forward and pointing at each other with angry faces. Below them a packed crowd in suits raises fists and blank white placards, and a giant wooden gavel comes down into the frame from the top right corner.

5164.words: campaign (noun): a race between candidates for office
5164.asset_description: A woman in a red campaign T-shirt pastes election posters onto a city wall with a wide brush, smoothing down a blue poster with a candidate's silhouette; then two candidates in suits argue from glass lecterns on a brightly lit debate stage in front of a seated audience and a moderator; then, at a night rally, a crowd holds up red and blue placards, confetti falls, and a young woman in a red shirt cheers with her fist in the air.

5197.words: rebel (verb): to take part in a rebellion
5197.asset_description: In a big open-plan Japanese office full of identical grey cubicles, a woman in a company uniform climbs up and stands on top of her desk, glaring down at the room while the other workers sit at their screens. One by one the workers stop working: sheets of paper and a necktie fly up into the air as men and women jump to their feet and punch their fists upward. At the end the whole floor is standing between the desks with their arms folded, staring straight ahead at the camera while loose paper lies scattered on the carpet.

5205.words: oath (noun): a serious promise to tell the truth
5205.asset_description: At an outdoor ceremony in front of a domed parliament building a woman in a dark suit raises her right hand and lays her other hand on a book held open in front of her while she speaks into a microphone. The crowd behind the barrier waves small red-white-and-blue flags and confetti drifts down. She then appears wearing a tricolour sash, waving to the cheering crowd, and finally turns on the stage and spreads both arms while photographers shoot from below.

5233.words: military (adjective): connected with soldiers and the army
5233.asset_description: Rows of young officers in dark green dress uniforms with peaked caps, gold shoulder cords and shiny buttons stand at attention and hold a salute, with rows of blue and yellow flags on poles behind them. The shot pulls back to a huge parade ground where hundreds of soldiers stand in straight blocks across the tarmac, a single officer in a beret out in front of them, while a crowd of spectators watches from behind steel barriers in the sunshine.

5234.words: rank (noun): a row of soldiers standing side by side
5234.asset_description: Row after row of young women in dark green dress uniforms with peaked caps, gold cords and white gloves stand shoulder to shoulder in a parade square, each row exactly level with the next. They all hold a salute with the white-gloved hand at the cap. The camera moves back over the block of them, showing a packed stand of spectators and a line of national flags on tall poles behind the formation.

5255.words: guilty (adjective): responsible for doing something wrong
5255.asset_description: A courtroom. An elderly judge in a red robe and white wig sits at a high wooden bench and reads a document aloud. A young man in a dark suit stands in the dock below her and stares up, shaken, as she speaks. She lifts a wooden gavel and strikes it on its block. A wide shot shows the packed court, barristers in wigs and gowns at their tables and a full public gallery.

5394.words: claim (verb): to demand something as your own property
5394.asset_description: A two-colour woodcut print. A person in a heavy padded coat, knitted hat and thick gloves leans their whole weight onto a tall flagpole and drives it down into the frozen ground. A ragged ochre flag snaps out sideways in the wind at the top of the pole. Splinters of ice burst up where the pole strikes and cracks run out across the white surface. Behind them lie empty snow dunes and, far off, a second small flag already standing in the snow.

5424.words: treaty (noun): a written agreement between two countries
5424.asset_description: A low, wide shot straight down a polished wooden table in a wood-panelled hall. Two men in dark suits lean in from opposite sides and shake hands above the table. Between them, open leather folders hold a signed document and a blank sheet, with a black fountain pen resting on the near folder. Behind them stand two flags on poles, one navy and one dark red, and two press photographers firing their camera flashes.

5426.words: delegation (noun): a group of representatives sent somewhere
5426.asset_description: In a green courtyard, two groups in business clothes meet at a long wooden table. A woman in a teal blazer and a man in a grey suit sit at the table with open document folders while four colleagues stand in a line behind them, two on each side. Two small desk flags, teal and orange, stand between the folders. The camera moves in as both sign their papers, then the two signers rise and shake hands while their groups look on.

5455.words: approval (noun): the official act of approving something
5455.asset_description: A young man in a blue t-shirt with a backpack stands in a crowded government office, clutching a black document folder to his chest and staring ahead, tense. Behind a glass counter a woman in a navy blazer leafs through a booklet, then lays an open passport on a sheet of holographic security stickers and presses one into it. She slides the finished passport back across the counter. The young man opens it, sees the page, and breaks into a huge grin while the people waiting behind him hold up cards marked 10.

5461.words: ballot (noun): a document listing the choices you vote for
5461.asset_description: Inside a school hall set up with cardboard privacy screens, a clear plastic box already half full of folded white papers stands on a table. A woman in a yellow blouse posts her folded paper through the slot in the lid and smiles. A tattooed young man walks up the aisle holding his paper and drops it in, watched by the queue behind him. An older man in a striped polo shirt pushes his paper through the slot, then a woman in a wheelchair reaches up and posts hers. The queue keeps moving and an official sits at a desk beside the box.

5462.words: democracy (noun): a system where citizens elect their leaders
5462.asset_description: In a community hall a clear plastic box stands on a folding table with a tall stack of folded white papers piled in front of it and more already inside. A woman in a mustard blouse steps up smiling with her hand on her chest. A young man in a white t-shirt pushes his folded paper through the slot in the lid, then an older man in a blue polo shirt posts his while the others wait and smile. A woman in a wheelchair holds hers ready and a helper in blue sits at the table. At the end the whole group stands around the full box, pleased.

5475.asset_description: A pencil sketch on yellowed paper shows a battlefield. A line of soldiers in round steel helmets, with packs on their backs and rifles in their hands, runs forward through churned mud, the leading man leaping over a shell crater as earth sprays up around his boots. Behind them a heavy armoured vehicle with a long gun barrel, a turret and caterpillar tracks pushes through the smoke. Thick black smoke rises from a burning ruined town on the horizon, shattered tree stumps and torn barbed wire stand on the left, and a great coil of barbed wire fills the foreground.

5477.asset_description: In a snowy park two structures built out of stacked snow blocks face each other across an open field, each with thick walls, corner towers and a coloured flag planted on top — one blue, one red. Children and teenagers in red and blue winter jackets, bobble hats and scarves crouch behind the snow walls, then jump up and hurl snowballs, and clouds of white snow burst over the walls. The camera runs with them as both sides charge across the open snow towards the other side's snow walls; one child in blue is knocked over and rolls in the snow, another carries the red flag on a stick along the wall. At the end the whole group lies together in a laughing heap on the snow.

5497.words: candidate (noun): a politician running for public office
5497.asset_description: An election night campaign room. A woman in a cream blazer with a big ribbon rosette on her chest stands clasping her hands in front of a screen showing a rising bar chart of results, surrounded by supporters in blue campaign T-shirts with her name on them. Their faces are tense, hands over mouths; a close-up shows her staring at the screen. Then the result lands: she throws her head back and screams with joy, the room erupts with raised fists, balloons and confetti, and her team lifts her up on their shoulders.

95.words: blush (noun): the pink face powder you brush onto your cheeks
95.asset_description: At a white vanity a girl dips a big brush into a round pink blush compact, sweeps it onto her cheeks in front of the mirror while her friend watches, and both admire the fresh pink glow, framing her face with their hands.

281.words: eyeliner (noun): a makeup pen used to draw a line along the eyelid
281.asset_description: A young woman leans close to a bathroom mirror and carefully draws a black winged line along her upper eyelid with an eyeliner pen while a friend watches behind her. She finishes the wing, celebrates, and tidies the edge with a cotton swab, getting a thumbs up.
281.transcript: (snaps) Oh, nailed it. (laughs) - No one's flying. (upbeat music)

282.words: eyeshadow (noun): colored powder makeup put on the eyelids
282.asset_description: Close-up of a makeup palette as a brush picks up shimmery gold eyeshadow, then pats and blends it over a woman's eyelid until the whole lid sparkles gold. She then admires the finished golden lids with a friend on camera.
282.transcript: Liquid gold. Ooh, look at that.

284.words: face mask (noun): a creamy product spread on the face to dry
284.asset_description: At a cozy pajama night, a woman spreads thick green clay from a bowl over her friend's face with a spatula. The two sit with matching green face masks; the dried masks crack as one starts laughing and warns the other not to make her laugh.
284.transcript: Don't make me laugh. It's cracking!

313.words: foundation (noun): the skin-coloured makeup base for your face
313.asset_description: At a bright vanity by a window, a friend helps a young woman with dots of foundation on her cheek, blending them into her skin with a makeup sponge. The camera shows her evenly covered face turning from side to side, and both smile into the round mirror next to bottles of foundation, saying 'That one gone, so smooth.'

448.words: lip gloss (noun): shiny liquid makeup painted on the lips
448.asset_description: A young woman holds up a pink lip gloss tube, pulls out the applicator wand and paints the glossy pink liquid onto her lips in close-up. She pats them with a finger and shows off the shiny glass-like result, saying it is shiny like glass.

466.words: mascara (noun): dark makeup brushed onto the eyelashes
466.asset_description: At a lit vanity mirror, a young woman pulls the wand out of a black mascara tube and brushes it onto her lashes with her mouth wide open the whole time, the funny face everyone makes. Her friend watches behind her, she fixes a smudge with a cotton swab and admires her lashes.
466.transcript: The face, everyone does it. Hello. (gasps)

886.words: wrinkle (noun): a small line or fold in the skin
886.asset_description: Selfie video under a grape pergola: a young woman scrunches her forehead to show her temporary frown lines and says hers just vanish, then her white-haired grandmother leans in, points proudly at the deep wrinkles on her own face and jokes that she earned these; both laugh.
886.transcript: Mine just vanish. I earned these.

1871.words: glow (verb): to shine with a soft light
1871.asset_description: A cyan-and-red glitch portrait of a woman's face in close-up, one wide eye glowing white with dotted lights along the eyebrow, a finger resting at her chin.

1912.words: tattoo (noun): a permanent picture inked into the skin
1912.asset_description: A photoreal fantasy portrait of a pale elf-like woman with pointed ears, light-blue hair and swirling blue tattoos across her face, neck and shoulders.

1924.words: vivid (adjective): very bright and intense in colour
1924.asset_description: A painterly portrait of a woman with closed eyes and red lips, her head and shoulders wrapped in swirling ribbons of vivid orange, pink, purple and blue liquid color against a teal background.

1983.words: eyelashes (noun): the small hairs on the edge of the eyelids
1983.asset_description: An ornate stylized portrait of a woman with closed eyes and long dark curved eyelashes, her swirling teal-and-gold hair filling the frame and decorated with cream roses.

2683.words: face paint (noun): colour painted onto someone's skin
2683.asset_description: A close portrait of a woman with blue hair wearing a crown of large sunflowers; an orange and blue mandala is painted on her forehead, matching swirls curl down both cheeks, and flowering tattoos cover her neck and chest.

2691.words: trench coat (noun): a long belted raincoat with wide lapels
2691.asset_description: A cartoon illustration of a young woman with a messy brown top-knot and a beige trench coat sitting behind an open laptop, looking up at the viewer with big eyes and dark spots scattered across her nose and cheeks.

2838.words: glitter (noun): tiny shiny specks that sparkle on skin
2838.asset_description: A glossy digital portrait of a young woman with a curved headset over her ears, her cheeks and eyelids dusted with rainbow-coloured glitter, sitting inside rings of coloured light on a dark starry background.

4319.words: blend (verb): to combine things into one
4319.asset_description: A make-up studio with a bulb-lit mirror. A woman with a white towel wrapped round her hair sits with her eyes closed; separate stripes of skin-coloured cream have been dabbed on her forehead and cheeks. A hand dabs an orange sponge over them until the stripes disappear into her skin and the tone is even. A red-haired make-up artist then sweeps powder over her cheek with a brush, and in close-up paints her lips with a dark red lipstick. At the end the woman looks up with an even, finished face and red lips.

4406.words: smooth (verb): to make something smooth, as if by rubbing
4406.asset_description: A woman sits at a lit vanity mirror with hard stripes of pale foundation and dark contour drawn across her cheek and forehead. A makeup artist works over them with an orange sponge, dabbing and pressing until the edges disappear, then goes over the same areas with a soft brush. The harsh lines melt into an even, glowing complexion, and at the end she is shown the finished face in a hand mirror.

4870.words: foam (noun): the mass of small white bubbles on waves
4870.asset_description: Close up, a man's face is covered in thick white shaving foam and he draws a straight razor down his cheek, leaving a clean stripe. In a bathroom mirror he trims his beard with an electric trimmer. In a barbershop a barber shaves his beard line with a straight razor while he sits under a white cape. By a swimming pool a bare forearm with a white stripe of foam is shaved smooth. Finally he sits grinning in the barber chair while four men around him applaud.

5289.asset_description: A soft painted illustration of a bare forearm and open hand against a cream background. A single clear drop of liquid sits on the inside of the forearm. In the top left a round magnifying inset shows the same skin close up, dry and cracked into a fine network of lines with visible pores.

224.words: designing (noun): planning how something will look before making it
224.asset_description: A young woman and man sit at a bright table sketching pencil drawings of a chair, comparing versions and adding measurements. They then cut cardboard, build a small model chair from their sketch, test it with a stone on the seat, and high-five when the design works.
224.transcript: That one, that's it. And it actually works!

475.words: memory (noun): something from the past that you remember
475.asset_description: A girl opens an old keepsake box in the hallway and goes through each memory inside: she holds a seashell to her ear, ties on an old friendship bracelet, and smiles at a childhood beach photo of her and a friend. She then laces up her old roller skates, finds they still fit and rolls down the hall grinning at the photo.

479.words: mind (noun): the part of you that thinks and plans
479.asset_description: In a Pixar-style autumn park, a girl plays chess against a taunting opponent. She taps her temple, closes her eyes, and a thought bubble over her head shows the board with her moves planned as dotted lines. She calmly plays the winning move and smiles smugly as the opponent slumps in defeat.
479.transcript: You've got nothing! Wait, let me think. All up here. No!

656.words: distract (verb): to take someone's attention away from their task
656.asset_description: A young woman sits at a chess board in a tournament hall while the spectators packed behind the rope barrier behind her wave their arms, pull faces and gesture at her to break her concentration; she never looks up, and calmly reaches out and moves a piece.

1513.words: pray (verb): to speak to a god
1513.asset_description: Stained-glass style image of two hands pressed together in prayer over a blue sleeve, on a black background.

1514.words: religion (noun): belief in a god and its traditions
1514.asset_description: Classic devotional painting of Jesus with long hair and a beard, wearing red and white robes and looking upward.

1547.words: holy (adjective): connected with God and religion, sacred
1547.asset_description: A dark classical painting of Jesus with long hair and a beard, a faint glowing halo circle behind his head, resting his chin thoughtfully on his hand.

1576.words: dream (noun): the pictures you see while you are asleep
1576.asset_description: A dreamlike night scene: the silhouette of a girl swings on ropes that hang from a bright crescent moon, with faint music notes floating around her and a city skyline with a ferris wheel far below.

1878.words: invisible (adjective): impossible to see with your eyes
1878.asset_description: A surreal photo composite of a man in a dark suit, striped shirt and tie whose head is invisible — only a glowing moon-like ring of smoke floats above the collar — against a sky of pink clouds.

1880.words: invention (noun): a new machine that someone has created
1880.asset_description: A vintage engraving of a fantastical flying machine: a huge balloon-globe fitted with sails, masts, ladders, a ship's hull, cannons and a rooster perched on top.

1934.words: surreal (adjective): strange and dream-like, against real rules
1934.asset_description: A dream-like painting of impossibly tall bookshelves that curve and bend like waves on both sides of a canyon of books, with a single glowing streetlamp floating in a swirling blue sky between them.

2032.words: portal (noun): a gateway that leads into another world
2032.asset_description: A steampunk painting of a man climbing steps toward a huge round machine-framed opening; through the glowing circular portal a golden city is visible, and the frame around it is packed with gears, dials and a blue screen.

2037.words: creature (noun): a living being, especially a strange one
2037.asset_description: A vector illustration framed by a dark cavern edge: in a sunny autumn forest under a giant green planet, a tiny person stands face to face with a dark winged creature, while an upside-down mirrored forest hangs beneath the ground they stand on.

2076.words: literature (noun): written works such as novels, poems and stories
2076.asset_description: A narrow sunlit room lined floor to ceiling with shelves of old books; more books are piled on a table under a large arched window with a white vase on top.

2389.words: faith (noun): a strong belief in God or a religion
2389.asset_description: An oil painting of a serene woman in a white head veil and flowing blue robe, eyes lowered and hands pressed together in prayer, framed by an arch of colorful painted flowers.

2401.words: fantasy (noun): an imagined magical world, not real life
2401.asset_description: A glowing iridescent stone path winds through a dreamlike forest of pink and purple blossoming trees toward a bright white light in the distance.

2408.words: imagination (noun): the mind's power to create unreal worlds
2408.asset_description: A giant open book lies in a golden field, and its pages turn into a real path where a tiny man walks toward a glowing sunset between two large trees.

2417.words: harmony (noun): a state where opposites fit together calmly
2417.asset_description: A giant glowing sphere shaped like a yin-yang symbol, half dark and half light, stands on a rocky plain under a night sky with small moons and birds.

2482.words: turret (noun): a small round tower on a big building
2482.asset_description: A tall fairy-tale castle covered in pointed turrets and glowing arched windows rises out of trees under a dark evening sky, with winding staircases climbing up to it.

2501.words: shiva (noun): the Hindu god with blue skin and a trident
2501.asset_description: The blue-skinned god Shiva sits cross-legged in meditation on a rock, with a trident standing beside him, snowy mountains, waterfalls and a rainbow behind.

2502.words: shrine (noun): a small holy place built to honour someone
2502.asset_description: Stone steps lead up to a mossy carved arch crowned with flowers, where a large Celtic cross hangs between two pillars like an overgrown forest shrine.
