2504.words: krishna (noun): a Hindu god shown with blue skin
2504.asset_description: A blue-skinned child Krishna with closed eyes wears a golden crown with a peacock feather, flowers in his dark curls, and layers of turquoise and gold jewelry.

2520.words: sacred (adjective): holy and connected to religion
2520.asset_description: A bearded man in a long grey robe stands barefoot on mossy stone ruins while a white dove hovers in a beam of heavenly light above him. Glowing red crosses shimmer in the dark forest around the arch.

2526.words: poseidon (noun): the ancient Greek god of the sea
2526.asset_description: A muscular bearded sea god with long flowing hair rises out of huge foaming ocean waves, holding two spears, framed by a glowing orange ring and purple storm clouds.

2538.words: little red riding hood (noun): the fairy-tale girl in a red hooded cloak
2538.asset_description: A young blonde woman in a long red hooded cloak stands in a sunlit green forest with a huge calm white wolf right beside her, both looking toward the viewer.

2544.words: hanuman (noun): the Hindu monkey god with a crown and mace
2544.asset_description: A cute young monkey with big ears stands upright wearing a golden crown, necklaces, bracelets and a red cloth around his waist, holding a tall golden staff with a ring on top.

2545.words: worship (verb): to show deep love and respect to a god
2545.asset_description: A small crowned monkey squats barefoot on ancient stone steps with its palms pressed together in front of its chest, eyes open in a calm devoted expression.

2606.words: clockwork (noun): machinery of gears and springs inside a clock
2606.asset_description: A surreal collage shows a woman's profile whose head merges into clockwork: large gears, a clock mechanism, towers and industrial buildings grow out of her skull.

2729.words: crystal ball (noun): a glass ball used to see the future
2729.asset_description: A woman with very long white hair in a shimmering white gown leans over a dark carved table and touches a big glowing glass ball, in a silvery room full of sparkling light and pale curtains.

2742.words: concentrate (verb): to give all your attention to one thing
2742.asset_description: A bearded man in glasses sits at a desk in a dark red-lit room with his chin resting on his hand, staring closely at a monitor full of code while a night city glows through the window behind him.

2757.words: inspiration (noun): a sudden idea that makes you want to create
2757.asset_description: A surreal oil painting of a woman's face with her eyes closed and her chin lifted; her hair dissolves into swirling orange and blue clouds with glowing planets, and the white keys of a piano run along the bottom of the picture.

2758.words: bust (noun): a sculpture of only a head and shoulders
2758.asset_description: A surreal grey stone head of a woman with closed eyes and an Egyptian-style headdress stands on a wide flight of steps in a desert, its back half built out of grey blocks and slabs with thin gold rods hanging around it.

2803.words: psychedelic (adjective): covered in wild, glowing, swirling colours
2803.asset_description: The same engraved portrait of a bearded man, but every hatched line is recoloured in electric rainbow stripes, so his face and the swirling background blaze in green, pink, orange and blue.

2819.words: glowing (adjective): giving out a soft steady light of its own
2819.asset_description: A digital-art portrait of a woman's bald head and shoulders made of dark blue skin covered in tiny lights, with bright golden rings burning on her forehead and chest and glowing lines spreading out into the dark background.

2859.words: to meditate (verb): to sit still and calm your mind
2859.asset_description: A woman with long blue hair and layers of beaded necklaces sits cross-legged on a patterned rug in a dark cave, eyes closed and head bowed, holding her open hands around a glowing blue crystal shape; two candles burn behind her.

3119.words: fairy (noun): a small magic person with wings from stories
3119.asset_description: A dark silhouette of a slender figure stands in profile against a blue-grey background of glowing leaves, with huge translucent golden wings spread from her back and sparks of light floating around her.

3188.words: to pray (verb): to speak to God, often kneeling
3188.asset_description: Coloured-pencil drawing of a person in white and grey robes kneeling and bowing forward with their forehead down on a red and green prayer mat; a string of prayer beads lies beside them, an open book rests on a wooden stand and a lit arched window shows domes outside.

3197.words: to daydream (verb): to let your mind wander to nice thoughts
3197.asset_description: Watercolour illustration of a young woman sitting at a table in a room with bookshelves and a sunny window, chin propped on her hand and eyes turned up and away; a chain of thought clouds curls above her with a globe, an open book, a music note, a cup of tea, a plant and two question marks.

3325.words: magic (noun): power that makes impossible things happen
3325.asset_description: Painted fantasy scene of a red-haired woman in a ragged cloak bending over an old open book on a wooden table; golden sparks rise from its pages, candles burn beside it and a black cat watches from a ruined window.

5077.words: recall (verb): to bring knowledge back from your memory
5077.asset_description: A student with silver-grey hair, glasses and headphones round his neck sits at a table in a busy study hall covered in small paper cards. He presses one card against his forehead with his eyes closed while he tries to say the answer, then looks at it to check, and works through card after card until the pile in front of him has grown into a heap. At the end he throws his fist up and grins, having got them all.

5396.words: mark (verb): to designate a place with a mark
5396.asset_description: Two rangers in matching khaki uniforms work on green coastal hills. They spread a white map over the bonnet of their truck and study it, then carry wooden stakes topped with orange flags up the slope and push them into the ground one after another, so that a line of orange flags curves over the ridge. An aerial shot shows the finished flag line running across the hillside down towards the sea, and one ranger steps back, takes off her hat and looks along it.

54.words: atm (noun): the machine in the street that gives you cash
54.asset_description: In a Ghibli-style animation, a woman slides her card into a street ATM at night, types her PIN, takes the banknotes from the lit tray and her card back, then buys a bouquet of sunflowers with the cash.

55.words: auction (noun): a public sale where the highest bidder wins
55.asset_description: In a packed country hall a young woman raises her numbered paddle again and again, bidding against the crowd on an antique chest and a grandfather clock while the auctioneer's gavel falls; she wins and hugs her paddle.

86.words: bill (noun): the paper that says what you pay in a restaurant
86.asset_description: A waiter places a folded restaurant bill on a plate; the couple unfolds it and it turns out comically long, the woman gasps and laughs, then the man counts out a thick stack of dollar notes onto the plate and they pay cheerfully.
86.transcript: A little paper. Oh no! (laughs) - And keep it. - Fair. - Worth every bit.

239.words: doubt (verb): to not be sure that something is true
239.asset_description: At an outdoor flea market, a young man skeptically examines a gold ring an old woman seller is offering him. He turns it over, squints at it against the light, frowns, says he does not think so, and puts the ring back on the stall table unconvinced.

525.words: paperclip (noun): a bent wire that holds sheets together
525.asset_description: In an office a desk fan blows sheets off a paper stack while two coworkers scramble; the woman takes a paperclip from a glass dish, clips the stack together, and the papers now hold even in front of the fan as they celebrate.
525.transcript: The pages catch! Holds even now!

849.words: visa (noun): a sticker in a passport that lets you enter
849.asset_description: In a Pixar-style office a nervous young man slides his green passport to an immigration officer and asks to enter. She checks the pages, sticks a colorful visa into the passport and stamps it. He raises his fist and thanks her, delighted.
849.transcript: Please, may I go there? One moment, young man. You may enter. Welcome. Yes! Thank you!

1423.words: chart (noun): a drawing that shows data as bars or lines
1423.asset_description: A close view of a computer monitor full of bar and line charts on a marketing dashboard; a finger points at one of the graphs.

1765.words: greedy (adjective): wanting far more money than you need
1765.asset_description: A cartoon of a bald man with huge bulging eyes and his tongue hanging out, grabbing a pile of gold coins on a table with both hands.

1886.words: consumer (noun): a person who buys and uses goods
1886.asset_description: An old political cartoon: a man labeled 'Consumer' sits at a table with an almost empty plate while men labeled Producer, Middleman, Broker and Speculator stand around him holding sacks of goods.

2753.words: piggy bank (noun): a pig-shaped box where you save coins
2753.asset_description: A 3D scene of a big pink pig-shaped money box with a coin slot in its back, standing beside a small white pig figure; stacks of gold coins, loose dollar bills and bundles of banknotes fill the space around them.

2840.words: scroll (noun): a long rolled sheet covered in handwriting
2840.asset_description: A long parchment scroll lies unrolled on a dark wooden table, still curled at both ends, its surface covered in rows of tiny handwriting; a whole miniature walled city with domes and towers rises out of the middle of it.

4148.words: luxury (noun): something nice you want but do not need
4148.asset_description: In a concrete parking garage a man in a navy suit runs his hand slowly along the bonnet of a bright red sports car. He opens the door and lowers himself into the red leather seat, then reaches for the start button on the steering wheel and the dials light up. The car rolls out of the garage with its headlights on, and the last shot shows it standing alone in profile on an empty rooftop deck under a grey sky.

4277.words: accountant (noun): someone who keeps and checks business accounts
4277.asset_description: A woman in a white shirt and grey cardigan sits at a desk buried under thick stacks of receipts and invoices, lit by a desk lamp at night. She frowns over a long till receipt held up in one hand, runs a red pen down a ruled ledger full of columns of figures, circles one number in red, taps the big black calculator, and finally throws both fists in the air in triumph.

4287.words: view (verb): to look at something carefully
4287.asset_description: An estate agent in a green blazer with a lanyard and a folder opens the door of an empty flat and waves a young couple in; she pulls the sheer white curtains aside and opens the balcony door onto a city skyline, and the three of them stand looking out; in the hallway she hands the couple a set of keys and they laugh with delight.

4361.asset_description: A woman in a bright floral dress stands on a sunny city street holding up two big brown paper shopping bags, one in each hand, grinning. She then walks through a shopping centre past lit storefronts with bags hanging off both arms, adds more bags and totes, and finally rides up an escalator hugging a pile of paper bags to her chest.

4370.words: safe (noun): a strongbox where valuables are kept
4370.asset_description: A black-and-white noir illustration of a bank interior. The huge round steel door of the strongroom stands open at the back, its thick locking wheel and bolts showing, with neat stacks of banknotes on the shelves inside. In the foreground a man in a hat slides a bundle of notes across the marble counter to a clerk behind brass railings, while another man in a long coat walks across the chequered floor.

4371.words: lobby (noun): a large entrance or reception area
4371.asset_description: A woman in a dark suit pushes through the glass doors of a bank. At the counter a clerk feeds banknotes through a counting machine. She then walks into the wide marble entrance hall, a big information screen on the wall and a row of staffed desks along the side. At the back a man in a suit turns the wheel of the huge round steel door and she stares into the corridor of deposit boxes behind it.

4488.words: document (noun): an official piece of writing with information
4488.asset_description: A large bearded man in a white shirt sits in a busy open-plan office with a telephone handset wedged against his ear. His desk is buried under printed forms and official papers, many of them already marked with big red crosses. He grabs a sheet, slams a rubber stamp down on it and leaves a red X across it, then bangs the stamp onto the ledger in front of him again and again, getting angrier until sheets of paper are flying up all around his head.

4573.words: secret (adjective): kept private, not open or public
4573.asset_description: A busy diner with red vinyl booths, white tablecloths and a violinist playing between the tables. An elderly woman in a grey suit sits at a booth and slides a folded napkin across the cloth. A man in a blue shirt and tie with a gold watch heaves a brown leather briefcase up onto the table opposite her. The two of them then sit behind raised menus, glancing sideways at each other. The camera pulls back to show the long tablecloth is draped over a wheelbarrow parked at the table, and under the cloth the barrow is heaped with banded bundles of cash; they reach across and shake hands over it.

4599.words: payment (noun): a sum of money paid
4599.asset_description: A close-up at a market stall in low evening sun. A hand tips a small drawstring cloth pouch upside down over a scrubbed wooden counter, and coins and folded paper notes in red, green and cream pour out of it and tumble through the air. A dozen coins have already landed and lie scattered across the boards. Brass balance scales, glass jars and a wicker basket stand blurred behind.

4600.words: exchange (verb): to give something and receive something back
4600.asset_description: At a money-changer's booth in a busy covered bazaar, a moustached man in a grey shirt and dark waistcoat holds out a thick bundle of banknotes in both hands over a glass case. He counts through a stack of purple notes, then spreads dozens of notes into a wide fan across the counter, laying different currencies side by side. A young woman in an orange beanie watches with her mouth open in amazement, and at the end he passes a handful of notes over to a hand reaching in from the camera side.

4694.words: contract (noun): a binding agreement enforceable by law
4694.asset_description: In a bright office a woman with short white hair in a blue suit leans over a desk and spreads a printed document on a clipboard in front of a young man in a suit, pointing at the line where he has to sign. He takes a pen and signs it. They stand up, she puts a hand on his shoulder and they shake hands while the staff at the desks behind clap. At the end she leads him to a free desk with a small box marked Welcome on it, and the whole office applauds.

4787.words: valuable (adjective): worth a great amount of money or value
4787.asset_description: A high-contrast black and white illustration of a prospector's hands, dark water and trees behind them. The two hands tilt a wide round pan at the edge of a river; water and grit spill over the near rim in a black stream. Inside the pan, picked out in bright yellow against the black and white drawing, lie two solid gold bars, a heap of rough gold nuggets and a scatter of fine gold grains, with one nugget lifted between finger and thumb and glinting above the pile.

4791.words: papers (noun): official writing that gives you information
4791.asset_description: A formal meeting in a tall wood-panelled room with a blue flag on a stand and daylight through a shuttered window. A woman in a dark suit stands and leans over the long table, setting down an open buff folder of documents in front of the others. Loose white sheets and a notepad lie on the polished wood beside a glass water jug. Five colleagues in suits, some seated and some standing behind the leather chairs, watch her place the folder.

4871.words: registration (noun): the act of signing up or enrolling
4871.asset_description: A close shot shows a hand writing a name into a spiral-bound book headed REGISTRATION, with other names already filled in. Two smiling staff in lanyards hand a printed name badge across the counter to a guest. Behind the desk more staff work with stacks of forms, badge printers and card scanners while a queue waits. The camera pulls back to show an enormous convention hall with a huge crowd lined up at long check-in tables.

4967.words: identity (noun): the characteristics by which a person is known
4967.asset_description: A neon-lit night scene in comic style: a young woman with dark hair stands at a checkpoint window in the rain, wearing a transparent visor while a glowing grid scans her face. She holds up a plastic card that carries her own photo and printed personal details, and a hand in the foreground points a scanner at the card to check that she is who the card says she is.

5169.words: mail (verb): to send something by the postal service
5169.asset_description: A young man in glasses and a cardigan sits at a metal cafe table by the sea, writing on the back of a picture postcard with a blue biro; a stamp lies on the table beside it. He then stands at a rotating rack of postcards on a village street, turning it and pulling out a fan of cards. Finally he stands at a yellow street postbox, holds the postcard to his lips, pushes it through the slot and pats the box.

5170.words: package (noun): a wrapped container you send or give
5170.asset_description: A postman in a bright red high-visibility uniform and red cap wheels a red bicycle along a street of English terraced houses; a red bag stuffed with letters hangs from the handlebars. He pushes a bundle of letters through the letter slot of a red front door, knocks on the door, waves to a woman watering her front garden, hands a wrapped birthday parcel over a brick garden wall to a resident, then rides off smiling at the camera.

5181.words: signature (noun): your name written in your own handwriting
5181.asset_description: A grey-haired woman in a burgundy suit steps out of a black limousine onto a red carpet in front of a white palace lined with flags and guards and waves to the cameras, then sits at a desk and signs a document with a black fountain pen, holds the open folder up to show the fresh blue signature, and finally raises both arms to a cheering crowd from a balcony.

5198.words: sheet (noun): paper you write or print on
5198.asset_description: A watercolour illustration of a desk seen from the side. A doctor in blue scrubs with a stethoscope round her neck holds out a small written sheet of paper across the wooden table, and a man in a brown jacket reaches his hand out to take it. An open spiral notepad lies on the desk with a black fountain pen beside it, and a potted plant stands behind them.

5269.words: purchase (verb): to obtain or acquire something by paying
5269.asset_description: A young woman in a beige coat and orange beret shops her way through a city: first in a wood-panelled chocolate shop where she holds up a chocolate bar, then at a clothes rail where she takes down an olive coat, then at the till where she hands the coat over and pays at the card terminal, then walking through the glass atrium of a shopping centre, and finally out through the doors holding a large white gift bag tied with a gold ribbon.

5279.words: scroll (noun): a long rolled sheet covered in handwriting
5279.asset_description: A man in a dark suit sits at a polished wooden desk in a grand hall with EU and French flags behind him and writes a looping signature on a sheet of paper with a gold fountain pen. He works through a tall stack of pages, lifting each one as he signs. Then two aides unroll an enormous roll of paper the whole length of the table, and while photographers film he leans over it and signs it with an oversized pen.

5353.words: paperwork (noun): work that means handling forms and papers
5353.asset_description: An open-plan office. A woman in a rust-coloured blouse sits at a desk with a corded handset wedged against her ear, talking into it while she reaches for a pink sticky note and taps at her keyboard. Around her the desk fills up with towers of loose printed sheets and ring binders - one stack to her left, another rising in front of the monitor, more piling up until they reach above her head and box her in. Colleagues move about in the background. She stops, puts the handset down and slumps forward onto the desk between the paper towers.

5427.words: seal (noun): a wax fastener that is soft when warm
5427.asset_description: In a dark theatre lit by warm lamps, a laughing young woman holds a cream envelope up to the camera; the flap is closed with a round red wax seal pressed with a stamp. A young man in a green hoodie then shakes his hands in front of his chest and pulls a wide-eyed, nervous face. The shot cuts to a group of young people on a lit stage who jump, scream, hug each other and celebrate.
5427.transcript: I'm shaking. So nervous. I can't.

5454.words: ink (noun): a liquid used for printing or writing
5454.asset_description: A close photo of a wooden desk where a hand in a khaki sleeve presses a round rubber stamp down onto the open page of a passport. The other hand holds the booklet flat. The page already carries one black rectangular stamp mark, and fresh black drops have splattered around the one being pressed, with a dark stamp pad standing at the top left of the desk.

5472.words: bill (noun): a piece of paper money from a bank
5472.asset_description: A black-and-white ink drawing seen from close up: two hands hold an open leather wallet upside down over a shop counter, and several banknotes slide out of it, one of them tumbling away through the air. Below the wallet a small clasp coin purse hangs open and a coin drops out of it towards the floor, with another coin already lying on the wooden counter. Behind the hands the blurred checkout of a shop is drawn, with a cash register, a customer display screen and a long printed receipt curling out of the till.

5473.words: wealthy (adjective): having a lot of money and valuable things
5473.asset_description: A man with a moustache in a brown corduroy jacket and a striped shoulder bag stands at a shop checkout, pulling a blue bank card out of a brown leather wallet next to the card terminal. He then walks through an open-air fruit market and opens the same wallet in front of the fruit crates, searching through it. He lifts the wallet up to the camera with both hands and turns it around so the empty pockets show, grinning in disbelief. Finally he leans over a wooden table where a small pile of loose coins has been tipped out, and pushes the coins around with both hands while another person's hand reaches in from the other side.

5504.words: send (verb): to cause something to be taken to another place
5504.asset_description: A young woman with a black bob sits at a wooden desk by a bright window, a green cardigan on, tapping a black fountain pen against her lips while she thinks over a sheet of writing paper. She then writes a handwritten letter across the page, folds the finished sheet, slides it into a cream envelope and presses the flap down flat with both hands. In the last shot she stands in the street at a red pillar postbox, smiling as she pushes the envelope through the slot.

44.words: anger (noun): the strong feeling of being annoyed or furious
44.asset_description: A flower-market worker finds her flowers dumped in a bag on the table and boils over: she grabs her head, hurls the bag down, kicks a bucket across the empty hall and stands over the flowers shaking with clenched fists.

102.words: boredom (noun): the feeling of having nothing interesting to do
102.asset_description: A cartoon man in a purple tracksuit waits in a laundromat and slowly loses his mind from boredom: he watches the clock, balances stacked cups on his head, blows a feather, spins his laundry bag on one finger, slides off his chair and ends up wearing a wet sock on his head.

226.words: despair (noun): the feeling of losing all hope
226.asset_description: A street musician plays the accordion in a tiled subway underpass while commuters walk past without giving anything. He bends over his instrument case, finds it completely empty, sighs, and ends up slumped on the floor of the long empty tunnel, hopeless.

232.words: disappointed (adjective): sad because something was not as good as you hoped
232.asset_description: A bearded man in a teal raincoat waits excitedly at a street food stand, rubbing his hands, and receives a large tray that turns out to hold only one tiny bite of food. He eats the single morsel in one spoonful, mutters 'that's it?', and stands in the street with the empty tray and a deflated face.

264.words: emotion (noun): a strong feeling like joy or sadness
264.asset_description: A young woman waits at airport arrivals clutching yellow flowers, and when a man pushes his luggage trolley through the doors she covers her mouth and bursts into tears. She runs to him and they hug tightly, both laughing and crying at once.

269.words: envy (noun): wanting what someone else has
269.asset_description: A young woman stuck on a crowded bus with a rusty old handlebar across her lap stares out the window at a cyclist gliding past on a nice bike. She sighs 'I want that', presses her hand against the glass and slumps back with a long envious look.

355.words: guilt (noun): the bad feeling after doing something wrong
355.asset_description: A young man knocks a clay jug and finds a long crack in it; he nervously puts it back on the shelf and glances around, then sits in front of his plate of rice unable to eat, rubbing his face and finally hiding it in both hands as he admits he broke it.

411.words: jealous (adjective): upset that someone else got what you wanted
411.asset_description: In a ballet studio a dancer performs confidently, but the teacher pins the red prize ribbon on another girl; the dancer claps stiffly, mutters, crosses her arms and glares with an exaggerated envious scowl.

536.words: peace (noun): a calm, quiet feeling with no stress
536.asset_description: A young woman in linen pajamas steps onto a tropical veranda at sunrise, sets a mug of coffee on a stool, settles into a rope hammock among palm trees and relaxes with closed eyes while an orange cat climbs onto her lap.

578.words: pride (noun): the good feeling about something you did well
578.asset_description: A woman mechanic in overalls wheels a vintage motorcycle she has restored out of her garage onto a sunlit cobbled street and polishes its silver tank. Neighbours gather around admiring it while she stands tall beside the bike, crosses her arms and beams, saying "There! I did that."

608.words: relief (noun): the good feeling when stress is finally over
608.asset_description: A driver grips the steering wheel with a tense, worried face through a tricky parking moment; when it is over she gasps, breathes 'phew', covers her face with both hands and melts into relieved laughter.

1718.words: calm (adjective): quiet, relaxed and not worried at all
1718.asset_description: Gold line drawing on black of a Buddha head with closed eyes and a completely peaceful, relaxed expression.

1823.words: lonely (adjective): sad because you are all alone
1823.asset_description: A girl sits alone on a dark balcony at night, seen from behind, hugging herself and looking at a huge full moon over the glowing windows of the city.

2498.words: tender (adjective): gentle and full of love
2498.asset_description: A young man in a white shirt and a woman in a flowing cream dress stand close together in a golden forest, holding hands in a tender embrace with their eyes closed.

2558.words: freedom (noun): the feeling of being free and held by nothing
2558.asset_description: A watercolour painting of a woman in a long dark dress rising weightlessly into the air with her arms spread wide, surrounded by orange and grey sunset clouds above a glowing sea, with a full moon in the corner.

2571.words: grumpy (adjective): in a bad mood and easily annoyed
2571.asset_description: A little boy with bright red curly hair, a red plaid beret and a plaid backpack looks over his shoulder with a pouty, annoyed face.

2576.words: heartbroken (adjective): extremely sad after losing someone you love
2576.asset_description: An old man in a dark coat sits hunched on a wet bench in the rain, holding a single red flower and staring down, with the Eiffel Tower fading in the fog behind him.

2723.words: furious (adjective): so angry that you shout and lose control
2723.asset_description: A muscular mythological warrior in a golden crown and red cloth roars with his mouth wide open and his arms spread, while lightning splits the black sky and fire burns around his legs.

2814.words: recline (verb): to lie back in a relaxed way
2814.asset_description: A dreamy painting of a blue-skinned god in orange robes lying back on a carved seat in the clouds, one arm bent behind his head and one leg stretched out, birds flying over the mountains and a lotus pond below.

2831.words: cheerful (adjective): bright and happy in a way that lifts you
2831.asset_description: A naive children's-book illustration of two little houses with red roofs on a yellow-green hill, under a teal sky filled with a big smiling sun, a smiling red heart, a floating pencil, a crescent moon and fluffy clouds.

3269.words: to relax (verb): to rest and let your body go calm
3269.asset_description: Vector illustration of a woman with long curly hair leaning back in a folding deck chair on a green rooftop terrace, eyes closed and one arm hanging loose, with a hillside of colourful houses and green mountains behind her.

4123.words: tears (noun): crying, with tears running down the face
4123.asset_description: A hand-drawn cartoon on a grey background. A girl with long dark hair kneels holding a sheet of paper marked with a big red A+. Her face crumples, her mouth turns down and two thick turquoise streams of tears run from her eyes. She throws her head back and wails with her mouth wide open while the tears gush out in great arcs on both sides of her head and pool on the ground around her knees, until she is kneeling in a spreading puddle of her own crying, still holding the paper. The cartoon then cuts to two grinning men in small gold crowns standing on a cliff, each holding up a sheet marked 50, waving them over a crowd of small figures cheering below.

4146.words: exhausted (adjective): extremely tired with no energy left
4146.asset_description: A man in a cream sweatshirt walks towards a grey sea at dusk, a thin pink line of sunset on the horizon. He pulls the sweatshirt off over his head as he walks, then runs into the shallow water and drops face down into the foam. He stays there, lying flat on the wet sand with his arms stretched out to the sides and his trainers still on, while the white foam of the waves washes over and around him.

4265.words: calm (verb): to make someone calm or still
4265.asset_description: A green cartoon parrot with a blazing red crest storms into a wood-panelled living room, wings spread and beak open in fury. A large blue parrot gets off the sofa and folds a wing around it. The red crest sinks and drains from fire-red to pale yellow to soft green, and the angry bird stops shouting, leans into the hug and closes its eyes.

4310.asset_description: A footballer in a green shirt stands in a floodlit stadium, her face wet with tears and her mouth open as she sings. Her team-mates stand in a line with their arms around each other's shoulders, singing toward the packed stand where a green flag waves. The camera returns to her; she is crying too hard to go on and covers her eyes with her hand.

4390.words: excitement (noun): the feeling of lively, cheerful joy
4390.asset_description: A woman in a bright blue jacket stands in a hallway with her hands clasped together, bouncing and beaming as if she cannot believe what is happening. Then she is outside at dusk with a friend, laughing and hurrying along a road towards a lit-up arena, and finally the two of them are in the crowd under coloured lights, holding each other's arms and jumping and dancing.

4506.words: comfort (noun): a relaxed state with no pain
4506.asset_description: Three people take a seat, one after another. A young man perches on a hard white kitchen chair, frowning and shifting about as he talks. A woman in a blue shirt sits up straight on a wooden dining chair with a thin cushion, hands in her lap, and smiles politely at the camera. Then a bearded man drops into a huge padded green armchair, sinks back into the cushions with his arms along the arms of the chair, closes his eyes and lets out a long sigh of relief.

4595.words: cry (verb): to shed tears because of sadness or pain
4595.asset_description: A young man in a green hoodie sits on a sofa in a living room at night, sobbing. His face is wet, his mouth is pulled down and his eyes are screwed up. He holds a tissue box on his lap, and the sofa around him is buried under a mound of crumpled white tissues. He pulls one tissue after another, presses it to his eyes, and drops it onto the pile.

4876.words: smile (verb): to spread your lips to show you are pleased
4876.asset_description: A woman in a yellow raincoat stands under a glass bus shelter in the rain, eyes squeezed shut and teeth showing in a wide smile, while a golden retriever puppy tucked inside her open jacket licks her chin. Behind her two other people wait for the bus with flat, miserable faces, staring down at the wet pavement. Warm yellow shop windows glow behind the rain-streaked glass.

4953.words: hope (verb): to wish for something and expect it to happen
4953.asset_description: A young woman leans over a terracotta flowerpot standing on a bright white windowsill. The pot holds only dark soil and nothing has come up yet. She waters it with a small metal can, then waits, biting her lip and pressing her clasped hands to her mouth, staring at the empty soil with an anxious face. Then a tiny green sprout pushes up through the soil; her eyes go wide, she gasps and finally smiles and cups her hands around the pot.

4997.asset_description: A selfie travel clip in three beats. First a young man with a camera round his neck holds the phone at arm's length in front of the Leaning Tower of Pisa and throws his head back with a loud open-mouthed laugh. Then he leans over the side of a gondola in a narrow Venice canal, laughing again and trailing his hand towards the green water under a small bridge with washing strung between the houses. Finally, in front of the Colosseum at sunset, a vendor hands him a huge ice cream stacked several scoops high and he laughs in disbelief as he holds it up.

5026.words: hilarious (adjective): very funny, causing wild laughter
5026.asset_description: A student with blue hair in a yellow hoodie sits in a lecture hall staring at his phone and laughing so hard that he covers his mouth and wipes tears out of his eyes. A girl with braids leans over to look at the screen and laughs with him, and a classmate behind them roars with his mouth wide open while the rest of the room carries on working.

5095.words: awe (noun): a huge feeling of wonder at something
5095.asset_description: Filmed on a selfie stick, a young man in glasses and a rust-coloured corduroy shirt leans over a museum display case of old coins, sketching them into a small notebook. He then walks through a picture gallery hung with gold-framed paintings, mouth falling open as he looks around. In the great hall he stops under an enormous mounted skeleton, tips his head right back and stares up at it open-mouthed, holding his notebook up, while a line of schoolchildren files past behind him.

5133.words: scream (verb): to cry out very loudly in fear
5133.asset_description: In a sunny park a group of young people play a freeze game on the grass. A man in a white t-shirt stands rigid with his eyes wide and his mouth open. A woman in black bounces towards the camera with her mouth wide open, crying out. Another man throws both hands up and shouts with his mouth wide open. The whole group then dances together on the lawn, one of them drops flat onto the grass, and the man in white cries out and laughs into the camera.

5174.words: cheerful (adjective): bright and happy in a way that lifts you
5174.asset_description: At an outdoor dinner table at dusk a young woman in a bright patterned dress pours orange juice from a glass jug into tall glasses while older relatives sit around the loaded table, laughing and clapping; she finally lifts the jug high over her head and pours a long stream into a glass.

5183.asset_description: A charcoal sketch of a lecture hall. An elderly man with wild white hair, round glasses and a long flowing coat strides at a blackboard, one arm flung out to write while a piece of chalk flies through the air behind him and his other hand is spread wide. The board is packed with arrows and diagrams; rows of students sit at desks behind him writing. His whole body is thrown into the explanation.

5185.words: kindness (noun): being considerate and sympathetic to others
5185.asset_description: Heavy rain on a city street. A frail elderly man in a dark jacket stands soaked, clutching a paper bag with two baguettes in it. A young person in a black raincoat steps in behind him and holds a big yellow umbrella over his head, taking all the rain themselves, then puts an arm around his shoulders. Water pours off the umbrella. The two walk on together under it and the old man smiles.

5188.words: disappointment (noun): the feeling when your expectations are not met
5188.asset_description: Two men on a wooden jetty on a still lake at dusk. A bearded man in a bucket hat fights a deeply bent fishing rod, winding the reel hard, sure he has a big fish. His friend sprints up the jetty with a landing net ready. What breaks the surface and swings up onto the planks is a green rubber boot full of water and weed. Both men stop dead and stare at it, the friend lowering the useless net.

5260.words: shame (noun): a painful feeling of guilt
5260.asset_description: A kitchen. A young man in a grey T-shirt sits at a counter and shovels a slice of strawberry cream cake into his mouth with a fork, cream smeared on his lips. A young woman in a purple cardigan appears in the doorway behind him and stands with her arms folded, staring at him. He freezes mid-bite, looks at her wide-eyed, pushes the plate away and finally hangs his head and hides his mouth behind his hand.

5311.words: calm (adjective): quiet, relaxed and not worried at all
5311.asset_description: A young woman sits in a warm living room strung with fairy lights, crying and rubbing the back of her neck. A friend drapes a thick knitted blanket over her shoulders, others lean in, hold her hands and put their arms around her. By the end the whole group is lying together under blankets on the sofa, quiet, still and smiling.

5335.words: enthusiastic (adjective): showing great excitement and interest
5335.asset_description: A young woman in a denim jacket and jeans springs up out of her seat in a packed football stadium, her face lit up, and cheers. She throws both arms above her head and claps hard while the fans around her get to their feet as well. The shot then widens: first the whole stand is up, then the full stadium under the floodlights at dusk.

5352.words: frustration (noun): the feeling of being blocked from your goals
5352.asset_description: A young woman works late at a cluttered desk under a single angled lamp, a pencil clamped in her teeth, typing on a laptop half-buried in loose paper. Behind her the wall is papered with sticky notes and printouts, a tottering stack of documents rises beside the screen and her phone lies face-up on the table. She reads a sheet, then both hands fly to her head - she grips her hair, screws her face up and screams at the screen, then collapses forward with her head in her hands over the keyboard.

5387.words: sorrow (noun): deep sadness, especially about a loss
5387.asset_description: An extreme close-up of an eye with a tear welling up and rolling down the cheek. The shot widens to two friends lying together on a sofa at night under a thick knitted blanket, both crying, faces screwed up. One pulls tissues from a box on the blanket and hands one over; they dab their eyes and blow their noses, then lean their heads together and keep watching, still in tears.

5413.words: hopeless (adjective): without hope that things can get better
5413.asset_description: A dark ink-and-wash comic panel of a city gridlock at dusk. Cars, vans and a box lorry stand nose to tail across every lane under an elevated flyover, tail lights glowing red and exhaust smoke drifting between them, with the jam stretching away to the horizon. In the foreground a driver has climbed halfway out of his car window and raised an open hand at the unmoving queue, a man in a cap leans out of the van beside him, and a motorcyclist edges along the narrow gap between the lanes. Blank billboards and tower blocks fill the smoky skyline behind, and nothing in the picture has any way out.

37.words: advance (verb): to move forward towards a goal
37.asset_description: Three roped mountain climbers in colorful jackets push forward step by step up a snowy ridge, advancing toward an orange flag planted on the summit; they reach the top together and throw their arms up in triumph.
37.transcript: Come on! Keep coming! We made it!

185.words: commute (verb): to travel regularly between home and work
185.asset_description: A 3D-animated young man with a coffee and shoulder bag runs to catch a morning tram, yawns while holding a strap among passengers, walks into a glass office building, and in the evening rides back and cheers with relief outside his home.

189.words: convoy (noun): a group of vehicles traveling together
189.asset_description: Three modified black, grey and white sports cars drive in formation down a tree-lined road, filmed from another car, then park side by side under a motorway bridge while the camera circles their bronze rims, spoilers and exhausts. Music only, no speech.

375.words: race car (noun): a very fast car built for racing on a track
375.asset_description: A driver in a white racing suit takes his black helmet off a formula car, puts it on and fastens it, climbs into the tight cockpit, grips the button-covered steering wheel and drives off down the empty race track at sunrise.

517.words: overtake (verb): to pass a slower vehicle and get ahead
517.asset_description: In a cel-animated desert highway scene, a red sports car pulls alongside a slow beige camper van, speeds past it and swings in front. The camper shrinks in the distance while the grinning driver whoops and races ahead.

1035.words: destination (noun): the place you are travelling to
1035.asset_description: Cars sit bumper to bumper in a huge motorway traffic jam outside a city skyline; one driver leans out of his window to see ahead.

1416.words: tunnel (noun): a passage cut under the ground for traffic
1416.asset_description: A motorcyclist in black rides out of the arched mouth of a road tunnel lit by rows of orange lights, with cars blurring past inside it.

2019.words: locomotive (noun): the engine at the front that pulls a train
2019.asset_description: A painting of an old steam locomotive coming down the rails toward the viewer, pouring thick dark smoke from its funnel, with red freight cars behind it and snowy mountains and autumn forest in the background.

2071.words: vintage (adjective): old but classic and high quality
2071.asset_description: A shiny vintage red car with round headlights and a chrome grille stands snow-covered in front of a house decorated with Christmas garlands; a wreath hangs on the car's front.

2380.words: escape (verb): to get away from danger
2380.asset_description: A dark sports car races at an angle through a burning forest, orange flames and glowing embers swirling around its wheels while red sparks fill the smoky sky between black trees.

2601.words: kneel (verb): to go down and rest on your knees
2601.asset_description: A long-haired robed man kneels on stone ground with his hands folded in prayer while a small girl stands before him with her head bowed; open books lie at their feet.

2725.words: crouch (verb): to bend your knees down close to the ground
2725.asset_description: A monkey-faced deity in orange trousers and heavy gold jewellery crouches on a grey rock high above a valley, one hand resting on the stone and a golden mace leaning on his shoulder.

2754.words: steam (noun): the hot white cloud boiling water turns into
2754.asset_description: A painted black steam locomotive with red carriages comes down the tracks towards the viewer at sunset, its headlights lit and a tall plume of white-grey steam rising from its funnel into an orange sky.

2801.words: headlight (noun): the strong lamp on the front of a vehicle
2801.asset_description: A big black steam locomotive comes straight down snowy tracks through a winter forest, black smoke pouring from its stack, its round front lamps burning orange in the grey light.

2897.words: sleigh (noun): an open vehicle that slides over snow
2897.asset_description: A glossy painted scene of Santa's empty red-and-gold sleigh standing in deep snow between frosted fir trees at night, its back piled high with brightly wrapped presents under a starry sky.

3301.words: to steer (verb): to turn a wheel to control where a boat goes
3301.asset_description: Pencil sketch of an older man in a heavy sailor's coat gripping the big wooden wheel of a ship with both hands, teeth clenched and hair blown back as he holds the ship on course.

3401.words: traffic light (noun): the lights that tell cars to stop and go
3401.asset_description: Cartoon close-up of a yellow traffic light against a pale blue sky; instead of lamps, the top circle is filled with red flowers, the middle one with a big yellow daisy and the bottom one with green leaves.

3472.words: to spin (verb): to turn round and round quickly
3472.asset_description: A woman in a long red dress turns on the spot in a formal garden with clipped hedges, pink flower beds and cypress trees; her wide skirt swings out around her.

3493.words: footprints (noun): the marks your feet leave on soft ground
3493.asset_description: Simple silhouette poster: a woman in a long dress walks away over a brown hill towards a huge pale sun, leaving a long line of footprints in the ground behind her.

3813.words: path (noun): a narrow marked way that you walk along
3813.asset_description: A minimalist grey illustration shows a lone figure in a hoodie with a backpack standing on a wide empty plaza with arches, looking along a winding orange, yellow and blue line painted across the paving into the distance.

4014.words: roll (verb): to move by turning over and over
4014.asset_description: A young man in a white shirt and red shorts rides a skateboard through an empty airport car park, towing a hard-shell suitcase along beside him by its handle. He carries on down a glazed walkway, steps onto a travelator at sunset and glides out across the open roof deck past concrete bollards.

4051.words: motorcycle (noun): a motor vehicle with two wheels
4051.asset_description: In a car park a man in a black t-shirt and cap stands beside a huge grey six-wheeled expedition truck with a living box built onto the back. He bends down at a rack on the truck's flank and pulls a black electric motorcycle out on its carrier, then stands holding it by the handlebars in front of the truck's giant wheels while he talks to the camera. He then walks through the wood-lined interior of the truck, past a black oven and microwave, a bed and a sink under a skylight, with two long-haired grey cats sitting on the counter and the bed.
4051.transcript: Yo, what is this? It's an electric motorcycle I charge off my truck. No, the truck. Oh, that's my house. Induction cooktop, full bed, even a skylight.

4071.words: leap (verb): to move forward in big jumps
4071.asset_description: A rusted shipwreck stands tilted out of bright turquoise shallows under a sky of white clouds. A woman in a bikini runs along the wreck's raised bow, bends her knees and leaps off the end, stretching out flat as she flies over the water. She hits the surface and the shot follows her down in a stream of white bubbles. Underwater she levels off above a sandy bottom dotted with coral heads, where several large tiger sharks are cruising. She swims in among them and glides right alongside one, her arms wrapped loosely around its back, as a second shark passes behind.

4079.asset_description: A point-of-view shot from the front of a yellow kayak dropping into a white-water river in a steep pine gorge. The pale green water rushes past on both sides, piling into standing waves and white foam between dark rocks, and the boat is carried down fast. A hand works a black paddle across the bow, spray bursts over the lens and blurs it, and the walls of fir trees rush by. The river then widens and slows, and the kayak arrives at a calm stretch where four paddlers in red kayaks and helmets are waiting on a grey gravel bank.

4098.words: way (noun): a line or route leading to a place
4098.asset_description: A helmet-camera view from a mountain bike on a narrow dirt track that runs along a steep green alpine ridge, with deep valleys and misty mountains beyond. Two brown cows with bells around their necks are standing right on the track, blocking the only way through. One walks straight at the camera and the rider reaches out a gloved hand and pushes its face gently aside. The cows step off the path, and the rider rolls on down the empty track over the ridge.
4098.transcript: Excuse me, coming through. You going or am I going? Okay, I'm going.

4150.asset_description: A dark green sports car speeds along a narrow country road, filmed from a camera held close to its side so the grass at the roadside blurs past. Close-ups show the rear wing with the badge on it, and a gold wheel with a yellow brake spinning fast just above the gravel. Another shot runs along the green bonnet towards the road ahead. At the end the car stands still on a sandy track by the dunes with the sea behind it, and a man in a brown t-shirt walks up to it.

4152.words: vehicle (noun): something that transports people or objects
4152.asset_description: A large black closed trailer stands on a gravel drive in front of green summer trees, filmed from behind. Its whole back wall begins to tip down slowly, turning into a ramp. As the ramp lowers, the dark inside of the trailer appears and a pale grey sports car is revealed standing inside it. The ramp comes all the way down to the gravel so the car could be driven straight out.

4199.words: drag (verb): to pull something along with effort
4199.asset_description: A paraglider under a red and white wing flies along a grey rock face above a thick pine forest in the mountains. He comes down over a still turquoise lake and pulls his feet through the water, cutting a long white line of spray across the surface, with the whole red wing mirrored in the lake beneath him. He lifts away again, flies over the shore and drops onto a green meadow, where the wing sinks down behind him and a group of people sit at the edge of the grass watching.

4201.words: upright (adjective): in a vertical position, standing up
4201.asset_description: Two riders on blue dirt bikes ride side by side across a wide beach at sunset. The sand is covered by a film of water that mirrors the pink and orange clouds so completely that the shot looks like sky above and below. Both riders pull the front wheels of their bikes off the ground and hold them there, so the machines stand almost vertical on their back wheels, their reflections rising to meet them in the wet sand. They ride on into the sunset still standing the bikes up on end.

4218.words: engine (noun): a motor that turns heat into movement
4218.asset_description: A corgi sits at the wheel of an old rust-orange tractor and drives it down a narrow road through green vineyards on a sunny day. The camera stays in front of the tractor, filling the frame with its big ribbed radiator grille, round headlamps and upright exhaust pipe. Halfway through, a thick cloud of black smoke bursts from the exhaust pipe as the motor is worked harder, and the tractor keeps rolling towards the camera past the vines and a stone farmhouse on the hill.

4270.asset_description: A point-of-view shot from inside a go-kart: a driver in a bright striped racing suit grips the small steering wheel and speeds along a sunlit tarmac circuit with red and white kerbs, tyre barriers and eucalyptus trees, another kart running ahead. Then a duck waddles out onto the track in front, and the kart drops from full speed to a crawl and creeps along behind the bird until it has crossed.

4273.words: collision (noun): when two or more bodies come together and hit
4273.asset_description: An illustrated street scene at dusk. A dark blue saloon has run head-on into the side of a beige hatchback in the middle of a crossroads; the blue car's bonnet is folded up and smoking and one hubcap has rolled away across the road among scattered broken glass. A man in a brown jacket throws both arms up in shock while a man in a green coat runs to the hatchback's driver door. Bystanders watch from the pavement in front of lit shopfronts.

4412.words: block (verb): to make a way unsuitable for passage
4412.asset_description: A delivery driver in a hi-vis vest leans out of his van window in a narrow old town street where a parked lorry leaves him no room to pass. He edges into a market square full of crates and market stalls that leave no way through. Then, on a mountain road, a whole flock of sheep fills the tarmac from verge to verge and walks straight at the van; the driver leans out shouting while the shepherd waves him back and the sheep press against the door.

4419.words: row (verb): to move a boat with oars
4419.asset_description: A soft pastel cartoon of a girl in dungarees and a striped top sitting in a little wooden boat on a calm pond. She holds an oar in each hand, one blade lifted clear of the water and flicking up droplets, the other dipping in and leaving a swirl behind it. A golden puppy lies over the bow watching the water; lily pads, bulrushes, a small jetty and rounded hills fill the background.

4466.words: aboard (adverb): on a ship, train, plane or other vehicle
4466.asset_description: A man in a cap and dark T-shirt gets onto one vehicle after another. He climbs into a crowded minibus and squeezes past the other passengers with his bag. He steps up through the doors of a modern city bus and holds a travel card out to the card reader beside the driver. Inside, he stands in the aisle holding the rail while the bus, full of seated passengers, moves off. Then he climbs the steps of a red open-top tour bus, and sits on the top deck with both arms flung wide as the bus drives between skyscrapers.

4647.words: to spin (verb): to turn round and round quickly
4647.asset_description: In an open-plan office a young man in a denim jacket sits on a black office chair with his feet up and whirls himself round and round on it. He stops and stands up, but staggers sideways with his arms out and his eyes wide, and has to grab the edge of a desk to stay upright. He leans over the desk holding on, then slides down and sits on the floor holding his forehead while a colleague watches from behind.

4662.words: supply (verb): to give something useful or necessary
4662.asset_description: A small propeller plane flies low over green grassland and releases a wooden crate from beneath its fuselage. The crate comes down under a parachute and lands in the grass, where a smiling woman in a striped robe runs up and takes hold of it by the handles. The plane circles back and drops a whole string of crates, each on its own coloured parachute, and the sky fills with them. Villagers walk out from their white round tents to collect the boxes, and the woman raises both arms towards the descending parachutes.

4698.words: motor (noun): a machine that turns energy into motion
4698.asset_description: A man in blue overalls works in a workshop on a stripped scooter whose engine block sits exposed in the frame, tightening a part with a screwdriver and grinning at it. The shot cuts to an open car bonnet with the four-cylinder engine, belts, alternator and hoses in plain view. Then he is outside on the grass beside a huge chrome-topped V8 engine mounted on a black steel stand, first pushing it, then standing back with his hands on his head, astonished at the size of it.

4702.words: escape (verb): to get away from danger
4702.asset_description: A brown and white goat pushes its head out between the boards of a wooden gate in a barn pen where other goats are standing. It works its horns and shoulders through the gap and squeezes its whole body out of the pen. Outside, a farmer in a straw hat lunges for it past a row of feed sacks but misses, and the goat gallops off down a red dirt track between rows of olive trees, growing smaller as it runs away.

4703.words: raise (verb): to move something from lower to higher
4703.asset_description: A man in a navy suit and a white hard hat presses a carved wooden sign into place above the door of a new stone building, then pulls a cord to drop the cloth covering beside it. Outside on the steps he hauls on a halyard and pulls a green flag up a tall white flagpole while a crowd of people in suits and hard hats claps and two drummers play. He then cuts a teal ribbon stretched across the steps and the crowd applauds.

4890.words: circle (verb): to travel around something in a ring
4890.asset_description: A rainbow-striped spinning top spins on the hexagonal paving of a city park while a teenage boy circles around it with one leg swung out; more and more people join in, running in a wide ring around the spinning top while the city skyline glows behind them at sunset.

4902.words: submarine (noun): a warship that travels under water
4902.asset_description: Swimmers splash and laugh in a calm blue lake; behind them a long dark grey military submarine rises out of the water with its conning tower streaming water, and then a humpback whale breaches beside it and throws spray over the swimmers.

4918.asset_description: A young man in a grey hoodie jogs along a suburban pavement in golden evening light. In close-up he takes a full paper grocery bag from an elderly woman's hands. Carrying a bag under each arm, he climbs the flight of steps up to her house, where the white-haired woman waits smiling by the porch railing. His hand steadies a loaded shopping trolley rolling along the pavement. Finally he stands beside her and gives a thumbs-up to the camera.

4932.words: to steer (verb): to turn a wheel to control where a boat goes
4932.asset_description: A hand pats the lit TAXI sign on the roof of a yellow cab, with tall city buildings behind it. From alongside the moving car we see it driving down a wide avenue into a low sun, other traffic ahead. Inside, over the shoulder of the driver, a young woman in a flat cap, white shirt and dark waistcoat holds the steering wheel with one hand and turns it as she follows the car in front through the traffic. She then leans out of the open driver's window at the kerb, grinning at the camera, and finally raises her hand to the brim of her cap and tips it.

4976.words: wade (verb): to walk through shallow water
4976.asset_description: A woodblock-style print of flooded rice terraces: a barefoot farmer in a dark tunic, rolled trousers and a conical straw hat walks along a narrow earth dike, ankle-deep in the shallow water, with ripples and splashes curling around his feet. White long-legged birds lift off from the paddies behind him and a smoking volcano rises above the terraces and palm trees under a pink dawn sky.

4998.words: tunnel (noun): a passage cut under the ground for traffic
4998.asset_description: A selfie travel clip in three beats. A young man in a yellow jacket with a camera round his neck holds the phone out on a crowded city crossing at dusk, with lit screens and pedestrians behind him. Then the camera moves forward down a long shaded passage formed by hundreds of orange shrine gates standing one behind the other, with a bright opening far ahead at the end. Finally he sits at a lit night stall under red paper lanterns and eats a bowl of ramen with chopsticks.

5156.words: kneel (verb): to go down and rest on your knees
5156.asset_description: Under floodlights on a small caged pitch, a footballer in a yellow number 10 shirt takes the ball past a defender in dark blue, drives into space and finishes. He runs towards the goal, drops down onto his knees on the grass and stays there, head back, mouth wide open, shouting, until a teammate in the same yellow shirt arrives and grabs him round the shoulders while spectators press against the fence behind them.

5160.words: dash (verb): to run or move very quickly
5160.asset_description: A black-and-white ink drawing of a rainy night on an old European market square: a young man in a long open coat runs at full stride across the wet cobbles, arms swinging, while a dozen pigeons burst into flight around him. Rain streaks down the sky, a tall church tower, a clock tower and an arcaded market hall stand behind him, a lit street lamp glows on the right, and the lamplight reflects in the puddles between the cobblestones.

5166.words: track (noun): the pair of rails that wheels run along
5166.asset_description: An illustrated hillside street in an old Portuguese city at sunset. Washing hangs on lines strung between the pastel houses. A yellow tram comes down the slope on the right with sparks flying from the wheel where it meets the metal rails set into the cobbles. A young woman with a shoulder bag is caught mid-leap off the tram's step onto the street, and the sea and the setting sun fill the gap at the end of the road. Two parallel rails run from the bottom of the frame up the middle of the cobbled street.

5187.words: wagon (noun): a wheeled vehicle pulled by a tractor or animal
5187.asset_description: A sunny mown grass field under a clear blue sky. A teenage boy in a white t-shirt and black shorts leans right back and hauls a thick rope towards himself hand over hand, face screwed up with the strain. The camera pulls back and the other end of the rope turns out to be tied to a green two-wheeled farm wagon, which rolls slowly across the grass behind him. He gets it moving, drops the rope and grins.

5210.words: retreat (verb): to move back or away from something
5210.asset_description: Three friends are having a picnic on a checked blanket in a park by a pond when a big white goose marches straight at them. They shuffle backwards with their hands raised, one still clutching a sandwich; as the goose spreads its wings they scramble to their feet and run off across the grass, abandoning the blanket. The goose stands on the blanket over the sandwiches, honking, while the group watches from a safe distance further down the path.

5216.words: stroll (noun): a slow, relaxed walk for pleasure
5216.asset_description: A woman in a long yellow dress with a film camera round her neck walks slowly through a narrow lantern-lit alley at dusk, then wanders between the stalls of a night flower market, and finally steps out onto a rooftop and spreads her arms in front of a city skyline at sunset.

5221.words: wind (verb): to move in a curving, twisting course
5221.asset_description: A woodblock-style print seen from above: a sandy path twists in long S-curves from the bottom of the picture, up and across green mountain ridges, and away toward a snow-capped peak in the distance. A lone traveller with a straw hat, cloak and walking staff is partway along it, small stone cairns mark the bends, and a blue lake with birds over it lies in the valley to the left.

5222.words: steps (noun): a flight of stairs you walk up or down
5222.asset_description: A hiker with a rucksack traces a red line across a laminated map with her finger, checks a trail information board at the edge of a forest, runs up a dusty path past a boulder painted with a red-and-white waymark, then climbs a long flight of stone steps built into the mountainside, and at the top holds the map up to the camera and points at the line she has just walked.

5235.words: cargo (noun): goods carried by a large vehicle
5235.asset_description: A woman in a light blue uniform shirt and a peaked cap with a winged badge stands in a container terminal, checking papers on a clipboard that already carry round red marks. She lifts a heavy red stamp over her head and brings it down hard, first on the paperwork and then on the lids of big wooden shipping crates lined up on a rack, watched by dockworkers in hi-vis vests. The shot then runs down a long aisle between walls of stacked shipping containers, with gantry cranes lowering their spreaders overhead and a forklift parked among more crates, and ends with her standing alone in the middle of the aisle.

5247.words: footprints (noun): the marks your feet leave on soft ground
5247.asset_description: A trail of big muddy footprints runs the whole length of a white tiled hallway. A small elderly woman in an apron stands at one end holding a mop and wags her finger at a large young man in a black T-shirt who is holding a motorcycle helmet; his boots and his dog are both caked in mud. She hands him the mop, he lowers his head and takes it, and starts pushing it over the prints while the dog sits and watches.

5264.words: shift (verb): to change the place something is in
5264.asset_description: In a sunlit flat with a mustard-yellow sofa and many houseplants, a woman rearranges the living room. She pulls the sofa across the parquet floor into a new position, kneels to push the oval coffee table onto the rug and straightens the books and vase on it, then lifts a large abstract canvas onto the wall above a wooden shelf unit. The last shot is filmed from the doorway: she sits down on the sofa and spreads her arms out along its back.

5337.words: rail (noun): the railway, the train system
5337.asset_description: A young man films himself with an outstretched arm on a small country railway platform while an orange and grey train pulls in behind him on the rails; he is holding a croissant. The shot cuts to him walking through a busy indoor railway station under big departure boards, commuters and rolling suitcases around him and the croissant in his mouth. He ends alone on a wide platform under a huge arched glass roof, tracks running away on both sides, looking up into the light.

5339.words: control (verb): to handle a machine and make it function
5339.asset_description: A woman in a denim shirt sits in the driver's seat of a small parked car with her seat belt on, both hands on the steering wheel, turning it one way and then the other and watching where the car points. The shot cuts to the same woman in the driver's cab of a city bus, taking hold of a huge flat steering wheel with both hands and turning it, grinning at how big it is, with buses and the depot visible through the windscreen.

5345.words: lean (verb): to rest your body sideways on something
5345.asset_description: A blonde woman in an orange running top jogs along a riverside bridge beside a running partner. Her face twists, she grabs her side and slows to a halt, then lays her forearm on the white bridge railing and rests her weight against it, bent forward and screwing up her face while her partner stops next to her.

5360.words: metro (noun): an electric railway that runs below the ground
5360.asset_description: A young man with bleached hair, glasses and a varsity jacket films himself pulling the camera along by the hand through an underground station. He taps through the ticket gate, stands on the platform as a train rolls in, steps into the carriage among other passengers, and then walks down a long underground corridor packed shoulder to shoulder with commuters, looking back at the camera with an astonished face.

5389.words: dodge (verb): to make a sudden move to avoid something
5389.asset_description: In a bright living room a young man holds an orange snack packet up over his head while a young woman in a red football kit jumps for it. Every time she lunges he twists sharply away, ducking low and darting sideways across the rug so her hands miss him. He crouches, spins past her and keeps the packet out of her reach, until she finally corners him, takes it, and they both sit down on the sofa with it, laughing.

5416.words: locomotive (noun): the engine at the front that pulls a train
5416.asset_description: A woman with a wheeled suitcase stands on a station platform on a bright day. A train comes in on the far track, then a bright orange electric locomotive rolls slowly past her at the head of its carriages, close enough to fill the frame, and she turns and beams at it. A blue regional train passes on the next track, and the clip cuts to a glass-roofed station hall where the long white nose of a high-speed train slides in beside the platform.

5417.words: depot (noun): a place where trams or buses are kept
5417.asset_description: A young woman in a mustard coat with a canvas tote bag steps up to an old red wooden tram standing in a cobbled old-town street and boards it, her mouth open in delight. Inside the carriage she leans towards the window and watches pastel-coloured townhouses slide past. The tram then runs into a large tram yard: several trams stand on parallel rails under a web of overhead wires, and she stands on the narrow platform between the tracks looking around at them.

5418.words: interior (noun): the space that is inside of something
5418.asset_description: A woman in a mustard coat climbs the wooden steps up into an old red tram from the street. The camera follows her inside, where the whole carriage is visible from within: varnished wooden benches, a wooden floor, brass handrails and windows on both sides. She leans out through the open side of the carriage and grins as the cobbled street and old houses pass. At the end she steps out of the tram onto a station platform where a long modern white tram is waiting.

5419.words: transfer (noun): moving something from one place to another
5419.asset_description: A man with a backpack jumps out of an underground metro train and runs across the station floor towards the stairs. Outside he sprints along the pavement towards a red and white tram waiting at a stop, then keeps running down a city street to catch a bus at the kerb. Finally he runs up a metal gangway onto a passenger ferry at a harbour quay, with cranes across the water behind him.

5420.words: vessel (noun): a craft built for travel on water
5420.asset_description: A man in an olive jacket with a backpack walks off a metro train onto the platform among other passengers, then jogs along a sunny street towards a red and cream tram and steps up through its open door. He then runs across a stone quay past flying seagulls towards the water, where a white passenger boat with a small wheelhouse and an open deck is moored. He walks up the metal gangway and steps aboard the boat.

5428.words: freight (noun): goods carried by a big truck or ship
5428.asset_description: A logistics yard under a clear blue sky. A bearded worker in a hi-vis jacket and work gloves stands beside a pickup stacked with shrink-wrapped pallets of cardboard boxes and pats the load. He turns and waves a large chrome-fronted American semi-truck forward; it rolls in towing a rusty steel shipping container, the driver waving from the high cab. The worker guides it past him along the gravel and grins as the container rolls by.

5492.words: spoke (noun): a bar joining a wheel's hub to its rim
5492.asset_description: A rough charcoal drawing of a big tyred wheel standing upright on a workshop floor. The thin metal spokes run out from the central hub in a criss-cross pattern to the rim, and the axle stub sticks out of the middle. A gloved hand reaches in from the right and holds the wheel steady; behind it a car body is dimly sketched and spanners and other tools lie scattered on the ground.

5493.words: hub (noun): the central part of a wheel, around the axle
5493.asset_description: In a bike workshop a young man in an apron holds a tiny white scooter wheel right up to the camera so its dark metal centre and bearing fill the frame. He then swings a blue bicycle upside down and spins its front wheel, and the camera drops low to follow the tyre and the silver centre with its spokes fanning out. Next he walks up to a huge black tractor tyre on a yellow rim taller than he is and stares at its bolted centre. Finally the camera tilts up at a giant ferris wheel against a blue sky, its spokes running out from the white centre, with the tractor tyre still in the bottom of the shot.

6.words: cushion (noun): a soft pillow-like pad you sit or lean on
6.asset_description: An animated man sits on a hard window bench and winces, rubbing his sore back. He fetches a yellow cushion, sits on it happily, then comically piles up more and more cushions and gives a thumbs up.
6.transcript: Ouch! It's not enough. Ah, yes.

839.words: extend (verb): to make something longer or bigger
839.asset_description: In a high-rise apartment an older man shows off his dining table: he slides it apart, drops extension leaves into the middle and the table grows to twice its length; he celebrates, planks on the matching bench and finally sits at the huge table.

859.words: wardrobe (noun): a tall cupboard where clothes hang and are stored
859.asset_description: An anime girl opens a big wooden wardrobe packed with hanging coats and folded sweaters. She browses the hangers, holds a yellow coat and a red dress against herself, gets buried when scarves and a hat tumble off the shelf, then stuffs everything back and shuts the doors.

917.words: attic (noun): the room under the roof, used for storing things
917.asset_description: A man strains to lift an old leather trunk in a dusty attic under bare wooden roof beams, sunlight falling through a skylight onto cobwebs, stacked suitcases, cardboard boxes, an old lamp and a vintage pram.

1189.words: mattress (noun): the thick soft part of a bed you lie on
1189.asset_description: A man and a woman carry a large quilted mattress up a narrow staircase during a house move, cardboard boxes stacked by the door behind them.

1861.words: antique (adjective): old, valuable and from an earlier time
1861.asset_description: A rendered scene of an antique carved chaise longue with a black wooden swan as its backrest, gold cushions and a red seat, standing on a wooden floor before draped curtains and snowy trees.

1951.words: armchair (noun): a big soft chair with supports for your arms
1951.asset_description: A moody painting of an old library room: a worn brown leather armchair stands by a tall arched window, surrounded by curving walls of bookshelves and stacks of books piled on the floor and a small table.

1982.words: cluttered (adjective): untidily full of far too many things
1982.asset_description: A warm-lit old room crammed with shelves overflowing with bottles, jars, plates, boxes and trinkets on every wall, with golden sunlight pouring through a small window.

2026.words: study (noun): a room at home used for reading and working
2026.asset_description: A lush painted room: a wooden desk with a golden globe lamp and fruit stands before tall bookshelves, while vines and bright flowers cascade around an open window with a view of clouds and hills.

2028.words: jug (noun): a container with a handle for holding liquid
2028.asset_description: A close-up painting of a wooden bookcase packed with old leather-bound books in warm colors; on one lower shelf a round white jug with a handle and metal lid sits among the books.

2049.asset_description: A worn leather armchair sits in a cozy reading corner before a tall arched window, surrounded on both sides by floor-to-ceiling shelves and piles of old books.

2064.words: snow globe (noun): a glass ball with a tiny scene and snow inside
2064.asset_description: A glass snow globe on a wooden base holds a miniature glowing church and snowy fir trees while golden snowflakes drift inside it against a blurred festive background.

2075.words: windowsill (noun): the flat shelf at the bottom of a window
2075.asset_description: A row of old books and a glowing lantern stand on a wide windowsill; through the window behind them, Christmas trees sparkle with strings of golden lights.

2078.words: flame (noun): the bright burning part of a fire or candle
2078.asset_description: Two candles on tall wooden candlesticks burn with warm flames beside an open book on a desk, in a dark room whose window is overgrown with green vines.

2109.words: tidy (adjective): arranged neatly and in good order
2109.asset_description: A flat-style illustration of bookshelves where colorful books stand upright in perfectly straight, tidy rows on every shelf.

2192.words: flask (noun): a narrow-necked glass container for liquids
2192.asset_description: A warmly lit wizard's cabinet: rows of glowing glass flasks and bottles in gold, green and blue stand on wooden shelves above old leather books, with a large open book on the desk below.

2250.words: gaze (verb): to look at something steadily for a long time
2250.asset_description: A girl stands at a tall window at night and gazes quietly out at a rainy city glowing with lights under a dark cloudy sky with a small moon.

2311.words: stained glass (noun): coloured glass pieces forming a picture
2311.asset_description: A grand dark room with towering stained glass windows in blue and pink patterns, pink blossom branches growing along the walls and a tufted pink sofa with cushions in the middle.

2397.words: gloomy (adjective): dark and sad, without light or cheer
2397.asset_description: A vast dark gothic room with tall arched windows letting in pale misty light, old tufted sofas and armchairs around a low table, and shadows swallowing the corners.

2434.words: still life (noun): a painting of arranged objects like flowers
2434.asset_description: An oil painting of pink blossom branches in a metal jug on a windowsill, with small bottles and cups beside it and a view of a river and old houses outside the window.

2475.words: barefoot (adjective): wearing nothing on your feet
2475.asset_description: A barefoot girl in a light blue dress sits on a green daybed in a sunlit book-filled room, reading a red hardcover book; stacks of books and a glowing lamp surround her and her bare feet rest on the floor.

2530.words: candlelight (noun): the warm light of a burning candle
