2530.asset_description: A black ornate lantern hangs among pink and orange roses on a dark blue background; inside its glass, a single candle burns and fills the scene with warm golden candlelight.

2537.words: bedtime story (noun): a story read to children before sleep
2537.asset_description: A watercolor storybook scene seen from above: a boy and a girl with rosy cheeks sit side by side on a big patchwork bed while the girl reads aloud from an open book.

2546.words: spacious (adjective): having a lot of open room inside
2546.asset_description: An anime-style hall with an enormous arched stained-glass window towering over a small pink sofa, lamps and pink blossom trees, with a city skyline visible far below outside.

2661.words: tile (noun): a flat square piece covering a floor
2661.asset_description: A grand old room with golden walls, heavy curtains and a long striped sofa, standing on a floor of big black and white tiles laid in a checkerboard pattern; a palm plant sits by the tall window.

2670.words: drawer (noun): a box that slides in and out of furniture
2670.asset_description: A watercolour of an old wooden table under a big arched window; a globe, a coffee pot, a glass and an open book stand on top, and a single drawer with a round knob is set into the front of the table, with a dark hanging lamp above and shelves of jars around.

2750.words: houseplant (noun): a plant kept indoors in a pot for decoration
2750.asset_description: A flat illustration on a cream background: a leafy green plant grows out of a round pot painted with red, yellow and blue rings, standing on two stacked books next to a pair of glasses on a narrow indoor shelf.

2910.words: bookshelf (noun): shelves where books stand side by side
2910.asset_description: A gentle watercolour of a small boy in a striped orange jumper standing with an open book in his hands in front of a tall wooden shelf unit packed with rows of colourful books, with potted plants on top and beside it.

3516.words: vase (noun): a container you put flowers in
3516.asset_description: Still life: a smooth white vase stands on a shelf holding one big open pink flower with dark green leaves, against a half dark green, half cream wall.

4017.words: lantern (noun): a lamp in a case that you hang or carry
4017.asset_description: A slow tour of a loft flat as the day ends. Low sun throws long bars across the herringbone floor and a big round red paper lantern glows beside the window. The kitchen is lit only by a strip under the units, then a warm orange paper lantern hangs over a bed facing the city skyline at dusk, and finally strings of bulbs and candles light a roof terrace at night.

4078.words: pillow (noun): a cushion for your head when you sleep
4078.asset_description: A plain bedroom with a woven wall hanging above an enormous bed made up in white. A row of seven identical white pillows is lined up along the head of the bed against the wall. A woman in a black top and grey joggers climbs onto the end of the bed and crawls slowly up the middle of it on her hands and knees, dragging the white duvet into long folds behind her. When she reaches the top she turns, drops back against the row of pillows and flings her arms out wide, lying flat with the pillows behind her head.

4234.words: closet (noun): a small room or cabinet for storage
4234.asset_description: In a cartoon bedroom a woman in blue pyjamas with a towel wrapped round her hair stands with both arms flung up, scowling. The shot cuts to a large walk-in closet, its shelves stacked with neatly folded jumpers in every colour and a rail of bright dresses. A man rushes through it in a blur, dragging everything off the shelves and rails until a huge mound of clothes fills the floor. He ends up standing on top of the pile with his arms spread wide, laughing.

4251.words: space (noun): an empty area between things
4251.asset_description: An animated walk-in wardrobe. A hand points along a completely bare wooden shelf and an empty hanging rail on one side of the room, then sweeps across to the other side. The camera pulls back to show the whole wardrobe crammed with pink and purple clothes on the rails and folded in stacks on every shelf, with a deep heap of clothes covering the floor. A muscular cartoon man in a white T-shirt and grey joggers stands in the middle of the heap staring at it, and the shot closes in on his shocked face.
4251.transcript: This is your side, and this is my side, okay? Okay. Where am I supposed to put my clothes? Here, put them here.

4328.words: rug (noun): a thick heavy fabric floor covering
4328.asset_description: A loose watercolour of a living room. A young woman has flopped backwards into a large floral armchair with her legs thrown up over the back, feet in the air, and has just tossed a yellow cushion up above her — it hangs in mid-air over the chair. A tall floor lamp stands to the left, a mug sits on a small wooden side table to the right, and a big window with curtains fills the background. On the pale floor in front of the chair lies a patterned rug with a fringed edge, and a second cushion has landed on the floor beside it.

4384.words: bounce (verb): to spring back after hitting something
4384.asset_description: A pastel cartoon bedroom. A girl in pyjamas is caught in mid-air above her bed, knees bent and hair flying upwards, having just sprung off the mattress. The duvet is flung up on one side and two pillows float in the air around her. A bedside table with a round lamp stands to the right.

4403.words: layer (noun): a single thickness of some material
4403.asset_description: A man in a grey jumper sits on a sofa in a sunlit living room and reaches for a folded blanket beside him. He throws it over himself, then another, then another, each one a different colour and pattern, until he is buried under a thick pile of woollen blankets with only his grinning face showing above them.

4450.words: patch (noun): a small part that looks different from the rest
4450.asset_description: A cartoon of a children's bedroom with a wooden bunk bed. A laughing boy in blue dungarees carries a smaller boy upside down over his shoulder. The dungarees are worn out and have square patches of a different shade of cloth stitched onto the leg and the hip, the stitching drawn as a line of little dashes around each one. On the lower bunk lies a quilt sewn together from many differently coloured squares, and a cushion made of the same patched squares flies through the air above them, while toy trucks, wooden blocks, a rugby ball and a skateboard lie on the floor.

4469.words: cabinet (noun): a piece of furniture with doors and shelves
4469.asset_description: A fine black-and-white pen drawing of a kitchen. A young man in a shirt and jeans stands on tiptoe and pulls open the tall wooden wall unit above the worktop, one hand on the swinging door and the other reaching up into it. The shelves inside are packed with stacked plates, tins and rows of preserving jars. Two jars have already tipped out and are falling through the air towards the floor, one past the tiled wall and one large in the foreground.

4489.words: wax (noun): a soft substance from plant, animal or mineral
4489.asset_description: A dark inked illustration of a woman leaning over a table and blowing hard at a tall candle in a metal holder. The flame is bent sideways by her breath and trailing smoke. Thick melted drops run down the whole side of the candle and pool on the holder, and beside it on the table lie a matchbox and the collapsed remains of an older candle that has melted into a puddle.

4496.words: lay (verb): to put something in a certain place
4496.asset_description: A barefoot man in a beige t-shirt and grey joggers stands on the bare wooden floor of a bright open living room. He bends down to a rolled-up patterned rug and pushes it away from him so that it unrolls across the boards. The red and blue rug ends up lying flat in the middle of the room; he walks onto it, then drops onto his back and stretches out on it with his arms out.

4502.words: ceiling (noun): the upper surface of a room, overhead
4502.asset_description: Three shots of people looking up at what is above them indoors. A man lies flat on a bed and stares up at a plain white surface with a single bare bulb on a round fitting. A woman on a sofa leans back and looks up at the wooden beams and rafters of a bright open room. A man in a dark suit stands under a huge painted dome inside a grand building, tilting his head back to take in the painted figures and gold panels above him.

4519.words: ash (noun): what remains when something is burned
4519.asset_description: Inside a stone fireplace in a wooden chalet a young man in a cream jumper kneels and builds a fire: he sets split logs upright against each other on the thick grey bed of burnt powder that covers the fireplace floor. The wood catches, flames climb up between the logs, and he sits back on his heels smiling at it. The shot then cuts outside to the same chalet at dusk, snow on the roof and warm yellow windows, with a plume of white smoke rising from the chimney into a deep blue sky.

4557.words: lap (noun): the top of your thighs when you sit
4557.asset_description: A log cabin at night with snow at the window and a wood stove burning. An elderly man with a white beard, in a cream cable-knit cardigan and grey woollen socks, sits back in a wing armchair with his feet on a footstool. He shakes out a tartan blanket and spreads it over his legs, picks up a mug in both hands and sips, and a golden retriever climbs up and lies across his lap. He leans back with his eyes closed, smiling.

4601.words: arrange (verb): to put things into a proper order
4601.asset_description: A woman in a cream jumper works on a grey corner sofa in a bright Scandinavian living room. She smooths the seat with both hands, then carries cushions over one at a time - mustard, pink, teal, patterned - and sets them along the back of the sofa in order, straightening each one as she goes. When the row is finished she steps back to look at it, then drops backwards onto the cushions and lies there with her arms spread.

4632.words: workspace (noun): the desk area where you set up to work
4632.asset_description: A woman in a rainbow jumper stands behind a completely bare wooden desk and pats it. She then sets a bright rainbow desk lamp on it and switches it on, adds an open laptop, a small potted plant, a pot of coloured pens and a stack of colourful books. At the end she sits down at the finished desk and smiles at the camera.

4695.words: chaos (noun): a state of extreme confusion and disorder
4695.asset_description: In a flat with a parquet floor a man lifts the body of a plastic bin off a full bin bag, then tips a cardboard box of odds and ends into a bigger box on the floor. He pulls a metal drawer out of a cabinet and empties that in too. By the end the whole living room floor is buried under a spreading heap of toys, boxed games, plastic tubs and building blocks, and he stands behind the emptied cabinet holding it, mouth open at the state of the room.

4737.words: jug (noun): a container with a handle for holding liquid
4737.asset_description: A sunny tropical back garden by a pool. A woman in swimwear holds a tall glass under a brass garden tap and lets the water run into it until it brims over. She then tips a grey metal jug with a curved handle and pours a long stream of water from it into a rainbow-striped watering can, and pours another jug of water into a big black bucket. Finally she stands over a blue inflatable paddling pool and fills it with a green garden hose while friends on sun loungers behind her cheer and raise their arms.

4809.words: corridor (noun): a long narrow passage inside a building
4809.asset_description: A long narrow passage inside a flat, white walls on both sides, coat racks with jackets hanging on each wall and two long rows of shoes on the floor. A woman carries a laundry basket down the passage towards the camera; two men squeeze past her carrying a big cardboard box over a bicycle parked in the passage; at the end the passage is empty again, with only the shoes and coats and a blue door at the far end.

4812.words: tidy (adjective): arranged neatly and in good order
4812.asset_description: A young man in a knitted vest holds up a blue shirt, slides a wooden hanger into it and smooths the shoulders and sleeves flat. He holds the finished shirt up straight so the collar and buttons sit square. He then carries it to an open wardrobe where a long rail of shirts hangs sorted by colour, from white through blue to orange and dark green, and slides his shirt into its place in the row, evening up the neighbouring shirts with his hand.

4991.words: messy (adjective): dirty and not in any order
4991.asset_description: A man in a colourful tie-dye shirt and glasses stands over a bed heaped with a big pile of crumpled clothes. He pulls a badly creased blue shirt out of the heap and pulls a face at the state of it, then irons it flat on a board and finally holds it up, smooth, beside a rail of hanging shirts.

5040.words: armchair (noun): a big soft chair with supports for your arms
5040.asset_description: At a flea market on a cobbled Flemish square a woman in a rust jacket holds up a big brass table lamp, then squats down and heaves a wooden crate full of vinyl records up onto a cargo bike. Next she and another person lift a large mustard-yellow velvet armchair with padded arm supports onto the same bike, on top of the crate, and she claps and laughs at the loaded bike.

5070.words: mattress (noun): the thick soft part of a bed you lie on
5070.asset_description: In a bright mattress showroom with rows of beds along a window wall, a young woman in colourful sportswear sits on the edge of a bare mattress and pulls a pained face, then lies back on it laughing. She stands up and talks to the camera, and finally throws herself backwards onto a large mattress, arms and legs spread wide, staring up at the ceiling.

5154.words: houseplant (noun): a plant kept indoors in a pot for decoration
5154.asset_description: A man in a white linen shirt stands at an open window with jungle and rice terraces behind it. He presses a tiny seedling into the soil of a terracotta pot standing on the windowsill, then lifts a metal watering can and pours water over it. The shot opens onto a room crowded with indoor plants - monsteras, ferns and trailing vines in pots on the floor, on stands and hanging in baskets from the ceiling - and he stands among them looking up at them.

5262.words: stable (adjective): not likely to change position or fall over
5262.asset_description: A cartoon-style illustration of a room where a long wooden shelf has torn loose from its metal wall bracket and tipped downwards. Books, a framed picture, a ceramic vase and a potted plant slide off the tilted board and fall through the air. A young woman in an orange jumper and jeans throws herself backwards with her mouth open and her hands raised, and one book tumbles past the camera in the foreground.

5307.words: spacious (adjective): having a lot of open room inside
5307.asset_description: A man in a denim shirt sits alone in a grey armchair in a bright open-plan home, drinking from a white mug. He leans back on a colourful patchwork sofa and stretches both arms out along the backrest, taking up the whole seat. The shot then opens onto a very large, almost empty living room with a huge grey sectional sofa running around three sides of the floor, the man sitting by himself in the middle of it with a wall-mounted television behind him. People run in from both sides and throw themselves onto the sectional, kicking their legs up and cheering, and by the end a dozen friends are spread out around the whole sofa with room to spare, waving at the camera.

5343.words: twin (adjective): being two identical ones that match
5343.asset_description: Two girls play in a bedroom that holds two identical white beds side by side, matching headboards and matching bare mattresses. They flop back onto one bed each, laughing at the camera. Sitting cross-legged on the beds they thread coloured beads into bracelets from a tray and fasten one onto the other girl's wrist. Then they pull jackets on in front of a tall mirror and dance together on the carpet.

5453.words: vase (noun): a container you put flowers in
5453.asset_description: An older woman stands at a wooden kitchen table with a tall dark blue ceramic vase in front of her. She pours water into it from a glass jug, then takes flowers from a pile on the table one by one and puts them into the vase: a pink peony, big yellow sunflowers, white daisies. At the end she holds the vase with both hands and turns it to show the full arrangement, then leans in and smells it.

5478.words: stuff (noun): objects of all kinds, not named
5478.asset_description: A colour comic-style illustration of a bedroom. A young woman with brown hair has pulled both mirrored doors of a tall wooden wardrobe wide open and stands in the opening with her arms stretched out, eyes wide, as a mass of assorted things bursts out over her: shirts, jumpers, trousers and skirts in red, green, blue, yellow and pink, folded stacks toppling off the shelves, and a brown leather shoe flying out of the frame towards the viewer. Empty wooden hangers swing on the rail above her, a battered suitcase sits on top of the wardrobe, and a patterned rug, a potted plant and a pair of jeans lie on the floor.

1072.words: fellow (noun): a man; a friendly informal word for a guy
1072.asset_description: Two middle-aged men in worn jackets shake hands and grip each other's shoulders, grinning, on a sunlit grassy hillside.

1104.asset_description: An older man in a brown tweed three-piece suit tips his hat and bows slightly while holding open the brass-handled door of a shop on a rainy street, umbrella hooked on his arm.

1143.words: human (noun): a person; a member of mankind
1143.asset_description: A vast desert of smooth dunes glowing at sunset, with a single tiny human figure walking along a ridge and leaving a line of footprints in the sand.

1365.words: stranger (noun): a person you do not know at all
1365.asset_description: On a rainy park path, a worried woman under an umbrella looks back over her shoulder as an unknown bearded man in a hood reaches out and touches her arm.

1436.asset_description: Five separate black-and-white street portraits sit side by side in one frame: a teenage boy, a young woman in glasses, a white-haired older man, a middle-aged woman and a smiling student, all different ages and looks.

1554.words: monk (noun): a religious man who lives simply
1554.asset_description: A watercolor of a young Buddhist monk with a shaved head, wrapped in a bright pink robe, seen from behind as he walks holding a red paper umbrella over himself.

1569.words: portrait (noun): a picture that shows a person's face
1569.asset_description: A crosshatched pen-and-ink portrait of an older man in a cap and jacket, his head turned upward to the right, drawn with rough sketch lines on a white background.

1598.words: jesus (noun): the central figure of the Christian faith
1598.asset_description: A painting in Divine Mercy style: Jesus with long brown hair and a beard, one hand raised in blessing and the other at his chest, from which red and white rays of light stream, all surrounded by a glowing blue aura.

1617.words: angel (noun): a holy winged being that protects people
1617.asset_description: An old engraving of a winged guardian angel walking beside a small child on a rocky path, holding the child's hand and pointing up at the sky.

1631.words: witch (noun): a woman with magic powers in stories
1631.asset_description: A cartoon witch in a pointed hat, orange skirt and purple gloves stands confidently holding a broom in front of a huge yellow full moon, with curly dark branches around her.

1635.words: mermaid (noun): a storybook woman with a fish tail
1635.asset_description: A cute cartoon mermaid with long brown hair, a rose behind her ear and a green fish tail sits smiling, surrounded by hearts, bubbles and seaweed.

1644.words: armor (noun): metal clothing that protects a fighter
1644.asset_description: An old black-and-white engraving of a knight covered head to toe in metal armor riding a horse, carrying a lance with a banner; a slain dragon lies under the horse's hooves.

1651.words: cloak (noun): a long loose coat with no sleeves
1651.asset_description: A classic painting of the Virgin Mary wrapped in a long blue star-covered cloak, praying with closed eyes, surrounded by golden rays of light, with a small angel at her feet.

1685.words: crowd (noun): a large group of people packed together
1685.asset_description: Dense black-and-white engraving of a temple with tall columns: a man swings a cord above his head while dozens of robed people scramble away down the steps, dropping baskets and coins.

1694.words: chief (noun): the leader of a group or tribe
1694.asset_description: Mixed-media portrait of a Native American chief with a feather in his hair, a white neck scarf and a bone breastplate, over a background of old handwriting.

1733.words: elf (noun): a magical creature with pointed ears
1733.asset_description: A realistic fantasy render of a young woman with pointed elf ears, a forehead circlet and a face tattoo standing in a misty forest, holding a glowing golden light above her palm.

1779.words: chain (noun): a row of metal rings joined together
1779.asset_description: A fantasy painting of a caped superhero swinging a glowing hammer while a huge silver chain whips in spirals around his body, lightning flashing above.

1933.words: spirit (noun): a magical being of nature, not fully human
1933.asset_description: A fantasy painting of a beautiful black-haired woman in a flowing white gown seated among the twisting branches of a huge old tree, red flowers woven through her hair and dress, her skin patterned like bark.

1943.words: gnome (noun): a tiny fairy-tale creature in a pointed hat
1943.asset_description: A 3D-animation-style render of a tiny adorable furry creature with big eyes and pointed ears, wearing a green pointed hat and tunic with a rope belt, holding a twig staff on a sunny forest path with falling leaves.

1960.words: samurai (noun): a Japanese warrior who fights with a sword
1960.asset_description: A woman with a fully tattooed back walks away from the camera holding a curved sword, dressed in a Japanese-style robe with a red sash while blossom petals drift around her.

1973.asset_description: A woman with blue-painted skin and golden eyes wears a huge Egyptian crown-headdress and layered bead necklaces, with golden wings fanned out behind her head.

1984.words: pale (adjective): very light, almost white in colour
1984.asset_description: A black-and-white intricately drawn portrait of a woman with a strikingly pale white face, grey eyes, ornate dangling earrings and dark hair full of jeweled ornaments above a patterned cloak.

2016.words: wand (noun): a thin stick used to cast magic spells
2016.asset_description: A stylized illustration of a small smiling girl in a green hooded cloak standing in a dark forest at night; she holds up a thin stick topped with a bright glowing green flower, and her eyes glow the same green.

2031.words: twig (noun): a very small thin branch of a tree
2031.asset_description: A fantasy portrait of a pale young woman with big blue eyes; a tangled mass of bare twigs and small branches grows out of her hair, green vines curl over her shoulder, and a burning orange city glows far behind her.

2036.words: spear (noun): a long pole weapon with a sharp tip
2036.asset_description: A fierce dark-haired warrior woman stares straight ahead holding an upright spear, while behind her a huge army of fighters raises dozens of spears against a pale green sky.

2137.words: halo (noun): a ring of light around a holy figure's head
2137.asset_description: A winged woman in a long dark gown stands over the sea at sunset, a radiating golden halo crown around her head and huge dark wings arching behind her.

2155.words: confident (adjective): sure of yourself and not afraid
2155.asset_description: Portrait of a woman in dark futuristic armor looking straight at the viewer with a calm half-smile, raised chin and steady blue eyes, hair swept up.

2186.words: thorn (noun): a sharp spike growing on a plant stem
2186.asset_description: A brightly colored painting of Jesus with closed eyes and a sorrowful face, wearing a crown of long spiky thorns, painted in splashes of pink, blue and yellow.

2187.words: buddha (noun): the founder of Buddhism, shown meditating
2187.asset_description: A blue-lit statue of Buddha sitting cross-legged in meditation with eyes closed, a small glowing neon-blue jar hovering in its lap against a dark blue background.

2190.words: villain (noun): an evil character in a story or film
2190.asset_description: A fierce dark-haired woman in a torn black battle suit stands among burning city ruins, her eyes glowing with orange flames as embers swirl around her.

2211.words: trident (noun): a spear with three sharp points
2211.asset_description: A muscular sea god with long white hair and a beard rises from stormy waves holding a tall three-pronged trident, with lightning splitting the sky behind him.

2216.words: altar (noun): a raised table where people pray
2216.asset_description: A young woman with long wavy hair presses her hands together in prayer before a candlelit altar lined with old carved statues in a dark shrine.

2217.words: spell (noun): words or power used to make magic happen
2217.asset_description: A forest elf girl with enormous flowing green hair strides through shallow water casting a spell, a blazing orb of magic light bursting from her staff while yellow leaves whirl around her.

2235.words: profile (noun): the side view of a person's face
2235.asset_description: An oil-style painted portrait shows a man in a pale open-collared shirt in full profile, facing left with a thin chin beard against a plain dark background.

2308.words: viking (noun): a warrior sailor from old Scandinavia
2308.asset_description: A stern long-haired man with a thick blond beard stands before snowy mountains, wearing a fur shoulder cloak, leather bracers and a chest strap, gripping a broad blade in one hand.

2363.words: mysterious (adjective): strange and hard to explain
2363.asset_description: A pale woman with flowing wavy hair looks at the viewer while her body and hair dissolve into glowing blue and violet smoke against a dark background.

2400.words: fierce (adjective): violent, angry and frightening to look at
2400.asset_description: Extreme close-up of a viking warrior's face with an intense angry stare, icy blue eyes, blue war paint across his cheeks and brow, a long grey beard and a winged metal helmet.

2415.words: garland (noun): a chain of flowers worn or hung as decoration
2415.asset_description: A blue-skinned Hindu god stands barefoot by a lake holding a tall golden staff, wearing a crown, an orange sash and long garlands of red, white and yellow flowers.

2567.words: saint (noun): a very holy person honoured in religion
2567.asset_description: A close portrait of a serene young woman in a white and gold veil, a bright halo of light rays glowing around her head, looking calmly at the viewer.

2584.words: baptism (noun): a religious ceremony using water
2584.asset_description: In a rocky river valley, a bearded man in a brown robe holds a younger man in wet white cloth who rises from the water, while robed onlookers watch from the stony banks.

2747.words: chubby (adjective): pleasantly round and soft, usually a child
2747.asset_description: A plump smiling toddler with round cheeks, a soft belly and dimpled arms sits cross-legged on the ground in a golden crown and orange cloth, holding a large golden mace, with a bright halo behind his head and pink petals on the grass.

2759.words: hero (noun): someone admired for brave and great deeds
2759.asset_description: A huge muscular monkey-faced figure in golden armbands and an orange loincloth stands proudly on a rock with his fists clenched and his chest out, a mace strapped to his back, while a blazing sun sets behind him over the mountains.

2782.words: engraving (noun): a picture printed from cut lines
2782.asset_description: A black-and-white line engraving of an older man with a thick wave of grey hair, a full white beard and moustache and a stern stare, wearing a jacket, waistcoat and bow tie; the whole image is built from fine hatched lines on white.

2952.words: superhero (noun): a caped character with special powers
2952.asset_description: A muscular man with long dreadlocks stands in a black armoured suit with gold lightning-bolt markings on the chest and a yellow cape, while a bolt of yellow lightning crackles beside his shoulder.

3548.words: to smoke (verb): to breathe in smoke from a cigarette
3548.asset_description: Felt-puppet style portrait of a woman with long black hair in a black tuxedo and bow tie, holding a burning cigarette near her face with a thin curl of smoke rising past her.

4227.asset_description: A man in a bucket hat rides a yellow bicycle down a tree-lined park road. An Australian shepherd rides in a wooden crate mounted on the handlebars and a corgi sits on top of his backpack. A police car pulls alongside and a smiling female officer walks over, laughing, and bends down to stroke the dog in the crate while a second officer chats from the car window. Everyone is grinning; then the man pedals away down the shady road.
4227.transcript: Goso. How are you, buddy? You know his name. That's Goso. Have a good day, guys. Nice meeting you. Let's go, boys.

4312.words: loud (adjective): producing sound of great volume
4312.asset_description: A cartoon of a man in a red and blue tracksuit and blue gloves standing on empty sand dunes under a violet sky. He leans forward, cups both hands around his open mouth and calls out. Four curved yellow arcs are drawn in the air in front of his mouth to show the sound travelling out across the empty desert; there is nobody else in the picture.

4749.words: formation (noun): a group of people arranged as one unit
4749.asset_description: A montage of people in the air. Two tandem skydivers hang under a canopy above a patchwork of green and brown fields with clouds below them. A woman swings in a harness under a rainbow paraglider wing over an alpine valley. A hot-air balloon drifts at sunrise with two passengers leaning on the basket rim. Then a group of skydivers falls through blue sky, and in the last shot about twenty of them have joined hands into a single wide ring against the clouds.

5003.words: explorer (noun): someone who travels into little known places
5003.asset_description: An ink-and-wash drawing of a dense green rainforest. A man in a wide-brimmed hat and a dirt-stained shirt stands in the middle of the frame and swings a machete, cutting through the hanging leaves in front of him so that fronds and scraps fly off. Thick vines loop across the whole picture, huge dripping leaves hang on both sides, mist rises off the tangled roots at his feet, and a macaw flies overhead against a pale sky.

5060.words: male (noun): a person of the sex that cannot have babies
5060.asset_description: A short montage of people of one sex at every age, all in a sunny park. A baby boy sits in a pushchair reaching for a coloured stacking toy held out to him; a boy rides a green kick scooter along a paved path past a colonnaded museum; a young man in a black vest does pull-ups on an outdoor bar; the same man flexes both arms and smiles at the camera; finally a father in a blue polo carries his little son on his shoulders while a grey-haired grandfather on a bench waves at the camera, all three waving.

5219.words: roommate (noun): a person who shares a room with you
5219.asset_description: Two young men who share a flat argue over a full black bin bag and settle it with rock-paper-scissors; one of them lifts the bag to take it out, then the two cook a big pot of pasta together and hold up plates, and finally sit side by side on the sofa with a bowl of crisps, playing a video game and shouting at the screen.

5405.words: toddler (noun): a very small child, only a year or two old
5405.asset_description: A baby in a striped bodysuit stands on a fluffy living-room rug and takes wobbly first steps towards two adults who kneel a few feet away, clapping and cheering it on. The film cuts to a bright daycare room where several small children in T-shirts toddle unsteadily between coloured foam blocks, and then to a wide view of the same room full of little children walking around low tables and small chairs.

5435.words: alike (adjective): having the same or similar features
5435.asset_description: Phone footage of two young red-haired women walking side by side across a sunny university campus. They are dressed exactly the same: white polo crop tops, blue jeans, white trainers and black backpacks, and they wear their hair in the same ponytails, so from behind and from the front they look like one person doubled. They stop, open a bag of crisps together and share it, then walk on laughing at each other while other students pass on the lawn behind them.

18.words: root (noun): the part of a plant that grows under the ground
18.asset_description: An anime girl in overalls kneels in a garden and lifts a seedling out of the soil, revealing its long pale roots. She shakes off the dirt, rinses the roots in a bowl of water, replants the seedling and waters it.

71.words: bark (noun): the rough outer skin of a tree trunk
71.asset_description: In a northern forest a young man and woman touch and knock on the thick cracked bark of a pine while a woodpecker clings to the trunk; they then walk to a birch and peel off a small curl of its papery white bark to show the camera.

127.words: cactus (noun): a desert plant covered in sharp spines
127.asset_description: A couple wanders through a desert garden full of tall saguaro and round barrel cacti; the camera zooms onto the long sharp spines and the woman points at them, joking that they are far too sharp to touch.

485.words: moss (noun): a soft green plant that carpets rocks and trees
485.asset_description: In a misty forest full of green-covered boulders, two people press their hands into the thick springy moss on a rock, leaving hand prints that slowly spring back. One squeezes a wet clump of moss so water drips out, then a woman rests her cheek on the soft mossy rock like a pillow.

713.words: soil (noun): the dark earth that plants grow in
713.asset_description: Two gardeners scoop up handfuls of dark crumbly soil from a raised bed, let it fall between their fingers and find a little earthworm in it, then plant spring-onion seedlings into the soil, pat it flat and water the row.

1305.words: seed (noun): the small hard part that grows into a plant
1305.asset_description: A single bean seed falls from a gardener's soil-dusted fingers toward dark earth, with a row of young seedlings and a watering can blurred behind.

1499.words: stem (noun): the long thin part that holds the flower
1499.asset_description: Old botanical plate of checkered bell-shaped flowers drooping on long, thin, curling green stems.

1701.words: lily (noun): a tall plant with big trumpet-shaped flowers
1701.asset_description: Medieval-style engraving of a woman in long flowing robes holding a small book, standing beside a tall lily plant growing from a jug.

1707.words: cottage (noun): a small simple house in the countryside
1707.asset_description: Black-and-white engraving of a small stone cottage overgrown with climbing plants, a garden path leading past it and a wheelbarrow resting in the foreground.

1757.words: blossom (noun): a flower on a tree, like cherry blossom
1757.asset_description: A fantasy painting of a dark-haired woman in a flowing blue robe playing a lute-like instrument before a glowing moon, framed by branches of pink cherry blossoms with petals drifting down.

1910.words: petal (noun): one of the soft colored parts of a flower
1910.asset_description: A painting of a woman with flowers piled in her hair and across her dress; large pink petals spread around her shoulders against a deep blue-green background.

1927.words: roots (noun): the parts of a plant that grow underground
1927.asset_description: A fantasy painting of a golden magical tree; its bare branches reach into a glowing turquoise sky while a huge fan of intricate golden roots studded with jewels spreads across the entire lower half of the image.

1940.words: dandelion (noun): a wild yellow flower that turns into a puffball
1940.asset_description: A dreamy close-up portrait of a young woman with wavy pale-green hair, surrounded by yellow dandelion flowers and delicate white dandelion puffs growing around her head and shoulders.

1949.asset_description: A fantasy scene of a whimsical crooked cottage deep in an enchanted forest: glowing lights float between huge mossy trees, pink and blue mushrooms line a purple stone path, and flowers cover the balcony and walls.

1955.words: fairy tale (noun): a magical story world with witches and elves
1955.asset_description: A richly detailed picture of a crooked tower cottage straight out of a fairy tale: mossy layered roofs, walls buried in flowers, and giant pink, purple and orange mushrooms filling the meadow in front.

1969.words: bouquet (noun): a bunch of flowers arranged together
1969.asset_description: An astronaut in a white spacesuit kneels among huge glowing red and pink flowers, gathering a big bouquet, with planets hanging in the dark sky behind.

1980.words: pine (noun): a tall evergreen tree with needles
1980.asset_description: An oil painting of tall snow-dusted pine trees around a small wooden hut by a rocky stream, with a huge sunlit snowy mountain rising behind them under a blue sky.

1986.words: bare (adjective): not covered — no leaves, no clothes
1986.asset_description: A great leafless tree with feathery blue-toned branches stands alone under a glowing full moon, with the night sky swirling around it like water.

2008.words: trunk (noun): the thick wooden stem of a tree
2008.asset_description: A classical-style painting of giant old trees on a hillside; the nearest tree's massive twisted trunk fills the picture, with green crowns above and mountains behind.

2034.words: poppy (noun): a wild flower with thin red petals
2034.asset_description: A delicate botanical watercolor of a single red poppy on a pale background: one big open bloom with papery red petals and a dark seeded center, next to a closed bud on a green stem.

2059.words: sunlight (noun): the light that comes from the sun
2059.asset_description: Thin hanging branches with small green leaves glow in bright sunlight on one side of the picture and fade into deep shadow under the dark tree canopy on the other.

2174.words: bloom (verb): to open flowers; to be full of flowers
2174.asset_description: A huge tree blooming with glowing pink flowers towers over a snowy town square at night, with lit house windows, parked cars and a tiny figure standing beneath it under a starry sky.

2194.words: tropical (adjective): from the hot wet regions near the equator
2194.asset_description: A dark, moody botanical painting of dense tropical foliage: huge banana and monstera leaves, curling ferns and a pale feathery flower glowing against a black background.

2245.words: overgrown (adjective): covered by plants growing out of control
2245.asset_description: A fairy-tale cottage whose whole roof and walls are buried under flowers, moss and climbing plants. Warm light glows from the windows and a giant mushroom stands beside the chimney.

2246.words: miniature (adjective): a very small copy of something bigger
2246.asset_description: A tiny model cottage with glowing windows sits in a miniature night garden with pebble paths, small flowers and moss, photographed with blurry tilt-shift edges like a diorama.

2387.words: twisted (adjective): bent and turned in many directions
2387.asset_description: A dark gnarled tree with a thick twisting trunk and winding branches stands on rocky ground in front of a giant red sun, drawn in Japanese woodblock style with low clouds.

2392.words: stroll (noun): a slow, relaxed walk for pleasure
2392.asset_description: An impressionist painting of a woman in a blue dress and straw hat with a small shoulder bag walking away down a wet reflective path between banks of colorful flowers and tall trees.

2404.words: lotus (noun): a large white water flower with many petals
2404.asset_description: A big white lotus flower with an orange center fills the frame, painted in soft watercolor blues and surrounded by swirling leaves and smaller pale flowers.

2421.words: fungus (noun): a mushroom-like thing that grows in damp places
2421.asset_description: Giant pale white fungus-like growths with round caps and thin stalks tower on both sides of a wet path, framing a misty gothic city in the distance.

2424.words: cypress (noun): a tall narrow dark-green tree
2424.asset_description: A warm watercolor of an old Italian stone house with terracotta roofs and green shutters beside a winding country road, with a row of tall dark cypress trees on the left.

2460.words: wildflowers (noun): flowers that grow by themselves in fields
2460.asset_description: A watercolor still life: a blue enamel pot and a wooden bucket overflow with mixed wildflowers — daisies, orange coneflowers and purple thistles — beside a stack of books, small glass jars and an open notebook on a table.

2463.words: peony (noun): a big round flower with soft ruffled petals
2463.asset_description: A soft watercolor of a misty mountain valley at sunrise, its foreground slopes covered in large ruffled pink peonies and smaller wildflowers, with orange and blue butterflies fluttering among the blooms.

2509.words: lavender (noun): a purple plant with a famous sweet smell
2509.asset_description: A sandy path winds between rows of purple lavender in a mosaic-textured painting, with dark trees on both sides and a golden evening sky.

2514.words: herbs (noun): leafy plants used in cooking, tea or medicine
2514.asset_description: A red-haired woman in a lace dress kneels on mossy ground by a forest stream, sprinkling dried herbs into a steaming bowl surrounded by small dishes of leaves and seeds.

2519.words: backyard (noun): the private grassy area behind a house
2519.asset_description: A painted view of a small house with a red roof seen from above its back garden, the lawn covered with a parasol, two red folding chairs, a plastic pink flamingo, a garden gnome, a rolled yoga mat, an exercise ball and a green paddling pool.

2522.words: clover (noun): a small plant with round leaves, a lucky sign
2522.asset_description: A glowing green lantern sits on a wooden table surrounded by four-leaf clovers, golden petals and twinkling lights, like a lucky St. Patrick's Day scene.

2547.words: toadstool (noun): a mushroom with a red cap and white spots
2547.asset_description: Giant red-and-white spotted toadstools tower over a tiny fairy cottage with a mushroom-shaped roof, a mossy garden and a winding dirt path through the forest.

2564.words: hydrangea (noun): a garden plant with round clusters of flowers
2564.asset_description: A botanical drawing of a blue hydrangea: one large round cluster of small blue flowers on a green stem with big veined leaves, on a pale blue vintage paper background.

2612.words: bud (noun): a flower that has not opened yet
2612.asset_description: A big open red hibiscus with a yellow stamen fills the frame, and above it two tightly closed pointed red buds sit among glossy green leaves in the sunlight.

2623.words: ivy (noun): a green plant that climbs walls and trees
2623.asset_description: A bookshelf full of old books stands inside a hollow tree, its wooden frame covered in trailing green ivy, opening onto a moonlit valley with a spired castle under a huge full moon.

2635.words: magnolia (noun): a big cup-shaped flower that grows on a tree
2635.asset_description: A painted magnolia branch against a dark teal background: one large open flower with creamy white and pink petals around a golden centre, a closed pink flower above it and round green leaves along the woody branch.

2660.words: vine (noun): a long climbing plant that hangs over things
2660.asset_description: A wooden library nook opens straight onto a misty forest; green climbing vines hang over the stone arch and wind up the tree trunks, while books lie stacked on a bench and a reading lamp glows over an open book.

2709.words: marigold (noun): a round orange flower used in garlands
2709.asset_description: A close portrait of the monkey-faced god Hanuman in a tall gold crown and gold earrings, a thick rope of round orange flowers hanging around his bare shoulders, against a soft green background.

2711.words: lily pad (noun): the flat round leaf of a water lily
2711.asset_description: A glossy painting of a dark-haired woman rising out of a dark pond up to her shoulders, a giant pink and yellow water lily resting on her head, with yellow and red round leaves floating on the water all around her.

2751.words: spiky (adjective): covered with sharp points that stick out
2751.asset_description: A flat illustration on a cream background: four coloured books lean together at one end of a wooden shelf, a pair of black glasses lies in the middle, and a plant with long sharp pointed leaves stands in an orange dotted pot at the other end.

2762.words: wheat (noun): the golden grain that flour and bread come from
2762.asset_description: A thickly painted impressionist landscape: a small figure in a wide straw hat walks through a huge field of ripe golden wheat, with a few white village houses and trees on the ridge behind and a bright blue sky above.

2817.words: watering can (noun): a container with a spout for watering plants
2817.asset_description: A simple flat illustration on a warm orange background: a pale grey watering can with a long spout and round handle stands filled with a bunch of yellow daisy-like flowers, with two orange butterflies flying beside it.

3148.words: to harvest (verb): to cut and gather ripe crops from a field
3148.asset_description: Flat graphic illustration at sunset: four women in colourful patterned dresses and headscarves bend low in a field of tall grass beside a river, cutting handfuls of golden stalks and dropping them into a basket, with a big pale sun and bare trees behind them.

3207.words: to glow (verb): to give off a soft steady light
3207.asset_description: Dark painterly artwork of a young woman standing in a night forest, head bowed, holding a small leafy plant in both hands; the plant and the leaves scattered over her coat shine with bright turquoise and golden light.

3572.words: to pick (verb): to take leaves or fruit off a plant
3572.asset_description: Painted Chinese river village: women in cone hats bend over rows of green tea bushes picking leaves into baskets on their backs, while a covered boat passes under a stone arch bridge below white houses and misty peaks.

3741.words: tulip (noun): a spring flower shaped like a cup
3741.asset_description: Vintage-style collage illustration of four open orange tulips with long grey-green leaves, painted over an old letter with faded handwriting and a postmark.

4008.words: shake (verb): to move something quickly back and forth
4008.asset_description: A young man in a red tracksuit jacket stands under an apple tree in a garden at night, with a black dog beside him and yellow apples already scattered over the grass. He grabs a low branch and shakes it hard, and more apples drop around him. The dog trots through the fallen fruit and he climbs up onto the concrete fence.

4109.words: lawn (noun): a field of short cut grass
4109.asset_description: A sunny back garden with a mown grass lawn and a tall green hedge along the back. Two fluffy dogs stand on the grass: a small cream Pomeranian and a bigger black and tan Lapphund. Between them on the lawn sits a round blue pet drinking fountain that shoots a thin jet of water straight up into the air. The dogs watch the jet, then the black and tan dog steps up to the fountain and drinks from it while the cream one circles around, jumps up and paws at the water, and the two take turns at the bowl on the grass.

4375.words: rough (adjective): having an irregular, uneven surface
4375.asset_description: A charcoal drawing filling the frame with the outer skin of a tree trunk: thick ridges, deep cracks and hard flaking plates, with patches of lichen. A hand at the right pulls a long broken strip away from the trunk, and small crumbs fall from it against the pale background.

4388.words: daisy (noun): a plant with flower heads of white ray petals
4388.asset_description: A soft cartoon meadow. A round cartoon bee with blurred wings hovers in the middle of the frame, trailing golden pollen from its legs. All around it grow big white daisies with fat yellow centres, some of them filling the whole bottom of the picture, along with a few pink clover heads.

4578.words: crop (noun): what plants yield in one growing season
4578.asset_description: A photograph taken from a hilltop on a clear day. A man in a black jacket with a canvas backpack strides past a stack of stones on the stony path, both arms flung out wide, seen from behind. Below him the whole plain is divided into a patchwork of farm fields: green pasture, standing green crops and pale gold fields already cut, separated by hedges and lines of trees, with a river curling through them, farmhouses dotted about and low hills and the sea on the horizon.

4672.words: reed (noun): tall grasses with hollow slender stems
4672.asset_description: A woodblock-style illustration of a pond. A brown duck with an orange bill and orange webbed feet drops down onto the water with its wings spread, throwing up a tall white splash and rings of ripples. Two yellow ducklings paddle nearby. Both edges of the picture are filled with tall green reeds and broad water-plant leaves rising straight out of the shallow water, with hills and clouds behind.

4765.words: greenhouse (noun): a building with glass walls and roof
4765.asset_description: A modelling-clay scene of a cottage garden. A woman in a straw hat and blue dungarees strides along a sandy path tipping a watering can, and a thick blue stream of water pours over a raised bed of tomato plants. Behind her stands a small greenhouse with a clay frame and pale glass walls and roof, with plants inside. A cottage with washing on the line, a wooden gate, seedlings, empty flower pots and a trowel fill the rest of the garden.

4792.words: to plant (verb): to put seeds or young plants into the ground
4792.asset_description: A small girl in a pale dress spins on the spot in a beamed living room, her skirt flying out, while a white-haired woman in an armchair claps and laughs. The two sit at a low table with a flowered tea set as an elderly man sips from a small cup. In close-up, the girl's hands lower a young flowering plant, roots and soil together, into a hole dug in dark earth while a man's hand steadies it and a trowel lies beside the hole. The camera pulls back to a sunny garden bed where grandparents and several children kneel in a row, setting plants into the soil and watering them.

4803.words: bouquet (noun): a bunch of flowers arranged together
4803.asset_description: A woman in a coat and a checked scarf arrives at an open front door holding a wine bottle and a paper-wrapped bouquet, hands the bouquet to the man who greets her, joins a table lit by fairy lights where food is served out of a red pan, and clinks a glass of white wine with the others.

4908.words: branch (noun): a stem growing out from a plant's main stem
4908.asset_description: Four shots of things being bent into a curve. Two hands hold a flexible white plastic strip over a wooden table and bow it into an S shape. Then two hands grip a thick grey branch of an apple tree, leaves attached, and pull it into an arc over a green garden. In a bright gym a girl in a leotard arches backwards until her hands reach the floor. Last, a heavy hydraulic press in a workshop presses a steel beam into a curve.

5093.words: overgrown (adjective): covered by plants growing out of control
5093.asset_description: A man in a jumper and jeans pushes a red petrol lawn mower straight towards the camera through a back garden where the grass has grown long, pale and gone to seed. Each pass cuts a clean green strip out of the shaggy grass, and the shots alternate between behind the mower and in front of it. By the end a wide band of short green lawn runs down the middle of the garden with the tall unmown grass still standing on either side.

5220.words: clip (verb): to remove something by snipping it off
5220.asset_description: A woodblock-style print of a deep red rose with a dew drop on one petal; a pair of iron garden shears is held open around the thorny green stem just below the flower, about to snip it off, while a single petal falls away through the air and leaves and a patterned sky fill the background.

5302.words: blossom (noun): a flower on a tree, like cherry blossom
5302.asset_description: A young man in an orange jacket sits on a park bench directly under a cherry tree covered in pale pink flowers. He tips his head back, mouth wide open, and sneezes so hard that the tissues beside him fly up into the air. Petals and bare blossom branches fill the frame behind him. He then leans forward, pinches his nose and wipes it, with used tissues and a coffee cup on the bench next to him.

5312.words: backyard (noun): the private grassy area behind a house
5312.asset_description: In the paved yard behind a low house at sunset, a young man in a green rugby shirt grills a long coiled sausage on a round charcoal kettle. Flames leap up over a row of meat skewers, he lifts a browned piece with tongs and turns to the camera laughing while friends stand around the yard with drinks.

5371.words: garland (noun): a chain of flowers worn or hung as decoration
5371.asset_description: At sunset beside a lake, a young woman in a white dress with a ring of flowers on her head ties a red ribbon to a tall birch pole that is wrapped in leaves and flowers. Four women, each wearing a flower ring on her head, then push the decorated pole upright against the orange sky. In the last shots a group of young people in the same flower rings hold hands and dance in a circle around the standing pole in a meadow of grass and wildflowers.

5485.words: watering can (noun): a container with a spout for watering plants
5485.asset_description: On a small balcony crowded with plants at sunset, a green plastic watering can pours a fan of water over pots of orange and pink marigolds and young rosemary plants. An elderly woman with grey hair in a floral blouse holds the can up with both hands and moves it along the hanging baskets and pot plants, smiling as the water sprays out of the long spout onto the leaves.

5490.words: weed (noun): a plant that crowds out garden plants
5490.asset_description: A young man in a straw hat and a football shirt kneels in a vegetable bed between rows of leafy green plants, a tall corn field behind him. He digs his gloved hands into the dark soil around the base of a big unwanted plant, works it loose, grips it low down and pulls hard. He rocks back, drags the plant out of the ground and stands up holding it above the bed, its long soil-covered roots and leafy top hanging down.

2.words: certificate (noun): official proof that you finished a course
2.asset_description: A smiling young woman stands in her room and proudly shows framed certificates to the camera, swapping one for another until she is hugging a whole armful of them.
2.transcript: I study very hard. Look at all my certificates!

7.words: graduation (noun): the ceremony where you receive your diploma
7.asset_description: A young man in a navy cap and gown with a gold sash stands in a packed stadium at his graduation ceremony. He raises his diploma and cheers as golden confetti rains down.
7.transcript: Today is my graduation. I am so happy!

9.words: laboratory (noun): a room with equipment for doing experiments
9.asset_description: A scientist in a white coat pulls on purple gloves in a laboratory, pipettes blue liquid into rows of tubes, writes notes on a pad, and stores a rack of samples in a lab freezer.
9.transcript: I work in a laboratory. I do experiments every day.

16.words: presentation (noun): a talk where you show your work to a group
16.asset_description: A student in a dark red sweater stands in front of her class next to a projector screen with slides, speaking and gesturing at the bullet points while classmates watch.
16.transcript: Hello. Today I give a presentation to my class. This is my work. I am a little nervous. Thank you for listening.

221.words: degree (noun): the qualification you get for finishing university
221.asset_description: A young woman in a maroon cap and gown films herself at a huge stadium graduation ceremony, proudly holding up her degree certificate to the camera. She walks along the graduate rows, appears on the jumbotron, and celebrates as confetti rains down.
221.transcript: I finished school. I finished. This is my degree!

229.words: diploma (noun): the official paper you get for finishing a course
229.asset_description: A young man in a green cap and gown crosses the stage at a graduation ceremony, shakes hands with the officials, and is handed a white rolled diploma tied with a ribbon. He turns to the audience and triumphantly lifts the scroll over his head with both hands, beaming.
229.transcript: Today I get my diploma! I am so proud!

234.words: dissolve (verb): to mix into a liquid and disappear
234.asset_description: In a Pixar-style kitchen, a woman in a striped apron drops a sugar cube into a glass of water and stirs it with a spoon. The cube breaks up and vanishes completely, and she holds up the clear glass with wide surprised eyes saying it is all gone.

272.words: evaporate (verb): to turn into vapour and disappear
272.asset_description: On a rooftop at sunset a cartoon woman with goggles heats a pan of water on a camping stove. The shallow puddle of water shrinks, vanishes in a puff of steam and she flips the pan over to show it is completely empty and dry.

338.words: globe (noun): a small round model of the Earth on a stand
338.asset_description: In a cozy study, a curly-haired woman excitedly shows off the desk globe next to her lamp, spins it fast, stops it with a finger to point out countries, then hugs the globe to the camera.
338.transcript: Look at my globe! A globe is a small round earth. I spin the globe and I can see every country! Can you believe this?

363.words: research (noun): careful study of sources to find information
363.asset_description: A man with glasses sits at a desk late at night under a lamp, surrounded by open books and stacks of papers covered in sticky notes; he types on a laptop, checks the books and scribbles notes on the pages.

476.words: microscope (noun): a lens tool that makes tiny things look huge
476.asset_description: At a desk, a student tears a small piece from a green leaf, puts it on a glass slide and clips it under a microscope. He looks into the eyepiece and turns the focus knob until the leaf's tiny green cells appear sharp and huge in the round view.
476.transcript: I look at a leaf in my microscope. The microscope makes it very big.

507.words: observe (verb): to watch something carefully to learn
507.asset_description: In a hand-painted anime scene, a girl crouches by a grassy stream and holds a magnifying glass up to a dragonfly perched on a cattail. She watches it closely and intently, then smiles at what she sees.

526.words: paralyze (verb): to make someone unable to move at all
526.asset_description: In a cartoon workshop a young scientist fires a ray gun at a man in a green tracksuit; he freezes mid-step with a glowing outline, stuck rigid in one pose while she waves at him and tests him, and he finally tips over stiff as a board into her arms.

579.words: programming (noun): writing code that tells a computer what to do
579.asset_description: A young couple sits at a laptop trying to code a small wheeled robot that stands on a paper track on the table. The robot won't obey, they groan with heads in hands, then type new code, and suddenly the robot drives along the drawn track - "It works!" - so they cheer, high-five and kiss.

836.words: prepared (adjective): ready because you organized everything in advance
836.asset_description: A boy walks through a crowded school hallway carrying a giant expedition backpack with ice axes, a rolled sleeping mat and a tower of books stacked on top; amazed classmates watch as he proudly declares himself ready, then tips backward onto his sleeping roll to rest.
836.transcript: Did you come here to sleep? I am a prepared student.

1504.words: philosopher (noun): a person who studies big questions about life
1504.asset_description: Old engraving of the head of an ancient Greek man with curly hair and a thick beard, shown in profile on a patterned background.

1665.words: ancient (adjective): very old, from thousands of years ago
1665.asset_description: A black-and-white illustration of a woman raising her clasped arms inside an ancient Egyptian temple gateway covered with hieroglyphs; a crowd and distant pyramids appear behind her.

1716.words: spacesuit (noun): the sealed suit an astronaut wears in space
1716.asset_description: Impressionist-style painting of an astronaut in a white spacesuit with tubes and a helmet, standing alone in an orange field under a pale blue sky.

1860.words: stack (noun): a neat pile of things placed on top of each other
1860.asset_description: A pop-art collage of a man in a dark suit whose head is a tall stack of books with one open book on top, against a bright pink-and-blue background full of printed letters.

1916.words: ufo (noun): a flying object believed to come from space
1916.asset_description: A cartoon robot stands on a colorful patchwork planet while flying saucers, moons and tiny rockets drift in the pale sky behind it.

1989.words: potion (noun): a magic drink made for a special effect
1989.asset_description: A dim apothecary room with wooden shelves packed with old potion bottles, jars and flasks beside an arched window overgrown with ivy, where butterflies flutter in the light.

2102.words: collection (noun): a large group of similar things kept together
2102.asset_description: A dim old room where tall wooden shelves are packed floor to ceiling with hundreds of antique leather books, warm light glowing from a doorway on the right.

2105.words: pile (noun): a heap of things placed on top of each other
2105.asset_description: Tall, leaning piles of old books are heaped on the floor next to a fully packed wooden bookshelf in a warm-lit room.

2132.words: abandoned (adjective): left empty and no longer used
2132.asset_description: A deserted old library with tall bookshelves, twisted vines growing across the glass ceiling, weeds on the floor and a single lantern hanging above.

2161.asset_description: An elderly scientist with wild white hair and a bushy mustache, unmistakably Einstein-like, gazes up in profile at a swirling galaxy and bright star filling the night sky behind him.

2176.words: aisle (noun): a narrow walkway between rows of shelves
2176.asset_description: A person with a blue umbrella and a small red backpack walks down a long aisle between impossibly tall bookshelves, while rain falls from an open cloudy sky above the library.

2291.words: asteroid (noun): a rock that flies through space
2291.asset_description: An astronaut in an orange spacesuit stands on a dark rocky surface while chunks of rock and small glowing fireballs float all around him against deep space.

2301.words: launch (verb): to send a rocket up into space
2301.asset_description: A colorful retro poster of a space shuttle lifting off on a huge column of flame and billowing orange-and-blue smoke clouds, with ringed planets and stars in the dark sky around it.

2302.words: weightless (adjective): floating freely because gravity does not pull
2302.asset_description: A comic-style astronaut in a white spacesuit with an American flag patch drifts weightlessly in a relaxed pose among colorful clouds, planets and spaceships.

2578.words: visor (noun): the clear front part of a helmet
2578.asset_description: A close-up of a worn retro space helmet whose large mirrored visor reflects a fiery orange landscape, against a blue sky with pink clouds.

2718.words: blueprint (noun): a technical drawing showing how it is built
2718.asset_description: A collage of a black grand piano with its gold lid raised, drawn half as a solid instrument and half as fine line diagrams, laid over aged graph paper covered in measurement lines, circular part drawings and scraps of sheet music.

2735.words: explosion (noun): a sudden violent burst of fire and noise
2735.asset_description: A Pixar-style scientist with wild white hair, round glasses and a lab coat laughs with his mouth wide open and his arms spread, while a huge ball of fire bursts behind him and bottles and bricks fly through his laboratory.

2736.words: astronomer (noun): a scientist who studies stars and planets
2736.asset_description: A black-and-white engraving-style portrait of an old man with a long beard and a ruffled collar; behind his head are the metal rings of an old star-globe, a cratered moon and a field of stars.

2737.words: black hole (noun): a place in space that pulls in even light
2737.asset_description: A round black disc sits in the middle of deep space with a thin bright blue ring around its edge, while red, orange and purple clouds of gas and stars spiral around it.

2791.words: transparent (adjective): clear enough to see straight through
2791.asset_description: A sci-fi portrait of a hairless female android: the top of her skull is a clear dome filled with purple and gold stars, she wears see-through yellow glasses, and her neck and shoulders are glossy panels with wiring showing underneath.

2810.words: workspace (noun): the desk area where you set up to work
2810.asset_description: An illustrated desk by a window at sunset: an open laptop, an open lined notebook with a pen, a mug of black coffee, a cup of latte with foam art, a pot of coloured pencils and a warm desk lamp.

2811.words: hologram (noun): a picture of light that looks three-dimensional
2811.asset_description: In a dark high-tech lab, a man in a white coat reaches out to touch a glowing blue three-dimensional car that hovers above the table, drawn only in lines of light, with data screens around him.

2827.words: doze off (phrase): to fall asleep for a short time by accident
2827.asset_description: A watercolour illustration of a schoolboy in a blue jumper asleep with his head on his folded arms at his classroom desk, an open sketchbook of paint blobs and two brushes in front of him and empty desks behind.

2829.words: browse (verb): to look slowly through things on shelves
2829.asset_description: A soft watercolour of a girl in a blue pinafore dress standing alone in a narrow lane between two tall wooden bookcases in an old library, holding a book open in her hands under a small ceiling lamp.

2909.words: scientist (noun): a person who studies nature and does experiments
2909.asset_description: A wildly colourful cartoon of a grinning old man with wild purple hair and round glasses in a paint-splattered blue jacket and bow tie, standing behind a bench of bubbling flasks while purple lightning arcs around his cluttered laboratory.

2937.words: astronaut (noun): a person in a sealed suit who travels in space
2937.asset_description: An astronaut in a white suit with a backpack and a round dark visor floats weightless in deep space, arms out, with a glowing orange and purple galaxy and small rocks drifting behind.

2942.words: planet (noun): a large round world that circles a star
2942.asset_description: A round-headed metal robot stands on red rocky ground while a starry sky behind it shows a glowing orange planet, a smaller grey planet and a bright blue star.

2980.words: telescope (noun): a tube with lenses for seeing far things
2980.asset_description: A dark golden painting of a bearded man in a top hat and coat standing on a rooftop terrace at night, one eye pressed to the eyepiece of a huge brass telescope mounted on a machine full of gears, with a bright full moon in the starry sky.

3199.words: dna (noun): the twisted thread that carries life's code
3199.asset_description: Dark blue 3D render of a long double spiral built from small glowing dots joined by thin lines, twisting up through empty space with parts blurred by shallow focus.

3243.words: network (noun): many things joined by lots of connections
3243.asset_description: Dark 3D render of an endless plain made of glowing blue lines and points of light joined into a web; small human silhouettes stand scattered across it, and a bright column of light falls into a ring far in the distance.

3346.words: library (noun): a place full of books you can read or borrow
3346.asset_description: Moody teal-and-orange image of two dark silhouettes standing face to face on a ledge in front of tall shelves packed with books, a diagonal beam of warm light falling across the shelves behind them.

3825.words: space (noun): the empty area beyond the sky, with stars
3825.asset_description: A vector illustration shows the glowing blue and white globe of the Earth hanging above a jagged pale grey landscape of ice and rock, against a dark starry background.

4090.asset_description: A tall silver rocket stands beside its steel launch tower on a concrete pad under a clear blue sky, venting white vapour. The engines light and orange flame and white smoke burst out around its base. The rocket lifts off the pad and rises past the tower, its exhaust turning to a bright pink and white column. It climbs out of frame and a huge cloud of pale smoke and dust rolls across the pad, leaving only the tower and the trail of fire above it.

4420.words: illustration (noun): artwork that helps make something clear
4420.asset_description: An old book plate on yellowed, foxed paper inside a hand-inked border. In the middle, drawn entirely in fine brown pen strokes, is a single long thigh bone seen at an angle: the round ball at the hip end at the top right, the smooth shaft running diagonally down, the two knobs of the knee end at the bottom left. Dense cross-hatching behind it gives the shading and shadow.

4435.words: exhibition (noun): a collection of things for public display
4435.asset_description: In the bright hall of a science museum a woman in a denim jacket holds a small pink model of a brain in both hands close to the camera, frowning at it; behind her are display stands and other visitors. She turns the model over in her fingers and studies it. She then leans over a low white display counter set with several large anatomical brain models on stands and points at one of them. Finally she stands in front of a huge glowing pink brain sculpture mounted on a purple wall and looks up at it with her mouth open.

4572.asset_description: A woman in a mustard blouse and red glasses sits alone at a long desk in an empty lecture theatre, with a takeaway coffee cup beside her. She works through a pile of exam papers with a red pen, drawing corrections across a sheet, then putting it down and pulling the next one over. Each time she looks up the two piles either side of her have grown taller, until they tower well above her head and hide her behind them. At the end she sits back, staring up at the towers of paper with her mouth open, spare red pens scattered across the desk.

4650.words: reaction (noun): a process in which substances change into others
4650.asset_description: In a school laboratory a student in a white lab coat, safety goggles and blue gloves tips a blue liquid from a small beaker into a conical glass flask on a black bench. Within seconds a thick pale-blue foam surges up out of the flask's neck and pours down the sides onto the bench. The foam keeps growing into a tall column that rises higher than his head and turns pink, yellow and rainbow-coloured, while he steps back with his mouth open in astonishment and classmates watch in the background.

4700.words: robot (noun): a mechanism that can move automatically
4700.asset_description: In a bright electronics lab a young man in glasses fits a black gripper onto the end of a jointed robotic arm bolted to the bench next to circuit boards and cables. He sits down at a sticker-covered laptop and types, watching the arm. The arm swings round on its own and holds out a white mug; he takes it, laughs and drinks from it, and two colleagues at the benches behind him raise their arms and cheer.

4860.words: bubble (noun): a small ball of gas inside a liquid
4860.asset_description: In a kitchen a woman in an apron drops a white tablet into a glass of water and small bubbles stream up through the water. She stirs it with a spoon, then lowers a big white block into a large glass tank where it fizzes into a swirling white cloud while she gasps at it.

4873.words: study (noun): using your mind to learn a subject by reading
4873.asset_description: A woman with glasses pushed up on her head sits at a desk walled in by towering stacks of books and bundles of paper. She reads an open book, writes on a small sticky note and looks up in surprise. The camera pulls back and the stacks keep growing until she is a tiny figure in the middle of a wall of books and files reaching the ceiling.

4930.words: reward (noun): something you get for doing worthy acts
4930.asset_description: A schoolgirl in a grey jumper and white collar sits at a desk in a classroom writing in a spiral notebook with a pencil, other pupils working behind her and a whiteboard at the front. She puts her hand up, beams, and slaps a high five with a hand reaching in from off camera. A close-up shows her carrying on writing a list of lines down the page. An adult hand then presses a large gold glitter star sticker onto the finished page beside her writing. In the final shot she holds the open notebook up to the camera with both hands, the gold star on the page, laughing with delight.

4931.words: diagram (noun): a drawing that explains how something works
4931.asset_description: A woman in a checked tweed blazer and black trousers walks past a wooden lectern into a large panelled lecture hall with a full audience, a leather case in her hand. In close-up her hand draws a wide chalk arc on a green blackboard. She then stands at the board beside a big chalk drawing of a circle with a cross of axes and labelled arrows pointing outwards, touching it with a wooden pointer as she speaks. Another close-up shows her chalking a formula with a fraction and arrows next to the drawing. At the end she faces the hall with both arms spread wide, smiling, the labelled circle drawing behind her.

5241.words: chamber (noun): an enclosed space, natural or man-made
5241.asset_description: A science-fiction illustration of a sealed medical room. A young woman in a pale blue gown lies on a padded table that slides into the mouth of a large white ring-shaped machine; the opening glows with blue and green light. Cables and control panels line the metal walls. Behind a thick window on the left, a technician in dark uniform watches her and works at a lit console.

5245.words: chemical (noun): material used in or made by a reaction
5245.asset_description: A cartoon laboratory: a young person in a white lab coat, orange goggles and rubber gloves holds a round flask of glowing purple liquid up above their head, mouth open in excitement, while swirling blue and pink smoke and floating bubbles rise out of it. Their other hand turns a dial on a big grey machine. The bench in front is covered with beakers and conical flasks of bubbling green and yellow liquid, and behind them stand test tubes of pink and purple liquid, boxy old monitors and shelves of jars.

5246.words: flask (noun): a narrow-necked glass container for liquids
5246.asset_description: A young woman in a white lab coat, white cap and safety goggles works in a busy laboratory. She pipettes bright blue liquid into a rack of test tubes, swirls a conical glass flask of blue-green liquid over a hotplate, then holds the flask up to the light and smiles at it. She bends to a microscope with a flask of blue liquid beside her, and at the end holds up a flask of glowing pink liquid while a colleague at the next bench watches.

5358.words: peek (verb): to take a quick secret look from hiding
5358.asset_description: A young woman in glasses and a beige cardigan sits at a long wooden table in a grand library, writing in an open textbook with a blue pen while other students work behind her. She piles more and more thick books on the table until the stacks form a wall taller than she is, and at the end she is hidden behind it, only her eyes showing as she looks out through a gap between the piles.

258.words: edge (noun): the line or border where a surface or object ends
258.asset_description: A hand slides along the rim of a wooden picnic table until the fingers stop right where the top ends. At a lakeside camp two people pull a rope to the corner of a tarp, and a blue-haired person walks carefully out a narrow dock, pointing down, until their toes stop at the very end above the water.
258.transcript: Got it. Whoa. All the way.

755.words: surface (noun): the flat top layer of something you can touch
755.asset_description: A woman in a workshop runs her hand over different flat tops: she sweeps dust off a wooden table, pours clear resin that sets into a glossy sheen, rolls a wooden wheel across a polished stone table, and finally admires a huge mirror-shiny factory floor.

1043.words: arc (noun): a curved line or path shaped like part of a circle
1043.asset_description: A dolphin is caught at the top of its leap over a sunset ocean, its body and the curling ribbon of water thrown up behind it drawing one smooth curve through the air.

1414.asset_description: One giant oak fills most of the frame on an empty grassy hill, and the two people standing at its foot with a picnic basket are so small next to the trunk that you barely notice them.

2420.words: rickety (adjective): old, weak and likely to fall apart
2420.asset_description: A tall, impossible tower of mismatched colorful houses stacked on top of each other, leaning on thin wooden poles beside old railway tracks under a blue sky.

2464.words: symmetrical (adjective): the same on both sides, like a mirror
2464.asset_description: A woman's pale face with blue eyes emerges from an elaborate white papercut-style relief; the carved leaf and feather patterns mirror each other perfectly on the left and right sides of her face.

2506.words: geometric (adjective): made of simple regular shapes like squares
2506.asset_description: A dreamlike scene built entirely from smooth pink and red geometric shapes: wide staircases, arches, blocks and round towers under a rosy sky.

2722.words: spiral (noun): a shape that curves round and round from a centre
