2722.asset_description: A glowing neon-blue portrait of a man in a wide cowboy hat and jacket, standing against black space; below him a bright orange-and-blue spiral of stars and dust curls around a shining core.

2867.words: sphere (noun): an object shaped like a perfect ball
2867.asset_description: Inside a huge stone hall with gold-topped columns and arched windows, a giant transparent glass sphere full of glowing sparks stands on an ornate round pedestal, with a second smaller sphere hanging above it pouring light down.

2908.words: giant (adjective): far bigger than normal for its kind
2908.asset_description: A textured painting of a man in a dark suit and two little girls standing hand in hand in a field of yellow flowers, looking up at an enormous open book that floats in the air above them, far taller than they are.

2987.words: golden (adjective): shining with the bright yellow colour of gold
2987.asset_description: A shiny digital render of a small big-headed robot in full golden armour with a glowing heart on its chest, standing on dark rock with a burning golden ring and a blue nebula behind it.

4019.words: ring (noun): a round shape with a hole in the middle
4019.asset_description: A man in swim shorts stands at the edge of a garden pool holding a folded towel and smiling at the camera. In the pool a golden retriever puppy floats with its head and front paws resting through a bright pink inflatable ring. A grey pitbull drifts past in a red one, and the camera returns to the puppy dozing in the pink ring.
4019.transcript: Three, two, one. Lucas, Rocky, Gumbo.

4480.words: curve (noun): a line that bends, changing direction
4480.asset_description: A stylised woodblock-style illustration of a camel with a patterned saddle blanket striding along the top of a desert dune at sunset. The whole bottom half of the picture is one long sweeping ridge of sand that bends across the frame in bands of orange, red and cream, and the camel's neck and the swirling clouds above it repeat the same bending line. A red sun sits low behind it.

4598.asset_description: In a coffee shop lined with shelves of brightly coloured cups, a red-haired woman in cat-eye glasses orders at the counter. A hand slides her a normal rainbow-striped mug of coffee and she lifts it and grins. Then a far bigger mug appears, and a bigger one still, until she is gripping a pastel-striped mug the size of a bucket with both hands, eyes wide and mouth open, its handle as thick as her wrist.

4688.words: massive (adjective): imposing in size or bulk
4688.asset_description: Two young men in yellow raincoats lean over the wooden rail of a small boat on a calm blue sea. A dark shape the length of the boat glides just under the surface beneath them. It blows a tall column of spray, then a barnacled humpback whale pushes its head and long ribbed throat up out of the water right beside the hull, rising higher than the men before sliding back down.

4823.words: depth (noun): how far downward something goes
4823.asset_description: A freediver in a black wetsuit and long carbon fins hangs head-down far below the surface of deep blue open water, sliding down beside a pale guide rope that runs from the sunlit surface into the dark water below him. Small bubbles trail up from his mask towards the light above.

4853.asset_description: Extreme close-up of a woman squinting through a gold eye loupe at a minute brass cog held in a pair of tweezers right in front of her eye. She sits back at a workbench covered with tweezers, tins and springs, in a shop whose walls are hung with wall clocks, and holds the loupe up to her eye. Next she points a fine tool into the open case of a mantel clock, its brass wheels visible behind the glass. Then a tall grandfather clock with brass weights and a swinging pendulum fills the frame, and finally she stands with her arms out under the enormous brass gears of a tower clock.

4858.words: spiral (noun): a shape that curves round and round from a centre
4858.asset_description: A young man in a tie-dye shirt kneels on the floor of a big empty hall setting up coloured dominoes. The camera follows winding rainbow lines of standing dominoes across the floor, and a wide shot reveals they form one enormous spiral curling in on itself, with him crouched at the centre.

4887.words: narrow (adjective): not wide, small from side to side
4887.asset_description: A hiker in a cap and backpack climbs down a red rock canyon trail; the camera looks along his boots as he steps from ledge to ledge, then opens onto huge layered sandstone cliffs and a thin stony path winding down into the gorge between the rock walls.

4889.words: circular (adjective): having the shape of a circle
4889.asset_description: In a bright white photo studio a young woman spins around on a black office chair, laughing; two people beside her point and turn; the camera rises to show dozens of people turning and stepping on a large circular white platform ringed with potted plants, sofas and stools.

4900.words: stack (noun): a neat pile of things placed on top of each other
4900.asset_description: In a sunny back garden a wooden barrel rolls across the grass towards two onlookers; then a folding table with bats and balls appears, then a shopping trolley loaded with grocery bags; finally a very tall neat pile of wooden pallets stands on the lawn and topples into a scattered heap.

4905.words: span (verb): to cover or extend over an area
4905.asset_description: Four shots of long structures reaching out over a distance. A workman in a blue shirt holds a telescopic aluminium ladder that pulls out to full length in front of a wooden fence. A red fire engine in a city street has its aerial ladder run out high into the sky. A crane boom stretches diagonally across a hazy construction site at sunset. Last, two steel bridge arches reach out from opposite cliffs across a red rock canyon with a river far below.

5094.asset_description: In a busy gym, a very thin young man with red hair pulls up his vest sleeve and flexes his arm with a strained grimace — the arm stays narrow and bony. The clip cuts to a woman in a blue top who flexes a clearly rounded, defined bicep and smiles at the camera, and then to a huge bodybuilder in a black vest who raises both arms into a double biceps pose while two friends behind him shout him on.

5146.words: strip (noun): a long narrow piece of something
5146.asset_description: A woman in a bright headscarf and a floral apron sits on a sunny terrace with a big patterned bowl of apples and potatoes on her lap. She turns a red apple against a small knife so that the skin comes away in one continuous ribbon rather than in pieces. The red and white ribbon gets longer and longer, curling over the edge of the bowl and hanging down past her knees towards the floor while she keeps turning the apple. She looks at the camera with her eyes and mouth wide open at how long the unbroken ribbon has become. Behind her are terracotta roof tiles, red geraniums in pots and washing on a line.

5227.words: several (adjective): more than two or three, but not many
5227.asset_description: A young woman in a neon yellow crop top and shorts jogs towards the camera along a wide paved seafront promenade lined with palm trees, with a beach and blue sea on one side. At first a single black-and-white border collie runs beside her. As she keeps going, more dogs of different breeds and colours appear from both sides and fall in with her, until she is jogging in the middle of a small group of about six dogs, laughing and throwing her arms up.

5229.words: handful (noun): the amount you can hold in your hand
5229.asset_description: A photograph taken on a bright, freezing winter morning in a snow-covered public square. A woman in a long dark fur coat, black gloves and a patterned fringed shawl stands side-on to the camera, has just scooped up as much powdery snow as her two hands could hold and thrown it upwards; the small cloud of snow hangs in the sunlight in front of her while the rest falls back down. Behind her rises a cathedral with brightly painted onion domes, with bare birch trees and snow-covered ground around it.

5236.words: distance (noun): the space between two objects or points
5236.asset_description: A watercolour illustration of a desert at sunset. A man in a white robe and red-and-white headscarf walks along the crest of a tall red dune, leading two loaded camels behind him. Sand sprays off the ridge under his feet. Far away across the flat desert, small in the haze, stands a cluster of glass office towers.

5373.words: expand (verb): to become larger in size or volume
5373.asset_description: In a sunny back garden, three people stand at a picnic table watching a striped beach ball get bigger and bigger until it fills the frame. A glass bowl of dough on the same table then rises until it bulges over the rim. Next a woman on the lawn watches a blue paddling pool grow out to its full size, and finally the whole group stands watching a yellow and blue bouncy castle rise up into a full castle with towers.

5374.words: shallow (adjective): not deep, lacking much depth
5374.asset_description: A man swims front crawl through bright turquoise sea that is so low and clear that the sandy bottom and his own shadow are visible right underneath him. Boats sit on the horizon and a dolphin leaps out of the water behind him. At the end he stops swimming and kneels beside a pale sandbank, the water reaching only to his chest.

5411.asset_description: A man at a bathroom basin screws up his face as he squeezes hard on an almost empty tube, getting barely a smear onto his brush. The film cuts to a young woman in a green towel headband at a bright counter with three blue toothbrushes laid out in front of her. She holds a full tube over each brush and squeezes out a thick coil of mint-green paste, winding it round and round into a fat spiral on every one, then looks up at the camera wide-eyed at the three big swirls.

135.words: cancel (verb): to say a planned meeting or event is off
135.asset_description: A man sitting in his car reads a text that says 'Hey, sorry, but I have to cancel our plans tonight', looks briefly shocked, then breaks into a huge grin and fist-pumps because now he can stay home.
135.transcript: My friend cancels our plans tonight! Oh yes! Now I stay home! I am so happy!

231.words: disappoint (verb): to make someone sad by not doing what they hoped
231.asset_description: An animated woman waits happily at a candlelit rooftop dinner table with spaghetti and a wrapped gift, waving as her partner arrives. He apologetically tells her he cannot stay and leaves, and she is left crying alone at the table, staring sadly at the untouched dinner and present.
231.transcript: *Door opens* Baralla, I can't stay. But...tonight? I'm sorry. Really. Oh.

347.words: gossip (noun): juicy talk about other people's private lives
347.asset_description: Two animated friends at an outdoor cafe table whisper into each other's ears with shocked faces, sneak glances at an old couple at a nearby table while saying they are not looking, then sip their coffee innocently.
347.transcript: She told me everything. No way! Don't look now. I'm not looking!

379.words: vlog (noun): a video diary someone films to share online
379.asset_description: A girl with freckles holds her phone at arm's length in her bright bedroom, waves at the camera and says good morning, explaining she is filming a little vlog today while smiling and fixing her hair.
379.transcript: good morning i'm filming a little vlog today

545.words: performance (noun): a show performed in front of an audience
545.asset_description: Two street performers juggle colorful clubs inside a chalk circle on a cobblestone old-town square, tossing clubs high while a large crowd rings them, watches and applauds, and the pair finally bow beside their tip hat.

834.words: hostess (noun): a woman who invites guests and looks after them
834.asset_description: A young woman in a flowery dress serves a big roast turkey to a table full of excited guests, brings out pineapple on demand and even pours water straight into a guest's mouth, then plants her hands on her hips, fed up with being used.
834.transcript: Enjoy your meal. You are the best hostess! Do you have pineapple please? Could you pass me the water? You are taking advantage of me a bit as a hostess.

918.words: audience (noun): the people watching a show or a talk
918.asset_description: Rows of seated people in a dark theater hall clap and smile toward the stage, seen from the stage edge, filling the raked seating from front to back.

1008.words: community (noun): people from one area who do things together
1008.asset_description: Neighbors of all ages and backgrounds, including a child and older adults, kneel around raised garden beds passing potted seedlings and digging together in a sunny shared garden between houses.

1116.words: groom (noun): the man who is getting married at a wedding
1116.asset_description: At an evening outdoor wedding under strings of lights, a groom in a navy suit lifts and carries his laughing bride across the dance floor while guests throw flower petals.

1139.words: host (noun): the person who invites guests and cares for them
1139.asset_description: A smiling middle-aged man stands at the head of a long candle-lit dinner table, raising his wine glass in a toast while his seated guests smile up at him.

1756.words: argue (verb): to speak angrily with someone you disagree with
1756.asset_description: A comic cartoon of an angry man at his desk gritting his teeth on a phone call while a thought bubble shows a furious woman screaming into her phone and pointing at it.

2035.words: romance (noun): a loving relationship between two people
2035.asset_description: A watercolor of a well-dressed couple seen from behind, arm in arm in hats and coats, while a big heart-shaped cloud of pink blossoms and branches grows above their heads and petals drift around them.

2262.words: connect (verb): to join two people or things together
2262.asset_description: A young woman and a man with earphones sit facing each other, each looking at a phone, while a colorful web of dots and lines connects the space between their heads.

2280.words: embrace (verb): to put your arms around someone
2280.asset_description: A painterly young couple stands close together on a sailing boat at sunset; the man wraps his arms around the woman, who wears a white dress and a flower crown, both with eyes closed.

2412.words: arm in arm (phrase): walking with your arm linked through another's
2412.asset_description: In a moody autumn oil painting, a man in a hat and coat and a woman in a red dress walk arm in arm down a wet street past a glowing lamppost.

2452.words: romantic (adjective): connected with love, making you feel love
2452.asset_description: Seen from behind, a man in a blue coat wraps his arm around a woman in a hat and long coat as they walk together down a snowy lamplit city street in falling snow.

2511.words: spark (noun): a tiny glowing bit of fire in the air
2511.asset_description: A young couple stands forehead to forehead in silhouette at night while hundreds of glowing orange and blue sparks drift through the air around them.

2575.words: anonymous (adjective): with the name and face kept hidden
2575.asset_description: A figure in a white hoodie stands at two turntables, the hood pulled up so the face is completely black and hidden, with bright paint splatters on the wall behind.

2684.words: carnival (noun): a street festival with costumes and masks
2684.asset_description: A flat-lay of two gold Venetian eye masks decorated with blue jewels and gold scrollwork, arranged on dark blue silk among yellow feathers, gold beads and thin gold chains.

2685.words: masquerade (noun): a party where everyone wears a mask
2685.asset_description: Three gold Venetian eye masks with dark blue feather crowns and jewelled scrollwork lie on folded black silk, scattered with gold fabric flowers and small blue pearls.

2824.words: nightclub (noun): a late place where people dance to a DJ
2824.asset_description: A neon-lit digital illustration of a smiling young woman with headphones round her neck leaning over a DJ mixer and spinning record decks, while a crowd of dancers glows pink and purple behind her.

2892.words: sparkler (noun): a thin stick that burns with white sparks
2892.asset_description: A watercolour of a small boy in a brown coat and bobble hat standing on a snowy city street at night, holding out a burning sparkler and looking up at big colourful fireworks over the lit shop fronts and street lamps.

3062.words: dj (noun): someone who plays and mixes recorded music
3062.asset_description: Retro screen-print poster of a young man in headphones bent over two turntables and a mixer, one hand on a record and the other on the controls, with a microphone beside him and wavy orange and green lines behind.

3278.words: couple (noun): two people in a romantic relationship
3278.asset_description: Watercolour of two faceless figures standing pressed close together in an embrace, one painted in deep blue and one in warm orange, their outlines dissolving into washes with thin gold lines running over them.

3285.words: costume (noun): special clothes worn for a show or festival
3285.asset_description: Colourful digital painting of a smiling carnival dancer wearing a huge headdress made of fruit, feathers and toy parrots, big red flower earrings and a shiny decorated top, on a dark stage with lights behind her.

3288.words: stilts (noun): two long poles you stand on to walk up high
3288.asset_description: Painted illustration of two carnival performers walking on tall wooden stilts in a colourful street; long ruffled skirts hang from their waists over the stilts, and a mural of the Brazilian flag covers the steps behind them.

3832.words: fireworks (noun): things that explode in the sky with colour
3832.asset_description: Five bursts of fireworks in blue, purple, green and white explode against a deep navy night sky, their thin sparks radiating out from bright centres.

4043.words: surprise (verb): to cause someone to be surprised
4043.asset_description: A woman in a black leather jacket and beige trousers walks along a sunlit street of honey-coloured stone buildings, tucking her hair behind her ear. She turns and sees a man getting out of a black car parked at the kerb, carrying an enormous bouquet of pale pink peonies. He walks up to her and holds the flowers out; she takes them, and in the final shot she is behind the huge bouquet with her hand over her mouth, laughing and crying at once.

4046.words: refuse (verb): to show you are unwilling to do something
4046.asset_description: A couple sits close together on a dark sofa in a room lit by candles and warm lamps at night. The woman in a floral top turns to the man in an olive t-shirt and talks to him, smiling. He turns his head towards her, raises his index finger in front of his chest, shakes it and says no. She keeps hold of his arm and bursts out laughing while he holds the finger up and keeps saying no.

4125.words: stage (noun): a platform where people stand to be seen
4125.asset_description: A theatre stage under a single beam of spotlight, with the dark silhouetted heads of the audience along the bottom of the frame. Something huge stands on the sand-covered stage floor under a turquoise silk sheet. A man in a white suit walks on from the side, takes the corner of the silk and pulls; the sheet lifts and floats away, and on the stage stands a life-size elephant made entirely of red, orange and white flowers. He steps back and the whole flower skin bursts apart into a curtain of falling petals that pours down over the stage. When the petals clear, a real elephant is standing there in the spotlight with a ring of red flowers on its head, lifting its trunk, and the stage floor is carpeted with petals while the audience films it.

4236.words: attract (verb): to draw someone toward you
4236.asset_description: Two young men in yellow high-visibility vests and work boots lift a large flat-screen television down from the back of a white delivery van on a city street. As they carry it, a woman in a short brown dress and heels walks past on the pavement. Both men turn their heads to follow her, still holding the heavy screen between them, and one nearly loses his grip. They set the television down and stand with their hands on their hips, watching her walk away.

4313.words: pub (noun): a building with a bar where people drink
4313.asset_description: A bar room with exposed brick, wooden tables and strings of fairy lights across the ceiling. A man in a denim shirt holds a microphone out toward the camera; pints of beer stand on the table in front of him. He offers the microphone to three young women at a table, who laugh; then a bearded man in a high-visibility jacket takes it, puts a hand on his chest and belts out a song while the drinkers around him clap. Finally an elderly woman in a cream cardigan sings into the microphone as the whole room cheers behind her.

4318.words: applause (noun): showing approval by clapping the hands
4318.asset_description: A darkened hall with a red-lit stage at the front where a performer stands beside a microphone stand. In the seats a bearded man in a mustard shirt, sunglasses pushed up on his head, claps his hands together over and over with a broad smile, watching the stage. The rows of people in front of him are clapping too. He grows more enthusiastic and finally raises both hands above his head to keep clapping.

4409.asset_description: At a house party hung with paper streamers and balloons, a woman with a rainbow cloth tied over her eyes gropes forward with both hands out, laughing, while others reach towards her. Outside in the garden, a blindfolded person swings at a piñata hanging from a beam. Back inside, the whole group is blindfolded, stumbling around the living room with their arms out until they take the blindfolds off and swing the piñata sticks.
4409.transcript: I can't see anything. This way?

4427.words: ceremony (noun): a formal event on a special occasion
4427.asset_description: A large tatami room with sliding paper screens, a hanging scroll in the alcove and two rows of people in dark suits kneeling along the side walls. A tall young man in a dark suit and an older woman in a black kimono stand facing each other down the middle of the mats, a white certificate laid on the floor between them. They bow to each other from the waist, then bow again lower, then kneel down on the mats on either side of the certificate. In the last shot both are pressed right down with their foreheads almost on the tatami over the paper.

4433.words: bunch (noun): a grouping of similar things
4433.asset_description: A loose pen and watercolour sketch of a doorstep at evening. A young man in a beige jacket stands side on in the foreground, glancing back over his shoulder with a small pleased smile, one hand in his pocket. In his other hand, held down behind his back, he grips the stems of a big bundle of flowers: red and pink roses and yellow blooms gathered together, with a single petal drifting away. Behind him the front door stands open with warm yellow light spilling out, a young woman inside clapping her hands to her face in delight, a lantern glowing on the wall and terracotta pots either side of the step.

4434.words: fair (noun): a traveling show with rides and games
4434.asset_description: At a fairground a young man in a college jacket hands a young woman a giant light brown teddy bear in front of a red and white striped stall hung with more teddy prizes, and she hugs it with her mouth open in surprise. They walk on together past the metal rails under a big ferris wheel, and he lays his jacket over her shoulders while she holds the bear. She laughs into the camera holding a white ice cream cone, and he holds another. In the last shot the two of them sit side by side high up on the wheel with the bear on her lap, the whole fair spread out below them with striped tents, stalls and rides.

4564.asset_description: A soft watercolour of a village barn raising on a summer meadow. A long line of villagers in waistcoats and caps leans back on a rope, hauling a big wooden roof frame upright, while an old man in a straw hat stands on the platform pointing and directing them. On the left, women in aprons carry trays of loaves and pies out from a trestle table under an awning; a girl holds a basket. Children run across the grass with buckets and tools for the men on the ladder, and thatched cottages sit behind.

4580.words: date (noun): a meeting arranged in advance
4580.asset_description: A cartoon of a diner with a red-and-white checked tablecloth, a jukebox and neon signs on the wall. A boy and a girl lean their heads together over one tall milkshake glass topped with whipped cream and a cherry, each drinking through their own bent straw. Their hands are joined on the table in front of the glass, both are blushing, and a pink heart-shaped balloon floats above them.

4614.words: hang (verb): to attach something high up so it drops down
4614.asset_description: A couple are getting a room ready for a birthday party. A man in a bright floral shirt stands on a blue stepladder and tapes the end of a rainbow paper garland to the wall so that it drops down in a long loop. He then drapes a string of fairy lights along a set of shelves. Below him a woman in a denim jacket blows up an orange balloon. A HAPPY BIRTHDAY bunting and rows of hanging lights go up on the wall, and by the end coloured paper streamers hang from the middle of the ceiling down to every corner, with balloons covering the floor.

4696.words: encourage (verb): to inspire someone with confidence
4696.asset_description: In a climbing gym an older woman with glasses chalks her hands and takes hold of a red grip on a bouldering wall. A group of young climbers stands on the mats below her, shouting up at her, punching the air and clapping. She pulls herself off the ground and works her way up the overhanging wall while they keep cheering, raising their arms and applauding as she reaches high above them.

4706.words: to shout (verb): to speak in a loud voice
4706.asset_description: A packed football stadium at dusk. In the front row a heavy man in a sky blue shirt with a striped scarf around his neck throws both arms in the air, tips his head back and roars with his mouth wide open. Around him fans with flags painted on their cheeks yell and punch the air. The camera lifts to show tier after tier of supporters on their feet, arms up, mouths open in one long roar, and finally the whole bowl of the ground with a small boy on his father's shoulders in the middle of it.

4713.asset_description: On a stone quay in an old harbour, two men in black overcoats and flat caps hand a heavy brown leather suitcase down to a white haired old man in a long dark coat as he steps into a small wooden rowing boat. Along the harbour wall a line of villagers in headscarves, shawls and old fashioned coats stand pressed together with their hands lifted, waving at him. The boat pushes off and is rowed out of the harbour; the camera holds on it as it gets smaller and smaller on the flat grey sea until it is only a dark speck on the horizon.

4773.words: gathering (noun): a group of people together in one place
4773.asset_description: A cobbled city square with cafe terraces and pastel townhouses. A young man stands alone in the middle of the square playing an accordion, his open case on the stones in front of him. A few passers-by slow down, then more stop, a cyclist halts, and within seconds dozens of people have collected around him in a wide ring. By the end a large crowd fills the square and everyone is clapping. A woman with a long red plait watches from the foreground.

4800.words: groom (noun): the man who is getting married at a wedding
4800.asset_description: A man in a black tuxedo straightens his bow tie in a hotel mirror while a second man watches, walks out through a white door into a garden, waits with his back to the camera in front of a large arch of white and pink roses with guests seated on the lawn, then turns and smiles with a white rose pinned to his lapel.

4919.words: membership (noun): being a member of a group
4919.asset_description: A campus club fair on a lawn: rows of tents, bunting and a stall under a red canopy with a hand-lettered sign. Three students with cameras hanging round their necks stand behind the stall table and wave a newcomer over. One of them holds out an old silver film camera; she takes it and raises it to her eye. In close-up a hand signs a form headed MEMBERSHIP on a clipboard with a blue pen. The three then lift their cameras over their heads and cheer.
4919.transcript: All right, do you mind if I just go up and shoot?

4920.words: community (noun): people from one area who do things together
4920.asset_description: In a garden between two apartment blocks, an elderly man, a young woman and a small boy kneel at a raised wooden bed and press a seedling into the dark soil. A striped watering can is passed from hand to hand among the neighbours standing around, adults of different ages plus the little boy. The young woman waters the seedlings, the water streaming from the spout onto the soil. She then holds a hand-painted COMMUNITY GARDEN sign over her head, and the whole group of residents cheers and throws their arms up around her.

4943.words: praise (noun): words or clapping that show approval
4943.asset_description: A young man in a striped knitted sweater sits with his eyes closed while a hand dusts powder onto his cheekbone with a make-up brush. He then stands on a film set lit by big softbox lamps, pulls a huge open-mouthed shocked expression twice while a crew member moves equipment behind him, and finally the crew - five people in dark clothes - line up and clap and cheer for him. He turns back to the camera beaming with his hands on his hips.

4960.words: cuddle (verb): to hold someone close in a soft, loving way
4960.asset_description: An arrivals hall at an airport. A red-haired woman in a mustard jacket wraps both arms tightly around a dark-haired woman and holds her close, eyes shut, beaming over her shoulder. Around them travellers wheel suitcases past under the yellow Arrivals sign. More family members close in until the whole group is holding each other in one long group cuddle, laughing and rocking together.

4971.words: fireworks (noun): things that explode in the sky with colour
4971.asset_description: Night scene in front of a floodlit domed capitol building: an officer in a white dress uniform hauls a rope and runs a red, white and blue flag up a tall pole while a huge crowd watches; the sky then fills with burst after burst of gold, red, white and blue fireworks over the dome, and the shot ends among the crowd waving small flags and sparklers and cheering.

5029.words: gesture (noun): a motion of the hands or body to show a feeling
5029.asset_description: An ink drawing of a courtroom in heavy cross-hatching. A man in a suit and loose tie strides across the floor mid-step, one fist punched high above his head and the other arm swung back holding an open folder. Behind him a judge sits at the bench, a flag stands in the corner and people watch from the benches on both sides.

5104.words: talk (noun): a conversation where people exchange ideas
5104.asset_description: A hand-drawn cartoon of two neighbours talking over the low wooden fence between their gardens. On the left a man in a straw hat and patched overalls leans on the fence and holds up a teacup, a speech bubble full of squiggles above him. On the right a woman in a floral dress and apron listens with a hand at her cheek, laughing, while her watering can pours onto a flower bed. A black cat sits on a fence post between them, laundry hangs on a line and a smiling sun is in the sky.

5184.words: romantic (adjective): connected with love, making you feel love
5184.asset_description: On a cobbled stone bridge at sunset a young man in a grey suit drops onto one knee and holds up an open ring box to a young woman in a yellow dress. She claps both hands over her mouth in tears. A close-up shows the diamond ring in the black velvet box against the golden sunset; an accordion player and passers-by watch from behind. She says yes, they laugh, and she throws her arms around him as strangers applaud.

5231.asset_description: A big family sits along both sides of a long wooden table inside a log house with a lit stove behind them. A tall brass samovar steams in the middle of the table, which is loaded with a platter of dumplings, a stack of pancakes, dark rye bread, jars of pickles, radishes, cucumbers and jam. An elderly woman in a headscarf and apron works the samovar tap, filling glasses of tea and handing them round to the children and adults; at the end everyone reaches in and clinks their glasses together over the food.

5256.words: address (verb): to speak to a group of people
5256.asset_description: A large wood-panelled hall of a court. A judge in a red robe and white wig stands at a raised lectern and speaks to the room from written notes. Five more judges in wigs and black gowns sit in a row behind him. In front of him a packed hall of seated people listens; a man at a table in the front row stands up while the judge is still speaking.

5261.words: share (noun): the part you get when something is divided
5261.asset_description: A picnic on the grass by the beach. A woman with pink hair opens a pizza box on her lap, lifts out a slice with the cheese stretching, and holds it out to the friends sitting around her. A jogger stops and takes a piece, and an older woman walking two dogs is offered one as well. In a wide shot the whole group sits on blankets in a circle, each of them eating their own slice while the open box stands in the middle.

5332.asset_description: Inside a busy restaurant a waitress takes plates of food from the kitchen pass while a chef in whites hands them over. Waiters in white shirts and dark aprons carry stacked plates through the dining room between white-clothed tables, and a waitress sets a cappuccino down on the bar counter in front of a guest. At the end the whole team - waiters, waitresses, the chef and the manager - crowd together in front of the open kitchen with their arms round each other, shouting and laughing into the camera as one group.

5334.words: respect (verb): to show respect towards someone
5334.asset_description: In a packed floodlit stadium at night a big bearded man in a denim jacket gets to his feet and lays his hand flat on his chest. Around him the whole block of spectators does the same - older men in team hoodies, a woman in a black coat - all standing still and looking towards the pitch while flags are held up behind them. The camera then pulls back to show the entire stadium on its feet.

5364.words: assist (verb): to give someone help with something
5364.asset_description: A young woman in an orange running vest is doubled over at a crowd barrier, sobbing with exhaustion. A man in a blue shirt and cap and another runner in a rainbow tri-suit each take one of her arms, lift her upright and walk her along the road past cheering spectators. The three finish together and end in a tearful hug.

5391.words: stare (verb): to look at something for a long time
5391.asset_description: Evening at a park with the sun low behind the trees. A boy in a black hoodie rolls across the flat concrete of a skatepark on his skateboard while four friends watch from the ramp behind him. On the basketball court another boy throws the ball up towards the hoop against the setting sun and catches it again. Then five teenagers sit shoulder to shoulder on a bench in front of the hoop, leaning in over one boy's phone with their eyes fixed on the screen and their mouths open, before they all break into laughter.

5432.words: trick (verb): to deceive somebody for fun
5432.asset_description: An evening street stall hung with rows of brass bells. A young ice cream seller in a red fez and an embroidered red waistcoat works the stretchy ice cream with a long metal paddle, lifting a heavy rope of it into the air. He holds a cone out to a customer, and each time the customer reaches for it he flips the paddle and takes the cone away again, ringing the bells and laughing while the customer keeps grabbing at nothing. In the end he hands the cone over.

5443.words: solidarity (noun): a union of purposes among members of a group
5443.asset_description: A city street at low golden-hour sun, filled end to end with people. In the foreground two hands clasp each other tightly, and behind them the crowd stretches away in two long facing rows, every person reaching across to grip the hand of the person opposite, forming an unbroken human chain down the middle of the road. The faces are serious and calm and all turned the same way. Behind the chain, plain coloured banners in red, blue and green are held up above the heads of the crowd, with city buildings and bare trees on both sides.

5444.words: cooperate (verb): to work together on a common project
5444.asset_description: In the bright white atrium of a museum, a group of young adults builds one giant floor jigsaw together. They carry big foam puzzle pieces shaped like countries across the tiled floor, kneel down and slot them into place at the edges of a huge coloured world map that is slowly taking shape. Two of them lift one long black piece between them and lower it into the gap; another crouches to push an orange piece into the outline; a woman in a headscarf lays a piece into the row beside them. Passers-by stop and watch from the sides. When the last pieces are in, the group stands back, laughs and throws their hands up for a high five over the finished map.

5484.words: gaze (verb): to look at something steadily for a long time
5484.asset_description: A boy, a woman and a man stand side by side at the wooden railing of a rooftop terrace at night, with the roofs of a town behind them. Fireworks climb and burst in the dark sky above them. All three keep their heads tilted back and their eyes fixed on the sky for the whole clip, mouths open in wonder, the boy pointing upwards once as another rocket goes up.

5488.words: farewell (noun): an expression of goodwill at parting
5488.asset_description: On a sunny quay a small group of people stand at the railing waving both arms at a white passenger ferry. An older woman in a flowered headscarf and a young man grin at the camera with their hands raised; others beside them swing pink scarves overhead. The ferry pulls away from the ramp, passengers crowded on its decks waving back, and it shrinks into the blue water towards the city skyline as the group on the quay keeps waving.

49.words: arrow (noun): the thin feathered stick you shoot from a bow
49.asset_description: On a misty field an archer holds a feathered arrow up to the camera, nocks it on her bow and shoots at a distant target; the arrow hits the bullseye and she pulls it out and shows it proudly.

69.words: barbell (noun): the long metal bar with heavy plates on both ends
69.asset_description: In a gym two people load big black plates onto a bar and clip them tight; a blonde woman chalks her hands, grips the heavy barbell and deadlifts it to a stand while friends watch, then drops it and celebrates.

105.words: bow (noun): a curved weapon with a string that shoots arrows
105.asset_description: In an anime-style clip, a silver-haired older woman draws a wooden bow, aims the arrow with narrowed eyes and hits the bullseye of a straw target; her big bearded companion celebrates and hands her the next arrow.
105.transcript: Wow, that's tight! Aha! Dead center!

172.words: cleats (noun): sports shoes with studs for grip on grass
172.asset_description: A soccer player on a rainy pitch holds up a boot to show the studded sole, laces the black cleats on at the bench, then sprints across wet grass and digs the studs into the mud without slipping, grinning at the camera.

251.words: dumbbell (noun): a short bar with a weight at each end
251.asset_description: A young man grabs a black plate-loaded dumbbell from a yoga mat, does biceps curls with it and presses it overhead in the living room. His girlfriend watches from an armchair sipping coffee and applauds as he sets it down grinning.

587.words: puck (noun): the hard black disc used in ice hockey
587.asset_description: A cartoon referee holds up a black puck and drops it for a face-off between purple and yellow teams. A player in yellow wins it, skates up the ice, fires the puck past the purple goalie into the net and celebrates holding it up.
587.transcript: Ready? Here it comes! Whoa! Yes! In!

591.words: punching bag (noun): a heavy hanging bag that boxers hit
591.asset_description: A muscular man carries a big leather punching bag up a ladder in his garage and hangs it from a ceiling chain while a woman helps. He tests it with punches, makes it swing, celebrates and finally hugs the bag.

740.words: stopwatch (noun): a watch you start and stop to time something
740.asset_description: At a running track at dusk, a coach clicks an analog stopwatch as a sprinter takes off, stops it the moment she finishes, then stares at the dial in disbelief and celebrates the record time with her.

1625.words: surfboard (noun): the long board you stand on to ride waves
1625.asset_description: The black silhouette of a long-haired surfer stands on a rocky shore holding a tall surfboard upright, against a bright orange sky with the sun low behind the rocks.

2580.words: archer (noun): a person who shoots with a bow and arrow
2580.asset_description: A dark polished statue of a young Indian deity standing as an archer, drawing an ornate bow with an arrow, a quiver of arrows strapped to his back.

3304.words: hockey stick (noun): a long stick with a bent end for the puck
3304.asset_description: Pencil sketch of an ice hockey player in helmet, gloves and knee pads crouching on his skates, holding his stick down on the ice with the puck in front of the blade.

5268.words: rifle (noun): a long gun you hold with two hands
5268.asset_description: A wide view of a biathlon range in flat winter light with a crowd of spectators packed behind the barriers. A female athlete in a green and blue race suit lies prone on a mat, the butt of her long rifle in her shoulder and her cheek against the stock, and shoots at five black targets set out on the snow in front of her. She holds the position through several shots, then lifts her head off the rifle and grins.

5365.words: weapon (noun): an instrument used in fighting or hunting
5365.asset_description: A paintball player in a visored helmet and overalls covered in red and pink paint splatter crouches behind a wooden barricade, holding a paintball marker with a blue and red hopper. He looks down at the marker, lowers it, then raises one hand and finally stands up with both arms in the air while other players and a referee move across the field behind him.

196.words: courage (noun): being able to act even when you are afraid
196.asset_description: A girl in a helmet and harness stands scared on a high rope bridge in a treetop adventure park, whispers "okay, okay" to herself, carefully steps across the swaying wire despite her fear, and reaches the wooden platform with a relieved "phew" and a smile.

289.words: fear (noun): the bad feeling when something seems dangerous
289.asset_description: A young woman on a glass skywalk high above a mountain canyon freezes in terror, gripping the railing with wide eyes and saying she can't go on. She clutches her chest, then crouches down hugging the rail post, too scared to look through the see-through floor, while a friend walks up behind her.

524.words: panic (noun): a sudden strong fear that stops you acting calmly
524.asset_description: On a metro platform a young woman with blue hair frantically pats her pockets, dumps her tote bag on the ground to search through keys, wallet and phone, then rushes at the closing train doors and grabs her head in wide-eyed despair as the train leaves.

667.words: shock (noun): the sudden upset when something bad surprises you
667.asset_description: A young woman carrying a helmet walks up to find her white scooter lying knocked over on the pavement; she gasps, freezes with wide eyes, clutches her head with both hands and crouches over the fallen scooter in disbelief.

747.words: stress (noun): mental pressure from having too much to do
747.asset_description: A cartoon office worker juggles a phone call while towers of paperwork rise around her desk; she sweats, clutches her head, cries out and finally collapses face-down on the clipboard.

812.words: trust (noun): the feeling that you can rely on someone
812.asset_description: High on a cliff face, a climber double-checks the knot on her rope while her belay partner waits on the ground below. After a quick "Ready?" and his "Got you!", she lets go of the rock, leans back into the rope and hangs over the huge drop with her arms spread wide, relying on him completely.

1510.words: scream (verb): to cry out very loudly in fear
1510.asset_description: Munch's The Scream: a figure on a bridge holds its face and screams under a swirling red-orange sky.

1711.words: skeleton (noun): all the bones of a body together
1711.asset_description: Old allegorical engraving: a robed figure with a banner stands over fallen bodies while a grinning skeleton draws a bow and arrow beside a winged, crowned creature with a serpent's tail.

1807.words: skull (noun): the bones that form the head
1807.asset_description: A vector-art girl in a red hooded costume with devil horns and a katana on her back stares forward while grinning horned skulls wrapped in pink flames float around her.

1945.words: spooky (adjective): strange and frightening, like a ghost place
1945.asset_description: A purple-toned painting of a spooky haunted castle with twisted spiky towers and glowing orange windows, perched on a jagged rock above swirling fog and a dark lake under a stormy sky.

1950.asset_description: A dark fantasy painting of an evil-looking spiked fortress towering over jagged black rocks, its windows glowing fiery orange and red under a boiling blood-red cloud, with a tiny figure climbing the winding stairs.

1964.words: haunted (adjective): believed to have ghosts living inside
1964.asset_description: A ruined old wooden house with glowing blue windows and a crooked spire stands in fog among dead trees, under a huge full moon, behind a spiked iron fence.

1977.words: creepy (adjective): making you feel nervous and a bit scared
1977.asset_description: A swarm of black bats flies through a stormy grey sky around a dark ruined house whose windows glow blood-red, with bare branches twisting in front of it.

2055.words: poison (noun): something that harms you if you drink it
2055.asset_description: A dark old bottle with a chained cap stands in golden smoky light; it is decorated with a skull wearing flowers and, ironically, the written label 'Rejuvenation'.

2287.words: grief (noun): deep sadness, especially after losing someone
2287.asset_description: A man in a long blue robe sits alone on rocks in a dark garden at night, covering his face with one hand while faint moonlight falls on him from above.

2341.words: death (noun): the end of a living thing's life
2341.asset_description: A large human skull with an open jaw floats surrounded by pink and orange flowers, tangled red vines and cables against a blue sky.

2371.words: sorrow (noun): deep sadness, especially about a loss
2371.asset_description: A pale angel with large feathered wings and a thorny crown sits on wooden steps under a stormy sky, eyes closed, holding a bunch of dried white roses against her grey tattered dress.

2396.words: corset (noun): a tight laced top that shapes the waist
2396.asset_description: A blonde witch in a wide pointed hat glares forward holding a glowing amber light, her dark gown fitted with an ornate laced corset, surrounded by floating glowing bells and flames.

2485.words: sinister (adjective): looking evil, as if something bad will happen
2485.asset_description: A sinister crow-headed figure in long dark robes stands before a huge golden moon, holding a golden orb on chains with clawed hands.

2540.words: dungeon (noun): a dark prison under a castle
2540.asset_description: Broken stone steps lead down through a dark underground hall lit by a few candles, toward a small glowing green doorway between huge shadowy pillars.

2664.words: drown (verb): to sink under water and stop breathing
2664.asset_description: A bare hand sticks up out of dark blue ocean water as its owner goes under, reaching not for help but for a red social-media notification badge showing one new follower, with lumpy storm clouds filling the sky.

2673.words: cage (noun): a box of metal bars that shuts an animal in
2673.asset_description: A pencil-and-paint drawing of a young man in a worn shirt and jeans sitting on a stone bench inside a huge birdcage, bent over some papers, while a small bird stands free on the ground outside the bars.

2679.words: in a hurry (phrase): needing to do something fast, with no time
2679.asset_description: A man in a grey shirt and trousers races forward in mid-stride with his arms swinging, across a ground completely covered with old clock faces, while huge rusty gears and clocks fill the sky behind him.

2833.words: burnout (noun): being completely used up by too much work
2833.asset_description: A dark painted scene of a bearded man slumped at his desk in front of a glowing computer monitor, forehead pressed into his hand and eyes shut, with steam rising from his head and hot orange light burning behind him.

3827.words: monster (noun): a frightening creature that is not real
3827.asset_description: A cartoon Halloween scene shows a small boy dressed as a vampire with a cape and a pumpkin bucket standing on a hill under a full moon, while a huge purple grinning creature with yellow eyes and claws rises out of the smoke behind him.

4260.words: figure (noun): the shape of a human body
4260.asset_description: A dark bedroom at night, lit only by a small bedside lamp and the glow of a tablet. A man lies in bed under a thick cream knitted blanket watching the tablet, its light on his face, with a golden retriever lying on the bed beside him. In the lit doorway behind them a dark human figure appears and stands still, only its outline visible against the blue light of the hall. The man falls asleep with his head back and the tablet resting on his chest while the figure keeps standing there, then he is awake and watching the tablet again with the dog still beside him.

4528.words: grave (noun): a place in the ground where a dead body is buried
4528.asset_description: A woodcut of a village church at night. The tall stone tower with its pointed spire rises against a swirling blue sky with a crescent moon and stars; a bell hangs in the open window of the tower with its rope swinging, and a flock of black crows scatters away from it. Warm light shows through the pointed stained-glass windows and small figures in pale robes walk in through the open wooden doors. All around the church, leaning stone markers stand in the rough grass over the buried dead, with a bare tree on each side.

4543.words: risk (noun): a source of danger, a chance of loss
4543.asset_description: A pencil-and-charcoal drawing of a huge sea cliff seen from the side. The rock face is a sheer, layered wall dropping straight into the sea, where white surf boils around its foot. A single thin rope runs down the middle of the face, and a tiny figure hangs on it about halfway down, dwarfed by the rock. Seabirds wheel in the empty grey sky to the left; tufts of coarse grass grow on the ledges at the bottom right.

4633.words: desperate (adjective): marked by despair or loss of hope
4633.asset_description: A man in a black raincoat leans into the driver's seat of an old blue car and tries to start it, dropping his head onto the steering wheel. He opens the bonnet and pokes at the battery terminals in the rain while buses pass on the wet street behind him. He gives up, closes the bonnet, leans against the car, then sits down on the kerb in the rain and covers his face with both hands.

4904.asset_description: Three shots of people and objects held up in precarious positions. A young man in black walks a slackline strung between two trees in a park, arms out to keep from falling. Then a very tall stack of wooden chairs balanced one on top of the other sways against a blue sky. Finally a group of men in black kit build a human tower, standing on each other's shoulders several levels high.

5300.words: threat (noun): something that is a source of danger
5300.asset_description: An ink-and-wash illustration of a large patterned viper coiled on sunlit rocks. Its body is wound in thick loops over the stone, the tail runs across the foreground, and the head is reared up high with the mouth wide open, fangs bared, ready to strike at whoever is looking. Dry bushes and a grey sky fill the background and a few leaves blow past the open jaws.

5392.words: terror (noun): an overwhelming feeling of fear and worry
5392.asset_description: A selfie-style shot inside the dark corridor of a haunted-house attraction, the walls lined with neon strips and glowing signs. A woman with a lilac bob in a denim jacket and a man in a yellow hoodie edge forward with their eyes wide and their mouths open. A grinning zombie head lights up on the wall beside them, then a clown mask appears further down the passage. The two clutch each other, the woman gripping his arm and then his shoulder, and both scream straight into the camera as they back away.

5393.words: calm (noun): staying steady in your mind under stress
5393.asset_description: A living room strung with fairy lights, the television on in the corner. A woman wrapped in a grey blanket walks in carrying a big bowl of popcorn. A person in an inflatable green T-rex costume rears up from behind the black sofa and lunges at her. She throws the popcorn into the air so it rains all over the floor, drops down beside the bookshelf and pulls the blanket right over her head, until only her wide frightened eyes are showing.

47.words: arena (noun): a big indoor hall with seats around a court
47.asset_description: A father and son walk through a dark tunnel and step out inside a huge indoor arena packed with thousands of fans around a basketball court; they gape at the stands in awe, then cheer and throw their popcorn in the air.

53.words: athletics (noun): track-and-field sports like running and jumping
53.asset_description: At a stadium track meet, athletes compete in different events: a woman sprints over hurdles, a man leaps into the long-jump sand pit, and a woman hurls the shot put, then the three celebrate together.

312.words: foul (noun): an unfair action against another player
312.asset_description: In an indoor futsal match, a player in orange dribbles the ball and a defender in purple grabs and trips her from behind. The referee blows the whistle, raises her arm and points for a free kick while the guilty player protests with his hands up.

315.words: free kick (noun): a kick given to a team after a foul
315.asset_description: On a pitch at sunset a player in maroon places the ball on the line while a wall of defenders in black lines up in front of the goal. He runs up and curls the free kick over the wall; the goalkeeper dives but the ball flies in, and the taker slides on his knees celebrating while the wall curses.

372.words: trick (noun): a clever skilful move done to impress
372.asset_description: On a rooftop helipad at sunset, a man performs freestyle football tricks: juggling the ball with his feet, balancing it on his head and on his shoe, and holding a handstand with the ball resting on his foot.

412.words: jersey (noun): a team sports shirt with a number on the back
412.asset_description: In a locker room a coach hands a young footballer a folded light-blue jersey; she unfolds it to reveal the number 7, pulls it on over her shirt and turns to show her teammates, who cheer and hug her.

500.words: dribble (verb): to run with the ball at your feet past players
500.asset_description: On a floodlit caged pitch at night, a player in a white hoodie dribbles a football toward a defender in teal. He beats him with quick skill touches, sprints away with the ball at his feet and finishes by shooting into the small goal.
500.transcript: Oh my head! No way, no way! He's gone!

540.words: penalty (noun): a free kick at goal given after a foul
540.asset_description: On a sun-baked pitch a referee points to the spot; a player in orange places the ball on the penalty mark, takes a run-up and shoots past the diving green goalkeeper, then her whole team mobs her in celebration.

553.words: pitch (noun): the grass field where football is played
553.asset_description: A groundskeeper in a flat cap mows the striped grass of a stadium football pitch, checks the fresh white lines with his boot, plants the yellow corner flag and stands proudly with crossed arms while players train in the background.

599.words: rapid (adjective): very fast; happening at great speed
599.asset_description: Two footballers face off one-on-one on indoor and outdoor pitches, chaining rapid stepovers, feints and direction changes to beat each other. Defenders lunge and slide in as the quick-cut compilation strings the fast moves together.

2770.words: sweat (verb): to lose salty drops of water through skin
2770.asset_description: A comic-style drawing of a blonde young woman in a red football shirt with the white number 3, head tilted back and mouth open as she gasps for air, with drops running down her face and neck and damp patches on the shirt.

3313.words: stadium (noun): a big sports ground with seats all around
3313.asset_description: Flat vector illustration of a female footballer in a pink and purple shirt and green shorts standing over the ball on the grass, with the curved empty seats and roof of a large stadium behind her.

4118.words: court (noun): a marked area where a game is played
4118.asset_description: A point of view shot from one end of an orange clay tennis court, high in the mountains. The white lines of the court run away from the camera to the net across the middle, and beyond it a grey rock face with snow on top rises into a deep blue sky under a bright sun. On the far side of the net a player in red hits the ball back; the yellow ball bounces on the clay and crosses the net again and again. The player at the camera end reaches into the frame to play a shot, and the rally goes on across the empty court with the mountain behind it.

4145.words: dive (verb): to throw yourself forward through the air
4145.asset_description: Two men in swimming shorts play with a ball in the shallow water of a sunny beach, sailing boats on the blue sea behind them. One man throws himself full length through the air to reach the ball and lands flat in the water with a big splash. Later he leaps up and kicks the ball over his own head with an overhead bicycle kick, both legs in the air. He lands in the water, then stands up in the shallows and raises both fists above his head in triumph while the other man bends over on the sand in the foreground.

4307.words: banner (noun): a long strip of cloth or paper with a message
4307.asset_description: A hand-drawn night scene in a packed stadium stand. Four long strips of cloth in brown, blue, dark red and gold stream sideways from tall poles above the terrace against a starry blue sky. Below them rows of people in winter coats, scarves and flat caps stand with their hands on their chests, mouths open in song; white puffs of breath show in the cold air.

4308.words: supporter (noun): a person who backs a team or politician
4308.asset_description: A floodlit football terrace at night. Rows of men and women in dark winter jackets stand shoulder to shoulder, singing with their heads back and their hands pressed to their chests, breath steaming in the cold. Behind them hundreds more hold club scarves in dark red, blue and yellow stretched above their heads in a long line up the stand.

4309.words: anthem (noun): a song of loyalty to a nation or school
4309.asset_description: Close-up of a footballer in a green and gold shirt standing in a line before a match at night. She has her hand flat on her chest and sings, tears running down both cheeks and her eyes red. Her team-mates stand beside her doing the same. A flag flies from a pole behind her, and the packed stand of spectators also stands with hands on their hearts.

4431.words: score (verb): to gain points in a game
4431.asset_description: A boy in a grey striped t shirt and navy shorts runs across a big park lawn with a black and white football at his feet, families sitting on the grass behind him. He flicks the ball up and bounces it on his knee, then dribbles on with a golden retriever trotting in from the side. He lines up in front of a small red, green and yellow plastic goal, swings his leg and drives the ball into the net past two jumpers laid out as markers. In the last shot he runs to another boy and the two of them hug and jump in front of the goal.

4436.asset_description: A colour cartoon of a beach in Rio. A player in a yellow shirt, blue shorts and brown boots is upside down in mid air doing an overhead bicycle kick, sand spraying up behind his heel and a worn brown ball flying off above him. A green and yellow flag flies on a pole at the left, and behind the beach rise a green mountain topped by a statue with outstretched arms and the rounded peak of another headland. On the right three children stand with their arms thrown up and their mouths wide open, and on the left a boy watches with his mouth open too.

4560.words: crew (noun): the men and women who run a ship or aircraft
4560.asset_description: A rowing eight on a still river lined with willows, filmed from the bow. Eight rowers in matching navy kit and sunglasses drive back and forth in exact time, their oars dipping and lifting together and throwing up splashes on both sides. The cox sits facing them in the stern with headphones and a microphone. A cyclist passes along the towpath. At the end one rower punches a fist into the air.

4561.words: command (noun): an instruction with authority to do something
4561.asset_description: A misty river at dawn with low sun through the willows. A rowing eight comes straight at the camera; the woman at the front, in a navy cap with a headset microphone at her mouth, shouts calls at the crew behind her, her mouth wide open. The rowers drive through the stroke in time with her, the boat surging and throwing spray off the blades. At the end the crew punch their fists up together.

4811.words: teammate (noun): someone who is on the same team as you
4811.asset_description: On a sunny beach volleyball court by the sea, two players clap their hands together in a high five in close-up. The camera pulls back to show six young players in bright sports tops standing in a ring in the sand under the net; they laugh, pile all their hands one on top of another in the middle of the circle, then throw both arms straight up in the air together.

4831.words: hit (noun): a successful stroke of the bat in baseball
4831.asset_description: In a grassy back garden ringed by a wooden fence, a young man in a cap sets up over a coloured ball balanced on a batting tee, swings a blue aluminium bat and sends the ball flying high over the lawn. The camera follows the ball into the grey sky, and he stands watching where it lands among the other balls scattered on the grass.
4831.transcript: Watch him ball. Whoa, watch him hit the ball.

5336.words: loyalty (noun): the quality of being loyal
5336.asset_description: In a floodlit stadium at night a grey-bearded man in a flat cap and black denim jacket takes off his cap, holds it against his chest and lays his hand over it. He looks up towards the stands and sings along with the anthem while the men and women around him stand with their hands on their hearts. The camera drifts back to show a long row of supporters all doing exactly the same.

406.words: iron (noun): the strong grey metal a blacksmith works with
406.asset_description: An animated young blacksmith heats iron bars in a glowing forge, hammers rings and spirals on an anvil, quenches them in water, and proudly hangs the pieces on a finished iron gate.

650.words: screw (noun): a threaded metal pin you turn into wood
650.asset_description: A couple assembling a flat-pack chair finds one screw missing; the man crawls around the living room searching until he spots the last screw near a cardboard box, holds it up in triumph, drives it into the chair leg with a screwdriver, then sits on the finished chair to prove it holds.
650.transcript: Oh, there you are! Holds solid!

651.words: screwdriver (noun): a hand tool with a shaped tip for turning screws
651.asset_description: A young couple mounts a wooden wall shelf: the woman takes a red-handled screwdriver and tightens the screws in the metal bracket while the man watches nervously, then they load books onto the shelf and she proudly shows off the screwdriver as it holds firm.

965.words: trowel (noun): a flat hand tool for spreading cement or mortar
965.asset_description: A builder holds a brick level with one hand while the other drags a loaded trowel of grey mortar along the top of a red brick wall against a clear blue sky.

1565.words: gear (noun): a toothed wheel that turns inside a machine
1565.asset_description: A dark textured portrait of a young woman with closed eyes and long hair; her neck, chest and shoulders are made of many interlocking rusty metal gears and cogwheels.

1997.words: axe (noun): a tool with a heavy blade for chopping
1997.asset_description: A fur-clad warrior with an antlered helmet stands with his back to us in a foggy dark forest, holding a knife in one hand and a huge broad-bladed battle axe in the other.

2108.words: pipe (noun): a tube that carries water or gas
2108.asset_description: A retro sci-fi ship interior where thick metal pipes curve along the ceiling and walls, connecting glowing round portholes, wooden cabinets and a small counter with a sink by the window.

2140.words: machine (noun): a thing with moving metal parts built to work
2140.asset_description: Dense steampunk painting of a green-lit passage packed with rusty pipes, dials, round gauges and hanging metal parts; two tiny figures walk along the glowing floor far below.

3145.words: loom (noun): a frame of tight threads for making cloth
3145.asset_description: Textured print-style illustration in reds and browns of a man sitting on a stool at a tall wooden loom, his hands among the stretched white and orange threads, with woven fabric filling the wall behind him.

4048.words: install (verb): to set something up for use
4048.asset_description: A time-lapse of two men converting an empty cargo van into a home. First the van stands open and bare in a car park and one man climbs in through the back doors. Inside, the two of them press timber studs and purple insulation panels into place along the walls under a new wooden roof frame, standing on a fresh plywood floor. On the roof under a blue sky they lower two large black solar panels into position and fix them down. The finished interior is lined with pale wood and has a white-tiled shower, a kitchen with a sink, and a skylight; four men stand inside cheering and dancing.

4336.words: instructions (noun): a manual explaining how to use a device
4336.asset_description: In an empty flat with bare walls and a parquet floor, a man in a grey beanie holds up a folded printed sheet covered in line drawings and reads it while a woman in work trousers kneels and screws round wooden legs onto a white seat. The finished stool stands on the floor. The two of them then hold the sides of a low wooden shelf unit and stand it up, and finally push together and lift a tall wooden wardrobe with shelves inside, closing its doors and stepping back to look at it.

4631.words: design (verb): to make or work out a plan for something
4631.asset_description: A man in a denim apron leans over a workbench and draws a birdhouse on a sketchpad with a pencil, adding a roof, a round hole and arrows. He then fits flat wooden pieces together into the same shape, and finally holds the finished wooden birdhouse up next to his drawing, smiling at the camera.

4656.words: mount (verb): to attach something to a support
4656.asset_description: A woman in a plaid shirt, safety glasses and a tool belt presses a cordless drill against a red brick wall; dust puffs out as the bit bites in. She then taps a wall plug into the hole with a hammer, leaving a line of fixings along the brickwork. Metal brackets go up and she lifts long pine boards onto them, pressing each shelf level against the wall. She sets a stack of coloured books on the finished shelf, then stands back with her hands on her hips looking at the two mounted shelves.

4699.asset_description: A painted factory interior. A man in a yellow hard hat, safety glasses and a work jacket stands in the foreground holding a clipboard with a technical drawing on it and points upwards with his other hand. Behind and above him rises a wall of old industrial machines: a giant toothed gearwheel on a shaft, riveted drums and pipes, round pressure gauges with coloured dials, control panels with buttons, and steel walkways, with steam drifting up between them.

4778.words: workshop (noun): a small workplace where things are made
4778.asset_description: Inside a small craft workshop. Two hands hold a black open-ended spanner next to a shiny chrome one, comparing them against a pale board where a whole graded row of spanners hangs in size order. A woman in navy overalls and safety glasses then stands at a workbench with a clamp and vice, using two fine tools to fit a small brass clock movement with visible toothed wheels. At the end she reaches up to a carved wooden cuckoo clock hanging on the timber wall while a colleague works behind her.

4793.words: sand (verb): to rub something smooth with sandpaper
4793.asset_description: A white-bearded man in a checked shirt stands on a wooden dock over a lake with a curly-haired boy, both gripping a fishing rod as a small fish comes up on the line. The scene cuts to a workshop close-up: a large weathered hand presses a folded sheet of sandpaper along the pitched roof of a half-finished wooden birdhouse, rubbing it back and forth while a child's hand holds the box steady. The man then stands at the workbench with five children around him, gesturing over the finished birdhouse. In the last shot two old men play chess at a low table in a park while children watch and kites fly overhead.

4810.words: post (noun): a piece of timber fixed upright in the ground
4810.asset_description: A bearded man in a checked shirt works outdoors on a sunny lawn beside a wire fence. He raises a hammer over his head and drives it down onto the top of a short round wooden upright. He kneels and sets the upright into a freshly dug hole in the earth next to a taller square one, then stands and swings the hammer down on it again to drive it into the ground, and wipes his forehead on his sleeve.

4836.words: saw (verb): to cut something using a saw
4836.asset_description: In a wood, a man in a blue T-shirt and work gloves cuts into a standing tree trunk with a chainsaw. A life-size bear is already emerging from the pale wood, and he saws around its shoulders and body, sending a spray of sawdust out to the side while the bark below is cut away to free the bear's legs.
4836.transcript: He can carve a big bear out of the wood.

4852.words: gear (noun): a toothed wheel that turns inside a machine
4852.asset_description: A young man in a workshop apron grins as he works an adjustable spanner on a blue circuit board at his bench, tools hanging on the pegboard behind him. Cut to him in goggles with his hair on end, holding the small board up in both hands over a heavy bench vice. Then he stands back with a screwdriver as a small mechanism is clamped in the vice, and next a larger machine with a motor and rails sits on a rolling bench in front of him, his mouth open. Finally he throws both arms up in a garage in front of a huge machine of purple pistons and interlocking metal gears.

4898.words: panel (noun): a flat sheet that forms part of something
4898.asset_description: Gardeners in straw hats and work gloves lift large flat rectangular sheets of glass into a metal frame standing over a flower bed; sheet after sheet is slotted in side by side until the frame is completely clad, and the camera flies up through the trees to show a huge glass dome in the forest.
4898.transcript: Close it in. See you later.

4928.words: to fix (verb): to put something broken back together
4928.asset_description: A metal bucket stands on the tiled floor under an open kitchen sink cabinet, catching drips from the pipework above it. A young man in blue dungarees and a white t-shirt bends down and switches on the headlamp strapped to his forehead. In close-up his hands put a red adjustable wrench on the nut under the sink drain and turn it tight, with the bucket still below. He reaches up and pushes the lever of the chrome mixer tap. In the last shot he stands at the worktop grinning at the camera, headlamp on, while clean water runs from the tap into the stainless steel sink.

4985.words: fix (verb): to attach something firmly in place
4985.asset_description: In an office two workers put up screens. A woman on a stepladder holds a cordless drill against a small bracket high on the wall while a man in a blue polo steadies it from below; he then reaches up to a round detector on the ceiling. The two of them carry a large flat screen over to the wall, lift it onto the bracket and press it firmly into place, then step back and look at it. At the end a whole wall of nine screens is up and switched on.

5071.words: service (verb): to make a machine fit to use again
5071.asset_description: A bearded mechanic in blue overalls lies on a creeper and slides out from under a silver car in a busy repair shop. He then works in the open engine bay with a ratchet, loosens the wheel nuts with a red impact driver, tightens them with a long torque wrench, and finally straightens up, wipes his hands on a rag and closes the bonnet with a satisfied look.

5159.asset_description: A cartoon kitchen: a plumber in blue overalls and a red cap lies on his back on the tiled floor under an open sink cupboard, holding a big red pipe wrench. A pipe under the sink has burst and a jet of water hits him full in the face and soaks him while he grins. Puddles spread over the tiles, an open red toolbox stands beside him, a hammer and pliers lie on the floor, and an elderly woman in an apron watches from the doorway with a worried face.

5284.asset_description: An oil painting of a knight standing in a castle courtyard. He wears a full suit of polished plate armour that catches the light, a dark red cloak hangs behind him, he rests both gauntleted hands on the pommel of a long sword whose point is set on the ground, and he holds a feathered helmet under one arm. Castle towers, a banner and a flag stand behind him.

5341.words: nail (verb): to attach something with nails
5341.asset_description: A pencil sketch on white paper. In a workshop a bearded man kneels beside a half-built wooden go-kart and tightens a bolt on its frame with a wrench. Next to him a boy in a baseball cap kneels on the floor and swings a hammer down onto a nail he is driving through a plank beside the kart's wheel. Behind them stands a workbench with a pegboard of spanners, an angled lamp and a shelf, and wood shavings and a screw hang in the air around them.

5445.words: useless (adjective): having no beneficial use, not working usefully
5445.asset_description: A comic-style drawing of a city street in heavy rain. A man in a beige trench coat runs across the flooded road, splashing through a deep puddle. In his right hand he holds up a black umbrella that the wind has blown completely inside out, its ribs bent backwards into a bowl so that the rain falls straight past it onto him; his coat and scarf are flying and his hair is soaked. Behind him a big clock tower rises into the grey sky, a red double-decker bus and a black taxi drive through the standing water, a red phone box stands on the pavement and a flag whips on its pole. Diagonal rain streaks cover the whole picture.

5471.words: level (adjective): flat, with no part higher or lower
5471.asset_description: A young man in a paint-spattered t-shirt is decorating a bare white wall in a flat with a wooden floor. He holds a black-framed picture up against the wall and shifts it until it sits straight, then lays a yellow spirit level along the top edge of a framed flower painting and watches the bubble. He hangs a striped woven textile beside the frames, adds two wooden shelves with potted plants and a decorative leaf clock, and by the end the whole wall is a dense gallery of aligned frames. A step ladder stands to one side and he steps back, hands on hips, to look at the finished wall.

5500.words: timber (noun): wood cut and prepared for building
5500.asset_description: A muted woodcut-style illustration of an open-sided timber shed at the edge of a misty forest. A young man in a flat cap and patched work clothes swings an axe down into a log standing on a chopping block; splinters fly and a split log falls away to the left. Behind him a sawhorse and a stack of round logs sit under the shed roof. In the foreground lies a neat pile of freshly sawn planks with visible grain, plus more cut logs and curls of wood shaving on the ground.

96.words: board (verb): to get on a plane, ship or train as a passenger
96.asset_description: POV of a traveler scanning her boarding pass at the airport gate, walking down the glass jet bridge, being greeted by a flight attendant at the plane door, moving along the cabin aisle and settling happily into her seat by the window.
96.transcript: I board the plane. I show my ticket and walk to my seat.

98.words: hammock (noun): a hanging bed of cloth or net you lie in
98.asset_description: In a 3D-animated holiday scene a young woman lounges in a rope hammock strung above a blue-domed island view, swaying gently while she reads; the netting and its ropes frame her through the whole clip.

203.words: cruise (noun): a holiday trip on a large ship
203.asset_description: An animated couple enjoys a holiday on a big white cruise ship: they wave from the deck with cocktails, relax on sun loungers by the pool, the ship sails past tropical islands with dolphins, and they walk down the gangway onto a beach.

211.words: customs (noun): the border check on what you bring into a country
211.asset_description: In a hand-painted border hall, a girl in a yellow coat puts her suitcase on the customs counter; the officer asks if she has anything to declare, digs through her clothes and pulls out a huge spiky durian, which ends up in a metal bin before he chalks an X on her suitcase and lets her through.
211.transcript: Anything to declare? Just fruit. One fruit! Not this one. Sorry.

222.words: delay (noun): when something happens later than planned
