222.asset_description: In an animated night-time bus station, a driver blocks the bus door telling waiting passengers with suitcases 'not yet'. A large clock's hands spin forward while a blonde woman in a red coat waits, throws up her arms in frustration, and finally lies collapsed on her suitcase in the rain with the other passengers still waiting.
222.transcript: Sorry, not yet! Aw, come on!

276.words: excursion (noun): a short trip made for fun with a group
276.asset_description: A group of friends with backpacks loads into a minibus and rides through green sheep-dotted countryside, pointing out the window. They park, hike a woodland path to a big waterfall and pose together for a phone group photo in front of it.

354.words: guidebook (noun): a book with facts and photos for tourists
354.asset_description: Two animated tourists sit on the steps of a lion fountain flipping through a thick travel book of photos; they match the lion fountain on the page to the real one behind them, then point at the Leaning Tower page and run off to find it, book under arm.
354.transcript: What is this one? That one! Look! Same! Now, the big tower.

393.words: hostel (noun): a cheap place to sleep in shared rooms
393.asset_description: A 3D-animated backpacker gets a room key at a small reception desk, climbs the stairs into a dorm full of bunk beds and other travelers, claims a free top bunk for ten euros, shares crisps with a bunk neighbor and later toasts mugs with the whole room.
393.transcript: Is this bed free? Yes! Take the top! Perfect! 10 euros! Welcome! We all share!

432.words: lead (verb): to go in front and show others the way
432.asset_description: In an animated night forest, a young woman with a lantern walks in front of a group of hikers, telling them to step where she steps; she leads them across stepping stones in a stream and up a path to a glowing valley view.
432.transcript: Follow me is it safe step where I step Okay

520.words: paddle (verb): to move a boat by pulling a flat oar
520.asset_description: A smiling girl in a life jacket dips a wooden paddle into a calm green river and strokes on both sides of a canoe, gliding past bamboo and orange cliffs. A man in a sun hat lies dozing in the bow and gets a few drips on his face as she paddles over him.

676.words: sightseeing (noun): visiting a city's famous places as a tourist
676.asset_description: In a Ghibli-style anime Venice, a tourist couple with a camera admires the bell tower and pigeons on a grand square, points at a domed cathedral, then rides a gondola under a bridge along the canals taking photos of the sights.

771.words: terminal (noun): the airport building where flights start
771.asset_description: In a Ghibli-style anime, a woman with a rolling suitcase walks through sliding doors into a vast glass airport terminal, passes the check-in counters, rides an escalator and watches planes on the runway through the huge windows.

784.words: tilt (verb): to lean something into a slanted position
784.asset_description: A cartoon woman in a green jumpsuit and headwrap stands on a sunny boardwalk, grips the pole of a striped beach umbrella and tilts it over so the shade covers her deck chair, then settles back into the chair with a satisfied "Better."

840.words: hike (verb): to walk a long way in mountains or countryside
840.asset_description: A young man ties his boots by an alpine chalet, hikes up a forest trail over tree roots, reaches a viewpoint above a turquoise mountain lake, takes a happy selfie and then sits on a rocky ledge eating fruit while looking over the valley.

892.words: rinse (verb): to wash something quickly with clean water
892.asset_description: A young woman in a yellow bikini steps under an outdoor shower on a wooden beach boardwalk, the sea and white sand behind her. She rinses the seawater off, running her hands through her wet hair while she talks to the camera about how good the shower feels.
892.transcript: Okay, this shower is actually the best part of the beach.

925.words: baggage claim (noun): the airport area where you collect suitcases
925.asset_description: Travelers stand around an airport carousel loaded with suitcases; a woman lifts a grey hard-shell suitcase off the moving belt.

953.words: border (noun): the line where one country meets another
953.asset_description: At a rural road checkpoint a uniformed guard lifts a red-and-white striped barrier pole so a waiting grey car can cross, a small guard booth at the roadside.

1009.words: compass (noun): an instrument whose needle shows you north
1009.asset_description: An open hand holds a brass compass with a pointing needle; behind it a grassy mountain ridge stretches away in soft evening light.

1125.words: harbour (noun): a sheltered place on the coast for boats
1125.asset_description: At sunrise a fisherman on a stone quay hauls a dripping net full of fish, with rows of small moored boats, stacked lobster pots and a lighthouse behind him.

1180.words: luggage tag (noun): a small label tied to a suitcase
1180.asset_description: A close-up of hands fastening a blank paper luggage tag to the leather strap of a brown suitcase, with a busy station concourse blurred behind.

1290.words: route (noun): the way you follow to get somewhere
1290.asset_description: An aerial view of a road snaking in tight hairpin bends up a green mountainside under a clear sky, with a single dark car driving along one of the lower curves.

1453.words: voyage (noun): a long journey across the sea by ship
1453.asset_description: A large white cruise ship seen from above sails across the open ocean at sunset, leaving a long foamy wake behind it with no land in sight.

1487.words: god (noun): a divine being that people worship
1487.asset_description: Traditional Thai mural: a green-skinned crowned god sits on a golden throne while a kneeling woman reaches toward him; winged figures fly above a temple.

1488.words: carriage (noun): a wheeled vehicle pulled by horses
1488.asset_description: Thai mural of a golden royal carriage pulled by two white horses; people kneel beside the road as it passes through a forest.

1524.words: hitchhike (verb): to ask drivers for a free ride with your thumb
1524.asset_description: A hooded man with a backpack sticks his thumb out to hitchhike on a mountain road while a UFO hovers above and shines a beam of light down; wrecked cars sit in the grass.

1531.words: arch (noun): a curved structure over an opening
1531.asset_description: A vintage travel poster of Palermo: a golden church with red domes and a bell tower and a row of small arches, all seen through a large dark pointed arch over a garden with agave plants.

1591.words: lighthouse (noun): a tall sea tower whose light guides ships
1591.asset_description: A watercolor sketch of a red-and-white striped lighthouse with a domed lamp room standing over a long stone building, painted on a background of old newspaper pages.

1600.words: canal (noun): a man-made water street for boats
1600.asset_description: A watercolor view down a Venetian canal: green water runs between tall orange and red old houses, with a small boat in the distance under a cloudy blue sky.

1610.words: balcony (noun): an open platform with a railing on a building
1610.asset_description: A moonlit gothic balcony at night: carved arches on stone columns, a balustrade railing, a potted plant and a marble floor, with the moon glowing behind the arches.

1619.words: sail (noun): the large cloth that catches the wind
1619.asset_description: An old engraving of a large sailing ship with billowing sails riding rough waves, a smaller sailboat behind it and a city skyline on the horizon.

1633.words: statue (noun): a figure of a person or creature made of stone
1633.asset_description: A stone gargoyle statue with folded wings and glowing eyes crouches on rocks in a misty lake, with a small boat, a temple and a snowy mountain in the background.

1679.words: temple (noun): a building where people pray
1679.asset_description: An ink-and-watercolor drawing of the golden Kinkaku-ji temple in Japan standing over a calm pond, with snowy bushes, rocks and a pine branch in the foreground.

1874.words: pier (noun): a wooden platform built out over the water
1874.asset_description: A textured flat illustration of a couple sitting close together at the end of a wooden pier over turquoise sea, their flip flops and a sun hat beside them, a small island on the horizon.

1879.words: dome (noun): a round roof shaped like half a ball
1879.asset_description: A painting of the Dome of the Rock in Jerusalem seen through stone arches and marble pillars: a shining golden dome above blue-tiled walls under a stormy blue sky.

1899.words: ruins (noun): the broken remains of old buildings
1899.asset_description: An engraving of two giant weathered stone statues seated by a flooded plain, with palm trees and ruined temple walls in the distance.

1930.words: medieval (adjective): from the age of castles and stone towns
1930.asset_description: A storybook painting of a medieval stone town at dusk: pointed towers, crooked houses with glowing orange windows, an arched gateway, and a small cloaked figure standing in the snowy lane.

1962.words: fortress (noun): a large strong building made to defend
1962.asset_description: A huge dark stone castle with many pointed towers stands on a hill under a stormy green-black sky, with lightning striking in the distance and water reflecting it below.

1998.words: mansion (noun): a very large and impressive house
1998.asset_description: A tall ornate Victorian mansion with towers, balconies and many warmly glowing windows stands in a misty garden at dusk beside an old street lamp.

2015.words: monument (noun): a big old structure built to be remembered
2015.asset_description: A misty painting of a Stonehenge-like circle of huge standing stones on a plain, with a pale sun glowing through clouds above distant mountains and fog drifting between the stones.

2080.words: pagoda (noun): an Asian temple with tiered curved roofs
2080.asset_description: A glowing street lamp stands in a snowy yard in front of a red Asian pagoda-style building with a curved roof and a wooden staircase, snow falling in the evening light.

2081.words: stepping stones (noun): flat stones you step on to cross water
2081.asset_description: A winding path of flat stepping stones crosses misty water toward a glowing Thai-style wooden house on stilts, with two lit torches and a full moon behind the trees.

2182.words: hiker (noun): a person who walks long distances in nature
2182.asset_description: A brush-stroke painting of a lone hiker with a red backpack standing on a rocky ledge, gazing up at a huge colorful mountain peak glowing orange and purple under a sunset sky.

2189.words: fall overboard (phrase): to fall off a boat into the water
2189.asset_description: A black-and-white ink illustration of a huge curling wave crashing over a small rowboat; a person tips backwards out of the boat with legs kicking in the air and oars flying loose.

2238.words: mosque (noun): a building where Muslims go to pray
2238.asset_description: A blue-gray watercolor painting of a grand mosque with a large central dome, many smaller domes and slender minarets rising above soft trees.

2258.words: spire (noun): a tall thin pointed top on a tower
2258.asset_description: A flat-vector landscape of a white church whose tall pointed spire rises against clouds, standing on a green slope where a rocky stream meets the sea, with mountains behind.

2259.words: lagoon (noun): a calm pool of sea water behind rocks
2259.asset_description: Tall palm trees lean over a clear turquoise lagoon with rocks visible under the water. White clouds tower over a small rocky island in the distance.

2260.words: rowboat (noun): a small open boat moved with oars
2260.asset_description: An empty wooden rowboat floats on a perfectly calm lake at sunset, tied near a rocky shore. Orange clouds and dark hills reflect in the still water.

2271.words: corridor (noun): a long narrow passage inside a building
2271.asset_description: A short-haired woman in a black leather jacket, trousers and tall boots stands in the middle of a grey futuristic spaceship corridor lit by white panel lights.

2313.words: camper van (noun): a van you can travel and sleep in
2313.asset_description: A retro t-shirt-style graphic of a hiker with a backpack and beanie standing in a forest clearing before an orange camper van, with pine trees and a huge snowy peak against an orange sun behind it.

2347.words: explore (verb): to travel through a new place to see it
2347.asset_description: An astronaut in an orange spacesuit wades through shallow reflective water on a strange rocky alien world, a huge orange planet glowing in the dark sky behind him.

2368.words: paradise (noun): a perfect place where all is wonderful
2368.asset_description: An oil painting of a tall palm tree leaning over a tropical beach at sunset, with glowing orange clouds, calm waves and a tiny white sailboat on the horizon.

2386.words: railing (noun): a fence of bars you hold onto
2386.asset_description: A flat vector view through an arched doorway onto a balcony: a dark metal railing in front, a palm tree silhouette to the left, and an orange sunset sinking over a calm sea.

2398.words: terrace (noun): an open paved area outside a building
2398.asset_description: A flat vector scene of a tiled terrace with a wooden lounge chair and a metal railing, looking out over palm tree silhouettes and a calm sea under a big orange sunset sky.

2454.words: winding (adjective): curving and turning again and again
2454.asset_description: A cobblestone path curves in an S-shape between old timber houses of a mountain village at dusk, past glowing lanterns, stone walls, benches and potted flowers.

2541.words: staircase (noun): a set of stairs inside a building
2541.asset_description: A huge crumbling stone staircase covered with rubble climbs toward the arched altar of a vast gothic hall, lit by candles and cold blue mist between tall pillars and statues.

2557.words: sailboat (noun): a small boat pushed along by the wind
2557.asset_description: A small sailboat made of coloured translucent glass, with a purple sail and an orange sail on gold frames, floats on shimmering green and gold water and casts a bright reflection beneath it.

2614.words: minaret (noun): the tall thin tower of a mosque
2614.asset_description: Two boys in long robes and caps walk down a misty dirt path toward a domed mosque at sunrise, their long dark shadows stretching across the path behind them while riders on horses cross the green field.

2621.words: mast (noun): the tall pole that stands up from a deck
2621.asset_description: A giant old ocean liner sails straight toward the viewer through dark blue water at night, its lit portholes and decks glowing, a tall mast with rigging ropes rising above the bow under a starry sky.

2928.words: spaceship (noun): a large vehicle that travels through space
2928.asset_description: Fantasy painting of a red-haired woman in a teal dress and long red cape sitting on a rock in a flowering green valley, while a huge pale spaceship flies through the starry sky above her past two planets.

3132.words: to hike (verb): to walk a long way in the countryside
3132.asset_description: Cartoon of a man in an orange shirt with a big blue backpack walking up a sandy path on a green mountain, leaning on a long wooden walking stick; bushes and rocks line the trail under a blue sky.

3171.words: signpost (noun): a post with arms that point the way
3171.asset_description: Pale watercolour of a misty snowy forest where an old wooden signpost stands beside a track, its two arrow-shaped boards pointing in opposite directions; fir trees, dry grass and faint tyre tracks fade into the fog behind it.

3673.words: hot-air balloon (noun): a huge cloth balloon that lifts a basket
3673.asset_description: Warm flat illustration of a plain full of old brick temples in the morning haze. Six hot-air balloons with baskets hanging under them drift across the orange sky above the trees and spires while the sun rises behind the hills.

4013.words: deck (noun): a floor or platform built into a vessel
4013.asset_description: A first-person view looks down from the bow of a wooden sailing ship at the planking and rigging beneath, with the viewer's boots on the boards and loose pack ice drifting in the dark water either side. The camera lifts to a huge pale blue iceberg passing the varnished rail, then to snow-covered mountains mirrored in the flat polar sea.

4139.words: path (noun): a narrow marked way that you walk along
4139.asset_description: A travel sequence in thick mist. A man in a teal jacket stands on a windswept grassy hilltop swinging a big white sheet through the fog. Then a point-of-view shot looks down at a pair of orange trainers standing at the top of a long, narrow stone stairway that runs straight down the ridge and disappears into the cloud, with a huge rock pillar looming ahead. Next, an empty road runs between two rows of golden ginkgo trees towards a red pagoda under a cliff. In the last shot the man, now with a blue rucksack, walks away up a narrow dirt path worn through the green grass, past a wooden handrail, climbing towards the fog-covered rock tower above.

4141.words: lie (verb): to be lying flat, not standing
4141.asset_description: A travel sequence. Five young men in swimming shorts lie side by side on their backs on the low heather and grass beside a still forest lake, feet towards the camera, resting in the sun with dark pine trees on the far shore. The next shot shows friends lying stretched out in long grass on a hillside high above a patchwork of green fields, only their heads and knees showing above the grass. Then a point-of-view shot looks down a long red wooden staircase dropping down a green cliff towards a turquoise bay and a white beach far below. In the last shot the camera sits in the grass at the top of a cliff, legs stretched out in front, looking across at a wide waterfall pouring into a gorge under an orange sunset sky.

4239.words: port (noun): a place by the sea where ships load and unload
4239.asset_description: A first-person shot shows two gloved hands holding leather reins that run to a seagull flying just ahead, harnessed like a horse. The gull carries the camera over a huge suspension bridge half lost in fog, then drops down and races along a narrow strip of green water between two big red cargo ships tied up at a dock. It skims through the spray, and finally levels out over the harbour towards a white lighthouse with a city skyline behind it.
4239.transcript: Ready, my friend? It's my first time. Okay, easy, easy. No more tricks. Take me to the tower.

4245.words: slide (verb): to move easily over a slippery surface
4245.asset_description: A long concrete aqueduct wall runs through a jungle of tall palm trees, with water spilling over its edge as a wide waterfall. Young men lie on their backs in the shallow water on top of the concrete channel and slide along it with their arms flung out, throwing up spray. They then stand under the falling water at the foot of the wall, the white torrent pouring over their heads and shoulders. A drone shot pulls back to show the whole mossy wall, the sheet of falling water and one man still sliding along the top, surrounded by green jungle.

4296.words: signal (noun): a gesture or action that sends a message
4296.asset_description: An illustrated view down from an airport control tower at sunset: ground marshals in orange vests stand on the apron with both arms raised holding marshalling wands to guide the aircraft in, a tug tows a train of baggage carts past a dropped suitcase, fuel tankers cross the taxiway, airliners sit at their jet bridges, and beyond the grass another plane lifts off the runway under a windsock.

4297.words: departure (noun): the act of leaving, departing
4297.asset_description: A young traveller with a grey neck pillow and a rolling suitcase turns to the camera in a small airport lounge with a propeller plane parked outside; she then rides an escalator down through a huge terminal beneath an enormous departures board covered in flight listings, past rows of luggage trolleys and crowds, and past an indoor waterfall with airliners lined up at the windows behind it, her mouth open in amazement.

4301.words: gap (noun): an empty space between things
4301.asset_description: A young traveller with a backpack and a camera walks away down a whitewashed blue lane in a Moroccan medina hung with drying laundry, then turns into an extremely tight slot between two blue-painted walls; he edges through the narrow space almost sideways with a wall at his chest and his back, looking up at the sliver of sky above him, and squeezes out of the far end laughing.

4333.asset_description: A grey train slides to a stop alongside a raised strip of paving in a large railway station with a high arched glass roof. The doors open and a young woman with bleached hair, a green jacket and a black backpack steps down out of the carriage pulling a silver suitcase, grinning. She walks along the raised strip beside the train, past other passengers and departure screens, and at the end of it a group of friends run up and pile into a group hug around her.

4347.words: ferry (verb): to transport people from one place to another
4347.asset_description: A blonde woman in a teal swimsuit and a grey visor sits at the rail of a passenger boat that is carrying her across a sunlit harbour; the white sail-shaped roofs of the opera house slide past on the left, the steel arch of the harbour bridge on the right, and the boat's white wake churns below her. The clip cuts to her crouched in tall golden grass at dusk, holding her phone up in both hands to film a line of kangaroos moving across the plain against an orange sky. It cuts again to her riding a small board in on a shallow, sunlit shorebreak, then sitting in the white foam holding a yellow board, laughing at the camera.

4351.words: marble (noun): a hard rock that takes a high polish
4351.asset_description: A red-haired woman in a long cream trench coat over a floral dress turns and walks backwards across the gravel forecourt of a huge yellow baroque palace, laughing, with tall fountains playing behind her. The clip cuts inside to a grand hall lit by crystal chandeliers: she leans forward on the wide, honey-coloured polished stone balustrade of a staircase, her forearms resting on its veined surface, and looks down at a string quartet playing on the patterned floor below between two more stone columns. It cuts again to the view from a cable car climbing a green alpine slope towards snowy peaks, and ends with her inside the cabin throwing both arms wide and grinning at the camera with the mountains behind the window.

4357.words: canvas (noun): a heavy woven fabric used for sails or tents
4357.asset_description: A watercolour of a young woman stopped on a stony mountain trail, seen from behind and slightly to the side, her brown hair blowing across her face as she looks back down the path. She carries an enormous pale khaki rucksack made of thick woven cloth, painted so the weave and the creases show, with brown leather straps, buckles and a stitched patch on the lid, and a dented tin mug clipped to one side. One loose strap hangs down and trails on the ground behind her. The narrow path winds away below through rocks and pine trees, with blue ridges of hills and tall white clouds behind.

4363.asset_description: A young man in a hoodie and neck pillow leans on the railing at an airport baggage carousel, staring at the empty moving belt with an anxious face. Suitcases start coming past, one after another, and other passengers pull theirs off. Then his red backpack comes into view on the belt; his face lights up, he grabs it and hugs it to the camera.

4424.words: border (noun): the line where one country meets another
4424.asset_description: A selfie video on a road bridge on a bright winter day. A young man in a black beanie with a rucksack holds a small passport in one hand and grins at the camera; behind him two flags snap on poles and a queue of cars waits at a lifted red and white boom bar. He walks on along the footway past a glass control booth, and a broad painted stripe in blue, white and red runs across the road surface beneath his feet. He looks down at the painted stripe, steps over it, and walks on with the river and the far bank in view.

4438.words: parade (noun): a ceremonial procession of people marching
4438.asset_description: A travel montage. A red haired woman in a green playsuit juggles a football on her knee on a city beach with a twin peaked green mountain behind her. The camera then looks up a steep cog railway track running through dense green jungle. She stands on a viewing terrace looking up at a huge stone statue of Christ with outstretched arms, and a wide shot shows the statue on its plinth with crowds pressed along the railings and the bay far below. In the last shot she runs down the middle of a city street straight at the camera, laughing, with a line of carnival dancers in enormous pink, blue and green feather headdresses and sequinned costumes dancing forward behind her while confetti falls between the tower blocks.

4461.words: dig (verb): to turn up or remove earth
4461.asset_description: A bright beach with blue sea and sky. Two pairs of hands scoop and throw loose sand, working over a body-shaped mound; a pair of bare feet still sticks out at the far end. A hand pats the sand flat along the mound. The camera moves round to the head of the mound, where a grinning young man in sunglasses is buried up to the neck, only his head above the sand. He laughs and talks to the camera while the others keep patting sand around him.
4461.transcript: My friends bury me in the sand! Only my head is out.

4468.words: porter (noun): a person employed to carry luggage
4468.asset_description: A shopping trip through a covered market street. A hand passes a brown paper bag across while another hand lifts down a coloured mosaic lamp from a display of hanging lanterns. A smiling man in a bright patterned shirt takes the paper bag by its handles in front of stacks of painted plates and tea glasses. Then the camera follows a porter walking away down the narrow lane, carrying an enormous stack on his shoulders and head — rolled rugs, cushions, folded blankets, woven baskets and paper bags piled far above his head — with a silver teapot balanced on top.

4472.asset_description: A man in a red padded jacket, glasses and a fur hat rides a mountain cable car and cannot believe how high he gets. He grins into the camera inside the crowded cabin, then leans out of the window as the car floats over the tops of tall spruce trees. At a mountain station he walks across the platform to a gondola full of skiers with a sea of cloud behind him. Back inside, he stares open-mouthed out of the window as the cabin travels along a huge snow-streaked rock face, with the valley and further peaks far below.

4507.words: tag (noun): a label attached to something, showing its owner
4507.asset_description: An illustration of an airport check-in desk seen from behind the counter. A ground agent in a blue uniform and cap holds a long curling paper label and loops it around the handle of a battered brown leather suitcase that sits on the weighing plate. A second printed strip is already hanging from the handle. The passenger in a green jacket stands on the other side of the counter watching. Behind them the belt runs into a dark hatch, screens hang from the ceiling and three more travellers queue at a rope barrier.

4508.words: load (verb): to fill or place a load on something
4508.asset_description: A man in a navy t-shirt and glasses is at a busy airline counter with a trolley piled high with luggage. Holding his passport in his mouth, he heaves one heavy suitcase after another up from the trolley and swings them onto the metal belt beside the desk, finishing with a big black holdall lifted right over his shoulder. The agent behind the desk checks his documents on her screen. At the end he leans on the empty counter and grins, out of breath, with his passport in front of him.

4511.words: service (noun): work done by one person that benefits another
4511.asset_description: A man in a white polo shirt with sunglasses on his head is being looked after at an airline desk. He lifts a brown leather holdall onto the counter and the agent behind it, smiling the whole time, takes his details, tags the bag and hands him back his passport with the boarding pass tucked inside. He signs where she points, she lifts the tagged bag onto the belt, and he taps the counter and walks off happy while she watches him go.

4520.words: stretch (verb): to spread over a large, long area
4520.asset_description: An ink-and-colour illustration of the Great Wall. In the foreground a woman in a long blue coat and a scarf climbs a broad stone staircase carrying a painted paper lantern, and a red flag flies from the watchtower above her. Behind her the wall runs on and on in one unbroken line: over a green ridge, down into cloud, and up again over the far blue mountains until it disappears at the horizon. Pine trees cling to the slopes and swallows dart over the battlements.

4521.asset_description: A photograph on the Great Wall at sunrise. A woman in a red jacket and black trousers walks straight towards the camera along the brick walkway with her arms held out wide, a cream paper parasol in her left hand. Behind her the wall drops away to a square stone watchtower, and beyond that the wall and its towers climb over one wooded ridge after another until they fade into the mist and the pale gold sun far away.

4620.words: overnight (adverb): during or for one night
4620.asset_description: A charcoal drawing of an airport terminal in the middle of the night. A young man lies stretched across a row of metal seats with one arm flung over his forehead, a backpack beside him and a wheeled suitcase parked at his feet. Behind him more stranded passengers sleep across the seats, curled up in their coats. A big round clock on the wall reads about half past four. Beyond the black glass wall, planes sit on the dark apron. A cleaner pushes a mop cart down the empty concourse and a crushed paper cup lies on the floor.

4622.words: sigh (verb): to breathe out deeply and heavily
4622.asset_description: A woman with red hair in a mustard tracksuit sits at an airport gate holding her boarding pass. She throws her head back against the seat, opens her mouth and lets out a long groaning breath at the ceiling. She looks down at her watch, taps it, and checks it again. Later she has a grey travel pillow round her neck and her bare feet up on her suitcase as night falls outside the window. In the last shot she is lying flat out asleep across the row of seats with four empty coffee cups lined up on the floor beneath her.

4635.words: destination (noun): the place you are travelling to
4635.asset_description: A girl in a denim jacket stands in front of a torn-out photo of a lighthouse stuck on a wall and draws a circle on it with a marker, pointing at it. She is then on a train, looking out at the sea while holding the same photo. Finally she stands on a grassy clifftop at sunset and holds the photo up in front of her, lining it up with the real white lighthouse in front of her.

4636.words: lighthouse (noun): a tall sea tower whose light guides ships
4636.asset_description: A girl sits on a train next to a poster of a red-and-white striped lighthouse taped to the partition and draws a circle around it with a marker, then rests her chin on her hands and looks at it. She is then standing on a grassy clifftop at sunset, holding the poster up towards the real lighthouse, and finally turns to look up at the tall red-and-white tower with the sun setting over the sea behind it.

4680.words: rider (noun): a traveler who rides an animal like a horse
4680.asset_description: A photograph in the desert at Giza. A blonde woman with a beige scarf wrapped round her head and a loose linen shirt is climbing onto the back of a camel that is kneeling in the sand. She grips the wooden pommel of the leather saddle with both hands and swings one booted leg over the animal's back, kicking up a cloud of dust. Behind her stand the three great pyramids and the Sphinx in the dusty haze.

4708.words: guide (verb): to direct the course of someone's travel
4708.asset_description: A soft watercolour of a dirt track winding through vineyards and olive trees towards a little chapel with cypresses on a hill. A cream and orange minibus is stopped at the roadside with its door folded open. A boy in a straw hat and backpack jumps down from the step with his arms out, another boy in a yellow shirt points up the track, and a woman in a green dress runs after them with a wicker picnic basket and a camera. Ahead of them on the track a man in a white shirt with a lanyard holds a wooden paddle high above his head so the group can see where to follow, and a second picnic hamper stands on the ground by the bus.

4743.words: flight (noun): a journey traveling by air in a plane
4743.asset_description: A young man with headphones round his neck films himself in a window seat of an airliner. In the first shot the plane is racing along the ground past green fields and low houses outside the window and he grins into the camera as it lifts off. The shot cuts to cruising altitude at sunset: the wing and engine are lit orange above a floor of cloud, and he holds up a plastic cup of orange juice from the drinks trolley that a crew member is pushing past behind him. In the last shots it is night, and through the window a whole coastal city glows in orange lines of street lights far below as the plane descends; he turns from the window and claps his hands together with delight.

4770.words: boarding (noun): getting on a plane or ship as a passenger
4770.asset_description: A claymation airport departure area. A traveller with a backpack and a duffel bag walks through an open rounded door into a ribbed jet bridge tunnel. On the right an agent in a blue uniform and cap sits at a wooden desk with a monitor and raises a hand towards him. Blue rope barrier posts snake across the floor, rows of moulded seats stand empty and a white and red airliner waits outside the tall window.

4804.words: tour (verb): to make a trip round a place to see it
4804.asset_description: In a town of blue-painted houses a young local man in a striped robe leads a small group of tourists through narrow lanes, pointing things out and waving them on; they squeeze past a donkey pulling a wooden cart, walk under a blue archway and come out into a busy sunlit square.
4804.transcript: Follow me. Whoa, shh, low. Whoa, yes.

4813.words: harbour (noun): a sheltered place on the coast for boats
4813.asset_description: A young man in a wool jumper and rubber boots stands on a stone quay at sunrise with seagulls flying past. Behind him a small wooden boat is tied up on still water, then rows of white sailing yachts moored side by side; he runs his hand along a mooring line stretched from a yacht to the quay. Further along he leans on a rusty iron bollard with a thick rope coiled around it while a container ship is loaded by tall cranes and a tugboat crosses the water behind him.

4878.words: pier (noun): a wooden platform built out over the water
4878.asset_description: A young man in swim shorts dives head first off the end of a wooden platform that runs out from the shore over a green lake, and hits the water with a big splash. He surfaces in the ring of foam, two more people plunge in, and then a long platform on posts over turquoise water appears, lined with dozens of teenagers who all jump off it together.

4882.words: aircraft (noun): a vehicle that can fly
4882.asset_description: A line of people in matching gym kit hauls on a thick rope across a mown field, teeth gritted, dragging a wooden sled loaded with people, then an old saloon car. The scene cuts to an airfield where the same line of people pulls the rope hand over hand and drags a huge grey military transport plane, with four jet engines under its wings, along the tarmac towards the camera.

4906.words: tent (noun): a shelter of cloth stretched over poles
4906.asset_description: A garden party set-up on a mown lawn behind a wooden fence. First a colourful inflatable bouncy castle stands on the grass. Then a white party tent with window panels stands square on the lawn, its cloth roof stretched over a centre pole and weighted at the foot. A purple and yellow inflatable arch stands over the grass, then sags and folds flat as the air goes out of it, and a large inflatable slide collapses in the same way.

4921.words: trail (noun): a rough path through the countryside
4921.asset_description: Two young men with big backpacks walk a narrow rough path cut through a spruce forest on a hillside. A selfie shot shows one of them breathing hard; the path behind him is loose dirt and stones. They laugh and point at each other, then climb on over a stretch of the path knotted with tree roots and rocks. At the end they stand on bare rock at the top, drop their packs, and throw their arms up over a wide green forest valley.

4935.words: compass (noun): an instrument whose needle shows you north
4935.asset_description: A woman in a white captain's cap, navy jacket and rubber boots walks up a metal gangway in a marina. She takes hold of the big wooden ship's wheel of a boat, with white yachts and masts behind her. A close-up shows her finger touching a brass compass set into the console, its needle and marked dial clearly visible. She pushes a throttle lever as the boat moves over the water, then points ahead over the bow.

4942.words: luggage (noun): bags you carry your things in when traveling
4942.asset_description: A young man in a dark blue dress uniform walks out of the sliding doors of an airport arrivals hall with a large black duffel bag slung over his shoulder. He grins and looks around, walks through the bright glass concourse past waiting travellers, and reaches a family holding a hand-coloured WELCOME HOME sign. He hugs the father while the mother and a young woman laugh and cheer, then lifts his peaked cap off his head as they crowd around him.

4955.words: locker (noun): a storage box for your clothes and valuables
4955.asset_description: A cartoon of a crowded shared dorm room with metal bunk beds on both sides and a bank of tall grey lockers along the back wall. Washing lines strung across the room are hung with socks, underwear and small towels, and backpacks, hiking boots and rolled sleeping mats lie all over the floor and beds. One boy is climbing down from a top bunk and has thrown an orange rolled-up mat through the air; a small child standing on a lower bunk reaches out to catch it, while a boy on the top bunk opposite laughs so hard that tears fly off his face.

4973.words: monument (noun): a big old structure built to be remembered
4973.asset_description: A young traveller films himself in three places: first standing with arms thrown wide in front of a white marble domed mausoleum at the end of a long reflecting pool, then leaning grinning over cones of bright yellow, orange and red spice at a covered market stall, and finally in a street where people in white clothes hurl clouds of pink, yellow and green powder over each other, until his face and shirt are smeared with colour and he laughs into the lens.

5051.words: lose (verb): to put something where you cannot find it
5051.asset_description: A young woman in a hostel dorm with metal bunk beds tips a khaki backpack out onto the floor and rakes through the growing heap of clothes. She stands over the mess with her hands on her hips, mouth open in dismay, then kneels and searches under the bunk, shakes the empty backpack, and finally sits down on the bed holding her head, because whatever she is looking for is not there.

5053.words: label (noun): a short description that identifies something
5053.asset_description: In a bright kitchen a young woman in a hijab loops a clear plastic ID tag onto the pulled-up handle of a black hard-shell suitcase, threads the strap and clicks it shut, then shows the card with her photo and name inside. The scene cuts to an airport baggage hall, where she waits by the carousel with her phone; a black case with a bright pink fluffy tag comes round and she pulls it off the belt.

5161.words: cathedral (noun): a very large and important church
5161.asset_description: A young man in an orange rain jacket with a backpack films himself on a big city square in front of a brick church tower while pigeons take off around him, then at a wooden railing above a turquoise mountain lake ringed with rock walls, then at a wooden table in a restaurant where he lifts a spoonful from a plate piled with fried dumplings and eats with wide, delighted eyes.

5211.words: return (noun): a coming home again after time away
5211.asset_description: Keys hang in the lock of a wooden front door. A girl with braided hair hauls a sticker-covered suitcase in over the threshold, pulls it past the fridge into the flat, and stops in the middle of the living room with her arms spread wide, grinning as she takes in the familiar rooms. She spins round barefoot on the rug and then drops backwards onto her own bed, arms flung out.

5213.words: railway (noun): the line that runs trains for passengers
5213.asset_description: On a covered platform a boy holds a blank white sign above his head and a woman waits beside him with a bouquet, a red train standing at the platform edge and the rails running away past them. Passengers come out of the train and walk down the platform with their cases; a young woman in a denim jacket runs along the platform towards a man with a rucksack and jumps into his arms. The whole group closes around them in a hug, the flowers still in someone's hand.

5223.words: route (noun): the way you follow to get somewhere
5223.asset_description: A woman in a red headband stands at a trail map board in a pine forest and raises a finger as if fixing the way in her head, then runs along a dusty forest trail past a large pale boulder, places a stone on a cairn at the top, and finally stands at a viewpoint above a wide green valley holding an open map with a red line drawn on it.

5226.words: carriage (noun): a train car where passengers ride
5226.asset_description: Under the glass-and-iron roof of a station, a man in a beige trench coat with a green duffel bag runs down the platform beside a long dark green train while other travellers walk the other way with suitcases. He reaches an open door in the side of the train, grabs the frame and hauls himself in as it starts to move. The last shot is from the platform looking into the open doorway: he is standing inside the lit interior of the train, holding his bag against his chest and looking back out.

5232.words: yacht (noun): a boat with sails used for cruising or racing
5232.asset_description: A young woman in an orange sailing jacket and a dark beanie is on the varnished wooden deck of a classic sailing boat crossing a fjord, with a big white sail above her and steep mountains on both sides. She hauls on a rope running through a wooden block, then leans over the side and cranks a metal winch as the boat picks up speed and throws a white wake behind it. She sits back at the rail with a coil of rope in her hands, looks out over the water, and finally punches a fist into the air and shouts while a second crew member steers at the wheel behind her.

5272.words: hiker (noun): a person who walks long distances in nature
5272.asset_description: The same three backpackers at the Grand Canyon railing, filmed closer. The woman calls out over the canyon, the bearded man lets out a roar while she points at him laughing, and then all three throw their arms and fists up in the air and whoop together over the view.

5280.words: signpost (noun): a post with arms that point the way
5280.asset_description: A woman in a green fleece stands on a country lane beside a weathered wooden post whose two arms read VILLAGE and LAKE, and she touches one arm as she reads it. Next she stands in a town square under a tall metal post covered in arms pointing to MUSEUMS, HARBOUR and OLD BRIDGE, looking up at them. Finally the same kind of post stands on a grassy clifftop above the sea and she throws both arms up beside it, holding a water bottle.

5333.words: staircase (noun): a set of stairs inside a building
5333.asset_description: A young man with a backpack films himself from below as he climbs one staircase after another inside four different buildings: first a plain grey concrete stairwell, then a white spiral staircase, then a wooden staircase under a crystal chandelier, and finally a huge marble staircase covered in red carpet in a grand opera-house foyer. His eyes widen and his mouth opens further at every new staircase.

5423.words: worldwide (adjective): spread out across the entire world
5423.asset_description: One traveller with a large red rucksack appears in three completely different parts of the world in a row. First he walks across the wide stone square in front of the Eiffel Tower in Paris under a blue sky. Then he is sitting in a long narrow boat under a striped canopy, riding through a floating market where sellers in conical hats hold trays of vegetables out of their boats, and he reaches over to one of them. Finally he is walking over flat white snow in a green sun hat, with icebergs on the horizon and penguins standing behind him.

5491.asset_description: A young traveller with a rucksack and a suitcase arrives at the carved wooden gate of a tropical guesthouse. A smiling woman in a batik dress lifts a chain of white flowers over his head and settles it on his shoulders while the hosts laugh around him. A man carries out a tray of green coconuts with straws and hands him one, which he takes gladly and drinks. The whole household lines the path clapping and cheering, arms in the air, as he walks through the gate holding the coconut and grinning at the camera.

259.words: eerie (adjective): strange and a bit scary, in a quiet unsettling way
259.asset_description: A static night shot looks over a floodlit rail freight yard while a deep red glow pulses in the dark clouds on the horizon. The glow swells into a bright burning ball lighting the sky blood-red, then slowly shrinks and fades as wind howls over the scene.

320.words: frost (noun): a thin white layer of ice crystals on everything
320.asset_description: On a freezing sunrise morning, boots crunch over grass coated white with frost as a couple walks through a garden leaving dark footprints. They admire a frosty spiderweb, wipe an icy layer off a white bench, show a leaf edged in ice crystals and draw a line in the frost with a finger, saying 'Cool, cool, cool.'

378.words: sunrise (noun): the moment when the sun comes up in the morning
378.asset_description: A round animated bird sits on a balcony rail above a city, then takes off over the roofs; the shot holds on the low sun sitting on the horizon and throwing long golden rays across the rooftops as the bird shrinks to a dot flying straight into the light.

577.words: predict (verb): to say what will happen before it happens
577.asset_description: In a hand-painted anime seaside scene, a woman points up at a single dark cloud and calmly gets her yellow umbrella ready while the man beside her scoffs "No chance!". Seconds later rain pours down exactly as she said; she stays dry under the umbrella and he laughs, admitting "You knew it!".
577.transcript: No chance! Oh! Haha! You knew it!

1000.words: climate (noun): the usual weather of a region over many years
1000.asset_description: A wide mountain scene where a glacier melts down into a milky green meltwater lake; a lone researcher with a tripod stands on the rocky shore documenting it.

1173.words: lightning (noun): the bright electric flash in a storm sky
1173.asset_description: A huge branching bolt of lightning strikes down from purple storm clouds into the sea at night, lighting up dark cliffs and waves along the coast.

1270.words: puddle (noun): a small pool of rain water on the ground
1270.asset_description: A woman in a yellow raincoat and rubber boots stomps into a puddle on a cobblestone street by a brick wall, sending up a splash; her reflection shows in the water.

1308.words: shadow (noun): the dark shape you make by blocking light
1308.asset_description: A dancer in an orange dress leaps in mid-air beside a sunlit white wall, and her giant dark shadow repeats the leap across the wall.

1620.words: heaven (noun): the holy place above the clouds with angels
1620.asset_description: An old engraving of many winged cherubs flying together among thick clouds while rays of light stream down from above.

1786.words: meteor (noun): a space rock that burns as it falls
1786.asset_description: A space scene of dozens of glowing streaks raining down past a huge pink planet onto a snowy landscape under a starry sky.

1856.asset_description: Under a huge glowing night sky full of falling streaks of light and a bright moon, a tiny black figure stands alone on a dark meadow between hills.

1981.words: crash (verb): to hit something hard with a loud noise
1981.asset_description: Huge foaming green sea waves crash against the base of a black-and-white striped lighthouse under a dramatic stormy sunset sky.

2000.words: moonlight (noun): the light the moon gives at night
2000.asset_description: A fantasy painting of a huge glowing full moon hanging over a dark marshy waterway at night; the water is full of bright reflections and mossy banks line both sides.

2021.words: constellation (noun): a group of stars that forms a pattern
2021.asset_description: A flat winter illustration of a couple hugging in the snow beside a blue house; the smoke from its chimney opens into a dark starry sky where dotted lines connect stars into constellations, next to the words 'the most wonderful time of the year'.

2061.words: galaxy (noun): a huge group of stars and glowing dust
2061.asset_description: Swirling purple, blue and golden clouds of a glowing galaxy fill dark space, with a blazing bright star at the center and countless small stars around it.

2151.words: crescent (noun): the curved sliver shape of a moon
2151.asset_description: A vintage-toned crescent moon resting in soft peach clouds under a teal night sky dotted with four gold stars.

2225.asset_description: A young woman with soaked hair and water running down her face stands in heavy rain among bright red, blue and yellow umbrellas, herself without one.

2373.words: universe (noun): all of space with its stars and planets
2373.asset_description: A vast cosmic vista full of dark planets and moons of many sizes floating among glowing orange and blue nebula clouds, rocky space formations and countless sparks of starlight.

2462.words: starry (adjective): full of stars, said about a night sky
2462.asset_description: A whimsical illustration of an outdoor reading nook framed by two plant-draped bookshelves: between them a starry night sky glitters with golden stars around a glowing full moon, above an open handwritten book on a small stand among daisies.

2465.words: float (verb): to stay up in the air without falling
2465.asset_description: A blonde woman in a gold-and-white outfit hangs in a bright blue sky full of white clouds, surrounded by a huge golden ring of machinery and floating golden balls, with no ground under her feet.

2484.words: steeple (noun): the tall pointed tower of a church
2484.asset_description: A snow-covered village sits among white frosted trees under a huge pale moon, with the tall pointed steeple of its church rising at the center.

2523.words: snowfall (noun): snow coming down from the sky
2523.asset_description: Thick snow falls over a small village at dusk: snow-covered pine trees frame warmly lit cottages, and a snowy path with lampposts leads toward the houses under a pink-purple sky.

2531.words: sparkle (verb): to shine with many small flashing points
2531.asset_description: Two dark silhouettes, a man and a woman, stand close together on a grassy hill about to kiss, while the whole night sky above them sparkles with thousands of golden lights.

2641.words: ray (noun): a narrow line of light from a bright source
2641.asset_description: A robed long-haired figure in white and blue stands barefoot on a rocky hilltop with both arms spread wide, while golden and blue rays of light burst outward behind him across the whole sky; small flowers grow on the rock below.

2949.words: eclipse (noun): when a dark disc hides the sun
2949.asset_description: An astronaut stands alone on a red rocky plain, seen from behind, staring up at a black sphere covering the sun so only a fiery orange ring and glowing clouds are left in the sky.

2981.words: tornado (noun): a spinning column of wind reaching the ground
2981.asset_description: A digital illustration of a giant glowing green tornado spinning down from dark clouds onto a black mountain ridge; its funnel is built out of rings of numbers and code instead of dust.

3059.words: northern lights (noun): coloured lights waving in the far north sky
3059.asset_description: Digital illustration of a night sky over dark snowy mountains, with wide ribbons of green, blue and pink light curving down among the stars.

3395.words: fog (noun): thick cloud near the ground that hides things
3395.asset_description: Ink-wash landscape in grey and cream: dark pine trees grow out of a rocky cliff edge in the foreground while steep mountain peaks and more trees disappear into thick pale mist behind them.

3497.words: sunset (noun): the evening moment when the sun goes down
3497.asset_description: A woman in a long dusty pink dress walks away across warm sand, glancing back, while a huge orange sun sinks halfway below the flat horizon in front of her.

4093.asset_description: A telescope view of the moon against a black sky scattered with faint stars. At first only a small pale disc shows in the corner of the frame. The camera zooms in steadily until the moon fills most of the picture: a large round grey body with its curved bright edge on one side, the darker flat plains in the middle, and thousands of small craters picked out along the shadow line.

4200.asset_description: A fast drone shot at sunset. It sweeps over a dry clifftop past a single wide tree, where a woman in a white dress stands looking out to sea. It tips over the edge and dives towards a turquoise bay with a natural rock arch in the headland, then races low across the water past a lone swimmer. In the last shots the camera skims the sea surface straight towards the sun on the horizon, and the water and the cloudy sky are one sheet of deep warm yellow light.

4286.words: fan (verb): to move the air with something, like a fan
4286.asset_description: A cartoon of a woman slumped back in a striped deckchair on a lawn under a blazing sun, sweat running down her face, waving a folding paper fan at herself; a tall glass of iced lemonade stands on a wooden side table beside her, the flowers behind her droop, and a ginger cat lies flat out asleep in the shade.

4414.words: struggle (noun): an energetic attempt to achieve something
4414.asset_description: A bearded man in a bright orange jacket and a grey beanie stands on a grassy clifftop above a grey, white-capped sea. The wind rips his scarf out sideways and flattens the grass; he grabs at his hat to stop it flying off, turns his back to the gust, then bends forward and pushes himself uphill step by step, bracing his hands on his knees as the wind shoves him back.

4441.words: breath (noun): the process of taking in and letting out air
4441.asset_description: A woman in a bright patchwork ski jacket and striped hat stands on packed snow high in the mountains, the Matterhorn sharp against a deep blue sky behind her. She looks straight into the camera, purses her lips and breathes out hard, and a thick white cloud of warm air bursts from her mouth and drifts away in the cold. She does it again, laughing, and other walkers standing further back on the snow do the same, so several white puffs hang in the air at once.

4484.words: dawn (noun): the first light of day
4484.asset_description: A man in a red checked shirt kneels in a wooden canoe on a still turquoise mountain lake, mid-stroke with a wooden paddle. Behind him a wall of snow-capped rocky peaks catches the first low golden light of the morning on its faces while the lower slopes and pine forest are still in cold shadow, and a moose wades in the shallows near the far shore.

4493.words: struggle (verb): to make a strenuous effort
4493.asset_description: A black and white woodcut-style illustration of an old bearded seaman in a peaked cap on the deck of a ship in a storm at night. He is braced with both fists clamped on the spokes of the big wooden steering wheel, teeth gritted and leaning his whole weight into it to hold the ship on course while a towering wave curls over the rail behind him, rain slashes down and a lantern swings on its rope above his head.

4661.words: fall (noun): the season when leaves fall from the trees
4661.asset_description: A bearded man in a checked jacket stands in a park under a huge maple tree whose leaves have turned bright yellow. He tips his head back and looks up into the branches. Yellow leaves start drifting down through the frame, and he holds out both hands to catch them as they fall past him. The ground around him is already carpeted in fallen yellow leaves, with red and orange trees behind him and people walking in the distance. At the end he bends forward, laughing, as the leaves keep coming down.

4721.words: fade (verb): to become less clearly visible
4721.asset_description: A woman in a soaking wet orange hooded raincoat films herself on a grassy hillside above a lake, grinning and pointing back over her shoulder at a full rainbow arching right across the grey sky. She turns to look at it, and second by second the colours grow weaker: first the left hand side thins out, then only a short faint band is left low on the right, and then the sky is empty and grey. She keeps standing there in the wet grass looking at the place where it was.

4817.words: drought (noun): a long time with a shortage of rain
4817.asset_description: A cartoon drawing of a burnt orange landscape under a huge spiralling sun. The ground in the foreground is baked hard and split into deep cracks, and a winding riverbed running through the hills has dried to a thick orange sludge. A shaggy dog lies panting in the last of it with its tongue out, a lone tree droops and melts like wax, and a man in a soaked shirt walks slowly forward wiping his forehead as heat lines rise off the ground around him.

4821.words: sunset (noun): the evening moment when the sun goes down
4821.asset_description: Filmed from inside a car looking out of the open window across an empty marked car park. The sun sits low on the horizon at the end of the tarmac and floods the whole shot with orange light, throwing a long shadow behind a woman walking towards the car. She is barefoot in a white summer dress and carries a flat pizza box in both hands; she comes up to the window smiling, leans in and hands the pizza box through it while the sun goes down behind her.
4821.transcript: I bring your pizza. I am your sunshine today.

5002.words: dusk (noun): the fading light just before night
5002.asset_description: A calm forest lake in fading evening light, the sun already gone behind the pine treeline and the sky still warm orange. A man in green shorts leaps off the end of a wooden jetty and lands in the water with a ring of spray. More people then run down the jetty and throw themselves in one after another, each raising a burst of white splash, until several heads are bobbing in the dark water while the last daylight drains out of the sky.

5041.words: flash (noun): a sudden burst of bright light
5041.asset_description: An anime-style illustration of a night storm over a city. Thick black clouds fill the top of the frame, and a huge white-violet bolt of lightning splits the sky and slams down onto a wet concrete rooftop, bursting into a blinding white flash with sparks and debris flying out sideways. Smaller branching bolts spread across the clouds, rain falls in streaks, and the skyscrapers behind the roof are lit violet by the strike.

5252.words: tropical (adjective): from the hot wet regions near the equator
5252.asset_description: A street fruit seller in a conical straw hat stands behind an enormous pyramid of yellow and green mangoes stacked on her stall on a hot Vietnamese street, with scooters and shophouses passing behind her. A brass pan balance hangs on chains beside the fruit. She smiles, takes a mango, and holds open a brown paper bag; a close-up shows hands dropping spiky red rambutans into the bag over a bed of more rambutans and mangoes. A wide shot shows the whole mango pyramid with a pineapple perched on top under a blue awning. At the end she laughs happily and reaches across the wooden counter to hand the bag over.

5446.words: misty (adjective): covered in thin fog that hides things
5446.asset_description: A short travel montage of a young woman in a mustard-yellow raincoat. First she leans out of a red telephone box on a city street, one arm raised in a wave, with a huge clock tower behind her and a red double-decker bus passing. Then she is out on a green hillside where low grey cloud sits right down on the hills: the far slopes fade into white haze and the long lake in the valley below is half swallowed by it, so you cannot see where the hills end. She walks along the ridge in the drizzle, looking out over the hazy valley. Finally she stands on a wooden seaside pier under a clear blue sky, laughing and eating chips out of a paper cone with the surf rolling in behind her.

240.words: draw (noun): a result where neither side wins
240.asset_description: A woman and a burly man arm-wrestle fiercely at a kitchen table while the family and a grandma watch. Neither can push the other's hand down, and the match ends with both arms collapsing at the same time and everyone laughing as grandma lays a towel over their locked fists.

322.words: gambling (noun): playing games for money, hoping to win even more
322.asset_description: In a 3D-animated casino, a woman in a green suit slams a tower of chips onto red at a spinning wheel; she and a nervous man despair as the wheel lands, then she wins a huge pile of chips and celebrates wildly.

515.words: overcome (verb): to succeed against something that holds you back
515.asset_description: In a 3D-animated climbing gym, a young woman fights her way up a tall climbing wall, gritting her teeth, slipping and dangling on the rope but refusing to quit. She hauls herself over the top edge and raises both fists as the crowd below cheers.

564.words: podium (noun): the three-step stand where winners stand
564.asset_description: In a gymnastics hall, athletes push three foam blocks together to build a three-step winners' podium while teammates watch. Three gymnasts in tracksuits climb onto first, second and third place; the winner in the middle throws her arms up, then all three join hands, wave and bow.

594.words: qualify (verb): to reach the standard to go through
594.asset_description: In a hand-painted animated athletics meet a girl arches over the high-jump bar and lands on the mat without knocking it off. An official waves a green flag, the crowd and rival jumpers applaud, and she pumps her fists — she is through to the next round.

794.words: tournament (noun): a series of matches until one winner is left
794.asset_description: In a Ghibli-style seaside village, crowds watch an arm-wrestling tournament at rows of tables while an official moves portrait tokens up a wooden bracket board after each match; a small bald boy beats a huge bearded sailor in the final and is lifted up as champion.
794.transcript: Ready, go! You are strong. Champion on the left!

847.words: victory (noun): winning a competition or a race
847.asset_description: In a hand-painted anime rowing race, a determined crew sprints their red boat down a lantern-lined river and crosses the finish line first, breaking the tape. They raise their oars, hug, and carry the rower on their shoulders while the crowd cheers.

1441.words: effort (noun): the hard work you put into something
1441.asset_description: A tennis player with a leg brace and crutches stands on a podium holding a big silver trophy; giant wooden letters behind her and the banner below read 'WORTH THE EFFORT' while confetti falls and photographers shoot.

4617.words: fight (verb): to be engaged in a fight
4617.asset_description: A medieval re-enactment battle on a grass field in front of a large crowd. A bald, red-bearded man in chainmail and steel arm and leg armour shoves forward behind a painted round shield, roaring. Two knots of fighters slam into each other and grind together, shields locked, shoving and swinging. One fighter is knocked down and lies on the grass while the others keep pushing over him. Spectators watch from behind a rope barrier with flags flying above them.

4618.words: charge (noun): a sudden rush toward someone or something
4618.asset_description: A viking re-enactment in front of a packed grandstand. A grinning red-bearded warrior crouches behind a big round blue shield with a metal boss. He and the fighters beside him lock their painted shields into a solid wall, then break into a run and rush forward together across the grass, shields level and heads down. Bodies go down on the field. The clip ends with the red-bearded man standing over the fallen, raising his sword in one hand and his shield in the other.

4652.words: compete (verb): to take part in a contest against others
4652.asset_description: At an outdoor event a crowd presses against a barrier to watch an arm-wrestling table. A woman with a red flower in her hair grips hands with a man across the padded table, both leaning in with their elbows planted on the pads. Their faces strain and their mouths open as they push; the crowd behind them laughs and reacts. In the last seconds the tension breaks and the same people sit together laughing, holding plastic cups of drink at the table.

4752.asset_description: A young man in a white apron is baking in a bright kitchen. He looks worried at the hob, where a pale pancake sits in a frying pan and he prods it with a spatula. He pulls on black oven gloves and opens the oven, which glows orange inside. He lifts out a baking tray of biscuits that have come out completely black and cracked, holds it up, and leans over it with his face screwed up in disappointment.

4879.words: competition (noun): an event where a winner is chosen
4879.asset_description: At an outdoor strength contest a woman in a black lifting suit and belt presses a loaded barbell overhead, then hauls a huge grey stone up to her chest and above her head. Next she balances a thick length of tree trunk, bark still on and the sawn end showing, across her shoulders, and finally holds a small black car over her head while the crowd watches from behind a rope.

4999.words: combat (verb): to battle against someone in a fight
4999.asset_description: A manga-style drawing inside a wooden training hall. A barefoot young man in a dark blue training robe grips a long bamboo sword in both hands and drives forward against an opponent, whose own bamboo sword and gloved hands come in from the left edge of the frame. Speed lines cut across the whole picture, dust bursts from the floorboards under his heel, and a Japanese flag hangs on the wall behind him with a stone garden visible through the open sliding doors.

5050.asset_description: An election night party in a small hall decorated with balloons, banners and a table of drinks and pastries. A grey-haired man in a suit with a blue-and-white rosette holds a microphone in front of a screen showing a bar chart of the results, and his face collapses as he reads it. The guests get up and walk out, leaving rows of empty chairs and confetti on the floor. He sits alone on a bench under the screen staring ahead, then drops his head into both hands.

5182.words: achievement (noun): the action of finishing something difficult
5182.asset_description: A woman in paint-spattered dungarees and a headband paints the last strokes of a huge mural of suns and waves on a city wall from a stepladder, then climbs down, backs onto the pavement and stands with her hands on her hips, looking up at the finished painting and smiling.

5349.words: award (verb): to give something as an honor or reward
5349.asset_description: A ceremonial hall hung with flags: a silver-haired woman in a dark dress uniform and white gloves pins a decoration onto the chest of a young man in black tie, while a rank of soldiers in dress uniform stands to one side. She moves along the line to the next man and pins a medal on him too. The camera then pulls back to reveal the man she is decorating: his whole chest and stomach are plated with hundreds of medals and ribbons in overlapping rows, from collar to waist. He beams and laughs as she adds one more.

5366.words: surrender (verb): to give up to the power of another
5366.asset_description: A player in a paint-spattered boiler suit and helmet kneels behind a wooden barricade on a field of hay bales and oil drums, aiming a paintball marker. Paint bursts near him, he sets the marker down on the ground, raises one gloved hand, then stands up with both arms high above his head, grinning, as other players walk in behind him.

5384.words: champion (noun): someone who won first place in a competition
5384.asset_description: A cartoon drawing of a sports team on a green pitch just after winning. Ten players in red-and-yellow striped shirts and shorts pile together, mouths open in a roar, fists in the air. One player is hoisted above the others, arms spread wide, laughing; a ball and a water bottle fly through the air over his head. Behind them a blurred crowd in the stands cheers and the goal posts rise into an orange sunset sky.

5385.words: win (noun): a victory in a race or a competition
5385.asset_description: A group in matching yellow shirts huddles in a tight circle on a blue outdoor volleyball court, heads together, psyching each other up. They break and play: one dives flat to dig the ball, another jumps at the net and smashes it over, the opposing players jump to block. The rally ends in their favour and the whole squad runs together into one big hug, jumping and shouting under palm trees and a bright blue sky.
